e-mail.t:
n. 电子邮件
v. 发邮件

e.en: Please send me an {e-mail} with the meeting agenda.
e.zh: 请给我发一封带会议议程的邮件。

e.en: I'll {e-mail} you the contract before noon tomorrow.
e.zh: 我明天中午前会把合同邮件发给你。

e.en: I get hundreds of {e-mails} every single workday.
e.zh: 我每个工作日都会收到几百封邮件。

e.en: She {e-mails} her clients a newsletter every Friday.
e.zh: 她每周五给客户发一封邮件简报。

each.t:
adj. 每个
pron. 每一个

e.en: {Each} student gets a free laptop on the first day.
e.zh: 每位学生在开学第一天都能领到一台免费笔记本。

e.en: The cupcakes cost three dollars {each}.
e.zh: 这些纸杯蛋糕每个三美元。

e.en: The kids were {eager} to open their birthday presents.
e.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开生日礼物。

e.en: She's {eager} to start her new job next Monday.
e.zh: 她迫切希望下周一开始新工作。

e.en: Fans {eagerly} awaited the release of the new album.
e.zh: 粉丝们热切地期待着新专辑的发行。

e.en: The puppy {eagerly} chased the tennis ball across the yard.
e.zh: 小狗兴奋地追着网球穿过院子。

e.en: His {eagerness} to please impressed the interview panel.
e.zh: 他想要表现的热切态度给面试官留下了深刻印象。

e.en: She accepted the offer with obvious {eagerness}.
e.zh: 她带着明显的热切接受了这份邀请。

e.en: The coach noticed different {eagernesses} among the new recruits.
e.zh: 教练注意到新队员们各种程度的求胜欲。

e.en: Their conflicting {eagernesses} sometimes slowed group decisions.
e.zh: 他们各自不同的热切诉求有时会拖慢集体决策。

e.en: A bald {eagle} soared high above the lake.
e.zh: 一只白头海雕在湖面高空翱翔。

e.en: She sank a long putt for {eagle} on the par five.
e.zh: 她在五杆洞推进一记长推得到老鹰球。

e.en: Golden {eagles} can spot prey from over a mile away.
e.zh: 金雕能从一英里外发现猎物。

e.en: The Philadelphia {Eagles} won the Super Bowl that year.
e.zh: 费城老鹰队那年赢得了超级碗冠军。

e.en: The {eaglet} took its first wobbly flight from the cliff nest.
e.zh: 小鹰从悬崖巢中第一次摇摇晃晃地飞起。

e.en: Rangers monitored the {eaglet} until its feathers fully developed.
e.zh: 护林员一直观察这只幼鹰，直到它羽翼丰满。

e.en: Leslie Knope works in {Eagleton}'s rival town hall.
e.zh: 莱斯利·诺普在与鹰顿镇竞争的市政厅工作。

e.en: The fictional town of {Eagleton} appears throughout the sitcom.
e.zh: 虚构小镇鹰顿贯穿整部情景喜剧。

e.en: She rented a flat in {Ealing}, west London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦西部的伊灵租了一套公寓。

e.en: The classic British comedies were filmed at {Ealing} Studios.
e.zh: 那些经典英国喜剧片是在伊灵制片厂拍摄的。

ear.t: n. 耳朵；(谷物的) 穗

e.en: He whispered a secret into her {ear}.
e.zh: 他在她耳边低声说了个秘密。

e.en: The dog perked up its {ear} at the doorbell.
e.zh: 狗一听到门铃就竖起了耳朵。

e.en: My toddler woke up crying with a bad {earache}.
e.zh: 我家小孩半夜哭醒，耳朵疼得厉害。

e.en: Swimming in cold water gave him an {earache}.
e.zh: 在冷水里游泳让他得了耳痛。

e.en: Frequent {earaches} in childhood led to her hearing loss.
e.zh: 童年时频繁的耳痛导致了她的听力下降。

e.en: Cold winds often trigger {earaches} for sensitive kids.
e.zh: 冷风常常让敏感的孩子耳朵痛。

e.en: The loud explosion nearly burst his {eardrum}.
e.zh: 那声巨响差点震破他的鼓膜。

e.en: Doctors examined her {eardrum} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查她的耳膜是否有感染迹象。

e.en: A long-{eared} rabbit hopped across the lawn.
e.zh: 一只长耳朵的兔子蹦过草坪。

e.en: Floppy-{eared} dogs are especially prone to ear infections.
e.zh: 垂耳的狗特别容易得耳部感染。

e.en: He pulled the {earflap} down to block the icy wind.
e.zh: 他把护耳放下来，挡住刺骨的寒风。

e.en: Her winter hat has a soft fleece {earflap} on each side.
e.zh: 她的冬帽两侧各有一片柔软的绒毛护耳。

earful.t: n. 一顿臭骂；一通唠叨

e.en: Mom gave me an {earful} for missing curfew.
e.zh: 我没按时回家，被妈妈狠狠教训了一顿。

e.en: The customer gave the manager an {earful} about the delay.
e.zh: 顾客就延误的事把经理数落了一通。

e.en: He shouted right into my {earhole} as a joke.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地对着我耳孔大喊。

e.en: Tiny insects sometimes crawl into a child's {earhole}.
e.zh: 小虫子有时会爬进小孩的耳洞里。

e.en: The {earl} owned a vast estate in the countryside.
e.zh: 那位伯爵在乡下拥有一大片庄园。

e.en: She married an {earl} and moved into his castle.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位伯爵，搬进了他的城堡。

e.en: He inherited the {earldom} after his father's death.
e.zh: 父亲去世后，他继承了伯爵的爵位。

e.en: The {earldom} has been in the family for centuries.
e.zh: 这个伯爵爵位在他们家族已经传了几个世纪。

e.en: The {earless} seal basked lazily on the rocky shore.
e.zh: 那只无耳海豹懒洋洋地躺在岩石海岸上晒太阳。

e.en: Some lizard species are completely {earless} on the outside.
e.zh: 有些蜥蜴种类外表上完全没有耳朵。

earlier.t:
adj. 更早的
adv. 较早地

e.en: I'll see you {earlier} tomorrow if traffic cooperates.
e.zh: 如果路上不堵，明天我会早点见你。

e.en: She mentioned the issue {earlier} in the meeting.
e.zh: 她在会议上较早的时候提过这个问题。

earliest.t:
adj. 最早的
adv. 最早地

e.en: Book your tickets at the {earliest} opportunity.
e.zh: 请尽早订票。

e.en: This is the {earliest} known photograph of the family.
e.zh: 这是已知最早的一张这家人的照片。

e.en: She got her {earlobe} pierced at the mall.
e.zh: 她在商场穿了耳垂的耳洞。

e.en: The cold wind made his {earlobe} turn bright red.
e.zh: 寒风把他的耳垂吹得通红。

e.en: Several {earls} attended the king's coronation ceremony.
e.zh: 几位伯爵参加了国王的加冕典礼。

e.en: The {earls} of England once held enormous political power.
e.zh: 英格兰的伯爵们曾掌握巨大的政治权力。

early.t:
adj. 早的；早期的
adv. 提前

e.en: She arrived {early} to grab a good seat.
e.zh: 她早早到场，抢了个好位置。

e.en: In the {early} 2000s, smartphones didn't exist yet.
e.zh: 在2000年代初期，智能手机还不存在。

earmark.t:
v. 指定用途；拨专款
n. 特征

e.en: Lawmakers will {earmark} funds for rural schools.
e.zh: 立法者将专门拨款给农村学校。

e.en: The company plans to {earmark} profits for research.
e.zh: 公司计划把利润专门用于研发。

earmarked.t: v. 已指定用途（过去式）

e.en: The grant was {earmarked} for cancer research only.
e.zh: 这笔拨款专门指定用于癌症研究。

e.en: They've {earmarked} him as the next CEO.
e.zh: 他们已经把他选定为下一任首席执行官。

e.en: You can {earn} extra cash by tutoring online.
e.zh: 你可以通过在线辅导挣点外快。

e.en: It takes years to {earn} a customer's trust.
e.zh: 赢得顾客的信任需要好多年。

e.en: She {earned} a promotion after six months on the team.
e.zh: 她加入团队半年后就升职了。

e.en: He {earned} every dollar through honest hard work.
e.zh: 他每一分钱都是靠诚实的辛勤劳动赚来的。

earner.t: n. 赚钱的人；赚钱项目

e.en: She is the main {earner} in her household.
e.zh: 她是家里的主要经济支柱。

e.en: That side hustle turned into a steady {earner}.
e.zh: 那个副业变成了稳定的收入来源。

e.en: As an {easterner}, he found California's culture fascinating.
e.zh: 作为一个东部人,他觉得加州的文化十分迷人。

e.en: The cowboys teased the young {easterner} about his accent.
e.zh: 牛仔们拿那个东部来的年轻人的口音开玩笑。

e.en: Maine is the {easternmost} state in the US.
e.zh: 缅因州是美国最东端的州。

e.en: The {easternmost} island in the chain is uninhabited.
e.zh: 群岛中最东端的那座岛上无人居住。

e.en: We're meeting at the {Eastgate} shopping center at noon.
e.zh: 我们中午在东门购物中心碰面。

e.en: The bus stops right outside {Eastgate} station.
e.zh: 公交车就停在东门站外面。

e.en: She grew up in {Eastham}, a quiet town on Cape Cod.
e.zh: 她在科德角的安静小镇伊斯特姆长大。

e.en: The ferry from {Eastham} runs only in summer.
e.zh: 从伊斯特姆出发的渡轮只在夏季运营。

eastleigh.t: n. 伊斯特利（英国城镇）

e.en: He commutes from {Eastleigh} to London every weekday.
e.zh: 他每个工作日都从伊斯特利通勤到伦敦。

e.en: {Eastleigh} has a busy railway station near Southampton.
e.zh: 伊斯特利在南安普顿附近有一座繁忙的火车站。

e.en: George {Eastman} founded the Kodak photography company.
e.zh: 乔治·伊士曼创立了柯达摄影公司。

e.en: She studied piano at the {Eastman} School of Music.
e.zh: 她在伊士曼音乐学院学习钢琴。

e.en: We drove through {Easton} on the way to the coast.
e.zh: 我们去海边的路上经过了伊斯顿。

e.en: {Easton} is a small town nestled in the Pennsylvania hills.
e.zh: 伊斯顿是一座坐落在宾夕法尼亚山间的小镇。

easts.t: n. east 的复数；东部地区

e.en: The compass needle points to magnetic and true {easts}.
e.zh: 指南针的指针指向磁北东向和真东向两个方位。

e.en: Sailors distinguish between several {easts} when navigating.
e.zh: 水手在导航时会区分几种不同的东方方位。

eastward.t:
adv. 向东
adj. 朝东的

e.en: The pioneers traveled {eastward} back to their homeland.
e.zh: 拓荒者向东返回他们的故乡。

e.en: Storm clouds are moving {eastward} across the plains.
e.zh: 暴风云正向东掠过平原。

e.en: The river flows {eastwards} to the Pacific Ocean.
e.zh: 这条河向东流入太平洋。

e.en: They sailed {eastwards} for three weeks before sighting land.
e.zh: 他们向东航行了三周才看到陆地。

eastwood.t: n. 伊斯特伍德（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Clint {Eastwood} directed several award-winning films.
e.zh: 克林特·伊斯特伍德执导了多部获奖影片。

e.en: My grandfather loved every {Eastwood} western ever made.
e.zh: 我爷爷喜欢伊斯特伍德拍过的每一部西部片。

e.en: The recipe is really {easy} for beginners to follow.
e.zh: 这个食谱对新手来说真的很容易上手。

e.en: Take it {easy} this weekend and get some rest.
e.zh: 这周末放轻松一些,好好休息。

e.en: My new boss is incredibly {easy-going} and approachable.
e.zh: 我的新老板非常随和,容易亲近。

e.en: He has an {easy-going} attitude that makes work pleasant.
e.zh: 他随和的态度让工作变得愉快。

e.en: She's so {easygoing} that nothing seems to stress her out.
e.zh: 她非常随和,似乎没什么能让她感到紧张。

e.en: We need an {easygoing} roommate who doesn't mind guests.
e.zh: 我们需要一位随和、不介意有客人来的室友。

e.en: Let's {eat} pizza for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 咱们今晚吃披萨当晚餐吧。

e.en: You should {eat} more vegetables to stay healthy.
e.zh: 你应该多吃蔬菜以保持健康。

e.en: The burnt toast was barely {eatable} this morning.
e.zh: 今早那片烤焦的吐司几乎没法吃。

e.en: After adding salt, the soup became actually {eatable}.
e.zh: 加了盐之后,这汤总算可以入口了。

e.en: I have already {eaten} lunch, thanks for asking.
e.zh: 我已经吃过午饭了,谢谢关心。

e.en: Half the cake was {eaten} before the party even started.
e.zh: 派对还没开始,蛋糕就被吃掉一半了。

eater.t: n. 进食者；食用某物的人

e.en: My son is a really picky {eater} these days.
e.zh: 我儿子最近变得非常挑食。

e.en: The panda is a slow {eater} but consumes huge amounts.
e.zh: 熊猫吃东西慢,但食量惊人。

e.en: There's a great little {eatery} on the corner serving tacos.
e.zh: 街角有家很棒的小餐馆,卖墨西哥卷饼。

e.en: This new {eatery} has gone viral on social media.
e.zh: 这家新开的小餐馆在社交媒体上火了。

eating.t:
n. 吃；饮食
v. eat 的现在分词

e.en: I'm {eating} ramen while watching Netflix tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚一边看奈飞一边吃拉面。

e.en: Healthy {eating} habits start with planning your meals.
e.zh: 健康的饮食习惯始于规划好每一餐。

e.en: Mr. {Eaton} has been our math teacher for ten years.
e.zh: 伊顿先生已经当我们的数学老师十年了。

e.en: The {Eaton} family hosts a barbecue every summer.
e.zh: 伊顿一家每年夏天都会举办烧烤聚会。

eats.t:
n. 吃的东西；食物
v. eat 的第三人称单数

e.en: Let's grab some cheap {eats} at the food court.
e.zh: 我们去美食广场吃点便宜的东西吧。

e.en: My dog {eats} twice a day, morning and evening.
e.zh: 我的狗每天早晚各吃一次。

eau.t: n. 水（法语，多用于香水名）

e.en: She sprayed some {eau} de cologne before leaving.
e.zh: 她出门前喷了些古龙水。

e.en: The boutique sells expensive {eau} de parfum from Paris.
e.zh: 这家精品店出售来自巴黎的昂贵香水。

e.en: A bird built its nest under the {eave} of our house.
e.zh: 一只鸟在我家屋檐下筑了巢。

e.en: Icicles hung from every {eave} during the cold winter.
e.zh: 寒冬里每个屋檐下都挂着冰柱。

e.en: It's rude to {eavesdrop} on private conversations.
e.zh: 偷听别人的私人谈话是不礼貌的。

e.en: I didn't mean to {eavesdrop}, but the walls are thin.
e.zh: 我并不是想偷听,只是墙壁太薄了。

e.en: The nosy {eavesdropper} pressed her ear against the door.
e.zh: 那个爱打听的偷听者把耳朵贴在了门上。

e.en: An {eavesdropper} in the café overheard the entire pitch.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里的一个偷听者听到了整个推销过程。

e.en: Stop {eavesdropping} on your sister's phone calls!
e.zh: 别再偷听你姐姐的电话了!

e.en: The app was caught {eavesdropping} on users' microphones.
e.zh: 这款应用被发现在偷听用户的麦克风。

ebb.t:
n. 退潮；衰退
v. 退潮；衰减

e.en: Her enthusiasm began to {ebb} as the meeting dragged on.
e.zh: 会议拖得越久，她的热情就越发减退。

e.en: We watched the tide {ebb} slowly from the shore.
e.zh: 我们看着潮水从岸边缓缓退去。

ebbed.t: v. ebb 的过去式；退去；衰减

e.en: His confidence {ebbed} after the third rejection email.
e.zh: 收到第三封拒信后，他的信心一点点消退了。

e.en: The fever {ebbed} by morning, leaving her exhausted.
e.zh: 到早晨烧退了，但她已经筋疲力尽。

ebbing.t: v. ebb 的现在分词；正在退去

e.en: With his energy {ebbing}, he finally agreed to rest.
e.zh: 体力渐渐不支，他终于同意休息一下。

e.en: The {ebbing} tide revealed a stretch of wet sand.
e.zh: 退潮露出了一片湿漉漉的沙滩。

ebbs.t:
v. ebb 的第三人称单数
n. 退潮（复数）

e.en: Public interest in the show {ebbs} every summer.
e.zh: 每到夏天，观众对这档节目的兴趣就会减退。

e.en: Life has its flows and {ebbs}, just like the sea.
e.zh: 人生有起有落，就像潮水一样。

e.en: The poet described her {ebon} hair shining in moonlight.
e.zh: 诗人形容她乌黑的头发在月光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: A single {ebon} feather lay on the windowsill.
e.zh: 窗台上躺着一根乌黑的羽毛。

e.en: The shop sells {ebonized} oak chairs at premium prices.
e.zh: 那家店出售经过乌木染色处理的橡木椅，价格不菲。

e.en: He admired the {ebonized} frame around the old portrait.
e.zh: 他欣赏着那幅老画像周围的乌木染色画框。

ebony.t:
n. 乌木；黑檀
adj. 乌黑的

e.en: The piano's keys were carved from polished {ebony}.
e.zh: 钢琴的黑键由打磨光亮的乌木雕成。

e.en: She wore an elegant dress in deep {ebony} black.
e.zh: 她穿着一条深乌木黑色的优雅连衣裙。

ebrd.t: n. 欧洲复兴开发银行（EBRD）

e.en: The {EBRD} approved a loan to upgrade the country's rail network.
e.zh: 欧洲复兴开发银行批准了一笔贷款用于升级该国的铁路网。

e.en: Several startups received funding through an {EBRD} green initiative.
e.zh: 多家初创公司通过欧洲复兴开发银行的绿色项目获得了资金。

ebullience.t: n. 热情洋溢；兴高采烈

e.en: Her {ebullience} on stage made the whole audience smile.
e.zh: 她在台上洋溢的热情让全场观众都笑了。

e.en: The puppy's {ebullience} was hard to manage in small apartments.
e.zh: 小狗那股欢腾劲儿在小公寓里实在难以应付。

ebullient.t: adj. 热情洋溢的；兴高采烈的

e.en: He was {ebullient} after winning his first design award.
e.zh: 获得首个设计奖后，他兴奋得不得了。

e.en: The crowd grew {ebullient} as the home team scored.
e.zh: 主队进球时，观众激动得欢呼雀跃。

e.en: They had brunch at a quiet café in {Ebury} Street.
e.zh: 他们在伊伯里街一家安静的咖啡馆吃了早午餐。

e.en: The novel's main character grew up near {Ebury} Square.
e.zh: 小说的主角在伊伯里广场附近长大。

ecc.t: n. 纠错码（Error-Correcting Code 缩写）

e.en: Server memory uses {ECC} to detect and correct random bit errors.
e.zh: 服务器内存使用 ECC 来检测和纠正随机位错误。

e.en: Many cryptocurrencies rely on {ECC} for digital signatures.
e.zh: 许多加密货币依赖椭圆曲线密码学（ECC）来生成数字签名。

eccentric.t:
adj. 古怪的；怪异的
n. 怪人

e.en: Their neighbor is a charming but {eccentric} retired professor.
e.zh: 他们的邻居是一位迷人却有点古怪的退休教授。

e.en: She has an {eccentric} habit of naming every houseplant.
e.zh: 她有个怪癖，会给家里每盆植物都取名字。

e.en: He dresses {eccentrically}, mixing vintage suits with neon sneakers.
e.zh: 他穿着古怪，把复古西装和荧光球鞋搭在一起。

e.en: The artist behaves {eccentrically} at every gallery opening.
e.zh: 那位艺术家每次画廊开幕都举止古怪。

e.en: His small {eccentricities} made him beloved by the team.
e.zh: 他那些小怪癖让团队成员都很喜欢他。

e.en: The novel celebrates the {eccentricities} of village life.
e.zh: 这部小说赞颂了乡村生活的种种古怪之处。

e.en: A touch of {eccentricity} can make a designer stand out.
e.zh: 一点点怪诞反而能让设计师脱颖而出。

e.en: The orbit's {eccentricity} determines how stretched its shape is.
e.zh: 轨道的偏心率决定了它的形状有多扁。

e.en: The neighborhood is full of artists, writers, and lovable {eccentrics}.
e.zh: 这片街区到处是艺术家、作家和招人喜欢的怪人。

e.en: History remembers many inventors as misunderstood {eccentrics}.
e.zh: 历史上许多发明家都被视为不被理解的怪才。

eccles.t: n. 埃克尔斯（地名/姓氏）

e.en: She bought warm {Eccles} cakes from the bakery on the corner.
e.zh: 她在街角面包店买了热乎乎的埃克尔斯蛋糕。

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Eccles} before heading into Manchester.
e.zh: 列车在埃克尔斯短暂停靠后驶向曼彻斯特。

e.en: The country is recovering from a deep {economic} recession.
e.zh: 该国正在从严重的经济衰退中恢复。

e.en: Rising fuel prices create real {economic} pressure on families.
e.zh: 燃油价格上涨给家庭带来了实实在在的经济压力。

economical.t: adj. 节约的，经济实惠的

e.en: This small car is very {economical} on long road trips.
e.zh: 这辆小车在长途旅行中非常省油。

e.en: Buying in bulk is usually more {economical} for big families.
e.zh: 对大家庭来说,大批量购买通常更划算。

e.en: The region is {economically} dependent on tourism revenue.
e.zh: 该地区在经济上依赖旅游业收入。

e.en: Living {economically}, she managed to save half her salary.
e.zh: 靠着省吃俭用,她设法存下了一半的工资。

e.en: He teaches {economics} at a small liberal arts college.
e.zh: 他在一所小型文理学院教经济学。

e.en: The {economics} of streaming have changed the music industry.
e.zh: 流媒体的经济模式已经改变了音乐产业。

economies.t: n. 经济体；节约措施（economy 复数）

e.en: Asian {economies} grew rapidly during the past two decades.
e.zh: 亚洲经济体在过去二十年里快速增长。

e.en: Large factories benefit from {economies} of scale.
e.zh: 大型工厂受益于规模经济。

economise.t: v. 节约，节省（economize 的英式拼写）

e.en: Families had to {economise} during the long winter months.
e.zh: 家庭在漫长的冬季不得不节省开支。

e.en: The company is trying to {economise} on office supplies.
e.zh: 公司正在设法节省办公用品的开支。

e.en: They {economised} on travel by booking flights months early.
e.zh: 他们提前几个月订机票,从而节省了旅行费用。

e.en: She {economised} carefully to afford her son's tuition.
e.zh: 她精打细算,以便能够支付儿子的学费。

economises.t: v. economise 的第三人称单数

e.en: The new policy {economises} on paper by going fully digital.
e.zh: 新政策通过全面数字化来节省用纸。

e.en: He {economises} wherever possible to pay off his loans.
e.zh: 他尽可能节省开支以偿还贷款。

e.en: They are {economising} by cooking at home instead of eating out.
e.zh: 他们通过在家做饭而不是外出就餐来节省开支。

e.en: The government is {economising} on public administration costs.
e.zh: 政府正在节省公共行政开支。

economism.t: n. 经济主义（过度强调经济因素）

e.en: Critics accused the party of crude {economism} and materialism.
e.zh: 批评者指责该党奉行粗陋的经济主义和物质主义。

e.en: His essay rejects {economism} as the only measure of progress.
e.zh: 他的文章反对把经济主义作为衡量进步的唯一标准。

e.en: The {economist} predicted a slowdown in consumer spending.
e.zh: 这位经济学家预测消费者支出将会放缓。

e.en: She works as a senior {economist} at the central bank.
e.zh: 她在中央银行担任高级经济学家。

economistic.t: adj. 经济主义的，唯经济论的

e.en: His {economistic} view ignores cultural and social factors.
e.zh: 他这种唯经济观忽视了文化和社会因素。

e.en: The professor criticized the report for its {economistic} bias.
e.zh: 教授批评这份报告带有唯经济论的偏见。

e.en: {Economists} disagree about how to fight inflation.
e.zh: 经济学家们对如何抗击通胀意见不一。

e.en: Top {economists} gathered in Geneva to debate trade policy.
e.zh: 顶尖经济学家齐聚日内瓦讨论贸易政策。

e.en: We need to {economize} on electricity this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天我们需要节省用电。

e.en: Restaurants {economize} by sourcing produce from local farms.
e.zh: 餐馆通过从当地农场采购农产品来节省成本。

e.en: She {economized} on rent by sharing a flat with friends.
e.zh: 她通过和朋友合租公寓来节省房租。

e.en: They {economized} during the recession but still ate well.
e.zh: 经济衰退期间他们精打细算,但依然吃得不错。

economizes.t: v. economize 的第三人称单数

e.en: This dishwasher {economizes} on both water and electricity.
e.zh: 这台洗碗机既省水又省电。

e.en: He {economizes} by walking to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天步行上班以节省开支。

e.en: They are {economizing} by canceling unused streaming services.
e.zh: 他们通过取消不用的流媒体服务来节省开支。

e.en: The factory is {economizing} on raw materials this quarter.
e.zh: 这家工厂本季度正在节省原材料。

economy.t:
n. 经济；节约
adj. 经济型的（舱位等）

e.en: The country's {economy} grew by three percent last year.
e.zh: 该国经济去年增长了百分之三。

e.en: I always book the {economy} class for short flights.
e.zh: 短途航班我总是订经济舱。

e.en: The Amazon is the largest tropical {ecoregion} in the world.
e.zh: 亚马逊是世界上最大的热带生态区。

e.en: Each {ecoregion} hosts its own unique plants and animals.
e.zh: 每个生态区都拥有独特的动植物。

e.en: Pollution affects every part of the planet's fragile {ecosphere}.
e.zh: 污染影响着地球脆弱生态圈的每一个部分。

e.en: Scientists worry about microplastics entering the {ecosphere}.
e.zh: 科学家担心微塑料进入生态圈。

e.en: Coral reefs form a delicate underwater {ecosystem}.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁构成了一个脆弱的水下生态系统。

e.en: Apple's app {ecosystem} keeps customers loyal to its devices.
e.zh: 苹果的应用生态系统让顾客忠于它的设备。

e.en: Wildfires can destroy entire forest {ecosystems} in days.
e.zh: 野火可以在几天内摧毁整个森林生态系统。

e.en: Healthy {ecosystems} provide clean air and fresh water.
e.zh: 健康的生态系统提供清洁的空气和淡水。

e.en: Costa Rica is famous for its {ecotourism} and rainforests.
e.zh: 哥斯达黎加以其生态旅游和雨林闻名。

e.en: {Ecotourism} can support conservation if managed responsibly.
e.zh: 如果管理得当,生态旅游可以支持自然保护。

e.en: Different {ecotourisms} around the world share common principles.
e.zh: 世界各地不同的生态旅游模式都遵循共同的原则。

e.en: The summit compared {ecotourisms} in Africa and Latin America.
e.zh: 峰会比较了非洲和拉丁美洲的生态旅游模式。

e.en: The {ecotourist} hiked quietly through the protected reserve.
e.zh: 这位生态游客静静地徒步穿越保护区。

e.en: As an {ecotourist}, she avoids hotels that waste resources.
e.zh: 作为一名生态游客,她避开浪费资源的酒店。

ecowas.t: n. 西非国家经济共同体（缩写）

e.en: {Ecowas} promotes economic cooperation among West African states.
e.zh: 西非国家经济共同体促进西非各国之间的经济合作。

e.en: Leaders met at an {ecowas} summit to discuss regional security.
e.zh: 各国领导人出席西共体峰会讨论地区安全问题。

ecr.t: n. 电子客户档案/电子病历（缩写，依语境）

e.en: The {ecr} system handles secure container images for our team.
e.zh: 这套弹性容器注册系统为我们团队管理安全的容器镜像。

e.en: She pushed the new build to {ecr} before deployment.
e.zh: 她在部署之前把新版本推送到了弹性容器仓库。

e.en: She wore an {ecru} silk blouse to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她穿了一件本色丝绸衬衫去画廊的开幕式。

e.en: The curtains came in soft {ecru} and pale gray.
e.zh: 窗帘有柔和的本色和浅灰色两种颜色。

ecsc.t: n. 欧洲煤钢共同体（缩写）

e.en: The {ecsc} laid the foundation for today's European Union.
e.zh: 欧洲煤钢共同体为今天的欧盟奠定了基础。

e.en: Historians often cite the {ecsc} as a postwar success story.
e.zh: 历史学家常把欧洲煤钢共同体视为战后的成功典范。

e.en: The crowd burst into {ecstasies} when the band returned for an encore.
e.zh: 乐队返场加演时,观众陷入了狂喜。

e.en: She wrote about the small {ecstasies} of a quiet morning.
e.zh: 她描写了一个宁静早晨里那些细小的狂喜。

e.en: Winning the championship filled the team with pure {ecstasy}.
e.zh: 赢得冠军让全队充满了纯粹的狂喜。

e.en: She closed her eyes in {ecstasy} at the first bite of cake.
e.zh: 咬下蛋糕的第一口,她陶醉地闭上了眼睛。

e.en: The kids were {ecstatic} when they saw the puppy.
e.zh: 孩子们看到小狗时欣喜若狂。

e.en: She got an {ecstatic} message after passing the bar exam.
e.zh: 她通过律师资格考试后收到了一条欣喜若狂的消息。

e.en: Fans cheered {ecstatically} as the team scored the winning goal.
e.zh: 球队攻入制胜一球时,球迷们欣喜若狂地欢呼。

e.en: She danced {ecstatically} when her favorite song came on.
e.zh: 听到自己最爱的歌曲响起,她欣喜若狂地跳起舞来。

e.en: As an {ectomorph}, he struggles to gain muscle despite eating a lot.
e.zh: 作为外胚型体质的人，他即使吃很多也很难长肌肉。

e.en: The trainer designed a special program for {ectomorph} clients.
e.zh: 教练为瘦长体型的客户设计了专门的训练计划。

ectopic.t: adj. 异位的（如异位妊娠）

e.en: The doctor diagnosed an {ectopic} pregnancy and recommended immediate surgery.
e.zh: 医生诊断为宫外孕并建议立即手术。

e.en: {Ectopic} heartbeats are usually harmless but can feel alarming.
e.zh: 异位心跳通常无害，但可能让人感到惊慌。

e.en: In ghost movies, spirits often leave behind glowing green {ectoplasm}.
e.zh: 在鬼片中，幽灵常常留下发光的绿色灵质。

e.en: The medium claimed to produce {ectoplasm} during the séance.
e.zh: 那位灵媒声称在降神会上产生了灵质。

e.en: The haunted house was filled with strange {ectoplasmic} residue.
e.zh: 那栋鬼屋里满是奇怪的灵质残留物。

e.en: She wrote a novel about {ectoplasmic} apparitions in old mansions.
e.zh: 她写了一部关于古宅中灵质幻影的小说。

ecu.t: n. 电子控制单元；欧洲货币单位（旧）

e.en: The {ecu} was replaced by the euro in 1999.
e.zh: 埃居于1999年被欧元取代。

e.en: My car's {ecu} needs to be reprogrammed after the engine swap.
e.zh: 换发动机后我车上的电控单元需要重新编程。

e.en: {Ecuador} is famous for the Galápagos Islands and Andean landscapes.
e.zh: 厄瓜多尔以加拉帕戈斯群岛和安第斯山景观闻名。

e.en: She backpacked through {Ecuador} for three weeks last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她背包游历厄瓜多尔三周。

ecuadorean.t:
adj. 厄瓜多尔的
n. 厄瓜多尔人

e.en: The {Ecuadorean} coast offers some of the best surfing in South America.
e.zh: 厄瓜多尔海岸是南美最佳的冲浪地之一。

e.en: He married an {Ecuadorean} woman he met in Quito.
e.zh: 他娶了一位在基多认识的厄瓜多尔女子。

ecuadorian.t:
adj. 厄瓜多尔的
n. 厄瓜多尔人

e.en: The {Ecuadorian} government announced new tourism initiatives this year.
e.zh: 厄瓜多尔政府今年宣布了新的旅游计划。

e.en: I love {Ecuadorian} cuisine, especially ceviche and llapingachos.
e.zh: 我喜欢厄瓜多尔菜，尤其是酸橘汁腌鱼和土豆饼。

ecumenical.t: adj. 普世的，基督教合一的

e.en: The pope called for an {ecumenical} dialogue between Christian denominations.
e.zh: 教皇呼吁各基督教派之间开展普世对话。

e.en: Their wedding was an {ecumenical} ceremony with both Catholic and Anglican elements.
e.zh: 他们的婚礼是融合天主教和圣公会元素的普世仪式。

e.en: The bishop spoke {ecumenically} about uniting different Christian traditions.
e.zh: 主教从普世合一的角度谈论联合不同基督教传统。

e.en: The conference was organized {ecumenically} to welcome all faith communities.
e.zh: 该会议以普世合一精神筹办，欢迎所有信仰群体。

ecumenism.t: n. 基督教普世合一运动

e.en: {Ecumenism} promotes cooperation and unity among Christian churches worldwide.
e.zh: 普世合一运动促进世界基督教会之间的合作与团结。

e.en: The seminary offers a course on the history of {ecumenism}.
e.zh: 该神学院开设一门普世合一运动史课程。

e.en: My daughter has {eczema}, so we use only fragrance-free lotions.
e.zh: 我女儿有湿疹，所以我们只用无香润肤霜。

e.en: Stress can trigger {eczema} flare-ups on sensitive skin.
e.zh: 压力可能引发敏感皮肤的湿疹发作。

e.en: I bought a wheel of {edam} cheese at the Dutch market.
e.zh: 我在荷兰市场买了一整轮埃丹奶酪。

e.en: {Edam} pairs wonderfully with apples and dark bread.
e.zh: 埃丹奶酪和苹果及黑面包搭配非常美味。

edc.t: n. 预产期（estimated date of confinement）

e.en: My {edc} includes a pocket knife, flashlight, and small notebook.
e.zh: 我的日常携带物品包括小刀、手电筒和小笔记本。

e.en: He posted his {edc} setup on the gear forum.
e.zh: 他在装备论坛上发了自己的每日携带配置。

e.en: The conference focused on {ecclesial} reform in modern parishes.
e.zh: 这场会议关注的是现代教区的教会改革。

e.en: Her dissertation explores {ecclesial} authority in early Christianity.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了早期基督教中的教会权威问题。

e.en: The pastor quoted {Ecclesiastes} on the vanity of worldly success.
e.zh: 牧师引用《传道书》谈到世俗成功的虚空。

e.en: Many readers find {Ecclesiastes} surprisingly modern in its philosophy.
e.zh: 许多读者觉得《传道书》的哲学思想出奇地现代。

ecclesiastic.t:
n. 神职人员
adj. 教会的

e.en: The old {ecclesiastic} spent his afternoons translating ancient texts.
e.zh: 那位年迈的教会人士整个下午都在翻译古代典籍。

e.en: She wrote a biography of a Renaissance {ecclesiastic} from Florence.
e.zh: 她为一位佛罗伦萨的文艺复兴时期教士写了传记。

e.en: The painting hangs in an {ecclesiastical} museum in Rome.
e.zh: 那幅画藏于罗马的一座教会博物馆中。

e.en: He studied {ecclesiastical} law before becoming a parish priest.
e.zh: 他在成为教区神父之前研究过教会法。

e.en: The book offers an {ecclesiological} comparison of Catholic and Orthodox traditions.
e.zh: 这本书对天主教与东正教传统作了教会学比较。

e.en: Her {ecclesiological} arguments sparked lively debate at the seminary.
e.zh: 她的教会学论点在神学院引发了热烈辩论。

ecclesiology.t: n. 教会学；教堂建筑学

e.en: He teaches a graduate seminar on Protestant {ecclesiology}.
e.zh: 他教授一门关于新教教会学的研究生研讨课。

e.en: Their disagreement comes down to a difference in {ecclesiology}.
e.zh: 他们的分歧归根到底在于教会学观点的不同。

e.en: Snakes go through {ecdysis} several times a year as they grow.
e.zh: 蛇在生长过程中每年要经历几次蜕皮。

e.en: The cicada left its empty shell behind after {ecdysis}.
e.zh: 蝉蜕皮后留下了一个空壳。

e.en: The doctor ordered an {ECG} to check his irregular heartbeat.
e.zh: 医生开了心电图检查，以排查他的心律不齐。

e.en: Modern smartwatches can record a basic {ECG} in thirty seconds.
e.zh: 现代智能手表能在三十秒内记录一份基本的心电图。

e.en: She joined the upper {echelon} of management after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后，她进入了管理层的高层。

e.en: Only the top {echelon} of athletes qualifies for the Olympics.
e.zh: 只有最顶尖一层的运动员才有资格参加奥运会。

e.en: He brews {echinacea} tea whenever he feels a cold coming on.
e.zh: 一感觉要感冒，他就会泡一杯紫锥菊茶。

e.en: The garden bed is filled with purple {echinacea} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天那片花圃开满了紫色的紫锥菊。

e.en: A starfish is a familiar example of a marine {echinoderm}.
e.zh: 海星是大家熟悉的一种海洋棘皮动物。

e.en: Sea urchins and sand dollars belong to the {echinoderm} family.
e.zh: 海胆和沙钱都属于棘皮动物类。

echo.t:
n. 回声；回响
v. 回荡；附和

e.en: Her shout produced a clear {echo} across the canyon.
e.zh: 她的喊声在峡谷里激起了清晰的回声。

e.en: The new policy seems to {echo} ideas from a decade ago.
e.zh: 这项新政策似乎在重复十年前的一些想法。

e.en: The cardiologist scheduled an {echocardiogram} to assess his heart valves.
e.zh: 心脏科医生安排了心脏超声检查来评估他的心脏瓣膜。

e.en: Her {echocardiogram} showed no signs of damage after the surgery.
e.zh: 术后她的心脏超声显示没有任何损伤迹象。

echoed.t: v. echo 的过去式，回荡；附和

e.en: Footsteps {echoed} down the empty marble hallway.
e.zh: 脚步声在空荡荡的大理石走廊里回响。

e.en: Several reviewers {echoed} the same complaint about battery life.
e.zh: 好几位测评人都对电池续航提出了同样的抱怨。

echoes.t: n./v. echo 的复数/第三人称单数

e.en: Her speech contained clear {echoes} of an earlier campaign.
e.zh: 她的演讲明显呼应了早先的一场竞选。

e.en: The cave is famous for the long {echoes} it produces.
e.zh: 那个山洞以能产生长长的回声而出名。

echoey.t: adj. 有回声的；空旷回响的

e.en: The empty apartment felt cold and {echoey} without furniture.
e.zh: 没有家具的空荡公寓显得又冷又回声大。

e.en: His podcast sounds a bit {echoey}; he should add foam panels.
e.zh: 他的播客有点空响，他该加点吸音棉了。

echoing.t: v. 回荡；附和（echo 的现在分词）

e.en: Children's laughter came {echoing} through the school corridors.
e.zh: 孩子们的笑声在学校走廊里回荡。

e.en: The CEO's email was {echoing} sentiments from last week's town hall.
e.zh: CEO 的邮件呼应了上周全员大会上的观点。

echolalia.t: n. 模仿言语；回声性言语

e.en: The therapist explained that {echolalia} is common in early language development.
e.zh: 治疗师解释说，模仿言语在语言发展早期很常见。

e.en: His parrot's {echolalia} surprised every guest who visited.
e.zh: 他鹦鹉的模仿话语让每位来访的客人都吃惊。

e.en: Bats {echolocate} to navigate and hunt in complete darkness.
e.zh: 蝙蝠靠回声定位在完全黑暗中飞行和捕猎。

e.en: Dolphins {echolocate} by sending out rapid clicks underwater.
e.zh: 海豚通过在水下发出快速咔哒声来回声定位。

e.en: The blind hiker {echolocated} obstacles using a series of tongue clicks.
e.zh: 那位失明的徒步者用舌头发出咔哒声进行回声定位以避开障碍。

e.en: Researchers showed that the whale {echolocated} fish at great depths.
e.zh: 研究人员发现这头鲸在极深的海域用回声定位寻鱼。

echolocates.t: v. echolocate 的第三人称单数

e.en: A bat {echolocates} thousands of times per minute while hunting.
e.zh: 蝙蝠在捕食时每分钟会发出数千次回声定位信号。

e.en: This species {echolocates} using lower frequencies than its cousins.
e.zh: 这一物种使用比近亲更低的频率进行回声定位。

echolocating.t: v. 进行回声定位（现在分词）

e.en: The {echolocating} bats darted between the trees at dusk.
e.zh: 那些用回声定位的蝙蝠在黄昏时分穿梭于树木之间。

e.en: Scientists are studying how dolphins coordinate while {echolocating} in groups.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究海豚成群回声定位时如何协调。

e.en: Bats rely on {echolocation} to find insects in the dark.
e.zh: 蝙蝠依靠回声定位在黑暗中寻找昆虫。

e.en: Some blind people use a form of {echolocation} to navigate cities.
e.zh: 一些盲人会用一种类似回声定位的方式在城市中辨路。

e.en: Researchers recorded thousands of dolphin {echolocations} during the expedition.
e.zh: 研究人员在考察期间录下了数千次海豚的回声定位信号。

e.en: Different species emit very distinct {echolocations} underwater.
e.zh: 不同物种在水下发出的回声定位信号差别很大。

echos.t: n. echo 的复数（非标准拼写）

e.en: His voice {echos} every time he speaks in this hallway.
e.zh: 他在这条走廊里说话时声音总会回响。

e.en: The canyon {echos} our shouts back several seconds later.
e.zh: 过几秒钟峡谷就会把我们的喊声回响回来。

eclair.t: n. 闪电泡芙（一种长条奶油泡芙）

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {eclair} with her afternoon coffee.
e.zh: 她点了一份巧克力闪电泡芙搭配下午的咖啡。

e.en: The bakery's coffee {eclair} sells out before noon every day.
e.zh: 那家面包店的咖啡口味闪电泡芙每天中午前就卖光了。

e.en: The startup launched its first product with surprising {eclat}.
e.zh: 那家初创公司的首款产品发布得出乎意料地风光。

e.en: She accepted the award with quiet dignity rather than {eclat}.
e.zh: 她接受这项荣誉时端庄低调，并不张扬。

eclectic.t: adj. 折衷的；博采众长的

e.en: His playlist is wildly {eclectic}, jumping from jazz to K-pop.
e.zh: 他的播放列表风格五花八门，从爵士跳到 K-pop。

e.en: The café has an {eclectic} menu inspired by global street food.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的菜单博采众长，灵感来自世界各地的街头小吃。

eclectically.t: adv. 折衷地；兼收并蓄地

e.en: Her apartment is decorated {eclectically} with finds from many countries.
e.zh: 她的公寓用从多个国家淘来的物件混搭装饰。

e.en: He reads {eclectically}, mixing physics papers with graphic novels.
e.zh: 他读书涉猎广泛，会把物理论文和图像小说混着看。

e.en: The designer is known for her bold {eclecticism} and warm colors.
e.zh: 这位设计师以大胆的折衷风格和温暖配色著称。

e.en: Critics praised the album's {eclecticism}, blending folk and electronica.
e.zh: 乐评人盛赞这张专辑兼收并蓄，将民谣与电子乐融合。

eclectics.t: n. 折衷派；折衷主义者

e.en: The gallery showcases works by self-taught {eclectics} from across Asia.
e.zh: 这家画廊展出来自亚洲各地自学成才的折衷派艺术家作品。

e.en: Curious {eclectics} tend to make the most interesting dinner guests.
e.zh: 那些什么都感兴趣的折衷派往往是最有趣的晚餐客人。

eclipse.t:
n. 日食；月食
v. 使黯然失色

e.en: Crowds gathered in the park to watch the solar {eclipse}.
e.zh: 人群聚集在公园里观看日食。

e.en: The new model threatens to {eclipse} every laptop in its price range.
e.zh: 这款新机型有望让同价位段的所有笔记本都黯然失色。

eclipsing.t: v. 遮蔽；使黯然失色（现在分词）

e.en: The new phone is {eclipsing} all its competitors in sales.
e.zh: 这款新手机的销量正在超越所有竞争对手。

e.en: The moon is slowly {eclipsing} the sun this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午月亮正在慢慢遮住太阳。

ecliptic.t:
n. 黄道
adj. 黄道的

e.en: Planets orbit the sun close to the {ecliptic} plane.
e.zh: 行星沿着接近黄道面的轨道围绕太阳运行。

e.en: Astronomers tracked the comet along the {ecliptic}.
e.zh: 天文学家沿着黄道追踪这颗彗星。

e.en: Virgil's {eclogue} celebrates the simple life of shepherds.
e.zh: 维吉尔的牧歌赞美了牧羊人的简朴生活。

e.en: She read a pastoral {eclogue} aloud in class.
e.zh: 她在课堂上朗读了一首田园牧歌。

eco.t: adj. 生态的；环保的（前缀/缩写）

e.en: The hotel offers an {eco} package with reusable toiletries.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供配有可重复使用洗漱用品的环保套餐。

e.en: Many shoppers prefer brands with an {eco} label.
e.zh: 许多购物者更偏爱带有环保标签的品牌。

e.en: Her {ecocentric} worldview puts nature before profit.
e.zh: 她以生态为中心的世界观把自然置于利润之上。

e.en: The book promotes an {ecocentric} approach to urban planning.
e.zh: 这本书倡导以生态为中心的城市规划方法。

e.en: His voice {ecoes} faintly through the empty hallway.
e.zh: 他的声音在空荡的走廊里微弱地回响。

e.en: The cave {ecoes} every footstep we take inside.
e.zh: 我们在洞里的每一步脚步声都会回响。

e.en: She studied painting at a famous Parisian {ecole}.
e.zh: 她在巴黎一所著名的学院学习绘画。

e.en: The {ecole} trains chefs from around the world.
e.zh: 这所学院培养来自世界各地的厨师。

e.en: The lettuce was recalled after an {ecoli} outbreak.
e.zh: 由于爆发大肠杆菌疫情,这批生菜被召回。

e.en: Scientists often grow {ecoli} bacteria in the lab.
e.zh: 科学家经常在实验室里培养大肠杆菌。

e.en: The dam caused serious {ecologic} damage downstream.
e.zh: 这座大坝对下游造成了严重的生态破坏。

e.en: Researchers study {ecologic} patterns in the rainforest.
e.zh: 研究人员研究雨林中的生态模式。

e.en: Plastic waste poses a major {ecological} threat to oceans.
e.zh: 塑料垃圾对海洋构成了重大的生态威胁。

e.en: The company published its annual {ecological} impact report.
e.zh: 该公司发布了年度生态影响报告。

ecologically.t: adv. 生态上；从生态角度

e.en: Bamboo is an {ecologically} friendly building material.
e.zh: 竹子是一种对生态友好的建筑材料。

e.en: The farm operates {ecologically}, without pesticides or chemicals.
e.zh: 这家农场采用生态方式经营,不使用农药和化学品。

e.en: Coral reefs support some of the richest {ecologies} on Earth.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁支撑着地球上最丰富的生态系统之一。

e.en: Different forest {ecologies} respond differently to climate change.
e.zh: 不同的森林生态系统对气候变化的反应各不相同。

e.en: The {ecologist} tracked wolves across the national park.
e.zh: 这位生态学家在国家公园里追踪狼群。

e.en: She became an {ecologist} after studying biology in college.
e.zh: 她大学学了生物学之后成为了一名生态学家。

e.en: {Ecologists} warn that bee populations are declining rapidly.
e.zh: 生态学家警告说蜜蜂数量正在迅速减少。

e.en: A team of {ecologists} surveyed the wetlands last summer.
e.zh: 一个生态学家团队去年夏天调查了这片湿地。

e.en: She majored in {ecology} and now works for a wildlife charity.
e.zh: 她主修生态学,现在为一家野生动物慈善机构工作。

e.en: Mining seriously disrupts the local {ecology} of the river.
e.zh: 采矿严重破坏了这条河流当地的生态环境。

e.en: He built an {econometric} model to predict housing prices.
e.zh: 他建立了一个计量经济学模型来预测房价。

e.en: The paper uses {econometric} methods to test the theory.
e.zh: 这篇论文用计量经济学方法来检验该理论。

e.en: {Econometrics} combines statistics with economic theory.
e.zh: 计量经济学把统计学和经济学理论结合起来。

e.en: She is taking a graduate course in {econometrics} this term.
e.zh: 她这学期在上一门计量经济学的研究生课程。

eddy.t:
n. 漩涡
v. 起漩涡

e.en: Leaves swirled in a small {eddy} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 树叶在河岸附近的小漩涡里打转。

e.en: Kayakers should learn to read every {eddy} in the river.
e.zh: 皮划艇手应学会判读河中的每一处涡流。

e.en: The hikers spotted rare {edelweiss} growing on the alpine cliffs.
e.zh: 徒步者在高山悬崖上发现了珍稀的雪绒花。

e.en: In Austria, the {edelweiss} is a beloved national symbol.
e.zh: 在奥地利，雪绒花是深受喜爱的国家象征。

e.en: The patient developed {edema} in both legs after the long flight.
e.zh: 病人长途飞行后双腿出现了水肿。

e.en: Reducing salt intake can help control mild {edema}.
e.zh: 减少盐的摄入有助于控制轻度水肿。

e.en: The doctor noted {edematous} swelling around the patient's ankles.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人脚踝周围有水肿性肿胀。

e.en: His {edematous} face suggested kidney problems.
e.zh: 他水肿的脸提示可能有肾脏问题。

e.en: The garden behind the cottage felt like a private {Eden}.
e.zh: 小屋后的花园感觉像是一处私人伊甸园。

e.en: The novel retells the story of {Eden} from a new perspective.
e.zh: 这部小说从全新视角重述了伊甸园的故事。

edenic.t: adj. 伊甸园般的；极乐的

e.en: The island offered an almost {edenic} retreat from city life.
e.zh: 那座小岛仿佛是远离都市生活的伊甸般避世之所。

e.en: She painted {edenic} landscapes full of lush greenery.
e.zh: 她画的风景如伊甸园般充满葱郁绿意。

edentate.t:
adj. 无齿的
n. 贫齿目动物

e.en: Sloths and anteaters belong to the {edentate} group of mammals.
e.zh: 树懒和食蚁兽属于贫齿目哺乳动物。

e.en: The zoo's new exhibit features several {edentate} species.
e.zh: 动物园的新展区展出了几种贫齿目动物。

edge.t:
n. 边缘；优势
v. 缓慢移动

e.en: Don't stand too close to the {edge} of the cliff.
e.zh: 别站得太靠近悬崖边。

e.en: Their new product gives them a real competitive {edge}.
e.zh: 他们的新产品给了他们真正的竞争优势。

edged.t:
adj. 有边的；锋利的
v. edge 的过去式

e.en: She {edged} closer to the door, hoping no one would notice.
e.zh: 她慢慢挪近门口，希望没人注意到。

e.en: The garden path was {edged} with smooth river stones.
e.zh: 花园小径两侧镶着光滑的河石。

edges.t:
n. 边缘（复数）
v. 缓慢移动

e.en: The book's {edges} were worn from decades of reading.
e.zh: 这本书的边缘因几十年的阅读而磨损。

e.en: She always {edges} the lawn neatly after mowing it.
e.zh: 她每次割完草坪都会把边缘修得整整齐齐。

e.en: He talked so much I couldn't get a word in {edgewise}.
e.zh: 他说个不停，我连一句话都插不进去。

e.en: Slide the board in {edgewise} to fit through the doorway.
e.zh: 把木板侧着推进去才能穿过门口。

e.en: She glanced {edgily} at the door, expecting bad news.
e.zh: 她紧张地瞟了一眼门口，预感会有坏消息。

e.en: He laughed {edgily} when the boss mentioned the missing files.
e.zh: 当老板提到丢失的文件时，他不安地笑了笑。

e.en: There was a noticeable {edginess} in the room before the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息前，房间里弥漫着明显的紧张气氛。

e.en: The film's {edginess} appealed to younger audiences.
e.zh: 这部电影的前卫风格吸引了年轻观众。

e.en: She added decorative {edging} around the flower beds.
e.zh: 她在花圃周围加了装饰性的边饰。

e.en: The team is {edging} closer to a championship win.
e.zh: 球队正在逐步逼近冠军宝座。

edgy.t: adj. 前卫的；紧张不安的

e.en: The brand is known for its {edgy} streetwear designs.
e.zh: 该品牌以其前卫的街头服饰设计闻名。

e.en: He felt {edgy} before his job interview started.
e.zh: 面试开始前他感到紧张不安。

edi.t: n. EDI（电子数据交换的缩写）

e.en: Many companies use {EDI} to exchange invoices and purchase orders electronically.
e.zh: 许多公司使用电子数据交换来电子化处理发票和订单。

e.en: Setting up {EDI} with our suppliers cut paperwork dramatically.
e.zh: 与供应商建立电子数据交换大幅减少了文书工作。

e.en: Always check the {edibility} of wild mushrooms before cooking them.
e.zh: 野生蘑菇烹饪前一定要确认是否可食用。

e.en: The lab tested the {edibility} of the new plant-based protein.
e.zh: 实验室测试了这种新型植物蛋白的可食用性。

edible.t:
adj. 可食用的
n. 食物

e.en: Not every berry in the forest is {edible}, so be careful.
e.zh: 森林里并非每种浆果都能吃，所以要小心。

e.en: She decorated the cake with {edible} flowers and gold leaf.
e.zh: 她用可食用的鲜花和金箔装饰蛋糕。

e.en: The king issued an {edict} banning public gatherings after sunset.
e.zh: 国王颁布敕令，禁止日落后的公共集会。

e.en: The company's new {edict} requires everyone to return to the office.
e.zh: 公司的新规定要求所有人返回办公室上班。

e.en: The museum tour was both entertaining and full of {edification}.
e.zh: 博物馆之旅既有趣又富有教益。

e.en: He read classical literature for his own {edification}.
e.zh: 他阅读古典文学是为了陶冶自己。

e.en: The pastor's sermons offered weekly {edifications} for the congregation.
e.zh: 牧师的布道每周都为会众提供精神启迪。

e.en: Her lectures provided {edifications} on both philosophy and ethics.
e.zh: 她的讲座在哲学和伦理方面都给人以启迪。

e.en: The cathedral is the most impressive {edifice} in the old town.
e.zh: 这座大教堂是老城区最壮观的建筑。

e.en: The whole legal {edifice} rests on a few core principles.
e.zh: 整个法律体系建立在几条核心原则之上。

e.en: Ancient Roman {edifices} still stand throughout modern Italy.
e.zh: 古罗马建筑至今仍矗立在现代意大利各地。

e.en: The campus features several historic {edifices} from the 1800s.
e.zh: 校园里有几座19世纪留下的历史建筑。

edified.t: v. edify 的过去式；使受熏陶

e.en: The students felt truly {edified} by the visiting professor's lecture.
e.zh: 客座教授的讲座让学生们获益良多。

e.en: Her grandmother's stories {edified} her about family history.
e.zh: 祖母的故事让她对家族历史有了更深的理解。

e.en: Good literature {edifies} the mind and broadens perspectives.
e.zh: 好的文学作品启迪心智、开阔视野。

e.en: A wise mentor {edifies} students through both words and example.
e.zh: 一位睿智的导师通过言传身教启迪学生。

e.en: The documentary aims to {edify} viewers about climate change.
e.zh: 这部纪录片旨在让观众更了解气候变化。

e.en: Reading classic novels can {edify} as well as entertain.
e.zh: 阅读经典小说既能启迪心灵又能带来乐趣。

edifying.t: adj. 有教益的；启发人的

e.en: The conversation with the elderly scholar was deeply {edifying}.
e.zh: 与那位年长学者的对话令人受益匪浅。

e.en: She found the documentary both entertaining and {edifying}.
e.zh: 她觉得这部纪录片既有趣又有启发性。

edinburgh.t: n. 爱丁堡（苏格兰首府）

e.en: {Edinburgh} hosts a famous arts festival every August.
e.zh: 爱丁堡每年八月都举办著名的艺术节。

e.en: We climbed Arthur's Seat for a panoramic view of {Edinburgh}.
e.zh: 我们爬上亚瑟王座，俯瞰爱丁堡全景。

edirne.t: n. 埃迪尔内（土耳其城市）

e.en: {Edirne} is a Turkish city famous for its Ottoman-era mosques.
e.zh: 埃迪尔内是土耳其一座以奥斯曼时期清真寺闻名的城市。

e.en: We visited {Edirne} during our trip through northwestern Turkey.
e.zh: 我们在土耳其西北部旅行时游览了埃迪尔内。

edit.t:
v. 编辑；修改
n. 编辑操作

e.en: Let me {edit} this paragraph before we publish the article.
e.zh: 在发布文章之前让我先编辑一下这段。

e.en: You can {edit} your profile picture in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单中修改个人头像。

edited.t:
v. edit 的过去式
adj. 经编辑的

e.en: She {edited} the manuscript carefully before sending it to the publisher.
e.zh: 她在寄给出版商之前仔细修改了手稿。

e.en: The video has been {edited} down to just three minutes.
e.zh: 视频已被剪辑成短短三分钟。

editing.t:
n. 编辑；剪辑
v. edit 的现在分词

e.en: He spent the afternoon {editing} photos for his travel blog.
e.zh: 他花了一下午为旅行博客修图。

e.en: Good {editing} can transform a rough draft into polished prose.
e.zh: 好的编辑能把粗糙的草稿变成精致的文章。

e.en: The first {edition} of this novel is worth thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 这本小说的初版价值数千美元。

e.en: They released a special {edition} of the game with bonus content.
e.zh: 他们发布了带有额外内容的游戏特别版。

e.en: The library owns several rare {editions} of Shakespeare's plays.
e.zh: 图书馆收藏有几部莎士比亚戏剧的珍贵版本。

e.en: Limited {editions} of the sneakers sell out within minutes online.
e.zh: 限量版运动鞋在网上几分钟内就售罄。

e.en: The {editor} suggested several changes to improve the article's flow.
e.zh: 编辑提出了几处修改建议，以让文章更流畅。

e.en: I prefer using a code {editor} with built-in syntax highlighting.
e.zh: 我更喜欢使用内置语法高亮的代码编辑器。

editorial.t:
n. 社论
adj. 编辑的

e.en: The newspaper's {editorial} criticized the government's new tax policy.
e.zh: 报纸的社论批评了政府的新税收政策。

e.en: She made an {editorial} decision to cut the controversial chapter.
e.zh: 她做出编辑决定，删掉那个有争议的章节。

e.en: The {editorialist} argued forcefully for stricter privacy laws online.
e.zh: 那位社论作者强烈主张制定更严格的网络隐私法。

e.en: As an {editorialist}, she shaped public opinion for decades.
e.zh: 作为社论作家，她影响公众舆论长达数十年。

editorialize.t: v. 发表社论；夹带主观评论

e.en: Reporters should report facts, not {editorialize} about them.
e.zh: 记者应当报道事实，而不是发表个人评论。

e.en: The anchor began to {editorialize} during the live broadcast.
e.zh: 主播在直播中开始夹带个人观点。

editorially.t: adv. 以社论方式；编辑上

e.en: The newspaper {editorially} endorsed the mayor's reelection bid.
e.zh: 该报在社论上支持市长的连任竞选。

e.en: The magazine is {editorially} independent from its parent company.
e.zh: 该杂志在编辑方针上独立于母公司。

e.en: Sunday {editorials} often spark heated debates on social media.
e.zh: 周日的社论常在社交媒体上引发激烈讨论。

e.en: She writes {editorials} for a major financial newspaper.
e.zh: 她为一家大型财经报纸撰写社论。

e.en: The {editors} cut two chapters before publishing the novel.
e.zh: 编辑们在出版小说前删掉了两章。

e.en: Most code {editors} now support AI-powered autocomplete features.
e.zh: 大多数代码编辑器现已支持AI自动补全功能。

editorship.t: n. 编辑职务；主编身份

e.en: Under her {editorship}, the magazine doubled its readership.
e.zh: 在她担任主编期间，杂志读者数量翻了一番。

e.en: He resigned the {editorship} after a dispute with management.
e.zh: 他在与管理层发生争执后辞去了主编职务。

edits.t:
n. 编辑内容（复数）
v. edit 的三单

e.en: She {edits} her photos before posting them to Instagram.
e.zh: 她在把照片发到Instagram前会先修图。

e.en: The document tracks all {edits} made by team members.
e.zh: 该文档会记录团队成员所做的所有修改。

e.en: He made an {earnest} effort to apologize to everyone.
e.zh: 他诚恳地向每个人道歉。

e.en: Her {earnest} expression made the children listen carefully.
e.zh: 她认真的表情让孩子们听得很专心。

e.en: He {earnestly} promised to pay back every cent.
e.zh: 他认真地承诺会把每一分钱都还清。

e.en: She spoke {earnestly} about her plans for the future.
e.zh: 她真诚地谈起对未来的打算。

e.en: His {earnestness} during the interview impressed the panel.
e.zh: 他面试时的诚恳给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.en: There was a quiet {earnestness} in her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音里带着一种安静的真诚。

earning.t:
v. 赚取；获得
n. 收入

e.en: She is {earning} a six-figure salary at her new job.
e.zh: 她在新工作中拿着六位数的薪水。

e.en: He's slowly {earning} the team's respect.
e.zh: 他正在慢慢赢得团队的尊重。

e.en: The company reported strong {earnings} this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度公布的收益很强劲。

e.en: She saved most of her {earnings} for college.
e.zh: 她把挣的钱大部分都存下来上大学。

earns.t: v. 赚得；获得（earn 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He {earns} more than his older brother now.
e.zh: 他现在赚得比他哥哥还多。

e.en: This app {earns} money through subscriptions and ads.
e.zh: 这款应用通过订阅和广告赚钱。

e.en: One {earphone} stopped working after I dropped it.
e.zh: 我把耳机摔了之后，有一只就不响了。

e.en: He wears a single {earphone} while jogging for safety.
e.zh: 他慢跑时只戴一只耳机，更安全。

e.en: The reporter listened to the producer through her {earpiece}.
e.zh: 记者通过耳机听制片人的指示。

e.en: Bodyguards communicated discreetly using a hidden {earpiece}.
e.zh: 保镖们用隐藏的耳机悄悄交流。

e.en: He pushed an {earplug} in to block out the snoring.
e.zh: 他塞上一只耳塞挡住打鼾声。

e.en: Always pack an {earplug} for noisy hostel stays.
e.zh: 住吵闹的青旅时一定要带上耳塞。

e.en: She lost one diamond {earring} at the party.
e.zh: 她在派对上弄丢了一只钻石耳环。

e.en: He bought her a pearl {earring} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他给她买了一只珍珠耳环作为周年纪念礼物。

e.en: Those gold {earrings} go perfectly with your dress.
e.zh: 那对金耳环和你的裙子很相配。

e.en: She takes off her {earrings} before going to bed.
e.zh: 她睡觉前会把耳环摘下来。

e.en: The puppy's floppy {ears} bounced as it ran.
e.zh: 小狗跑动时，那对耷拉着的耳朵一晃一晃的。

e.en: Cover your {ears} when the fireworks start.
e.zh: 烟花一开始就赶紧捂住耳朵。

e.en: Don't say that within {earshot} of the kids.
e.zh: 别在孩子们听得见的地方说这种话。

e.en: The whisper was just out of {earshot}.
e.zh: 那个低语刚好在听不到的范围之外。

e.en: The fire alarm let out an {earsplitting} shriek.
e.zh: 火警发出震耳欲聋的尖叫声。

e.en: Concerts can be {earsplitting} without proper hearing protection.
e.zh: 演唱会要是不戴护耳就会震得耳朵疼。

earth.t:
n. 地球；土壤
v. 接地

e.en: Astronauts can see the {Earth} clearly from the space station.
e.zh: 宇航员从空间站能清晰地看到地球。

e.en: He dug into the soft {earth} to plant the rose.
e.zh: 他挖开松软的泥土，种下那株玫瑰。

earthbound.t: adj. 受地面束缚的；平凡的

e.en: Penguins are {earthbound} birds that swim instead of fly.
e.zh: 企鹅是不会飞、只会游泳的陆地鸟类。

e.en: She felt {earthbound} watching the planes take off.
e.zh: 看着飞机起飞，她觉得自己被困在了地面上。

e.en: The tea was served in a small {earthen} cup.
e.zh: 茶被盛在一个小小的陶土杯里。

e.en: They built an {earthen} dam to control the floods.
e.zh: 他们筑起一道土坝来控制洪水。

e.en: She collects handmade {earthenware} from local potters.
e.zh: 她收藏当地陶匠手工制作的陶器。

e.en: The kitchen shelves are lined with rustic {earthenware} bowls.
e.zh: 厨房架子上摆满了古朴的陶碗。

e.en: I love the {earthiness} of freshly brewed coffee.
e.zh: 我喜欢现煮咖啡那种泥土般的醇厚感。

e.en: Her humor has an honest {earthiness} that draws people in.
e.zh: 她的幽默有一种朴实的接地气，让人喜欢。

e.en: In the movie, aliens called every human an {earthling}.
e.zh: 电影里，外星人把每个人类都叫做地球人。

e.en: The robot greeted the astronaut as a fellow {earthling}.
e.zh: 机器人把宇航员当作同胞地球人来打招呼。

e.en: He gave away all his {earthly} possessions to charity.
e.zh: 他把自己所有的世俗财产都捐给了慈善机构。

e.en: There is no {earthly} reason to worry about that.
e.zh: 完全没有任何理由为那件事担心。

earthmover.t: n. 大型挖土机；推土机

e.en: A massive {earthmover} cleared the construction site overnight.
e.zh: 一台巨型推土机一夜之间清平了工地。

e.en: The {earthmover} dug a deep trench for the pipeline.
e.zh: 那台推土机为管道挖出一条深沟。

e.en: A magnitude 6 {earthquake} shook the coastal city.
e.zh: 一场6级地震震动了这座沿海城市。

e.en: After the {earthquake}, residents slept outside for days.
e.zh: 地震过后，居民们在外面睡了好几天。

e.en: Japan experiences thousands of small {earthquakes} every year.
e.zh: 日本每年都会发生上千次小地震。

e.en: Modern buildings are designed to withstand strong {earthquakes}.
e.zh: 现代建筑设计上能够抵御强烈地震。

e.en: Scientists imagine parallel {Earths} in alternate universes.
e.zh: 科学家设想平行宇宙中存在多个地球。

e.en: Rare {earths} are essential for smartphone batteries.
e.zh: 稀土元素对智能手机电池至关重要。

earthshaking.t: adj. 惊天动地的；极其重大的

e.en: The discovery wasn't exactly {earthshaking}, but still useful.
e.zh: 这个发现算不上惊天动地，但还是有用的。

e.en: Her speech delivered an {earthshaking} message about climate change.
e.zh: 她的演讲传达了关于气候变化的震撼信息。

e.en: The skydiver plunged {earthward} at terrifying speed.
e.zh: 那名跳伞者以惊人的速度向地面坠落。

e.en: Autumn leaves drifted slowly {earthward} in the still air.
e.zh: 秋叶在静止的空气中缓缓飘向地面。

earthwork.t: n. 土方工程；土木工事

e.en: Ancient tribes built a massive {earthwork} to defend the village.
e.zh: 古代部落筑起庞大的土方工事来保卫村庄。

e.en: Archaeologists are studying the prehistoric {earthwork} on the hill.
e.zh: 考古学家正在研究山上那处史前土筑遗迹。

e.en: An {earthworm} wriggled across the wet sidewalk after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后一条蚯蚓在湿漉漉的人行道上扭动着爬过。

e.en: Gardeners love finding an {earthworm} in healthy soil.
e.zh: 园丁们喜欢在肥沃的土壤里发现蚯蚓。

e.en: The mushrooms had a rich, {earthy} flavor.
e.zh: 这些蘑菇带有浓郁的泥土香味。

e.en: She has an {earthy} sense of humor that everyone loves.
e.zh: 她那种朴实直率的幽默感人人都喜欢。

e.en: The doctor removed a buildup of {earwax} from my left ear.
e.zh: 医生清除了我左耳里堆积的耳垢。

e.en: Cotton swabs can actually push {earwax} deeper inside.
e.zh: 棉签其实会把耳垢推到更深的地方。

e.en: An {earwig} crawled out from under the flower pot.
e.zh: 一只蠼螋从花盆底下爬了出来。

e.en: Gardeners often find an {earwig} hiding in damp leaves.
e.zh: 园丁们常在潮湿的叶子里发现蠼螋。

earworm.t: n. 洗脑神曲；萦绕脑中的旋律

e.en: That catchy pop song became a total {earworm} all week.
e.zh: 那首朗朗上口的流行歌成了整周挥之不去的洗脑曲。

e.en: The jingle is such an {earworm} I can't stop humming it.
e.zh: 这段广告歌太洗脑了,我忍不住一直哼。

ease.t:
n. 轻松；容易
v. 减轻；缓解

e.en: The new app lets you book flights with {ease}.
e.zh: 这款新应用让你轻松预订机票。

e.en: Take some painkillers to {ease} the headache.
e.zh: 吃点止痛药缓解一下头痛吧。

e.en: The traffic finally {eased} after the rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰过后,交通终于变得顺畅了。

e.en: She {eased} the door open so as not to wake the baby.
e.zh: 她轻轻地把门推开,以免吵醒宝宝。

e.en: The artist set up her {easel} by the window.
e.zh: 画家把画架支在了窗边。

e.en: A small {easel} displayed the wedding seating chart.
e.zh: 一个小画架上展示着婚礼座位图。

e.en: The neighbor has an {easement} to use our driveway.
e.zh: 邻居拥有使用我们车道的地役权。

e.en: The utility company secured an {easement} to lay cables.
e.zh: 公用事业公司获得了铺设电缆的通行地役权。

eases.t: v. 缓解；减轻（第三人称单数）

e.en: Stretching daily {eases} lower back pain significantly.
e.zh: 每天拉伸能显著缓解腰部疼痛。

e.en: The medication {eases} symptoms within an hour.
e.zh: 这种药一小时内就能缓解症状。

easier.t: adj. 更容易的（easy 的比较级）

e.en: Online shopping makes life so much {easier}.
e.zh: 网购让生活轻松了许多。

e.en: It's {easier} to learn languages when you're young.
e.zh: 年纪轻时学语言要容易得多。

e.en: This phone {easily} lasts two days on one charge.
e.zh: 这款手机充一次电轻松能用两天。

e.en: She {easily} won the championship last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末她轻松赢得了冠军。

e.en: I love the {easiness} of paying with my phone.
e.zh: 我喜欢用手机支付的那种便捷感。

e.en: There's an {easiness} about him that puts everyone at ease.
e.zh: 他身上有一种让大家都放松的随和感。

easing.t:
v. 缓解
n. 缓动（动画过渡曲线）

e.en: The central bank is {easing} interest rates next month.
e.zh: 央行下个月将放宽利率。

e.en: Yoga is great for {easing} stress after work.
e.zh: 瑜伽很适合用来缓解下班后的压力。

east.t:
n. 东方
adj. 东部的

e.en: The sun rises in the {east} every morning.
e.zh: 太阳每天早晨从东方升起。

e.en: They moved to the {east} coast for better job opportunities.
e.zh: 他们为了更好的工作机会搬到了东海岸。

e.en: The {eastbound} train will depart from platform three.
e.zh: 东行列车将从三号站台发车。

e.en: Traffic on the {eastbound} highway is moving slowly.
e.zh: 东行高速公路上的车流行驶缓慢。

eastbourne.t: n. 伊斯特本（英国城市）

e.en: We spent the weekend by the sea in {Eastbourne}.
e.zh: 我们在伊斯特本海边度过了周末。

e.en: {Eastbourne} is famous for its Victorian pier and seafront.
e.zh: 伊斯特本以其维多利亚式码头和海滨闻名。

e.en: As a true {EastEnder}, she grew up near the docks.
e.zh: 作为地道的伦敦东区人,她在码头附近长大。

e.en: Many an {EastEnder} still speaks with a strong Cockney accent.
e.zh: 许多伦敦东区人至今仍说着浓重的考克尼口音。

e.en: The kids painted eggs for {Easter} this morning.
e.zh: 孩子们今天早上为复活节画了彩蛋。

e.en: We always visit grandma during {Easter} weekend.
e.zh: 我们总是在复活节周末去看望奶奶。

easterly.t:
adj. 偏东的
adv. 向东

e.en: A strong {easterly} wind blew across the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵强劲的东风吹过港口。

e.en: The boat drifted in an {easterly} direction overnight.
e.zh: 小船一夜之间向东漂去。

e.en: Many tech companies have offices in {eastern} China.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在中国东部设有办事处。

e.en: She studies {eastern} philosophy at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究东方哲学。

edmonton.t: n. 埃德蒙顿（加拿大城市）

e.en: Winters in {Edmonton} can drop below minus thirty degrees.
e.zh: 埃德蒙顿的冬天气温能降到零下三十度以下。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Edmonton} for an engineering job.
e.zh: 我表哥为了一份工程师工作搬去了埃德蒙顿。

e.en: The textbook's third {edn} includes updated case studies throughout.
e.zh: 这本教科书的第三版收录了全面更新的案例研究。

e.en: Check the latest {edn} for the corrected formulas.
e.zh: 请查阅最新版本以获取修正后的公式。

edta.t: n. 乙二胺四乙酸（螯合剂）

e.en: The lab uses {EDTA} to prevent blood samples from clotting.
e.zh: 实验室用EDTA防止血液样本凝固。

e.en: Many shampoos contain {EDTA} as a chelating agent.
e.zh: 许多洗发水含有EDTA作为螯合剂。

educable.t: adj. 可教育的，可培养的

e.en: The program supports children with {educable} learning differences.
e.zh: 该项目支持有可教育性学习差异的儿童。

e.en: Even older dogs are surprisingly {educable} with patience.
e.zh: 只要有耐心，老狗也出人意料地能被训练。

e.en: Schools must {educate} students about online safety risks.
e.zh: 学校必须教育学生认识网络安全风险。

e.en: We need to {educate} consumers about hidden subscription fees.
e.zh: 我们需要让消费者了解隐藏的订阅费用。

educated.t: adj. 受过教育的；有学识的

e.en: She is highly {educated} but struggled to find work.
e.zh: 她受过良好教育，但仍很难找到工作。

e.en: Make an {educated} guess if you don't know the answer.
e.zh: 不知道答案时就做一个有根据的猜测吧。

educates.t: v. 教育（educate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {educates} users about healthy sleep habits daily.
e.zh: 这款应用每天向用户普及健康的睡眠习惯。

e.en: Her podcast {educates} listeners on personal finance basics.
e.zh: 她的播客向听众普及个人理财基础知识。

educating.t: v. 教育中（educate 的现在分词）

e.en: The campaign focuses on {educating} parents about screen time.
e.zh: 该活动重点向家长普及屏幕使用时间的知识。

e.en: {Educating} rural children remains a major national priority.
e.zh: 教育农村儿童仍是国家的一项重要任务。

e.en: A good {education} opens doors to better career opportunities.
e.zh: 良好的教育能打开通往更好职业机会的大门。

e.en: Online {education} grew rapidly during the pandemic years.
e.zh: 在线教育在疫情期间迅速发展。

educational.t: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的

e.en: The museum offers {educational} programs for school groups.
e.zh: 博物馆为学校团体提供教育项目。

e.en: YouTube has tons of {educational} content for kids.
e.zh: YouTube上有大量适合孩子的教育内容。

e.en: The {educationalist} proposed reforms to the national curriculum.
e.zh: 那位教育学家对国家课程改革提出了建议。

e.en: She trained as an {educationalist} before becoming a minister.
e.zh: 她在成为部长前曾接受过教育学家培训。

e.en: The game is both fun and {educationally} valuable for children.
e.zh: 这款游戏对儿童来说既好玩又具有教育价值。

e.en: {Educationally}, the new policy benefits low-income families most.
e.zh: 从教育角度看，新政策最有利于低收入家庭。

e.en: A renowned {educationist} delivered the keynote at the conference.
e.zh: 一位著名的教育家在大会上做了主旨演讲。

e.en: The {educationist} criticized standardized testing as deeply flawed.
e.zh: 这位教育家批评标准化考试存在严重缺陷。

e.en: Travel can be a deeply {educative} experience for teenagers.
e.zh: 旅行对青少年来说可以是非常富有教育意义的体验。

e.en: The documentary has strong {educative} value for biology students.
e.zh: 这部纪录片对生物学专业学生很有教育价值。

e.en: As an {educator}, she inspires students to question everything.
e.zh: 作为一名教育工作者，她激励学生质疑一切。

e.en: The {educator} won an award for innovative teaching methods.
e.zh: 这位教育者因创新的教学方法获得了奖项。

e.en: {Educators} are calling for smaller class sizes nationwide.
e.zh: 教育工作者们呼吁全国范围内缩小班级规模。

e.en: Many {educators} struggle with rapidly changing technology in classrooms.
e.zh: 许多教师难以应对课堂中快速变化的技术。

e.en: A skilled teacher can {educe} talent from quiet students.
e.zh: 优秀的老师能从安静的学生身上引出才能。

e.en: The interviewer tried to {educe} honest answers from him.
e.zh: 采访者试图从他那里引出真实的回答。

edutainment.t: n. 寓教于乐的节目或产品

e.en: Sesame Street pioneered {edutainment} for preschool children worldwide.
e.zh: 《芝麻街》在全球开创了学龄前儿童的寓教于乐节目。

e.en: Parents increasingly seek {edutainment} apps that actually teach something.
e.zh: 家长越来越青睐真正能学到东西的寓教于乐应用。

edwardian.t: adj. 英王爱德华七世时代的

e.en: The hotel retains its grand {Edwardian} architecture and charm.
e.zh: 这家酒店保留着宏伟的爱德华时代建筑风格和魅力。

e.en: She collects {Edwardian} jewelry from antique markets in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的古董市场收集爱德华时代的珠宝。

eea.t: n. 欧洲经济区（European Economic Area）

e.en: Norway participates in the single market through the {EEA} agreement.
e.zh: 挪威通过欧洲经济区协议参与单一市场。

e.en: Citizens of {EEA} countries can work freely across member states.
e.zh: 欧洲经济区国家公民可在成员国之间自由工作。

eec.t: n. 欧洲经济共同体（European Economic Community）

e.en: Britain joined the {EEC} in 1973 after lengthy negotiations.
e.zh: 英国在经过长期谈判后于1973年加入了欧洲经济共同体。

e.en: The {EEC} eventually evolved into today's European Union.
e.zh: 欧洲经济共同体最终演变为今天的欧盟。

eeg.t: n. 脑电图（electroencephalogram 的缩写）

e.en: The doctor ordered an {EEG} to check for seizure activity.
e.zh: 医生开了脑电图检查以查看是否有癫痫活动。

e.en: Researchers used {EEG} to study brain responses during sleep.
e.zh: 研究人员用脑电图研究睡眠期间的大脑反应。

eejit.t: n. 傻瓜，蠢货（爱尔兰/苏格兰俚语）

e.en: Don't be such an {eejit} and lock the door behind you.
e.zh: 别那么傻，进门后把门锁上。

e.en: The Irish character called him an {eejit} for forgetting umbrella.
e.zh: 那位爱尔兰角色因他忘带伞而骂他是个傻瓜。

e.en: Grilled {eel} is a popular dish in Japanese cuisine.
e.zh: 烤鳗鱼是日本料理中很受欢迎的一道菜。

e.en: The slippery {eel} wriggled out of his hands instantly.
e.zh: 那条滑溜溜的鳗鱼立刻从他手中扭了出去。

e.en: {Eelgrass} meadows provide vital habitat for young fish species.
e.zh: 鳗草草甸为幼鱼提供了重要的栖息地。

e.en: Pollution has destroyed much of the bay's {eelgrass} cover.
e.zh: 污染破坏了海湾大部分的鳗草覆盖区。

eerie.t: adj. 怪异的，令人毛骨悚然的

e.en: The abandoned hospital had an {eerie} silence at night.
e.zh: 那座废弃医院夜里弥漫着诡异的寂静。

e.en: There's an {eerie} resemblance between the twins' voices.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎的声音有种诡异的相似。

eeriest.t: adj. 最诡异的（eerie 最高级）

e.en: That was the {eeriest} sound I've ever heard in the woods.
e.zh: 那是我在树林里听过最诡异的声音。

e.en: This documentary covers the {eeriest} unsolved mysteries in history.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了历史上最诡异的未解之谜。

e.en: The empty subway station felt {eerily} quiet at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分，空荡荡的地铁站显得诡异地安静。

e.en: Her prediction came {eerily} close to what actually happened.
e.zh: 她的预言与实际发生的情况惊人地接近。

e.en: The fog added an {eeriness} to the deserted village streets.
e.zh: 雾气给荒凉的村中街道增添了一种诡异感。

e.en: There's a strange {eeriness} about old abandoned amusement parks.
e.zh: 废弃的旧游乐园有种奇怪的诡异气息。

eery.t: adj. 怪异的（eerie 的异体）

e.en: An {eery} glow came from the basement window at midnight.
e.zh: 午夜时分，地下室窗户透出一种诡异的微光。

e.en: The forest felt {eery} after the sudden snowfall stopped.
e.zh: 突如其来的雪停后，森林显得阴森诡异。

efa.t: n. 必需脂肪酸（essential fatty acid）

e.en: Omega-3 is an {EFA} the body cannot produce itself.
e.zh: 欧米伽-3是一种人体无法自行合成的必需脂肪酸。

e.en: Nutritionists recommend foods rich in {EFA} for brain health.
e.zh: 营养师建议多吃富含必需脂肪酸的食物来保护大脑。

eff.t: v. 脏话委婉语（代替 fuck）

e.en: He told the rude customer to {eff} off politely.
e.zh: 他客气地叫那个无礼的顾客滚开。

e.en: What the {eff} is happening with my internet connection?
e.zh: 我的网络到底是怎么回事？

e.en: Time will eventually {efface} even the deepest carved inscriptions.
e.zh: 时间最终会磨灭哪怕是最深的雕刻铭文。

e.en: She tried to {efface} all memories of that relationship.
e.zh: 她试图抹去关于那段感情的所有记忆。

effacement.t: n. 抹去；消失；自我隐退

e.en: Doctors monitor cervical {effacement} during the later stages of labor.
e.zh: 医生在分娩后期会监测子宫颈消失情况。

e.en: The {effacement} of old graffiti revealed a hidden mural underneath.
e.zh: 清除旧涂鸦后露出了下面隐藏的壁画。

effect.t:
n. 效果；影响
v. 实现；使产生

e.en: Caffeine has a strong {effect} on my sleep quality.
e.zh: 咖啡因对我的睡眠质量有很大影响。

e.en: The new tax law takes {effect} next January.
e.zh: 新税法将于明年一月生效。

e.en: Regular exercise is the most {effective} treatment for mild depression.
e.zh: 定期锻炼是治疗轻度抑郁最有效的方法。

e.en: She gave an {effective} presentation that won over the investors.
e.zh: 她做了一场出色的演讲，赢得了投资者的认可。

e.en: The team communicates {effectively} despite working across three time zones.
e.zh: 尽管跨越三个时区工作，团队仍能高效沟通。

e.en: The new policy {effectively} bans single-use plastic bags citywide.
e.zh: 新政策实际上在全市禁止了一次性塑料袋。

e.en: Studies confirm the vaccine's {effectiveness} against severe symptoms.
e.zh: 研究证实该疫苗对重症症状的有效性。

e.en: We measure ad {effectiveness} by click-through rates and conversions.
e.zh: 我们通过点击率和转化率来衡量广告效果。

e.en: The report compared the {effectivenesses} of four different teaching methods.
e.zh: 该报告比较了四种不同教学方法的有效性。

e.en: Researchers documented the relative {effectivenesses} of various cancer treatments.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了各种癌症治疗方法的相对有效性。

e.en: The robot's {effector} can grip objects of various shapes.
e.zh: 该机器人的执行器能抓取各种形状的物体。

e.en: Hormones bind to receptors and trigger {effector} cells to respond.
e.zh: 激素与受体结合，触发效应细胞作出反应。

effects.t:
n. 效果；影响（复数）
v. 实现（三单）

e.en: Climate change has serious long-term {effects} on coastal communities.
e.zh: 气候变化对沿海社区有严重的长期影响。

e.en: The movie's special {effects} cost more than the script.
e.zh: 这部电影的特效成本比剧本还高。

e.en: The medication proved {effectual} in reducing chronic joint pain.
e.zh: 该药物在减轻慢性关节疼痛方面证明有效。

e.en: Her warning was {effectual} in stopping the dangerous behavior.
e.zh: 她的警告有效地制止了那种危险行为。

e.en: The new fence {effectually} prevented deer from raiding the garden.
e.zh: 新栅栏有效地阻止了鹿群闯入花园。

e.en: Strict regulations {effectually} reduced air pollution in the city.
e.zh: 严格的规定切实降低了该市的空气污染。

e.en: The new law will {effectuate} sweeping changes to healthcare.
e.zh: 这项新法律将促成医疗体系的重大变革。

e.en: Managers must {effectuate} the board's strategy within six months.
e.zh: 管理层必须在六个月内落实董事会的战略。

e.en: Critics mocked his {effeminacy} in the harshest terms.
e.zh: 批评者以最尖刻的言辞嘲笑他的女气。

e.en: The play challenges old stereotypes about {effeminacy} and masculinity.
e.zh: 这部戏挑战了关于女气与男子气概的陈旧刻板印象。

e.en: He spoke in a soft, slightly {effeminate} voice.
e.zh: 他说话声音柔和,略带女性化。

e.en: The character's {effeminate} mannerisms drew unfair criticism online.
e.zh: 该角色女性化的举止在网上招来了不公平的批评。

effendi.t: n. 先生（土耳其等地对男子的尊称）

e.en: The old {effendi} greeted us warmly at the gate.
e.zh: 那位老爷在门口热情地迎接我们。

e.en: In Ottoman society, an {effendi} was a respected gentleman or scholar.
e.zh: 在奥斯曼社会中,effendi 是受人尊敬的绅士或学者。

e.en: {Efferent} nerves carry signals from the brain to muscles.
e.zh: 传出神经将信号从大脑传递到肌肉。

e.en: The diagram highlights {efferent} pathways in red.
e.zh: 该图用红色标出了传出神经通路。

e.en: The tablets {effervesce} as soon as they hit water.
e.zh: 药片一接触水就开始冒泡。

e.en: Champagne continues to {effervesce} long after being poured.
e.zh: 香槟倒出后还会持续冒气泡很久。

e.en: I love the {effervescence} of a freshly opened soda.
e.zh: 我喜欢刚开瓶汽水那种气泡四溢的感觉。

e.en: Her natural {effervescence} made the whole room light up.
e.zh: 她天生活泼开朗,让整个房间都热闹起来。

effervescent.t: adj. 冒泡的；热情洋溢的

e.en: She has an {effervescent} personality that everyone enjoys.
e.zh: 她性格活泼开朗,大家都很喜欢她。

e.en: Drop one {effervescent} tablet into a glass of water.
e.zh: 把一片泡腾片放入一杯水中。

effete.t: adj. 衰弱的；没有活力的

e.en: Critics dismissed the ruling class as lazy and {effete}.
e.zh: 评论家认为统治阶级懒散又软弱无能。

e.en: The novel satirizes the {effete} aristocrats of pre-war Europe.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了战前欧洲那些颓废虚弱的贵族。

e.en: The vaccine proved highly {efficacious} in clinical trials.
e.zh: 该疫苗在临床试验中被证明非常有效。

e.en: Meditation can be an {efficacious} remedy for everyday stress.
e.zh: 冥想对缓解日常压力是一种有效的方法。

e.en: Researchers questioned the {efficacy} of the new treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员质疑这种新疗法的疗效。

e.en: We need data to demonstrate the {efficacy} of this approach.
e.zh: 我们需要数据来证明这种方法的有效性。

e.en: Automation has created huge {efficiencies} in our supply chain.
e.zh: 自动化为我们的供应链带来了巨大的效率提升。

e.en: The merger should produce real cost {efficiencies} next year.
e.zh: 明年这次合并应该会带来切实的成本效益。

e.en: The new engine improves fuel {efficiency} by twenty percent.
e.zh: 新引擎将燃油效率提升了百分之二十。

e.en: Remote work can boost {efficiency} when meetings are kept short.
e.zh: 会议简短时,远程办公能够提高效率。

e.en: This algorithm is more {efficient} than the old one.
e.zh: 这个算法比旧的更高效。

e.en: She's incredibly {efficient} at handling customer complaints.
e.zh: 她处理客户投诉的效率非常高。

e.en: The team handled the crisis quickly and {efficiently}.
e.zh: 团队迅速而高效地处理了这次危机。

e.en: Sort the files {efficiently} so we can find them later.
e.zh: 把文件高效地分类,以便日后查找。

effigy.t: n. 肖像；人像（常用于焚烧抗议）

e.en: Protesters burned an {effigy} of the prime minister.
e.zh: 抗议者焚烧了首相的塑像。

e.en: A bronze {effigy} of the king stood in the square.
e.zh: 广场上立着一尊国王的青铜像。

effing.t: adj. 该死的（fucking 的委婉说法）

e.en: It's {effing} freezing outside today!
e.zh: 今天外面冷得要命!

e.en: I can't believe the {effing} printer is broken again.
e.zh: 真不敢相信那台破打印机又坏了。

e.en: White {efflorescence} appeared on the basement walls after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后地下室墙上出现了一层白色盐渍。

e.en: The 1920s saw an {efflorescence} of jazz in Harlem.
e.zh: 1920 年代哈莱姆区爵士乐迎来了繁荣兴盛。

e.en: The factory was fined for dumping {effluent} into the river.
e.zh: 该工厂因向河中排放废水而被罚款。

e.en: Treated {effluent} can sometimes be reused for irrigation.
e.zh: 经过处理的废水有时可以再用于灌溉。

e.en: Strange {effluvia} drifted up from the abandoned drain.
e.zh: 一股股怪味从废弃的下水道里飘出来。

e.en: The chemical plant released harmful {effluvia} into the air.
e.zh: 化工厂向空气中排放了有害气体。

e.en: A foul {effluvium} rose from the swamp at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分,沼泽中升起一股恶臭。

e.en: Doctors warned residents about the toxic {effluvium} near the dump.
e.zh: 医生警告居民垃圾场附近有毒气体的危害。

e.en: Engineers measured the {efflux} of gas from the pipe.
e.zh: 工程师测量了管道中气体的流出量。

e.en: An ion {efflux} drives the cell's electrical signal.
e.zh: 离子的外流驱动了细胞的电信号。

e.en: It took a huge {effort} to finish the report on time.
e.zh: 按时完成这份报告费了很大的劲。

e.en: Thanks for your {effort} on the launch this week.
e.zh: 谢谢你这周为这次发布付出的努力。

e.en: Learning a new language is slow and {effortful} at first.
e.zh: 学一门新语言起初既缓慢又费力。

e.en: Her smile looked {effortful} rather than genuine.
e.zh: 她的微笑看上去很勉强,并不真心。

e.en: She made public speaking look completely {effortless}.
e.zh: 她让公开演讲看起来毫不费力。

e.en: The app provides {effortless} syncing across all your devices.
e.zh: 该应用让所有设备间的同步变得轻松无忧。

effortlessly.t: adv. 轻松地；毫不费力地

e.en: He {effortlessly} switched between English and Mandarin.
e.zh: 他在英语和普通话之间毫不费力地切换。

e.en: The car handles tight corners {effortlessly}.
e.zh: 这辆车过急弯时轻松自如。

e.en: His writing has an {effortlessness} that's actually very hard to achieve.
e.zh: 他的文字看似轻松自然,其实极难达到。

e.en: The dancer moved with an unusual {effortlessness}.
e.zh: 那位舞者动作中透出难得的轻盈自如。

e.en: Despite our best {efforts}, the deadline slipped by a week.
e.zh: 尽管我们尽了最大努力,截止日期还是延后了一周。

e.en: The team's {efforts} were finally rewarded with a promotion.
e.zh: 团队的努力最终换来了升职。

e.en: He had the {effrontery} to ask for a raise after being late daily.
e.zh: 他天天迟到,居然还厚着脸皮要求加薪。

e.en: Her {effrontery} in interrupting the CEO shocked everyone.
e.zh: 她竟敢打断 CEO 讲话,真是大胆得让人吃惊。

e.en: The {effulgence} of the sunrise lit up the entire valley.
e.zh: 日出的灿烂光辉照亮了整个山谷。

e.en: A soft {effulgence} surrounded the candle on the altar.
e.zh: 祭坛上的蜡烛散发着柔和的光辉。

e.en: The actress wore an {effulgent} silver gown to the premiere.
e.zh: 那位女演员身穿一袭闪闪发光的银色礼服出席首映。

e.en: An {effulgent} moon hung above the quiet sea.
e.zh: 一轮皎洁明亮的月亮悬在宁静的海面上。

e.en: His speech was a long {effusion} of gratitude and tears.
e.zh: 他的讲话是一段冗长而充满感激和泪水的倾诉。

e.en: Doctors drained a pleural {effusion} from the patient's lung.
e.zh: 医生从病人的肺部抽出了胸腔积液。

effusive.t: adj. 热情洋溢的；感情外露的

e.en: She offered {effusive} thanks for the unexpected gift.
e.zh: 她为这份意外的礼物表达了热烈的感谢。

e.en: The reviews were {effusive}, calling the film a masterpiece.
e.zh: 评论赞不绝口,称这部电影为杰作。

e.en: He {effusively} praised the new intern in front of everyone.
e.zh: 他在众人面前对新来的实习生大加赞扬。

e.en: The host greeted us {effusively} at the door.
e.zh: 主人在门口热情洋溢地迎接我们。

efl.t: n. 英语作为外语（English as a Foreign Language 缩写）

e.en: She teaches {EFL} to adult learners in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她在东京给成年学习者教英语作为外语。

e.en: Many {EFL} textbooks now include short video clips.
e.zh: 许多英语作为外语的教材现在都附有短视频片段。

efta.t: n. 欧洲自由贸易联盟（European Free Trade Association 缩写）

e.en: Norway and Switzerland are both members of {EFTA}.
e.zh: 挪威和瑞士都是欧洲自由贸易联盟的成员。

e.en: {EFTA} negotiated a separate trade deal with the UK.
e.zh: 欧洲自由贸易联盟与英国单独谈判了一项贸易协议。

ega.t: n. 增强图形适配器（Enhanced Graphics Adapter 缩写）

e.en: My old PC could barely run games in {EGA} graphics.
e.zh: 我那台旧电脑几乎跑不动 EGA 显卡的游戏。

e.en: {EGA} supported sixteen colors, a big jump from CGA.
e.zh: EGA 支持十六种颜色,比 CGA 有了大幅提升。

e.en: "{Egad}, I forgot the keys again!" he muttered.
e.zh: “天哪,我又忘带钥匙了!”他咕哝道。

e.en: {Egad}, that bill is much higher than I expected.
e.zh: 我的天,这账单比我预想的高得多。

egalitarian.t:
adj. 平等主义的
n. 平等主义者

e.en: The startup promotes an {egalitarian} culture without job titles.
e.zh: 这家初创公司倡导一种不设职称的平等文化。

e.en: Sweden is often cited as a relatively {egalitarian} society.
e.zh: 瑞典常被视为一个相对平等的社会。

e.en: The party was founded on principles of social {egalitarianism}.
e.zh: 该党是基于社会平等主义的原则建立起来的。

e.en: Critics argue that pure {egalitarianism} ignores individual effort.
e.zh: 批评者认为纯粹的平等主义忽视了个人努力。

e.en: The {egalitarians} pushed for equal pay across all departments.
e.zh: 平等主义者推动各部门间实行同工同酬。

e.en: Many {egalitarians} support universal healthcare and free education.
e.zh: 许多平等主义者支持全民医保和免费教育。

e.en: We took the kids to {Egerton} House Museum last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们带孩子去了埃杰顿故居博物馆。

e.en: Professor {Egerton} will give the keynote at the conference.
e.zh: 埃杰顿教授将在会议上做主旨发言。

egf.t: n. 表皮生长因子（epidermal growth factor 缩写）

e.en: {EGF} is added to many high-end skincare serums.
e.zh: 许多高端护肤精华液中都添加了表皮生长因子。

e.en: Researchers study how {EGF} signaling drives certain cancers.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究表皮生长因子信号如何驱动某些癌症。

egg.t:
n. 蛋；鸡蛋
n. 卵

e.en: I usually have one boiled {egg} for breakfast.
e.zh: 我早餐通常吃一个白煮蛋。

e.en: Don't forget to buy a dozen {eggs} on your way home.
e.zh: 回家路上别忘了买一打鸡蛋。

e.en: My grandma still uses a hand {eggbeater} for pancakes.
e.zh: 我奶奶做煎饼时还在用手摇打蛋器。

e.en: Toss the {eggbeater} in the dishwasher when you're done.
e.zh: 用完后把打蛋器扔进洗碗机里就行。

egghead.t: n. 书呆子；知识分子（贬义）

e.en: My brother is a total {egghead} who reads physics for fun.
e.zh: 我哥是个十足的书呆子,读物理书当娱乐。

e.en: The team needs more {eggheads} to crack this problem.
e.zh: 团队需要更多书生气的高手来解决这个问题。

e.en: We always drink {eggnog} on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 我们每年平安夜都会喝蛋奶酒。

e.en: This {eggnog} recipe uses bourbon and fresh nutmeg.
e.zh: 这款蛋奶酒配方用了波本威士忌和新鲜肉豆蔻。

e.en: I roasted some {eggplant} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 我用蒜和橄榄油烤了一些茄子。

e.en: The walls are painted a deep {eggplant} purple.
e.zh: 墙壁刷成了浓郁的茄紫色。

e.en: She scrambled some {eggs} for a quick breakfast.
e.zh: 她炒了几个蛋当作快手早餐。

e.en: Sea turtles lay their {eggs} on sandy beaches.
e.zh: 海龟会在沙滩上产卵。

eggshell.t:
n. 蛋壳
adj. 蛋壳色的；易碎的

e.en: Be careful not to get any {eggshell} in the batter.
e.zh: 小心别让蛋壳掉进面糊里。

e.en: We painted the bedroom a soft {eggshell} white.
e.zh: 我们把卧室刷成了柔和的蛋壳白。

eggy.t: adj. 有蛋味的；沾满蛋液的

e.en: The kitchen smelled {eggy} after breakfast.
e.zh: 早餐过后厨房弥漫着一股蛋味。

e.en: This custard tastes a bit too {eggy} for me.
e.zh: 这个蛋奶冻对我来说蛋味有点太重了。

eglinton.t: n. 埃格林顿（地名/姓氏）

e.en: We caught the subway at {Eglinton} station.
e.zh: 我们在埃格林顿地铁站上了车。

e.en: She lives in a condo near {Eglinton} Avenue.
e.zh: 她住在埃格林顿大道附近的公寓里。

e.en: His huge {ego} makes teamwork difficult.
e.zh: 他自负的个性让团队合作变得很困难。

e.en: Losing the match really bruised her {ego}.
e.zh: 输掉那场比赛严重打击了她的自尊。

egocentric.t: adj. 自我中心的；自私的

e.en: He is so {egocentric} that he ignores everyone else.
e.zh: 他太以自我为中心,根本不理会别人。

e.en: Toddlers tend to be naturally {egocentric}.
e.zh: 幼儿天生倾向于以自我为中心。

egocentricity.t: n. 自我中心（性格特征）

e.en: Her {egocentricity} drove her closest friends away.
e.zh: 她的自我中心把最亲近的朋友都赶走了。

e.en: Fame often amplifies a person's {egocentricity}.
e.zh: 名气常常会放大一个人的自我中心倾向。

e.en: Piaget studied {egocentrism} in young children.
e.zh: 皮亚杰研究了幼儿的自我中心思维。

e.en: His {egocentrism} blinded him to others' feelings.
e.zh: 他的自我中心让他无法察觉他人的感受。

egoism.t: n. 利己主义；自我本位

e.en: Pure {egoism} rarely leads to lasting happiness.
e.zh: 纯粹的利己主义很少带来持久的幸福。

e.en: The philosopher defended ethical {egoism} in his book.
e.zh: 那位哲学家在书中为伦理利己主义辩护。

e.en: He is a complete {egoist} who never shares credit.
e.zh: 他是个彻底的利己主义者,从不分享功劳。

e.en: Only an {egoist} would behave that selfishly at dinner.
e.zh: 只有利己主义者才会在晚餐上那么自私地表现。

e.en: Her {egoistic} attitude annoyed the whole team.
e.zh: 她那种自我至上的态度惹恼了整个团队。

e.en: The novel critiques {egoistic} pursuits of wealth.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了对财富的利己追求。

egomania.t: n. 极度自我中心；自大狂

e.en: Power can quickly turn ambition into {egomania}.
e.zh: 权力会迅速把抱负变成自大狂。

e.en: His {egomania} made working with him impossible.
e.zh: 他的极度自我中心让人没法跟他共事。

egomaniac.t: n. 自大狂；极端自我中心者

e.en: The director is a notorious {egomaniac} on set.
e.zh: 那位导演在片场是出了名的自大狂。

e.en: Nobody wants to date an {egomaniac}.
e.zh: 没人想跟一个自大狂约会。

egomaniacal.t: adj. 极度自我中心的；自大的

e.en: His {egomaniacal} speech alienated the entire audience.
e.zh: 他那番自大狂式的演讲让全场观众反感。

e.en: The CEO's {egomaniacal} decisions tanked the company.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官狂妄自大的决策拖垮了公司。

e.en: Big {egos} often clash in Hollywood productions.
e.zh: 在好莱坞的制作中,大牌的自负常常会冲突。

e.en: The coach has to manage many fragile {egos}.
e.zh: 教练必须照顾许多脆弱的自尊心。

e.en: His {egotism} ruined what could have been a good friendship.
e.zh: 他的自负毁了一段本可以很好的友谊。

e.en: Social media seems to encourage everyday {egotism}.
e.zh: 社交媒体似乎在鼓励日常的自我吹嘘。

e.en: Don't be such an {egotist} at the party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚的派对上别那么自我吹嘘。

e.en: He's an {egotist} who turns every story into his own.
e.zh: 他是个自负的人,把每个话题都扯到自己身上。

e.en: His {egotistic} remarks made the interview awkward.
e.zh: 他那些自负的话让采访变得很尴尬。

e.en: She found his {egotistic} jokes increasingly tiresome.
e.zh: 她觉得他自吹自擂的笑话越来越讨厌。

egotistical.t: adj. 自大的；自以为是的

e.en: Stop being so {egotistical} and listen to others.
e.zh: 别再那么自负,听听别人怎么说。

e.en: The {egotistical} actor refused to share the spotlight.
e.zh: 那位自负的演员不愿与人共享聚光灯。

e.en: The report contained several {egregious} factual errors.
e.zh: 那份报告里有几个极其离谱的事实错误。

e.en: His behavior at the meeting was simply {egregious}.
e.zh: 他在会上的行为简直令人发指。

e.en: The contract was {egregiously} unfair to small vendors.
e.zh: 这份合同对小供应商极其不公平。

e.en: She had been {egregiously} misquoted by the tabloid.
e.zh: 她被那家小报严重断章取义地引用了。

egress.t:
n. 出口；外出
v. 离开

e.en: The fire code requires two {egress} routes per floor.
e.zh: 消防规范要求每层楼必须有两条疏散通道。

e.en: Crowds slowed their {egress} from the stadium.
e.zh: 人群让他们离开体育场的速度慢了下来。

e.en: A white {egret} stood motionless in the marsh.
e.zh: 一只白鹭在沼泽里一动不动地站着。

e.en: The {egret} took flight as we approached the pond.
e.zh: 我们靠近池塘时,那只白鹭飞了起来。

e.en: We visited the pyramids during our trip to {Egypt}.
e.zh: 我们去埃及旅行时参观了金字塔。

e.en: Ancient {Egypt} fascinates archaeologists to this day.
e.zh: 古埃及至今仍让考古学家着迷。

egyptian.t:
adj. 埃及的
n. 埃及人

e.en: She studies {Egyptian} hieroglyphs at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究埃及象形文字。

e.en: The museum acquired a rare {Egyptian} artifact.
e.zh: 博物馆获得了一件珍稀的埃及文物。

e.en: The {egyptologist} deciphered the inscription on the wall.
e.zh: 那位埃及学家破译了墙上的铭文。

e.en: A famous {egyptologist} led the dig at Saqqara.
e.zh: 一位著名的埃及学家主持了萨卡拉的发掘。

eia.t: n. 环境影响评估（Environmental Impact Assessment 缩写）

e.en: The {EIA} forecasts a drop in global oil demand.
e.zh: 美国能源信息署预测全球石油需求将下降。

e.en: The project requires an {EIA} before construction begins.
e.zh: 项目动工前需要进行环境影响评估。

e.en: An {eider} duck dove for shellfish near the rocks.
e.zh: 一只绒鸭在礁石旁潜入水中觅食贝类。

e.en: The coast is home to large flocks of {eider}.
e.zh: 那片海岸栖息着大群的绒鸭。

e.en: She pulled the warm {eiderdown} up to her chin.
e.zh: 她把温暖的鸭绒被拉到下巴。

e.en: This jacket is filled with genuine {eiderdown}.
e.zh: 这件外套里填的是真正的绒鸭羽绒。

eidetic.t: adj. 过目不忘的；遗觉的

e.en: He claims to have an {eidetic} memory for faces.
e.zh: 他声称自己对人脸有过目不忘的记忆力。

e.en: True {eidetic} memory in adults is extremely rare.
e.zh: 成年人真正具有过目不忘记忆的非常罕见。

eiffel.t: n. 埃菲尔（如埃菲尔铁塔）

e.en: We watched the sunset from the {Eiffel} Tower.
e.zh: 我们在埃菲尔铁塔上观看了日落。

e.en: The {Eiffel} Tower lights up every evening in Paris.
e.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔每晚都会在巴黎亮起灯光。

e.en: The matrix has three distinct {eigenvalue} solutions.
e.zh: 该矩阵有三个不同的特征值解。

e.en: Compute the largest {eigenvalue} of this symmetric matrix.
e.zh: 求出这个对称矩阵的最大特征值。

eiger.t: n. 艾格峰（瑞士阿尔卑斯山峰）

e.en: Climbing the {Eiger} north face remains a serious challenge.
e.zh: 攀登艾格峰北壁至今仍是一项严峻挑战。

e.en: The {Eiger} dominates the skyline above Grindelwald.
e.zh: 艾格峰主宰着格林德尔瓦尔德上方的天际线。

e.en: The meeting starts at {eight} sharp tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 会议明天早上八点准时开始。

e.en: She ordered {eight} dumplings for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了八个饺子。

e.en: You must be {eighteen} to vote in this country.
e.zh: 在这个国家你必须年满十八岁才能投票。

e.en: The team has {eighteen} active players this season.
e.zh: 本赛季球队有十八名现役球员。

eighteenth.t:
adj. 第十八的
n. 十八分之一

e.en: Her {eighteenth} birthday party was unforgettable.
e.zh: 她的十八岁生日派对令人难忘。

e.en: The novel is set in the {eighteenth} century.
e.zh: 这部小说的背景设在十八世纪。

eightfold.t:
adj. 八倍的
adv. 以八倍

e.en: Online sales grew {eightfold} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间在线销售增长了八倍。

e.en: Buddhism teaches the noble {eightfold} path.
e.zh: 佛教传授高贵的八正道。

eighth.t:
adj. 第八的
n. 八分之一

e.en: She finished {eighth} in the marathon.
e.zh: 她在马拉松比赛中获得第八名。

e.en: Cut the cake into {eighth} slices for the kids.
e.zh: 把蛋糕切成八等份给孩子们。

e.en: Divide the pizza into {eighths} so everyone gets a piece.
e.zh: 把披萨切成八等份,让每个人都能分到一块。

e.en: Three {eighths} of the students chose Spanish.
e.zh: 八分之三的学生选择了西班牙语。

eightieth.t:
adj. 第八十的
n. 八十分之一

e.en: They threw a huge party for grandma's {eightieth} birthday.
e.zh: 他们为奶奶的八十大寿办了一个盛大的派对。

e.en: The company celebrated its {eightieth} anniversary last week.
e.zh: 公司上周庆祝了八十周年纪念。

e.en: In old novels, a loaf of bread cost just {eightpence}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,一条面包只要八便士。

e.en: He pulled {eightpence} from his pocket for the fare.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出八便士付车费。

e.en: Grandpa is turning {eighty} this December.
e.zh: 爷爷今年十二月就八十岁了。

e.en: The hotel has {eighty} rooms overlooking the sea.
e.zh: 这家酒店有八十间面海的客房。

ein.t: (德语) 一个，相当于英语的 a/an

e.en: In German class we learned that '{ein}' means 'a' or 'one'.
e.zh: 在德语课上我们学到 ein 的意思是“一个”。

e.en: He greeted the waiter and ordered '{ein} Bier, bitte'.
e.zh: 他向服务员打招呼并点了一杯啤酒。

eindhoven.t: n. 埃因霍温（荷兰城市）

e.en: Philips was founded in the Dutch city of {Eindhoven}.
e.zh: 飞利浦创立于荷兰城市埃因霍温。

e.en: We flew into {Eindhoven} to visit the design museum.
e.zh: 我们飞到埃因霍温参观设计博物馆。

eine.t: (德语) 阴性不定冠词，一个

e.en: She wrote '{eine} kleine Nachtmusik' on the program cover.
e.zh: 她在节目单封面上写下了《一首小夜曲》。

e.en: In German, '{eine}' is the feminine form of 'a'.
e.zh: 在德语中,eine 是不定冠词的阴性形式。

einstein.t: n. 爱因斯坦（物理学家）

e.en: {Einstein} revolutionized physics with his theory of relativity.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦凭借相对论彻底改变了物理学。

e.en: You don't have to be {Einstein} to solve this puzzle.
e.zh: 解开这道谜题不需要你是个天才。

e.en: The experiment confirmed several {Einsteinian} predictions.
e.zh: 该实验证实了爱因斯坦的若干预言。

e.en: GPS satellites must account for {Einsteinian} time dilation.
e.zh: GPS 卫星必须考虑爱因斯坦提出的时间膨胀效应。

eire.t: n. 爱尔兰（爱尔兰语国名）

e.en: {Eire} is the Irish-language name for Ireland.
e.zh: Eire 是爱尔兰在爱尔兰语中的名字。

e.en: The treaty was signed by representatives of {Eire}.
e.zh: 该条约由爱尔兰的代表签署。

eis.t: n. 高管信息系统；环境影响报告

e.en: The new hire reviewed the {EIS} before her first shift.
e.zh: 新员工在第一次轮班前查阅了员工信息系统。

e.en: German children always ask for '{Eis}' on hot days.
e.zh: 德国小孩在大热天总是吵着要冰淇淋。

eisa.t: n. 扩展工业标准架构（旧总线标准）

e.en: Tourists gather in Okinawa each summer to watch {eisa}.
e.zh: 每年夏天游客们都会聚集在冲绳观看 eisa 太鼓表演。

e.en: The {eisa} dancers drummed energetically through the streets.
e.zh: eisa 舞者们沿街充满活力地敲鼓起舞。

eisteddfod.t: n. 威尔士传统诗歌音乐节

e.en: The Welsh {eisteddfod} celebrates poetry and music.
e.zh: 威尔士的 eisteddfod 文化节庆祝诗歌与音乐。

e.en: She won a prize for singing at the local {eisteddfod}.
e.zh: 她在当地的 eisteddfod 比赛中因唱歌获奖。

either.t:
adj. 任一的；两者之一
adv. 也（用于否定句）

e.en: You can take {either} the bus or the train.
e.zh: 你可以坐公交车,也可以坐火车。

e.en: I don't like coffee, and I don't like tea {either}.
e.zh: 我不喜欢咖啡,也不喜欢茶。

ejaculate.t:
v. 射精
v. 突然喊出

e.en: Doctors study how the body produces and releases {ejaculate}.
e.zh: 医生研究身体如何产生和排出精液。

e.en: "Watch out!" he {ejaculate}d as the vase tipped over.
e.zh: "小心!"花瓶倾倒时他突然喊道。

ejaculation.t:
n. 射精
n. 突然的惊呼

e.en: The clinic offers treatment for premature {ejaculation}.
e.zh: 该诊所提供早泄治疗服务。

e.en: His sudden {ejaculation} of surprise startled everyone in the room.
e.zh: 他突然惊呼一声,把屋里每个人都吓了一跳。

ejaculatory.t: adj. 射精的；突然喊出的

e.en: The textbook describes the {ejaculatory} ducts in detail.
e.zh: 教科书详细描述了射精管的结构。

e.en: He let out a brief {ejaculatory} cry of joy.
e.zh: 他短促地发出一声欢呼。

eject.t:
v. 弹出；驱逐
v. （飞行员）弹射逃生

e.en: Press this button to {eject} the disc from the player.
e.zh: 按这个按钮可以从播放器中弹出光盘。

e.en: Security had to {eject} the rowdy fan from the stadium.
e.zh: 保安不得不把那名闹事的球迷赶出体育场。

ejecta.t: n. 喷出物（火山、陨石撞击）

e.en: Scientists analyzed the volcanic {ejecta} scattered across the valley.
e.zh: 科学家分析了散落在山谷中的火山喷出物。

e.en: The crater was surrounded by rocky {ejecta} from the impact.
e.zh: 撞击坑周围布满了撞击产生的岩石碎屑。

ejected.t: v. 被弹出；被驱逐（eject 的过去式）

e.en: The pilot {ejected} seconds before the jet crashed.
e.zh: 飞行员在战机坠毁前几秒弹射逃生。

e.en: The referee {ejected} two players for fighting.
e.zh: 裁判将两名打架的球员罚下场。

e.en: His {ejection} from the game cost the team dearly.
e.zh: 他被罚出场让球队损失惨重。

e.en: The fighter jet has an emergency {ejection} seat.
e.zh: 这架战斗机配有紧急弹射座椅。

e.en: The rifle's {ejector} flips spent shells out automatically.
e.zh: 步枪的抛壳器会自动把弹壳弹出。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the {ejector} mechanism for better reliability.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了抛出机构以提高可靠性。

ejido.t: n. 墨西哥的公有耕地

e.en: The Mexican {ejido} system grants farmland to local communities.
e.zh: 墨西哥的公有土地制度把农田分配给当地社区。

e.en: Farmers in the {ejido} share water rights and grazing land.
e.zh: 公有地里的农民共享水权和牧场。

eke.t: v. 勉强维持（生计）；设法凑足

e.en: Many freelancers {eke} out a living from gig to gig.
e.zh: 许多自由职业者靠零工勉强糊口。

e.en: The team managed to {eke} out a one-point win.
e.zh: 球队勉强以一分险胜。

elaborate.t:
adj. 精心设计的；详尽的
v. 详细阐述

e.en: She wore an {elaborate} costume to the masquerade ball.
e.zh: 她穿着一身精致的服装去参加化装舞会。

e.en: Could you {elaborate} on your last point a little?
e.zh: 你能就刚才那一点再详细说说吗?

elaborated.t:
