v. 详细阐述（过去式）
adj. 精心制作的

e.en: The professor {elaborated} on the theory for another hour.
e.zh: 教授又花了一个小时详细阐述这个理论。

e.en: He {elaborated} a detailed plan for launching the startup.
e.zh: 他制定了一份创办初创公司的详尽计划。

e.en: The cake was {elaborately} decorated with sugar flowers.
e.zh: 蛋糕上精心装饰着糖花。

e.en: She {elaborately} explained why the project had stalled.
e.zh: 她详尽地解释了项目停滞的原因。

elaborates.t: v. 详细阐述（第三人称单数）

e.en: Chapter two {elaborates} on the author's main argument.
e.zh: 第二章详细阐述了作者的核心论点。

e.en: The chef {elaborates} simple ingredients into stunning dishes.
e.zh: 这位厨师把简单的食材精心制作成惊艳的菜肴。

e.en: She spent the meeting {elaborating} on next quarter's strategy.
e.zh: 她整场会议都在详细说明下季度的战略。

e.en: Without {elaborating} further, he ended the press conference.
e.zh: 他没有再多作说明,就结束了新闻发布会。

elaboration.t: n. 详尽阐述；精心制作

e.en: The proposal needs more {elaboration} before the board reviews it.
e.zh: 这份提案在董事会审查前还需要更多细节说明。

e.en: His answer was brief, with no {elaboration} offered.
e.zh: 他的回答很简短,没有作进一步阐述。

e.en: The script's later {elaborations} made the plot confusing.
e.zh: 剧本后期的种种添加让情节变得混乱。

e.en: She added small {elaborations} to the recipe over the years.
e.zh: 多年来她对这道食谱做了一些小的改良。

elaborative.t: adj. 精心阐述的；精加工的

e.en: Teachers encourage {elaborative} thinking to deepen student understanding.
e.zh: 老师鼓励精细化思考,以加深学生的理解。

e.en: The notes use an {elaborative} approach linking new ideas to old.
e.zh: 这套笔记采用精加工方法,把新概念与旧知识联系起来。

e.en: She danced with the {elan} of a seasoned performer.
e.zh: 她以老练表演者的活力翩翩起舞。

e.en: The young chef cooks with surprising {elan} and confidence.
e.zh: 这位年轻厨师做菜时充满了出人意料的活力与自信。

e.en: A herd of {eland} grazed peacefully on the savanna.
e.zh: 一群大羚羊在草原上安详地吃草。

e.en: The {eland} is the largest antelope species in Africa.
e.zh: 大羚羊是非洲体型最大的羚羊。

e.en: Several months will {elapse} before the verdict is announced.
e.zh: 在判决宣布前还要过好几个月。

e.en: Let a few minutes {elapse} before refreshing the page.
e.zh: 等几分钟再刷新页面。

elapsed.t:
v. 已流逝（elapse 的过去式）
adj. 已过的（时间）

e.en: Two hours had {elapsed} since the meeting started.
e.zh: 会议开始后已经过去了两个小时。

e.en: The app shows the {elapsed} time of your workout.
e.zh: 这款应用会显示你锻炼已经过去的时间。

elastic.t:
adj. 有弹性的
n. 松紧带

e.en: These leggings have an {elastic} waistband for comfort.
e.zh: 这条紧身裤有松紧腰带,穿着舒适。

e.en: Working from home gives me a more {elastic} schedule.
e.zh: 在家办公让我的时间安排更有弹性。

e.en: The shorts have an {elasticated} waist for easy fit.
e.zh: 这条短裤腰部有松紧设计,方便穿着。

e.en: She prefers {elasticated} cuffs that don't ride up.
e.zh: 她喜欢松紧袖口,不会往上滑。

e.en: Economists compare price {elasticities} across different consumer goods.
e.zh: 经济学家比较不同消费品的价格弹性。

e.en: The fabrics show different {elasticities} when stretched.
e.zh: 这些面料拉伸时表现出不同的弹性。

e.en: Skin loses {elasticity} as we age.
e.zh: 皮肤会随着年龄增长而失去弹性。

e.en: The product's price {elasticity} surprised the marketing team.
e.zh: 该产品的价格弹性让营销团队感到意外。

e.en: The pants have an {elasticized} waist that fits any size.
e.zh: 这条裤子腰部有弹性,任何尺码都能穿。

e.en: She bought an {elasticized} sheet for the new mattress.
e.zh: 她为新床垫买了一条松紧床单。

elastics.t: n. 松紧带；橡皮筋（复数）

e.en: The orthodontist gave him colored {elastics} for his braces.
e.zh: 正畸医生给他的牙套配了彩色橡皮筋。

e.en: She tied her hair back with two thin {elastics}.
e.zh: 她用两根细皮筋把头发扎了起来。

e.en: {Elastin} helps skin snap back after being stretched.
e.zh: 弹性蛋白帮助皮肤在被拉伸后恢复原状。

e.en: The cream claims to boost collagen and {elastin} production.
e.zh: 这款面霜声称能促进胶原蛋白和弹性蛋白的生成。

elastomer.t: n. 弹性体；高弹聚合物

e.en: The seal is made of a heat-resistant {elastomer}.
e.zh: 这个密封件由耐热弹性体材料制成。

e.en: Engineers chose a soft {elastomer} for the phone case.
e.zh: 工程师为手机壳选择了一种柔软的弹性体。

e.en: The roof was sealed with an {elastomeric} coating.
e.zh: 屋顶用一层弹性涂料做了密封。

e.en: {Elastomeric} gaskets withstand both pressure and temperature changes.
e.zh: 弹性体垫片能承受压力和温度的变化。

elastoplast.t: n. 弹性橡皮膏（英国品牌）

e.en: She put an {elastoplast} on the small cut on her finger.
e.zh: 她在手指的小伤口上贴了一片创可贴。

e.en: Mom keeps a box of {elastoplast} in the kitchen drawer.
e.zh: 妈妈在厨房抽屉里放着一盒创可贴。

e.en: News of the promotion is sure to {elate} her.
e.zh: 升职的消息一定会让她欣喜若狂。

e.en: Small wins can {elate} a struggling team for days.
e.zh: 小小的胜利能让陷入困境的团队兴奋好几天。

elated.t: adj. 兴高采烈的；得意洋洋的

e.en: She felt {elated} after acing her final exam.
e.zh: 期末考试取得高分后,她欣喜若狂。

e.en: Fans were {elated} when the band announced a reunion tour.
e.zh: 乐队宣布重组巡演时,粉丝们欣喜不已。

e.en: His face glowed with {elation} as he crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 冲过终点线时,他脸上洋溢着兴奋。

e.en: The team celebrated their win with pure {elation}.
e.zh: 球队以纯粹的喜悦庆祝胜利。

e.en: Life brings small {elations} that make tough days bearable.
e.zh: 生活中会有些小欢喜,让难熬的日子变得可以忍受。

e.en: The novel captures both the sorrows and {elations} of youth.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉了青春的悲伤与喜悦。

elba.t: n. 厄尔巴岛（拿破仑流放地）

e.en: Napoleon was exiled to the island of {Elba} in 1814.
e.zh: 拿破仑于1814年被流放到厄尔巴岛。

e.en: We took a ferry to {Elba} for a weekend getaway.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮去厄尔巴岛度周末。

e.en: The {Elbe} river flows through Hamburg into the North Sea.
e.zh: 易北河流经汉堡注入北海。

e.en: Tourists cruise the {Elbe} to enjoy the German countryside.
e.zh: 游客们乘船游览易北河,欣赏德国乡村风光。

elbow.t:
n. 手肘；弯头
v. 用肘推挤

e.en: He bumped his {elbow} hard against the door frame.
e.zh: 他的肘部重重地撞到了门框上。

e.en: She had to {elbow} her way through the crowded subway.
e.zh: 她不得不用肘部挤过拥挤的地铁车厢。

elbowroom.t: n. 活动空间；回旋余地

e.en: This tiny apartment doesn't give us much {elbowroom}.
e.zh: 这间小公寓让我们没什么活动空间。

e.en: The new role gives her {elbowroom} to make real decisions.
e.zh: 新职位给了她做出真正决策的余地。

elbows.t:
n. 手肘（复数）
v. 用肘推挤

e.en: Rest your {elbows} on the table only between courses.
e.zh: 只在两道菜之间才把肘部放在桌上。

e.en: He {elbows} his way to the front of every line.
e.zh: 每次排队他都用胳膊挤到最前面。

elder.t:
adj. 年长的
n. 长辈；接骨木

e.en: My {elder} sister taught me how to ride a bike.
e.zh: 我姐姐教我怎么骑自行车。

e.en: Village {elder}s gathered to discuss the new water project.
e.zh: 村里的长辈们聚在一起讨论新的水利工程。

e.en: She brews {elderberry} syrup to fight off winter colds.
e.zh: 她熬制接骨木果糖浆来抵御冬季感冒。

e.en: The bakery sells a delicious {elderberry} jam tart.
e.zh: 这家面包店出售美味的接骨木果酱挞。

eldercare.t: n. 老年护理；养老服务

e.en: Quality {eldercare} is becoming a major concern for families.
e.zh: 优质的养老护理正成为许多家庭关注的大问题。

e.en: She works as a nurse in a local {eldercare} facility.
e.zh: 她在当地一家养老护理机构当护士。

e.en: This cocktail uses {elderflower} liqueur and fresh lime.
e.zh: 这款鸡尾酒用了接骨木花利口酒和新鲜青柠。

e.en: She picked {elderflower} blossoms to make homemade cordial.
e.zh: 她采摘接骨木花来自制果露。

elderly.t: adj. 年老的；上了年纪的

e.en: The app helps {elderly} users video-call their grandchildren easily.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助老年用户轻松地与孙辈视频通话。

e.en: An {elderly} man kindly offered me his seat on the bus.
e.zh: 一位老先生在公交车上好心给我让了座。

e.en: Her {eldest} son just graduated from medical school.
e.zh: 她的大儿子刚从医学院毕业。

e.en: As the {eldest}, he often looks after his siblings.
e.zh: 作为长子,他经常照顾弟弟妹妹。

e.en: Silicon Valley was once seen as a tech {eldorado}.
e.zh: 硅谷曾被视为科技业的黄金乐土。

e.en: For many immigrants, the city felt like a promised {eldorado}.
e.zh: 对许多移民来说,这座城市就像一片应许的黄金乐土。

e.en: An {eldritch} glow hovered above the ancient stones.
e.zh: 古老的石头上方笼罩着一种诡异的光芒。

e.en: The novel features {eldritch} creatures from another dimension.
e.zh: 小说中出现了来自另一个维度的诡异生物。

elect.t:
v. 选举；选择
adj. 当选而未就职的

e.en: Citizens will {elect} a new mayor next month.
e.zh: 市民下个月将选举新市长。

e.en: You may {elect} to receive notifications by email.
e.zh: 你可以选择通过电子邮件接收通知。

elected.t:
adj. 当选的
v. 选出（elect 的过去式）

e.en: Voters {elected} her mayor by a wide margin.
e.zh: 选民以巨大优势选她为市长。

e.en: He {elected} to study abroad instead of taking the job.
e.zh: 他选择出国留学,而没有接受那份工作。

e.en: The country is {electing} a new president this fall.
e.zh: 今年秋天,这个国家将选举新总统。

e.en: She is {electing} to work part-time after the baby arrives.
e.zh: 她决定在孩子出生后改做兼职。

e.en: The {election} results will be announced tonight.
e.zh: 选举结果将于今晚公布。

e.en: Young voters turned out in record numbers for this {election}.
e.zh: 年轻选民在这次选举中以创纪录的人数参与投票。

e.en: Candidates {electioneer} door to door in small towns.
e.zh: 候选人在小镇里挨家挨户拉票。

e.en: He spent the whole summer trying to {electioneer} for his friend.
e.zh: 他整个夏天都在为朋友拉选票。

e.en: The senator was accused of {electioneering} with public funds.
e.zh: 该参议员被指控用公款进行竞选活动。

e.en: Aggressive {electioneering} on social media has changed modern campaigns.
e.zh: 社交媒体上激烈的拉票活动改变了现代竞选。

e.en: Several countries are holding {elections} this year.
e.zh: 今年有好几个国家要举行选举。

e.en: Local {elections} often have surprisingly low turnout.
e.zh: 地方选举的投票率往往低得出奇。

elective.t:
adj. 选修的；选举的
n. 选修课

e.en: She signed up for an {elective} course on film history.
e.zh: 她报名选修了一门电影史课程。

e.en: The surgery is {elective}, not urgent.
e.zh: 这是择期手术,并不紧急。

e.en: Each {elector} casts a vote on behalf of their state.
e.zh: 每位选举人代表本州投出一票。

e.en: The registered {elector} received a ballot in the mail.
e.zh: 这位登记选民收到了邮寄选票。

e.en: The {electoral} system has been criticized for being outdated.
e.zh: 该选举制度被批评已经过时。

e.en: She studies {electoral} behavior in young voters.
e.zh: 她研究年轻选民的选举行为。

e.en: The policy proved {electorally} popular in swing states.
e.zh: 这项政策在摇摆州的选举中颇受欢迎。

e.en: His message resonated {electorally} with rural voters.
e.zh: 他的主张在选举中引起了农村选民的共鸣。

e.en: The {electorate} is deeply divided over immigration.
e.zh: 选民在移民问题上分歧严重。

e.en: Polls suggest the {electorate} wants real change.
e.zh: 民调显示选民希望看到真正的改变。

electra.t: n. 埃莱克特拉（希腊神话人物）

e.en: Freud described the {Electra} complex as a daughter's rivalry with her mother.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德将恋父情结描述为女儿与母亲的较量。

e.en: The play retells the ancient Greek myth of {Electra}.
e.zh: 这部戏剧重述了古希腊厄勒克特拉的神话。

electric.t: adj. 电的；用电的；令人激动的

e.en: More drivers are switching to {electric} cars every year.
e.zh: 每年有越来越多的司机改用电动汽车。

e.en: The atmosphere in the stadium was absolutely {electric}.
e.zh: 体育场内的气氛简直令人热血沸腾。

e.en: An {electrical} fault caused the entire building to lose power.
e.zh: 一处电气故障让整栋楼停电了。

e.en: He's studying {electrical} engineering at university.
e.zh: 他在大学攻读电气工程。

e.en: The gate is {electrically} operated from inside the booth.
e.zh: 这道门由岗亭内通过电控操作。

e.en: The wires must be {electrically} insulated for safety.
e.zh: 出于安全考虑,这些电线必须做好绝缘处理。

e.en: We hired an {electrician} to rewire the kitchen.
e.zh: 我们请了一位电工重新布置厨房的电路。

e.en: The {electrician} found a loose connection behind the panel.
e.zh: 电工在配电板后发现了一处松动的接线。

e.en: Licensed {electricians} are in high demand right now.
e.zh: 目前有执照的电工非常抢手。

e.en: Two {electricians} spent the day installing new outlets.
e.zh: 两位电工花了一整天安装新插座。

e.en: The storm knocked out {electricity} across the neighborhood.
e.zh: 暴风雨让整个街区都停了电。

e.en: Solar panels generate {electricity} even on cloudy days.
e.zh: 太阳能板即使在阴天也能发电。

e.en: Rural {electrification} transformed daily life in the 1930s.
e.zh: 上世纪三十年代的农村电气化改变了日常生活。

e.en: The company is investing heavily in fleet {electrification}.
e.zh: 该公司正大力投资车队的电动化转型。

electrified.t:
adj. 通电的
v. 使通电（过去式）

e.en: Her surprise victory {electrified} the crowd at the rally.
e.zh: 她出人意料的胜利让集会现场的观众沸腾起来。

e.en: The fence is {electrified}, so don't touch it.
e.zh: 这道围栏通了电,千万别碰。

e.en: The new station will fully {electrify} the rail line by 2027.
e.zh: 新车站将在2027年前让这条铁路全面电气化。

e.en: A great speaker can {electrify} an entire room.
e.zh: 一位出色的演讲者能让整个会场为之振奋。

electrifying.t: adj. 令人震撼的；激动人心的

e.en: The final goal was absolutely {electrifying} to watch.
e.zh: 最后那个进球看得人热血沸腾。

e.en: She gave an {electrifying} performance on opening night.
e.zh: 她在首演之夜的表演震撼全场。

e.en: The DJ played {electro} all night at the warehouse party.
e.zh: DJ在仓库派对上整晚都在放电子音乐。

e.en: His latest album blends {electro} with classic funk.
e.zh: 他的新专辑把电子乐和经典放克融合在一起。

e.en: Researchers developed an {electroactive} polymer for soft robotics.
e.zh: 研究人员为软体机器人开发了一种电活性聚合物。

e.en: The material's {electroactive} properties make it ideal for sensors.
e.zh: 这种材料的电活性特性使其非常适合用作传感器。

e.en: The doctor ordered an {electrocardiogram} to check his heart rhythm.
e.zh: 医生开了心电图检查以查看他的心律。

e.en: Her {electrocardiogram} came back completely normal.
e.zh: 她的心电图结果完全正常。

e.en: They reviewed the {electrocardiographic} data after the patient collapsed.
e.zh: 病人晕倒后,他们查看了心电图数据。

e.en: Subtle {electrocardiographic} changes can hint at early heart disease.
e.zh: 细微的心电图变化可能预示着早期心脏病。

e.en: The surgeon used {electrocautery} to stop the bleeding quickly.
e.zh: 外科医生用电凝术迅速止血。

e.en: {Electrocautery} is common in modern minor surgical procedures.
e.zh: 电灼术在现代小型手术中很常见。

e.en: Batteries store energy through {electrochemical} reactions.
e.zh: 电池通过电化学反应储存能量。

e.en: She studies {electrochemical} sensors for medical diagnostics.
e.zh: 她研究用于医疗诊断的电化学传感器。

e.en: Modern battery research relies heavily on {electrochemistry}.
e.zh: 现代电池研究在很大程度上依赖电化学。

e.en: He teaches {electrochemistry} to graduate engineering students.
e.zh: 他给工程学研究生讲授电化学。

e.en: The new windows use {electrochromic} glass that darkens automatically.
e.zh: 这种新窗户使用可自动变暗的电致变色玻璃。

e.en: {Electrochromic} displays consume very little power once set.
e.zh: 电致变色显示屏一旦设定后耗电极少。

e.en: Be careful not to {electrocute} yourself while fixing the outlet.
e.zh: 修插座的时候小心别触电了。

e.en: Faulty wiring can {electrocute} unsuspecting workers.
e.zh: 故障线路可能让毫无防备的工人触电身亡。

e.en: A worker was nearly {electrocuted} by an exposed wire.
e.zh: 一名工人差点被裸露的电线电死。

e.en: The bird was {electrocuted} when it landed on the transformer.
e.zh: 那只鸟落在变压器上时被电死了。

e.en: Wear rubber gloves to avoid {electrocution}.
e.zh: 戴上橡胶手套以避免触电。

e.en: The investigation ruled the death an accidental {electrocution}.
e.zh: 调查认定这起死亡是意外触电。

e.en: The technician attached an {electrode} to the patient's scalp.
e.zh: 技师在病人头皮上贴了一个电极。

e.en: A corroded {electrode} caused the battery to fail.
e.zh: 一个被腐蚀的电极导致电池失灵。

e.en: Lie detectors measure {electrodermal} responses on the skin.
e.zh: 测谎仪通过测量皮肤的电反应来工作。

e.en: The watch tracks {electrodermal} activity to estimate stress levels.
e.zh: 这款手表通过追踪皮肤电活动来估算压力水平。

e.en: The technician placed {electrodes} on her chest for the test.
e.zh: 技师把电极贴在她胸口进行检查。

e.en: Cleaner {electrodes} would extend the battery's lifespan significantly.
e.zh: 更洁净的电极能显著延长电池寿命。

e.en: The lab built an {electrodynamic} shaker for vibration testing.
e.zh: 实验室搭建了一台用于振动测试的电动振动台。

e.en: They modeled the {electrodynamic} forces inside the motor.
e.zh: 他们对电机内部的电动力进行了建模。

e.en: Maxwell's equations form the foundation of {electrodynamics}.
e.zh: 麦克斯韦方程组是电动力学的基础。

e.en: He failed his {electrodynamics} exam and had to retake it.
e.zh: 他电动力学考试没通过,只好重考。

e.en: The neurologist ordered an {electroencephalogram} to investigate the seizures.
e.zh: 神经科医生开了脑电图检查以查找癫痫原因。

e.en: His {electroencephalogram} showed unusual activity in the left hemisphere.
e.zh: 他的脑电图显示左脑半球出现了异常活动。

e.en: She had {electrolysis} to remove unwanted facial hair.
e.zh: 她做了电解脱毛来去除脸上多余的毛发。

e.en: Hydrogen can be produced from water through {electrolysis}.
e.zh: 氢气可以通过电解水来制取。

e.en: After the long run, she sipped an {electrolyte} drink.
e.zh: 长跑结束后,她喝了一瓶电解质饮料。

e.en: A failing {electrolyte} can cause the battery to swell.
e.zh: 电解液失效可能导致电池鼓包。

e.en: The circuit board uses several large {electrolytic} capacitors.
e.zh: 电路板上用了好几个大容量的电解电容。

e.en: Aluminum is produced industrially in {electrolytic} cells.
e.zh: 工业上通过电解槽生产铝。

e.en: The crane uses a giant {electromagnet} to lift scrap metal.
e.zh: 这台起重机用一个巨大的电磁铁来吊起废金属。

e.en: You can build a simple {electromagnet} with a nail and wire.
e.zh: 用一根钉子和电线就能做一个简单的电磁铁。

e.en: Visible light is just one part of the {electromagnetic} spectrum.
e.zh: 可见光只是电磁波谱的一部分。

e.en: Phones emit weak {electromagnetic} radiation during calls.
e.zh: 手机在通话时会发出微弱的电磁辐射。

e.en: He's writing a textbook on applied {electromagnetics}.
e.zh: 他正在写一本应用电磁学的教科书。

e.en: Antenna design relies heavily on {electromagnetics}.
e.zh: 天线设计在很大程度上依赖电磁学。

e.en: Faraday's experiments revolutionized our understanding of {electromagnetism}.
e.zh: 法拉第的实验彻底改变了人们对电磁学的认识。

e.en: {Electromagnetism} is one of the four fundamental forces in nature.
e.zh: 电磁力是自然界四种基本作用力之一。

e.en: The factory still uses old {electromechanical} relays.
e.zh: 这家工厂仍在使用老式的机电继电器。

e.en: Vintage pinball machines are full of clever {electromechanical} parts.
e.zh: 老式弹珠机里满是精巧的机电零件。

e.en: {Electromyography} helps diagnose nerve and muscle disorders.
e.zh: 肌电图有助于诊断神经和肌肉疾病。

e.en: The clinic offers {electromyography} for athletes recovering from injury.
e.zh: 该诊所为康复中的运动员提供肌电图检查。

e.en: An {electron} carries a tiny negative charge.
e.zh: 一个电子带有微小的负电荷。

e.en: The microscope can image individual {electron} clouds around atoms.
e.zh: 这台显微镜能够拍到原子周围的单个电子云。

e.en: Please submit your application through the {electronic} form.
e.zh: 请通过电子表格提交你的申请。

e.en: He composes {electronic} music in his bedroom studio.
e.zh: 他在卧室工作室里创作电子音乐。

e.en: The club plays {electronica} every Friday night.
e.zh: 这家俱乐部每周五晚上播放电子音乐。

e.en: He produces {electronica} tracks in his bedroom studio.
e.zh: 他在卧室工作室里制作电子音乐曲目。

electronically.t: adv. 以电子方式；电子地

e.en: You can sign the contract {electronically} from your phone.
e.zh: 你可以用手机以电子方式签署合同。

e.en: All bills are now filed {electronically} with the court.
e.zh: 所有文件现在都以电子方式提交给法院。

e.en: He studies {electronics} at the technical college.
e.zh: 他在技术学院学习电子学。

e.en: Please switch off all {electronics} during takeoff.
e.zh: 起飞期间请关闭所有电子设备。

e.en: {Electrons} flow through the wire to power the bulb.
e.zh: 电子流过导线为灯泡供电。

e.en: Atoms share {electrons} when they form chemical bonds.
e.zh: 原子在形成化学键时共享电子。

e.en: The doctor ordered {electronystagmography} to diagnose her vertigo.
e.zh: 医生开了眼震电图检查来诊断她的眩晕。

e.en: {Electronystagmography} measures eye movements to test inner ear function.
e.zh: 眼震电图通过测量眼球运动来检测内耳功能。

e.en: Gel {electrophoresis} separates DNA fragments by size.
e.zh: 凝胶电泳按大小分离DNA片段。

e.en: The lab uses {electrophoresis} to analyze protein samples.
e.zh: 实验室使用电泳法分析蛋白质样本。

e.en: The cardiologist reviewed her {electrophysiologic} test results carefully.
e.zh: 心脏病专家仔细审阅了她的电生理检查结果。

e.en: {Electrophysiologic} studies help locate abnormal heart rhythms.
e.zh: 电生理研究有助于定位异常心律。

e.en: They recorded {electrophysiological} signals from the patient's brain.
e.zh: 他们记录了病人大脑的电生理信号。

e.en: The drug altered {electrophysiological} activity in the neurons.
e.zh: 该药物改变了神经元的电生理活动。

e.en: Her {electrophysiologist} performed an ablation to fix the arrhythmia.
e.zh: 她的电生理专家做了消融手术来治疗心律失常。

e.en: The {electrophysiologist} mapped the electrical pathways of the heart.
e.zh: 电生理专家绘制了心脏的电传导通路。

e.en: She specializes in cardiac {electrophysiology} at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院专攻心脏电生理学。

e.en: Modern {electrophysiology} relies heavily on advanced imaging tools.
e.zh: 现代电生理学高度依赖先进的成像工具。

electroplate.t:
v. 电镀
n. 电镀制品

e.en: The factory will {electroplate} the steel parts with chrome.
e.zh: 工厂将给钢制零件电镀上铬。

e.en: Jewelers often {electroplate} cheap metals with thin gold.
e.zh: 珠宝商常给廉价金属电镀一层薄金。

e.en: Doctors used {electroshock} therapy for her severe depression.
e.zh: 医生用电休克疗法治疗她的重度抑郁。

e.en: The film depicted {electroshock} treatment in the 1950s.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了1950年代的电击疗法。

e.en: An {electrostatic} charge made her hair stand up.
e.zh: 静电使她的头发都竖了起来。

e.en: The painter uses {electrostatic} spray for an even coat.
e.zh: 漆工使用静电喷涂以获得均匀的涂层。

e.en: The dust particles cling {electrostatically} to the screen.
e.zh: 灰尘颗粒因静电吸附在屏幕上。

e.en: The powder is applied {electrostatically} to the metal surface.
e.zh: 粉末通过静电喷涂施加到金属表面。

elects.t: v. 选举；选择（elect 三单）

e.en: The town {elects} a new mayor every four years.
e.zh: 该镇每四年选举一位新市长。

e.en: She {elects} to walk home rather than take a taxi.
e.zh: 她选择步行回家而不是打车。

e.en: The dress had a quiet {elegance} that everyone admired.
e.zh: 这条裙子有一种含蓄的优雅,人人都赞叹。

e.en: I love the mathematical {elegance} of this proof.
e.zh: 我喜欢这个证明在数学上的简洁优美。

elegances.t: n. 优雅之处（elegance 复数）

e.en: The hotel offered small {elegances} like fresh flowers daily.
e.zh: 酒店提供每日鲜花等精致优雅的小细节。

e.en: Her writing weaves together various {elegances} of style.
e.zh: 她的写作融合了各种优雅的文风。

elegant.t: adj. 优雅的；简洁精妙的

e.en: She wore an {elegant} black dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条优雅的黑色礼服参加晚宴。

e.en: The engineer found an {elegant} solution to the bug.
e.zh: 工程师找到了一个简洁优雅的修复方案。

e.en: The dancer moved {elegantly} across the polished floor.
e.zh: 舞者优雅地在打磨过的地板上滑过。

e.en: This API handles errors {elegantly} without crashing.
e.zh: 这个API能够优雅地处理错误而不崩溃。

e.en: The film has an {elegiac} mood about lost youth.
e.zh: 这部电影流露出对逝去青春的哀婉情绪。

e.en: His final album took on an {elegiac} tone.
e.zh: 他的最后一张专辑带有挽歌般的基调。

e.en: She wrote a moving {elegy} for her late grandmother.
e.zh: 她为已故的祖母写了一首感人的挽歌。

e.en: The poem reads like an {elegy} for a vanished town.
e.zh: 这首诗读起来像是为消失的小镇所作的挽歌。

elektra.t: n. 人名（希腊神话人物）

e.en: The opera {Elektra} is famous for its haunting score.
e.zh: 歌剧《厄勒克特拉》以其令人难忘的配乐而闻名。

e.en: She played {Elektra} in the Greek tragedy last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天她在希腊悲剧中饰演厄勒克特拉。

element.t:
n. 元素；要素
n. 元件

e.en: Trust is a key {element} of any good team.
e.zh: 信任是任何优秀团队的关键要素。

e.en: Hydrogen is the lightest {element} in the periodic table.
e.zh: 氢是元素周期表中最轻的元素。

e.en: The storm had an {elemental} fury that frightened everyone.
e.zh: 暴风雨有一种原始的狂怒,令所有人胆寒。

e.en: Bread and salt are {elemental} parts of the meal.
e.zh: 面包和盐是这顿饭最基本的组成部分。

e.en: My daughter just started {elementary} school this fall.
e.zh: 我女儿今年秋天刚上小学。

e.en: This is an {elementary} mistake any beginner could avoid.
e.zh: 这是任何初学者都能避免的基本错误。

e.en: The recipe combines just three simple {elements}.
e.zh: 这道菜只用了三种简单的食材。

e.en: Hikers must protect themselves from the harsh {elements}.
e.zh: 徒步者必须保护自己免受恶劣天气的侵袭。

e.en: We saw an {elephant} bathing in the river.
e.zh: 我们看到一头大象在河里洗澡。

e.en: The {elephant} in the room was nobody's salary.
e.zh: 房间里那个明显却没人提的话题是工资。

e.en: {Elephantiasis} causes severe swelling of the limbs.
e.zh: 象皮病会导致四肢严重肿胀。

e.en: Mosquito-borne parasites can lead to {elephantiasis} in tropical regions.
e.zh: 蚊媒寄生虫在热带地区可能引起象皮病。

e.en: He has an {elephantine} memory for old phone numbers.
e.zh: 他对旧电话号码有着大象般惊人的记忆力。

e.en: The truck moved with {elephantine} slowness up the hill.
e.zh: 卡车以大象般缓慢的速度爬上山坡。

e.en: A herd of {elephants} crossed the dusty plain.
e.zh: 一群大象穿过尘土飞扬的平原。

e.en: African {elephants} are larger than their Asian cousins.
e.zh: 非洲象比它们的亚洲亲戚体型更大。

e.en: Doctors told him to {elevate} his injured ankle.
e.zh: 医生让他把受伤的脚踝抬高。

e.en: Good lighting can really {elevate} a small apartment.
e.zh: 好的灯光能让小公寓的格调显著提升。

elevated.t:
adj. 升高的
v. 提升（过去式）

e.en: Her blood pressure has been slightly {elevated} lately.
e.zh: 她最近的血压有些偏高。

e.en: The restaurant has {elevated} comfort food into fine dining.
e.zh: 这家餐厅把家常菜提升为精致料理。

elevates.t: v. 提升（第三人称单数）

e.en: Adding fresh herbs really {elevates} this simple dish.
e.zh: 加点新鲜香草让这道简单的菜肴提升不少。

e.en: Stress {elevates} the body's cortisol levels significantly.
e.zh: 压力会显著升高体内的皮质醇水平。

e.en: She spent the evening {elevating} her sprained foot.
e.zh: 她整晚都把扭伤的脚抬高着。

e.en: The director is {elevating} the genre with smart writing.
e.zh: 导演正用聪明的剧本提升这一类型片的水平。

elevation.t:
n. 海拔；高度
n. 提升

e.en: The town sits at an {elevation} of 2,000 meters.
e.zh: 这座小镇位于海拔两千米的地方。

e.en: His {elevation} to chairman surprised the whole company.
e.zh: 他被擢升为董事长让全公司都感到意外。

e.en: Hikers should acclimate slowly at higher {elevations}.
e.zh: 登山者应在较高海拔处慢慢适应。

e.en: The architect drew the front and side {elevations}.
e.zh: 建筑师画出了正面和侧面的立面图。

e.en: Please take the {elevator} to the fifth floor.
e.zh: 请乘电梯到五楼。

e.en: The {elevator} broke down again this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上电梯又坏了。

e.en: Both {elevators} in the building were out of service.
e.zh: 大楼里两部电梯都停用了。

e.en: Modern {elevators} use smart algorithms to reduce wait times.
e.zh: 现代电梯使用智能算法来减少等待时间。

e.en: The meeting starts at {eleven} sharp tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 会议明天上午十一点准时开始。

e.en: There are {eleven} players on a soccer team.
e.zh: 一支足球队有十一名球员。

e.en: He scored the winning goal in the {eleventh} minute.
e.zh: 他在第十一分钟攻入了制胜进球。

e.en: The deal was saved at the {eleventh} hour.
e.zh: 这笔交易在最后关头得救了。

e.en: The story features a tiny {elf} who lives in mushrooms.
e.zh: 故事的主角是住在蘑菇里的小精灵。

e.en: She dressed as a Christmas {elf} for the office party.
e.zh: 她打扮成圣诞小精灵参加公司聚会。

elfin.t: adj. 小精灵般的；小巧的

e.en: She has an {elfin} face with bright green eyes.
e.zh: 她有着精灵般的面容和明亮的绿眼睛。

e.en: The child gave him an {elfin} grin and ran off.
e.zh: 孩子对他露出精灵般的笑容然后跑开了。

e.en: The orchestra performed {Elgar}'s Cello Concerto last night.
e.zh: 乐团昨晚演奏了埃尔加的大提琴协奏曲。

e.en: {Elgar} is one of England's most beloved composers.
e.zh: 埃尔加是英国最受喜爱的作曲家之一。

e.en: The {Elgin} Marbles remain a contested topic between Britain and Greece.
e.zh: 埃尔金石雕仍是英希两国争议的话题。

e.en: He bought a vintage {Elgin} pocket watch at the antique fair.
e.zh: 他在古董集市买了一块复古的埃尔金怀表。

e.en: The teacher's question failed to {elicit} any response.
e.zh: 老师的问题没能引出任何回应。

e.en: Good interviewers know how to {elicit} honest answers.
e.zh: 优秀的采访者懂得如何引出真诚的回答。

e.en: The survey aims at the {elicitation} of consumer preferences.
e.zh: 这项调查旨在了解消费者的偏好。

e.en: Requirements {elicitation} is a key part of software design.
e.zh: 需求获取是软件设计的关键环节。

e.en: Speakers often {elide} syllables in casual conversation.
e.zh: 说话者在随意交谈中常会略去音节。

e.en: The report tends to {elide} the most uncomfortable details.
e.zh: 这份报告倾向于略去最令人不安的细节。

e.en: Check your {eligibility} before applying for the scholarship.
e.zh: 申请奖学金前请确认你的资格。

e.en: His {eligibility} for the team depends on his recovery.
e.zh: 他能否入选球队取决于他的恢复情况。

e.en: Are you {eligible} to vote in this election?
e.zh: 你有资格在这次选举中投票吗?

e.en: Only employees with five years are {eligible} for the bonus.
e.zh: 只有工作满五年的员工才有资格获得奖金。

e.en: {Elijah} is a prophet in the Hebrew Bible.
e.zh: 以利亚是希伯来圣经中的一位先知。

e.en: They named their son {Elijah} after his grandfather.
e.zh: 他们以祖父的名字给儿子取名以利亚。

e.en: The new filter helps {eliminate} spam from your inbox.
e.zh: 新的过滤器有助于清除收件箱里的垃圾邮件。

e.en: Their team was {eliminate}d in the first round of the tournament.
e.zh: 他们的队伍在锦标赛第一轮就被淘汰了。

e.en: The update {eliminated} most of the bugs in the app.
e.zh: 这次更新消除了应用中的大部分错误。

e.en: She was {eliminated} from the contest after the second challenge.
e.zh: 她在第二轮挑战后被淘汰出比赛。

eliminates.t: v. 消除（第三人称单数）

e.en: This setting {eliminates} unnecessary notifications on your phone.
e.zh: 这个设置可以去除手机上多余的通知。

e.en: The new policy {eliminates} the need for paper receipts.
e.zh: 新政策让纸质收据变得不再必要。

e.en: They are focused on {eliminating} waste in the supply chain.
e.zh: 他们专注于减少供应链中的浪费。

e.en: {Eliminating} sugar from her diet improved her energy levels.
e.zh: 戒掉糖分后,她的精力明显提升了。

e.en: The {elimination} round will start tomorrow afternoon.
e.zh: 淘汰赛将于明天下午开始。

e.en: Doctors recommend the {elimination} of processed foods for better health.
e.zh: 医生建议减少加工食品以改善健康。

e.en: This odor {eliminator} works well on pet smells.
e.zh: 这款除味剂对宠物气味很有效。

e.en: He played the role of {eliminator} in the team's final defense.
e.zh: 他在队伍的最终防守中担任终结者的角色。

e.en: T.S. {Eliot} wrote some of the most influential poems of the twentieth century.
e.zh: T.S. 艾略特写下了二十世纪最具影响力的一些诗作。

e.en: George {Eliot} is the pen name of the novelist Mary Ann Evans.
e.zh: 乔治·艾略特是小说家玛丽·安·埃文斯的笔名。

e.en: {Elisha} is a prophet mentioned in the Hebrew Bible.
e.zh: 以利沙是希伯来圣经中提到的一位先知。

e.en: {Elisha} Otis invented the safety elevator in the 1850s.
e.zh: 伊莱沙·奥的斯于1850年代发明了安全电梯。

e.en: The poet used {elision} to keep the rhythm flowing smoothly.
e.zh: 诗人通过省音让韵律流畅自然。

e.en: In casual speech, {elision} of vowels is very common.
e.zh: 在日常口语中,元音的省略非常普遍。

elite.t:
n. 精英
adj. 精锐的

e.en: Only an {elite} group of athletes qualifies for the Olympics.
e.zh: 只有少数精英运动员才能获得奥运资格。

e.en: The school trains {elite} programmers for top tech firms.
e.zh: 这所学校为顶尖科技公司培养精英程序员。

e.en: Political {elites} often have very different priorities from ordinary citizens.
e.zh: 政治精英的优先事项常与普通民众截然不同。

e.en: Tech {elites} gathered in San Francisco for the conference.
e.zh: 科技界精英齐聚旧金山参加这次大会。

e.en: Critics accused the university of {elitism} in its admissions.
e.zh: 批评者指责该大学在招生中存在精英主义。

e.en: His attitude reeked of {elitism} and condescension.
e.zh: 他的态度充满了精英主义和居高临下的味道。

elitist.t:
adj. 精英主义的
n. 精英主义者

e.en: That country club has an {elitist} reputation in the city.
e.zh: 那家乡村俱乐部在城里以精英做派著称。

e.en: Her comments about coffee snobs sounded a bit {elitist}.
e.zh: 她对咖啡势利眼的评论听起来有点精英主义。

e.en: He dismissed the critics as out-of-touch {elitists}.
e.zh: 他把那些批评者贬为脱离群众的精英分子。

e.en: The forum was overrun with self-proclaimed {elitists} mocking newcomers.
e.zh: 论坛上充斥着自封的精英分子嘲笑新人。

elixir.t: n. 灵丹妙药；长生不老药

e.en: Marketers often call green tea an {elixir} of youth.
e.zh: 营销者常把绿茶宣传成青春的灵药。

e.en: He claimed the herbal {elixir} cured his chronic headaches.
e.zh: 他声称那款草药酊剂治好了他的慢性头痛。

elizabethan.t: adj. 伊丽莎白一世时代的

e.en: Shakespeare wrote during the {Elizabethan} era of English drama.
e.zh: 莎士比亚的创作处于英国戏剧的伊丽莎白时代。

e.en: The museum displayed several {Elizabethan} costumes and jewels.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几件伊丽莎白时期的服装和珠宝。

e.en: A large {elk} crossed the highway just before sunset.
e.zh: 一头大麋鹿在日落前穿过了高速公路。

e.en: Tourists often spot {elk} grazing in Yellowstone meadows.
e.zh: 游客们常在黄石公园的草地上看到麋鹿吃草。

e.en: They added an {ell} to the back of the farmhouse.
e.zh: 他们在农舍后面加建了一个偏房。

e.en: The old tailor still measured cloth by the {ell}.
e.zh: 那位老裁缝仍然用厄尔来量布。

e.en: Leeds United plays its home matches at {Elland} Road.
e.zh: 利兹联队在埃兰路球场进行主场比赛。

e.en: The town of {Elland} sits in West Yorkshire, England.
e.zh: 埃兰镇位于英格兰西约克郡。

elle.t: n. 埃勒（女性名/杂志名）

e.en: She subscribed to {Elle} magazine for the latest fashion trends.
e.zh: 她订阅了《ELLE》杂志关注最新时尚潮流。

e.en: {Elle} Woods is the heroine of the film Legally Blonde.
e.zh: 艾丽·伍兹是电影《律政俏佳人》的女主角。

e.en: {Ellesmere} Island lies in the far north of Canada.
e.zh: 埃尔斯米尔岛位于加拿大最北端。

e.en: The {Ellesmere} Port refinery has operated for many decades.
e.zh: 埃尔斯米尔港炼油厂已经运营了几十年。

e.en: Earth's orbit around the sun is an {ellipse}, not a circle.
e.zh: 地球绕太阳的轨道是椭圆形,而非正圆。

e.en: Use the shape tool to draw a perfect {ellipse}.
e.zh: 使用形状工具可以画出标准的椭圆。

e.en: Her message ended with an {ellipsis}, leaving him puzzled.
e.zh: 她的消息以省略号结尾,让他十分困惑。

e.en: Use an {ellipsis} to show that you've cut part of a quote.
e.zh: 用省略号可以表示你删去了引文的一部分。

e.en: {Elliptic} curves play a key role in modern cryptography.
e.zh: 椭圆曲线在现代密码学中起着关键作用。

e.en: The satellite follows an {elliptic} path around Earth.
e.zh: 这颗卫星沿椭圆形轨道环绕地球运行。

e.en: She runs on the {elliptical} machine at the gym every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上在健身房用椭圆机锻炼。

e.en: His answers were so {elliptical} that no one understood him.
e.zh: 他的回答含糊其辞,没人能听懂。

e.en: He spoke {elliptically} about his plans, hinting without explaining.
e.zh: 他对自己的计划隐晦其词,只暗示不解释。

e.en: The comet moves {elliptically} around the sun.
e.zh: 这颗彗星以椭圆轨道围绕太阳运行。

e.en: A huge {elm} tree shades our front yard in summer.
e.zh: 夏天里一棵高大的榆树为我们前院遮阴。

e.en: Disease wiped out most of the {elm}s along the street.
e.zh: 一场病害让街边大多数榆树都枯死了。

elmo.t: n. 埃尔莫（人名/角色名）

e.en: Toddlers everywhere love watching {Elmo} on Sesame Street.
e.zh: 全世界的小朋友都爱看《芝麻街》里的埃尔莫。

e.en: She bought a tickle-me {Elmo} doll for her nephew.
e.zh: 她给侄子买了一只挠痒痒的埃尔莫玩偶。

e.en: He took {elocution} lessons to improve his public speaking.
e.zh: 他上了演讲发音课以提升公共演讲能力。

e.en: Her clear {elocution} made every word easy to follow.
e.zh: 她清晰的发音让每个字都听得清清楚楚。

e.en: Stretching exercises help {elongate} tight muscles after running.
e.zh: 拉伸动作有助于跑步后放松紧绷的肌肉。

e.en: Designers use vertical stripes to {elongate} the figure.
e.zh: 设计师用竖条纹让身形显得修长。

e.en: The cat had an unusually {elongated} tail.
e.zh: 那只猫长着一条异常细长的尾巴。

e.en: She drew an {elongated} oval to represent the lake.
e.zh: 她画了一个细长的椭圆来代表那个湖。

elongates.t: v. 拉长（第三人称单数）

e.en: This yoga pose {elongates} the spine and relieves back tension.
e.zh: 这个瑜伽动作能拉伸脊柱并缓解背部紧张。

e.en: Sunset {elongates} the shadows of the trees.
e.zh: 夕阳让树影被拉得很长。

elongating.t: v. 正在拉长（现在分词）

e.en: She wore heels, {elongating} her legs in the photo.
e.zh: 她穿了高跟鞋,在照片里显得腿更修长。

e.en: The factory is {elongating} its production line to boost output.
e.zh: 工厂正在延长生产线以提升产量。

e.en: The metal showed significant {elongation} before it broke.
e.zh: 金属在断裂前出现了明显的伸长。

e.en: The {elongation} of the days marks the arrival of spring.
e.zh: 白昼变长标志着春天的到来。

e.en: They decided to {elope} to Vegas instead of having a big wedding.
e.zh: 他们决定私奔去拉斯维加斯,而不办盛大婚礼。

e.en: Her parents were furious when she chose to {elope}.
e.zh: 她选择私奔时,父母气坏了。

e.en: Their {elopement} surprised everyone in the family.
e.zh: 他们的私奔让家里所有人都大吃一惊。

e.en: More couples now plan a small {elopement} ceremony abroad.
e.zh: 如今越来越多的情侣选择在海外办小型私奔式婚礼。

e.en: The lawyer's {eloquence} convinced the entire jury.
e.zh: 那位律师的雄辩说服了整个陪审团。

e.en: Her speech was delivered with surprising {eloquence}.
e.zh: 她的演讲表达得出人意料地流畅动人。

e.en: The anthology celebrates the varied {eloquences} of African American preachers.
e.zh: 这本选集展示了非裔美国传道者们各具风采的雄辩之美。

e.en: Different cultures cultivate different {eloquences} suited to their traditions.
e.zh: 不同文化孕育出契合各自传统的不同雄辩风格。

eloquent.t: adj. 雄辩的；有说服力的

e.en: She gave an {eloquent} speech at the graduation ceremony.
e.zh: 她在毕业典礼上发表了一场动人的演讲。

e.en: His silence was more {eloquent} than any words.
e.zh: 他的沉默比任何言语都更有力。

e.en: The author writes {eloquently} about loss and memory.
e.zh: 作者以优美的笔触描写失去与回忆。

e.en: She argued {eloquently} for stronger climate policies.
e.zh: 她雄辩地呼吁推行更严格的气候政策。

elp.t: v. 帮助（help 的口语省略形）

e.en: Could you {elp} me lift this box up the stairs?
e.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬上楼吗?

e.en: In dialect writing, characters often shout '{elp}!' instead of 'help!'.
e.zh: 方言文学里角色常喊"救命"而省略首字母。

else.t:
adv. 其他；另外
adj. 别的

e.en: Is there anything {else} you'd like to add to the order?
e.zh: 你还想再加点别的到订单里吗?

e.en: If the file isn't there, look somewhere {else} on the drive.
e.zh: 如果文件不在那儿,就到硬盘的其他地方找找。

e.en: If we don't fix prices soon, customers will shop {elsewhere}.
e.zh: 如果不尽快调整价格,顾客就会去别处购买。

e.en: The article was first published {elsewhere} before appearing online.
e.zh: 这篇文章先在别处发表,后来才放到网上。

e.en: She works as an {ELT} teacher at an international school in Tokyo.
e.zh: 她在东京一所国际学校担任英语教学老师。

e.en: The conference focuses on innovations in {ELT} methodology.
e.zh: 本次会议聚焦英语教学方法的创新。

eltham.t: n. 埃尔瑟姆（英国地名）

e.en: {Eltham} Palace is famous for its art deco interiors near London.
e.zh: 埃尔瑟姆宫以其伦敦近郊的装饰艺术风格内饰而闻名。

e.en: He grew up in {Eltham}, a suburb in southeast London.
e.zh: 他在伦敦东南郊的埃尔瑟姆长大。

e.en: Could you {elucidate} the main point of your argument?
e.zh: 你能阐明一下你论点的核心吗?

e.en: The professor used diagrams to {elucidate} the complex theory.
e.zh: 教授用图表来阐释这个复杂的理论。

e.en: The textbook offers a clear {elucidation} of quantum mechanics.
e.zh: 这本教材对量子力学做了清晰的阐释。

e.en: His comments needed further {elucidation} for the audience.
e.zh: 他的评论需要进一步解释,观众才能理解。

elude.t: v. 躲避；使困惑（难以理解）

e.en: The thief managed to {elude} police for nearly a week.
e.zh: 窃贼成功躲避警方追捕近一周。

e.en: The right word seemed to {elude} her at the worst moment.
e.zh: 她偏偏在最关键的时刻想不起合适的词。

eluded.t: v. elude 的过去式，躲避；难倒

e.en: The answer to the puzzle {eluded} him for hours.
e.zh: 这道谜题的答案让他想了好几个小时也没头绪。

e.en: The fox {eluded} the hunters by darting into the woods.
e.zh: 狐狸窜进树林,巧妙地躲开了猎人。

eludes.t: v. elude 的第三人称单数，躲开；难倒

e.en: True work-life balance still {eludes} many young professionals.
e.zh: 真正的工作生活平衡仍让许多年轻白领可望而不可及。

e.en: The cause of the bug {eludes} the entire engineering team.
e.zh: 这个 bug 的成因让整个工程团队百思不得其解。

eluding.t: v. elude 的现在分词，正在躲避

e.en: The fox kept {eluding} the hunters in the dense forest.
e.zh: 狐狸在茂密的森林里不断躲过猎人的追捕。

e.en: The right word for that feeling keeps {eluding} me.
e.zh: 形容那种感觉的恰当词语我总是想不起来。

elusive.t: adj. 难以捉摸的；难找到的

e.en: A good night's sleep has been {elusive} all week.
e.zh: 这一整周想睡个好觉都成了奢望。

e.en: The startup is chasing the {elusive} goal of profitability.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在追逐难以企及的盈利目标。

e.en: She smiled {elusively} and refused to answer the question.
e.zh: 她意味深长地笑了笑,拒绝回答这个问题。

e.en: The bug behaves {elusively}, only appearing in production.
e.zh: 这个bug很难捉摸,只在生产环境才出现。

elusiveness.t: n. 难以捉摸；难以理解

e.en: The {elusiveness} of true happiness is a common theme in literature.
e.zh: 真正幸福的难以捉摸是文学中常见的主题。

e.en: Detectives were frustrated by the suspect's {elusiveness}.
e.zh: 嫌疑人的难以追踪让侦探们倍感沮丧。

e.en: We {elute} the compound from the column with methanol.
e.zh: 我们用甲醇将化合物从色谱柱上洗脱下来。

e.en: Different solvents are used to {elute} specific proteins.
e.zh: 使用不同的溶剂来洗脱特定的蛋白质。

e.en: The hero forged an {elven} blade in the ancient forge.
e.zh: 英雄在古老的锻炉中打造出一把精灵剑。

e.en: She wore an {elven} cloak that shimmered in moonlight.
e.zh: 她披着一件在月光下闪烁的精灵斗篷。

e.en: Tolkien invented an entire {elvish} language for his novels.
e.zh: 托尔金为他的小说创造了一整套精灵语。

e.en: The map was inscribed with {elvish} runes.
e.zh: 地图上刻着精灵文字的符文。

e.en: We visited the medieval cathedral in {Ely} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了伊利的中世纪大教堂。

e.en: The train from Cambridge to {Ely} takes about twenty minutes.
e.zh: 从剑桥到伊利的火车大约需要二十分钟。

elysees.t: n. 爱丽舍（香榭丽舍 Champs-Élysées）

e.en: Tourists love walking down the Champs-{Elysees} in Paris.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢漫步在巴黎的香榭丽舍大街上。

e.en: The parade marched along the Champs-{Elysees} on Bastille Day.
e.zh: 国庆日游行队伍沿着香榭丽舍大街行进。

elysian.t: adj. 极乐世界的；无比幸福的

e.en: The garden felt like an {elysian} retreat from city life.
e.zh: 这座花园宛如远离城市喧嚣的极乐之地。

e.en: Heroes were said to dwell in the {elysian} fields after death.
e.zh: 传说英雄们死后会居住在极乐之野。

e.en: Severe illness can {emaciate} a patient within weeks.
e.zh: 严重的疾病可以在几周内让病人变得骨瘦如柴。

e.en: Famine continues to {emaciate} populations in war zones.
e.zh: 饥荒持续让战乱地区的民众日益消瘦。

e.en: Rescuers found the {emaciated} dog tied behind a shed.
e.zh: 救援人员发现那只骨瘦如柴的狗被拴在棚屋后面。

e.en: Photos showed {emaciated} children in the refugee camp.
e.zh: 照片显示难民营里的孩子们瘦骨嶙峋。

e.en: The doctor was alarmed by the patient's extreme {emaciation}.
e.zh: 医生对病人极度的消瘦感到震惊。

e.en: Months of drought caused widespread {emaciation} among livestock.
e.zh: 连月的干旱导致牲畜普遍瘦弱。

email.t:
n. 电子邮件
v. 发邮件

e.en: Please send me the report by {email} tonight.
e.zh: 请今晚通过电子邮件把报告发给我。

e.en: I get hundreds of {email} messages every day.
e.zh: 我每天都会收到数百封电子邮件。

emailed.t: v. email 的过去式，已发送邮件

e.en: She {emailed} the contract to her lawyer this morning.
e.zh: 她今天上午把合同邮件发给了律师。

e.en: I {emailed} you the details an hour ago.
e.zh: 一小时前我已经把细节邮件给你了。

emailing.t: v. email 的现在分词，正在发邮件

e.en: He spent the whole afternoon {emailing} potential clients.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在给潜在客户发邮件。

e.en: Stop {emailing} me at midnight, please.
e.zh: 拜托别再半夜给我发邮件了。

emails.t:
n. 电子邮件（复数）
v. 发邮件（第三人称单数）

e.en: My inbox has over a thousand unread {emails}.
e.zh: 我的收件箱里有一千多封未读邮件。

e.en: She checks her work {emails} first thing every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上第一件事就是查看工作邮件。

emanate.t: v. 散发；发出（光、气味、情绪）

e.en: Warmth seemed to {emanate} from the old fireplace.
e.zh: 温暖仿佛从那座老壁炉中散发出来。

e.en: Confidence and calm {emanate} from a great leader.
e.zh: 自信与从容会从伟大的领导者身上散发出来。

emanation.t: n. 散发；散发出的东西

e.en: The sweet {emanation} of jasmine filled the courtyard.
e.zh: 茉莉花甜美的香气弥漫在庭院里。

e.en: Some philosophers viewed the universe as an {emanation} of the divine.
e.zh: 一些哲学家把宇宙视为神性的流溢。

e.en: Lincoln moved to {emancipate} enslaved people during the Civil War.
e.zh: 林肯在内战期间着手解放被奴役的人民。

e.en: Education can {emancipate} women from economic dependence.
e.zh: 教育能让女性从经济依赖中解放出来。

emancipated.t: adj. 已解放的；不受约束的

e.en: She felt {emancipated} after leaving the toxic relationship.
e.zh: 离开那段有毒的关系后,她感到无比自由。

e.en: The {emancipated} slaves began rebuilding their lives in freedom.
e.zh: 获释的奴隶们开始在自由中重建自己的生活。

e.en: The {emancipation} of women remains an ongoing global struggle.
e.zh: 妇女的解放至今仍是一场全球性的斗争。

e.en: Lincoln signed the {Emancipation} Proclamation in 1863.
e.zh: 林肯于1863年签署了《解放宣言》。

e.en: Lincoln is often remembered as the great {emancipator}.
e.zh: 林肯常被人们铭记为伟大的解放者。

e.en: History honors her as an {emancipator} of oppressed workers.
e.zh: 历史尊她为受压迫工人的解放者。

emancipatory.t: adj. 解放的；带来自由的

e.en: The book offers an {emancipatory} vision of education.
e.zh: 这本书提出了一种具有解放意义的教育愿景。

e.en: Her research focuses on {emancipatory} social movements.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦于解放性的社会运动。

emap.t: n. EMAP（英国传媒公司名，罕用）

e.en: The team built an interactive {emap} of regional pollution data.
e.zh: 团队制作了一份显示区域污染数据的互动电子地图。

e.en: Open the {emap} app to find nearby charging stations.
e.zh: 打开电子地图应用查找附近的充电站。

e.en: Critics said the amendments would {emasculate} the new law.
e.zh: 评论人士说这些修正案会让新法律形同虚设。

e.en: He felt the constant criticism was meant to {emasculate} him.
e.zh: 他觉得不断的批评是为了打击他的自尊。

emasculated.t: adj. 被削弱的；失去力量的

e.en: The new regulations have {emasculated} the agency's enforcement powers.
e.zh: 新规定让该机构的执法权力大打折扣。

e.en: He felt {emasculated} by being passed over for the promotion.
e.zh: 被跳过升职让他感到自尊受挫。

e.en: Lobbyists pushed for the {emasculation} of the environmental rules.
e.zh: 游说团体推动削弱这些环保规定。

e.en: The treaty led to the {emasculation} of the country's military.
e.zh: 该条约导致这个国家的军队被严重削弱。

embalm.t: v. 对尸体作防腐处理

e.en: Ancient Egyptians knew how to {embalm} bodies for eternity.
e.zh: 古埃及人懂得如何为永恒保存尸体。

e.en: Funeral homes typically {embalm} the deceased before viewing.
e.zh: 殡仪馆通常会在告别仪式前对遗体进行防腐处理。

embalmed.t: v. embalm 的过去式，已做防腐处理

e.en: Lenin's body has been {embalmed} and displayed for decades.
e.zh: 列宁的遗体被防腐保存并展示了数十年。

e.en: The mummy was {embalmed} with rare oils and resins.
e.zh: 这具木乃伊用稀有的油和树脂进行了防腐处理。

e.en: The {embalmer} worked carefully to prepare the body for the funeral.
e.zh: 防腐师细致地为遗体做葬礼前的准备。

e.en: She trained for years to become a licensed {embalmer}.
e.zh: 她经过多年培训才成为持证的遗体防腐师。

embalming.t: n. 遗体防腐；v. 正在防腐处理

e.en: The {embalming} process can take several hours to complete.
e.zh: 遗体防腐处理可能需要数小时才能完成。

e.en: Egyptians developed advanced {embalming} techniques thousands of years ago.
e.zh: 埃及人在数千年前就发展出先进的防腐技术。

e.en: Workers reinforced the {embankment} before the storm hit.
e.zh: 工人们在风暴来临前加固了堤坝。

e.en: We sat on the river {embankment} and watched the boats.
e.zh: 我们坐在河堤上看船只来往。

embargo.t:
n. 禁运；封港令
v. 对…实施禁运

e.en: The country imposed a trade {embargo} on its rival.
e.zh: 该国对其对手实施了贸易禁运。

e.en: The news is under {embargo} until tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 这则新闻在明早之前禁止发布。

embark.t:
v. 着手；开始（从事）
v. 上船；登机

e.en: They are about to {embark} on a year-long road trip.
e.zh: 他们即将开启为期一年的公路旅行。

e.en: Passengers will {embark} from Gate 14 at noon.
e.zh: 乘客将于中午从14号登机口登机。

e.en: Please present your passport at the {embarkation} point.
e.zh: 请在登船检查口出示您的护照。

e.en: The {embarkation} of troops took most of the night.
e.zh: 部队的登船工作持续了大半个夜晚。

embarked.t: v. embark 的过去式；已开始；已登船

e.en: She {embarked} on a new career in software engineering.
e.zh: 她开启了软件工程师的新职业生涯。

e.en: The cruise passengers {embarked} from the port at sunset.
e.zh: 邮轮乘客在日落时分从港口登船。

embarking.t: v. embark 的现在分词；正在开始

e.en: He is {embarking} on his first solo expedition next week.
e.zh: 他下周将开启他的首次单人探险。

e.en: Travelers should check their passports before {embarking}.
e.zh: 旅客在登机前应检查好护照。

embarks.t: v. embark 的第三人称单数

e.en: Every spring the team {embarks} on a new research project.
e.zh: 每年春天这个团队都会开启一个新研究项目。

e.en: She {embarks} on her overseas adventure tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 她明早就要开始她的海外冒险了。

e.en: Don't sing in public — you'll {embarrass} the kids.
e.zh: 别在公共场合唱歌,会让孩子们难堪的。

e.en: The leaked emails could {embarrass} the entire company.
e.zh: 泄露的邮件可能让整个公司颜面尽失。

e.en: She was {embarrassed} when her phone rang during the lecture.
e.zh: 讲座中手机响了起来,她尴尬极了。

e.en: He felt {embarrassed} about forgetting her birthday again.
e.zh: 他对又一次忘记她的生日感到不好意思。

e.en: He laughed {embarrassedly} after tripping in front of his crush.
e.zh: 在心仪的人面前绊倒后,他尴尬地笑了笑。

e.en: She glanced {embarrassedly} at the stain on her shirt.
e.zh: 她不好意思地瞥了一眼衬衫上的污渍。

embarrasses.t: v. embarrass 的第三人称单数

e.en: Nothing {embarrasses} my dad more than singing happy birthday.
e.zh: 没什么比唱生日快乐歌更让我爸难为情了。

e.en: Public speaking still {embarrasses} her after years of practice.
e.zh: 练习多年后,公开演讲仍让她感到尴尬。

embarrassing.t: adj. 令人尴尬的；丢脸的

e.en: That typo in the headline was really {embarrassing}.
e.zh: 标题里的那个错字真让人尴尬。

e.en: He told an {embarrassing} story about his college days.
e.zh: 他讲了一个关于自己大学时代的尴尬故事。

embarrassingly.t: adv. 令人尴尬地；难堪地

e.en: The team lost {embarrassingly} in front of their home fans.
e.zh: 球队在主场球迷面前输得颜面无光。

e.en: My French is {embarrassingly} bad despite years of study.
e.zh: 尽管学了多年,我的法语依然差得让人尴尬。

embarrassment.t: n. 尴尬；窘迫；难堪之事

e.en: Her face turned red with {embarrassment} at the comment.
e.zh: 听到那句话,她羞得满脸通红。

e.en: The scandal was a major {embarrassment} for the government.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻让政府颜面尽失。

embarrassments.t: n. embarrassment 的复数；尴尬之事

e.en: The campaign suffered a series of public {embarrassments}.
e.zh: 这场竞选活动接连出现多次公开的难堪事件。

e.en: Childhood {embarrassments} have a way of staying with you.
e.zh: 童年时的尴尬往事总会让人难以忘怀。

embassies.t: n. embassy 的复数；大使馆

e.en: Several Western {embassies} closed due to security concerns.
e.zh: 由于安全问题,几个西方国家的大使馆关闭了。

e.en: Foreign {embassies} line the quiet street near the park.
e.zh: 公园附近那条安静的街道两旁排列着外国大使馆。

e.en: You'll need to apply for a visa at the {embassy}.
e.zh: 你需要去大使馆申请签证。

e.en: Protesters gathered outside the {embassy} this morning.
e.zh: 抗议者今天上午聚集在大使馆门外。

embattle.t: v. 使列阵备战；部署战斗

e.en: Rising debt continues to {embattle} the small business owner.
e.zh: 不断攀升的债务持续困扰着这位小企业主。

e.en: Lawsuits {embattle} the company on multiple fronts.
e.zh: 多起诉讼让这家公司四面受敌。

embattled.t: adj. 处境艰难的；备受攻击的

e.en: The {embattled} CEO faced calls to resign after the scandal.
e.zh: 这位深陷困境的首席执行官在丑闻后面临辞职呼声。

e.en: {Embattled} troops held the bridge through the night.
e.zh: 陷入苦战的部队整夜守住了那座桥。

e.en: Boats anchored safely inside the sheltered {embayment}.
e.zh: 船只安全地停泊在这个避风的海湾内。

e.en: The {embayment} provides a habitat for migrating birds.
e.zh: 这片小海湾为迁徙的鸟类提供了栖息地。

embed.t: v. 嵌入；内嵌（代码、视频）

e.en: You can {embed} a YouTube video directly into the post.
e.zh: 你可以直接把 YouTube 视频嵌入到帖子里。

e.en: Reporters often {embed} with military units during conflicts.
e.zh: 记者们常在冲突期间随军采访。

embedded.t:
adj. 嵌入式的；内嵌的
v. embed 的过去式

e.en: The chip is {embedded} deep inside the device's main board.
e.zh: 这块芯片被嵌入在设备主板的深处。

e.en: Racism remains {embedded} in many social institutions.
e.zh: 种族主义仍然根植于许多社会机构之中。

e.en: The study examines the {embeddedness} of firms in local networks.
e.zh: 该研究探讨了企业在本地网络中的嵌入程度。

e.en: Cultural {embeddedness} shapes how people view success.
e.zh: 文化的深度嵌入塑造了人们对成功的看法。

embedding.t:
n. 嵌入；(AI)词向量
v. embed 的现在分词

e.en: The model converts each word into a numerical {embedding}.
e.zh: 模型把每个词转换为一个数值向量表示。

e.en: {Embedding} ads in podcasts has become very common.
e.zh: 在播客中植入广告已经变得十分常见。

embeds.t:
v. embed 的第三人称单数
n. 内嵌内容

e.en: This platform {embeds} tracking pixels in every email it sends.
e.zh: 这个平台在它发出的每封邮件中都嵌入了追踪像素。

e.en: The site allows users to share {embeds} from other websites.
e.zh: 该网站允许用户分享来自其它网站的嵌入内容。

e.en: He likes to {embellish} his stories with dramatic details.
e.zh: 他喜欢用戏剧化的细节来润色自己的故事。

e.en: They used gold thread to {embellish} the wedding dress.
e.zh: 他们用金线装饰那件婚纱。

embellished.t: adj. 经装饰的；加以润色的

e.en: The witness apparently {embellished} parts of his testimony.
e.zh: 那位证人显然夸大了他证词中的部分内容。

e.en: She wore an {embellished} jacket covered in sequins.
e.zh: 她穿着一件缀满亮片的装饰外套。

embellishment.t: n. 装饰；润色；修饰部分

e.en: The dress had floral {embellishment} along the neckline.
e.zh: 这件连衣裙的领口饰有花朵装饰。

e.en: His memoir is honest, with little {embellishment} of the truth.
e.zh: 他的回忆录很诚实,几乎没有粉饰真相。

e.en: A single {ember} from the campfire started the wildfire.
e.zh: 营火中的一颗余烬引发了这场山火。

e.en: She poked the last glowing {ember} in the fireplace.
e.zh: 她拨弄着壁炉里最后一块发亮的余烬。

e.en: The accountant tried to {embezzle} funds from client accounts.
e.zh: 那名会计试图挪用客户账户中的资金。

e.en: Executives can face prison if they {embezzle} company money.
e.zh: 高管若侵吞公司资金可能面临牢狱之灾。

e.en: She was charged with {embezzlement} after an internal audit.
e.zh: 内部审计后,她被指控贪污挪用公款。

e.en: The {embezzlement} scheme went undetected for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 这个挪用资金的骗局近十年都未被发现。

embezzler.t: n. 挪用公款者；贪污犯

e.en: The convicted {embezzler} was ordered to repay millions.
e.zh: 这名被定罪的挪用公款者被判赔偿数百万元。

e.en: Auditors finally caught the {embezzler} hiding fake invoices.
e.zh: 审计员终于抓到了这个用假发票作案的贪污者。

e.en: Years of unfair treatment can {embitter} even kind people.
e.zh: 长年的不公对待会让连善良的人也变得怨恨。

e.en: The divorce did not {embitter} her toward future relationships.
e.zh: 那场离婚并未让她对未来的感情心生怨恨。

embittered.t: adj. 满怀怨恨的；苦涩的

e.en: He became {embittered} after losing the election by ten votes.
e.zh: 以十票之差落选后,他变得心怀怨恨。

e.en: An {embittered} ex-employee leaked the documents online.
e.zh: 一名心怀怨恨的前员工把文件泄露到了网上。

emblazon.t: v. 在…上饰以纹章；醒目展示

e.en: The team will {emblazon} their logo on the new jerseys.
e.zh: 球队会把队徽显眼地印在新球衣上。

e.en: Activists chose to {emblazon} the slogan across the banner.
e.zh: 活动人士选择把那句口号醒目地印在横幅上。

e.en: The dove has long been an {emblem} of peace.
e.zh: 鸽子长期以来都是和平的象征。

e.en: Each soldier wore the regiment's {emblem} on his sleeve.
e.zh: 每名士兵都在袖子上佩戴着团队的徽章。

emblematic.t: adj. 象征性的；作为标志的

e.en: The rusting factory is {emblematic} of the town's decline.
e.zh: 那座生锈的工厂正是这座小镇衰落的象征。

e.en: His speech was {emblematic} of the new political mood.
e.zh: 他的演讲代表了新的政治氛围。

embodied.t:
adj. 具体化的；具身的
v. embody 的过去式

e.en: She {embodied} everything the company hoped a leader would be.
e.zh: 她体现了公司希望领导者所具备的一切品质。

e.en: The constitution {embodied} the values of the new republic.
e.zh: 宪法体现了新共和国的价值观。

embodies.t: v. embody 的第三人称单数

e.en: This product {embodies} years of careful design and testing.
e.zh: 这款产品凝聚了多年的精心设计与测试。

e.en: Her music {embodies} the spirit of the immigrant generation.
e.zh: 她的音乐体现了移民一代的精神。

e.en: The young athlete is the {embodiment} of discipline and hard work.
e.zh: 这位年轻运动员是自律与勤奋的化身。

e.en: That café feels like the {embodiment} of small-town charm.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆仿佛就是小镇魅力的具体体现。

embodiments.t: n. embodiment 的复数；具体形式

e.en: The patent describes several different {embodiments} of the invention.
e.zh: 该专利描述了这项发明的几种不同实现形式。

e.en: These characters are {embodiments} of classic moral virtues.
e.zh: 这些角色都是经典道德品质的化身。

e.en: Good teachers should {embody} the values they teach.
e.zh: 好老师应该身体力行所教的价值观。

e.en: These laws {embody} our commitment to equal treatment.
e.zh: 这些法律体现了我们对平等对待的承诺。

e.en: The new app, {embodying} years of feedback, finally launched today.
e.zh: 这款凝聚多年用户反馈的新应用今天终于上线。

e.en: She gave a speech {embodying} the hopes of her generation.
e.zh: 她发表了一场承载着同代人希望的演讲。

embolden.t:
v. 使有胆量；鼓励
v. (文本)加粗

e.en: Weak penalties only {embolden} cybercriminals to try again.
e.zh: 过轻的处罚只会让网络罪犯更加肆无忌惮。

e.en: Her praise helped {embolden} him to share his idea publicly.
e.zh: 她的赞许鼓励他公开分享自己的想法。

emboldened.t: adj. 胆子更大的；受到鼓舞的

e.en: {Emboldened} by the cheers, she sang a second encore.
e.zh: 在欢呼声的鼓舞下,她又加唱了一曲返场。

e.en: Hackers feel {emboldened} when companies fail to disclose breaches.
e.zh: 当公司不公开披露入侵事件时,黑客便变得更加肆意妄为。

embolism.t: n. 栓塞（医学）；血管阻塞

e.en: Doctors discovered a pulmonary {embolism} blocking her lung artery.
e.zh: 医生发现一个肺栓塞堵塞了她的肺动脉。

e.en: Long flights can increase the risk of an {embolism}.
e.zh: 长途飞行可能会增加发生血栓栓塞的风险。

e.en: The patient underwent {embolization} to stop the internal bleeding.
e.zh: 医生为该患者进行了栓塞手术以止住内出血。

e.en: {Embolization} is often preferred over invasive surgery for tumors.
e.zh: 对于肿瘤,栓塞术常比侵入性手术更受青睐。

embosom.t: v. 环抱；怀抱于中（罕用）

e.en: Tall pines {embosom} the cottage on three sides.
e.zh: 高大的松树从三面环抱着这间小屋。

e.en: The valley seemed to {embosom} the village in green hills.
e.zh: 山谷仿佛把村庄环抱在青翠的群山之中。

e.en: The shop can {emboss} your initials on the leather wallet.
e.zh: 店里可以在皮夹上压印你的名字缩写。

e.en: They use a heated press to {emboss} the company logo.
e.zh: 他们用加热的压模来压印公司标志。

embossed.t: adj. 有浮雕花纹的；压纹的

e.en: He handed me an {embossed} business card on thick paper.
e.zh: 他递给我一张厚纸压印图案的名片。

e.en: The book had a beautifully {embossed} leather cover.
e.zh: 这本书有一个压花精美的皮质封面。

eminence.t:
n. 卓越；声望
n. 高地

e.en: She rose to {eminence} as a heart surgeon.
e.zh: 她作为心脏外科医生声名显赫。

e.en: The scholar's {eminence} attracted students from abroad.
e.zh: 这位学者的盛名吸引了来自海外的学生。

eminences.t: n. eminence 的复数；名流、显要

e.en: Several literary {eminences} attended the award ceremony.
e.zh: 几位文学界的名流出席了颁奖典礼。

e.en: The conference brought together global scientific {eminences}.
e.zh: 这次会议汇聚了全球科学界的杰出人士。

e.en: She is an {eminent} expert in climate science.
e.zh: 她是气候科学领域的杰出专家。

e.en: The award honors {eminent} contributions to medicine.
e.zh: 该奖项表彰对医学的杰出贡献。

e.en: Her résumé is {eminently} suitable for the role.
e.zh: 她的履历非常适合这个职位。

e.en: The plan seemed {eminently} reasonable to everyone present.
e.zh: 在场的每个人都觉得这个计划极为合理。

emir.t: n. 埃米尔（阿拉伯酋长）

e.en: The {emir} welcomed foreign leaders to the palace.
e.zh: 埃米尔在宫殿中接待了外国领导人。

e.en: A new {emir} took the throne after his father.
e.zh: 在父亲之后，一位新的酋长继承了王位。

e.en: Dubai is the most famous {emirate} in the region.
e.zh: 迪拜是该地区最著名的酋长国。

e.en: The {emirate} invests heavily in tourism and tech.
e.zh: 该酋长国大力投资旅游业和科技业。

emirates.t: n. 酋长国（复数）；阿联酋

e.en: The United Arab {Emirates} hosted the summit.
e.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国主办了此次峰会。

e.en: Several Gulf {emirates} signed the new trade deal.
e.zh: 几个海湾酋长国签署了新的贸易协定。

e.en: The president sent an {emissary} to negotiate peace.
e.zh: 总统派出一名特使去谈判和平。

e.en: An {emissary} delivered the king's message in private.
e.zh: 一名使节私下转交了国王的口信。

e.en: The new car has very low carbon {emission}.
e.zh: 这款新车的碳排放非常低。

e.en: Sensors detect any unusual gas {emission} from the pipe.
e.zh: 传感器可检测出管道中任何异常的气体排放。

e.en: The country aims to cut {emissions} by half.
e.zh: 该国的目标是将排放量减少一半。

e.en: Factories must report their monthly {emissions} to regulators.
e.zh: 工厂必须每月向监管机构报告排放量。

e.en: Polished metal has very low {emissivity} for heat radiation.
e.zh: 抛光金属对热辐射的发射率非常低。

e.en: Engineers measured the surface's {emissivity} with an infrared camera.
e.zh: 工程师用红外相机测量了表面的发射率。

emit.t: v. 发出、散发（光、声、气体）

e.en: The lamp can {emit} a soft warm light.
e.zh: 这盏灯能发出柔和温暖的光线。

e.en: Old engines {emit} more pollutants than newer models.
e.zh: 旧引擎比新款排放更多污染物。

emitted.t: v. emit 的过去式；已发出

e.en: The factory {emitted} smoke throughout the night.
e.zh: 工厂整夜都在排放烟雾。

e.en: The phone {emitted} a quiet beep when charging.
e.zh: 手机充电时发出轻微的提示音。

e.en: This sensor uses an infrared {emitter} to detect motion.
e.zh: 该传感器利用红外发射器检测移动。

e.en: Coal plants are major {emitter}s of greenhouse gases.
e.zh: 燃煤电厂是温室气体的主要排放源。

emmaus.t: n. 以马忤斯（圣经地名）

e.en: The painting depicts the road to {Emmaus}.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘的是通往以马忤斯的道路。

e.en: Pilgrims still walk the path toward {Emmaus} today.
e.zh: 如今朝圣者仍走在通往以马忤斯的路上。

e.en: The actress won her first {Emmy} last night.
e.zh: 这位女演员昨晚赢得了她的首座艾美奖。

e.en: The drama received six {Emmy} nominations this year.
e.zh: 这部剧今年获得了六项艾美奖提名。

emo.t:
n. Emo 情绪摇滚
adj. 情绪化的

e.en: He still loves the {emo} bands of his teens.
e.zh: 他依然喜爱青少年时期的情绪摇滚乐队。

e.en: Her dark fringe gave her an {emo} look.
e.zh: 她乌黑的刘海让她带着一股情绪摇滚的味道。

emollient.t:
n. 润肤剂
adj. 缓和的

e.en: Apply an {emollient} cream to soothe dry skin.
e.zh: 涂抹润肤霜以舒缓干燥的皮肤。

e.en: His {emollient} tone calmed the angry customer.
e.zh: 他温和的语气安抚了愤怒的顾客。

e.en: The role offers a generous {emolument} and benefits.
e.zh: 该职位提供丰厚的薪酬和福利。

e.en: The constitution forbids accepting any foreign {emolument}.
e.zh: 宪法禁止接受任何外国报酬。

e.en: The judge declined all {emoluments} from outside firms.
e.zh: 法官拒绝了所有来自外部公司的报酬。

e.en: His {emoluments} included housing and a car allowance.
e.zh: 他的薪酬包括住房和车贴。

e.en: Young actors learn how to {emote} on stage.
e.zh: 年轻演员学习如何在舞台上表达情感。

e.en: Players can {emote} with their characters in the game.
e.zh: 玩家可以用角色在游戏中做出表情动作。

e.en: She struggled to hide the {emotion} in her voice.
e.zh: 她努力掩饰声音中的情感。

e.en: The film stirred up a lot of {emotion} in the audience.
e.zh: 这部电影在观众中激起了强烈的情感。

e.en: The wedding speech was deeply {emotional} and touching.
e.zh: 那段婚礼致辞非常感人,充满情感。

e.en: He's been {emotional} ever since his dog passed away.
e.zh: 自从他的狗去世后,他一直情绪低落。

e.en: The debate was ruined by pure {emotionalism} instead of facts.
e.zh: 这场辩论被纯粹的感情用事毁了,而不是讲事实。

e.en: Critics accused the politician of cheap {emotionalism}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这位政客在廉价地煽情。

e.en: The song's {emotionality} made many listeners cry.
e.zh: 这首歌的情感张力让许多听众落泪。

e.en: Her writing is praised for its raw {emotionality}.
e.zh: 她的写作因其原始的情感力量而备受赞誉。

e.en: Caring for a sick parent is {emotionally} exhausting.
e.zh: 照顾生病的父母在情感上非常耗人。

e.en: He was {emotionally} unavailable throughout the relationship.
e.zh: 他在整段关系中都缺乏情感投入。

emotionless.t: adj. 面无表情的；冷漠的

e.en: Her face stayed {emotionless} as she heard the verdict.
e.zh: 听到判决时,她脸上毫无表情。

e.en: The robot delivered the news in an {emotionless} voice.
e.zh: 机器人用毫无感情的声音播报了消息。

e.en: Try to name the {emotions} you're feeling right now.
e.zh: 试着说出你此刻的感受。

e.en: Sports fans often experience intense {emotions} during finals.
e.zh: 球迷在决赛期间常常情绪激烈。

emotive.t: adj. 煽动情绪的；动情的

e.en: Climate change is a deeply {emotive} topic for many.
e.zh: 气候变化对很多人来说是个触动情感的话题。

e.en: The advertisement used {emotive} music to sell the brand.
e.zh: 那则广告用煽情的音乐来推销品牌。

e.en: {Emotivism} claims moral statements just express feelings.
e.zh: 情感主义认为道德判断只是情绪的表达。

e.en: The professor lectured on the flaws of ethical {emotivism}.
e.zh: 教授讲解了伦理情感主义的缺陷。

empanada.t: n. 恩帕纳达（拉美肉馅饺）

e.en: I ordered a beef {empanada} from the food truck.
e.zh: 我在餐车那儿点了一个牛肉馅饼。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her how to fold an {empanada}.
e.zh: 她奶奶教她怎么包馅饼。

e.en: The judge will {empanel} the jury tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 法官将于明天上午组成陪审团。

e.en: They plan to {empanel} a committee to investigate the issue.
e.zh: 他们打算成立一个委员会来调查此事。

e.en: As an {empath}, she easily picks up on others' moods.
e.zh: 作为一个共情者,她很容易察觉他人的情绪。

e.en: He's a natural {empath} who makes everyone feel heard.
e.zh: 他是个天生的共情者,能让每个人都感到被倾听。

empathetic.t: adj. 有同理心的；共情的

e.en: A good therapist needs to be {empathetic} and patient.
e.zh: 一名优秀的心理治疗师需要有同理心和耐心。

e.en: Her {empathetic} response made me feel truly understood.
e.zh: 她那充满同理心的回应让我感到被真正理解。

e.en: She nodded {empathetically} as he shared his struggles.
e.zh: 他诉说自己的挣扎时,她带着同理心点头。

e.en: The manager listened {empathetically} to every complaint.
e.zh: 经理带着同理心倾听了每一个投诉。

e.en: His {empathic} listening style helps clients open up.
e.zh: 他富有同理心的倾听风格让客户愿意敞开心扉。

e.en: Children learn {empathic} behavior by watching their parents.
e.zh: 孩子通过观察父母学会富有同理心的行为。

empathise.t: v. 产生共情（英式拼写）

e.en: I really {empathise} with parents working from home.
e.zh: 我非常理解居家办公的父母。

e.en: Try to {empathise} with your teammates before criticising them.
e.zh: 批评队友之前先试着体谅他们。

empathize.t: v. 产生共情；感同身受

e.en: It's hard to {empathize} with someone you've never met.
e.zh: 很难对一个素未谋面的人产生共情。

e.en: Good leaders {empathize} with their team's daily struggles.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会体谅团队的日常困难。

e.en: She showed real {empathy} when I lost my job.
e.zh: 我失业时她表现出了真正的同理心。

e.en: Teaching {empathy} to kids helps them build friendships.
e.zh: 教孩子学会共情有助于他们建立友谊。

e.en: The {emperor} ruled the vast empire for forty years.
e.zh: 这位皇帝统治了庞大的帝国四十年。

e.en: A statue of the {emperor} stands in the city square.
e.zh: 城市广场上矗立着这位皇帝的雕像。

e.en: Many Roman {emperors} died under mysterious circumstances.
e.zh: 许多罗马皇帝都在离奇的情况下去世。

e.en: The museum exhibits portraits of ancient Chinese {emperors}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了中国古代皇帝的画像。

emphases.t: n. 重点，强调（emphasis 的复数）

e.en: The two essays have very different {emphases} and tones.
e.zh: 这两篇文章的侧重点和语气大不相同。

e.en: Modern schools place new {emphases} on creative thinking.
e.zh: 现代学校对创造性思维有了新的侧重。

e.en: The course places strong {emphasis} on practical skills.
e.zh: 这门课程非常重视实践技能。

e.en: She read the line with {emphasis} on the last word.
e.zh: 她朗读这句话时着重强调了最后一个词。

e.en: I want to {emphasise} how important deadlines are.
e.zh: 我想强调一下截止日期有多重要。

e.en: The teacher used bold text to {emphasise} key points.
e.zh: 老师用粗体来强调要点。

e.en: Let me {emphasize} that safety comes first on this site.
e.zh: 我要强调一下,这里安全第一。

e.en: Coaches often {emphasize} teamwork over individual talent.
e.zh: 教练们通常更强调团队合作而非个人天赋。

e.en: She {emphasized} the need for honest feedback at work.
e.zh: 她强调了工作中需要诚实的反馈。

e.en: The report {emphasized} rising costs in major cities.
e.zh: 报告着重指出大城市生活成本不断上涨。

emphasizes.t: v. 强调（第三人称单数）

e.en: This diet {emphasizes} vegetables and whole grains.
e.zh: 这种饮食方式强调蔬菜和全谷物。

e.en: The new policy {emphasizes} remote work flexibility.
e.zh: 新政策强调远程办公的灵活性。

e.en: He kept {emphasizing} the importance of regular exercise.
e.zh: 他一直在强调规律锻炼的重要性。

e.en: The ad campaign is {emphasizing} sustainability this year.
e.zh: 今年的广告宣传重点强调可持续性。

emphatic.t: adj. 语气强烈的，明确的

e.en: Her answer was an {emphatic} no to the proposal.
e.zh: 她对这个提议给出了坚决的否定回答。

e.en: The team scored an {emphatic} victory in the finals.
e.zh: 该队在决赛中赢得了一场绝对的胜利。

e.en: He {emphatically} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 他斩钉截铁地否认与这起丑闻有任何关联。

e.en: She nodded {emphatically} when asked if she'd join us.
e.zh: 被问到是否加入时,她非常肯定地点了点头。

e.en: Years of smoking caused his severe {emphysema}.
e.zh: 多年的吸烟导致他患上了严重的肺气肿。

e.en: Patients with {emphysema} often struggle to breathe.
e.zh: 肺气肿患者常常呼吸困难。

e.en: The Roman {empire} lasted for several centuries.
e.zh: 罗马帝国延续了几个世纪。

e.en: She built a small business {empire} from her kitchen.
e.zh: 她从自家厨房起步建起了一个小型商业帝国。

e.en: History shows that all {empires} eventually fall.
e.zh: 历史表明,所有帝国最终都会衰落。

e.en: Tech billionaires run global media {empires} today.
e.zh: 如今的科技亿万富翁掌控着全球媒体帝国。

empiric.t:
adj. 凭经验的
n. 经验主义者

e.en: His conclusions rest on {empiric} observation, not theory.
e.zh: 他的结论建立在经验观察上,而非理论。

e.en: The doctor took an {empiric} approach to the treatment.
e.zh: 医生对这一治疗采取了凭经验的方法。

empirical.t: adj. 基于经验的，实证的

e.en: Scientists rely on {empirical} data to test hypotheses.
e.zh: 科学家依靠实证数据来检验假设。

e.en: There's no {empirical} evidence that the diet works.
e.zh: 没有实证证据表明这种饮食有效。

e.en: The claim has been {empirically} verified by many studies.
e.zh: 该说法已被许多研究通过实证验证。

e.en: We need to test this idea {empirically} before launch.
e.zh: 在发布前,我们需要通过实验来验证这个想法。

empiricism.t: n. 经验主义，实证主义

e.en: British {empiricism} shaped much of modern science.
e.zh: 英国经验主义塑造了现代科学的大部分内容。

e.en: He prefers {empiricism} over abstract philosophical reasoning.
e.zh: 比起抽象的哲学推理,他更倾向于经验主义。

e.en: As an {empiricist}, she trusts only what data shows.
e.zh: 作为一个经验主义者,她只相信数据所显示的内容。

e.en: Locke is often called the founder of modern {empiricist} thought.
e.zh: 洛克常被称为现代经验主义思想的奠基人。

emplace.t: v. 放置，安置（尤指武器）

e.en: Soldiers worked overnight to {emplace} the heavy artillery.
e.zh: 士兵们连夜把重型火炮安置到位。

e.en: Engineers will {emplace} sensors along the new bridge.
e.zh: 工程师将沿着新桥安装传感器。

e.en: The gun {emplacement} overlooked the entire valley.
e.zh: 那个炮位俯瞰整个山谷。

e.en: They built a concrete {emplacement} for the antenna.
e.zh: 他们为天线建造了一个混凝土底座。

e.en: The factory plans to {employ} two hundred workers next year.
e.zh: 工厂计划明年雇用两百名工人。

e.en: Writers often {employ} metaphors to make ideas clearer.
e.zh: 作家经常运用比喻来让观点更清晰。

e.en: Internships greatly improve a graduate's {employability}.
e.zh: 实习经历能大大提高毕业生的就业能力。

e.en: The course aims to boost students' {employability} skills.
e.zh: 该课程旨在提升学生的就业技能。

e.en: Coding bootcamps make graduates highly {employable}.
e.zh: 编程训练营让毕业生极具就业竞争力。

e.en: Soft skills are just as important as being {employable}.
e.zh: 软技能与就业能力同样重要。

employed.t:
adj. 受雇的
v. 雇用（过去式）

e.en: She's been {employed} at the same company for ten years.
e.zh: 她在同一家公司工作了十年。

e.en: The chef {employed} a clever trick to keep meat juicy.
e.zh: 主厨用了一个巧妙的方法让肉保持多汁。

e.en: Every {employee} receives health insurance and paid leave.
e.zh: 每位员工都享有医疗保险和带薪休假。

e.en: She was named {employee} of the month for her efforts.
e.zh: 她因表现出色被评为本月最佳员工。

e.en: The startup has just twelve {employees} so far.
e.zh: 这家初创公司目前只有十二名员工。

e.en: All {employees} must complete the safety training online.
e.zh: 所有员工都必须在线完成安全培训。

e.en: My current {employer} offers great work-from-home flexibility.
e.zh: 我现在的雇主提供很灵活的居家办公政策。

e.en: A good {employer} listens to staff concerns seriously.
e.zh: 好的雇主会认真听取员工的诉求。

e.en: Many {employers} now require basic AI literacy.
e.zh: 许多雇主现在都要求具备基本的人工智能素养。

e.en: Top {employers} compete fiercely for skilled engineers.
e.zh: 顶级雇主争相招揽技术过硬的工程师。

employing.t: v. 雇用；使用（现在分词）

e.en: The team is {employing} new tools to speed up testing.
e.zh: 团队正在使用新工具来加快测试速度。

e.en: That café is {employing} more part-time staff this summer.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆今夏正在招更多兼职员工。

e.en: She found stable {employment} in the healthcare sector.
e.zh: 她在医疗行业找到了稳定的工作。

e.en: The city's {employment} rate has risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 该市今年的就业率大幅上升。

employs.t: v. 雇用（第三人称单数）

e.en: The restaurant {employs} mostly local college students.
e.zh: 这家餐厅雇用的大多是本地大学生。

e.en: This algorithm {employs} machine learning to detect fraud.
e.zh: 该算法运用机器学习来检测欺诈行为。

e.en: The vintage {emporium} downtown sells rare vinyl records and old cameras.
e.zh: 市中心那家古董商场出售稀有黑胶唱片和旧相机。

e.en: She opened a small tea {emporium} near the train station.
e.zh: 她在火车站附近开了一家小型茶叶商行。

e.en: Good teachers {empower} students to think for themselves.
e.zh: 好老师能让学生学会独立思考。

e.en: This app aims to {empower} small businesses with free tools.
e.zh: 这款应用旨在用免费工具赋能小型企业。

empowered.t: v. 被赋予权力（过去式）

e.en: She felt {empowered} after finishing her first marathon.
e.zh: 完成第一次马拉松后,她感到充满力量。

e.en: Managers are {empowered} to approve refunds under fifty dollars.
e.zh: 经理有权批准五十美元以下的退款。

empowering.t:
adj. 给予力量的
v. 赋能（现在分词）

e.en: Learning to code was an {empowering} experience for her.
e.zh: 学习编程对她来说是一次充满力量的经历。

e.en: The company is {empowering} employees by offering flexible hours.
e.zh: 公司通过提供弹性工时来赋予员工更多自主权。

e.en: The workshop focuses on financial {empowerment} for young women.
e.zh: 该工作坊聚焦于年轻女性的经济赋权。

e.en: True {empowerment} comes from education and opportunity.
e.zh: 真正的赋权来自教育和机会。

empowers.t: v. 赋权（第三人称单数）

e.en: This platform {empowers} creators to sell directly to fans.
e.zh: 这个平台让创作者能够直接向粉丝销售产品。

e.en: Knowledge {empowers} people to make better decisions.
e.zh: 知识让人们能够做出更好的决定。

e.en: The {empress} ruled the kingdom for over forty years.
e.zh: 这位女皇统治这个王国四十多年。

e.en: Historians wrote extensively about the famous Chinese {empress}.
e.zh: 历史学家大量撰写关于这位著名中国女皇的著作。

e.en: He {emptied} his pockets and found only loose change.
e.zh: 他掏空了口袋,只找到一些零钱。

e.en: The stadium {emptied} quickly after the concert ended.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后,体育场迅速空了下来。

empties.t:
v. 倒空（第三人称单数）
n. 空瓶

e.en: The cleaning crew {empties} the trash bins every morning.
e.zh: 清洁人员每天早上倒空垃圾桶。

e.en: Please return the {empties} to the recycling bin.
e.zh: 请把空瓶子放回回收箱。

e.en: He stared {emptily} at the screen, lost in thought.
e.zh: 他茫然地盯着屏幕,陷入了沉思。

e.en: The hallway echoed {emptily} as she walked alone.
e.zh: 她独自走过时,走廊里回荡着空洞的回声。

e.en: After the move, the apartment felt full of {emptiness}.
e.zh: 搬家之后,公寓里充满了空荡荡的感觉。

e.en: She felt a strange {emptiness} after finishing the novel.
e.zh: 读完那本小说后,她感到一种奇怪的空虚感。

empty.t:
adj. 空的
v. 清空，倒空

e.en: The fridge is completely {empty} again.
e.zh: 冰箱又一次空空如也。

e.en: Please {empty} the dishwasher before going to bed.
e.zh: 睡觉前请把洗碗机里的碗碟拿出来。

e.en: She is {emptying} the boxes into the new closet.
e.zh: 她正把箱子里的东西腾到新衣柜里。

e.en: {Emptying} the inbox every Friday helps me stay organized.
e.zh: 每周五清空收件箱有助于我保持条理。

e.en: The poem describes an {empyreal} light shining over the mountains.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了一束天界之光照耀群山。

e.en: Her voice had an almost {empyreal} quality on stage.
e.zh: 她在台上的嗓音带着一种近乎天籁的特质。

e.en: Ancient poets believed the {empyrean} was the home of gods.
e.zh: 古代诗人相信至高天是众神的居所。

e.en: The painting depicts angels descending from the {empyrean}.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了天使从至高天降临人间。

e.en: Set the paragraph spacing to two {ems} for better readability.
e.zh: 将段落间距设为两个em以提高可读性。

e.en: In CSS, {ems} scale relative to the parent font size.
e.zh: 在CSS中,em单位会根据父元素字体大小进行缩放。

emu.t: n. 鸸鹋（澳洲大型鸟类）

e.en: The {emu} is a large flightless bird native to Australia.
e.zh: 鸸鹋是一种原产于澳大利亚的大型不会飞的鸟。

e.en: We saw an {emu} running across the dusty road.
e.zh: 我们看到一只鸸鹋跑过满是灰尘的路。

e.en: Many young coders try to {emulate} their favorite open-source maintainers.
e.zh: 许多年轻程序员都想模仿他们喜爱的开源维护者。

e.en: This software can {emulate} older game consoles on your laptop.
e.zh: 这款软件可以在笔记本电脑上模拟旧款游戏机。

e.en: The new chip {emulated} the old system with surprising accuracy.
e.zh: 这款新芯片以惊人的精度模拟了旧系统。

e.en: She {emulated} her mentor's calm leadership style at work.
e.zh: 她在工作中效仿导师那种沉稳的领导风格。

emulates.t: v. 模仿；模拟（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {emulates} a classic typewriter, complete with sound effects.
e.zh: 这款应用模拟经典打字机,连音效都一并还原。

e.en: The younger sister {emulates} everything her older brother does.
e.zh: 妹妹会模仿哥哥做的每一件事。

e.en: He spent years {emulating} the writing style of his hero.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间模仿偶像的写作风格。

e.en: The browser is {emulating} a mobile device for testing purposes.
e.zh: 浏览器正在模拟移动设备以便进行测试。

e.en: Game {emulation} lets you play retro titles on modern hardware.
e.zh: 游戏模拟让你能在现代硬件上玩复古游戏。

e.en: Her success inspired widespread {emulation} among colleagues.
e.zh: 她的成功在同事中引发了广泛的效仿。

e.en: The museum showcases {emulations} of historic computing systems.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了历史计算机系统的模拟版本。

e.en: Modern {emulations} of vintage synths sound nearly identical to originals.
e.zh: 对老式合成器的现代模拟在音色上几乎与原版无异。

emulator.t: n. 模拟器（如安卓模拟器）

e.en: I tested the app on an Android {emulator} before shipping.
e.zh: 我在发布前用安卓模拟器测试了这款应用。

e.en: He uses a Game Boy {emulator} to replay childhood favorites.
e.zh: 他用Game Boy模拟器重玩童年最爱的游戏。

e.en: Proper {emulsification} keeps salad dressing from separating in the bottle.
e.zh: 良好的乳化能让沙拉酱在瓶中不会分层。

e.en: The chef explained the science of butter {emulsification} in sauces.
e.zh: 主厨讲解了酱汁中黄油乳化背后的科学原理。

e.en: Different {emulsifications} produce creams with very different textures.
e.zh: 不同的乳化方式会做出质地差别很大的奶油。

e.en: The lab tested several {emulsifications} for the new lotion.
e.zh: 实验室为新款乳液测试了几种乳化配方。

e.en: She slowly whisked the oil until it {emulsified} into mayonnaise.
e.zh: 她慢慢搅打油液,直到乳化成蛋黄酱。

e.en: The {emulsified} dressing coated the leaves perfectly.
e.zh: 乳化好的酱汁完美地裹住了菜叶。

e.en: Egg yolk acts as a natural {emulsifier} in hollandaise sauce.
e.zh: 蛋黄在荷兰酱中起到天然乳化剂的作用。

e.en: Most commercial peanut butters contain a small amount of {emulsifier}.
e.zh: 大多数市售花生酱都含有少量乳化剂。

e.en: Many processed foods rely on {emulsifiers} to maintain their texture.
e.zh: 许多加工食品依靠乳化剂来维持其口感。

e.en: Plant-based {emulsifiers} are becoming popular in clean-label products.
e.zh: 植物乳化剂在洁净标签产品中越来越流行。

emulsifies.t: v. 使乳化（第三人称单数）

e.en: Mustard {emulsifies} the vinaigrette and prevents separation.
e.zh: 芥末能让油醋汁乳化,防止油水分离。

e.en: This soap {emulsifies} grease so it rinses away easily.
e.zh: 这款肥皂能乳化油污,使其容易冲洗干净。

e.en: Whisk continuously to {emulsify} the oil and lemon juice.
e.zh: 持续搅打,使油和柠檬汁乳化。

e.en: Soaps {emulsify} oils, allowing water to wash them away.
e.zh: 肥皂能乳化油脂,让水把它们冲走。

e.en: The blender does a great job {emulsifying} the salad dressing.
e.zh: 这台搅拌机能很好地把沙拉酱乳化均匀。

e.en: Lecithin is a common {emulsifying} agent in chocolate.
e.zh: 卵磷脂是巧克力中常见的乳化剂。

e.en: Mayonnaise is essentially an {emulsion} of oil and egg yolk.
e.zh: 蛋黄酱本质上是油和蛋黄形成的乳化液。

e.en: Apply a thin layer of {emulsion} after cleansing your face.
e.zh: 洁面后涂一层薄薄的乳液。

e.en: Please {enable} two-factor authentication on your account.
e.zh: 请在你的账户上启用双重验证。

e.en: Better tools {enable} small teams to ship products faster.
e.zh: 更好的工具让小团队能够更快地推出产品。

enabled.t:
adj. 已启用的
v. 使能够（过去式）

e.en: Dark mode is now {enabled} by default on the app.
e.zh: 应用现已默认启用深色模式。

e.en: The scholarship {enabled} her to study abroad for a year.
e.zh: 这笔奖学金让她得以出国留学一年。

e.en: Sales {enablement} teams build resources to help reps close deals.
e.zh: 销售赋能团队会制作资源帮助销售人员达成交易。

e.en: The company invested heavily in customer {enablement} programs.
e.zh: 公司在客户赋能项目上投入了大量资金。

e.en: Cheap cloud storage was a key {enabler} of the streaming era.
e.zh: 廉价的云存储是流媒体时代的关键推动力。

e.en: Friends warned him not to be an {enabler} of bad habits.
e.zh: 朋友们提醒他不要成为坏习惯的纵容者。

e.en: Open APIs are powerful {enablers} of third-party innovation.
e.zh: 开放API是推动第三方创新的强大助力。

e.en: Mentors can be quiet {enablers} of long-term career growth.
e.zh: 导师可以是长期职业成长背后默默的推动者。

enables.t: v. 启用；使能够（第三人称单数）

e.en: This setting {enables} offline access to your documents.
e.zh: 此设置可启用文档的离线访问。

e.en: Remote work {enables} her to live closer to family.
e.zh: 远程工作让她能够住在离家人更近的地方。

enabling.t:
v. 正在启用
adj. 赋予能力的

e.en: {Enabling} notifications will alert you to new messages instantly.
e.zh: 启用通知后,你会立即收到新消息提醒。

e.en: Cheap sensors are {enabling} a wave of smart-home products.
e.zh: 廉价传感器正在催生新一波智能家居产品。

e.en: Lawmakers plan to {enact} stricter privacy regulations next year.
e.zh: 立法者计划明年颁布更严格的隐私法规。

e.en: The students will {enact} the play in front of parents.
e.zh: 学生们将在家长面前表演这出戏。

e.en: The new tax law was {enacted} just before the holidays.
e.zh: 新的税法在节假日前夕刚刚颁布。

e.en: Several states have already {enacted} similar bans on plastic bags.
e.zh: 已有数个州颁布了类似的塑料袋禁令。

e.en: Congress is {enacting} reforms to address rising healthcare costs.
e.zh: 国会正在出台改革措施以应对不断上涨的医疗成本。

e.en: The kids were {enacting} their favorite movie scenes in the yard.
e.zh: 孩子们在院子里表演他们最爱的电影场景。

e.en: The {enactment} of the new law took nearly two years.
e.zh: 这部新法律的颁布历时近两年。

e.en: Her {enactment} of the role earned widespread praise from critics.
e.zh: 她对这个角色的演绎赢得了评论家的广泛赞誉。

enacts.t: v. 颁布（第三人称单数）

e.en: The bill {enacts} sweeping changes to the immigration system.
e.zh: 该法案对移民制度进行了大刀阔斧的改革。

e.en: The actor {enacts} the same scene differently every night.
e.zh: 这位演员每晚演绎同一场戏的方式都不一样。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {enalapril} to help lower his blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生开了依那普利来帮助他降低血压。

e.en: Patients taking {enalapril} should monitor their kidney function regularly.
e.zh: 服用依那普利的患者应定期监测肾功能。

enamel.t:
n. 珐琅；牙釉质
v. 涂珐琅

e.en: Brushing too hard can wear down your tooth {enamel}.
e.zh: 刷牙太用力会磨损牙釉质。

e.en: She painted the old kettle with bright blue {enamel}.
e.zh: 她用亮蓝色的搪瓷漆涂了那把旧水壶。

e.en: The kitchen had a beautiful {enameled} cast iron stove.
e.zh: 厨房里有一个漂亮的搪瓷铸铁炉。

e.en: She bought an {enameled} mug with tiny floral patterns.
e.zh: 她买了一个带小花图案的搪瓷杯。

e.en: The factory specializes in {enameling} cookware and bathtubs.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门从事炊具和浴缸的搪瓷加工。

e.en: She took a class on {enameling} jewelry last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天上了一门珠宝珐琅课。

enamelled.t: adj. 涂珐琅的（英式拼写）

e.en: He served tea in delicately {enamelled} porcelain cups.
e.zh: 他用精致的珐琅瓷杯端上茶。

e.en: The antique box had a beautifully {enamelled} lid.
e.zh: 这只古董盒子有一个绘有精美珐琅的盖子。

e.en: Grandma served coffee in a chipped blue {enamelware} mug.
e.zh: 奶奶用一只磕了边的蓝色搪瓷杯倒咖啡。

e.en: Campers prefer {enamelware} because it resists rust and scratches.
e.zh: 露营者偏爱搪瓷器皿，因为它防锈又耐刮。

e.en: Cheap gimmicks rarely {enamor} serious gamers for long.
e.zh: 廉价的噱头很难长久吸引硬核玩家。

e.en: The city's quiet streets {enamor} every first-time visitor.
e.zh: 这座城市安静的街道让每位初访者都为之倾心。

e.en: She is completely {enamored} of her new puppy.
e.zh: 她对自己的新小狗爱得不行。

e.en: Investors are no longer {enamored} with crypto hype.
e.zh: 投资者已不再迷恋加密货币的炒作。

e.en: He grew {enamoured} of jazz during his college years.
e.zh: 他在大学期间渐渐迷上了爵士乐。

e.en: Critics are not {enamoured} with the sequel's pacing.
e.zh: 影评人对这部续集的节奏并不感冒。

e.en: One {enantiomer} of the drug causes serious side effects.
e.zh: 该药物的一种对映异构体会引发严重副作用。

e.en: Chemists separated the mixture into each pure {enantiomer}.
e.zh: 化学家将混合物分离成各自纯净的对映异构体。

e.en: The hikers decided to {encamp} beside the frozen lake.
e.zh: 徒步者决定在结冰的湖边扎营。

e.en: Protesters {encamp} outside the parliament every weekend.
e.zh: 抗议者每个周末都在议会外驻扎。

e.en: Police cleared the homeless {encampment} under the bridge.
e.zh: 警方清理了桥下的无家可归者营地。

e.en: Soldiers built a temporary {encampment} near the river.
e.zh: 士兵们在河边搭起了临时营地。

e.en: One photo can {encapsulate} the entire mood of a trip.
e.zh: 一张照片就能浓缩整段旅程的情绪。

e.en: We {encapsulate} database logic inside a single service class.
e.zh: 我们把数据库逻辑封装在单个服务类里。

encapsulated.t:
adj. 封装的
v. 概括（过去式）

e.en: Her speech {encapsulated} everything we'd been arguing about.
e.zh: 她的发言把我们争论的一切都概括了出来。

e.en: The API key is safely {encapsulated} inside the config module.
e.zh: API 密钥被安全地封装在配置模块内。

e.en: Good {encapsulation} hides messy implementation details from users.
e.zh: 良好的封装把杂乱的实现细节藏在用户视线之外。

e.en: The film offers a neat {encapsulation} of 1990s nostalgia.
e.zh: 这部电影是九十年代怀旧情绪的精彩浓缩。

e.en: Designers {encase} the battery in a fireproof aluminum shell.
e.zh: 设计师将电池封装在防火铝壳中。

e.en: Thick ice began to {encase} the airplane's wings.
e.zh: 厚厚的冰开始包裹住飞机的机翼。

e.en: The phone's rubber {encasement} survived a six-foot drop.
e.zh: 手机的橡胶外壳经受住了六英尺的跌落。

e.en: Workers added a concrete {encasement} around the old pipes.
e.zh: 工人们在旧管道外加了一层混凝土护套。

e.en: You can {encash} the cheque at any branch downtown.
e.zh: 您可以在市中心任何一家分行兑现这张支票。

e.en: Retirees often {encash} bonds to cover medical bills.
e.zh: 退休人员常把债券兑现来支付医疗费用。

encaustic.t:
n. 蜡画法
adj. 蜡画的

e.en: She paints portraits using ancient {encaustic} wax techniques.
e.zh: 她用古老的蜡画技法创作肖像。

e.en: The bathroom floor features bold {encaustic} cement tiles.
e.zh: 浴室地面铺着图案大胆的水泥花砖。

embouchure.t: n. (管乐器的) 吹口；吹奏口型

e.en: The trumpet teacher worked patiently on the student's {embouchure}.
e.zh: 小号老师耐心地纠正学生的吹奏口型。

e.en: A relaxed {embouchure} produces a much warmer tone.
e.zh: 放松的吹奏口型能发出更温暖的音色。

embrace.t:
v. 拥抱；欣然接受
n. 拥抱

e.en: More companies are starting to {embrace} remote work permanently.
e.zh: 越来越多的公司开始永久接受远程办公。

e.en: She gave her sister a long, tearful {embrace} at the airport.
e.zh: 在机场,她久久地含泪拥抱着自己的妹妹。

embraceable.t: adj. 可拥抱的；可接受的

e.en: The new policy felt fair and {embraceable} to most employees.
e.zh: 对大多数员工来说,新政策公平且容易接受。

e.en: Her warm personality made her instantly {embraceable} to strangers.
e.zh: 她温暖的性格让陌生人也立刻愿意亲近她。

embraced.t: v. 拥抱；接受（embrace 的过去式）

e.en: Teenagers quickly {embraced} the new social media app.
e.zh: 青少年很快就接受了这款新的社交媒体应用。

e.en: The mother {embraced} her son tightly after the long trip.
e.zh: 长途旅行后,母亲紧紧地拥抱了自己的儿子。

embraces.t:
v. 拥抱（第三人称单数）
n. 拥抱（复数）

e.en: This framework {embraces} the latest web standards out of the box.
e.zh: 这个框架开箱即用地支持最新的网页标准。

e.en: He {embraces} every challenge with surprising enthusiasm.
e.zh: 他以惊人的热情迎接每一个挑战。

embracing.t: v. 拥抱；接纳（embrace 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is finally {embracing} automated testing in their workflow.
e.zh: 团队终于在工作流程中开始采用自动化测试。

e.en: She walked in {embracing} a huge bouquet of flowers.
e.zh: 她抱着一大束鲜花走了进来。

embrasure.t: n. 枪眼；（墙上的）斜开窗口

e.en: Archers fired arrows through each {embrasure} in the castle wall.
e.zh: 弓箭手从城墙上的每个射击孔射出箭矢。

e.en: A cat curled up in the deep window {embrasure}.
e.zh: 一只猫蜷缩在深深的窗洞凹槽里。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her to {embroider} flowers on linen.
e.zh: 她的祖母教她在亚麻布上绣花。

e.en: Politicians love to {embroider} the truth during campaign speeches.
e.zh: 政客们喜欢在竞选演讲中渲染夸大事实。

embroidered.t:
adj. 绣花的
v. 刺绣（过去式）

e.en: She wore a jacket {embroidered} with tiny silver stars.
e.zh: 她穿着一件绣着银色小星星的夹克。

e.en: He {embroidered} the story so much that nobody believed him.
e.zh: 他把故事添油加醋到没人再相信他了。

e.en: The {embroiderer} spent six months stitching the wedding gown.
e.zh: 那位刺绣师花了六个月绣制这件婚纱。

e.en: A skilled {embroiderer} can earn good money on Etsy.
e.zh: 技艺精湛的刺绣师在 Etsy 上可以赚到不少钱。

e.en: The pillow features delicate gold {embroidery} along the edges.
e.zh: 这个抱枕的边缘有精致的金线刺绣。

e.en: She picked up {embroidery} as a hobby during the lockdown.
e.zh: 封城期间她把刺绣当作了一项爱好。

embroil.t: v. 使卷入（纠纷）；使陷入

e.en: The leak threatened to {embroil} the senator in another scandal.
e.zh: 这次泄密可能会让那位参议员卷入又一桩丑闻。

e.en: Reporters worry the dispute will {embroil} neighboring countries.
e.zh: 记者们担心这场争端会把邻国也卷进来。

embroiled.t: v. 卷入纷争（embroil 的过去式）

e.en: The startup got {embroiled} in a long patent lawsuit.
e.zh: 这家创业公司卷入了一场漫长的专利诉讼。

e.en: She is {embroiled} in a public feud with her former agent.
e.zh: 她正与前经纪人陷入一场公开的争执之中。

e.en: Scientists studied the developing chick {embryo} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家们在显微镜下研究着发育中的鸡胚胎。

e.en: The plan is still in {embryo} and needs more refinement.
e.zh: 这个方案还处于雏形阶段,需要进一步完善。

embryogenesis.t: n. 胚胎发生；胚胎形成

e.en: This gene plays a crucial role during early {embryogenesis}.
e.zh: 这个基因在胚胎发育早期起着关键作用。

e.en: Researchers are mapping every cell division in {embryogenesis}.
e.zh: 研究人员正在绘制胚胎发生中每一次细胞分裂的图谱。

e.en: The textbook explains the {embryologic} origin of each organ.
e.zh: 教科书解释了每个器官的胚胎学起源。

e.en: Many birth defects trace back to {embryologic} development errors.
e.zh: 许多出生缺陷都可追溯到胚胎发育过程中的错误。

embryological.t: adj. 胚胎学的；与胚胎相关的

e.en: {Embryological} studies reveal how complex tissues first form.
e.zh: 胚胎学研究揭示了复杂组织最初是如何形成的。

e.en: The lab specializes in {embryological} research on zebrafish.
e.zh: 该实验室专门从事斑马鱼的胚胎学研究。

e.en: The {embryologist} carefully examined each fertilized egg.
e.zh: 这位胚胎学家仔细检查了每一个受精卵。
