e.en: She trained as an {embryologist} at a leading fertility clinic.
e.zh: 她在一家顶尖生育诊所接受了胚胎学家的培训。

e.en: She studies {embryology} to understand how organs form.
e.zh: 她研究胚胎学，以了解器官如何形成。

e.en: The textbook on {embryology} covers early human development.
e.zh: 这本胚胎学教科书涵盖了人类早期发育。

e.en: Doctors detected an {embryonal} tumor during the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中发现了一个胚胎性肿瘤。

e.en: Researchers study {embryonal} cells to learn about growth.
e.zh: 研究人员研究胚胎细胞以了解生长过程。

embryonic.t: adj. 胚胎的；初期的，萌芽的

e.en: The startup is still in its {embryonic} stage.
e.zh: 这家初创公司仍处于萌芽阶段。

e.en: Scientists examined the {embryonic} development of the fish.
e.zh: 科学家研究了这种鱼的胚胎发育。

emcee.t:
n. 司仪，主持人
v. 担任主持

e.en: She will {emcee} the awards show tonight.
e.zh: 她今晚将担任颁奖典礼的主持人。

e.en: The {emcee} kept the audience laughing all evening.
e.zh: 司仪让观众整晚都笑声不断。

e.en: The editor will {emend} the manuscript before printing.
e.zh: 编辑会在印刷前校订这份手稿。

e.en: Scholars {emend} ancient texts to fix copying errors.
e.zh: 学者们修订古籍以纠正抄写错误。

e.en: The professor suggested an {emendation} to the old verse.
e.zh: 教授对这首古老的诗句提出了一处修订。

e.en: Each {emendation} was carefully noted in the footnotes.
e.zh: 每一处校订都仔细标注在脚注中。

emerald.t:
n. 祖母绿；翡翠
adj. 翠绿色的

e.en: She wore an {emerald} ring at the gala.
e.zh: 她在晚会上戴了一枚祖母绿戒指。

e.en: The hills turned a brilliant {emerald} after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后山丘变成了鲜亮的翠绿色。

e.en: New details about the case continue to {emerge}.
e.zh: 有关该案的新细节不断浮出水面。

e.en: Butterflies {emerge} from their cocoons in spring.
e.zh: 蝴蝶在春天从茧中破壳而出。

emerged.t: v. 浮现，出现（emerge 的过去式）

e.en: A clear winner {emerged} after the third round.
e.zh: 第三轮过后出现了明显的赢家。

e.en: She {emerged} from the tunnel into bright sunlight.
e.zh: 她从隧道中走出，进入明亮的阳光下。

e.en: The {emergence} of AI has changed many industries.
e.zh: 人工智能的兴起改变了许多行业。

e.en: We watched the slow {emergence} of dawn over the lake.
e.zh: 我们看着黎明慢慢从湖面上升起。

e.en: The book traces several cultural {emergences} in the region.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了该地区若干文化的兴起。

e.en: Sudden {emergences} of new species puzzled the biologists.
e.zh: 新物种的突然出现让生物学家感到困惑。

e.en: Save this number for medical {emergencies} only.
e.zh: 这个号码只在医疗紧急情况下使用。

e.en: The hospital handles dozens of {emergencies} each night.
e.zh: 这家医院每晚都要处理数十起急诊。

emergency.t:
n. 紧急情况
adj. 应急的

e.en: Call 911 if there is an {emergency}.
e.zh: 如有紧急情况请拨打 911。

e.en: Keep an {emergency} flashlight near your bed.
e.zh: 在床边放一支应急手电筒。

e.en: Language is an {emergent} property of social groups.
e.zh: 语言是社会群体中涌现出的一种特性。

e.en: The hospital prioritizes {emergent} cases over routine ones.
e.zh: 医院优先处理紧急病例，而非常规病例。

emerges.t: v. 浮现，出现（第三人称单数）

e.en: A pattern {emerges} once you analyze the data.
e.zh: 分析数据后，一种规律便浮现出来。

e.en: The moon {emerges} from behind the clouds.
e.zh: 月亮从云层后面露了出来。

emerging.t:
adj. 新兴的，崛起的
v. 浮现（现在分词）

e.en: Investors are watching {emerging} markets in Asia.
e.zh: 投资者正密切关注亚洲的新兴市场。

e.en: She is an {emerging} talent in modern dance.
e.zh: 她是现代舞领域一位崭露头角的人才。

e.en: Professor Lee is now an {emerita} at the university.
e.zh: 李教授现已成为该大学的荣休教授。

e.en: The {emerita} still gives occasional guest lectures.
e.zh: 这位荣休教授偶尔仍会做客座讲座。

emeritus.t: adj. 荣誉退休的；名誉退休的

e.en: He retired as professor {emeritus} of physics.
e.zh: 他以物理学荣誉退休教授的身份退休。

e.en: The {emeritus} chairman attends board meetings as an advisor.
e.zh: 这位名誉主席以顾问身份出席董事会议。

e.en: I read an essay by Ralph Waldo {Emerson} last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚读了一篇拉尔夫·沃尔多·爱默生的散文。

e.en: The library has a special collection on {Emerson}.
e.zh: 图书馆有一个关于爱默生的专题藏书。

emersonian.t: adj. 爱默生式的；爱默生思想的

e.en: Her essay has a distinctly {Emersonian} tone.
e.zh: 她的散文带着明显的爱默生式风格。

e.en: He preached an {Emersonian} faith in self-reliance.
e.zh: 他宣扬一种爱默生式的自立信念。

e.en: She filed her nails with an {emery} board.
e.zh: 她用砂纸锉打磨指甲。

e.en: The workshop uses {emery} cloth to smooth metal edges.
e.zh: 车间用砂布打磨金属边缘。

emetic.t:
n. 催吐剂
adj. 催吐的

e.en: Doctors gave the patient an {emetic} after the poisoning.
e.zh: 中毒后医生给病人服用了催吐剂。

e.en: Some plants contain {emetic} compounds that induce vomiting.
e.zh: 有些植物含有引起呕吐的催吐成分。

emf.t: n. 电动势（electromotive force 缩写）

e.en: The battery generates an {emf} of nine volts.
e.zh: 这块电池产生九伏的电动势。

e.en: Engineers measured the induced {emf} in the coil.
e.zh: 工程师测量了线圈中感应的电动势。

emi.t: n. 电磁干扰（electromagnetic interference 缩写）

e.en: He pays a monthly {EMI} on his car loan.
e.zh: 他每月偿还车贷的等额分期款。

e.en: Shielding reduces {EMI} between nearby electronic devices.
e.zh: 屏蔽可减少邻近电子设备之间的电磁干扰。

emic.t: adj. (人类学) 主位的，内部视角的

e.en: Anthropologists value the {emic} perspective of insiders.
e.zh: 人类学家重视来自圈内人的主位视角。

e.en: Her study takes an {emic} approach to local rituals.
e.zh: 她的研究以主位视角分析当地的仪式。

emigrant.t:
n. (移出的) 移民
adj. 移居外国的

e.en: His grandfather was an {emigrant} from Ireland.
e.zh: 他的祖父是从爱尔兰移居海外的移民。

e.en: Each {emigrant} carried only one small suitcase.
e.zh: 每位出境移民只带了一个小手提箱。

e.en: They plan to {emigrate} to Canada next year.
e.zh: 他们计划明年移居加拿大。

e.en: Many young engineers {emigrate} for better opportunities.
e.zh: 许多年轻工程师为更好的机会而出国移居。

e.en: Mass {emigration} reduced the village's population sharply.
e.zh: 大规模外迁使该村人口骤减。

e.en: The war triggered a wave of {emigration} abroad.
e.zh: 战争引发了一波向国外的移民潮。

emigre.t: n. 流亡者；移居国外者

e.en: The Russian {emigre} opened a bookshop in Paris.
e.zh: 这位俄罗斯流亡者在巴黎开了一家书店。

e.en: Many {emigre} writers settled in New York after the war.
e.zh: 许多流亡作家战后定居纽约。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the child with viral {encephalitis} overnight.
e.zh: 医生连夜诊断这个孩子患上了病毒性脑炎。

e.en: Mosquito bites can sometimes lead to severe {encephalitis}.
e.zh: 蚊虫叮咬有时会引发严重的脑炎。

e.en: Repeated concussions are linked to chronic traumatic {encephalopathy}.
e.zh: 反复的脑震荡与慢性创伤性脑病有关。

e.en: Liver failure can trigger dangerous hepatic {encephalopathy}.
e.zh: 肝衰竭可能引发危险的肝性脑病。

e.en: Street magicians still {enchant} crowds in the old square.
e.zh: 街头魔术师在老广场上依旧令人群着迷。

e.en: The villagers believed witches could {enchant} ordinary objects.
e.zh: 村民们相信女巫能给普通物品施加魔法。

enchanted.t: adj. 着迷的；被施了魔法的

e.en: Children walked through the {enchanted} forest at the theme park.
e.zh: 孩子们穿过主题公园里的魔法森林。

e.en: She was {enchanted} by the singer's gentle voice.
e.zh: 她被那位歌手温柔的嗓音深深迷住。

e.en: In the game, the {enchanter} buffs allies with magical spells.
e.zh: 在游戏里，附魔师用法术为队友增益。

e.en: A wandering {enchanter} appeared at the king's court.
e.zh: 一位云游的术士出现在国王的宫廷上。

e.en: The bookstore has an {enchanting} smell of old paper.
e.zh: 这家书店散发着旧纸张那种迷人的气味。

e.en: Her {enchanting} smile lit up the entire room.
e.zh: 她迷人的微笑照亮了整个房间。

e.en: The garden was {enchantingly} lit with hundreds of fairy lights.
e.zh: 花园被几百盏小彩灯点缀得如梦似幻。

e.en: She danced {enchantingly} across the candlelit stage.
e.zh: 她在烛光舞台上翩翩起舞，迷人极了。

e.en: The kids stared at the fireworks in pure {enchantment}.
e.zh: 孩子们出神地望着烟花，满脸沉醉。

e.en: Players can craft an {enchantment} that boosts sword damage.
e.zh: 玩家可以制作一种提升剑伤的附魔。

e.en: In the legend, an {enchantress} cursed the lonely prince.
e.zh: 传说中，一位女巫诅咒了那位孤独的王子。

e.en: Critics called the actress a true screen {enchantress}.
e.zh: 影评人称这位女演员是真正的银幕魅惑者。

e.en: I ordered a chicken {enchilada} with extra green sauce.
e.zh: 我点了一份加多绿酱的鸡肉卷饼。

e.en: This deal includes the whole {enchilada}, not just hosting.
e.zh: 这套方案包含全部服务，而不仅是托管。

e.en: An ancient {encina} oak shaded the village square for centuries.
e.zh: 一棵古老的圣栎几个世纪以来为村口广场遮阴。

e.en: Acorns from the {encina} feed the famous Iberian pigs.
e.zh: 圣栎的橡果是著名伊比利亚猪的食物。

e.en: Spies used to {encipher} messages with rotating letter wheels.
e.zh: 间谍们曾用旋转字母盘把消息加密。

e.en: Modern apps {encipher} every chat before it leaves the phone.
e.zh: 现代应用在消息离开手机前就将其加密。

e.en: Tall hedges {encircle} the entire backyard for privacy.
e.zh: 高大的树篱把整个后院围起来以保护隐私。

e.en: Police moved quickly to {encircle} the suspicious vehicle.
e.zh: 警察迅速行动，包围了那辆可疑车辆。

encircled.t: adj. 被环绕的；被包围的

e.en: Snow-covered peaks {encircled} the tiny mountain village.
e.zh: 白雪覆盖的山峰环抱着这个小山村。

e.en: Fans {encircled} the singer the moment she stepped outside.
e.zh: 她一走出门，粉丝就把她团团围住。

e.en: The army surrendered after weeks of complete {encirclement}.
e.zh: 在被彻底包围数周之后，军队选择投降。

e.en: Analysts warned of a strategic {encirclement} by rival powers.
e.zh: 分析人士警告说存在被对手大国战略包围的风险。

encircling.t:
adj. 环绕的
v. 包围（-ing）

e.en: A narrow path runs along the {encircling} stone wall.
e.zh: 一条小径沿着环形石墙延伸。

e.en: Reporters kept {encircling} the actor as he left court.
e.zh: 那位演员离开法院时，记者一直把他围在中间。

e.en: Chinatown remains a vibrant cultural {enclave} in the city.
e.zh: 唐人街仍是这座城市里充满活力的文化飞地。

e.en: The startup hub became an {enclave} for young engineers.
e.zh: 这个创业园区成了年轻工程师们的聚集地。

e.en: Please {enclose} a copy of your ID with the application.
e.zh: 请在申请表中附上一份身份证复印件。

e.en: We plan to {enclose} the patio with sliding glass panels.
e.zh: 我们打算用推拉玻璃把露台围起来。

e.en: The cat loves sleeping in {enclosed} cardboard boxes.
e.zh: 那只猫喜欢钻进封闭的纸箱里睡觉。

e.en: Please review the {enclosed} contract before our meeting.
e.zh: 开会前请先看一下随附的合同。

encloses.t: v. 围住（第三人称单数）

e.en: A wooden fence {encloses} the entire vegetable garden.
e.zh: 一道木栅栏把整个菜园围了起来。

e.en: The envelope {encloses} a handwritten thank-you note.
e.zh: 信封里装着一张手写的感谢卡。

e.en: I'm {enclosing} the receipt for your records.
e.zh: 我把收据一并附上，方便您留存。

e.en: The {enclosing} brackets in the code group two arguments.
e.zh: 代码里那对括号把两个参数括在一起。

e.en: The zoo built a larger {enclosure} for the snow leopards.
e.zh: 动物园为雪豹建了一个更大的围栏区。

e.en: Please see the {enclosure} for our updated price list.
e.zh: 请查看附件中我们最新的价目表。

e.en: Browsers {encode} special characters before sending the URL.
e.zh: 浏览器在发送网址前会对特殊字符进行编码。

e.en: Memories may {encode} differently when you're under stress.
e.zh: 在紧张状态下，记忆的编码方式可能会不同。

e.en: The video is {encoded} in H.265 to save bandwidth.
e.zh: 该视频采用 H.265 编码以节省带宽。

e.en: Cultural values are deeply {encoded} in everyday language.
e.zh: 文化价值观深深嵌入在日常语言之中。

e.en: This {encoder} converts raw audio into compact MP3 files.
e.zh: 这个编码器把原始音频转换成体积小的 MP3 文件。

e.en: The model uses a transformer {encoder} to embed each sentence.
e.zh: 该模型用一个 Transformer 编码器把每个句子嵌入向量。

encoding.t:
n. 编码（方式）
v. 编码中

e.en: Save the file using UTF-8 {encoding} to avoid garbled text.
e.zh: 请用 UTF-8 编码保存文件，避免出现乱码。

e.en: The brain is constantly {encoding} new sensory information.
e.zh: 大脑时刻在对新的感官信息进行编码。

e.en: Every aging dictator seems to attract a loyal {encomiast}.
e.zh: 每个年迈的独裁者似乎都会吸引一位忠实的颂扬者。

e.en: The biographer became more {encomiast} than honest critic.
e.zh: 那位传记作者变成了歌功颂德者，而不是诚实的评论者。

e.en: The retiring professor received a heartfelt {encomium} from students.
e.zh: 退休教授收到了学生们一份发自肺腑的颂词。

e.en: Her review reads more like an {encomium} than analysis.
e.zh: 她的评论读起来更像颂歌，而非分析。

e.en: Our services {encompass} design, development, and ongoing support.
e.zh: 我们的服务涵盖设计、开发和持续支持。

e.en: The new park will {encompass} two hundred acres of wetland.
e.zh: 新公园将占地两百英亩的湿地。

e.en: Her thesis {encompassed} every major dialect of Mandarin.
e.zh: 她的论文涵盖了普通话的所有主要方言。

e.en: Misty hills {encompassed} the quiet lakeside town.
e.zh: 雾蒙蒙的群山环绕着这座宁静的湖滨小镇。

encompasses.t: v. 包含（第三人称单数）

e.en: The package {encompasses} flights, hotels, and daily breakfast.
e.zh: 该套餐包含机票、酒店和每日早餐。

e.en: His research {encompasses} both physics and philosophy.
e.zh: 他的研究横跨物理学和哲学两大领域。

e.en: The CEO gave an all-{encompassing} vision for the next decade.
e.zh: CEO 描绘了一幅涵盖未来十年的宏大愿景。

e.en: They offer an {encompassing} insurance plan for digital nomads.
e.zh: 他们为数字游民提供一份覆盖全面的保险方案。

encore.t: n. 返场表演；再来一次

e.en: The crowd cheered until the band played one final {encore}.
e.zh: 观众欢呼不停，直到乐队加演了最后一首返场曲。

e.en: Audiences demanded an {encore} after her stunning aria.
e.zh: 在她惊艳的咏叹调之后，观众强烈要求返场。

encounter.t:
v. 遇到；遭遇
n. 相遇

e.en: Travelers often {encounter} unexpected delays at small airports.
e.zh: 旅客在小机场经常会遇到意想不到的延误。

e.en: Their first {encounter} happened at a coffee shop downtown.
e.zh: 他们的初次相遇发生在市中心的一家咖啡店。

e.en: We {encountered} a strange bug while testing the login flow.
e.zh: 我们在测试登录流程时遇到了一个奇怪的 bug。

e.en: She {encountered} an old classmate at the airport gate.
e.zh: 她在登机口偶遇了一位老同学。

e.en: Users keep {encountering} a blank screen after the latest update.
e.zh: 用户在最新更新后不断遇到白屏问题。

e.en: He enjoys {encountering} new cultures during long backpacking trips.
e.zh: 他喜欢在长途背包旅行中接触新的文化。

encounters.t:
n. 相遇
v. 遇到（第三人称单数）

e.en: She often {encounters} rude drivers on her morning commute.
e.zh: 她早上通勤时经常遇到粗鲁的司机。

e.en: The book describes his strange {encounters} with wildlife.
e.zh: 这本书描述了他与野生动物的奇特相遇。

e.en: Good teachers {encourage} students to ask questions freely.
e.zh: 好老师会鼓励学生自由提问。

e.en: We {encourage} customers to leave honest reviews online.
e.zh: 我们鼓励顾客在网上留下真实的评价。

encouraged.t:
adj. 受鼓舞的
v. 鼓励（过去式）

e.en: She felt {encouraged} after reading her mentor's email.
e.zh: 读完导师的邮件后,她感到备受鼓舞。

e.en: The coach {encouraged} the team during halftime.
e.zh: 教练在中场休息时鼓励了全队。

e.en: A little {encouragement} goes a long way with kids.
e.zh: 对孩子来说,一点鼓励就能起很大作用。

e.en: He needed {encouragement} before launching his startup.
e.zh: 创办公司之前,他需要一些鼓励。

e.en: Her inbox was full of warm {encouragements} from fans.
e.zh: 她的收件箱里满是粉丝温暖的鼓励。

e.en: Small {encouragements} from coworkers kept him going.
e.zh: 同事们的小小鼓励让他坚持了下去。

e.en: My grandmother was the biggest {encourager} of my dreams.
e.zh: 奶奶是我梦想最大的支持者。

e.en: Every team needs an {encourager} to lift morale.
e.zh: 每个团队都需要一个能鼓舞士气的人。

encourages.t: v. 鼓励（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {encourages} users to walk ten thousand steps daily.
e.zh: 这款应用鼓励用户每天走一万步。

e.en: Her boss {encourages} open feedback in meetings.
e.zh: 她的老板鼓励大家在会议上坦率提出意见。

e.en: The early sales numbers are very {encouraging}.
e.zh: 早期的销售数据令人非常振奋。

e.en: She gave him an {encouraging} smile before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她给了他一个鼓励的微笑。

e.en: The doctor smiled {encouragingly} as the results came back.
e.zh: 结果出来时,医生鼓励地笑了笑。

e.en: He nodded {encouragingly} while she practiced her speech.
e.zh: 她练习演讲时,他鼓励地点了点头。

e.en: New houses continue to {encroach} on the forest.
e.zh: 新建的房屋不断侵占着森林。

e.en: Don't let work {encroach} on your family time.
e.zh: 别让工作侵占你的家庭时间。

encroaching.t:
adj. 侵占的
v. 侵占（-ing）

e.en: Developers are {encroaching} on protected wetlands.
e.zh: 开发商正在侵占受保护的湿地。

e.en: Social media is {encroaching} on every part of daily life.
e.zh: 社交媒体正侵入日常生活的方方面面。

e.en: Residents protested the {encroachment} of the new highway.
e.zh: 居民们抗议新高速公路的侵占。

e.en: The law prevents {encroachment} on private property.
e.zh: 法律禁止侵占私人财产。

e.en: Salt began to {encrust} the rocks along the shore.
e.zh: 盐开始在岸边的岩石上结成硬壳。

e.en: The jeweler will {encrust} the ring with tiny diamonds.
e.zh: 珠宝匠会在戒指上镶满小钻石。

e.en: A thick {encrustation} of limescale clogged the kettle.
e.zh: 水壶里结了一层厚厚的水垢。

e.en: The crown had a beautiful {encrustation} of pearls.
e.zh: 那顶王冠镶嵌着美丽的珍珠。

e.en: The body produces {endogenous} hormones to regulate sleep.
e.zh: 人体会分泌内源性激素来调节睡眠。

e.en: Researchers distinguish {endogenous} from external factors.
e.zh: 研究人员把内源性因素和外部因素区分开来。

e.en: Vitamin D is produced {endogenously} when skin meets sunlight.
e.zh: 维生素D在皮肤接触阳光时由体内自行合成。

e.en: The hormone is released {endogenously} during exercise.
e.zh: 这种激素在运动时由体内自然释放。

e.en: Doctors performed {endolymphatic} sac surgery to relieve vertigo.
e.zh: 医生进行了内淋巴囊手术以缓解眩晕。

e.en: Pressure in the {endolymphatic} duct can cause hearing loss.
e.zh: 内淋巴管内的压力可能导致听力下降。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {endometrial} cancer last year.
e.zh: 她去年被诊断出患有子宫内膜癌。

e.en: The doctor ordered an {endometrial} biopsy for testing.
e.zh: 医生开了子宫内膜活检以进行检查。

e.en: Many women suffer years before {endometriosis} is diagnosed.
e.zh: 许多女性多年后才被确诊为子宫内膜异位症。

e.en: Severe pain is a common symptom of {endometriosis}.
e.zh: 剧烈疼痛是子宫内膜异位症的常见症状。

e.en: The {endometrium} thickens during the menstrual cycle.
e.zh: 子宫内膜在月经周期中会变厚。

e.en: Hormones cause the {endometrium} to shed each month.
e.zh: 激素会使子宫内膜每月脱落一次。

endomorph.t: n. 内胚型体质（偏胖型）

e.en: As an {endomorph}, he gains muscle and fat easily.
e.zh: 作为内胚型体质，他容易长肌肉也容易长脂肪。

e.en: Trainers tailor diets differently for an {endomorph}.
e.zh: 教练会为内胚型体质的人定制不同的饮食方案。

e.en: The {endonuclease} cuts DNA at specific sequences.
e.zh: 内切酶在特定序列处切断DNA。

e.en: CRISPR uses an {endonuclease} called Cas9 to edit genes.
e.zh: CRISPR利用一种叫Cas9的内切酶来编辑基因。

e.en: Proteins are folded inside the {endoplasmic} reticulum.
e.zh: 蛋白质在内质网内折叠。

e.en: The {endoplasmic} reticulum plays a key role in cell function.
e.zh: 内质网在细胞功能中扮演关键角色。

e.en: Running releases an {endorphin} rush that lifts your mood.
e.zh: 跑步会释放内啡肉令心情变好。

e.en: Laughter triggers {endorphin} production in the brain.
e.zh: 大笑会促使大脑分泌内啡肽。

endorse.t:
v. 支持；为…背书
v. 在票据背面签字

e.en: Several celebrities {endorse} the new fitness app.
e.zh: 几位名人为这款新健身应用代言。

e.en: The newspaper refused to {endorse} any candidate.
e.zh: 这家报纸拒绝为任何候选人背书。

e.en: The doctor {endorsed} the new treatment in her column.
e.zh: 这位医生在专栏里推荐了这种新疗法。

e.en: The plan was {endorsed} by the entire board.
e.zh: 该方案得到了全体董事会的支持。

endorsement.t:
n. 认可；代言
n. 票据背书

e.en: The athlete signed a million-dollar {endorsement} deal.
e.zh: 这位运动员签下了一份百万美元的代言合同。

e.en: Her {endorsement} carries weight in tech circles.
e.zh: 她的推荐在科技圈很有分量。

e.en: The startup collected {endorsements} from industry leaders.
e.zh: 这家初创公司获得了多位业界领袖的背书。

e.en: Top players earn millions through brand {endorsements}.
e.zh: 顶级球员通过品牌代言赚取数百万美元。

e.en: She became the celebrity {endorser} for the skincare brand.
e.zh: 她成了这个护肤品牌的明星代言人。

e.en: The {endorser} must disclose any payment received.
e.zh: 代言人必须披露所收到的任何报酬。

endorses.t: v. 支持；代言（第三人称单数）

e.en: The mayor publicly {endorses} the housing initiative.
e.zh: 市长公开支持这项住房倡议。

e.en: This reviewer rarely {endorses} a product so enthusiastically.
e.zh: 这位测评人很少这么热情地推荐一款产品。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {endorsing} checks at the bank.
e.zh: 他下午在银行里背书签支票。

e.en: The union is {endorsing} the labor reform bill.
e.zh: 工会正在为这项劳工改革法案背书。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a tiny {endoscope} through the nostril.
e.zh: 外科医生从鼻孔插入了一根细小的内窥镜。

e.en: A flexible {endoscope} lets doctors examine the stomach.
e.zh: 软式内窥镜让医生可以检查胃部。

e.en: She underwent {endoscopic} surgery to remove the polyp.
e.zh: 她接受了内窥镜手术切除息肉。

e.en: {Endoscopic} procedures usually mean shorter recovery times.
e.zh: 内窥镜手术通常恢复时间较短。

e.en: The tumor was removed {endoscopically} without open surgery.
e.zh: 肿瘤通过内窥镜切除，无需开放性手术。

e.en: Doctors examined the airway {endoscopically} for damage.
e.zh: 医生用内窥镜检查了气道是否受损。

e.en: He's scheduled for an {endoscopy} next Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 他下周二上午预约了做内窥镜检查。

e.en: The {endoscopy} revealed a small ulcer in his stomach.
e.zh: 内窥镜检查发现他胃里有一个小溃疡。

e.en: Mammals have a bony {endoskeleton} supporting their bodies.
e.zh: 哺乳动物有支撑身体的骨骼内骨架。

e.en: Unlike insects, fish rely on an {endoskeleton}.
e.zh: 与昆虫不同，鱼类依靠内骨架。

e.en: The {endosperm} provides nutrients for the growing seedling.
e.zh: 胚乳为正在生长的幼苗提供营养。

e.en: White rice is mostly {endosperm} with the bran removed.
e.zh: 白米主要由胚乳组成，麸皮已被去除。

e.en: Smoking damages the {endothelial} cells lining your blood vessels.
e.zh: 吸烟会损伤血管内壁的内皮细胞。

e.en: Healthy {endothelial} function is crucial for circulation.
e.zh: 健康的内皮功能对血液循环至关重要。

e.en: The {endothelium} regulates the flow of substances into tissues.
e.zh: 内皮调节物质进入组织的流动。

e.en: Inflammation can damage the delicate {endothelium} of arteries.
e.zh: 炎症会损伤动脉脆弱的内皮层。

endotherm.t: n. 内温动物；恒温动物

e.en: As an {endotherm}, a bear maintains its body temperature internally.
e.zh: 作为温血动物，熊靠自身维持体温。

e.en: Birds and mammals are classified as {endotherm} species.
e.zh: 鸟类和哺乳动物被归为内温动物。

e.en: The bacteria release a dangerous {endotoxin} when they die.
e.zh: 这些细菌死亡时会释放危险的内毒素。

e.en: Hospitals test IV fluids for {endotoxin} contamination.
e.zh: 医院会检测静脉注射液是否被内毒素污染。

e.en: The anesthesiologist placed an {endotracheal} tube before surgery.
e.zh: 麻醉师在手术前插入了气管插管。

e.en: {Endotracheal} intubation helps the patient breathe during anesthesia.
e.zh: 气管插管能帮助病人在麻醉期间呼吸。

e.en: Wealthy alumni often {endow} scholarships at their old universities.
e.zh: 富有的校友常向母校捐赠设立奖学金。

e.en: Nature seems to {endow} some people with great patience.
e.zh: 自然似乎赋予了某些人极大的耐心。

e.en: The professor holds an {endowed} chair in physics.
e.zh: 这位教授担任物理学讲席教授。

e.en: She is {endowed} with a remarkable singing voice.
e.zh: 她天生拥有一副非凡的歌喉。

endowment.t:
n. 捐赠基金
n. 天赋

e.en: Harvard's {endowment} is the largest of any university worldwide.
e.zh: 哈佛的捐赠基金是全球各大学中规模最大的。

e.en: The museum received a generous {endowment} from a donor.
e.zh: 博物馆收到了一位捐赠者的慷慨捐款。

e.en: The map of Middle-earth is printed on the book's {endpaper}.
e.zh: 中土世界的地图印在这本书的环衬页上。

e.en: A signed {endpaper} can dramatically increase a book's value.
e.zh: 一张签名的环衬页能让书的价值大幅提升。

e.en: The mobile app calls a single API {endpoint} to fetch data.
e.zh: 这款移动应用通过调用一个API端点来获取数据。

e.en: We agreed on a clear {endpoint} for the project.
e.zh: 我们就项目的明确终点达成了一致。

ends.t:
v. 结束（第三人称单数）
n. 末端（复数）

e.en: The school year {ends} in early June.
e.zh: 学年在六月初结束。

e.en: She works two jobs to make {ends} meet.
e.zh: 她做两份工作来维持生计。

e.en: May good fortune {endue} you with strength on this journey.
e.zh: 愿好运在这段旅程中赋予你力量。

e.en: The poet asked the muse to {endue} him with inspiration.
e.zh: 诗人祈求缪斯赐予他灵感。

e.en: With air conditioning, the summer heat became {endurable}.
e.zh: 有了空调，夏天的炎热就变得可以忍受了。

e.en: The pain was barely {endurable} without medication.
e.zh: 不吃药的话，那种疼痛几乎难以忍受。

e.en: Marathon runners need incredible {endurance} to finish the race.
e.zh: 马拉松选手需要惊人的耐力才能跑完全程。

e.en: Her {endurance} during the long illness inspired everyone.
e.zh: 她在长期患病中的坚韧鼓舞了所有人。

e.en: The athletes' {endurances} were tested in extreme heat.
e.zh: 运动员们的耐力在极端高温下经受考验。

e.en: Different sports demand different kinds of {endurances}.
e.zh: 不同的运动需要不同种类的耐力。

e.en: Refugees often {endure} terrible conditions during long journeys.
e.zh: 难民在长途跋涉中常常忍受恶劣的环境。

e.en: Classic novels {endure} because their themes feel timeless.
e.zh: 经典小说之所以经久不衰,是因为主题永不过时。

e.en: She {endured} years of training before winning gold.
e.zh: 她经过多年的艰苦训练才赢得金牌。

e.en: The old bridge has {endured} countless storms.
e.zh: 这座老桥经受住了无数次风暴。

endures.t: v. 忍受（第三人称单数）

e.en: Their friendship {endures} despite living on different continents.
e.zh: 尽管身处不同的大陆,他们的友谊依然长存。

e.en: He {endures} the long commute for a better salary.
e.zh: 为了更高的薪水,他忍受着漫长的通勤。

e.en: The film left an {enduring} impression on audiences worldwide.
e.zh: 这部电影给全球观众留下了持久的印象。

e.en: She is {enduring} chemotherapy with remarkable courage.
e.zh: 她正以非凡的勇气忍受化疗。

e.en: The brand remains {enduringly} popular among teenagers.
e.zh: 这个品牌在青少年中持续受欢迎。

e.en: His novels are {enduringly} relevant to modern readers.
e.zh: 他的小说对现代读者依然有持久的意义。

e.en: He competed in a weekend {enduro} race through the mountains.
e.zh: 他参加了周末山地耐力赛。

e.en: The {enduro} bike is built for rough off-road terrain.
e.zh: 这辆耐力赛摩托车专为崎岖越野路况设计。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {enema} before the colonoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在结肠镜检查前开了灌肠剂。

e.en: An {enema} can provide quick relief from severe constipation.
e.zh: 灌肠可以迅速缓解严重便秘。

e.en: In the game, you must defeat all the {enemies} on each level.
e.zh: 游戏中你必须击败每一关的所有敌人。

e.en: Politicians often make powerful {enemies} during their careers.
e.zh: 政客在职业生涯中常常会树敌甚多。

e.en: Procrastination is the {enemy} of productivity.
e.zh: 拖延是效率的最大敌人。

e.en: The soldiers spotted the {enemy} approaching from the north.
e.zh: 士兵们发现敌人正从北方逼近。

energetic.t: adj. 精力充沛的；有活力的

e.en: My puppy is incredibly {energetic} early in the morning.
e.zh: 我的小狗一大早就精力旺盛得不得了。

e.en: The team gave an {energetic} performance on stage.
e.zh: 乐队在舞台上呈现了充满活力的演出。

e.en: She {energetically} promoted her startup at the conference.
e.zh: 她在会议上充满干劲地推广自己的初创公司。

e.en: The kids danced {energetically} until they collapsed.
e.zh: 孩子们一直精力充沛地跳舞直到累倒。

e.en: Bioengineers study the {energetics} of cellular reactions.
e.zh: 生物工程师研究细胞反应的能量学。

e.en: The textbook covers the {energetics} of chemical bonds.
e.zh: 这本教科书涵盖了化学键的能量学。

energies.t:
n. 能量（energy 的复数）
n. 精力

e.en: She channels her {energies} into community volunteering.
e.zh: 她把精力投入到社区志愿服务中。

e.en: Renewable {energies} like solar are reshaping the grid.
e.zh: 太阳能等可再生能源正在重塑电网。

e.en: A short walk can {energise} you for the afternoon.
e.zh: 散步片刻就能让你为下午充满活力。

e.en: The new coach hopes to {energise} the struggling team.
e.zh: 新教练希望能给陷入低谷的球队注入活力。

energize.t:
v. 使充满活力；激励
v. 通电

e.en: A cold shower can {energize} you on a sleepy morning.
e.zh: 在困倦的早晨,冷水澡能让你瞬间清醒振奋。

e.en: The speech aimed to {energize} young voters before the election.
e.zh: 这场演讲旨在选举前激励年轻选民。

energized.t:
adj. 充满活力的
v. energize 的过去式

e.en: I felt {energized} after the weekend hiking trip.
e.zh: 周末徒步旅行后我感觉精力充沛。

e.en: The keynote {energized} everyone in the auditorium.
e.zh: 主题演讲让礼堂里的每个人都精神振奋。

energizer.t:
n. 激励者；提神物
n. 劲量（电池品牌）

e.en: Coffee is my morning {energizer} before work.
e.zh: 咖啡是我上班前的提神能量饮品。

e.en: She's the team {energizer} who lifts everyone's mood.
e.zh: 她是团队里的活力担当,能带动大家的情绪。

e.en: Yoga can be surprisingly {energizing} in the morning.
e.zh: 瑜伽在早晨能让人意想不到地充满活力。

e.en: The playlist features {energizing} tracks for workouts.
e.zh: 这个歌单收录了适合健身的活力歌曲。

energy.t:
n. 能量；能源
n. 精力

e.en: I have no {energy} left after that long meeting.
e.zh: 开完那场冗长的会议后我一点力气都没了。

e.en: Solar {energy} now powers most of our home.
e.zh: 太阳能现在为我们家供应大部分电力。

e.en: Long video calls tend to {enervate} even productive workers.
e.zh: 长时间的视频会议会让再高效的员工也感到疲惫。

e.en: Heat and humidity can {enervate} hikers within hours.
e.zh: 高温和潮湿能在数小时内消耗徒步者的体力。

e.en: She felt {enervated} after three sleepless nights.
e.zh: 连续三晚没睡后她感到疲惫不堪。

e.en: The endless bureaucracy left him utterly {enervated}.
e.zh: 无止境的官僚程序让他彻底心力交瘁。

enervating.t: adj. 令人疲乏的；使人虚弱的

e.en: The tropical heat was {enervating} for northern visitors.
e.zh: 对北方来的游客来说,热带的炎热令人萎靡。

e.en: Office politics can be more {enervating} than the actual work.
e.zh: 办公室政治有时比实际工作更让人精疲力竭。

enfant.t: n. （法语）小孩；常见于 enfant terrible

e.en: He was once the {enfant} terrible of the fashion world.
e.zh: 他曾是时尚界的离经叛道者。

e.en: Critics called the young director an {enfant} prodige.
e.zh: 评论家称这位年轻导演为天才神童。

e.en: Chronic stress can {enfeeble} the immune system over time.
e.zh: 长期压力会逐渐削弱免疫系统。

e.en: Years of austerity began to {enfeeble} the local economy.
e.zh: 多年的紧缩政策开始让当地经济日益衰弱。

e.en: The {enfeebled} patient struggled to walk to the window.
e.zh: 虚弱的病人吃力地走到窗边。

e.en: Decades of war had {enfeebled} the country's infrastructure.
e.zh: 几十年的战争削弱了这个国家的基础设施。

e.en: Strict regulations can {enfetter} small business owners.
e.zh: 严苛的法规可能束缚小企业主的手脚。

e.en: Don't let fear {enfetter} your creative instincts.
e.zh: 不要让恐惧束缚你的创作直觉。

enfield.t: n. 恩菲尔德（伦敦地名 / 步枪名）

e.en: He restored a vintage Royal {Enfield} motorcycle from the 1960s.
e.zh: 他修复了一辆1960年代的皇家恩菲尔德摩托车。

e.en: The shop sells parts for classic {Enfield} rifles.
e.zh: 这家店出售经典恩菲尔德步枪的零件。

e.en: Tabloid headlines often {enflame} public outrage online.
e.zh: 小报标题常常在网上煽动公众的愤怒。

e.en: Spicy food can {enflame} a sensitive stomach.
e.zh: 辛辣食物会刺激敏感的胃。

e.en: She let the warm blanket {enfold} her tired shoulders.
e.zh: 她让温暖的毯子裹住自己疲惫的双肩。

e.en: Mist began to {enfold} the entire valley at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,雾气开始笼罩整个山谷。

enforce.t: v. 执行；强制实施（法律、规则）

e.en: Schools must {enforce} their anti-bullying policies consistently.
e.zh: 学校必须始终如一地执行反霸凌政策。

e.en: It's hard to {enforce} a curfew on teenagers.
e.zh: 对青少年实施宵禁很难奏效。

e.en: The lawyer questioned the contract's {enforceability} in court.
e.zh: 律师质疑这份合同在法庭上的可执行性。

e.en: Online terms of service often have limited {enforceability}.
e.zh: 网上的服务条款通常可执行性有限。

e.en: A verbal agreement isn't always legally {enforceable}.
e.zh: 口头协议在法律上并不总是可执行的。

e.en: The clause must be clearly written to be {enforceable}.
e.zh: 该条款必须措辞清晰才具有可执行性。

e.en: The mask mandate was strictly {enforced} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 疫情期间口罩规定得到了严格执行。

e.en: Heavy rain led to an {enforced} delay of the match.
e.zh: 大雨导致比赛被迫延期。

e.en: Stricter {enforcement} of speeding laws reduced highway accidents.
e.zh: 对超速法规的更严格执行减少了高速公路事故。

e.en: The agency lacks the budget for proper {enforcement}.
e.zh: 该机构缺乏足够的预算来进行有效执法。

enforcements.t: n. enforcement 的复数；强制执行措施

e.en: Different states have different tax {enforcements} for online sellers.
e.zh: 各州对网络卖家的税务执法标准各不相同。

e.en: Recent {enforcements} targeted illegal short-term rentals.
e.zh: 近期的执法行动针对的是非法短租。

enforcer.t: n. 执法者；强制执行者

e.en: He acts as the team's {enforcer} on the ice rink.
e.zh: 他在冰场上充当球队的硬汉打手。

e.en: The mob boss sent his {enforcer} to collect the debt.
e.zh: 黑帮头目派他的打手去讨债。

enforces.t: v. enforce 的第三人称单数；强制实施

e.en: The app {enforces} two-factor authentication for all users.
e.zh: 该应用对所有用户强制启用双重验证。

e.en: This park strictly {enforces} its no-littering rule.
e.zh: 这个公园严格执行禁止乱扔垃圾的规定。

enforcing.t: v. enforce 的现在分词；强制实施

e.en: Police are {enforcing} the new noise ordinance downtown.
e.zh: 警方正在市中心执行新的噪音条例。

e.en: The moderator is {enforcing} community guidelines on the forum.
e.zh: 版主正在论坛上执行社区准则。

e.en: The amendment aimed to {enfranchise} young voters everywhere.
e.zh: 该修正案旨在赋予各地年轻人选举权。

e.en: Reformers fought to {enfranchise} women in the early 1900s.
e.zh: 改革者在20世纪初争取赋予妇女选举权。

enfranchised.t: adj. 有选举权的；被解放的

e.en: Women were finally {enfranchised} in the United States in 1920.
e.zh: 美国妇女终于在1920年获得了选举权。

e.en: Newly {enfranchised} citizens lined up to vote at dawn.
e.zh: 刚获得选举权的公民黎明时就排队投票。

enfranchisement.t: n. 选举权的赋予；解放

e.en: The {enfranchisement} of former colonies took decades to complete.
e.zh: 前殖民地获得选举权花了几十年才完成。

e.en: Universal {enfranchisement} remains a goal in many countries.
e.zh: 普选权在许多国家仍是奋斗目标。

eng.t:
n. 工程（engineering 的缩写）
n. 英格兰（England 的缩写）

e.en: She majored in mechanical {eng} at a top university.
e.zh: 她在一所顶尖大学主修机械工程。

e.en: The job posting requires a degree in software {eng}.
e.zh: 这份招聘要求拥有软件工程学位。

engage.t:
v. 参与；吸引（注意）
v. 雇用；交战

e.en: Good teachers know how to {engage} bored students.
e.zh: 优秀的老师懂得如何吸引无聊的学生。

e.en: Brands use short videos to {engage} younger audiences.
e.zh: 品牌通过短视频来吸引年轻观众。

engaged.t:
adj. 忙碌的；已订婚的
adj. 占线的；参与中的

e.en: They got {engaged} after dating for three years.
e.zh: 他们恋爱三年后订婚了。

e.en: Students were fully {engaged} during the interactive lesson.
e.zh: 学生们在互动课上全神贯注。

engagement.t:
n. 参与度；约定
n. 订婚；交战

e.en: Our latest post got record {engagement} on Instagram.
e.zh: 我们最新的帖子在Instagram上获得了创纪录的互动量。

e.en: She announced her {engagement} on social media yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天在社交媒体上宣布了订婚消息。

engagements.t: n. engagement 的复数；约会、参与活动

e.en: The author has several speaking {engagements} this month.
e.zh: 这位作者本月有好几场演讲活动。

e.en: The general reviewed his troops' recent battle {engagements}.
e.zh: 将军回顾了部队最近的几次交战。

engages.t: v. engage 的第三人称单数；参与、吸引

e.en: The podcast {engages} listeners with thoughtful interviews.
e.zh: 这档播客通过深度访谈吸引听众。

e.en: This gear {engages} automatically when you press the pedal.
e.zh: 踩下踏板时这个齿轮会自动啮合。

engaging.t: adj. 吸引人的；有魅力的

e.en: The teacher has a warm and {engaging} classroom style.
e.zh: 这位老师的课堂风格温暖而吸引人。

e.en: Short-form videos are especially {engaging} for Gen Z.
e.zh: 短视频对Z世代特别有吸引力。

engagingly.t: adv. 迷人地；引人入胜地

e.en: She {engagingly} described her travels to the captivated audience.
e.zh: 她引人入胜地向着迷的观众讲述她的旅行经历。

e.en: The host spoke {engagingly} about science on the podcast.
e.zh: 主持人在播客中生动有趣地谈论科学。

engender.t: v. 引起；产生（情感、状况）

e.en: Honest leadership tends to {engender} trust among employees.
e.zh: 诚实的领导往往能在员工中培养信任。

e.en: Public art can {engender} a stronger sense of community.
e.zh: 公共艺术可以激发更强的社区归属感。

engendered.t: v. engender 的过去式；引起、产生

e.en: The new policy {engendered} fierce debate across the country.
e.zh: 新政策在全国范围内引发了激烈的辩论。

e.en: Her kindness {engendered} loyalty in everyone she worked with.
e.zh: 她的善良让每位共事者都心生忠诚。

engendering.t: v. engender 的现在分词；正在引起

e.en: The film succeeds in {engendering} sympathy for its flawed hero.
e.zh: 这部电影成功地让观众同情其有缺陷的主角。

e.en: Transparent communication is key to {engendering} workplace trust.
e.zh: 透明的沟通是建立职场信任的关键。

engenders.t: v. engender 的第三人称单数；引起

e.en: Poverty often {engenders} desperation and short-term thinking.
e.zh: 贫困往往催生绝望与短视的思维。

e.en: Good design {engenders} confidence in the product.
e.zh: 优秀的设计能让用户对产品产生信心。

engine.t:
n. 引擎；发动机
n. （搜索/游戏）引擎

e.en: The car's {engine} started smoothly on the cold morning.
e.zh: 汽车的引擎在寒冷的早晨顺利启动了。

e.en: Google's search {engine} returns billions of results daily.
e.zh: 谷歌的搜索引擎每天返回数十亿条结果。

engined.t: adj. 装有发动机的（多用作复合词，如 twin-engined）

e.en: They bought a twin-{engined} plane for the regional airline.
e.zh: 他们为这家支线航空公司购入了一架双引擎飞机。

e.en: The single-{engined} aircraft landed safely at the small airfield.
e.zh: 那架单引擎飞机安全降落在小型机场。

engineer.t:
n. 工程师
v. 设计、策划

e.en: She works as a software {engineer} at a startup.
e.zh: 她在一家创业公司担任软件工程师。

e.en: The team will {engineer} a clever solution to the bug.
e.zh: 团队将巧妙地设计出解决这个漏洞的方案。

engineered.t:
adj. 经过设计的
v. engineer 的过去式

e.en: The bridge was {engineered} to withstand strong earthquakes.
e.zh: 这座桥被设计成能承受强烈地震。

e.en: Critics said the merger was {engineered} behind closed doors.
e.zh: 批评人士称这次合并是在暗中策划的。

engineering.t:
n. 工程；工程学
v. 设计、策划

e.en: He studied mechanical {engineering} at a top university.
e.zh: 他在一所顶尖大学学习机械工程。

e.en: The {engineering} team shipped the new feature last week.
e.zh: 工程团队上周发布了这项新功能。

engineers.t:
n. engineer 的复数
v. 设计、策划（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our company hires {engineers} from around the world.
e.zh: 我们公司在全球招聘工程师。

e.en: She {engineers} clean water systems for rural villages.
e.zh: 她为乡村设计净水系统。

engines.t: n. engine 的复数；发动机；引擎

e.en: Modern jet {engines} are remarkably fuel-efficient.
e.zh: 现代喷气发动机的燃油效率非常高。

e.en: Search {engines} have transformed how we find information.
e.zh: 搜索引擎彻底改变了我们获取信息的方式。

england.t: n. 英格兰（英国主要组成部分）

e.en: She spent the summer traveling around {England} by train.
e.zh: 她整个夏天乘火车在英格兰各地旅行。

e.en: {England} won the cricket match by a narrow margin.
e.zh: 英格兰队以微弱优势赢得了那场板球比赛。

e.en: As a New {Englander}, he loves clam chowder and autumn leaves.
e.zh: 作为一个新英格兰人,他喜爱蛤蜊浓汤和秋叶。

e.en: The old {Englander} reminisced about his childhood in Yorkshire.
e.zh: 那位老英格兰人回忆起他在约克郡的童年。

english.t:
n. 英语
adj. 英国的

e.en: She speaks {English} fluently after living in London for years.
e.zh: 在伦敦住了多年后,她英语说得很流利。

e.en: The cafe serves a traditional {English} breakfast every morning.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆每天早晨供应传统英式早餐。

e.en: The {Englishman} ordered tea with milk and a scone.
e.zh: 那位英国人点了加奶的茶和一块司康饼。

e.en: An {Englishman} abroad often craves a proper cup of tea.
e.zh: 身在国外的英国人常常想喝上一杯正宗的茶。

e.en: Two {Englishmen} were chatting loudly at the next table.
e.zh: 两位英国人在邻桌大声聊天。

e.en: Several {Englishmen} founded the cricket club in 1875.
e.zh: 几位英国人于1875年创立了这家板球俱乐部。

e.en: The novel captures a quiet sense of {Englishness} in rural life.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉到了乡村生活中静谧的英式韵味。

e.en: Tea and queueing are stereotypes of {Englishness}.
e.zh: 喝茶与排队是关于英国人特质的刻板印象。

e.en: The {Englishwoman} settled in Paris and opened a bookshop.
e.zh: 那位英国女士定居巴黎,开了一家书店。

e.en: An elegant {Englishwoman} greeted us at the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 一位优雅的英国女士在酒店门口迎接我们。

e.en: Heavy rain can {engorge} small streams within hours.
e.zh: 暴雨能在几小时内让小溪暴涨。

e.en: Mosquitoes {engorge} themselves on blood before laying eggs.
e.zh: 蚊子在产卵前会吸饱血液。

e.en: The river was {engorged} after three days of storms.
e.zh: 经过三天的暴风雨,河水暴涨了。

e.en: The tick had become visibly {engorged} with blood.
e.zh: 那只蜱虫明显已经吸饱了血。

e.en: New mothers sometimes experience painful breast {engorgement}.
e.zh: 新妈妈有时会经历令人疼痛的乳房胀痛。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {engorgement} of the patient's veins.
e.zh: 医生密切观察患者血管的充血情况。

e.en: Coaches try to {engrain} good habits in young athletes early.
e.zh: 教练们努力尽早把良好习惯灌输给年轻运动员。

e.en: Schools should {engrain} a love of reading in children.
e.zh: 学校应当把热爱阅读深植于孩子心中。

e.en: Scientists believe each memory leaves an {engram} in the brain.
e.zh: 科学家认为每段记忆都会在大脑中留下记忆痕迹。

e.en: Researchers traced the {engram} of fear to specific neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员将恐惧的记忆痕迹追溯到特定神经元。

e.en: The jeweler will {engrave} your initials on the ring for free.
e.zh: 珠宝商会免费在戒指上刻上你的姓名首字母。

e.en: They asked the artist to {engrave} a quote on the trophy.
e.zh: 他们请艺术家在奖杯上刻一句名言。

e.en: Her name was {engraved} on a small brass plaque.
e.zh: 她的名字被刻在一块小小的铜牌上。

e.en: The watch was {engraved} with the date of their wedding.
e.zh: 那只手表上刻着他们婚礼的日期。

e.en: The skilled {engraver} carved tiny letters onto the silver cup.
e.zh: 那位熟练的雕刻师在银杯上刻下了细小的字母。

e.en: My grandfather was an {engraver} for a printing company.
e.zh: 我祖父曾在一家印刷公司当雕刻师。

engraving.t:
n. 雕刻品；版画
v. 雕刻

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {engraving} from the 17th century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅罕见的十七世纪版画。

e.en: He spent hours {engraving} delicate patterns onto the wood.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时在木头上雕刻精致的花纹。

e.en: A good mystery novel can completely {engross} me for hours.
e.zh: 一本好的悬疑小说能让我入迷好几个小时。

e.en: Video games tend to {engross} children more than homework.
e.zh: 电子游戏比作业更容易让孩子们入迷。

e.en: She was so {engrossed} in her book she missed her stop.
e.zh: 她太沉浸在书里,以至于错过了下车的站点。

e.en: The kids sat {engrossed} in the puppet show all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都全神贯注地看着木偶戏。

engrosses.t: v. 使全神贯注（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new fantasy series {engrosses} readers from the first chapter.
e.zh: 这部新奇幻系列从第一章就让读者着迷。

e.en: Anything tech-related instantly {engrosses} my younger brother.
e.zh: 任何与科技有关的东西都能立刻吸引我弟弟。

e.en: The documentary was so {engrossing} I forgot to eat dinner.
e.zh: 那部纪录片太吸引人,我都忘了吃晚饭。

e.en: She wrote an {engrossing} thriller set in modern Tokyo.
e.zh: 她写了一部以现代东京为背景的扣人心弦的惊悚小说。

e.en: His total {engrossment} in the puzzle made him forget the time.
e.zh: 他完全沉迷于拼图,以致忘了时间。

e.en: Her {engrossment} in painting started in early childhood.
e.zh: 她对绘画的痴迷始于幼年时期。

e.en: Floodwaters threatened to {engulf} the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 洪水眼看就要淹没整个街区。

e.en: Wildfires can {engulf} a hillside in a matter of minutes.
e.zh: 山火能在几分钟内吞没整片山坡。

e.en: The cabin was quickly {engulfed} in flames after the lightning strike.
e.zh: 那间小木屋在雷击后迅速被大火吞没。

e.en: She was {engulfed} by a wave of grief at the funeral.
e.zh: 在葬礼上,她被一阵悲痛淹没。

e.en: The fog was slowly {engulfing} the entire valley.
e.zh: 浓雾正慢慢地笼罩整个山谷。

e.en: An {engulfing} sense of loneliness hit him after she left.
e.zh: 她离开后,一种铺天盖地的孤独感袭来。

engulfs.t: v. 吞没（第三人称单数）

e.en: Panic {engulfs} the market whenever rumors of layoffs spread.
e.zh: 每当裁员传闻扩散,恐慌就会笼罩市场。

e.en: The tide quickly {engulfs} the rocks at sunset.
e.zh: 潮水在日落时分迅速淹没了那些岩石。

e.en: A few herbs can really {enhance} the flavor of the soup.
e.zh: 几味香草确实能提升这道汤的风味。

e.en: The new update will {enhance} battery life on older phones.
e.zh: 新的更新会延长旧款手机的电池续航。

e.en: The {enhanced} camera takes much sharper photos at night.
e.zh: 升级后的相机在夜间能拍出更清晰的照片。

e.en: Her resume was {enhanced} by two years of overseas experience.
e.zh: 她的简历因两年的海外经验而更具竞争力。

e.en: Users requested a small UI {enhancement} in the next release.
e.zh: 用户希望在下个版本中对界面做小幅改进。

e.en: The performance {enhancement} cut load times in half.
e.zh: 这次性能优化把加载时间缩短了一半。

e.en: Garlic is a wonderful flavor {enhancer} in almost any dish.
e.zh: 大蒜在几乎任何菜肴里都是绝佳的风味提升剂。

e.en: This serum acts as a natural skin {enhancer}.
e.zh: 这款精华液是天然的肌肤提亮剂。

enhances.t: v. 提升；增强（第三人称单数）

e.en: Regular exercise {enhances} both mood and concentration.
e.zh: 规律运动能改善情绪和专注力。

e.en: Soft lighting {enhances} the cozy feel of the cafe.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光让咖啡馆显得更加温馨。

e.en: The team is focused on {enhancing} the user experience.
e.zh: 团队正专注于优化用户体验。

e.en: She uses photo-{enhancing} apps before posting on Instagram.
e.zh: 她在发布到 Instagram 前会使用修图美化应用。

e.en: His sudden disappearance remains a complete {enigma} to police.
e.zh: 他的突然失踪对警方来说仍是一个完全的谜。

e.en: That quiet new coworker is a bit of an {enigma}.
e.zh: 那位安静的新同事让人有点摸不透。

e.en: She gave an {enigmatic} smile and refused to explain further.
e.zh: 她露出神秘的微笑,拒绝再多作解释。

e.en: The painting's {enigmatic} subject has fascinated critics for decades.
e.zh: 这幅画神秘的主题让评论家们着迷了几十年。

enigmatically.t: adv. 神秘地；令人费解地

e.en: He smiled {enigmatically} when asked about his next project.
e.zh: 被问到下一个项目时,他神秘地笑了笑。

e.en: She answered {enigmatically}, leaving everyone more confused.
e.zh: 她的回答含糊神秘,让所有人更加困惑。

e.en: The poet uses {enjambment} to keep the rhythm flowing naturally.
e.zh: 这位诗人用跨行连续来保持节奏自然流畅。

e.en: Notice the {enjambment} between lines two and three.
e.zh: 注意第二行和第三行之间的跨行连续。

e.en: The judge may {enjoin} the company from selling the product.
e.zh: 法官可能会下令禁止该公司销售这款产品。

e.en: Doctors {enjoin} patients to quit smoking before surgery.
e.zh: 医生叮嘱患者在手术前戒烟。

e.en: I really {enjoy} long walks in the park on weekends.
e.zh: 我非常喜欢周末在公园里散步。

e.en: Did you {enjoy} the movie we watched last night?
e.zh: 你喜欢我们昨晚看的那部电影吗?

e.en: We had a thoroughly {enjoyable} dinner with old friends.
e.zh: 我们和老朋友们度过了一顿非常愉快的晚餐。

e.en: Learning a new language can be surprisingly {enjoyable}.
e.zh: 学习一门新语言可能会出乎意料地有趣。

e.en: The afternoon passed {enjoyably} with friends and good coffee.
e.zh: 下午和朋友们在一起，愉快地度过，还有好咖啡。

e.en: She spent the weekend {enjoyably} hiking in the mountains.
e.zh: 她愉快地在山里徒步，度过了整个周末。

e.en: I really {enjoyed} the new movie last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚非常喜欢那部新电影。

e.en: The kids {enjoyed} every minute of the birthday party.
e.zh: 孩子们尽情享受了生日派对的每一分钟。

e.en: She is {enjoying} her new job at the hospital.
e.zh: 她很享受在医院的新工作。

e.en: We are {enjoying} a quiet dinner on the balcony.
e.zh: 我们正在阳台上享用一顿安静的晚餐。

e.en: Reading novels brings her endless {enjoyment} on rainy days.
e.zh: 读小说在雨天给她带来无尽的乐趣。

e.en: He plays guitar purely for personal {enjoyment}, not money.
e.zh: 他弹吉他纯粹是为了自娱自乐，不为赚钱。

enjoys.t: v. 享受（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandmother {enjoys} gardening every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 我奶奶每周六早上都喜欢侍弄花园。

e.en: He {enjoys} a strong reputation among his colleagues.
e.zh: 他在同事中享有很高的声誉。

e.en: Click the icon to {enlarge} the image on screen.
e.zh: 点击图标即可放大屏幕上的图片。

e.en: The company plans to {enlarge} its overseas market share.
e.zh: 公司计划扩大其海外市场份额。

e.en: The doctor said his heart was slightly {enlarged}.
e.zh: 医生说他的心脏有些肿大。

e.en: She {enlarged} the photo and framed it for the wall.
e.zh: 她把照片放大后装框挂在墙上。

e.en: The {enlargement} of the airport will take three years.
e.zh: 机场的扩建将耗时三年。

e.en: He ordered an {enlargement} of his favorite wedding photo.
e.zh: 他订做了一张最喜欢的婚礼照片的放大版。

e.en: He still uses an old photo {enlarger} in his darkroom.
e.zh: 他在暗房里还在用一台旧的照片放大机。

e.en: The vintage {enlarger} sits on a shelf gathering dust.
e.zh: 那台老式放大机放在架子上积着灰。

e.en: The shop is {enlarging} its menu to include vegan options.
e.zh: 那家店正在扩充菜单，加入纯素选项。

e.en: They are {enlarging} the kitchen to fit a bigger fridge.
e.zh: 他们正在扩建厨房，以放下更大的冰箱。

e.en: Could you {enlighten} me about how the new system works?
e.zh: 你能给我讲讲新系统是怎么运作的吗？

e.en: A good teacher can {enlighten} students with simple examples.
e.zh: 好老师能用简单的例子启发学生。

e.en: His talk {enlightened} the audience about climate science.
e.zh: 他的演讲让听众对气候科学有了新的认识。

e.en: The company has fairly {enlightened} policies on remote work.
e.zh: 这家公司在远程办公方面有相当开明的政策。

e.en: The app will {encrypt} your messages end-to-end.
e.zh: 这款应用会对你的消息进行端到端加密。

e.en: Always {encrypt} sensitive files before uploading them.
e.zh: 上传敏感文件之前,务必先加密。

e.en: All passwords are stored in an {encrypted} database.
e.zh: 所有密码都保存在加密的数据库中。

e.en: She sent the contract through an {encrypted} channel.
e.zh: 她通过加密通道发送了合同。

e.en: Strong {encryption} protects user data from hackers.
e.zh: 强加密能保护用户数据免受黑客攻击。

e.en: The chat uses end-to-end {encryption} by default.
e.zh: 该聊天默认使用端到端加密。

enculturation.t: n. 文化习得；文化适应

e.en: Childhood {enculturation} shapes how we view the world.
e.zh: 童年的文化熏陶塑造了我们看待世界的方式。

e.en: Language is central to the process of {enculturation}.
e.zh: 语言是文化习得过程中的核心。

e.en: Heavy luggage will only {encumber} you on the hike.
e.zh: 沉重的行李只会拖累你的徒步。

e.en: Don't {encumber} the report with unnecessary details.
e.zh: 不要让报告被无关的细节拖累。

encumbered.t: adj. 受阻的；背负负担的

e.en: She was {encumbered} with shopping bags on the subway.
e.zh: 她在地铁上被一堆购物袋累得不行。

e.en: The startup is {encumbered} by too much legacy code.
e.zh: 这家初创公司被过多的遗留代码所拖累。

encumbering.t: v. 妨碍（encumber 的现在分词）

e.en: Strict regulations are {encumbering} small businesses.
e.zh: 严格的监管正在拖累小企业。

e.en: She removed the {encumbering} jacket before running.
e.zh: 跑步前她脱下了碍事的外套。

encumbers.t: v. 妨碍（第三人称单数）

e.en: Bureaucracy {encumbers} every step of the approval process.
e.zh: 官僚主义阻碍着审批过程的每一步。

e.en: A heavy backpack {encumbers} climbers on steep trails.
e.zh: 沉重的背包让攀登者在陡峭路段举步维艰。

e.en: His old phone became an {encumbrance} during the trip.
e.zh: 他的旧手机在旅行中成了累赘。

e.en: The lawyer checked the property for any {encumbrance}.
e.zh: 律师检查了该房产是否有任何产权负担。

e.en: The deed lists no {encumbrances} on the land.
e.zh: 地契上显示该土地没有任何产权负担。

e.en: He travels light, free of unnecessary {encumbrances}.
e.zh: 他轻装出行,没有任何不必要的累赘。

encyclical.t:
n. 教皇通谕
adj. 传阅的

e.en: The Pope released a new {encyclical} on climate change.
e.zh: 教皇发布了一份关于气候变化的新通谕。

e.en: Her thesis analyzed the famous 1965 {encyclical}.
e.zh: 她的论文分析了著名的1965年通谕。

encyclopaedia.t: n. 百科全书（英式拼写）

e.en: He still keeps a printed {encyclopaedia} on the shelf.
e.zh: 他书架上还放着一套印刷版百科全书。

e.en: My grandfather was a walking {encyclopaedia} of jazz.
e.zh: 我祖父是一部活的爵士乐百科全书。

encyclopaedias.t: n. 百科全书（复数，英式）

e.en: Old {encyclopaedias} are being replaced by Wikipedia.
e.zh: 老式百科全书正被维基百科取代。

e.en: The library donated its outdated {encyclopaedias} last week.
e.zh: 图书馆上周捐出了那些过时的百科全书。

encyclopaedic.t: adj. 百科全书式的（英式）

e.en: She has an almost {encyclopaedic} knowledge of football.
e.zh: 她对足球有着近乎百科全书式的了解。

e.en: The website offers {encyclopaedic} coverage of birds.
e.zh: 该网站提供了百科全书式的鸟类资料。

e.en: Wikipedia is the world's largest online {encyclopedia}.
e.zh: 维基百科是世界上最大的在线百科全书。

e.en: As a kid, I read the entire animal {encyclopedia}.
e.zh: 小时候我把整本动物百科全书都读完了。

e.en: Old {encyclopedias} can still be useful for verified facts.
e.zh: 老旧的百科全书在查证事实上仍然有用。

e.en: Her parents bought a set of {encyclopedias} in 1990.
e.zh: 她父母在1990年买了一整套百科全书。

encyclopedic.t: adj. 百科全书式的；知识广博的

e.en: He has an {encyclopedic} memory for movie quotes.
e.zh: 他对电影台词有着百科全书式的记忆。

e.en: The app provides {encyclopedic} information on plants.
e.zh: 这款应用提供了百科全书式的植物资料。

end.t:
n. 末端；结尾
v. 结束

e.en: The movie's {end} left everyone in tears.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局让所有人都泪流满面。

e.en: Tap the button to {end} the video call.
e.zh: 点击按钮即可结束视频通话。

e.en: Texting while driving can {endanger} other people's lives.
e.zh: 开车时发短信可能危及他人的生命。

e.en: Pollution continues to {endanger} marine ecosystems.
e.zh: 污染持续威胁着海洋生态系统。

e.en: Pandas are no longer classified as {endangered} species.
e.zh: 大熊猫已不再被列为濒危物种。

e.en: His careless tweet {endangered} the entire negotiation.
e.zh: 他那条不经意的推文危及了整个谈判。

e.en: Speeding is {endangering} pedestrians in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 超速行驶正威胁着这一带行人的安全。

e.en: He was charged with {endangering} a child.
e.zh: 他被指控危害儿童。

e.en: He pleaded guilty to reckless {endangerment} of others.
e.zh: 他承认了对他人构成鲁莽危害的罪名。

e.en: Habitat loss leads to the {endangerment} of many species.
e.zh: 栖息地的丧失导致许多物种濒危。

endangers.t: v. 危及（第三人称单数）

e.en: Climate change {endangers} coastal cities worldwide.
e.zh: 气候变化威胁着全球的沿海城市。

e.en: Skipping vaccines {endangers} the entire community.
e.zh: 不接种疫苗会危及整个社区。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {endarterectomy} to clear the artery.
e.zh: 外科医生做了动脉内膜切除术以疏通血管。

e.en: Recovery from an {endarterectomy} usually takes a few weeks.
e.zh: 动脉内膜切除术后通常需要几周才能恢复。

e.en: His kindness will {endear} him to his new coworkers.
e.zh: 他的善良会让新同事们喜欢上他。

e.en: Honest mistakes can sometimes {endear} a leader to staff.
e.zh: 真诚的失误有时反而能让领导赢得员工的喜爱。

endearing.t: adj. 惹人喜爱的；讨喜的

e.en: The puppy's clumsy walk is absolutely {endearing}.
e.zh: 小狗笨拙的走路样子真是惹人喜爱。

e.en: She has an {endearing} habit of humming while working.
e.zh: 她有个讨人喜欢的习惯,工作时会哼歌。

e.en: He smiled {endearingly} at his sleeping daughter.
e.zh: 他温柔可爱地看着熟睡的女儿微笑。

e.en: The robot waved {endearingly} at the curious children.
e.zh: 机器人惹人怜爱地向好奇的孩子们挥手。

e.en: "Honey" is a common {endearment} between couples.
e.zh: "亲爱的"是情侣间常用的爱称。

e.en: She whispered an {endearment} into the baby's ear.
e.zh: 她在宝宝耳边低声说了句昵称。

endeavor.t:
v. 努力尝试
n. 努力；事业

e.en: Launching a startup is a risky {endeavor}.
e.zh: 创办公司是一项有风险的事业。

e.en: We {endeavor} to ship every order within 24 hours.
e.zh: 我们努力在24小时内发出每一份订单。

endeavors.t: v./n. 努力（第三人称单数/复数）

e.en: Wishing you the best in all your future {endeavors}.
e.zh: 祝你未来一切顺利。

e.en: She {endeavors} to write a thousand words every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上努力写一千字。

endeavour.t:
v. 努力（英式拼写）
n. 努力

e.en: The team's {endeavour} to reach the summit failed.
e.zh: 团队登顶的努力失败了。

e.en: We {endeavour} to reply to all emails within a day.
e.zh: 我们努力在一天内回复所有邮件。

endeavours.t: v./n. 努力（英式，复数形式）

e.en: His latest {endeavours} include a podcast and a book.
e.zh: 他最近的项目包括一档播客和一本书。

e.en: She {endeavours} to learn one new word every day.
e.zh: 她努力每天学一个新单词。

e.en: The meeting {ended} earlier than expected today.
e.zh: 今天的会议比预期早结束了。

e.en: Their friendship {ended} after a silly argument.
e.zh: 他们的友谊因为一次无聊的争吵而结束了。

endemic.t: adj. 地方性的；（疾病）流行的

e.en: Corruption is {endemic} in some local government offices.
e.zh: 在一些地方政府机构里,腐败现象屡见不鲜。

e.en: Koalas are {endemic} to Australia.
e.zh: 考拉是澳大利亚的特有物种。

e.en: Madagascar is famous for its high level of {endemism}.
e.zh: 马达加斯加以其极高的物种特有性而闻名。

e.en: Island {endemism} fascinates evolutionary biologists.
e.zh: 岛屿特有现象令进化生物学家着迷。

e.en: That goal was a real game-{ender} in the final minute.
e.zh: 那个进球真是终场前的绝杀。

e.en: Her witty comment was the perfect conversation-{ender}.
e.zh: 她机智的评论完美地结束了那场对话。

e.en: The chess match reached a tense {endgame} after hours of play.
e.zh: 经过数小时对弈，这盘棋进入了紧张的残局。

e.en: Critics wonder what the company's real {endgame} is.
e.zh: 评论家好奇这家公司真正的最终目的是什么。

e.en: The movie has a surprising {ending} that nobody saw coming.
e.zh: 这部电影有一个出人意料的结局。

e.en: I love stories with a happy {ending}.
e.zh: 我喜欢有美好结局的故事。

e.en: Korean verb {endings} change based on politeness level.
e.zh: 韩语动词词尾会根据敬语程度而变化。

e.en: She prefers films with ambiguous {endings}.
e.zh: 她喜欢结局开放的电影。

e.en: The salad had crisp {endive} and toasted walnuts.
e.zh: 沙拉里有爽脆的菊苣和烤核桃。

e.en: Belgian {endive} pairs well with blue cheese.
e.zh: 比利时菊苣和蓝纹奶酪很搭。

endless.t: adj. 无尽的；没完没了的

e.en: The meeting felt {endless} and nobody wanted to be there.
e.zh: 那场会议没完没了，没人想待着。

e.en: Streaming services offer {endless} options to watch.
e.zh: 流媒体平台提供看不完的内容选择。

e.en: The toddler asked questions {endlessly} during the car ride.
e.zh: 小孩在车上没完没了地问问题。

e.en: He scrolled {endlessly} through social media before bed.
e.zh: 他睡前不停地刷社交媒体。

e.en: The {endlessness} of the desert made her feel small.
e.zh: 沙漠的无边无际让她感到自己很渺小。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {endlessness} of the universe.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论宇宙是否无穷无尽。

endnote.t: n. 尾注（文档末尾的注释）

e.en: Each citation appears as a numbered {endnote} at the back.
e.zh: 每条引用在书末以编号尾注的形式出现。

e.en: Add an {endnote} explaining the data source.
e.zh: 加一条尾注说明数据来源。

e.en: The patient was hospitalized with bacterial {endocarditis}.
e.zh: 病人因细菌性心内膜炎住院。

e.en: Untreated {endocarditis} can damage the heart valves.
e.zh: 心内膜炎若不治疗会损害心脏瓣膜。

e.en: The thyroid is part of the {endocrine} system.
e.zh: 甲状腺是内分泌系统的一部分。

e.en: Stress can disrupt {endocrine} function in the body.
e.zh: 压力会扰乱体内的内分泌功能。

e.en: Her doctor referred her to an {endocrinologist} for diabetes care.
e.zh: 医生把她转诊给了内分泌科医生看糖尿病。

e.en: The {endocrinologist} adjusted his thyroid medication.
e.zh: 内分泌科医生调整了他的甲状腺药物。

e.en: She specialized in {endocrinology} after medical school.
e.zh: 她医学院毕业后专攻内分泌学。

e.en: The hospital's {endocrinology} department treats hormone disorders.
e.zh: 医院的内分泌科治疗激素紊乱疾病。

endogamous.t: adj. 内婚制的；同族通婚的

e.en: The community remained {endogamous} for generations.
e.zh: 这个社区世代族内通婚。

e.en: Some castes practice strictly {endogamous} marriage rules.
e.zh: 有些种姓严格实行族内婚规则。

e.en: Cultural {endogamy} helped preserve the group's traditions.
e.zh: 族内通婚帮助这个群体保留了传统。

e.en: Anthropologists study {endogamy} in isolated villages.
e.zh: 人类学家研究偏远村庄的族内通婚现象。

enlightening.t: adj. 有启发的；令人开窍的

e.en: The documentary was both entertaining and {enlightening}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片既有趣又发人深省。

e.en: I had an {enlightening} conversation with my mentor today.
e.zh: 今天我和导师进行了一次很有启发的谈话。

enlightenment.t: n. 启发；启蒙（思想运动）

e.en: Many travelers visit India seeking spiritual {enlightenment}.
e.zh: 许多旅行者前往印度寻求心灵的觉悟。

e.en: The book offers real {enlightenment} on personal finance.
e.zh: 这本书在个人理财方面给人真正的启迪。

enlist.t: v. 参军；争取（支持、帮助）

e.en: He decided to {enlist} in the navy after graduation.
e.zh: 他决定毕业后参军加入海军。

e.en: We need to {enlist} volunteers for the charity event.
e.zh: 我们需要为慈善活动招募志愿者。

e.en: Each new {enlistee} receives a uniform on the first day.
e.zh: 每位新兵第一天都会领到一套制服。

e.en: The {enlistee} signed a four-year contract with the army.
e.zh: 这名新兵与陆军签订了四年的合同。

e.en: His {enlistment} in the army surprised the whole family.
e.zh: 他参军入伍的决定让全家人都很吃惊。

e.en: The standard {enlistment} period is four years of service.
e.zh: 标准的服役期为四年。

e.en: A few jokes can {enliven} even the dullest meeting.
e.zh: 几个笑话能让最沉闷的会议也活跃起来。

e.en: Bright cushions {enliven} the otherwise plain living room.
e.zh: 几个亮色靠垫为原本朴素的客厅增添了生气。

enmesh.t: v. 使陷入；使纠缠其中

e.en: Don't let petty office politics {enmesh} you in drama.
e.zh: 别让那些办公室小斗争把你卷入是非中。

e.en: The scandal threatened to {enmesh} several senior officials.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻有可能牵连数位高级官员。

enmeshed.t: adj. 深陷其中的；被缠住的

e.en: He became deeply {enmeshed} in a complicated legal battle.
e.zh: 他深陷于一场错综复杂的法律纠纷中。

e.en: The startup got {enmeshed} in red tape for months.
e.zh: 这家创业公司被官僚程序缠了好几个月。

e.en: Therapists warn against unhealthy {enmeshment} between parents and kids.
e.zh: 心理治疗师警告父母与孩子间不健康的纠缠关系。

e.en: Her {enmeshment} in family drama drained her energy.
e.zh: 她深陷家庭纠纷之中，耗尽了精力。

e.en: There is long-standing {enmity} between the two neighboring villages.
e.zh: 两个相邻村庄之间有着长久的敌意。

e.en: His harsh words created lasting {enmity} among the team.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话语在团队中造成了持久的敌意。

enniskillen.t: n. 恩尼斯基林（北爱尔兰城镇）

e.en: We spent a quiet weekend exploring {Enniskillen} in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 我们在北爱尔兰的恩尼斯基林安静地度过了一个周末。

e.en: The old castle in {Enniskillen} attracts many summer tourists.
e.zh: 恩尼斯基林的古堡每年夏天都吸引许多游客。

e.en: Acts of kindness can truly {ennoble} the human spirit.
e.zh: 善举能真正提升人的精神境界。

e.en: The king chose to {ennoble} the loyal general after victory.
e.zh: 国王在胜利后决定册封那位忠诚的将军为贵族。

ennobling.t:
adj. 使人高尚的
v. ennoble 的现在分词

e.en: Volunteer work can be a deeply {ennobling} experience.
e.zh: 做志愿者可以是一种使人心灵升华的体验。

e.en: She found teaching children to be truly {ennobling} work.
e.zh: 她觉得教孩子是真正令人崇高的工作。

e.en: A sense of {ennui} settled over him during the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天里，一种倦怠感笼罩着他。

e.en: Endless meetings filled the office with quiet {ennui}.
e.zh: 无休止的会议让办公室弥漫着无聊的气氛。

e.en: Brian {Eno} pioneered ambient music in the 1970s.
e.zh: 布赖恩·伊诺在七十年代开创了氛围音乐流派。

e.en: My uncle takes {Eno} salts whenever he has indigestion.
e.zh: 我叔叔每次消化不良就服用伊诺胃药盐。

e.en: Add some {enoki} mushrooms to the hot pot for flavor.
e.zh: 在火锅里加些金针菇会更香。

e.en: She topped the ramen with fresh {enoki} and scallions.
e.zh: 她在拉面上铺了新鲜金针菇和葱花。

e.en: He slowly grasped the {enormity} of the mistake he made.
e.zh: 他慢慢意识到自己所犯错误的严重性。

e.en: The {enormity} of the disaster left everyone speechless.
e.zh: 这场灾难的巨大规模让所有人都说不出话来。

e.en: The new shopping mall has an {enormous} parking lot.
e.zh: 新购物中心有一个超大的停车场。

e.en: Raising a child takes an {enormous} amount of patience.
e.zh: 养育一个孩子需要极大的耐心。

e.en: Her cooking has improved {enormously} over the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年里她的厨艺提高了非常多。

e.en: The team benefited {enormously} from the new training program.
e.zh: 团队从新的培训项目中获益巨大。

enough.t:
adj. 足够的
adv. 足够地

e.en: We have {enough} food in the fridge for the weekend.
e.zh: 冰箱里的食物够我们吃一个周末了。

e.en: That's {enough} complaining—let's get back to work.
e.zh: 抱怨够了，咱们继续干活吧。

e.en: Please {enquire} at the front desk about the missing package.
e.zh: 请到前台询问那个丢失的包裹。

e.en: I'd like to {enquire} whether the room is still available.
e.zh: 我想问一下那个房间是否还可以入住。

e.en: She {enquired} about the price before ordering anything.
e.zh: 她在点餐之前先问了价格。

e.en: He politely {enquired} after my mother's health.
e.zh: 他礼貌地问候了我母亲的健康状况。

e.en: The hotel staff treats every {enquirer} with patience and respect.
e.zh: 酒店员工对每位询问者都耐心又尊重。

e.en: An anonymous {enquirer} called asking about the missing dog.
e.zh: 一位匿名的询问者打电话询问那只走失的狗。

enquires.t: v. enquire 的第三人称单数

e.en: He often {enquires} about job openings at local cafes.
e.zh: 他经常打听本地咖啡馆的招聘信息。

e.en: She {enquires} after her former teacher whenever they meet.
e.zh: 她每次见面都会问候她以前的老师。

e.en: Please direct all {enquiries} to our customer service team.
e.zh: 所有咨询请联系我们的客服团队。

e.en: The hotel received many {enquiries} after the article was published.
e.zh: 那篇文章发表后，酒店收到了许多咨询。

e.en: Children have naturally {enquiring} minds about the world.
e.zh: 孩子们对世界天生有着探究的好奇心。

e.en: She is {enquiring} about flights to Tokyo next week.
e.zh: 她在咨询下周飞往东京的航班。

e.en: He glanced at her {enquiringly} when she stayed silent.
e.zh: 她沉默不语时，他用询问的目光看了她一眼。

e.en: The dog tilted its head {enquiringly} at the strange noise.
e.zh: 听到怪声，狗好奇地歪着头看过去。

e.en: I sent an {enquiry} email but haven't received any reply.
e.zh: 我发了一封咨询邮件，但还没收到回复。

e.en: The official {enquiry} into the accident lasted six months.
e.zh: 对这起事故的正式调查持续了六个月。

e.en: Loud chewing seems to {enrage} her more than anything.
e.zh: 大声咀嚼似乎比什么都更能惹她生气。

e.en: The unfair ruling will surely {enrage} many longtime fans.
e.zh: 这个不公正的判罚一定会激怒众多老球迷。

e.en: The driver was {enraged} when someone scratched his new car.
e.zh: 司机看到有人划了他的新车，气得不行。

e.en: His rude comment {enraged} everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的话激怒了餐桌上的每一个人。

e.en: Her singing never fails to {enrapture} the entire audience.
e.zh: 她的歌声总能让全场观众如痴如醉。

e.en: The mountain views {enrapture} every visitor at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时的山景让每位游客都心醉神迷。

e.en: The kids sat {enraptured} as the magician performed his tricks.
e.zh: 魔术师表演时，孩子们看得入了迷。

e.en: She was {enraptured} by the orchestra's powerful performance.
e.zh: 她被乐团充满力量的演奏深深陶醉。

e.en: Travel can really {enrich} your understanding of other cultures.
e.zh: 旅行真的能丰富你对其他文化的理解。

e.en: They add vitamins to {enrich} the breakfast cereal.
e.zh: 他们添加维生素来丰富早餐麦片的营养。

enriched.t: adj. 浓缩的；富集的；强化的

e.en: Her new friendships have {enriched} her life enormously.
e.zh: 她新结交的朋友极大地丰富了她的生活。

e.en: This bread is made with {enriched} flour and extra fiber.
e.zh: 这种面包是用强化面粉和额外纤维做的。

enriches.t: v. enrich 的第三人称单数

e.en: Reading widely {enriches} both vocabulary and imagination.
e.zh: 广泛阅读能丰富词汇量也能丰富想象力。

e.en: Volunteering {enriches} your resume and your soul alike.
e.zh: 做志愿者既能丰富简历，也能滋养心灵。

enriching.t:
adj. 使人充实的
v. enrich 的现在分词

e.en: Studying abroad was the most {enriching} year of my life.
e.zh: 出国留学是我人生中收获最丰富的一年。

e.en: They are {enriching} the soil with compost before planting.
e.zh: 他们在种植前用堆肥来改良土壤。

e.en: The school offers many {enrichment} programs after regular classes.
e.zh: 学校在正课之后提供许多兴趣拓展课程。

e.en: Music lessons provide great {enrichment} for young children.
e.zh: 音乐课对幼儿来说是一种很好的素质拓展。

enrol.t: v. 登记；入学；报名（= enroll）

e.en: You can {enrol} in the online course before Friday.
e.zh: 你可以在周五之前报名参加这门网课。

e.en: Parents must {enrol} their children at the local school.
e.zh: 家长必须为孩子在当地学校办理入学注册。

e.en: You can {enroll} in the online course for free.
e.zh: 你可以免费报名参加这门在线课程。

e.en: Parents must {enroll} their kids before September.
e.zh: 家长必须在九月前为孩子办理入学手续。

enrolled.t:
adj. 已注册的
v. enroll 的过去式

e.en: She {enrolled} in a Spanish class last month.
e.zh: 她上个月报名参加了一个西班牙语班。

e.en: Over 500 students {enrolled} in the new program.
e.zh: 超过500名学生注册了这个新项目。

e.en: Each {enrollee} receives a welcome email and login.
e.zh: 每位注册者都会收到欢迎邮件和登录信息。

e.en: The program tracks every {enrollee} for two years.
e.zh: 该项目会跟踪每位入学者长达两年。

e.en: They are {enrolling} new members until Friday.
e.zh: 他们将在周五前持续招募新会员。

e.en: I'm thinking about {enrolling} in graduate school.
e.zh: 我在考虑去读研究生。

e.en: University {enrollment} dropped slightly this year.
e.zh: 今年大学注册人数略有下降。

e.en: Open {enrollment} for health insurance ends tomorrow.
e.zh: 健康保险的公开报名明天截止。

enrolls.t: v. enroll 的第三人称单数

e.en: The platform {enrolls} thousands of users each week.
e.zh: 该平台每周吸引数千名用户注册。

e.en: She {enrolls} her son in a coding camp every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都给儿子报名编程营。

e.en: School {enrolment} numbers are released each spring.
e.zh: 学校招生人数每年春季公布。

e.en: Please complete the {enrolment} form online.
e.zh: 请在线填写报名表。

enrols.t: v. 注册；报名（enrol 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The academy {enrols} about 200 students annually.
e.zh: 该学院每年招收约200名学生。

e.en: He {enrols} in a new language course every January.
e.zh: 他每年一月都会报名一门新的语言课程。

ensconce.t: v. 安置；使舒适地坐下

e.en: She likes to {ensconce} herself in a corner with a book.
e.zh: 她喜欢蜷在角落里看书。

e.en: He'd {ensconce} himself by the fire on cold nights.
e.zh: 寒冷的夜晚他会窝在火炉旁。

ensconced.t: v. 舒适地安顿（ensconce 的过去式）

e.en: The cat was {ensconced} on the warmest cushion.
e.zh: 那只猫舒舒服服地窝在最暖和的垫子上。

e.en: He's firmly {ensconced} as the company's CEO.
e.zh: 他已稳稳地坐上了公司CEO的位置。

ensemble.t:
n. 整体；全套服装
n. 合奏团；合唱团

e.en: The jazz {ensemble} performs every Friday night.
e.zh: 这支爵士乐团每周五晚上演出。

e.en: She wore a stylish black {ensemble} to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一套时髦的黑色套装出席晚宴。

enshrine.t:
v. 铭记；珍藏
v. 供奉于神龛

e.en: The constitution will {enshrine} these basic rights.
e.zh: 宪法将把这些基本权利明确写入条文。

e.en: They wanted to {enshrine} her memory in a small chapel.
e.zh: 他们想把她的纪念安放在一座小教堂中。

e.en: His {enshrinement} in the hall of fame surprised no one.
e.zh: 他入选名人堂没让任何人感到意外。

e.en: The law's {enshrinement} of free speech is fundamental.
e.zh: 该法律对言论自由的明文确立至关重要。

e.en: Thick fog began to {enshroud} the harbor at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,浓雾开始笼罩港口。

e.en: Mystery continues to {enshroud} the ancient ruins.
e.zh: 这片古老的遗迹至今仍笼罩在神秘之中。

ensign.t:
n. （军舰）旗帜
n. 海军少尉

e.en: The ship raised its national {ensign} at sunrise.
e.zh: 军舰在日出时升起了国旗。

e.en: The young {ensign} reported for duty on deck.
e.zh: 那位年轻的少尉到甲板上报到。

e.en: Smartphones can {enslave} us if we're not careful.
e.zh: 如果不加小心,智能手机会让我们沦为奴隶。

e.en: Colonizers tried to {enslave} the local population.
e.zh: 殖民者曾企图奴役当地居民。

enslaved.t: v. 被奴役（enslave 的过去式）

e.en: The museum honors people who were {enslaved} here.
e.zh: 这座博物馆纪念曾在这里被奴役的人们。

e.en: He felt {enslaved} by his demanding schedule.
e.zh: 他感觉被繁重的日程束缚得喘不过气。

e.en: The book documents the history of {enslavement} in America.
e.zh: 这本书记录了美国奴隶制的历史。

e.en: Debt can lead to a kind of modern {enslavement}.
e.zh: 债务可能导致一种现代意义上的奴役。

e.en: Phishing emails {ensnare} thousands of users daily.
e.zh: 钓鱼邮件每天诱骗数千名用户上当。

e.en: Hunters use nets to {ensnare} small animals.
e.zh: 猎人用网捕捉小动物。

ensue.t: v. 接着发生；因而产生

e.en: If prices rise, protests are likely to {ensue}.
e.zh: 如果物价上涨,接踵而至的可能就是抗议。

e.en: A long debate will {ensue} after the announcement.
e.zh: 公告发布后将随之展开一场漫长的辩论。

ensued.t: v. 随后发生（ensue 的过去式）

e.en: A heated argument {ensued} between the two managers.
e.zh: 两位经理之间随即爆发了激烈的争论。

e.en: Chaos {ensued} when the power suddenly went out.
e.zh: 电源突然中断后,现场陷入一片混乱。

ensues.t: v. 随之发生（ensue 的第三人称单数）

e.en: When traffic stops, honking usually {ensues}.
e.zh: 交通一停下来,通常就会随之响起一片喇叭声。

e.en: A brief silence {ensues} before the audience claps.
e.zh: 在观众鼓掌前,会出现一阵短暂的沉默。

ensuing.t: adj. 接着发生的；随后的

e.en: In the {ensuing} weeks, sales doubled unexpectedly.
e.zh: 在随后的几周里,销售额意外翻了一番。

e.en: The {ensuing} chaos made the news headlines.
e.zh: 随之而来的混乱登上了新闻头条。

ensuite.t: adj. 套间的（卧室带独立卫浴）

e.en: Each hotel room has its own {ensuite} bathroom.
e.zh: 每间酒店客房都配有独立卫浴。

e.en: The master bedroom comes with a spacious {ensuite}.
e.zh: 主卧附带一间宽敞的套间浴室。

e.en: Please {ensure} your seatbelt is fastened during takeoff.
e.zh: 请确保起飞时系好安全带。

e.en: Backups {ensure} you don't lose important data.
e.zh: 备份能确保你不会丢失重要数据。

ensured.t: v. 已确保（ensure 的过去式）

e.en: The contract {ensured} fair pay for all workers.
e.zh: 这份合同保障了所有工人的公平报酬。

e.en: Strict testing {ensured} the app launched without bugs.
e.zh: 严格的测试确保了应用上线时没有错误。

ensures.t: v. 确保（ensure 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Two-factor authentication {ensures} your account stays safe.
e.zh: 双重验证能确保你的账户安全。

e.en: Daily practice {ensures} steady progress over time.
e.zh: 每日练习能确保长期稳步进步。

ensuring.t: v. 确保（ensure 的现在分词）

e.en: The team is focused on {ensuring} customer satisfaction.
e.zh: 团队专注于确保客户满意度。

e.en: He spent hours {ensuring} the report had no typos.
e.zh: 他花了数小时确保报告里没有错别字。

ent.t: n. 耳鼻喉科（ear, nose, throat 的缩写）

e.en: My doctor referred me to an {ent} specialist for the issue.
e.zh: 医生把我转介给耳鼻喉科专家处理这个问题。

e.en: The {ent} clinic is on the third floor of the hospital.
e.zh: 耳鼻喉科诊室在医院三楼。

entablature.t: n. 柱顶盘（古典建筑柱上部结构）

e.en: The ancient temple's {entablature} was carved with gods.
e.zh: 那座古庙的柱顶横檐上雕刻着众神。

e.en: Restorers carefully cleaned the marble {entablature}.
e.zh: 修复人员仔细清理了大理石檐部。

e.en: What does the new role {entail} on a daily basis?
e.zh: 这个新职位日常具体涉及哪些工作?

e.en: Buying a house can {entail} years of paperwork.
e.zh: 买房可能涉及多年的文书手续。

e.en: Logical {entailment} means one statement guarantees another.
e.zh: 逻辑蕴涵意味着一个陈述必然推出另一个。

e.en: The model checks for textual {entailment} between sentences.
e.zh: 该模型检查句子之间的文本蕴涵关系。

e.en: Long fishing lines can {entangle} sea turtles.
e.zh: 长钓鱼线可能会缠住海龟。

e.en: Don't let gossip {entangle} you in office drama.
e.zh: 别让八卦把你卷入办公室纷争。

e.en: My headphones got {entangled} at the bottom of my bag.
e.zh: 我的耳机在包底缠成了一团。

e.en: He became {entangled} in a complicated lawsuit.
e.zh: 他陷入了一场复杂的官司中。

entanglement.t:
n. 纠缠；牵连
n. （量子）纠缠

e.en: Quantum {entanglement} still puzzles many physicists.
e.zh: 量子纠缠至今仍让许多物理学家困惑。

e.en: She avoided any romantic {entanglement} at work.
e.zh: 她在职场上尽量避免任何感情纠葛。

e.en: The two nations signed a friendly {entente} last year.
e.zh: 两国去年签署了一份友好谅解协定。

e.en: A fragile {entente} kept the rival teams cooperating.
e.zh: 脆弱的协约让两支对立的队伍勉强合作。

enter.t:
v. 进入；输入
v. 参加；加入

e.en: Please {enter} your password to continue.
e.zh: 请输入密码以继续。

e.en: You can {enter} the building through the side door.
e.zh: 你可以从侧门进入这栋楼。

e.en: The patient receives {enteral} nutrition through a feeding tube.
e.zh: 该患者通过饲管接受肠内营养。

e.en: Doctors prefer {enteral} feeding when the gut still works.
e.zh: 在肠道仍能工作时,医生更倾向于肠内喂养。

entered.t: v. 进入；输入（enter 的过去式）

e.en: She quietly {entered} the room and sat down.
e.zh: 她悄悄走进房间坐了下来。

e.en: I {entered} my email but the form rejected it.
e.zh: 我输入了邮箱,但表单提示无效。

e.en: Probiotics may help with certain {enteric} infections.
e.zh: 益生菌可能有助于某些肠道感染。

e.en: The pill has an {enteric} coating to protect the stomach.
e.zh: 这种药片有肠溶包衣以保护胃部。

entering.t: v. 进入；输入（enter 的现在分词）

e.en: She paused before {entering} the interview room.
e.zh: 她在走进面试室前停顿了一下。

e.en: Please remove your shoes before {entering} the temple.
e.zh: 进入寺庙前请脱鞋。

e.en: The puppy was diagnosed with viral {enteritis}.
e.zh: 小狗被诊断出患有病毒性肠炎。

e.en: Severe {enteritis} can cause dehydration in children.
e.zh: 严重的肠炎会导致儿童脱水。

e.en: Each {enterocyte} absorbs nutrients from the gut lining.
e.zh: 每个肠上皮细胞都从肠壁吸收营养。

e.en: Damage to the {enterocyte} layer can impair digestion.
e.zh: 肠上皮细胞层受损会影响消化功能。

e.en: Celiac disease is a common form of {enteropathy}.
e.zh: 乳糜泻是一种常见的肠病。

e.en: Chronic {enteropathy} causes long-term nutrient loss.
e.zh: 慢性肠病会导致长期的营养流失。

e.en: The bacteria release an {enterotoxin} that triggers vomiting.
e.zh: 这种细菌会释放一种引发呕吐的肠毒素。

e.en: Food poisoning often involves a powerful {enterotoxin}.
e.zh: 食物中毒常常涉及一种强效肠毒素。

enterprise.t:
n. 企业；公司
n. 事业；进取心

e.en: Starting a small {enterprise} takes courage and capital.
e.zh: 创办一家小企业需要勇气和资本。

e.en: Our software is built for large {enterprise} customers.
e.zh: 我们的软件专为大型企业客户设计。

e.en: Many small {enterprises} struggled during the pandemic.
e.zh: 许多小企业在疫情期间举步维艰。

e.en: Tech {enterprises} are racing to adopt AI tools.
e.zh: 科技企业正竞相采用AI工具。

enterprising.t: adj. 有进取心的；有魄力的

e.en: An {enterprising} student turned the idea into a startup.
e.zh: 一位有进取心的学生把这个想法做成了创业公司。

e.en: She's {enterprising} enough to spot opportunities others miss.
e.zh: 她足够有胆识,能发现别人忽略的机会。

enters.t: v. 进入（enter 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Whenever she {enters} the room, everyone smiles.
e.zh: 每当她走进房间,大家都会微笑。

e.en: The app {enters} sleep mode after five minutes idle.
e.zh: 该应用在闲置五分钟后进入休眠模式。

entertain.t:
v. 使娱乐；招待
v. 考虑（想法）

e.en: Cartoons {entertain} kids on long road trips.
e.zh: 长途旅行中,动画片能逗孩子开心。

e.en: I won't {entertain} that ridiculous suggestion.
e.zh: 我不会考虑那个荒唐的建议。

entertained.t: v. 使娱乐（entertain 的过去式）

e.en: The clown {entertained} the kids for nearly an hour.
e.zh: 小丑给孩子们表演了将近一个小时。

e.en: She {entertained} the idea of moving abroad someday.
e.zh: 她考虑过有朝一日搬到国外去。

e.en: He's a gifted {entertainer} who can work any crowd.
e.zh: 他是个天赋出众的演艺人,能调动任何观众。

e.en: The street {entertainer} juggled flaming torches downtown.
e.zh: 那位街头艺人在市中心抛接燃烧的火把。

e.en: Several famous {entertainers} performed at the charity gala.
e.zh: 几位著名艺人在慈善晚会上登台演出。

e.en: Cruise ships hire {entertainers} to keep passengers happy.
e.zh: 邮轮会聘请演艺人员让乘客玩得开心。

e.en: That documentary was surprisingly {entertaining} and informative.
e.zh: 那部纪录片出乎意料地有趣又长知识。

e.en: We're {entertaining} guests from out of town tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们要招待外地来的客人。

entertainingly.t: adv. 有趣地；令人愉快地

e.en: The author writes {entertainingly} about even dry topics.
e.zh: 这位作家连枯燥话题都能写得妙趣横生。

e.en: He {entertainingly} described his disastrous first date.
e.zh: 他绘声绘色地讲了他糟糕的初次约会。

e.en: Streaming services have transformed home {entertainment} forever.
e.zh: 流媒体服务彻底改变了家庭娱乐的方式。

e.en: The kids built a fort just for their own {entertainment}.
e.zh: 孩子们搭起堡垒,纯粹是为了自娱自乐。

e.en: The festival offered live music, games, and other {entertainments}.
e.zh: 音乐节提供了现场音乐、游戏等各式娱乐节目。

e.en: Victorian {entertainments} often included parlor songs and recitations.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的娱乐活动常包括客厅歌曲和朗诵。

e.en: She {entertains} clients at upscale restaurants every week.
e.zh: 她每周都在高档餐厅招待客户。

e.en: He still {entertains} hopes of becoming a professional pianist.
e.zh: 他仍然怀抱着成为职业钢琴家的希望。

e.en: The reaction's change in {enthalpy} was clearly negative.
e.zh: 该反应的焓变明显为负值。

e.en: Engineers calculate {enthalpy} when designing steam turbines.
e.zh: 工程师设计蒸汽涡轮时要计算焓值。

e.en: Live magic shows still {enthral} audiences of all ages.
e.zh: 现场魔术表演至今仍能让各年龄段的观众着迷。

e.en: The novel's twists {enthral} readers from page one.
e.zh: 这部小说的反转从第一页就让读者入迷。

e.en: Great storytellers can {enthrall} a room within minutes.
e.zh: 出色的讲故事者能在几分钟内迷住全场。

e.en: The northern lights never fail to {enthrall} visitors.
e.zh: 北极光总能让游客叹为观止。

enthralling.t: adj. 迷人的；引人入胜的

e.en: I just finished an {enthralling} thriller in one sitting.
e.zh: 我一口气读完了一本扣人心弦的惊悚小说。

e.en: Her {enthralling} performance earned a standing ovation.
e.zh: 她引人入胜的表演赢得了全场起立鼓掌。

e.en: The young queen was formally {enthroned} last Sunday.
e.zh: 年轻的女王上周日正式登基。

e.en: A massive Buddha statue sat {enthroned} in the temple.
e.zh: 一尊巨大的佛像端坐于寺庙之中。

e.en: The king's {enthronement} drew dignitaries from across Europe.
e.zh: 国王的登基典礼吸引了来自欧洲各地的政要。

e.en: Television networks broadcast the {enthronement} ceremony live.
e.zh: 各大电视台对登基仪式进行了现场直播。

e.en: Fans {enthuse} about the new album on social media.
e.zh: 粉丝们在社交媒体上热情地谈论这张新专辑。

e.en: Good teachers {enthuse} students about learning itself.
e.zh: 好老师能让学生对学习本身产生热情。

enthused.t: adj. 兴奋的；热情洋溢的

e.en: She {enthused} over the new restaurant for hours.
e.zh: 她兴致勃勃地夸了那家新餐厅好几个小时。

e.en: The team felt {enthused} after the coach's pep talk.
e.zh: 教练的鼓励讲话后,全队士气高涨。

e.en: He always {enthuses} about the latest gadgets online.
e.zh: 他总在网上热情地介绍最新的电子产品。

e.en: My grandma {enthuses} over every photo I send her.
e.zh: 我发给奶奶的每张照片她都赞不绝口。

e.en: Her {enthusiasm} for the project quickly spread to everyone.
e.zh: 她对这个项目的热情很快感染了每个人。

e.en: The crowd greeted the announcement with genuine {enthusiasm}.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,人群发出了由衷的欢呼。

e.en: My brother is a serious coffee {enthusiast} with three machines.
e.zh: 我哥是个狂热的咖啡爱好者,家里有三台机器。

e.en: As a hiking {enthusiast}, she explores new trails every weekend.
e.zh: 作为徒步爱好者,她每个周末都去探索新路线。

e.en: The students gave the speaker an {enthusiastic} round of applause.
e.zh: 学生们给演讲者报以热烈的掌声。

e.en: He's {enthusiastic} about learning Mandarin this year.
e.zh: 他对今年学习普通话充满热情。

e.en: She {enthusiastically} agreed to lead the new project.
e.zh: 她欣然同意带头负责这个新项目。

e.en: The dog wagged its tail {enthusiastically} at the door.
e.zh: 小狗在门口热情地摇着尾巴。

e.en: Photography {enthusiasts} gathered at sunrise for the workshop.
e.zh: 摄影爱好者们在日出时分聚集起来参加工作坊。

e.en: The forum connects vintage car {enthusiasts} from around the world.
e.zh: 这个论坛将世界各地的老爷车爱好者联系在一起。

enthusing.t: v. 热情地谈论（进行式）

e.en: She kept {enthusing} about her trip to Japan over dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时她不停地兴奋地讲述她的日本之行。

e.en: The reviewer was {enthusing} over the film's cinematography.
e.zh: 那位影评人对这部电影的摄影赞不绝口。

e.en: Discounts often {entice} shoppers to spend more than planned.
e.zh: 打折常常诱使购物者比预算花得更多。

e.en: The bakery's smell tries to {entice} passersby inside.
e.zh: 面包店的香味总想把路人吸引进店。

e.en: Free shipping is a powerful {enticement} for online shoppers.
e.zh: 免运费对网购者来说是一种很大的诱惑。

e.en: The job offered higher pay as an {enticement} to relocate.
e.zh: 那份工作以更高薪资作为搬迁的诱因。

e.en: The menu featured several {enticing} vegetarian options.
e.zh: 菜单上有几道很诱人的素食选择。

e.en: Working from a beach sounds {enticing} but rarely works.
e.zh: 在海滩办公听起来很诱人,但实际上很难。

e.en: The chocolate cake sat {enticingly} on the counter.
e.zh: 巧克力蛋糕诱人地摆在台面上。

e.en: She smiled {enticingly} as she described the surprise.
e.zh: 她描述那个惊喜时,笑得让人充满期待。

e.en: I watched the {entire} season in a single weekend.
e.zh: 我一个周末就看完了整季的剧。

e.en: The {entire} team showed up to support the launch.
e.zh: 整个团队都到场支持产品发布。

e.en: Your concerns are {entirely} understandable given the situation.
e.zh: 鉴于这种情况,你的担忧完全可以理解。

e.en: The redesign feels {entirely} different from the old version.
e.zh: 重新设计的版本感觉与旧版完全不同。

e.en: Please read the contract in its {entirety} before signing.
e.zh: 请在签字前完整阅读这份合同。

e.en: She devoted the {entirety} of her career to teaching.
e.zh: 她把整个职业生涯都奉献给了教学。

e.en: Several legal {entities} were involved in the merger.
e.zh: 这次合并涉及多个法律实体。

e.en: The game features mythical {entities} from various cultures.
e.zh: 这款游戏中有来自各种文化的神话生物。

e.en: Premium membership will {entitle} you to free shipping.
e.zh: 高级会员资格让你享有免费配送。

e.en: Owning shares does not {entitle} you to daily updates.
e.zh: 持有股份并不意味着你有权获得每日更新。

entitled.t:
adj. 有权的
v. 命名为

e.en: All employees are {entitled} to two weeks of paid leave.
e.zh: 所有员工都有权享受两周带薪假期。

e.en: His {entitled} attitude annoyed everyone in the meeting.
e.zh: 他那种自以为是的态度让会议上所有人都很反感。

e.en: He has a real sense of {entitlement} about the promotion.
e.zh: 他对升职抱有一种理所应当的心态。

e.en: Healthcare is considered a basic {entitlement} in many countries.
e.zh: 在许多国家,医疗保健被视为一项基本权益。

e.en: This pass {entitles} you to unlimited rides for a month.
e.zh: 这张通行证可让你一个月内无限次乘坐。

e.en: Citizenship {entitles} residents to vote in national elections.
e.zh: 公民身份赋予居民在全国选举中投票的权利。

e.en: The court issued a ruling {entitling} her to compensation.
e.zh: 法院作出裁决,赋予她获得赔偿的权利。

e.en: He signed the document {entitling} his daughter to the property.
e.zh: 他签署了将房产权益授予女儿的文件。

e.en: The startup was registered as a separate legal {entity}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司被注册为独立的法律实体。

e.en: Players battle a mysterious {entity} in the final level.
e.zh: 玩家在最后一关要与一个神秘存在战斗。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians would {entomb} pharaohs with vast treasures.
e.zh: 古埃及人会将法老与大量财宝一同安葬。

e.en: Heavy snow can {entomb} entire villages in the mountains.
e.zh: 大雪可以将山中整个村庄掩埋。

e.en: The miners were {entombed} for two days before rescue.
e.zh: 矿工被困在井下两天后才获救。

e.en: The pharaoh lay {entombed} in the pyramid for millennia.
e.zh: 那位法老在金字塔中长眠了数千年。

e.en: The {entombment} ceremony followed centuries of royal tradition.
e.zh: 安葬仪式遵循了数百年的皇家传统。

e.en: Archaeologists studied the {entombment} practices of the Maya.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了玛雅人的安葬习俗。

e.en: The museum houses an impressive {entomological} collection.
e.zh: 该博物馆收藏了一批令人印象深刻的昆虫标本。

e.en: She published her findings in an {entomological} journal.
e.zh: 她将研究成果发表在一本昆虫学期刊上。

e.en: The {entomologist} discovered three new beetle species in Borneo.
e.zh: 这位昆虫学家在婆罗洲发现了三种新的甲虫。

e.en: As an {entomologist}, she spends weeks observing ant colonies.
e.zh: 作为昆虫学家,她要花数周时间观察蚁群。

e.en: She majored in {entomology} and now studies pollinators.
e.zh: 她主修昆虫学,现在研究传粉昆虫。

e.en: {Entomology} plays a key role in modern agricultural science.
e.zh: 昆虫学在现代农业科学中发挥着关键作用。

e.en: The pop star arrived with a huge {entourage} of assistants.
e.zh: 那位流行歌星带着一大群随行助理抵达。

e.en: The president's {entourage} filled three black SUVs.
e.zh: 总统的随行人员坐满了三辆黑色越野车。

e.en: The fisherman cleaned the {entrails} from the fresh catch.
e.zh: 渔夫把刚捕到的鱼的内脏清理干净。

e.en: Ancient priests claimed to read fate in animal {entrails}.
e.zh: 古代祭司声称能从动物内脏中预测命运。

e.en: Bright morning light helps {entrain} your sleep cycle.
e.zh: 明亮的晨光有助于调整你的睡眠节律。

e.en: Troops began to {entrain} for the front at dawn.
e.zh: 部队在拂晓时开始登上火车开赴前线。

entrance.t:
n. 入口；进入
v. 使入迷

e.en: The main {entrance} is on the south side of the building.
e.zh: 正门位于大楼的南侧。

e.en: Her dramatic {entrance} silenced the entire room.
e.zh: 她戏剧性的登场让整个房间瞬间安静下来。

e.en: The children sat {entranced} by the puppet show.
e.zh: 孩子们被木偶戏迷得入了神。

e.en: Tourists stood {entranced} before the giant waterfall.
e.zh: 游客们站在巨大的瀑布前看得出神。

entrances.t:
n. 入口（复数）
v. 使入迷

e.en: The stadium has six {entrances} for crowd control.
e.zh: 为了疏导人流,体育场设有六个入口。

e.en: Her singing always {entrances} the audience completely.
e.zh: 她的歌声总能彻底迷住观众。

e.en: A red carpet covered the grand {entranceway} to the hall.
e.zh: 红地毯铺满了通往大厅的宏伟入口通道。

e.en: Potted plants lined the narrow {entranceway} to the cafe.
e.zh: 盆栽植物排列在通往咖啡馆的狭窄入口处。

entrancing.t: adj. 迷人的；使人入迷的

e.en: The dancer gave an absolutely {entrancing} performance on stage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在台上的表演令人神魂颠倒。

e.en: She found the sunset over the ocean utterly {entrancing}.
e.zh: 她觉得海上的日落美得让人着迷。

e.en: Every {entrant} must register online before the deadline.
e.zh: 每位参赛者必须在截止日期前在线报名。

e.en: The youngest {entrant} in the contest was only nine.
e.zh: 比赛中最年轻的参赛者只有九岁。

e.en: Police cannot legally {entrap} citizens into committing crimes.
e.zh: 警方不能合法地诱使公民犯罪。

e.en: The spider's web is designed to {entrap} small insects.
e.zh: 蜘蛛网的构造是为了诱捕小昆虫。

e.en: His lawyer argued the sting operation was clear {entrapment}.
e.zh: 他的律师辩称这次诱捕行动明显属于钓鱼执法。

e.en: The court dismissed the case on grounds of {entrapment}.
e.zh: 法院以诱捕入罪为由驳回了此案。

e.en: The miners were {entrapped} underground for nearly two days.
e.zh: 矿工们被困在地下将近两天。

e.en: She felt {entrapped} by the company's restrictive contract.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被公司限制性的合同困住了。

e.en: The phrase {entre} nous means just between us in French.
e.zh: 短语 entre nous 在法语里意为「你我之间」。

e.en: This conversation is strictly {entre} you and me.
e.zh: 这段对话仅限于你我之间。

e.en: I {entreat} you to reconsider your hasty decision.
e.zh: 我恳求你重新考虑这个仓促的决定。

e.en: The villagers came to {entreat} the king for mercy.
e.zh: 村民们前来恳求国王开恩。

e.en: She ignored his desperate {entreaty} for a second chance.
e.zh: 她无视了他想要再来一次机会的苦苦哀求。

e.en: The letter was a heartfelt {entreaty} for forgiveness.
e.zh: 那封信是一份发自内心请求原谅的恳求。

entree.t:
n. 主菜
n. 进入权

e.en: The grilled salmon {entree} comes with seasonal vegetables.
e.zh: 烤三文鱼主菜配有时令蔬菜。

e.en: Her family connections gave her {entree} to elite circles.
e.zh: 家族关系让她得以进入精英圈子。

e.en: New laws may {entrench} inequality rather than reduce it.
e.zh: 新法律可能会让不平等更加根深蒂固而非减少。

e.en: Soldiers worked overnight to {entrench} their position.
e.zh: 士兵们连夜挖战壕加固阵地。

e.en: Corruption is deeply {entrenched} in the political system.
e.zh: 腐败在政治体制中已根深蒂固。

e.en: His {entrenched} views on the issue won't easily change.
e.zh: 他对这个问题的固有看法不会轻易改变。

e.en: The {entrenchment} of these habits makes change difficult.
e.zh: 这些习惯的根深蒂固让改变变得困难。

e.en: Voters worry about the {entrenchment} of corporate power.
e.zh: 选民担心企业权力变得越来越根深蒂固。

e.en: Singapore became a major {entrepot} for Asian trade.
e.zh: 新加坡成为亚洲贸易的重要转口港。

e.en: The port served as an {entrepot} between East and West.
e.zh: 该港口曾是东西方之间的转口贸易中心。

e.en: She became a successful tech {entrepreneur} before turning thirty.
e.zh: 她在三十岁前就成了一名成功的科技创业者。

e.en: Every {entrepreneur} faces failure at some point in their journey.
e.zh: 每位创业者在创业路上都会经历失败。

e.en: He has a strong {entrepreneurial} spirit and loves taking risks.
e.zh: 他有强烈的创业精神,喜欢冒险。

e.en: The university promotes {entrepreneurial} thinking among students.
e.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生培养创业思维。

entrepreneurs.t: n. 创业者们（entrepreneur 的复数）

e.en: Young {entrepreneurs} are reshaping the global startup landscape.
e.zh: 年轻创业者正在重塑全球创业格局。

e.en: Many {entrepreneurs} struggle to find investors in tough markets.
e.zh: 许多创业者在艰难市场中难以找到投资人。

entrepreneurship.t: n. 创业精神；企业家精神

e.en: The course teaches the basics of {entrepreneurship} and innovation.
e.zh: 这门课程教授创业与创新的基础知识。
