e.en: Government grants encourage {entrepreneurship} in rural communities.
e.zh: 政府拨款鼓励农村社区的创业活动。

entries.t: n. 条目；记录（entry 的复数）

e.en: The contest received over a thousand {entries} this year.
e.zh: 今年比赛收到了一千多份参赛作品。

e.en: Please check your diary {entries} for any scheduling conflicts.
e.zh: 请查看你的日记条目,看是否有时间冲突。

e.en: The universe drifts toward an {entropic} state of disorder.
e.zh: 宇宙正朝着熵增的无序状态漂移。

e.en: Old buildings have an {entropic} charm as they decay.
e.zh: 老建筑在衰败中散发出一种熵化的魅力。

e.en: Physics tells us that {entropy} always increases over time.
e.zh: 物理学告诉我们,熵总是随时间增加。

e.en: The codebase suffers from years of accumulated {entropy}.
e.zh: 这个代码库因多年累积的混乱而问题重重。

e.en: I would never {entrust} my passwords to a stranger.
e.zh: 我绝不会把密码托付给陌生人。

e.en: Parents {entrust} teachers with their children's education daily.
e.zh: 家长每天都把孩子的教育托付给老师。

entry.t:
n. 条目；进入
n. 参赛作品

e.en: The {entry} fee for the museum is ten dollars.
e.zh: 博物馆的入场费是十美元。

e.en: She added a new {entry} to her travel blog.
e.zh: 她在旅行博客上新增了一篇日志。

e.en: Muddy boots were piled up in the {entryway}.
e.zh: 沾满泥的靴子堆在门厅里。

e.en: A small bench sits beside the apartment's {entryway}.
e.zh: 公寓门厅旁放着一张小长椅。

e.en: Roses {entwine} themselves around the old wooden fence.
e.zh: 玫瑰缠绕在古老的木栅栏上。

e.en: Their lives began to {entwine} after that first meeting.
e.zh: 自从初次相遇后,他们的生活开始交织在一起。

e.en: Their fingers were tightly {entwined} as they walked home.
e.zh: 他们手指紧紧交握着走回家。

e.en: The two families' histories are deeply {entwined}.
e.zh: 这两个家族的历史紧密交织在一起。

enucleation.t: n. 摘除（医学，如眼球摘除）

e.en: The surgeon recommended {enucleation} to remove the damaged eye.
e.zh: 外科医生建议通过摘除手术取出受损的眼球。

e.en: Cell {enucleation} is a key step in cloning research.
e.zh: 细胞去核是克隆研究中的关键步骤。

e.en: Could you {enumerate} the main reasons for the delay?
e.zh: 你能逐一列出延误的主要原因吗?

e.en: The report tries to {enumerate} every safety risk involved.
e.zh: 该报告试图逐项列举所有相关的安全风险。

e.en: The contract includes a careful {enumeration} of all fees.
e.zh: 合同中详细列举了所有费用。

e.en: Census {enumeration} happens once every ten years here.
e.zh: 这里每十年进行一次人口普查清点。

e.en: Each census {enumerator} visits about two hundred households.
e.zh: 每位人口普查员要走访大约两百户人家。

e.en: The loop uses an {enumerator} to iterate over the collection.
e.zh: 循环使用一个枚举器来遍历集合。

enunciate.t:
v. 清晰发音
v. 阐明

e.en: Please {enunciate} clearly so everyone in back can hear.
e.zh: 请发音清晰,让后排的人也能听见。

e.en: The speech tried to {enunciate} a new vision for the company.
e.zh: 那次演讲试图阐明公司的新愿景。

e.en: Her crisp {enunciation} makes the podcast easy to follow.
e.zh: 她清晰的发音让这档播客很容易听懂。

e.en: Voice actors practice {enunciation} for hours every day.
e.zh: 配音演员每天练习咬字数小时。

e.en: Childhood {enuresis} usually resolves on its own with age.
e.zh: 儿童遗尿症通常会随年龄增长自行好转。

e.en: The doctor prescribed treatment for the boy's nighttime {enuresis}.
e.zh: 医生为这个男孩的夜间遗尿症开了治疗方案。

e.en: Thick fog began to {envelop} the entire mountain village.
e.zh: 浓雾开始笼罩整个山村。

e.en: Soft music seemed to {envelop} the cozy little café.
e.zh: 柔和的音乐仿佛笼罩着这家温馨的小咖啡馆。

envelope.t:
n. 信封
n. 包络；外壳

e.en: She sealed the letter inside a plain white {envelope}.
e.zh: 她把信封进一个普通的白色信封里。

e.en: The startup is pushing the {envelope} of AI capabilities.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在突破人工智能能力的极限。

e.en: He stamped a stack of {envelopes} for tomorrow's mail.
e.zh: 他给明天要寄的一摞信封贴上了邮票。

e.en: The store sells colorful {envelopes} for invitations and cards.
e.zh: 这家店出售用于请柬和贺卡的彩色信封。

e.en: A warm, {enveloping} hug greeted her at the airport.
e.zh: 机场里一个温暖紧紧的拥抱迎接了她。

e.en: Darkness was slowly {enveloping} the quiet countryside.
e.zh: 夜色正慢慢笼罩着寂静的乡村。

e.en: The general planned a complete {envelopment} of enemy forces.
e.zh: 将军策划对敌军实施全面合围。

e.en: She enjoyed the warm {envelopment} of the heated blanket.
e.zh: 她享受着电热毯温暖的包裹感。

e.en: He has an {enviable} ability to remember every name.
e.zh: 他有一种令人羡慕的本领,能记住每个人的名字。

e.en: The company is in an {enviable} financial position right now.
e.zh: 该公司目前处于令人羡慕的财务状况。

e.en: She remained {enviably} calm during the heated debate.
e.zh: 在激烈辩论中,她依然冷静得令人羡慕。

e.en: The team finished the project {enviably} ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 团队提前完成了项目,进度令人羡慕。

e.en: Classmates {envied} her effortless talent for languages.
e.zh: 同学们都羡慕她在语言上毫不费力的天赋。

e.en: He was {envied} by colleagues for his flexible schedule.
e.zh: 他因为灵活的工作时间而被同事们羡慕。

envies.t: v. 羡慕（envy 第三人称单数）

e.en: Everyone in the office secretly {envies} her work-life balance.
e.zh: 办公室里每个人都暗暗羡慕她的工作与生活平衡。

e.en: He {envies} friends who travel freely around the world.
e.zh: 他羡慕那些能自由环游世界的朋友。

e.en: I'm a little {envious} of your relaxing weekend plans.
e.zh: 我有点羡慕你那悠闲的周末计划。

e.en: She gave her sister an {envious} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向妹妹投去羡慕的目光。

e.en: The kids stared {enviously} at the new bicycle outside.
e.zh: 孩子们羡慕地盯着外面那辆新自行车。

e.en: She glanced {enviously} at her friend's promotion announcement.
e.zh: 她羡慕地瞥了一眼朋友的升职公告。

e.en: Tall pines {environ} the small cabin by the lake.
e.zh: 高大的松树环绕着湖边的小木屋。

e.en: Ancient walls still {environ} the historic city center.
e.zh: 古老的城墙至今仍环绕着历史悠久的市中心。

environment.t:
n. 环境
n. 开发环境

e.en: Plastic waste continues to harm the marine {environment}.
e.zh: 塑料垃圾持续危害着海洋环境。

e.en: A quiet {environment} helps me focus while coding.
e.zh: 安静的环境能帮助我在写代码时专注。

e.en: The new policy aims to reduce {environmental} damage from factories.
e.zh: 新政策旨在减少工厂对环境的破坏。

e.en: She studies the {environmental} impact of fast fashion brands.
e.zh: 她研究快时尚品牌对环境的影响。

e.en: Modern {environmentalism} began gaining momentum in the 1960s.
e.zh: 现代环保主义在二十世纪六十年代开始兴起。

e.en: Her commitment to {environmentalism} shapes every business decision.
e.zh: 她对环保主义的坚持影响着每一个商业决策。

e.en: The {environmentalist} spoke passionately about saving the rainforest.
e.zh: 那位环保主义者满怀激情地谈论拯救雨林。

e.en: As an {environmentalist}, she avoids single-use plastics entirely.
e.zh: 作为一名环保人士,她完全不用一次性塑料制品。

e.en: {Environmentalists} protested outside the oil company's headquarters yesterday.
e.zh: 环保人士昨天在那家石油公司总部外抗议。

e.en: Many {environmentalists} support stricter rules on industrial emissions.
e.zh: 许多环保人士支持对工业排放制定更严格的规定。

environmentally.t: adv. 在环境方面；环保地

e.en: The company switched to {environmentally} friendly packaging last year.
e.zh: 该公司去年改用了环保包装。

e.en: Driving less is a simple way to live more {environmentally} responsibly.
e.zh: 少开车是更环保地生活的一种简单方式。

e.en: Cloud {environments} let teams deploy code in minutes.
e.zh: 云环境让团队几分钟就能部署代码。

e.en: Polar bears thrive in extremely cold {environments}.
e.zh: 北极熊在极寒环境中生存得很好。

e.en: The hotel sits in the quiet {environs} of the lake.
e.zh: 酒店坐落在湖的宁静周边地区。

e.en: Tourists explored Paris and its {environs} for a week.
e.zh: 游客花了一周游览巴黎及其周边。

e.en: I {envisage} a future where remote work is standard.
e.zh: 我设想未来远程办公会成为常态。

e.en: Engineers {envisage} cars that drive themselves safely.
e.zh: 工程师们设想能安全自动驾驶的汽车。

e.en: The project took longer than originally {envisaged}.
e.zh: 项目耗时比最初设想的要长。

e.en: She {envisaged} herself running her own startup someday.
e.zh: 她设想着有朝一日经营自己的创业公司。

envisages.t: v. 设想（envisage 第三人称单数）

e.en: The plan {envisages} a new subway line by 2030.
e.zh: 该计划设想到2030年开通一条新地铁线。

e.en: He {envisages} no major problems with the launch.
e.zh: 他预想发布不会有什么大问题。

envisaging.t: v. 展望、设想（envisage 的现在分词）

e.en: We are {envisaging} a complete redesign of the app.
e.zh: 我们正在设想对应用进行彻底重新设计。

e.en: The author kept {envisaging} alternative endings for the book.
e.zh: 作者不断设想这本书的不同结局。

envision.t: v. 展望、想象（未来情景）

e.en: I {envision} a cleaner, greener city in ten years.
e.zh: 我设想十年后会有一个更干净更环保的城市。

e.en: Designers {envision} how users will interact with the product.
e.zh: 设计师设想用户将如何与产品互动。

envisioned.t:
v. 设想、展望（envision 的过去式）
adj. 所设想的

e.en: The founders {envisioned} a tool everyone could use freely.
e.zh: 创始人设想了一个人人都能自由使用的工具。

e.en: She {envisioned} her wedding on a quiet beach.
e.zh: 她想象着自己的婚礼在一片宁静的海滩举行。

e.en: The president sent a special {envoy} to negotiate peace.
e.zh: 总统派出一位特使去谈判和平。

e.en: A UN {envoy} arrived to assess the humanitarian crisis.
e.zh: 一名联合国特使抵达评估人道主义危机。

envy.t:
n. 羡慕、嫉妒
v. 羡慕、嫉妒

e.en: I {envy} people who can fall asleep instantly.
e.zh: 我羡慕那些一沾枕头就能睡着的人。

e.en: Her new apartment is the {envy} of all her friends.
e.zh: 她的新公寓让所有朋友都羡慕不已。

envying.t: v. 羡慕、嫉妒（envy 的现在分词）

e.en: I caught myself {envying} her relaxed weekend routine.
e.zh: 我发现自己在羡慕她悠闲的周末生活。

e.en: Stop {envying} others and focus on your own progress.
e.zh: 别再羡慕别人,专注于自己的进步。

e.en: Soft blankets {enwrap} the baby through the cold night.
e.zh: 柔软的毯子在寒夜里包裹着婴儿。

e.en: Thick fog seemed to {enwrap} the entire mountain village.
e.zh: 浓雾仿佛笼罩了整个山村。

enzootic.t: adj. 地方性流行的（动物疾病）

e.en: The disease is {enzootic} among local cattle herds.
e.zh: 这种疾病在当地牛群中长期流行。

e.en: Vets identified an {enzootic} infection in the sheep population.
e.zh: 兽医在羊群中发现了一种地方性感染。

e.en: Most laundry detergents rely on {enzymatic} action to remove stains.
e.zh: 大多数洗衣液靠酶的作用去除污渍。

e.en: The reaction requires {enzymatic} activity to proceed efficiently.
e.zh: 该反应需要酶的活性才能高效进行。

e.en: Saliva contains an {enzyme} that helps digest starch.
e.zh: 唾液含有一种帮助消化淀粉的酶。

e.en: Scientists engineered a new {enzyme} to break down plastic.
e.zh: 科学家设计了一种能分解塑料的新酶。

eocene.t:
n. 始新世
adj. 始新世的

e.en: Many modern mammal groups appeared during the {Eocene} epoch.
e.zh: 许多现代哺乳动物类群出现于始新世。

e.en: The fossil dates back to the early {Eocene} period.
e.zh: 该化石可追溯到始新世早期。

e.en: It feels like an {eon} since we last met.
e.zh: 感觉我们上次见面已是好久好久以前。

e.en: The Precambrian {eon} covers most of Earth's history.
e.zh: 前寒武纪宙涵盖了地球历史的大部分时间。

e.en: The lab uses {eosin} to stain tissue samples pink.
e.zh: 实验室用伊红将组织样本染成粉色。

e.en: Hematoxylin and {eosin} are standard dyes in pathology.
e.zh: 苏木精和伊红是病理学的标准染色剂。

e.en: An elevated {eosinophil} count may indicate an allergic reaction.
e.zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞升高可能提示过敏反应。

e.en: The {eosinophil} plays a key role in fighting parasites.
e.zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞在对抗寄生虫方面起关键作用。

eosinophilia.t: n. 嗜酸性粒细胞增多症

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with mild {eosinophilia} after blood tests.
e.zh: 血液检查后患者被诊断为轻度嗜酸性粒细胞增多。

e.en: Persistent {eosinophilia} can signal underlying parasitic infection.
e.zh: 持续的嗜酸性粒细胞增多可能提示潜在的寄生虫感染。

e.en: Doctors confirmed an {eosinophilic} inflammation in the esophagus.
e.zh: 医生确诊食道存在嗜酸性粒细胞炎症。

e.en: {Eosinophilic} asthma responds well to certain biologic drugs.
e.zh: 嗜酸性粒细胞性哮喘对某些生物药物反应良好。

epa.t: n. 美国环境保护署（Environmental Protection Agency）

e.en: The {EPA} fined the company for polluting the river.
e.zh: 环保署因河流污染对该公司处以罚款。

e.en: New {EPA} rules limit emissions from coal power plants.
e.zh: 新的环保署规定限制了燃煤电厂的排放。

e.en: A gold {epaulet} marked his rank as captain.
e.zh: 金色肩章标示着他上尉的军衔。

e.en: The jacket featured a decorative {epaulet} on each shoulder.
e.zh: 夹克每个肩部都有装饰性的肩章。

epaulette.t: n. 肩章（epaulet 的英式拼写）

e.en: Her uniform shoulders bore a polished silver {epaulette}.
e.zh: 她制服的肩头佩戴着锃亮的银色肩章。

e.en: The designer added an {epaulette} to give the coat structure.
e.zh: 设计师加了肩章让大衣更有型。

epc.t: n. 设计采购施工总承包（Engineering Procurement Construction）

e.en: The house received an {EPC} rating of B last year.
e.zh: 这栋房子去年获得了B级能效证书评级。

e.en: Landlords must show a valid {EPC} before renting out flats.
e.zh: 房东出租公寓前必须出示有效的能效证书。

e.en: She trains daily to compete in {epee} fencing.
e.zh: 她每天训练以参加重剑击剑比赛。

e.en: The {epee} is heavier than the foil used in fencing.
e.zh: 重剑比击剑用的花剑要重一些。

e.en: The pastor referenced {Eph} 4:32 in this morning's sermon.
e.zh: 牧师在今早的讲道中引用了以弗所书4章32节。

e.en: Students memorized verses from {Eph} for Sunday school.
e.zh: 学生们为主日学背诵以弗所书的经文。

e.en: Hikers spotted wild {ephedra} growing on the dry hillside.
e.zh: 徒步者在干燥山坡上发现了野生麻黄。

e.en: Supplements containing {ephedra} were banned for safety reasons.
e.zh: 含麻黄的补充剂出于安全考虑被禁。

e.en: {Ephedrine} is sometimes prescribed to treat low blood pressure.
e.zh: 麻黄碱有时被用来治疗低血压。

e.en: Many cold medicines no longer contain {ephedrine} due to regulations.
e.zh: 由于监管,许多感冒药不再含有麻黄碱。

ephemera.t: n. 短暂存在的事物；蜉蝣

e.en: He collects vintage postcards and other paper {ephemera}.
e.zh: 他收藏老明信片和其他纸质短期印刷品。

e.en: The museum displayed political {ephemera} from the 1960s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了1960年代的政治短期印刷品。

ephemeral.t: adj. 短暂的、转瞬即逝的

e.en: Social media trends are often {ephemeral} and quickly forgotten.
e.zh: 社交媒体的潮流往往转瞬即逝,很快被遗忘。

e.en: Cherry blossoms are beautiful but {ephemeral}.
e.zh: 樱花虽美却短暂易逝。

ephemeralities.t: n. 短暂性（ephemerality 的复数）

e.en: The poem dwells on the {ephemeralities} of youth and beauty.
e.zh: 这首诗细味着青春与美丽的种种短暂。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {ephemeralities} that define human experience.
e.zh: 哲学家们探讨定义人类经验的种种短暂之物。

e.en: The artist captures the {ephemerality} of a summer evening.
e.zh: 这位艺术家捕捉到了夏日夜晚的转瞬即逝。

e.en: Snapchat built its brand on the {ephemerality} of messages.
e.zh: Snapchat以消息的短暂性打造了品牌。

ephemeras.t: n. 短暂事物（ephemera 的复数）

e.en: Mayflies are delicate {ephemeras} that live for only a day.
e.zh: 蜉蝣是只活一天的纤弱昆虫。

e.en: Anglers tie flies that imitate hatching {ephemeras} on the river.
e.zh: 钓鱼者绑制仿河面上孵化蜉蝣的拟饵。

e.en: Astronomers consult an {ephemeris} to track planetary positions.
e.zh: 天文学家查阅星历表来追踪行星位置。

e.en: The ship's navigator relied on a printed {ephemeris}.
e.zh: 船上的航海员依靠一本印刷的星历表。

ephesian.t:
adj. 以弗所的
n. 以弗所人

e.en: The apostle wrote a letter to the {Ephesian} church.
e.zh: 使徒给以弗所教会写了一封书信。

e.en: Ancient {Ephesian} merchants traded across the Aegean Sea.
e.zh: 古代以弗所商人在爱琴海一带做贸易。

ephesus.t: n. 以弗所（古希腊城市）

e.en: Tourists wander the marble streets of ancient {Ephesus}.
e.zh: 游客在古城以弗所的大理石街道上漫步。

e.en: The Library of Celsus stands among the ruins of {Ephesus}.
e.zh: 塞尔苏斯图书馆矗立于以弗所遗址中。

epic.t:
n. 史诗、史诗级作品
adj. 史诗般的、宏大的

e.en: That concert was absolutely {epic} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那场演唱会从头到尾都超级精彩。

e.en: Homer wrote an {epic} about the Trojan War.
e.zh: 荷马写了一部关于特洛伊战争的史诗。

e.en: Silicon Valley is the {epicenter} of global tech innovation.
e.zh: 硅谷是全球科技创新的中心。

e.en: The earthquake's {epicenter} was just offshore from the city.
e.zh: 地震的震中就在城市的近海处。

epicentre.t: n. 震中（epicenter 的英式拼写）

e.en: London became the {epicentre} of the financial crisis in 2008.
e.zh: 2008年伦敦成为金融危机的中心。

e.en: The quake's {epicentre} lay deep beneath the ocean floor.
e.zh: 地震的震中位于海底深处。

epicure.t: n. 美食家、讲究饮食的人

e.en: As an {epicure}, she travels the world tasting rare cuisines.
e.zh: 作为一位美食家,她周游世界品尝珍稀美食。

e.en: The wine was clearly chosen by a true {epicure}.
e.zh: 这款酒显然是真正的美食家挑选的。

epicurean.t:
adj. 享乐主义的、讲究美食的
n. 伊壁鸠鲁学派信徒

e.en: The restaurant offers an {epicurean} tasting menu of ten courses.
e.zh: 这家餐厅提供十道菜的美食家品鉴菜单。

e.en: He has rather {epicurean} tastes in cheese and wine.
e.zh: 他对奶酪和葡萄酒有相当讲究的口味。

epicycle.t: n. 本轮、周转圆（天文学）

e.en: Ptolemy used the {epicycle} to explain planetary motion.
e.zh: 托勒密用本轮来解释行星的运动。

e.en: Each {epicycle} added complexity to the old astronomical model.
e.zh: 每个本轮都让旧的天文模型更复杂。

epidemic.t:
n. 流行病、疫情
adj. 流行性的

e.en: The flu {epidemic} forced several schools to close temporarily.
e.zh: 流感疫情迫使几所学校暂时停课。

e.en: Loneliness has become a silent {epidemic} among young adults.
e.zh: 孤独已成为年轻人中无声蔓延的流行问题。

epidemics.t: n. 流行病（epidemic 的复数）

e.en: Vaccines have prevented countless {epidemics} over the past century.
e.zh: 过去一个世纪疫苗预防了无数次流行病。

e.en: Health officials track {epidemics} using real-time data dashboards.
e.zh: 卫生官员通过实时数据看板追踪各类流行病。

e.en: Researchers conducted an {epidemiologic} survey of the affected region.
e.zh: 研究人员对受影响地区开展了流行病学调查。

e.en: The study used standard {epidemiologic} methods to analyze risk.
e.zh: 该研究采用标准的流行病学方法分析风险。

e.en: The {epidemiological} data show a sharp drop in new cases.
e.zh: 流行病学数据显示新增病例大幅下降。

e.en: They published an {epidemiological} review of obesity trends.
e.zh: 他们发表了关于肥胖趋势的流行病学综述。

e.en: The two outbreaks are {epidemiologically} linked, experts say.
e.zh: 专家表示两次疫情在流行病学上相互关联。

e.en: Smoking is {epidemiologically} associated with many cancers.
e.zh: 吸烟在流行病学上与多种癌症相关。

e.en: The {epidemiologist} traced the outbreak back to a single restaurant.
e.zh: 这位流行病学家把疫情追溯到一家餐厅。

e.en: She trained as an {epidemiologist} after working as a nurse.
e.zh: 她当过护士后接受流行病学家的训练。

e.en: He teaches {epidemiology} at a major medical school.
e.zh: 他在一所知名医学院教授流行病学。

e.en: {Epidemiology} helps us understand how diseases spread in populations.
e.zh: 流行病学帮助我们理解疾病如何在人群中传播。

e.en: The cream targets the {epidermal} layer to reduce dryness.
e.zh: 这款面霜针对表皮层来减少干燥。

e.en: Doctors found {epidermal} damage caused by long sun exposure.
e.zh: 医生发现长时间日晒造成了表皮损伤。

e.en: Sunscreen helps protect the {epidermis} from harmful UV rays.
e.zh: 防晒霜可以保护表皮免受紫外线伤害。

e.en: The outermost layer of skin is called the {epidermis}.
e.zh: 皮肤的最外层叫做表皮。

e.en: The surgeon removed an {epidermoid} cyst from her back.
e.zh: 外科医生从她背上切除了一个表皮样囊肿。

e.en: An {epidermoid} tumor was detected during the routine scan.
e.zh: 常规扫描中发现了一个表皮样肿瘤。

epidural.t:
adj. 硬膜外的
n. 硬膜外麻醉

e.en: She asked for an {epidural} during labor to ease the pain.
e.zh: 她在分娩时要求打硬膜外麻醉来止痛。

e.en: The anesthesiologist administered an {epidural} before the surgery.
e.zh: 麻醉师在手术前进行了硬膜外麻醉。

e.en: The patient complained of sharp {epigastric} pain after meals.
e.zh: 病人主诉饭后上腹部剧烈疼痛。

e.en: Doctors examined her for {epigastric} discomfort and nausea.
e.zh: 医生检查了她的上腹部不适和恶心症状。

e.en: Stress can trigger {epigenetic} changes that affect gene expression.
e.zh: 压力会引发影响基因表达的表观遗传变化。

e.en: Researchers study {epigenetic} markers passed between generations.
e.zh: 研究人员研究代际传递的表观遗传标记。

e.en: The {epiglottis} prevents food from entering the windpipe.
e.zh: 会厌可以防止食物进入气管。

e.en: Swallowing causes the {epiglottis} to close over the larynx.
e.zh: 吞咽时会厌会盖住喉部。

epigone.t: n. 平庸的模仿者、追随者

e.en: Critics dismissed him as a mere {epigone} of greater poets.
e.zh: 评论家认为他不过是更伟大诗人的拙劣模仿者。

e.en: The painter was called an {epigone} of the Impressionist masters.
e.zh: 这位画家被称为印象派大师的模仿者。

e.en: Wilde was famous for his witty {epigram} about life.
e.zh: 王尔德以其关于人生的妙语警句而闻名。

e.en: She ended her speech with a sharp {epigram}.
e.zh: 她以一句犀利的警句结束了演讲。

epigrammatic.t: adj. 警句式的、简练俏皮的

e.en: His writing has an {epigrammatic} style full of clever turns.
e.zh: 他的写作风格简练机智,充满巧妙的转折。

e.en: The novel is praised for its {epigrammatic} dialogue.
e.zh: 这部小说因其警句式的对话而受到赞誉。

e.en: The novel opens with an {epigraph} from Shakespeare.
e.zh: 这部小说以莎士比亚的题词开篇。

e.en: Each chapter begins with a thoughtful {epigraph}.
e.zh: 每一章都以一句发人深省的题词开头。

e.en: The museum displayed {epigraphic} evidence from ancient Rome.
e.zh: 博物馆展示了来自古罗马的铭文证据。

e.en: Scholars rely on {epigraphic} sources to date the temple.
e.zh: 学者们依靠铭文资料来确定这座神庙的年代。

e.en: She specializes in Greek {epigraphy} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学专攻希腊铭文学。

e.en: The study of {epigraphy} reveals much about ancient societies.
e.zh: 铭文学的研究揭示了许多古代社会的面貌。

e.en: He has lived with {epilepsy} since he was a child.
e.zh: 他从小就患有癫痫症。

e.en: New medications can help control {epilepsy} effectively.
e.zh: 新药可以有效控制癫痫。

epileptic.t:
adj. 癫痫的
n. 癫痫患者

e.en: Flashing lights can trigger an {epileptic} seizure.
e.zh: 闪烁的灯光可能诱发癫痫发作。

e.en: She wears a bracelet that identifies her as {epileptic}.
e.zh: 她戴着一个标明自己是癫痫患者的手环。

e.en: The book's {epilogue} reveals what happens ten years later.
e.zh: 这本书的尾声揭示了十年后发生的事情。

e.en: Many readers cried while reading the heartfelt {epilogue}.
e.zh: 许多读者读到那感人的尾声时哭了。

e.en: Paramedics injected {epinephrine} to treat the allergic reaction.
e.zh: 急救人员注射肾上腺素来治疗过敏反应。

e.en: The body releases {epinephrine} during stressful situations.
e.zh: 身体在紧张状态下会释放肾上腺素。

epiphanic.t: adj. 顿悟般的、豁然开朗的

e.en: She had an {epiphanic} moment while watching the sunset.
e.zh: 她看日落时经历了一个顿悟的瞬间。

e.en: The novel's ending offers an {epiphanic} insight into love.
e.zh: 小说的结尾提供了对爱情的顿悟式洞察。

e.en: She had an {epiphany} about her career while jogging.
e.zh: 她在慢跑时对自己的职业有了顿悟。

e.en: The artist's sudden {epiphany} changed his entire style.
e.zh: 艺术家突如其来的顿悟改变了他的整个风格。

epiphenomenal.t: adj. 附带现象的、伴随发生的

e.en: Some philosophers argue consciousness is merely {epiphenomenal}.
e.zh: 一些哲学家认为意识仅仅是附带现象。

e.en: The symptoms appeared {epiphenomenal} to the underlying disease.
e.zh: 这些症状似乎是潜在疾病的附带现象。

e.en: He treated emotion as an {epiphenomenon} of brain activity.
e.zh: 他将情感视为大脑活动的附带现象。

e.en: Some scientists view dreams as an {epiphenomenon} of sleep.
e.zh: 一些科学家将梦视为睡眠的附带现象。

e.en: The orchid is an {epiphyte} that grows on tree branches.
e.zh: 这种兰花是一种生长在树枝上的附生植物。

e.en: Many ferns thrive as an {epiphyte} in tropical forests.
e.zh: 许多蕨类植物作为附生植物在热带森林中茂盛生长。

e.en: Bromeliads are {epiphytic} plants commonly found on trees.
e.zh: 凤梨科植物是常见于树上的附生植物。

e.en: The rainforest is full of {epiphytic} mosses and ferns.
e.zh: 雨林里到处是附生的苔藓和蕨类。

e.en: The reformers challenged the authority of the {episcopacy}.
e.zh: 改革者们挑战了主教制度的权威。

e.en: Debates over {episcopacy} divided the early church.
e.zh: 关于主教制的争论分裂了早期教会。

e.en: She attends an {Episcopal} church every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早上都去圣公会教堂做礼拜。

e.en: The {episcopal} council met to discuss new policies.
e.zh: 主教会议召开,讨论新的政策。

episcopalian.t:
adj. 圣公会的
n. 圣公会教徒

e.en: He grew up in an {Episcopalian} family in Boston.
e.zh: 他在波士顿一个圣公会家庭长大。

e.en: The {Episcopalian} tradition emphasizes liturgical worship.
e.zh: 圣公会传统强调礼仪式的崇拜。

e.en: His {episcopate} lasted nearly thirty years before retirement.
e.zh: 他的主教任期在退休前持续了近三十年。

e.en: The {episcopate} issued a statement on social justice.
e.zh: 主教团就社会正义问题发表了声明。

e.en: The doctor performed an {episiotomy} to ease the delivery.
e.zh: 医生实施了会阴切开术以协助分娩。

e.en: Modern practice avoids routine {episiotomy} during childbirth.
e.zh: 现代做法避免在分娩中常规进行会阴切开术。

episode.t: n. 一集（剧集）；一段经历

e.en: I watched the latest {episode} of the show last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚看了这部剧的最新一集。

e.en: That embarrassing {episode} at the office still haunts him.
e.zh: 办公室那次尴尬的事件仍困扰着他。

episodes.t: n. 剧集、各集；多段经历

e.en: Netflix released all eight {episodes} at once.
e.zh: 网飞一次性放出了全部八集。

e.en: She suffered occasional {episodes} of dizziness after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她偶尔会出现头晕的发作。

e.en: The TV series has a loose, {episodic} structure.
e.zh: 这部电视剧采用松散的单元剧结构。

e.en: He suffers from {episodic} migraines triggered by stress.
e.zh: 他患有由压力引发的间歇性偏头痛。

e.en: The committee meets {episodically} rather than on a fixed schedule.
e.zh: 委员会不定期地开会,而非按固定日程。

e.en: Her symptoms appear {episodically} throughout the year.
e.zh: 她的症状全年都会间歇性地出现。

e.en: Dry winter air often causes {epistaxis} in young children.
e.zh: 冬天干燥的空气常常导致幼儿流鼻血。

e.en: The patient was admitted for severe and recurrent {epistaxis}.
e.zh: 该病人因严重且反复的鼻出血入院。

episteme.t: n. 知识体系、认知范式

e.en: Foucault analyzed how each era has its own {episteme}.
e.zh: 福柯分析了每个时代都有自己独特的知识型。

e.en: The Renaissance {episteme} differed sharply from medieval thought.
e.zh: 文艺复兴的知识型与中世纪思想截然不同。

epistemic.t: adj. 认知的、知识层面的

e.en: There is real {epistemic} uncertainty about the model's predictions.
e.zh: 对模型的预测存在真正的认知层面的不确定性。

e.en: Scientists must acknowledge their own {epistemic} limitations.
e.zh: 科学家必须承认自身在认知上的局限。

e.en: The claim is {epistemically} weak without supporting evidence.
e.zh: 这种说法在认知上缺乏依据,因而站不住脚。

e.en: We should remain {epistemically} humble about complex issues.
e.zh: 对于复杂问题,我们应保持认知上的谦逊。

e.en: The debate raises deep {epistemological} questions about truth.
e.zh: 这场辩论提出了关于真理的深刻认识论问题。

e.en: His paper takes an {epistemological} approach to AI.
e.zh: 他的论文从认识论的角度探讨人工智能。

e.en: The {epistemologist} argued that knowledge requires justified true belief.
e.zh: 这位认识论学家认为知识需要被证成的真信念。

e.en: She became a leading {epistemologist} of the digital age.
e.zh: 她成为了数字时代的一位顶尖认识论学家。

e.en: Her thesis explores the {epistemology} of scientific discovery.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了科学发现的认识论。

e.en: Philosophy students must study {epistemology} early in their program.
e.zh: 哲学专业学生必须在课程初期学习认识论。

epistle.t: n. 书信（尤指正式或长篇）

e.en: He wrote a long {epistle} to his old college roommate.
e.zh: 他给大学时的老室友写了一封长信。

e.en: The pastor read an {epistle} from Paul during the service.
e.zh: 牧师在礼拜中朗读了保罗的一封书信。

epistolary.t: adj. 书信体的、书信往来的

e.en: The novel has an {epistolary} format told entirely through letters.
e.zh: 这部小说采用书信体,完全通过信件来叙述。

e.en: She loves {epistolary} fiction from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 她喜欢十八世纪的书信体小说。

e.en: His tombstone bore a simple but moving {epitaph}.
e.zh: 他的墓碑上刻着一句简单却动人的墓志铭。

e.en: The poet wrote his own {epitaph} years before his death.
e.zh: 这位诗人在去世多年前就写好了自己的墓志铭。

epitaxy.t: n. 外延（晶体生长技术）

e.en: Modern chip fabrication relies on precise {epitaxy} techniques.
e.zh: 现代芯片制造依赖精密的外延生长技术。

e.en: Researchers improved solar cells using molecular beam {epitaxy}.
e.zh: 研究人员利用分子束外延技术改进了太阳能电池。

epithelial.t: adj. 上皮的、上皮组织的

e.en: The biopsy revealed abnormal {epithelial} cells in the lung.
e.zh: 活检显示肺部存在异常的上皮细胞。

e.en: Scientists are growing {epithelial} tissue in the lab.
e.zh: 科学家正在实验室里培育上皮组织。

e.en: The intestinal {epithelium} absorbs nutrients from food.
e.zh: 肠道上皮负责从食物中吸收营养。

e.en: Smoking damages the delicate {epithelium} lining the lungs.
e.zh: 吸烟会损害肺内娇嫩的上皮组织。

epithet.t: n. 称号、绰号（常含贬义）

e.en: Reporters used the {epithet} to describe the controversial leader.
e.zh: 记者用这个绰号来形容那位有争议的领导人。

e.en: He was given the {epithet} 'the Great' after his victories.
e.zh: 他在多次胜利后被冠以"大帝"的称号。

e.en: She is the {epitome} of grace under pressure.
e.zh: 她是压力下保持优雅的典范。

e.en: That little café is the {epitome} of Parisian charm.
e.zh: 那家小咖啡馆是巴黎魅力的缩影。

epitomise.t: v. 是…的典型、集中体现（英式拼写）

e.en: His career seems to {epitomise} hard work and persistence.
e.zh: 他的职业生涯似乎是勤奋与坚持的典型代表。

e.en: These photos {epitomise} life in 1960s London.
e.zh: 这些照片集中体现了上世纪六十年代伦敦的生活。

epitomize.t: v. 是…的典型、集中体现

e.en: Her novels {epitomize} the spirit of modern feminism.
e.zh: 她的小说体现了现代女性主义的精神。

e.en: Tokyo seems to {epitomize} the blend of old and new.
e.zh: 东京似乎是新旧融合的典型代表。

epitope.t: n. 抗原表位，抗体识别位点

e.en: The vaccine targets a specific {epitope} on the virus surface.
e.zh: 该疫苗针对病毒表面一个特定的抗原表位。

e.en: Researchers identified a new {epitope} for antibody binding.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一个新的抗体结合表位。

epizootic.t:
adj. 动物流行病的
n. 兽类流行病

e.en: An {epizootic} swept through the cattle herds last winter.
e.zh: 去年冬天一场动物流行病席卷了牛群。

e.en: Veterinarians warned of a possible {epizootic} among local horses.
e.zh: 兽医警告当地马匹中可能爆发动物疫病。

epo.t: n. 促红细胞生成素（erythropoietin 缩写）

e.en: Athletes can be banned for using {EPO} to boost endurance.
e.zh: 运动员若使用促红细胞生成素提高耐力会被禁赛。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {EPO} to treat severe anemia in kidney patients.
e.zh: 医生给肾病患者开促红素来治疗严重贫血。

epoch.t:
n. 纪元，时代
n. 时间戳起点

e.en: The internet marked a new {epoch} in human communication.
e.zh: 互联网标志着人类通讯进入了一个新纪元。

e.en: Unix time counts seconds since the {epoch} of January 1970.
e.zh: Unix 时间从 1970 年 1 月这一纪元开始计秒。

epochal.t: adj. 划时代的，开创性的

e.en: The discovery of penicillin was an {epochal} moment in medicine.
e.zh: 青霉素的发现是医学史上划时代的一刻。

e.en: Few inventions have had such an {epochal} impact as the smartphone.
e.zh: 很少有发明能像智能手机那样产生划时代的影响。

eponym.t: n. 以人名命名之物，名祖

e.en: Sandwich is an {eponym} named after the Earl of Sandwich.
e.zh: 三明治是以三明治伯爵命名的名祖词。

e.en: Many diseases are named after their {eponym}, the discovering doctor.
e.zh: 许多疾病都以其名祖——发现该病的医生命名。

eponymous.t: adj. 同名的，以其命名的

e.en: The band released their {eponymous} debut album last year.
e.zh: 这支乐队去年发行了与乐队同名的首张专辑。

e.en: Sherlock Holmes is the {eponymous} hero of Conan Doyle's stories.
e.zh: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯是柯南·道尔小说中的同名主角。

epoxies.t: n. 环氧树脂（epoxy 的复数）

e.en: Modern {epoxies} can bond metal, glass, and plastic together.
e.zh: 现代环氧树脂胶可以把金属、玻璃和塑料粘合在一起。

e.en: The lab tested several {epoxies} for waterproof performance.
e.zh: 实验室测试了几种环氧树脂的防水性能。

epoxy.t:
n. 环氧树脂
v. 用环氧胶粘合

e.en: I used {epoxy} to glue the broken mug back together.
e.zh: 我用环氧树脂胶把摔碎的杯子粘了回去。

e.en: The boat hull is coated with marine-grade {epoxy} resin.
e.zh: 船体涂有船用级别的环氧树脂。

e.en: We took the tube out to {Epping} for a forest walk.
e.zh: 我们坐地铁到埃平去森林里散步。

e.en: {Epping} Forest is a popular weekend escape from London.
e.zh: 埃平森林是伦敦周末郊游的热门去处。

eps.t:
n. 每股收益（earnings per share）
n. EPS 图像格式

e.en: The designer sent the logo as an {EPS} file for printing.
e.zh: 设计师把 logo 以 EPS 文件格式发来用于印刷。

e.en: The company's quarterly {EPS} beat analyst expectations.
e.zh: 该公司季度每股收益超出了分析师预期。

epsilon.t:
n. 希腊字母 ε
n. 极小量

e.en: The proof requires choosing an {epsilon} smaller than one.
e.zh: 该证明需要选取一个小于一的ε值。

e.en: Set the learning rate {epsilon} to a very small value.
e.zh: 将学习率ε设置为一个非常小的值。

epsom.t: n. 埃普瑟姆（英国地名，常指泻盐）

e.en: Soaking in {Epsom} salts helps relieve sore muscles.
e.zh: 用泻盐泡澡有助于缓解肌肉酸痛。

e.en: The famous Derby horse race is held at {Epsom} Downs.
e.zh: 著名的德比赛马大会在埃普索姆草地举行。

epson.t: n. 爱普生（日本打印机品牌）

e.en: My {Epson} printer ran out of cyan ink again.
e.zh: 我的爱普生打印机又没青色墨水了。

e.en: She bought an {Epson} projector for her home theater.
e.zh: 她为家庭影院买了一台爱普生投影仪。

e.en: See {eqn}. 4 in the appendix for the full derivation.
e.zh: 完整推导见附录中的方程 4。

e.en: The textbook references {eqn}. 12 throughout the chapter.
e.zh: 教科书在本章中多次引用方程 12。

equable.t: adj. 平稳的，性情平和的

e.en: She has an {equable} temperament that calms everyone around her.
e.zh: 她性情平和,能让身边的人都安定下来。

e.en: The island enjoys an {equable} climate year-round.
e.zh: 这座岛屿全年气候温和宜人。

e.en: He responded {equably} to the angry customer's complaints.
e.zh: 他心平气和地回应了愤怒顾客的投诉。

e.en: The judge spoke {equably}, even under intense pressure.
e.zh: 即使在巨大压力下,法官说话依然平静沉着。

equal.t:
adj. 相等的，平等的
v. 等于

e.en: All citizens deserve {equal} rights under the law.
e.zh: 所有公民都应在法律下享有平等的权利。

e.en: Two plus three is {equal} to five.
e.zh: 二加三等于五。

equaled.t: v. 等于（equal 的过去式）

e.en: Her sprint time {equaled} the previous world record.
e.zh: 她的短跑成绩追平了此前的世界纪录。

e.en: This year's profits {equaled} those of the previous decade combined.
e.zh: 今年的利润相当于过去十年的总和。

equaling.t: v. 等于（equal 的现在分词）

e.en: He scored thirty points, {equaling} his career best.
e.zh: 他得了三十分,追平了自己的职业生涯最高纪录。

e.en: The donations poured in, {equaling} last year's total in days.
e.zh: 捐款蜂拥而至,几天内就追平了去年的总额。

equalisation.t: n. 均衡化，平等化（英式拼写）

e.en: The fund aims at the {equalisation} of opportunities for rural students.
e.zh: 该基金旨在使农村学生的机会均等化。

e.en: Tax {equalisation} ensures expats are not penalized for working abroad.
e.zh: 税务均等化政策确保外派员工不会因海外工作而吃亏。

equalise.t: v. 使相等，扳平（英式拼写）

e.en: The striker scored late to {equalise} the match.
e.zh: 前锋在最后时刻进球,把比分扳平。

e.en: New laws aim to {equalise} pay between men and women.
e.zh: 新法律旨在使男女薪酬平等。

equaliser.t: n. 均衡器；扳平比分（英式拼写）

e.en: He scored a dramatic {equaliser} in the final minute.
e.zh: 他在最后一分钟踢进了一个戏剧性的扳平球。

e.en: Adjust the {equaliser} to boost the bass on your headphones.
e.zh: 调节均衡器以增强耳机的低音。

e.en: The two {equalities} can be solved simultaneously to find x.
e.zh: 这两个等式可以联立求解 x。

e.en: The report examines racial and gender {equalities} in hiring.
e.zh: 该报告考察了招聘中的种族和性别平等问题。

e.en: The movement fought for racial {equality} in schools.
e.zh: 该运动为学校的种族平等而抗争。

e.en: True gender {equality} requires changes at home and at work.
e.zh: 真正的性别平等需要在家庭和职场都做出改变。

e.en: Divers practice {equalization} to balance pressure in their ears.
e.zh: 潜水员练习耳压平衡以适应水下压力。

e.en: The policy aims at the {equalization} of regional incomes.
e.zh: 该政策旨在实现地区收入的均衡化。

e.en: The team scored late to {equalize} the score.
e.zh: 球队在最后阶段进球,把比分扳平。

e.en: Tax reforms should {equalize} the burden across income groups.
e.zh: 税制改革应使各收入阶层的负担更加均衡。

equalizer.t:
n. 均衡器（音频）
n. 扳平进球

e.en: He blasted in the {equalizer} during stoppage time.
e.zh: 他在补时阶段轰入扳平一球。

e.en: Tweak the audio {equalizer} to make voices sound clearer.
e.zh: 调一下音频均衡器,让人声听起来更清晰。

equalizing.t: v. 使相等（equalize 的现在分词）

e.en: They scored an {equalizing} goal in the eightieth minute.
e.zh: 他们在第八十分钟攻入扳平一球。

e.en: The grant has an {equalizing} effect on poorer school districts.
e.zh: 该补助对较贫困学区起到了均衡的作用。

e.en: The children shared the cake {equally} among themselves.
e.zh: 孩子们把蛋糕平均分给了彼此。

e.en: Both candidates are {equally} qualified for the position.
e.zh: 两位候选人都同样适合这个职位。

equals.t:
v. 等于
n. 同等之物

e.en: In math, two plus two {equals} four.
e.zh: 在数学里,二加二等于四。

e.en: In leadership, she has few {equals} in the industry.
e.zh: 在领导力方面,业内几乎没有人能与她比肩。

e.en: She accepted the bad news with surprising {equanimity}.
e.zh: 她以出人意料的从容接受了这个坏消息。

e.en: Meditation helps me maintain {equanimity} during stressful weeks.
e.zh: 冥想帮助我在压力大的几周里保持心境平和。

e.en: Don't {equate} wealth with happiness — they're different things.
e.zh: 不要把财富等同于幸福——两者并不相同。

e.en: Many parents {equate} good grades with future success.
e.zh: 许多家长把好成绩等同于未来的成功。

equation.t:
n. 方程，等式
n. 平衡关系

e.en: Solve the {equation} to find the value of x.
e.zh: 解这个方程,求 x 的值。

e.en: Cost is just one part of the buying {equation}.
e.zh: 价格只是购买决策中的一个因素而已。

e.en: Maxwell's {equations} describe how electric and magnetic fields behave.
e.zh: 麦克斯韦方程组描述了电场和磁场的行为。

e.en: The exam included five differential {equations} to solve.
e.zh: 考试中包含五道需要求解的微分方程。

e.en: Singapore lies very close to the {equator}.
e.zh: 新加坡非常靠近赤道。

e.en: Temperatures rise as you travel toward the {equator}.
e.zh: 越靠近赤道,气温就越高。

equatorial.t: adj. 赤道的，赤道附近的

e.en: {Equatorial} regions experience little change between seasons.
e.zh: 赤道地区四季变化很小。

e.en: The rainforest thrives in the hot, humid {equatorial} climate.
e.zh: 雨林在炎热潮湿的赤道气候中繁茂生长。

e.en: The royal {equerry} accompanied the prince on official duties.
e.zh: 王室侍从武官陪同王子执行公务。

e.en: He served as {equerry} to the queen for fifteen years.
e.zh: 他担任女王的侍从武官长达十五年。

equestrian.t:
adj. 马术的，骑马的
n. 骑手

e.en: She trained for years to compete at the {equestrian} Olympics.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才参加奥运会马术比赛。

e.en: The park has miles of {equestrian} trails for horseback riding.
e.zh: 公园里有数英里长的骑马小径。

e.en: {Equestrianism} requires both athletic skill and strong bonds with horses.
e.zh: 马术既需要运动技巧,也需要与马建立紧密的联系。

e.en: She has loved {equestrianism} since she was a small child.
e.zh: 她从小就热爱马术运动。

e.en: The town is {equidistant} from both major cities.
e.zh: 这座小镇与两个主要城市的距离相等。

e.en: Plant the seedlings {equidistant} from each other in the row.
e.zh: 把幼苗在行内等距种植。

e.en: All three sides of an {equilateral} triangle are the same length.
e.zh: 等边三角形的三条边长度相等。

e.en: The logo is based on a simple {equilateral} triangle.
e.zh: 该标志基于一个简单的等边三角形。

e.en: Allow the sample to {equilibrate} at room temperature before testing.
e.zh: 测试前让样品在室温下达到平衡。

e.en: The market will eventually {equilibrate} once supply meets demand.
e.zh: 一旦供需匹配,市场最终会达到平衡。

e.en: The {equilibration} of the solution took about thirty minutes.
e.zh: 溶液达到平衡大约用了三十分钟。

e.en: Piaget described learning as a process of cognitive {equilibration}.
e.zh: 皮亚杰将学习描述为一种认知平衡化过程。

equilibria.t: n. 平衡状态（equilibrium 的复数）

e.en: The game has multiple Nash {equilibria} depending on player strategy.
e.zh: 根据玩家策略,该博弈存在多个纳什均衡。

e.en: Chemists study how reactions reach different {equilibria}.
e.zh: 化学家研究反应如何达到不同的平衡状态。

e.en: The economy slowly returned to {equilibrium} after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后,经济慢慢恢复到了均衡状态。

e.en: Yoga helps me find inner {equilibrium} after a hectic day.
e.zh: 瑜伽帮我在忙乱的一天后找回内心的平衡。

e.en: The model predicts several possible {equilibriums} for the system.
e.zh: 该模型预测系统可能存在几种平衡状态。

e.en: Different market {equilibriums} emerge under varying tax policies.
e.zh: 在不同税收政策下,市场会出现不同的均衡。

equine.t:
adj. 马的，似马的
n. 马

e.en: The clinic specializes in {equine} surgery and rehabilitation.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门从事马匹手术和康复治疗。

e.en: She has loved {equine} sports since she was a child.
e.zh: 她从小就热爱马类运动。

equinox.t: n. 昼夜平分点；春分或秋分

e.en: Day and night are roughly equal during the spring {equinox}.
e.zh: 春分时节,昼夜大致等长。

e.en: Many cultures celebrate festivals around the autumn {equinox}.
e.zh: 许多文化都会在秋分前后举行节日庆典。

equip.t: v. 装备；配备；使具备（能力）

e.en: This course will {equip} you with practical coding skills.
e.zh: 这门课程将让你掌握实用的编程技能。

e.en: The army plans to {equip} every soldier with night-vision goggles.
e.zh: 军队计划为每名士兵配备夜视镜。

e.en: The Italian {equipe} dominated the cycling race this season.
e.zh: 意大利车队本赛季在自行车比赛中占据主导地位。

e.en: Each {equipe} sent three riders to the championship.
e.zh: 每支车队派出三名车手参加锦标赛。

e.en: The lab ordered new safety {equipment} for the team.
e.zh: 实验室为团队订购了新的安全设备。

e.en: Hiking requires proper {equipment} like boots and a backpack.
e.zh: 徒步旅行需要靴子和背包等合适的装备。

equipments.t: n. 设备（equipment 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The catalog lists military {equipments} used in the campaign.
e.zh: 目录中列出了战役中使用的各类军事装备。

e.en: Various test {equipments} were shipped to the new facility.
e.zh: 各种测试设备已运往新工厂。

e.en: The dancer held perfect {equipoise} on one foot.
e.zh: 舞者单脚保持着完美的平衡。

e.en: Her mind found {equipoise} after weeks of meditation.
e.zh: 经过数周冥想,她的内心找到了平静。

equipped.t:
v. 装备（equip 的过去式）
adj. 配备好的

e.en: The kitchen is fully {equipped} with modern appliances.
e.zh: 这间厨房配备了齐全的现代家电。

e.en: She felt well {equipped} to handle the new role.
e.zh: 她觉得自己完全有能力胜任新职位。

equipping.t: v. 装备（equip 的现在分词）

e.en: The school is {equipping} every classroom with smart boards.
e.zh: 学校正在为每间教室配备智能白板。

e.en: Training focuses on {equipping} staff with digital skills.
e.zh: 培训重点是让员工掌握数字技能。

equips.t: v. 装备（equip 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This course {equips} students with practical coding skills.
e.zh: 这门课程让学生掌握实用的编程技能。

e.en: The army {equips} each soldier with a standard rifle.
e.zh: 军队为每位士兵配发一支制式步枪。

e.en: We need a more {equitable} distribution of resources.
e.zh: 我们需要更公平地分配资源。

e.en: The judge proposed an {equitable} settlement for both parties.
e.zh: 法官为双方提出了一个公平的和解方案。

e.en: Profits should be shared {equitably} among all partners.
e.zh: 利润应在所有合伙人之间公平分配。

e.en: The teacher distributed attention {equitably} across the class.
e.zh: 老师把注意力公平地分给班上每个人。

equities.t: n. 股票；股权（equity 的复数）

e.en: Investors are shifting money from bonds into {equities}.
e.zh: 投资者正把资金从债券转向股票。

e.en: The fund mainly holds Asian {equities} and tech stocks.
e.zh: 该基金主要持有亚洲股票和科技股。

equity.t:
n. 股权；权益
n. 公平；公正

e.en: She owns a small {equity} stake in the startup.
e.zh: 她持有这家初创公司的小部分股权。

e.en: The school promotes diversity, {equity}, and inclusion.
e.zh: 学校倡导多元、公平与包容。

e.en: There's no exact {equivalence} between these two units.
e.zh: 这两个单位之间没有完全对应的换算。

e.en: The treaty recognizes the {equivalence} of both diplomas.
e.zh: 协议承认两种文凭具有同等效力。

e.en: He earned a high school {equivalency} diploma online.
e.zh: 他在网上拿到了高中同等学力文凭。

e.en: The program checks {equivalency} between foreign degrees.
e.zh: 该项目核查外国学位的同等学力认证。

equivalent.t:
adj. 等价的；相等的
n. 等价物

e.en: One mile is roughly {equivalent} to 1.6 kilometers.
e.zh: 一英里大约相当于1.6公里。

e.en: This app is the Chinese {equivalent} of WhatsApp.
e.zh: 这款应用相当于中国版的WhatsApp。

e.en: You can write the formula {equivalently} as x squared.
e.zh: 这个公式可以等价地写成x的平方。

e.en: Both methods produce {equivalently} accurate results in tests.
e.zh: 在测试中两种方法得出同样精确的结果。

equivalents.t: n. 等价物（equivalent 的复数）

e.en: The dictionary lists Chinese {equivalents} for each English word.
e.zh: 词典为每个英文单词列出了对应的中文词。

e.en: Find vegan {equivalents} for butter and milk in baking.
e.zh: 在烘焙中找到黄油和牛奶的纯素替代品。

equivocal.t: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊的

e.en: Her response to the proposal was disappointingly {equivocal}.
e.zh: 她对该提议的回应含糊其辞,令人失望。

e.en: The test results were {equivocal} and required further analysis.
e.zh: 测试结果模棱两可,需要进一步分析。

equivocate.t: v. 含糊其辞；支吾搪塞

e.en: Don't {equivocate} — just tell me what you decided.
e.zh: 别支支吾吾,直接告诉我你决定了什么。

e.en: Politicians often {equivocate} when asked about tax increases.
e.zh: 政客被问及加税时常常含糊其辞。

equivocation.t: n. 含糊其辞；模棱两可的话

e.en: His answer was full of {equivocation} and empty promises.
e.zh: 他的回答充满了含糊其辞和空洞承诺。

e.en: The CEO denied the rumors without any {equivocation}.
e.zh: 首席执行官毫不含糊地否认了那些传言。

e.en: We are entering a new {era} of artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 我们正在进入人工智能的新时代。

e.en: The Victorian {era} produced many great novels.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代诞生了许多伟大的小说。

e.en: The campaign aims to {eradicate} polio worldwide.
e.zh: 该运动旨在全球范围内根除小儿麻痹症。

e.en: It's hard to {eradicate} bad habits once formed.
e.zh: 坏习惯一旦养成就很难根除。

e.en: The {eradication} of smallpox was a major achievement.
e.zh: 消灭天花是一项重大成就。

e.en: Poverty {eradication} remains a top global priority.
e.zh: 消除贫困仍是全球的首要任务。

e.en: Fashion has changed dramatically across different {eras}.
e.zh: 时尚在不同时代发生了巨大变化。

e.en: Her tour celebrates all the {eras} of her career.
e.zh: 她的巡演庆祝其职业生涯的各个时期。

erasable.t: adj. 可擦除的；可抹去的

e.en: The whiteboard uses {erasable} markers for easy cleanup.
e.zh: 这块白板使用可擦写笔,便于清理。

e.en: Buy an {erasable} pen for your math homework.
e.zh: 买一支可擦写的笔做数学作业吧。

e.en: Tap the button to {erase} all browsing history.
e.zh: 点击按钮即可清除所有浏览记录。

e.en: Nothing can {erase} the memory of that day.
e.zh: 没有什么能抹去那一天的记忆。

erased.t:
v. 擦除（erase 的过去式）
adj. 已被删除的

e.en: She accidentally {erased} the entire spreadsheet.
e.zh: 她不小心删掉了整个电子表格。

e.en: Years of war {erased} the village from the map.
e.zh: 多年的战争将这个村庄从地图上抹去。

e.en: Can I borrow your {eraser} for a second?
e.zh: 能借一下你的橡皮擦吗?

e.en: The pencil has a small {eraser} on top.
e.zh: 这支铅笔顶端有个小橡皮。

erasing.t: v. 擦除（erase 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent an hour {erasing} pencil marks from the drawing.
e.zh: 他花了一小时擦掉画上的铅笔痕迹。

e.en: The update is {erasing} old cached files automatically.
e.zh: 该更新正在自动清除旧的缓存文件。

erasmus.t: n. 伊拉斯谟（人名）；欧盟交换生项目

e.en: She studied in Spain through the {Erasmus} exchange program.
e.zh: 她通过伊拉斯谟交换项目去西班牙留学。

e.en: {Erasmus} was a famous Renaissance humanist scholar.
e.zh: 伊拉斯谟是著名的文艺复兴时期人文主义学者。

erasure.t: n. 擦除；删除；抹去的痕迹

e.en: GDPR gives users the right to data {erasure}.
e.zh: 通用数据保护条例赋予用户数据删除权。

e.en: Critics protested the {erasure} of minority history.
e.zh: 评论人士抗议少数族裔历史被抹除。

erbium.t: n. 铒（化学元素，符号 Er）

e.en: {Erbium} is used in fiber-optic communication amplifiers.
e.zh: 铒被用于光纤通信放大器中。

e.en: The laser contains a small amount of {erbium}.
e.zh: 该激光器含有少量的铒元素。

ercp.t: n. 内镜逆行胰胆管造影（医学检查）

e.en: The doctor scheduled an {ERCP} to examine her bile duct.
e.zh: 医生安排了一次内镜逆行胰胆管造影来检查她的胆管。

e.en: Patients usually fast before undergoing an {ERCP} procedure.
e.zh: 病人在做内镜逆行胰胆管造影前通常需要禁食。

e.en: He vowed to return {ere} the sun set again.
e.zh: 他发誓在日落之前再度归来。

e.en: The poem speaks of love {ere} the dawn breaks.
e.zh: 这首诗讲述了黎明前的爱情。

erect.t:
v. 竖立；建造
adj. 直立的

e.en: The workers will {erect} a tent before the storm.
e.zh: 工人们会在暴风雨前搭起帐篷。

e.en: She sat with an {erect} posture during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她坐姿挺直。

erected.t: v. 竖立（erect 的过去式）

e.en: A statue was {erected} in honor of the founder.
e.zh: 为了纪念创始人,一座雕像被竖立起来。

e.en: They {erected} barriers to keep the crowd safe.
e.zh: 他们设置了护栏以保护人群安全。

e.en: The doctor prescribed medication for his {erectile} dysfunction.
e.zh: 医生为他的勃起功能障碍开了药。

e.en: Stress can contribute to {erectile} problems in men.
e.zh: 压力可能导致男性出现勃起方面的问题。

erecting.t: v. 竖立（erect 的现在分词）

e.en: Crews are {erecting} a new bridge across the river.
e.zh: 工人们正在河上架设一座新桥。

e.en: They spent hours {erecting} the camping tent in wind.
e.zh: 他们在大风中花了几小时搭起露营帐篷。

erection.t:
n. 建造；竖立
n. 勃起

e.en: The {erection} of the new tower took two years.
e.zh: 这座新塔的建造历时两年。

e.en: The project covers the {erection} of three wind turbines.
e.zh: 该项目包括三台风力涡轮机的安装。

erector.t: n. 竖立者；建造者；竖立肌

e.en: The steel {erector} carefully bolted the beams together.
e.zh: 钢结构安装工小心地将梁螺栓固定在一起。

e.en: He bought his son an {erector} set for Christmas.
e.zh: 他给儿子买了一套金属积木作为圣诞礼物。

erects.t: v. 竖立（erect 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Each spring, the city {erects} a stage in the park.
e.zh: 每年春天,市政府都会在公园里搭起一个舞台。

e.en: The company {erects} prefabricated houses in just days.
e.zh: 该公司只需几天就能搭建好预制房屋。

e.en: One {erg} is a tiny unit of energy in physics.
e.zh: 在物理学中,一尔格是非常小的能量单位。

e.en: Rowers train daily on the {erg} machine indoors.
e.zh: 赛艇运动员每天在室内的划船机上训练。

e.en: I think, {ergo} I am — Descartes' famous line.
e.zh: 我思故我在——笛卡尔的名言。

e.en: The store is closed; {ergo}, we'll cook at home.
e.zh: 商店关门了,所以我们在家做饭吧。

e.en: He measured his cycling power on the {ergometer}.
e.zh: 他用功率计测量了自己的骑行功率。

e.en: The gym installed a new rowing {ergometer} yesterday.
e.zh: 健身房昨天安装了一台新的划船测力计。

e.en: Buy an {ergonomic} chair to protect your back.
e.zh: 买一把符合人体工学的椅子保护你的背部。

e.en: The keyboard has an {ergonomic} split design.
e.zh: 这款键盘采用人体工学分体设计。

e.en: The mouse is {ergonomically} shaped to reduce wrist strain.
e.zh: 这款鼠标采用人体工学外形,可减轻手腕负担。

e.en: Office furniture should be {ergonomically} designed for long use.
e.zh: 办公家具应按人体工学设计以便长时间使用。

ergonomics.t: n. 人体工程学；人因工学

e.en: Good {ergonomics} can prevent neck and back pain.
e.zh: 良好的人体工学可以预防颈背疼痛。

e.en: The company hired a specialist in workplace {ergonomics}.
e.zh: 公司聘请了一位职场人体工学专家。

e.en: {Erica} brought homemade cookies to the office today.
e.zh: 艾丽卡今天带了自制饼干到办公室。

e.en: My neighbor planted pink {erica} along the garden path.
e.zh: 我邻居在花园小径旁种了粉色的欧石南。

ericsson.t: n. 爱立信（瑞典通信公司）

e.en: {Ericsson} is a major Swedish telecom equipment maker.
e.zh: 爱立信是一家主要的瑞典电信设备制造商。

e.en: She works as an engineer at {Ericsson} in Stockholm.
e.zh: 她在斯德哥尔摩的爱立信担任工程师。

eritrea.t: n. 厄立特里亚（东非国家）

e.en: {Eritrea} gained independence from Ethiopia in 1993.
e.zh: 厄立特里亚于1993年从埃塞俄比亚独立。

e.en: The capital of {Eritrea} is Asmara.
e.zh: 厄立特里亚的首都是阿斯马拉。

eritrean.t:
adj. 厄立特里亚的
n. 厄立特里亚人

e.en: We tried an {Eritrean} restaurant for dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们去一家厄立特里亚餐厅吃了晚饭。

e.en: He shared stories about {Eritrean} coffee ceremonies.
e.zh: 他分享了厄立特里亚咖啡仪式的故事。

e.en: {Erm}, I'm not really sure how to answer that.
e.zh: 呃,我真的不太确定该怎么回答。

e.en: "{Erm}, could you repeat the question please?" she asked.
e.zh: 她问:“呃,能再说一遍问题吗?”

ermine.t:
n. 白鼬
n. 貂皮（礼袍用）

e.en: The judge wore a robe trimmed with white {ermine} fur.
e.zh: 法官穿着一件饰有白色貂皮的长袍。

e.en: An {ermine} darted across the snowy field at dawn.
e.zh: 一只白鼬在黎明时分窜过雪地。

e.en: The {ern} soared above the rocky coast searching for fish.
e.zh: 那只海雕在岩石海岸上空盘旋寻找鱼。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {ern} nesting on the cliff.
e.zh: 观鸟者发现一只罕见的海雕在悬崖上筑巢。

e.en: The {erne} is another name for the white-tailed sea eagle.
e.zh: erne是白尾海雕的另一个名称。

e.en: A majestic {erne} circled high above the fjord.
e.zh: 一只雄伟的海雕在峡湾上空高高盘旋。

e.en: Constant rain can {erode} even the hardest rock.
e.zh: 持续的降雨甚至能侵蚀最坚硬的岩石。

e.en: Repeated scandals {erode} public trust in the government.
e.zh: 接连不断的丑闻削弱了公众对政府的信任。

eroded.t: adj. 被侵蚀的；被削弱的

e.en: The cliffs have been heavily {eroded} by the sea.
e.zh: 那些悬崖被海水严重侵蚀了。

e.en: Years of misinformation have {eroded} confidence in the media.
e.zh: 多年的虚假信息已经削弱了人们对媒体的信任。

eroding.t: v. 正在侵蚀；逐渐削弱

e.en: Inflation is steadily {eroding} household purchasing power.
e.zh: 通货膨胀正在稳步侵蚀家庭的购买力。

e.en: The river is slowly {eroding} the bank near the bridge.
e.zh: 河水正在慢慢冲刷桥附近的河岸。

e.en: The neck is often considered an {erogenous} zone.
e.zh: 颈部常被视为一个性敏感区。

e.en: Different people have different {erogenous} areas on their bodies.
e.zh: 不同的人身上有不同的性敏感部位。

eros.t:
n. 厄洛斯（希腊爱神）
n. 性爱

e.en: Greek myths often describe {eros} as a powerful, irrational force.
e.zh: 希腊神话常将爱欲描述为一种强大而非理性的力量。

e.en: The novel explores the tension between {eros} and duty.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了爱欲与责任之间的冲突。

e.en: Coastal {erosion} is threatening homes along the shore.
e.zh: 海岸侵蚀正在威胁沿岸的房屋。

e.en: There has been a steady {erosion} of workers' rights.
e.zh: 工人权利一直在持续被削弱。

e.en: The canyon shows clear {erosional} patterns from ancient rivers.
e.zh: 峡谷展示出古河流形成的清晰侵蚀痕迹。

e.en: Geologists studied the {erosional} forces shaping the valley.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了塑造这条山谷的侵蚀力量。

e.en: Heavy rainfall has a strong {erosive} effect on hillsides.
e.zh: 强降雨对山坡有很强的侵蚀作用。

e.en: Constant criticism can be {erosive} to a child's confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评会逐渐侵蚀孩子的自信心。

e.en: The film contains several {erotic} scenes unsuitable for children.
e.zh: 这部电影含有几个不适合儿童观看的情色场景。

e.en: She writes {erotic} poetry that explores desire and intimacy.
e.zh: 她写情色诗,探讨欲望与亲密关系。

e.en: The bookstore has a small section dedicated to {erotica}.
e.zh: 那家书店有一个小区域专门陈列情色文学。

e.en: Online platforms have made {erotica} far more accessible.
e.zh: 网络平台让情色作品变得更容易获取。

e.en: She danced {erotically} under the dim red lights.
e.zh: 她在昏暗的红灯下跳着撩人的舞。

e.en: The novel describes their meeting in {erotically} charged language.
e.zh: 小说用充满情欲色彩的语言描写了他们的相遇。

e.en: Advertisers often {eroticise} everyday products to grab attention.
e.zh: 广告商常把日常产品情色化来吸引注意力。

e.en: Some critics argue the show tends to {eroticise} violence.
e.zh: 一些评论家认为该剧倾向于将暴力情色化。

e.en: The painting is famous for its subtle {eroticism}.
e.zh: 这幅画因其含蓄的情色意味而闻名。

e.en: Her novels blend romance with a quiet sense of {eroticism}.
e.zh: 她的小说将浪漫与一种含蓄的情色感融合在一起。

e.en: Western media has long {eroticized} certain Asian stereotypes.
e.zh: 西方媒体长期将某些亚洲形象情色化。

e.en: The campaign was criticized for its {eroticized} portrayal of teenagers.
e.zh: 该广告因将青少年情色化而受到批评。

e.en: It's better to {err} on the side of caution.
e.zh: 宁可谨慎一点也不要冒险。

e.en: Even the best engineers occasionally {err} in their calculations.
e.zh: 即便最优秀的工程师偶尔也会在计算上出错。

e.en: I need to run a quick {errand} after work.
e.zh: 下班后我得去办点小事。

e.en: She sent her son on an {errand} to the grocery store.
e.zh: 她让儿子去杂货店帮忙跑趟腿。

errant.t: adj. 行为出格的；离群的

e.en: An {errant} email leaked the company's quarterly results early.
e.zh: 一封发错的邮件提前泄露了公司的季度业绩。

e.en: The teacher gently corrected the {errant} student.
e.zh: 老师温和地纠正了那个犯错的学生。

erratic.t: adj. 反复无常的；不规律的

e.en: His driving became {erratic} after the long shift.
e.zh: 长时间值班后,他的驾驶变得飘忽不定。

e.en: The stock market has been {erratic} all week.
e.zh: 股市这一整周都波动不定。

e.en: The old printer behaves {erratically} when the office gets warm.
e.zh: 办公室一变热,那台旧打印机就会反复出毛病。

e.en: He swerved {erratically} across the lanes before pulling over.
e.zh: 他在车道间忽左忽右地变线后才靠边停下。

erring.t: adj. 犯错的；行为不端的

e.en: The coach was patient with his {erring} young players.
e.zh: 教练对那些经常犯错的年轻球员很有耐心。

e.en: I'm {erring} toward accepting the offer despite the lower salary.
e.zh: 尽管薪水较低,我还是倾向于接受这份工作。

e.en: The article was based on {erroneous} statistics from an old report.
e.zh: 这篇文章基于一份旧报告中的错误数据。

e.en: Many people hold {erroneous} beliefs about how vaccines work.
e.zh: 许多人对疫苗的作用方式持有错误的看法。

e.en: The package was {erroneously} delivered to the wrong address.
e.zh: 这个包裹被错送到了错误的地址。

e.en: He was {erroneously} identified as the suspect by witnesses.
e.zh: 他被目击者错误地指认为嫌疑人。

error.t: n. 错误；差错（程序报错）

e.en: The app crashed and showed a strange {error} message.
e.zh: 应用崩溃了,弹出一条奇怪的错误信息。

e.en: Submitting the form caused a 500 server {error}.
e.zh: 提交表单导致了500服务器错误。

e.en: The compiler found three syntax {errors} in your code.
e.zh: 编译器在你的代码里发现了三个语法错误。

e.en: Please fix the spelling {errors} before publishing the post.
e.zh: 发帖前请先修正拼写错误。

ersatz.t:
adj. 代用的；劣质替代的
n. 代用品

e.en: The cafe serves {ersatz} maple syrup made from corn.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆供应用玉米做的代用枫糖浆。

e.en: Critics dismissed the film as an {ersatz} version of the original.
e.zh: 评论家批评这部电影是原作的拙劣仿制品。

e.en: He met up with his {erstwhile} colleagues at the reunion.
e.zh: 他在聚会上见到了昔日的同事。

e.en: The {erstwhile} rivals are now business partners.
e.zh: 昔日的对手如今成了生意伙伴。

erudite.t: adj. 博学的；学识渊博的

e.en: The professor gave an {erudite} lecture on medieval poetry.
e.zh: 那位教授做了一场关于中世纪诗歌的渊博讲座。

e.en: Her writing is {erudite} but still accessible to general readers.
e.zh: 她的文笔学识渊博,但普通读者依然能看懂。

e.en: His {erudition} in classical languages impressed the entire faculty.
e.zh: 他在古典语言方面的博学让全院教师都印象深刻。

e.en: The book displays remarkable {erudition} on Renaissance art.
e.zh: 这本书展现了对文艺复兴艺术的非凡学识。

erupt.t: v. 喷发（火山）；突然爆发

e.en: Scientists fear the volcano could {erupt} within months.
e.zh: 科学家担心这座火山可能在几个月内喷发。

e.en: Protests are likely to {erupt} if prices keep rising.
e.zh: 如果物价继续上涨,抗议很可能会爆发。

erupted.t: v. erupt 的过去式；喷发了

e.en: The crowd {erupted} in cheers when the goal was scored.
e.zh: 进球时,观众爆发出欢呼。

e.en: Mount Vesuvius {erupted} catastrophically in 79 AD.
e.zh: 维苏威火山在公元79年发生了毁灭性的喷发。

erupting.t: v. erupt 的现在分词；正在爆发

e.en: Lava is {erupting} from a new fissure on the island.
e.zh: 岛上的一道新裂缝正在喷发岩浆。

e.en: Arguments kept {erupting} between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 那两位同事之间不断爆发争吵。

eruption.t: n. 火山喷发；（事件、情绪）爆发

e.en: The volcanic {eruption} forced thousands to evacuate the region.
e.zh: 火山喷发迫使数千人撤离该地区。

e.en: His comment caused an {eruption} of laughter in the room.
e.zh: 他的话让屋里爆发出一阵笑声。

eruptions.t: n. eruption 的复数；多次喷发

e.en: The island has experienced several major {eruptions} this century.
e.zh: 本世纪以来,这座岛屿经历了几次大规模火山喷发。

e.en: Sudden {eruptions} of anger made him hard to work with.
e.zh: 突如其来的怒火让他很难共事。

eruptive.t: adj. 喷发性的；易爆发的

e.en: The region is known for its {eruptive} geological activity.
e.zh: 该地区以其活跃的火山地质活动而闻名。

e.en: He has an {eruptive} temper that surprises new colleagues.
e.zh: 他脾气暴躁,常让新同事吃惊。

erupts.t: v. erupt 的第三人称单数

e.en: Whenever the team scores, the stadium {erupts} in noise.
e.zh: 球队一进球,整个球场就爆发出震耳的喧闹声。

e.en: Conflict often {erupts} between the two neighboring villages.
e.zh: 那两个邻村之间经常爆发冲突。

e.en: The patient developed mild {erythema} around the injection site.
e.zh: 患者注射部位周围出现了轻微红斑。

e.en: Sunburn is a common cause of {erythema} on the skin.
e.zh: 晒伤是皮肤红斑的常见原因。

erythematous.t: adj. 红斑性的；皮肤发红的

e.en: The doctor noted an {erythematous} rash on the child's arm.
e.zh: 医生注意到孩子手臂上有红斑样皮疹。

e.en: An {erythematous} reaction may indicate an allergic response.
e.zh: 出现红斑反应可能提示过敏反应。

e.en: Each {erythrocyte} carries oxygen from the lungs to body tissues.
e.zh: 每个红细胞将氧气从肺部输送到身体组织。

e.en: The {erythrocyte} count was lower than the normal range.
e.zh: 红细胞计数低于正常范围。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {erythromycin} for her chest infection.
e.zh: 医生给她开了红霉素治疗胸部感染。

e.en: {Erythromycin} is often used for patients allergic to penicillin.
e.zh: 红霉素常用于对青霉素过敏的患者。

e.en: The kidneys produce {erythropoietin} to stimulate red blood cell creation.
e.zh: 肾脏分泌促红细胞生成素来刺激红细胞的生成。

e.en: Some athletes have been caught doping with synthetic {erythropoietin}.
e.zh: 一些运动员因使用合成促红细胞生成素被查出兴奋剂违规。

esa.t: n. 欧洲航天局（European Space Agency）

e.en: The {esa} successfully launched a new Earth observation satellite.
e.zh: 欧洲航天局成功发射了一颗新的地球观测卫星。

e.en: NASA and the {esa} are collaborating on a Mars mission.
e.zh: 美国国家航空航天局和欧洲航天局正在合作进行火星任务。

e.en: In the Bible, {Esau} sold his birthright for a bowl of stew.
e.zh: 在《圣经》中,以扫为了一碗炖菜卖掉了长子继承权。

e.en: The story of Jacob and {Esau} explores rivalry between brothers.
e.zh: 雅各和以扫的故事探讨了兄弟之间的争斗。

e.en: Press {Esc} to close the dialog without saving.
e.zh: 按Esc键可关闭对话框且不保存。

e.en: You can hit {Esc} to exit fullscreen mode.
e.zh: 你可以按Esc键退出全屏模式。

escalate.t: v. 升级；逐步加剧；上报（问题）

e.en: Please {escalate} this ticket to the senior support team.
e.zh: 请把这个工单升级给高级支持团队。

e.en: Tensions could {escalate} quickly if no agreement is reached.
e.zh: 如果达不成协议,紧张局势可能会迅速升级。

escalated.t: v. escalate 的过去式；已加剧

e.en: The argument quickly {escalated} into a full-blown shouting match.
e.zh: 争吵很快升级为一场激烈的对骂。

e.en: After two hours, the customer's complaint was {escalated} to a manager.
e.zh: 两小时后,这位顾客的投诉被上报给经理处理。

escalates.t: v. escalate 的第三人称单数

e.en: If the issue {escalates}, please notify the on-call engineer.
e.zh: 如果问题升级,请通知值班工程师。

e.en: Pressure on the central bank {escalates} as inflation persists.
e.zh: 随着通胀持续,央行承受的压力不断加大。

escalating.t: v. 正在升级；持续加剧

e.en: Companies are worried about {escalating} energy costs this winter.
e.zh: 企业担心今年冬天不断上涨的能源成本。

e.en: The {escalating} conflict has displaced millions of civilians.
e.zh: 不断升级的冲突已使数百万平民流离失所。

escalation.t: n. 升级；加剧；上报流程

e.en: The protest led to a serious {escalation} of tensions.
e.zh: 抗议导致紧张局势严重升级。

e.en: Customer support flagged the issue for {escalation} to engineering.
e.zh: 客服将该问题升级转交给工程团队。

e.en: Take the {escalator} to the second floor for menswear.
e.zh: 乘自动扶梯到二楼男装区。

e.en: The {escalator} broke down during the morning rush.
e.zh: 自动扶梯在早高峰时坏了。

e.en: The mall installed new {escalators} between every floor.
e.zh: 商场在每层之间装了新的自动扶梯。

e.en: Both {escalators} were under maintenance this weekend.
e.zh: 两部自动扶梯本周末都在维修。

escapade.t: n. 恶作剧；出格的冒险

e.en: Their midnight {escapade} ended with a call from the police.
e.zh: 他们的午夜冒险以警察来电告终。

e.en: She laughed about her teenage {escapade} years later.
e.zh: 多年后她笑谈起自己少年时的胡闹。

escape.t:
v. 逃跑；逃离
n. 逃脱；退出键

e.en: Press Esc to {escape} the full-screen view.
e.zh: 按 Esc 键退出全屏视图。

e.en: Weekend hikes are her favorite {escape} from work.
e.zh: 周末徒步是她逃离工作的最佳方式。

escaped.t: v. escape 的过去式；逃走了

e.en: The cat {escaped} through the open window last night.
e.zh: 猫昨晚从开着的窗户跑了出去。

e.en: That detail completely {escaped} my notice.
e.zh: 那个细节我完全没注意到。

e.en: Police are searching for the prison {escapee} downtown.
e.zh: 警方正在市区搜捕越狱逃犯。

e.en: The {escapee} was caught two blocks from the jail.
e.zh: 逃犯在距监狱两个街区处被抓获。

e.en: The watchmaker carefully repaired the tiny {escapement}.
e.zh: 钟表匠仔细修理了那个微小的擒纵机构。

e.en: A reliable {escapement} keeps the clock running on time.
e.zh: 可靠的擒纵机构让时钟走时准确。

e.en: The famous {escaper} broke out of three prisons.
e.zh: 那位著名越狱者曾从三所监狱中逃脱。

e.en: Guards finally cornered the {escaper} in the woods.
e.zh: 狱警最终在树林里将逃脱者围住。

escapes.t:
v. escape 的第三人称单数
n. 多次逃脱

e.en: The author {escapes} into fiction whenever life gets hard.
e.zh: 每当生活艰难,作者就躲进小说里。

e.en: Few hostages made successful {escapes} from the building.
e.zh: 很少有人质成功从该大楼逃脱。

escaping.t: v. 正在逃离；转义（字符）

e.en: Gas was {escaping} from the cracked pipe.
e.zh: 煤气正从裂开的管道里漏出来。

e.en: He spent the weekend {escaping} city noise in the mountains.
e.zh: 他周末躲到山里逃离城市的喧嚣。

e.en: Video games offer pure {escapism} after a long day.
e.zh: 漫长的一天后,电子游戏带来纯粹的逃避感。

e.en: Critics dismissed the novel as shallow {escapism}.
e.zh: 评论家把这部小说斥为肤浅的逃避主义。

escapist.t:
adj. 逃避现实的
n. 逃避现实者

e.en: She loves {escapist} fantasy novels on rainy weekends.
e.zh: 她喜欢在下雨的周末看逃避现实的奇幻小说。

e.en: The film is pure {escapist} entertainment.
e.zh: 这部电影纯属逃避现实的娱乐片。

e.en: Houdini was the most famous {escapologist} of his era.
e.zh: 胡迪尼是那个时代最著名的脱逃术表演者。

e.en: The {escapologist} freed himself from the locked tank.
e.zh: 脱逃术师从锁住的水箱中挣脱出来。

e.en: We ordered {escargot} as a starter at the French bistro.
e.zh: 我们在法式小馆点了焗蜗牛作为前菜。

e.en: The {escargot} was served with garlic butter and parsley.
e.zh: 焗蜗牛配着蒜香黄油和欧芹端上桌。

e.en: She tossed fresh {escarole} into the white bean soup.
e.zh: 她把新鲜的阔叶菊苣加进白豆汤里。

e.en: This salad uses {escarole} instead of romaine.
e.zh: 这道沙拉用阔叶菊苣代替罗马生菜。

e.en: Hikers paused to admire the view from the {escarpment}.
e.zh: 徒步者在悬崖陡坡上驻足欣赏风景。

e.en: A steep {escarpment} runs along the edge of the plateau.
e.zh: 高原边缘有一道陡峭的峭壁。

e.en: The burn left a hard {eschar} on her forearm.
e.zh: 烧伤在她的前臂上留下一块硬痂。

e.en: Doctors examined the {eschar} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查焦痂是否有感染迹象。

eschatological.t: adj. 末世论的；关于末日的

e.en: The sermon dwelled on {eschatological} themes of judgment.
e.zh: 这场布道侧重于末世审判的主题。

e.en: Her thesis explores {eschatological} imagery in medieval art.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨中世纪艺术中的末世意象。

e.en: The course covers {eschatology} across world religions.
e.zh: 该课程涵盖世界各宗教的末世论。

e.en: Christian {eschatology} centers on the second coming.
e.zh: 基督教末世论的核心是基督再临。

escherichia.t: n. 埃希氏菌属（如大肠杆菌）

e.en: The lab cultured {escherichia} coli for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室为实验培养了大肠杆菌。

e.en: Researchers study {escherichia} to understand gut bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员通过研究埃希氏菌了解肠道细菌。

e.en: Many minimalists {eschew} owning more than one bag.
e.zh: 许多极简主义者拒绝拥有不止一个包。

e.en: The author tends to {eschew} flowery language entirely.
e.zh: 该作者倾向于完全避开华丽辞藻。

e.en: The series dramatizes the rise of Pablo {Escobar}.
e.zh: 该剧戏剧化地演绎了巴勃罗·埃斯科巴的崛起。

e.en: {Escobar} once ran the world's largest cocaine cartel.
e.zh: 埃斯科巴曾掌管世界最大的可卡因贩毒集团。

escort.t:
v. 护送；陪同
n. 护卫；陪同者

e.en: A security guard will {escort} you to the parking lot.
e.zh: 保安会护送你到停车场。

e.en: The convoy traveled with a police {escort}.
e.zh: 车队在警车护卫下行进。

escorted.t: v. escort 的过去式；已陪同

e.en: The host {escorted} guests to their assigned tables.
e.zh: 主持人把客人引到各自的桌位。

e.en: She was {escorted} from the building by security.
e.zh: 她被保安护送出了大楼。

escrow.t: n. 第三方托管；代管协议

e.en: The buyer placed the deposit in {escrow}.
e.zh: 买家将定金存入第三方托管账户。

e.en: Funds remain in {escrow} until both parties sign.
e.zh: 资金会一直由第三方托管,直到双方签字。

escudo.t: n. 葡萄牙旧货币单位

e.en: Portugal used the {escudo} before adopting the euro.
e.zh: 葡萄牙在采用欧元之前使用埃斯库多。

e.en: He found an old {escudo} coin in his grandfather's drawer.
e.zh: 他在祖父的抽屉里发现一枚旧埃斯库多硬币。

escutcheon.t: n. 盾形纹章；锁眼盖板

e.en: The family {escutcheon} hung above the fireplace.
e.zh: 家族纹章盾牌挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: A brass {escutcheon} surrounded the keyhole on the door.
e.zh: 门上的钥匙孔周围镶着一块黄铜锁眼盖。

e.en: The train from Waterloo stops at {Esher} every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 从滑铁卢出发的列车每二十分钟在埃舍尔停一次。

e.en: They moved to a quiet street in {Esher} last spring.
e.zh: 他们去年春天搬到了埃舍尔一条安静的街上。

esk.t: n. 埃斯克河（英国河流名）

e.en: The river {Esk} winds through the Scottish countryside.
e.zh: 埃斯克河蜿蜒穿过苏格兰乡村。

e.en: We fished for salmon along the {Esk} all morning.
e.zh: 我们整个上午都在埃斯克河边钓鲑鱼。

eskimo.t:
n. 爱斯基摩人
adj. 爱斯基摩的

e.en: The museum displayed traditional {Eskimo} hunting tools.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了传统的因纽特人狩猎工具。

e.en: Many prefer Inuit over the older term {Eskimo}.
e.zh: 许多人更偏好用因纽特人,而非旧称爱斯基摩人。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests for {esophageal} reflux.
e.zh: 医生开了食管反流的检查。

e.en: Smoking greatly increases the risk of {esophageal} cancer.
e.zh: 吸烟会大大增加食管癌的风险。

e.en: Chronic acid reflux can lead to {esophagitis}.
e.zh: 长期胃酸反流会引发食管炎。

e.en: The endoscopy confirmed mild {esophagitis}.
e.zh: 内镜检查确诊为轻度食管炎。

e.en: Food travels down the {esophagus} to the stomach.
e.zh: 食物经食管向下进入胃部。

e.en: A fish bone got stuck in his {esophagus}.
e.zh: 一根鱼刺卡在他的食管里。

e.en: The lecture used {esoteric} jargon only experts understood.
e.zh: 讲座用了只有专家才懂的深奥术语。

e.en: He collects {esoteric} books on medieval alchemy.
e.zh: 他收藏关于中世纪炼金术的冷僻书籍。

esoterica.t: n. 冷门知识；小众事物

e.en: The shop specializes in occult {esoterica} and rare prints.
e.zh: 那家店专营神秘学典籍和稀有版画。

e.en: His blog explores cinematic {esoterica} from the 1970s.
e.zh: 他的博客探讨七十年代的冷门电影。

esp.t: n. 超感知觉（extrasensory perception 缩写）

e.en: He claims to have {ESP} that warns him of danger.
e.zh: 他声称自己有能预警危险的超感官知觉。

e.en: Scientists remain skeptical that {ESP} actually exists.
e.zh: 科学家们仍怀疑超感官知觉是否真实存在。

e.en: The Renault {Espace} is a popular family minivan in Europe.
e.zh: 雷诺 Espace 是欧洲很受欢迎的家用 MPV。

e.en: French signs often label the lobby as {espace} d'accueil.
e.zh: 法语标识常把大厅标为 espace d'accueil(接待区)。

e.en: She wore a linen dress and a single {espadrille} sandal.
e.zh: 她穿着亚麻连衣裙和一只草编凉鞋。

e.en: The {espadrille} has a soft jute-rope sole.
e.zh: 这种帆布鞋有一层柔软的黄麻绳鞋底。

espalier.t:
n. 墙面整枝果树
v. 整枝栽培

e.en: Gardeners {espalier} pear trees against the south wall.
e.zh: 园丁把梨树整形贴在南墙上生长。

e.en: An {espalier} apple tree decorates the courtyard fence.
e.zh: 一棵整形苹果树装点着庭院的栅栏。

espaliered.t: adj. 经墙面整枝栽培的

e.en: The {espaliered} fruit trees lined the brick wall neatly.
e.zh: 经过整形的果树整齐地排列在砖墙旁。

e.en: She {espaliered} the young pear against a sunny fence.
e.zh: 她把那棵小梨树整形固定在向阳的栅栏上。

e.en: The travel poster proudly read "Visit {España}".
e.zh: 那张旅游海报骄傲地写着"来西班牙吧"。

e.en: He cheered loudly whenever {España} scored a goal.
e.zh: 每当西班牙队进球,他都大声欢呼。

e.en: This project requires {especial} attention to safety details.
e.zh: 这个项目需要对安全细节给予特别关注。

e.en: He took {especial} care wrapping the fragile vase.
e.zh: 他格外小心地包装那只易碎的花瓶。

e.en: Traffic gets bad downtown, {especially} on Friday evenings.
e.zh: 市中心很堵,尤其是周五傍晚。

e.en: She loves seafood, {especially} fresh oysters.
e.zh: 她喜欢海鲜,特别是新鲜的生蚝。

e.en: He learned {Esperanto} hoping to find an international community.
e.zh: 他学世界语,希望能融入国际社群。

e.en: {Esperanto} was designed to be easy for anyone to learn.
e.zh: 世界语被设计成人人都易于学习。

e.en: The agent was arrested on charges of {espionage}.
e.zh: 那名特工因间谍罪被捕。

e.en: Corporate {espionage} cost the firm millions in lost research.
e.zh: 商业间谍活动让该公司损失了数百万的研究成果。

e.en: Couples strolled along the seafront {esplanade} at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下,情侣们沿着海滨步道散步。

e.en: Street musicians played near the city {esplanade}.
e.zh: 街头艺人在城市滨海大道附近演奏。

e.en: Her public {espousal} of the cause surprised many colleagues.
e.zh: 她公开支持这项事业让许多同事感到意外。

e.en: The party's {espousal} of reform won younger voters.
e.zh: 该党对改革的拥护赢得了年轻选民的支持。

espouse.t: v. 支持；信奉（某种主张）

e.en: Several senators began to {espouse} stricter privacy laws.
e.zh: 几位参议员开始支持更严格的隐私法。

e.en: The startup founders {espouse} a remote-first culture.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的创始人推崇远程优先的文化。

e.en: He ordered a double {espresso} to wake himself up.
e.zh: 他点了一杯双份浓缩咖啡来提神。

e.en: The café roasts its own beans for the {espresso}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆自己烘豆制作浓缩咖啡。

e.en: The team showed remarkable {esprit} during the championship run.
e.zh: 球队在冠军征程中展现出非凡的团队精神。

e.en: Her witty remarks revealed a sharp {esprit} at dinner.
e.zh: 她机智的话语在晚宴上显露出敏锐的才思。

e.en: From the hilltop you can {espy} the distant village.
e.zh: 从山顶你可以远远望见那个村庄。

e.en: I {espy} a familiar face across the crowded room.
e.zh: 我在拥挤的房间里瞥见了一张熟悉的面孔。

esq.t: n. 先生（Esquire 的缩写，用于姓名后）

e.en: The letter was addressed to John Smith, {Esq}.
e.zh: 这封信是寄给约翰·史密斯律师的。

e.en: Please contact Mary Jones, {Esq}., for legal advice.
e.zh: 请联系玛丽·琼斯律师咨询法律事宜。

esquire.t: n. 先生（姓名后的尊称）

e.en: The envelope was addressed to Robert Brown, {Esquire}.
e.zh: 信封上写着收件人罗伯特·布朗先生。

e.en: In medieval times, an {esquire} attended a knight.
e.zh: 在中世纪,侍从负责服侍骑士。

esrc.t: n. 英国经济与社会研究委员会

e.en: The {ESRC} funds social science research across the UK.
e.zh: 经济与社会研究委员会资助英国各地的社会科学研究。

e.en: She received a generous {ESRC} grant for her doctoral work.
e.zh: 她获得了一笔丰厚的经社研究委员会博士奖学金。

ess.t: n. 字母 S；S 形物

e.en: The road curved into a graceful {ess} shape.
e.zh: 道路弯成了优美的S形。

e.en: He drew a perfect {ess} on the chalkboard.
e.zh: 他在黑板上画了一个完美的S形。

essay.t:
n. 文章；论文
v. 尝试

e.en: She wrote an {essay} about climate change for class.
e.zh: 她为课堂写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。

e.en: The students will {essay} a difficult math problem today.
e.zh: 学生们今天将尝试解决一道难题。

e.en: Montaigne is considered a pioneering French {essayist}.
e.zh: 蒙田被视为法国散文写作的先驱。

e.en: The {essayist} explored memory and loss in her latest book.
e.zh: 这位散文家在新书中探讨了记忆与失落。

e.en: His novel has an {essayistic} quality, full of digressions.
e.zh: 他的小说带有散文式的风格,充满了离题之笔。

e.en: The documentary takes an {essayistic} approach to its subject.
e.zh: 这部纪录片以随笔式的方式探讨主题。

essayists.t: n. 散文家们（essayist 的复数）

e.en: Modern {essayists} often blog about everyday life online.
e.zh: 现代散文作家常在网上撰写关于日常生活的博客。

e.en: The anthology features {essayists} from twelve countries.
e.zh: 这本选集收录了来自十二个国家的散文家作品。

essays.t:
n. 文章（复数）
v. 尝试（第三人称单数）

e.en: She publishes personal {essays} on her popular blog.
e.zh: 她在自己热门的博客上发表个人随笔。

e.en: The professor assigned three {essays} this semester.
e.zh: 教授这学期布置了三篇论文。

e.en: {Essen} is an industrial city in western Germany.
e.zh: 埃森是德国西部的一座工业城市。

e.en: The conference will be held in {Essen} next month.
e.zh: 会议下个月将在埃森举行。

e.en: Freedom is the very {essence} of democracy.
e.zh: 自由正是民主的本质。

e.en: Add a few drops of vanilla {essence} to the batter.
e.zh: 在面糊里加几滴香草精。

e.en: The shop sells natural {essences} for aromatherapy.
e.zh: 这家店出售用于芳香疗法的天然精油。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {essences} of beauty and truth.
e.zh: 哲学家们辩论美与真理的本质。

essene.t: n. 艾赛尼派（古犹太教派成员）

e.en: The {Essene} community lived ascetically near the Dead Sea.
e.zh: 艾赛尼派社团在死海附近过着苦行生活。

e.en: Scholars believe an {Essene} sect wrote the Dead Sea Scrolls.
e.zh: 学者认为艾赛尼派宗派撰写了死海古卷。

essential.t:
adj. 必不可少的；本质的
n. 必需品

e.en: Water is {essential} for human survival.
e.zh: 水对人类生存至关重要。

e.en: Pack only the {essential} items for your trip.
e.zh: 旅行只带必需的物品就好。

e.en: Critics argue {essentialism} oversimplifies cultural identity.
e.zh: 批评者认为本质主义过度简化了文化身份。

e.en: Her philosophy class debated {essentialism} versus existentialism.
e.zh: 她的哲学课讨论了本质主义与存在主义。

essentialist.t:
n. 本质主义者
adj. 本质主义的

e.en: That argument relies on an {essentialist} view of gender.
e.zh: 那个论点建立在本质主义的性别观之上。

e.en: He took an {essentialist} approach, focusing only on priorities.
e.zh: 他采取极简主义方法,只关注最重要的事。

e.en: The report stresses the {essentiality} of clean water.
e.zh: 报告强调了清洁水源的重要性。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the {essentiality} of the surgery.
e.zh: 医生确认了这次手术的必要性。

e.en: The film {essentialized} an entire culture into a stereotype.
e.zh: 这部电影把整个文化简化成了刻板印象。

e.en: Her writing has often been criticized as {essentialized}.
e.zh: 她的作品常被批评为本质化处理。

e.en: The two phones are {essentially} the same model.
e.zh: 这两部手机基本上是同一款。

e.en: He's {essentially} a kind person despite his gruff manner.
e.zh: 尽管他态度粗鲁,但本质上是个善良的人。

essex.t: n. 埃塞克斯（英国郡名）

e.en: They moved to a quiet village in {Essex} last year.
e.zh: 他们去年搬到了埃塞克斯一个安静的村庄。

e.en: {Essex} County borders London to the northeast.
e.zh: 埃塞克斯郡位于伦敦东北方向接壤。

e.en: We stopped at an {Esso} station to refuel.
e.zh: 我们在一家埃索加油站停车加油。

e.en: The {Esso} brand is owned by ExxonMobil today.
e.zh: 埃索品牌如今归埃克森美孚所有。

est.t: n. 美国东部时间（Eastern Standard Time）

e.en: The meeting starts at 3 PM {EST} today.
e.zh: 会议今天东部时间下午三点开始。

e.en: The company was founded {est}. 1985 in Boston.
e.zh: 该公司成立于1985年,总部在波士顿。

e.en: They want to {establish} a new branch in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他们想在东京设立一个新的分公司。

e.en: We need to {establish} the facts before deciding.
e.zh: 我们需要先弄清事实再做决定。

established.t:
adj. 已确立的
v. 建立（过去式）

e.en: The university was {established} in 1872.
e.zh: 这所大学创建于1872年。

e.en: She is an {established} author with ten novels published.
e.zh: 她是一位已经出版了十部小说的成名作家。

establishes.t: v. 建立、确立（establish 的三单）

e.en: This contract {establishes} the terms of our partnership.
e.zh: 这份合同确立了我们合作的条款。

e.en: The opening scene {establishes} the film's dark tone.
e.zh: 开场戏奠定了这部电影阴暗的基调。

establishing.t: v. 建立、确立（establish 的现在分词）

e.en: They are {establishing} a new charity for homeless youth.
e.zh: 他们正在为无家可归的青少年创办一个新的慈善机构。

e.en: The director used an {establishing} shot of the city skyline.
e.zh: 导演使用了一个城市天际线的定场镜头。

establishment.t:
n. 机构、企业
n. 建立、设立

e.en: The {establishment} of the company took several months.
e.zh: 公司的成立花了好几个月时间。

e.en: This restaurant is a popular {establishment} downtown.
e.zh: 这家餐厅是市中心很受欢迎的店家。

e.en: Several dining {establishments} opened on Main Street recently.
e.zh: 最近大街上新开了几家餐饮店。

e.en: Educational {establishments} must follow strict safety rules.
e.zh: 教育机构必须遵守严格的安全规定。

e.en: They spent the holidays at a sprawling Argentine {estancia}.
e.zh: 他们在阿根廷一座辽阔的庄园度过了假期。

e.en: The {estancia} raises cattle on thousands of acres.
e.zh: 这座庄园在数千英亩土地上养牛。

estate.t:
n. 地产、庄园
n. 遗产

e.en: He inherited a large {estate} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里继承了一大笔遗产。

e.en: The real {estate} market has cooled this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度房地产市场有所降温。

e.en: Many country {estates} are now open to tourists.
e.zh: 许多乡间庄园现在对游客开放。

e.en: Her family owns several {estates} in the countryside.
e.zh: 她家在乡下拥有几处庄园。

e.en: The {Este} family ruled Ferrara for centuries.
e.zh: 埃斯特家族统治费拉拉长达数百年。

e.en: We toured the famous Villa d'{Este} gardens in Tivoli.
e.zh: 我们参观了蒂沃利著名的埃斯特别墅花园。

esteem.t:
n. 尊重、敬重
v. 尊敬

e.en: I hold my mentor in the highest {esteem}.
e.zh: 我对我的导师怀有最高的敬意。

e.en: Building self-{esteem} takes time and consistent effort.
e.zh: 建立自尊需要时间和持续的努力。

esteemed.t: adj. 受尊敬的、备受推崇的

e.en: She is an {esteemed} colleague known for her integrity.
e.zh: 她是一位以正直著称、备受尊敬的同事。

e.en: Welcome to our {esteemed} guests from across the world.
e.zh: 欢迎来自世界各地的尊贵宾客。

e.en: Fruity smells often come from {ester} compounds.
e.zh: 水果香味通常来自酯类化合物。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {ester} for the perfume.
e.zh: 化学家为这款香水合成了一种新酯。

e.en: The Book of {Esther} tells of a brave Jewish queen.
e.zh: 《以斯帖记》讲述了一位勇敢的犹太王后的故事。

e.en: My aunt {Esther} sends cards every birthday.
e.zh: 我的姑姑埃丝特每年生日都寄贺卡。

e.en: The cafe has a minimalist {esthetic} that I love.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有我喜欢的极简美学风格。

e.en: Her photography shows a strong {esthetic} sensibility.
e.zh: 她的摄影展现出强烈的审美感受。

e.en: The garden is {esthetically} pleasing in every season.
e.zh: 这座花园四季看上去都赏心悦目。

e.en: The website is functional but not {esthetically} appealing.
e.zh: 这个网站功能齐全,但在美感上欠缺吸引力。

e.en: She studies the {esthetics} of modern Japanese design.
e.zh: 她研究现代日本设计的美学。

e.en: Function matters as much as {esthetics} in good architecture.
e.zh: 在优秀建筑中,功能与美学同等重要。

estimable.t:
adj. 值得尊敬的
adj. 可估算的

e.en: The judge is an {estimable} figure in legal circles.
e.zh: 这位法官是法律界备受尊敬的人物。

e.en: Her contributions to science are truly {estimable}.
e.zh: 她对科学的贡献确实值得高度赞赏。

estimate.t:
v. 估计、估算
n. 估价、报价

e.en: Can you {estimate} how long the repair will take?
e.zh: 你能估算一下修理大概需要多久吗?

e.en: The contractor sent us an {estimate} for the renovation.
e.zh: 承包商给我们寄来了装修报价单。

e.en: The trip's {estimated} cost is around two thousand dollars.
e.zh: 这次旅行预计花费约两千美元。

e.en: Engineers {estimated} the bridge's lifespan at fifty years.
e.zh: 工程师估计这座桥的寿命为五十年。

estimates.t: n./v. 估计、估价（复数/三单）

e.en: The company {estimates} sales will grow ten percent.
e.zh: 公司估计销售额将增长百分之十。

e.en: We got three {estimates} before choosing a contractor.
e.zh: 我们在选定承包商前拿到了三份报价。

estimating.t: v. 估算、估计（现在分词）

e.en: He's good at {estimating} crowd sizes from photographs.
e.zh: 他擅长根据照片估算人群规模。

e.en: {Estimating} project timelines accurately is a valuable skill.
e.zh: 准确估算项目时间表是一项宝贵的技能。

e.en: In my {estimation}, the plan needs more work.
e.zh: 依我看,这个计划还需要修改。

e.en: Accurate {estimation} of costs is crucial for the budget.
e.zh: 准确估算成本对预算至关重要。

e.en: His {estimations} of travel time are usually too optimistic.
e.zh: 他对旅行时间的估算通常过于乐观。

e.en: Statistical {estimations} guide the company's pricing decisions.
e.zh: 统计估算指导着公司的定价决策。

e.en: The tax {estimator} on the website is very helpful.
e.zh: 网站上的税款估算工具非常有用。

e.en: She works as a cost {estimator} for a construction firm.
e.zh: 她在一家建筑公司担任造价估算师。

e.en: {Estonia} is famous for its digital government services.
e.zh: 爱沙尼亚以其数字化政府服务闻名。

e.en: We spent a week exploring the old town in {Estonia}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览爱沙尼亚的老城。

estonian.t:
adj. 爱沙尼亚的
n. 爱沙尼亚人/语

e.en: My new roommate is {Estonian} and speaks four languages fluently.
e.zh: 我的新室友是爱沙尼亚人，能流利讲四种语言。

e.en: The cafe serves traditional {Estonian} black bread with herring.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应传统的爱沙尼亚黑面包配鲱鱼。

e.en: The court may {estop} him from denying the agreement.
e.zh: 法院可以禁止他否认这份协议。

e.en: Prior statements can {estop} a party from changing positions.
e.zh: 先前的陈述可以阻止当事人改变立场。

e.en: The lawyer raised {estoppel} as a defense in court.
e.zh: 律师在法庭上以禁反言原则作为抗辩。

e.en: Promissory {estoppel} protects people who rely on broken promises.
e.zh: 允诺禁反言保护那些信赖被违反承诺的人。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {estradiol} patches for her menopause symptoms.
e.zh: 医生为她的更年期症状开了雌二醇贴片。

e.en: Blood tests showed her {estradiol} levels were unusually low.
e.zh: 血液检查显示她的雌二醇水平异常偏低。

e.en: His harsh words began to {estrange} him from old friends.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话开始让他与老朋友疏远。

e.en: Money disputes can {estrange} even the closest siblings.
e.zh: 金钱纠纷甚至能让最亲密的兄弟姐妹反目。

e.en: She finally reconciled with her {estranged} father after ten years.
e.zh: 她终于在十年后与疏远的父亲和解了。

e.en: He remained {estranged} from his family throughout college.
e.zh: 整个大学期间他都与家人关系疏远。

e.en: Their long {estrangement} ended with a tearful phone call.
e.zh: 他们长期的疏离以一通含泪的电话告终。

e.en: Therapy helped heal the {estrangement} between mother and daughter.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮助修复了母女之间的隔阂。

e.en: Doctors measure {estriol} levels to monitor pregnancy health.
e.zh: 医生通过检测雌三醇水平来监测怀孕状况。

e.en: Low {estriol} can indicate problems with the developing fetus.
e.zh: 雌三醇偏低可能提示胎儿发育存在问题。

e.en: {Estrogen} levels naturally decline during menopause.
e.zh: 绝经期间雌激素水平会自然下降。

e.en: The medication blocks {estrogen} to slow tumor growth.
e.zh: 该药物通过阻断雌激素来减缓肿瘤生长。

estrogenic.t: adj. 雌激素的、产生雌激素的

e.en: Some plastics contain {estrogenic} chemicals that disrupt hormones.
e.zh: 某些塑料含有会扰乱激素的类雌激素化学物质。

e.en: Soy products have mild {estrogenic} effects on the body.
e.zh: 豆制品对身体有轻微的雌激素样作用。

e.en: {Estrone} is the main estrogen produced after menopause.
e.zh: 雌酮是绝经后人体产生的主要雌激素。

e.en: Researchers measured {estrone} levels in postmenopausal women.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了绝经后女性的雌酮水平。

e.en: Female cats vocalize loudly during their {estrous} cycle.
e.zh: 母猫在发情周期会大声叫唤。

e.en: The vet tracked the dog's {estrous} cycle for breeding.
e.zh: 兽医追踪这只狗的发情周期以便繁育。

e.en: Cows in {estrus} stand still when other cows mount them.
e.zh: 处于发情期的母牛会在其他牛爬跨时站立不动。

e.en: The mare came into {estrus} earlier than expected this spring.
e.zh: 今春这匹母马比预期更早进入了发情期。

estuarine.t: adj. 河口的、河口生态的

e.en: {Estuarine} ecosystems support an enormous variety of fish.
e.zh: 河口生态系统养育着种类极其丰富的鱼群。

e.en: Pollution threatens fragile {estuarine} habitats along the coast.
e.zh: 污染正威胁着沿海脆弱的河口栖息地。

e.en: We kayaked through the quiet {estuary} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出时划皮划艇穿过宁静的河口湾。

e.en: Salmon return to the {estuary} each year to spawn.
e.zh: 鲑鱼每年都会回到这处河口产卵。

eta.t:
n. 预计到达时间（estimated time of arrival）
n. 希腊字母 η

e.en: What's your {ETA}? I'm already at the restaurant.
e.zh: 你预计什么时候到？我已经在餐厅了。

e.en: The driver's {ETA} keeps changing because of heavy traffic.
e.zh: 由于交通拥堵，司机的预计到达时间一直在变。

etc.t: abbr. 等等（et cetera 的缩写）

e.en: Bring snacks, drinks, sunscreen, {etc.} for the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐时记得带零食、饮料、防晒霜等等。

e.en: The store sells pens, notebooks, staplers, {etc.}
e.zh: 这家店出售钢笔、笔记本、订书机等。

etcetera.t: n. 等等、其他诸如此类

e.en: He listed taxes, insurance, maintenance, {etcetera}, before signing.
e.zh: 他在签字前列出了税费、保险、维护等等项目。

e.en: Just pack clothes, toiletries, {etcetera}, into one bag.
e.zh: 把衣服、洗漱用品等等都塞进一个包里就行。

e.en: Artists {etch} delicate patterns into copper plates.
e.zh: 艺术家在铜板上蚀刻精致的图案。

e.en: That moment will {etch} itself into my memory forever.
e.zh: 那一刻将永远铭刻在我的记忆里。

etched.t: adj. 蚀刻的、深深印下的

e.en: Her name was {etched} onto the silver bracelet.
e.zh: 她的名字被刻在了那只银手镯上。

e.en: The shock was {etched} clearly across his pale face.
e.zh: 震惊清晰地刻在他苍白的脸上。

e.en: The {etcher} carefully prepared an acid bath for the metal plate.
e.zh: 蚀刻师为金属板小心地准备了一桶酸液。

e.en: Rembrandt was a master {etcher} as well as a painter.
e.zh: 伦勃朗既是画家，也是一位蚀刻大师。

e.en: The laser {etches} serial numbers onto each circuit board.
e.zh: 激光在每块电路板上蚀刻出序列号。

e.en: Time {etches} fine lines around even the youngest eyes.
e.zh: 时间会在最年轻的眼角也刻出细纹。

etching.t:
n. 蚀刻画
v. 蚀刻（etch 的现在分词）

e.en: He hung a beautiful {etching} of Paris above the fireplace.
e.zh: 他在壁炉上方挂了一幅美丽的巴黎蚀刻画。

e.en: She is {etching} a design onto the glass vase.
e.zh: 她正在玻璃花瓶上蚀刻一个图案。

e.en: The gallery displayed rare {etchings} from the eighteenth century.
e.zh: 画廊展出了十八世纪的珍贵蚀刻版画。

e.en: Her grandmother collected antique Japanese {etchings} for decades.
e.zh: 她奶奶几十年来一直收藏古董日本蚀刻画。

e.en: They promised each other {eternal} love at the wedding.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼上互相许下了永恒的爱。

e.en: My neighbor's {eternal} complaining is finally driving me crazy.
e.zh: 邻居没完没了的抱怨终于把我逼疯了。

e.en: I'll be {eternally} grateful for your help during the move.
e.zh: 我会永远感激你在搬家时给予的帮助。

e.en: He's {eternally} optimistic, even when things go badly.
e.zh: 即使情况糟糕，他也始终保持乐观。

eternities.t: n. 永恒（复数）；漫长的时光

e.en: Waiting for the test results felt like two {eternities}.
e.zh: 等待化验结果就像过了两个世纪那么久。

e.en: Long-distance flights can feel like absolute {eternities}.
e.zh: 长途飞行简直让人觉得没完没了。

e.en: It took an {eternity} for the website to finally load.
e.zh: 网页加载花了好久才终于打开。

e.en: Some religions promise an {eternity} of peace after death.
e.zh: 有些宗教承诺死后会获得永恒的安宁。

e.en: {Ethane} is the second most abundant component of natural gas.
e.zh: 乙烷是天然气中含量第二多的成分。

e.en: Pipelines transport {ethane} to plants that make plastics.
e.zh: 管道将乙烷输送到生产塑料的工厂。

e.en: Many cars now run on gasoline blended with {ethanol}.
e.zh: 如今许多汽车使用掺入乙醇的汽油。

e.en: Hand sanitizer typically contains about 70 percent {ethanol}.
e.zh: 洗手液通常含有约百分之七十的乙醇。

e.en: Her message vanished into the {ether} without any reply.
e.zh: 她的消息消失在虚空中，没有任何回复。

e.en: Surgeons once used {ether} as a general anesthetic.
e.zh: 外科医生过去曾用乙醚作为全身麻醉剂。

e.en: Her voice has an {ethereal} quality that captivates listeners.
e.zh: 她的嗓音有种空灵的特质，深深吸引着听众。

e.en: Morning mist gave the forest an {ethereal} appearance.
e.zh: 晨雾让整片森林呈现出缥缈虚幻的景象。

e.en: The ballerina moved {ethereally} across the dimly lit stage.
e.zh: 芭蕾舞者在昏暗的舞台上飘逸轻盈地舞动。

e.en: Candles glowed {ethereally} through the thick evening fog.
e.zh: 烛光透过浓重的夜雾发出空灵的光晕。

e.en: The healer claimed to sense disturbances in his {etheric} body.
e.zh: 那位治疗师声称能感知到他以太体中的紊乱。

e.en: New age books often describe {etheric} energy fields around people.
e.zh: 新时代书籍常描述人体周围的以太能量场。

e.en: Plug an {Ethernet} cable in for a more stable connection.
e.zh: 插上以太网线可以获得更稳定的网络连接。

e.en: The router has four {Ethernet} ports on the back.
e.zh: 这台路由器背面有四个以太网端口。

e.en: She has a strong work {ethic} that impresses her boss.
e.zh: 她有着令老板钦佩的强烈职业操守。

e.en: The company promotes an {ethic} of transparency and honesty.
e.zh: 这家公司倡导透明与诚信的道德准则。

ethical.t: adj. 合乎道德的；伦理的

e.en: It's not {ethical} to use customer data without consent.
e.zh: 未经同意使用客户数据是不道德的。

e.en: She buys only {ethical} clothing made by fair-wage workers.
e.zh: 她只购买由获得公平工资的工人制作的良心服装。

ethically.t: adv. 道德上；合乎伦理地

e.en: The coffee is {ethically} sourced from small farms in Colombia.
e.zh: 这种咖啡通过道德方式从哥伦比亚的小型农场采购。
