e.en: The patient {exhibited} clear signs of recovery.
e.zh: 病人表现出明显的康复迹象。

exhibiting.t: v. 展示；表现（exhibit 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: Several startups are {exhibiting} new products at the conference.
e.zh: 几家创业公司正在大会上展示新产品。

e.en: The dog was {exhibiting} unusual aggressive behavior.
e.zh: 那只狗表现出异常的攻击性行为。

e.en: We visited a Van Gogh {exhibition} last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末去看了梵高画展。

e.en: His skating routine was a stunning {exhibition} of skill.
e.zh: 他的滑冰表演是一场精彩的技艺展示。

e.en: Social media often encourages a kind of digital {exhibitionism}.
e.zh: 社交媒体常常助长一种数字化的炫耀欲。

e.en: His loud outfits border on pure {exhibitionism}.
e.zh: 他那些张扬的穿着已近乎纯粹的炫耀。

exhibitionist.t: n. 爱出风头的人；露阴癖者

e.en: He's a bit of an {exhibitionist} on stage.
e.zh: 他在舞台上有点爱出风头。

e.en: The dancer was a natural {exhibitionist} who loved the spotlight.
e.zh: 这位舞者天生爱表现,享受聚光灯。

exhibitionistic.t: adj. 爱出风头的；炫耀的

e.en: Her {exhibitionistic} style of vlogging attracted millions of viewers.
e.zh: 她那种张扬的视频风格吸引了数百万观众。

e.en: The artist's {exhibitionistic} performances shocked the conservative audience.
e.zh: 这位艺术家张扬的表演震惊了保守的观众。

e.en: Some influencers are basically online {exhibitionists}.
e.zh: 有些网红基本上就是网络炫耀者。

e.en: The reality show was full of loud {exhibitionists}.
e.zh: 那档真人秀里满是爱出风头的人。

e.en: The gallery hosts three major {exhibitions} every year.
e.zh: 这家画廊每年举办三场大型展览。

e.en: Trade {exhibitions} are great for networking with suppliers.
e.zh: 贸易展会是与供应商建立联系的好机会。

e.en: Each {exhibitor} was given a small booth at the fair.
e.zh: 每位参展商在博览会上都获得了一个小展位。

e.en: The {exhibitor} answered questions about her new product.
e.zh: 参展者回答了关于她新产品的提问。

exhibits.t:
n. 展品
v. 展出（exhibit 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The science museum has interactive {exhibits} for children.
e.zh: 科学博物馆有适合孩子的互动展品。

e.en: This software {exhibits} strange behavior under heavy load.
e.zh: 这款软件在高负载下表现异常。

e.en: Fast downhill skiing never fails to {exhilarate} me.
e.zh: 高速滑下山坡总能让我兴奋不已。

e.en: Live concerts {exhilarate} fans like nothing else.
e.zh: 现场演唱会带给粉丝无与伦比的兴奋感。

e.en: She felt {exhilarated} after finishing her first triathlon.
e.zh: 完成首场铁人三项后,她感到无比兴奋。

e.en: The crowd was {exhilarated} by the team's last-minute goal.
e.zh: 球队最后一刻的进球让观众激动万分。

exhilarates.t: v. 使兴奋（exhilarate 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The morning ocean breeze always {exhilarates} her.
e.zh: 清晨的海风总能让她精神振奋。

e.en: Public speaking {exhilarates} him rather than scares him.
e.zh: 演讲让他兴奋,而不是害怕。

exhilarating.t: adj. 令人振奋的；使人兴奋的

e.en: Riding a roller coaster is an {exhilarating} experience.
e.zh: 乘坐过山车是一种令人兴奋的体验。

e.en: Their first kiss was absolutely {exhilarating}.
e.zh: 他们的初吻令人心潮澎湃。

e.en: She felt pure {exhilaration} as she crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 冲过终点线时她感到纯粹的兴奋。

e.en: The {exhilaration} of skydiving is hard to describe.
e.zh: 跳伞带来的快感难以形容。

e.en: Travel offers small {exhilarations} that office life cannot.
e.zh: 旅行带来办公室生活无法提供的种种小兴奋。

e.en: He chased the {exhilarations} of extreme sports across continents.
e.zh: 他横跨各大洲追寻极限运动带来的种种刺激。

e.en: Coaches often {exhort} their players to give maximum effort.
e.zh: 教练常常激励球员全力以赴。

e.en: Teachers {exhort} students to read more books.
e.zh: 老师们鼓励学生多读书。

e.en: The speech was a passionate {exhortation} to vote.
e.zh: 那篇演讲是对投票的激情呼吁。

e.en: Her father's {exhortation} to study harder finally paid off.
e.zh: 父亲让她努力学习的劝勉终于得到了回报。

e.en: The {exhumation} of the body provided crucial DNA evidence.
e.zh: 对遗体的开棺取证提供了关键的DNA证据。

e.en: A court order was needed for the {exhumation}.
e.zh: 开棺需要法院的命令。

e.en: Investigators decided to {exhume} the body for new tests.
e.zh: 调查人员决定开棺以进行新的检验。

e.en: Historians sometimes {exhume} long-forgotten stories from old archives.
e.zh: 历史学家有时会从旧档案中挖掘出被遗忘的故事。

exhumed.t: v. 掘出（exhume 的过去式）

e.en: The remains were {exhumed} for forensic examination.
e.zh: 遗骸被挖出以进行法医检验。

e.en: Old letters were {exhumed} from the dusty attic.
e.zh: 一些旧信从布满灰尘的阁楼里被翻了出来。

e.en: The {exigence} of the situation demanded immediate action.
e.zh: 情况的紧迫性要求立即采取行动。

e.en: Every speech responds to some rhetorical {exigence}.
e.zh: 每篇演讲都回应着某种话语层面的紧迫诉求。

e.en: The hospital prepared backup plans for any medical {exigency}.
e.zh: 医院为任何医疗紧急情况都准备了应急方案。

e.en: Wartime {exigency} forced the government to ration food.
e.zh: 战时的紧急形势迫使政府对食物实行配给。

e.en: The fire chief faced {exigent} circumstances inside the building.
e.zh: 消防队长在大楼内面对紧急的情况。

e.en: Police entered without a warrant due to {exigent} need.
e.zh: 由于情势紧迫,警方未持搜查令便进入了现场。

e.en: The refugees survived on {exiguous} rations for weeks.
e.zh: 难民们靠微薄的口粮支撑了数周。

e.en: His {exiguous} salary barely covered the rent.
e.zh: 他微薄的薪水勉强够付房租。

exile.t:
n. 流亡；流亡者
v. 流放

e.en: The deposed king lived in {exile} for twenty years.
e.zh: 被废黜的国王流亡了二十年。

e.en: The government threatened to {exile} the dissident writer.
e.zh: 政府威胁要将这位异见作家流放。

exiled.t:
adj. 被流放的
v. 流放（过去式）

e.en: The poet was {exiled} for criticizing the regime.
e.zh: 这位诗人因批评政权而遭流放。

e.en: Many {exiled} families dream of returning home one day.
e.zh: 许多流亡家庭都梦想有一天能回到故乡。

exiles.t:
n. 流亡者（复数）
v. 流放（三单）

e.en: Political {exiles} often gather in neighboring countries.
e.zh: 政治流亡者常常聚集在邻国。

e.en: The novel follows three {exiles} adjusting to life abroad.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述三位流亡者适应海外生活的故事。

e.en: Many species {exist} only in remote rainforests.
e.zh: 许多物种只生存在偏远的雨林中。

e.en: Do you really believe ghosts {exist}?
e.zh: 你真的相信有鬼存在吗?

e.en: Dinosaurs {existed} millions of years before humans.
e.zh: 恐龙在人类出现之前几百万年就存在了。

e.en: Before smartphones {existed}, people carried paper maps.
e.zh: 在智能手机出现之前,人们随身携带纸质地图。

e.en: Scientists are searching for proof of life's {existence} on Mars.
e.zh: 科学家们正在寻找火星上存在生命的证据。

e.en: He led a quiet {existence} in a small mountain village.
e.zh: 他在一个小山村里过着平静的生活。

e.en: The novel explores the parallel {existences} of two sisters.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了两姐妹各自平行的人生。

e.en: Many people lead double {existences} online and offline.
e.zh: 许多人在网上和现实中过着双重生活。

e.en: Few {existent} copies of the manuscript remain today.
e.zh: 这份手稿如今所剩无几。

e.en: The currently {existent} laws do not cover this situation.
e.zh: 现行法律并未涵盖这种情况。

existential.t: adj. 存在的；存在主义的

e.en: Climate change poses an {existential} threat to coastal cities.
e.zh: 气候变化对沿海城市构成生存威胁。

e.en: Turning thirty triggered an {existential} crisis for him.
e.zh: 三十岁让他陷入了一场存在危机。

e.en: Sartre is one of the key figures of {existentialism}.
e.zh: 萨特是存在主义的代表人物之一。

e.en: The course covered the basics of French {existentialism}.
e.zh: 这门课介绍了法国存在主义的基本思想。

existentialist.t:
n. 存在主义者
adj. 存在主义的

e.en: He took an {existentialist} view of his career choices.
e.zh: 他以存在主义的视角看待自己的职业选择。

e.en: The novel features an {existentialist} hero searching for meaning.
e.zh: 这部小说的主人公是一位寻找意义的存在主义者。

e.en: We need to update the {existing} database schema.
e.zh: 我们需要更新现有的数据库结构。

e.en: The new policy replaces all {existing} guidelines.
e.zh: 新政策取代了所有现行的指导方针。

e.en: A backup copy {exists} on the cloud server.
e.zh: 云服务器上存有一份备份副本。

e.en: No simple solution {exists} for this complex problem.
e.zh: 这个复杂的问题没有简单的解决办法。

exit.t:
v. 退出；离开
n. 出口

e.en: Please use the emergency {exit} during a fire.
e.zh: 火灾时请使用紧急出口。

e.en: Press Ctrl+C to {exit} the program safely.
e.zh: 按 Ctrl+C 可以安全退出程序。

e.en: She {exited} the building through the back door.
e.zh: 她从后门离开了大楼。

e.en: The script {exited} with an unexpected error code.
e.zh: 脚本以一个意外的错误码退出了。

exiting.t:
v. 正在退出
n. 退出

e.en: Passengers were {exiting} the plane in an orderly line.
e.zh: 乘客们正有序地下飞机。

e.en: The app crashed while {exiting} the settings menu.
e.zh: 应用在退出设置菜单时崩溃了。

exits.t:
n. 出口（复数）
v. 退出（三单）

e.en: The theater has four clearly marked {exits}.
e.zh: 剧院有四个标识清晰的出口。

e.en: He quietly {exits} the meeting before it ends.
e.zh: 他在会议结束前悄悄离开了。

exmoor.t: n. 埃克斯穆尔（英国地名）

e.en: We hiked across {Exmoor} on a misty morning.
e.zh: 我们在一个雾蒙蒙的早晨徒步穿越了埃克斯穆尔。

e.en: Wild ponies still roam freely on {Exmoor}.
e.zh: 野生小马依然在埃克斯穆尔自由漫步。

exmouth.t: n. 埃克斯茅斯（英国地名）

e.en: They spent the weekend at the beach in {Exmouth}.
e.zh: 他们在埃克斯茅斯的海滩度过了周末。

e.en: {Exmouth} is a popular seaside town in Devon.
e.zh: 埃克斯茅斯是德文郡一个受欢迎的海滨小镇。

e.en: The warship was struck by an {Exocet} missile.
e.zh: 那艘军舰被飞鱼导弹击中了。

e.en: France developed the {Exocet} for naval combat use.
e.zh: 法国为海战用途研发了飞鱼导弹。

e.en: Sweat glands are a familiar example of {exocrine} glands.
e.zh: 汗腺是大家熟悉的外分泌腺的例子。

e.en: The pancreas has both endocrine and {exocrine} functions.
e.zh: 胰腺同时具有内分泌和外分泌的功能。

e.en: There has been a mass {exodus} of engineers from the company.
e.zh: 公司里出现了工程师大规模离职的现象。

e.en: Rising rents triggered an {exodus} from the city center.
e.zh: 房租上涨引发了一波从市中心搬离的潮流。

e.en: Several {exoduses} have reshaped the region's population.
e.zh: 几次大规模的迁出重塑了该地区的人口结构。

e.en: History records many {exoduses} driven by war and famine.
e.zh: 历史上记载了许多由战争和饥荒引发的大迁徙。

e.en: The tribe practiced strictly {exogamous} marriage customs.
e.zh: 该部落严格奉行族外通婚的习俗。

e.en: Many traditional societies are {exogamous} by design.
e.zh: 许多传统社会在制度上都是族外通婚的。

e.en: Anthropologists study {exogamy} across different cultures.
e.zh: 人类学家研究不同文化中的族外通婚现象。

e.en: {Exogamy} helps prevent inbreeding in small communities.
e.zh: 族外通婚有助于防止小社群中的近亲繁殖。

e.en: The model accounts for {exogenous} shocks to the economy.
e.zh: 该模型考虑了来自经济外部的冲击。

e.en: Doctors warned about {exogenous} sources of contamination.
e.zh: 医生警告了来自外部的污染源。

e.en: The variable is determined {exogenously} in this model.
e.zh: 在此模型中,该变量由外部因素决定。

e.en: Hormones can be supplied {exogenously} through injections.
e.zh: 激素可以通过注射从体外补充。

e.en: Each {exon} codes for part of the final protein.
e.zh: 每个外显子编码最终蛋白质的一部分。

e.en: Researchers identified a mutation in the third {exon}.
e.zh: 研究人员在第三个外显子中发现了一处突变。

e.en: New evidence may {exonerate} the wrongly convicted man.
e.zh: 新证据可能会为这名被错判的男子洗清罪名。

e.en: The report did not fully {exonerate} the company.
e.zh: 该报告并未完全洗清公司的责任。

e.en: DNA testing finally {exonerated} the prisoner after years.
e.zh: 多年后,DNA 检测终于还了这名囚犯清白。

e.en: The audit {exonerated} the staff of any wrongdoing.
e.zh: 审计结果证明员工没有任何不当行为。

e.en: His {exoneration} came twenty years too late.
e.zh: 他的平反来得整整晚了二十年。

e.en: The lawyer fought for her client's full {exoneration}.
e.zh: 这位律师为当事人的彻底平反不懈努力。

e.en: Astronomers discovered a new {exoplanet} orbiting a distant star.
e.zh: 天文学家发现了一颗围绕遥远恒星运行的新系外行星。

e.en: The {exoplanet} may have liquid water on its surface.
e.zh: 这颗系外行星表面可能存在液态水。

e.en: The hotel charged an {exorbitant} fee for late checkout.
e.zh: 酒店对延迟退房收取了高得离谱的费用。

e.en: Concert tickets are at {exorbitant} prices on resale sites.
e.zh: 演唱会门票在二手网站上价格高得吓人。

e.en: The startup priced its software {exorbitantly} for enterprise clients.
e.zh: 这家初创公司给企业客户的软件定价高得离谱。

e.en: Rents rose {exorbitantly} during the housing boom.
e.zh: 在房地产繁荣期,房租上涨得离谱。

e.en: Writing the memoir helped her {exorcise} old memories.
e.zh: 写这本回忆录帮她驱散了过去的记忆。

e.en: The priest tried to {exorcise} the haunted house.
e.zh: 神父试图为那栋闹鬼的房子驱魔。

e.en: The film depicts a dramatic {exorcism} scene.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一场戏剧性的驱魔场景。

e.en: Belief in {exorcism} persists in many cultures today.
e.zh: 如今许多文化中仍存在对驱魔的信仰。

e.en: The church no longer performs public {exorcisms}.
e.zh: 教会不再公开举行驱魔仪式。

e.en: He wrote a book documenting historical {exorcisms}.
e.zh: 他写了一本书记录历史上的驱魔事件。

e.en: The {exorcist} arrived with prayers and holy water.
e.zh: 驱魔师带着祷文和圣水赶到了。

e.en: She watched a horror movie about an {exorcist}.
e.zh: 她看了一部关于驱魔师的恐怖片。

e.en: Only a few trained {exorcists} are recognized by the church.
e.zh: 只有少数受过训练的驱魔师得到教会认可。

e.en: Medieval {exorcists} relied on Latin prayers and rituals.
e.zh: 中世纪的驱魔师依靠拉丁文祷词和仪式。

e.en: He hoped therapy would {exorcize} his childhood fears.
e.zh: 他希望心理治疗能驱散他童年的恐惧。

e.en: The monks gathered to {exorcize} the troubled spirit.
e.zh: 僧侣们聚集起来驱赶那个不安的灵魂。

e.en: The robot has an {exoskeletal} frame for added support.
e.zh: 该机器人采用外骨骼框架以提供额外支撑。

e.en: Insects rely on their {exoskeletal} structure for protection.
e.zh: 昆虫依靠外骨骼结构来保护自己。

e.en: Soldiers wore a powered {exoskeleton} to carry heavy gear.
e.zh: 士兵穿上动力外骨骼来搬运重型装备。

e.en: A crab's {exoskeleton} hardens shortly after molting.
e.zh: 螃蟹的外壳在蜕皮后不久会变硬。

e.en: The book offers an {exoteric} introduction to the philosophy.
e.zh: 这本书提供了对该哲学的通俗易懂的入门介绍。

e.en: His lectures were {exoteric}, aimed at general audiences.
e.zh: 他的讲座面向大众,内容浅显易懂。

exotic.t: adj. 异国情调的；奇异的

e.en: The market sells {exotic} fruits from Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 这个市场出售来自东南亚的异国水果。

e.en: She loves cooking dishes with {exotic} spices.
e.zh: 她喜欢用异域香料做菜。

exotica.t: n. 异国情调之物；奇珍异品

e.en: The shop specializes in tropical {exotica} and rare plants.
e.zh: 这家店专营热带奇珍和稀有植物。

e.en: His record collection includes plenty of midcentury {exotica}.
e.zh: 他的唱片收藏里有不少二十世纪中叶的异域风情音乐。

e.en: The room was {exotically} decorated with Moroccan lanterns.
e.zh: 房间用摩洛哥灯笼装饰得颇具异域风情。

e.en: She dressed {exotically} for the costume party.
e.zh: 她为化装舞会打扮得很有异国风情。

e.en: The painting captures the {exoticism} of distant lands.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了异域他乡的风情。

e.en: Critics praised the film's vivid sense of {exoticism}.
e.zh: 评论界称赞这部电影鲜明的异域情调。

exp.t:
n. 经验值（experience 的缩写）
n. 指数（exponential 的缩写）

e.en: Use {exp} in NumPy to compute the exponential function.
e.zh: 在 NumPy 中使用 exp 来计算指数函数。

e.en: The candidate listed five years of {exp} on his résumé.
e.zh: 这位候选人在简历上写明有五年工作经验。

expand.t:
v. 展开；扩展
v. 扩大（规模、范围）

e.en: Click the arrow to {expand} the folder tree.
e.zh: 点击箭头可以展开文件夹目录。

e.en: The company plans to {expand} into Asian markets.
e.zh: 公司计划向亚洲市场扩张。

expandable.t: adj. 可扩展的；可展开的

e.en: The phone has an {expandable} memory slot for SD cards.
e.zh: 这款手机有可扩展的 SD 卡内存槽。

e.en: Each section is collapsible and {expandable} on click.
e.zh: 每个版块都可以点击展开或折叠。

expanded.t: adj. 已展开的；已扩展的

e.en: They {expanded} the office to fit a larger team.
e.zh: 他们扩建了办公室以容纳更大的团队。

e.en: The article was later {expanded} into a full book.
e.zh: 这篇文章后来被扩写成了一本完整的书。

e.en: The macro {expander} replaces shortcuts with full text.
e.zh: 宏扩展器会把缩写替换为完整文本。

e.en: He uses a chest {expander} during his morning workout.
e.zh: 他在晨练时使用胸部扩张器。

expanding.t: adj. 扩展中的；不断扩大的

e.en: The startup is rapidly {expanding} its engineering team.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在迅速扩充工程团队。

e.en: Hot air keeps {expanding} until the balloon bursts.
e.zh: 热空气不断膨胀,直到气球爆裂。

expands.t: v. expand 的第三人称单数

e.en: Reading regularly {expands} your vocabulary over time.
e.zh: 经常阅读会逐渐扩大你的词汇量。

e.en: Metal {expands} when heated and contracts when cooled.
e.zh: 金属受热时膨胀,冷却时收缩。

e.en: A vast {expanse} of desert stretched before them.
e.zh: 一片广袤的沙漠在他们面前延伸开来。

e.en: The ranch covers an {expanse} of several thousand acres.
e.zh: 这座牧场占地几千英亩之广。

expansion.t:
n. 扩展；扩张
n. 扩充内容（如游戏资料片）

e.en: The team is planning a major {expansion} into Europe.
e.zh: 团队正在计划向欧洲大举扩张。

e.en: This game's latest {expansion} adds two new maps.
e.zh: 这款游戏最新的资料片新增了两张地图。

expansionary.t: adj. 扩张性的（多指经济政策）

e.en: The central bank adopted an {expansionary} monetary policy.
e.zh: 央行采取了扩张性的货币政策。

e.en: {Expansionary} fiscal measures helped boost employment.
e.zh: 扩张性的财政措施帮助提振了就业。

e.en: The lecture focused on nineteenth-century European {expansionism}.
e.zh: 讲座聚焦于十九世纪欧洲的扩张主义。

e.en: Critics accused the regime of aggressive {expansionism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该政权奉行激进的扩张主义。

expansionist.t:
n. 扩张主义者
adj. 扩张主义的

e.en: The empire pursued an aggressive {expansionist} foreign policy.
e.zh: 该帝国推行咄咄逼人的扩张主义外交政策。

e.en: Neighboring states grew wary of his {expansionist} ambitions.
e.zh: 邻国对他的扩张野心日益警惕。

expansions.t: n. expansion 的复数；扩展内容

e.en: The game has released three paid {expansions} this year.
e.zh: 这款游戏今年已经发布了三个付费资料片。

e.en: Several office {expansions} are planned for next quarter.
e.zh: 下个季度计划进行几次办公室扩建。

expansive.t:
adj. 广阔的；开阔的
adj. 健谈的；豪爽的

e.en: The CEO gave an {expansive} speech about future growth.
e.zh: 首席执行官就未来增长发表了热情洋溢的演讲。

e.en: Their new house has an {expansive} backyard for the kids.
e.zh: 他们的新房子有个宽敞的后院供孩子玩耍。

e.en: He gestured {expansively} while describing his travels in Asia.
e.zh: 他一边描述亚洲之行,一边大幅度地比划着。

e.en: She wrote {expansively} about her childhood in the countryside.
e.zh: 她洋洋洒洒地写下了乡村童年的点滴。

e.en: The {expansiveness} of the desert sky took my breath away.
e.zh: 沙漠天空的辽阔让我屏住了呼吸。

e.en: I admired the {expansiveness} of his thinking on climate policy.
e.zh: 我很佩服他在气候政策上视野的开阔。

expat.t: n. 侨居海外者（expatriate 的缩写）

e.en: She joined an {expat} community in Singapore last year.
e.zh: 她去年加入了新加坡的一个外籍人士社区。

e.en: Many {expat} workers send money home every month.
e.zh: 许多外派员工每月都会汇钱回家。

e.en: He loves to {expatiate} on the history of jazz.
e.zh: 他喜欢滔滔不绝地讲述爵士乐的历史。

e.en: Please don't {expatiate} too long during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请不要长篇大论。

expatriate.t:
n. 侨居国外者
v. 移居国外

e.en: She works as an {expatriate} engineer in Dubai.
e.zh: 她在迪拜担任外派工程师。

e.en: The novel follows an American {expatriate} living in Paris.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一位旅居巴黎的美国人。

expatriation.t: n. 移居海外；放弃国籍

e.en: His {expatriation} to Berlin changed his entire career path.
e.zh: 他移居柏林彻底改变了职业方向。

e.en: The form covers tax issues related to {expatriation}.
e.zh: 该表格涉及与放弃国籍相关的税务问题。

expect.t:
v. 期待；预期
v. 要求；指望

e.en: I {expect} the package to arrive by Friday.
e.zh: 我估计包裹周五前就能到。

e.en: Don't {expect} too much from a free app.
e.zh: 别对免费应用抱太高期望。

expectable.t: adj. 可预料的；意料之中的

e.en: Some delays are {expectable} during the holiday rush.
e.zh: 假期高峰期出现一些延误是意料之中的。

e.en: His angry reaction was entirely {expectable} given the circumstances.
e.zh: 鉴于当时的情形,他的愤怒反应完全在意料之中。

expectancy.t:
n. 期望；预期
n. 预期值（如寿命）

e.en: Life {expectancy} has risen steadily over the past century.
e.zh: 过去一个世纪人均寿命稳步上升。

e.en: There was a feeling of {expectancy} in the crowded theater.
e.zh: 拥挤的剧院里弥漫着期待的气氛。

expectant.t:
adj. 期待的
adj. 怀孕的（expectant mother）

e.en: The {expectant} mother attended her first prenatal class today.
e.zh: 这位准妈妈今天参加了第一节产前课。

e.en: Children waited with {expectant} faces for the magician.
e.zh: 孩子们带着期待的神情等着魔术师出场。

expectantly.t: adv. 期待地；满怀期望地

e.en: The dog stared {expectantly} at the treat in my hand.
e.zh: 狗狗眼巴巴地盯着我手里的零食。

e.en: She looked at me {expectantly}, waiting for an answer.
e.zh: 她满怀期待地看着我,等着回答。

e.en: The new phone exceeded every {expectation} reviewers had.
e.zh: 这款新手机超出了评测者的所有预期。

e.en: There's an {expectation} that staff reply to emails within a day.
e.zh: 员工被期望在一天内回复邮件。

e.en: Setting clear {expectations} early prevents conflict later.
e.zh: 早期就明确预期能避免日后冲突。

e.en: The movie failed to live up to fan {expectations}.
e.zh: 这部电影未能达到粉丝们的期望。

e.en: Rain is {expected} throughout the weekend in Tokyo.
e.zh: 预计东京整个周末都会下雨。

e.en: The results were better than {expected}.
e.zh: 结果比预期的要好。

expectedly.t: adv. 如预期地；不出所料地

e.en: Quite {expectedly}, the sequel broke box office records.
e.zh: 不出所料,这部续集打破了票房纪录。

e.en: Stocks fell {expectedly} after the central bank's announcement.
e.zh: 央行宣布消息后,股市如预期般下跌。

expecting.t:
adj. 怀孕的
v. 期待中

e.en: My sister is {expecting} her first baby in June.
e.zh: 我姐姐六月份就要生第一个宝宝了。

e.en: I wasn't {expecting} so many people at the party.
e.zh: 我没料到派对上会来这么多人。

expectorant.t:
n. 祛痰药
adj. 祛痰的

e.en: The doctor prescribed an {expectorant} to ease his cough.
e.zh: 医生开了化痰药来缓解他的咳嗽。

e.en: Many cold syrups contain an {expectorant} as the main ingredient.
e.zh: 许多感冒糖浆都以祛痰剂为主要成分。

e.en: Signs in the park ask visitors not to {expectorate}.
e.zh: 公园里有告示请游客不要随地吐痰。

e.en: The patient was told to {expectorate} into the cup for testing.
e.zh: 医生要求病人将痰吐入杯中以便化验。

expects.t: v. expect 的第三人称单数

e.en: The teacher {expects} every student to submit homework on time.
e.zh: 老师要求每位学生按时交作业。

e.en: Nobody {expects} a perfect first draft.
e.zh: 没人指望初稿就完美无瑕。

e.en: They chose the cheaper option for {expedience} rather than quality.
e.zh: 他们出于权宜之计选了便宜的方案,而非追求质量。

e.en: Politicians often act out of {expedience} during election years.
e.zh: 政客们在选举年常常为了眼前利益行事。

expediency.t: n. 权宜之计；功利考量

e.en: He prioritized {expediency} over doing things the right way.
e.zh: 他把权宜之计放在了正确做事之上。

e.en: The merger was driven by {expediency}, not strategy.
e.zh: 这次合并是出于权宜,而非战略考量。

expedient.t:
adj. 权宜的；有利的
n. 权宜之计

e.en: Skipping the meeting was an {expedient} but risky choice.
e.zh: 跳过会议是个方便却冒险的选择。

e.en: It's not always {expedient} to tell the whole truth.
e.zh: 全盘托出真相并不总是明智之举。

e.en: The team handled the bug report {expediently} and shipped a fix.
e.zh: 团队迅速处理了缺陷报告并发布了修复。

e.en: Refunds are processed {expediently} once your form is received.
e.zh: 收到表格后,退款会被尽快处理。

e.en: He misspelled {expedit} when he meant expedite the order.
e.zh: 他想写 expedite(加快办理),却拼错成了 expedit。

e.en: The variable name {expedit} should probably be renamed expedite.
e.zh: 变量名 expedit 大概应该改成 expedite。

e.en: Please {expedite} the shipping for an extra fee.
e.zh: 请加价加急发货。

e.en: The new software helps {expedite} the visa application process.
e.zh: 新软件能加快签证申请的办理速度。

e.en: I paid for {expedited} shipping to get it before Christmas.
e.zh: 我付了加急运费,想在圣诞节前收到。

e.en: The court {expedited} the case due to public interest.
e.zh: 由于涉及公共利益,法院加快审理了此案。

e.en: Our {expediter} keeps every order moving through the kitchen.
e.zh: 我们的传菜员让每份订单在厨房顺畅流转。

e.en: The factory hired an {expediter} to chase delayed parts.
e.zh: 工厂请了一名催货员追踪延迟的零件。

expedites.t: v. expedite 的第三人称单数

e.en: Using a template {expedites} the whole onboarding process.
e.zh: 使用模板能加快整个入职流程。

e.en: This portal {expedites} refunds by skipping manual review.
e.zh: 该门户通过省去人工审核来加快退款。

e.en: The agency is {expediting} passport renewals this summer.
e.zh: 该机构今年夏天正在加快办理护照续签。

e.en: She's in charge of {expediting} urgent customer orders.
e.zh: 她负责加急处理紧急的客户订单。

expedition.t:
n. 远征；探险
n. 迅速；敏捷

e.en: The {expedition} to Antarctica took nearly six months.
e.zh: 这次南极远征历时近六个月。

e.en: We're planning a shopping {expedition} for the new apartment.
e.zh: 我们打算来一次为新公寓采购的购物之行。

e.en: The {expeditionary} force landed on the island at dawn.
e.zh: 远征部队黎明时分登陆了那座岛屿。

e.en: She joined an {expeditionary} team studying Arctic wildlife.
e.zh: 她加入了一支研究北极野生动物的考察队。

e.en: He's led three {expeditions} to the Himalayas this decade.
e.zh: 近十年来他已带队三次远征喜马拉雅山。

e.en: Polar {expeditions} require months of careful preparation.
e.zh: 极地探险需要数月的精心准备。

e.en: The bank promised an {expeditious} review of my loan application.
e.zh: 银行承诺会迅速审核我的贷款申请。

e.en: We need an {expeditious} solution before the deadline.
e.zh: 我们需要在截止日期前迅速找到解决方案。

e.en: The IT team resolved the outage {expeditiously} that morning.
e.zh: IT团队当天上午迅速解决了故障。

e.en: Please respond {expeditiously} so we can finalize the contract.
e.zh: 请尽快回复,以便我们敲定合同。

expel.t:
v. 驱逐；开除
v. 排出（气体等）

e.en: The school may {expel} students caught cheating on exams.
e.zh: 学校可能会开除考试作弊的学生。

e.en: Plants {expel} oxygen as part of photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中会释放氧气。

e.en: Two players were {expelled} from the league for doping.
e.zh: 两名球员因兴奋剂被联赛除名。

e.en: The diplomat was {expelled} from the country last week.
e.zh: 那位外交官上周被驱逐出境。

expend.t: v. 花费；消耗（金钱、精力）

e.en: Don't {expend} too much energy on minor edits.
e.zh: 别在细枝末节的修改上耗费太多精力。

e.en: Startups often {expend} cash faster than they expect.
e.zh: 初创公司烧钱的速度往往比预想的快。

expendable.t: adj. 可消耗的；可牺牲的

e.en: The company treats interns as if they were {expendable}.
e.zh: 公司把实习生当作可有可无的人。

e.en: Pack only {expendable} supplies for the camping trip.
e.zh: 露营只带些用完即弃的补给就行。

e.en: She {expended} months of effort on a project that got cancelled.
e.zh: 她花了数月心血在一个最终被取消的项目上。

e.en: The team had {expended} all its budget by October.
e.zh: 团队在十月份就已花光了全部预算。

e.en: Government {expenditure} on education rose sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年政府在教育上的支出大幅增加。

e.en: Track every business {expenditure} for tax purposes.
e.zh: 为了报税要记录每一笔业务支出。

e.en: Monthly {expenditures} on streaming services keep adding up.
e.zh: 每月在流媒体服务上的开销越积越多。

e.en: The report breaks down all military {expenditures} by region.
e.zh: 报告按地区分解了全部军事开支。

e.en: Rent is my biggest monthly {expense} in the city.
e.zh: 房租是我在城里每月最大的开销。

e.en: You can {expense} taxi rides during business trips.
e.zh: 出差期间的打车费可以报销。

e.en: The app helps me track daily {expenses} automatically.
e.zh: 这款应用能自动帮我记录日常开销。

e.en: All travel {expenses} will be reimbursed by the company.
e.zh: 所有差旅费用将由公司报销。

e.en: This restaurant is delicious but really {expensive}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅很好吃,但是真的很贵。

e.en: Owning a car in Tokyo is more {expensive} than I expected.
e.zh: 在东京养车比我预想的贵多了。

e.en: She was {expensively} dressed for the gala.
e.zh: 她为这次晚会穿得十分昂贵讲究。

e.en: The lobby is {expensively} decorated with marble and gold.
e.zh: 大堂用大理石和黄金装饰得极为奢华。

experience.t:
n. 经验；体验
v. 经历；感受

e.en: Visiting Kyoto was an unforgettable {experience} for me.
e.zh: 游览京都对我来说是一次难忘的经历。

e.en: The job requires three years of {experience} in marketing.
e.zh: 这份工作要求有三年市场营销经验。

experienced.t:
adj. 有经验的；老练的
v. 经历过

e.en: We need an {experienced} engineer to lead the project.
e.zh: 我们需要一位经验丰富的工程师来领导这个项目。

e.en: I've never {experienced} jet lag this bad before.
e.zh: 我以前从没经历过这么严重的时差反应。

e.en: In linguistics, the {experiencer} is the one feeling the emotion.
e.zh: 在语言学中,经验者就是感受情绪的那个角色。

e.en: Each {experiencer} reported the VR demo differently.
e.zh: 每位体验者对这次VR演示的反馈都不一样。

e.en: Travel {experiences} often shape who we become.
e.zh: 旅行经历往往塑造我们成为什么样的人。

e.en: She {experiences} mild anxiety before every public talk.
e.zh: 她每次公开演讲前都会感到轻微焦虑。

e.en: She is {experiencing} some lag while playing the online game.
e.zh: 她玩这款网游时遇到了一些延迟。

e.en: Many users are {experiencing} login issues this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上很多用户都遇到登录问题。

experiential.t: adj. 基于经验的；体验式的

e.en: The museum offers an {experiential} learning program for kids.
e.zh: 博物馆为孩子们提供体验式学习项目。

e.en: Brands now focus on {experiential} marketing rather than ads.
e.zh: 品牌如今更注重体验式营销而非广告。

experiment.t:
n. 实验
v. 做实验；尝试

e.en: Let's run a small {experiment} to test the new feature.
e.zh: 我们做个小实验测试一下新功能。

e.en: The chemistry {experiment} produced unexpected results.
e.zh: 那次化学实验产生了意想不到的结果。

e.en: This is an {experimental} feature and may break occasionally.
e.zh: 这是一个实验性功能,可能偶尔会出问题。

e.en: She enjoys listening to {experimental} electronic music.
e.zh: 她喜欢听实验性电子音乐。

e.en: The artist's {experimentalism} pushed the boundaries of modern painting.
e.zh: 这位艺术家的实验主义拓展了现代绘画的边界。

e.en: His {experimentalism} in cooking led to surprising new flavors.
e.zh: 他在烹饪上的实验主义带来了惊喜的新口味。

experimentalist.t: n. 实验主义者；实验家

e.en: She is a respected {experimentalist} in particle physics.
e.zh: 她是粒子物理领域备受尊敬的实验学家。

e.en: The composer was a bold {experimentalist} ahead of his time.
e.zh: 这位作曲家是超越时代的大胆实验者。

experimentally.t: adv. 以实验方式；试验性地

e.en: The drug has been {experimentally} tested on small groups.
e.zh: 该药物已在小范围内进行了实验性测试。

e.en: We {experimentally} enabled dark mode for some users.
e.zh: 我们对部分用户实验性地开启了深色模式。

e.en: Continuous {experimentation} helps the team improve the product.
e.zh: 持续的实验帮助团队改进产品。

e.en: Scientific progress depends on careful {experimentation}.
e.zh: 科学进步依赖于审慎的实验。

experimented.t: v. 做实验；尝试（过去式）

e.en: He {experimented} with several recipes before settling on one.
e.zh: 他尝试了好几种食谱才最终选定一个。

e.en: The startup {experimented} with a new pricing model last quarter.
e.zh: 这家初创公司上季度试行了新的定价模式。

experimenter.t: n. 实验者；做实验的人

e.en: The {experimenter} recorded each subject's reaction time carefully.
e.zh: 实验员仔细记录了每位受试者的反应时间。

e.en: She is a fearless {experimenter} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 她是厨房里无所畏惧的实验者。

e.en: The team is {experimenting} with AI-generated thumbnails.
e.zh: 团队正在尝试使用 AI 生成缩略图。

e.en: He's been {experimenting} with intermittent fasting recently.
e.zh: 他最近一直在尝试间歇性禁食。

experiments.t:
n. 实验（复数）
v. 做实验

e.en: Google constantly runs A/B {experiments} on its search results.
e.zh: 谷歌不断对搜索结果进行 A/B 实验。

e.en: The lab conducts {experiments} on new battery materials.
e.zh: 该实验室对新型电池材料进行实验。

expert.t:
n. 专家
adj. 专业的；熟练的

e.en: She is an {expert} in machine learning and data privacy.
e.zh: 她是机器学习和数据隐私方面的专家。

e.en: You'll need {expert} advice before signing this contract.
e.zh: 签这份合同前你需要专业建议。

e.en: His {expertise} in cybersecurity made him a key hire.
e.zh: 他在网络安全方面的专业知识让他成为关键员工。

e.en: The project requires {expertise} in both design and engineering.
e.zh: 这个项目同时需要设计和工程方面的专业能力。

expertises.t: n. 专业技能（复数，罕用）

e.en: The consultancy combines {expertises} from finance, tech, and law.
e.zh: 这家咨询公司汇集了金融、科技和法律领域的专长。

e.en: Her two main {expertises} are negotiation and strategy.
e.zh: 她的两大专长是谈判和战略。

e.en: The chef {expertly} sliced the fish into thin pieces.
e.zh: 厨师娴熟地把鱼切成薄片。

e.en: She {expertly} handled the customer's complaint over chat.
e.zh: 她在聊天中专业地处理了客户的投诉。

e.en: Health {experts} recommend at least seven hours of sleep.
e.zh: 健康专家建议每天至少睡七小时。

e.en: Industry {experts} predict strong growth in the EV market.
e.zh: 业内专家预测电动车市场将强劲增长。

e.en: He donated to charity to {expiate} his past mistakes.
e.zh: 他捐款给慈善机构以弥补过去的错误。

e.en: The character tries to {expiate} her guilt through sacrifice.
e.zh: 那个角色试图通过牺牲来赎清自己的罪。

e.en: His long apology felt like an act of {expiation}.
e.zh: 他长长的道歉像是一种赎罪行为。

e.en: The novel explores themes of guilt and {expiation}.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了罪与赎的主题。

expiration.t:
n. 到期；期满
n. 呼气

e.en: Always check the {expiration} date before drinking the milk.
e.zh: 喝牛奶前一定要检查保质期。

e.en: The coupon's {expiration} is midnight on Sunday.
e.zh: 这张优惠券周日午夜过期。

e.en: The doctor measured his peak {expiratory} flow rate.
e.zh: 医生测量了他的最大呼气流量。

e.en: Asthma can reduce a patient's {expiratory} capacity significantly.
e.zh: 哮喘会显著降低患者的呼气能力。

expire.t:
v. 到期；失效
v. 咽气；去世

e.en: Your password will {expire} in three days, please update it.
e.zh: 您的密码三天后过期,请及时更新。

e.en: Most gift cards {expire} after one year of issue.
e.zh: 大多数礼品卡在发行一年后失效。

e.en: The login session has {expired}, please sign in again.
e.zh: 登录会话已过期,请重新登录。

e.en: She tossed out the {expired} yogurt from the fridge.
e.zh: 她把冰箱里过期的酸奶扔了。

e.en: This subscription {expires} on the last day of the month.
e.zh: 此订阅在月底最后一天到期。

e.en: The discount code {expires} at midnight tonight.
e.zh: 折扣码今晚午夜失效。

e.en: Renew your {expiring} domain before someone else grabs it.
e.zh: 在别人抢注之前续费即将到期的域名。

e.en: The app warns me about {expiring} cards in my wallet.
e.zh: 这个应用会提醒我钱包里即将过期的卡。

e.en: Check the {expiry} date printed on the package.
e.zh: 请查看包装上印的有效期。

e.en: My passport's {expiry} is next March, so I need to renew.
e.zh: 我的护照明年三月到期,得续办了。

e.en: Could you {explain} how this algorithm actually works?
e.zh: 你能解释一下这个算法到底是怎么运作的吗?

e.en: It's hard to {explain} the bug without showing the screen.
e.zh: 不看屏幕很难把这个 bug 说清楚。

explainable.t: adj. 可解释的；可说明的

e.en: Banks prefer {explainable} AI models for credit scoring.
e.zh: 银行在信用评分上更倾向于可解释的 AI 模型。

e.en: His sudden absence is not easily {explainable}.
e.zh: 他突然缺席不太好解释。

e.en: The teacher patiently {explained} the formula again.
e.zh: 老师耐心地又把公式讲了一遍。

e.en: She {explained} why the deadline had to be moved.
e.zh: 她解释了为什么截止日期必须延后。

e.en: The site published a great {explainer} on quantum computing.
e.zh: 该网站发布了一篇精彩的量子计算科普文章。

e.en: Watch this short {explainer} video before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前请先看这段简短的解说视频。

e.en: He spent ten minutes {explaining} the new return policy.
e.zh: 他花了十分钟解释新的退货政策。

e.en: Stop {explaining} and just show me the code.
e.zh: 别解释了,直接给我看代码吧。

e.en: This article {explains} why interest rates affect housing prices.
e.zh: 这篇文章解释了利率为何会影响房价。

e.en: That {explains} why my laptop has been running so slowly.
e.zh: 难怪我的笔记本最近这么慢。

e.en: The support team gave a clear {explanation} of the charge.
e.zh: 客服对这笔收费给出了清晰的说明。

e.en: There must be a logical {explanation} for the missing files.
e.zh: 文件丢失一定有个合理的解释。

e.en: His {explanations} were too technical for the general audience.
e.zh: 他的解释对普通观众来说太过技术化。

e.en: Good documentation provides {explanations} alongside code examples.
e.zh: 好的文档会在代码示例旁附上解释。

e.en: The chart includes an {explanatory} note about the data source.
e.zh: 图表附有关于数据来源的说明性注释。

e.en: Add an {explanatory} comment so future developers understand this hack.
e.zh: 加一条解释性注释,方便后来的开发者理解这个临时方案。

explant.t:
n. 外植体
v. 取出植入物

e.en: The surgeon decided to {explant} the faulty pacemaker.
e.zh: 外科医生决定取出有故障的起搏器。

e.en: Many patients chose to {explant} their breast implants.
e.zh: 许多患者选择取出乳房假体。

e.en: He muttered an {expletive} when his code crashed again.
e.zh: 代码又崩了,他低声骂了一句脏话。

e.en: The streamer was fined for using an {expletive} on air.
e.zh: 主播因在直播中爆粗口被罚款。

explicable.t: adj. 可解释的；说得通的

e.en: The sudden crash is not easily {explicable} from the logs.
e.zh: 从日志里很难解释这次突然的崩溃。

e.en: Her behavior is {explicable} once you know her background.
e.zh: 了解她的背景后,她的行为就说得通了。

e.en: The professor took an hour to {explicate} the poem's imagery.
e.zh: 教授花了一小时阐释这首诗的意象。

e.en: Please {explicate} the assumptions behind your model.
e.zh: 请详细说明你模型背后的假设。

e.en: The book offers a careful {explication} of Kant's ethics.
e.zh: 这本书对康德伦理学进行了细致的阐释。

e.en: Her {explication} of the contract clause was very helpful.
e.zh: 她对合同条款的解释非常有帮助。

explicit.t:
adj. 明确的，清晰的
adj. 露骨的（内容）

e.en: Please give {explicit} instructions so there's no confusion.
e.zh: 请给出明确的说明,以免混淆。

e.en: The album is marked {explicit} due to strong language.
e.zh: 这张专辑因含粗口被标记为少儿不宜。

e.en: The contract {explicitly} forbids subletting the apartment.
e.zh: 合同明确禁止转租公寓。

e.en: He {explicitly} asked us not to share the document.
e.zh: 他明确要求我们不要分享这份文件。

e.en: I appreciate the {explicitness} of his feedback.
e.zh: 我很欣赏他反馈的直白明确。

e.en: The contract's {explicitness} left no room for misinterpretation.
e.zh: 合同表述的明确性没有留下误读空间。

explode.t:
v. 爆炸，爆发
v. 激增

e.en: Lithium batteries can {explode} if they overheat badly.
e.zh: 锂电池如果严重过热可能会爆炸。

e.en: The video made her follower count {explode} overnight.
e.zh: 这条视频让她的粉丝数一夜暴涨。

e.en: The firework {exploded} too close to the crowd.
e.zh: 烟花在离人群太近的地方炸开了。

e.en: Her TikTok account {exploded} after the dance challenge.
e.zh: 她的 TikTok 账号在那个舞蹈挑战后人气爆棚。

explodes.t: v. 爆炸（第三人称单数）

e.en: The popularity of AI tools {explodes} every few months.
e.zh: AI 工具的热度每隔几个月就会井喷一次。

e.en: In the movie, the spaceship {explodes} during reentry.
e.zh: 在电影中,飞船在再入大气层时爆炸了。

e.en: Demand for electric vehicles is {exploding} in Asia.
e.zh: 亚洲对电动汽车的需求正在爆炸式增长。

e.en: Firefighters worried about the {exploding} gas tanks nearby.
e.zh: 消防员担心附近不断爆炸的油罐。

exploit.t:
v. 利用；开发
n. 漏洞利用（程序）

e.en: Hackers can {exploit} this vulnerability to steal user data.
e.zh: 黑客可以利用此漏洞窃取用户数据。

e.en: Smart investors {exploit} small inefficiencies in the market.
e.zh: 聪明的投资者会利用市场上的微小低效。

exploitable.t: adj. 可利用的，可开发的

e.en: The audit found several {exploitable} bugs in the login flow.
e.zh: 审计在登录流程中发现了几个可被利用的漏洞。

e.en: Old software often has {exploitable} security flaws.
e.zh: 旧软件常常存在可被利用的安全缺陷。

e.en: The documentary exposes the {exploitation} of migrant workers.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了对外来务工者的剥削。

e.en: Responsible {exploitation} of natural resources is essential.
e.zh: 对自然资源进行负责任的开发利用至关重要。

e.en: The report listed several {exploitations} of vulnerable workers abroad.
e.zh: 报告列举了在海外对弱势劳工的几起剥削行为。

e.en: Security teams documented multiple {exploitations} of the bug last week.
e.zh: 安全团队上周记录了对该漏洞的多次利用。

e.en: Critics called the loan terms {exploitative} and unfair to borrowers.
e.zh: 批评者称这些贷款条款带有剥削性,对借款人不公平。

e.en: The documentary exposed {exploitative} practices in fast fashion factories.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了快时尚工厂里的剥削行为。

exploited.t: v. 被利用；被剥削（过去式）

e.en: Hackers {exploited} a flaw in the login system yesterday.
e.zh: 黑客昨天利用了登录系统中的一个漏洞。

e.en: Migrant workers are often {exploited} by unscrupulous recruitment agents.
e.zh: 外来务工者常常被不良中介剥削。

e.en: The novel portrays the landlord as a ruthless {exploiter} of peasants.
e.zh: 小说把那个地主描绘成无情剥削农民的人。

e.en: Regulators fined the company, branding it a serial {exploiter} of loopholes.
e.zh: 监管机构对该公司开出罚单,称其惯于钻法律漏洞。

exploiting.t: v. 正在利用；正在剥削

e.en: The startup is {exploiting} a gap in the streaming market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在抢占流媒体市场的一个空白点。

e.en: Scammers are {exploiting} elderly users with fake tech support calls.
e.zh: 骗子正利用假冒技术支持电话来欺骗老年用户。

e.en: Reviewers slammed the game for its {exploitive} loot box mechanics.
e.zh: 评测者抨击这款游戏带有剥削性的开箱机制。

e.en: She refused to sign the {exploitive} contract her agent proposed.
e.zh: 她拒绝签下经纪人提出的那份带剥削性质的合同。

exploits.t:
v. 利用
n. 功绩；漏洞利用

e.en: The hacker shared zero-day {exploits} on a private forum.
e.zh: 那名黑客在私密论坛上分享了零日漏洞利用程序。

e.en: Children listened to the soldier's wartime {exploits} in awe.
e.zh: 孩子们敬畏地听着这位士兵讲述战时的英勇事迹。

e.en: Space {exploration} has captured public imagination since the 1960s.
e.zh: 自上世纪六十年代以来,太空探索就深深吸引着公众。

e.en: The team began an {exploration} of new pricing strategies.
e.zh: 团队开始探索新的定价策略。

e.en: His musical {explorations} blend jazz with traditional Chinese instruments.
e.zh: 他的音乐探索把爵士乐与中国传统乐器结合在一起。

e.en: Early Arctic {explorations} cost many lives and ships.
e.zh: 早期的北极探险曾使许多人和船只葬身冰海。

e.en: The therapist took an {explorative} approach to the patient's anxiety.
e.zh: 治疗师对这位病人的焦虑采取了探索式的方法。

e.en: Children naturally adopt an {explorative} attitude toward new toys.
e.zh: 孩子们对新玩具天然抱有探索的态度。

exploratory.t: adj. 探索性的，试探性的

e.en: Doctors scheduled {exploratory} surgery to find the source of pain.
e.zh: 医生安排了探查性手术以查明疼痛的根源。

e.en: The committee held {exploratory} talks about a possible merger.
e.zh: 该委员会就可能的合并进行了探索性会谈。

e.en: Let's {explore} the new neighborhood this weekend.
e.zh: 我们这周末去那个新街区逛逛吧。

e.en: The app lets you {explore} 3D models of ancient temples.
e.zh: 这款应用让你以三维模型方式探索古代寺庙。

e.en: We {explored} every alley in the old town before lunch.
e.zh: 午饭前我们把老城的每条小巷都逛遍了。

e.en: The paper {explored} how social media affects teenage sleep.
e.zh: 这篇论文探讨了社交媒体如何影响青少年的睡眠。

explorer.t:
n. 探索者
n. 资源管理器（文件浏览器）

e.en: The young {explorer} kept a detailed journal of her travels.
e.zh: 这位年轻探险家详细记录了她的旅行日记。

e.en: Open the file {explorer} to find the downloaded image.
e.zh: 打开文件资源管理器找到下载好的图片。

explorers.t: n. 探索者，探险家（复数）

e.en: Portuguese {explorers} reached the coast of India in 1498.
e.zh: 葡萄牙探险家于1498年抵达印度海岸。

e.en: Modern {explorers} now map the deepest parts of the ocean.
e.zh: 现代探险家如今在测绘最深的海底区域。

explores.t: v. 探索（第三人称单数）

e.en: The documentary {explores} the impact of AI on creative jobs.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了人工智能对创意职业的影响。

e.en: My cat happily {explores} every cardboard box in the house.
e.zh: 我家的猫开心地钻遍家里的每一个纸箱。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {exploring} hidden cafes in Kyoto.
e.zh: 那个下午我们在京都到处找隐秘的小咖啡馆。

e.en: The startup is {exploring} ways to cut shipping costs.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在研究降低运费的办法。

explosion.t:
n. 爆炸
n. 激增，爆发

e.en: A gas {explosion} damaged several apartments downtown.
e.zh: 一次煤气爆炸损毁了市中心的几间公寓。

e.en: There has been an {explosion} of short-video apps in Asia.
e.zh: 短视频应用在亚洲呈爆炸式增长。

e.en: Witnesses reported two loud {explosions} near the harbor.
e.zh: 目击者称在港口附近听到两声巨大的爆炸声。

e.en: The film's CGI {explosions} look surprisingly realistic.
e.zh: 这部电影的特效爆炸场面看起来惊人地逼真。

explosive.t:
adj. 爆炸性的
n. 炸药

e.en: The CEO has an {explosive} temper in board meetings.
e.zh: 这位CEO在董事会上脾气非常暴躁。

e.en: Police found {explosive} material in the abandoned warehouse.
e.zh: 警方在废弃仓库中发现了爆炸物。

e.en: The video clip spread {explosively} across social media overnight.
e.zh: 那段视频一夜之间在社交媒体上爆炸式传播。

e.en: He laughed {explosively} at the comedian's punchline.
e.zh: 他对那位喜剧演员的笑点爆笑出声。

e.en: Coaches admire the sprinter's raw {explosiveness} off the blocks.
e.zh: 教练们赞叹这位短跑选手起跑时的爆发力。

e.en: The {explosiveness} of the debate surprised even seasoned reporters.
e.zh: 这场辩论的火爆程度连资深记者都感到意外。

e.en: Engineers used {explosives} to demolish the old bridge safely.
e.zh: 工程师用炸药安全地拆除了旧桥。

e.en: Airport scanners can detect tiny traces of {explosives}.
e.zh: 机场扫描仪能检测到极微量的爆炸物。

e.en: The tech {expo} drew thousands of developers to Shanghai.
e.zh: 这场科技博览会吸引了数千名开发者来到上海。

e.en: She showcased her ceramics at the local craft {expo}.
e.zh: 她在当地的手工艺博览会上展出了她的陶艺作品。

exponent.t:
n. 指数（数学）
n. 倡导者

e.en: She is a leading {exponent} of minimalist interior design.
e.zh: 她是极简主义室内设计的主要倡导者。

e.en: In math, the {exponent} tells you how many times to multiply.
e.zh: 在数学中,指数告诉你要把底数相乘多少次。

e.en: The startup saw {exponential} growth after the viral tweet.
e.zh: 那条推文走红后,这家初创公司迎来了指数级增长。

e.en: Compound interest follows an {exponential} curve over time.
e.zh: 复利随时间按指数曲线增长。

e.en: Storage costs have dropped {exponentially} over the past decade.
e.zh: 过去十年存储成本呈指数级下降。

e.en: The number of subscribers grew {exponentially} after the redesign.
e.zh: 改版之后订阅人数呈指数级激增。

export.t:
v. 导出（文件）；出口
n. 出口商品

e.en: You can {export} the chart as a PNG or PDF.
e.zh: 你可以把图表导出为PNG或PDF格式。

e.en: Vietnam continues to {export} large quantities of coffee.
e.zh: 越南继续大量出口咖啡。

exportable.t: adj. 可导出的，可出口的

e.en: All reports in this dashboard are {exportable} to Excel.
e.zh: 该面板中所有报表都可导出为Excel。

e.en: Make sure your contacts are {exportable} before switching phones.
e.zh: 换手机之前确保你的联系人可以导出。

e.en: The {exportation} of rare antiques requires special government permits.
e.zh: 出口稀有古董需要政府的特别许可。

e.en: New rules tightened the {exportation} of advanced semiconductors.
e.zh: 新规收紧了高端半导体的出口管控。

exported.t: v. 导出了；出口了（过去式）

e.en: I {exported} the spreadsheet and emailed it to my boss.
e.zh: 我把表格导出后用邮件发给了老板。

e.en: Last year, the country {exported} a record amount of beef.
e.zh: 去年该国牛肉出口量创下历史新高。

e.en: Brazil is the world's largest {exporter} of soybeans.
e.zh: 巴西是全球最大的大豆出口国。

e.en: The small {exporter} struggled to meet the new tariffs.
e.zh: 这家小型出口商难以应对新增的关税。

exporting.t: v. 正在导出；正在出口

e.en: The plugin keeps crashing while {exporting} large videos.
e.zh: 导出大视频时这个插件总是崩溃。

e.en: The company started {exporting} skincare products to Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 该公司开始向东南亚出口护肤产品。

exports.t:
v. 导出
n. 出口商品（复数）

e.en: Chinese {exports} to Europe rose sharply this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度中国对欧洲的出口大幅增长。

e.en: This module {exports} a single helper function.
e.zh: 这个模块导出了一个辅助函数。

expose.t:
v. 暴露，揭露
v. 公开（接口、方法）

e.en: The article aims to {expose} corruption in city hall.
e.zh: 这篇文章旨在揭露市政府的腐败行为。

e.en: Don't {expose} your skin to direct sunlight for too long.
e.zh: 不要让皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。

exposed.t:
adj. 暴露的
v. 揭露了（过去式）

e.en: The leak {exposed} thousands of users' email addresses.
e.zh: 这次泄露事件曝光了数千名用户的电子邮箱。

e.en: Hikers were {exposed} to freezing winds on the ridge.
e.zh: 徒步者在山脊上暴露在刺骨的寒风中。

exposes.t: v. 暴露，揭露（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new policy {exposes} a deep rift within the party.
e.zh: 新政策暴露了党内深层的分歧。

e.en: This API {exposes} only read-only endpoints to clients.
e.zh: 该API只向客户端开放只读接口。

exposing.t: v. 正在暴露，正在揭露

e.en: The journalist was praised for {exposing} the cover-up.
e.zh: 这名记者因揭露此次掩盖行为而受到赞扬。

e.en: He rolled up his sleeves, {exposing} a faded tattoo.
e.zh: 他卷起袖子,露出一处褪色的刺青。

e.en: The {extensiveness} of the research surprised everyone on the panel.
e.zh: 研究的广泛程度让评审委员会的所有人都感到惊讶。

e.en: We were impressed by the {extensiveness} of the menu options.
e.zh: 菜单选择之丰富让我们印象深刻。

e.en: The {extensor} muscles in your forearm straighten the fingers.
e.zh: 前臂的伸肌负责伸直手指。

e.en: He strained an {extensor} tendon while playing tennis.
e.zh: 他打网球时拉伤了一条伸肌肌腱。

e.en: We didn't realize the {extent} of the damage until morning.
e.zh: 直到早晨我们才意识到损失的严重程度。

e.en: To some {extent}, both sides share the blame.
e.zh: 在某种程度上,双方都有责任。

extents.t: n. 程度、范围（extent 的复数）

e.en: She went to incredible {extents} to surprise her partner.
e.zh: 她费尽心思想给伴侣一个惊喜。

e.en: The map shows the {extents} of the protected forest.
e.zh: 地图标出了保护林的范围边界。

e.en: Nothing can {extenuate} such a serious breach of trust.
e.zh: 没有什么能减轻这种严重背信行为的责任。

e.en: The lawyer tried to {extenuate} her client's role in the crime.
e.zh: 律师试图减轻当事人在该案中的责任。

extenuating.t: adj. 可减轻罪责的；情有可原的

e.en: The judge considered {extenuating} circumstances before sentencing.
e.zh: 法官在量刑前考虑了从轻的情节。

e.en: He missed the deadline due to {extenuating} family issues.
e.zh: 由于家中有特殊情况,他错过了截止日期。

exterior.t:
adj. 外部的；外表的
n. 外观

e.en: They repainted the {exterior} of the house last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们重新粉刷了房屋外墙。

e.en: Beneath his tough {exterior} lies a kind heart.
e.zh: 在他强硬的外表下藏着一颗善良的心。

e.en: The philosopher explored the {exteriority} of human experience.
e.zh: 这位哲学家探讨了人类经验的外在性。

e.en: In phenomenology, {exteriority} contrasts with inner consciousness.
e.zh: 在现象学中,外在性与内在意识相对。

exteriors.t: n. 外观、外表（exterior 的复数）

e.en: The film shot all the {exteriors} on location in Iceland.
e.zh: 这部影片所有外景都在冰岛实地拍摄。

e.en: Many old building {exteriors} have been carefully restored.
e.zh: 许多老建筑的外立面已经过精心修复。

e.en: The company was hired to {exterminate} termites in the attic.
e.zh: 该公司受雇消灭阁楼里的白蚁。

e.en: Conservationists fear poachers will {exterminate} the species entirely.
e.zh: 环保人士担心偷猎者会让该物种彻底灭绝。

e.en: The crew is {exterminating} cockroaches throughout the building.
e.zh: 工作人员正在消灭整栋楼里的蟑螂。

e.en: {Exterminating} invasive rats saved the island's seabird colony.
e.zh: 消灭外来鼠类拯救了岛上的海鸟群。

e.en: The {extermination} of bedbugs took several treatments.
e.zh: 清除臭虫前后做了好几次处理。

e.en: Historians documented the systematic {extermination} of entire communities.
e.zh: 历史学家记录了整个族群遭到系统性灭绝的过程。

e.en: We called an {exterminator} to deal with the rats in the basement.
e.zh: 我们叫了灭虫人员来处理地下室的老鼠。

e.en: The {exterminator} sprayed every corner of the apartment.
e.zh: 灭虫员在公寓的每个角落都喷了药。

e.en: I back up my photos to an {external} hard drive every week.
e.zh: 我每周都把照片备份到外接硬盘上。

e.en: The company hired an {external} consultant to review the strategy.
e.zh: 公司聘请了外部顾问来审查战略。

externality.t: n. 外部性（经济学）；外在

e.en: Pollution is a classic negative {externality} of industrial production.
e.zh: 污染是工业生产典型的负外部性。

e.en: Economists argue that carbon taxes can correct this {externality}.
e.zh: 经济学家认为碳税可以纠正这种外部性。

e.en: Writing notes is a useful {externalization} of your thinking.
e.zh: 写笔记是把思考外化的有效方式。

e.en: The {externalization} of costs onto society harms the environment.
e.zh: 把成本转嫁给社会会损害环境。

externalize.t: v. 使外在化；表现出来

e.en: Try to {externalize} your worries by writing them down.
e.zh: 试着把烦恼写下来,把它们外化出来。

e.en: Some people {externalize} blame instead of taking responsibility.
e.zh: 有些人会把责任归咎他人,而不是自己承担。

e.en: She {externalized} her anxiety through long runs every morning.
e.zh: 她通过每天早上的长跑来释放焦虑。

e.en: The team {externalized} their workflow into a shared document.
e.zh: 团队把工作流程外化为一份共享文档。

e.en: He has a habit of {externalizing} every problem onto his coworkers.
e.zh: 他习惯把每个问题都推到同事身上。

e.en: Journaling is a way of {externalizing} complicated feelings.
e.zh: 写日记是把复杂情绪外化的一种方式。

e.en: The drive can be powered {externally} through a USB cable.
e.zh: 这个硬盘可以通过 USB 线从外部供电。

e.en: She seemed calm {externally} but was nervous inside.
e.zh: 她表面看起来很冷静,内心却很紧张。

e.en: Dinosaurs went {extinct} about sixty-six million years ago.
e.zh: 恐龙大约在六千六百万年前灭绝了。

e.en: Many languages are becoming {extinct} as elders pass away.
e.zh: 随着长辈相继离世,许多语言正在消亡。

e.en: Climate change pushes many species toward {extinction}.
e.zh: 气候变化让许多物种濒临灭绝。

e.en: Conservation groups are fighting to prevent the {extinction} of tigers.
e.zh: 保护组织正在努力防止老虎灭绝。

extinctions.t: n. 多次灭绝事件（extinction 的复数）

e.en: Earth has experienced five mass {extinctions} in its history.
e.zh: 地球历史上经历过五次大灭绝。

e.en: Recent {extinctions} of insects worry many scientists.
e.zh: 近期昆虫的灭绝让许多科学家感到担忧。

e.en: Firefighters worked all night to {extinguish} the forest fire.
e.zh: 消防员通宵奋战扑灭了那场森林大火。

e.en: Please {extinguish} your cigarette before entering the building.
e.zh: 进入大楼前请先把烟掐灭。

e.en: The candles {extinguished} themselves when the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风一刮起来,蜡烛就自己熄灭了。

e.en: Years of failure had {extinguished} his hope of winning.
e.zh: 多年的失败已经熄灭了他获胜的希望。

e.en: Every kitchen should have a fire {extinguisher} within reach.
e.zh: 每间厨房都应该在伸手可及处放一个灭火器。

e.en: He grabbed the {extinguisher} and put out the small flames.
e.zh: 他抓起灭火器扑灭了那点小火苗。

e.en: The crew spent hours {extinguishing} the warehouse fire.
e.zh: 消防队花了几个小时才扑灭仓库的火。

e.en: Bad reviews kept {extinguishing} his enthusiasm for the project.
e.zh: 差评不断浇灭他对这个项目的热情。

e.en: The government tried to {extirpate} corruption from the agency.
e.zh: 政府试图把这家机构里的腐败彻底铲除。

e.en: Hunters had nearly {extirpate}d wolves from the region.
e.zh: 猎人几乎把这一地区的狼赶尽杀绝。

e.en: The {extirpation} of beavers changed the river ecosystem.
e.zh: 海狸的灭绝改变了整条河的生态。

e.en: Activists demanded the {extirpation} of child labor in the industry.
e.zh: 活动人士要求彻底根除该行业的童工现象。

e.en: Reviewers continue to {extol} the virtues of the new phone.
e.zh: 评论员们一直在大力称赞这款新手机的优点。

e.en: Coaches often {extol} the importance of teamwork.
e.zh: 教练经常盛赞团队合作的重要性。

e.en: The hackers tried to {extort} money by encrypting company files.
e.zh: 黑客通过加密公司文件试图勒索钱财。

e.en: He was arrested for trying to {extort} his former boss.
e.zh: 他因试图敲诈前老板而被捕。

e.en: The gang was charged with {extortion} and money laundering.
e.zh: 这个团伙被指控敲诈勒索和洗钱。

e.en: Charging that price for water feels like outright {extortion}.
e.zh: 水卖那个价钱简直就是赤裸裸的敲诈。

extortionate.t: adj. (价格) 过高的；敲诈性的

e.en: The hotel charges {extortionate} prices for bottled water.
e.zh: 酒店瓶装水的价格高得离谱。

e.en: Concert tickets have become almost {extortionate} this year.
e.zh: 今年的演唱会门票贵得近乎敲诈。

e.en: Police finally caught the {extortionist} who had been threatening shop owners.
e.zh: 警方终于抓住了那个一直威胁店主的敲诈者。

e.en: An online {extortionist} demanded payment in cryptocurrency.
e.zh: 一名网络敲诈者要求用加密货币付款。

extortions.t: n. 敲诈行为（extortion 的复数）

e.en: The mafia's {extortions} drained small businesses for years.
e.zh: 黑手党的勒索让小商家多年来不堪重负。

e.en: Investigators uncovered a long pattern of {extortions} by the official.
e.zh: 调查人员揭露了那名官员长期的敲诈勒索行为。

extra.t:
adj. 额外的
n. 附加物；临时演员

e.en: Could I get an {extra} pillow for the bed, please?
e.zh: 可以再给我一个床上用的枕头吗?

e.en: She worked {extra} hours to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 她加班加点才按时完成了这个项目。

e.en: Calcium plays an important role in the {extracellular} space.
e.zh: 钙在细胞外空间发挥着重要作用。

e.en: Researchers are studying {extracellular} signals between neurons.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究神经元之间的细胞外信号。

extract.t:
v. 提取；摘录
n. 提取物；摘录

e.en: The dentist had to {extract} my wisdom tooth yesterday.
e.zh: 牙医昨天不得不把我的智齿拔掉。

e.en: Use a script to {extract} the email addresses from the file.
e.zh: 用脚本把文件里的邮箱地址提取出来。

extractable.t: adj. 可提取的；可提炼的

e.en: Only a small fraction of the data is easily {extractable}.
e.zh: 这些数据中只有一小部分容易提取出来。

e.en: The minerals in this rock are not commercially {extractable}.
e.zh: 这块岩石里的矿物在商业上无法开采。

e.en: The script {extracted} all the phone numbers from the document.
e.zh: 这个脚本从文档里提取出了所有电话号码。

e.en: Workers {extracted} oil from the field for over fifty years.
e.zh: 工人们在这块油田采油已经超过五十年。

e.en: The tool is great for {extracting} text from scanned PDFs.
e.zh: 这个工具非常适合从扫描版 PDF 中提取文字。

e.en: They are {extracting} lithium from the salt flats in Chile.
e.zh: 他们正从智利的盐湖里提炼锂。

e.en: The {extraction} of the broken tooth took less than an hour.
e.zh: 拔掉那颗坏牙花了不到一个小时。

e.en: Data {extraction} from old systems can be surprisingly tricky.
e.zh: 从旧系统中提取数据有时会异常棘手。

e.en: The country's economy depends heavily on {extractive} industries like mining.
e.zh: 这个国家的经济严重依赖采矿等开采型产业。

e.en: Critics argue the business model is purely {extractive}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这种商业模式纯粹是榨取式的。

e.en: Turn on the {extractor} fan whenever you fry food.
e.zh: 煎炸食物时记得打开抽油烟机。

e.en: He used a juice {extractor} to make fresh orange juice.
e.zh: 他用榨汁机榨了新鲜的橙汁。

extracts.t:
n. 提取物；摘录
v. 提取（第三人称单数）

e.en: The book includes {extracts} from her private letters.
e.zh: 这本书收录了她私人信件中的几段摘录。

e.en: Many shampoos contain plant {extracts} like aloe and chamomile.
e.zh: 许多洗发水含有芦荟、洋甘菊等植物提取物。

e.en: Universities look closely at students' {extracurricular} activities.
e.zh: 大学会仔细考察学生的课外活动。

e.en: Soccer was his favorite {extracurricular} class in middle school.
e.zh: 足球是他中学时最喜欢的课外课程。

e.en: Her resume listed several impressive {extracurriculars} from college.
e.zh: 她的简历上列着大学时几项亮眼的课外活动。

e.en: Too many {extracurriculars} can leave kids exhausted.
e.zh: 课外活动太多会让孩子精疲力尽。

e.en: The country refused to {extradite} the suspect to the United States.
e.zh: 该国拒绝把嫌疑人引渡到美国。

e.en: Officials are negotiating to {extradite} the fugitive back home.
e.zh: 官员们正在协商把这名逃犯引渡回国。

e.en: The two countries signed a new {extradition} treaty last year.
e.zh: 两国去年签署了一份新的引渡条约。

e.en: His lawyers are fighting the {extradition} request in court.
e.zh: 他的律师正在法庭上抗辩这项引渡请求。

e.en: The telescope detected {extragalactic} radio waves from a distant source.
e.zh: 望远镜捕捉到了来自遥远星系外天体的射电波。

e.en: She studies {extragalactic} astronomy at the observatory.
e.zh: 她在天文台研究河外天文学。

exposition.t:
n. 阐述，说明
n. 展览会

e.en: The opening chapter is mostly {exposition} about the family's history.
e.zh: 开篇章节大多在交代这个家族的历史背景。

e.en: The world {exposition} attracted visitors from over 80 countries.
e.zh: 世界博览会吸引了来自八十多个国家的游客。

e.en: Students were asked to write an {expository} essay on climate change.
e.zh: 学生被要求写一篇关于气候变化的说明文。

e.en: The opening scene is too {expository} and slows the film.
e.zh: 开场过于交代背景,拖慢了整部电影的节奏。

e.en: She tried to {expostulate} with the manager about the unfair fine.
e.zh: 她试图就这笔不公平的罚款与经理理论。

e.en: It's pointless to {expostulate} with someone who won't listen.
e.zh: 跟一个根本不听的人讲道理毫无意义。

exposure.t:
n. 暴露，接触
n. 曝光（摄影）

e.en: Long {exposure} to blue light may strain your eyes.
e.zh: 长时间接触蓝光可能会让眼睛疲劳。

e.en: The viral post gave her brand huge {exposure} overnight.
e.zh: 那条爆款帖子让她的品牌一夜之间获得了巨大曝光。

e.en: The photographer combined three {exposures} to balance the light.
e.zh: 这位摄影师合成了三张曝光来平衡光线。

e.en: Workers reported repeated {exposures} to harmful chemicals.
e.zh: 工人反映多次接触到有害化学物质。

e.en: The professor loves to {expound} on ancient Roman politics.
e.zh: 那位教授喜欢长篇大论地讲古罗马政治。

e.en: He took the floor to {expound} his vision for the company.
e.zh: 他上台详细阐述了他对公司的愿景。

express.t:
v. 表达，表示
adj. 快速的，特快的

e.en: It's hard to {express} how grateful I am for your help.
e.zh: 很难表达我对你帮助的感激之情。

e.en: Take the {express} train if you want to skip the suburbs.
e.zh: 如果想跳过郊区站点,就坐特快列车。

expressed.t:
v. 表达（过去式）
adj. 明确表示的

e.en: Several employees {expressed} concerns about the new policy.
e.zh: 几名员工对新政策表达了担忧。

e.en: Her face {expressed} surprise even before she spoke.
e.zh: 她还没开口,脸上就已经流露出惊讶。

expresses.t: v. 表达（第三人称单数）

e.en: This song {expresses} the loneliness of long-distance relationships.
e.zh: 这首歌表达了异地恋的孤独感。

e.en: The CEO {expresses} confidence in the company's roadmap.
e.zh: 这位CEO对公司的发展规划表示有信心。

expressible.t: adj. 可表达的，能表述的

e.en: Some emotions are barely {expressible} in words.
e.zh: 有些情感几乎无法用语言表达。

e.en: Every rational number is {expressible} as a fraction.
e.zh: 每个有理数都可以表示为一个分数。

e.en: He has trouble {expressing} feelings in front of his family.
e.zh: 他在家人面前不太会表达感情。

e.en: Fans flooded the comments {expressing} support for the singer.
e.zh: 粉丝们涌入评论区表达对这位歌手的支持。

expression.t:
n. 表达，表述
n. 表情；表达式

e.en: A puzzled {expression} crossed her face when she read the message.
e.zh: 她读到那条消息时,脸上闪过一丝困惑。

e.en: Art is a powerful form of personal {expression}.
e.zh: 艺术是一种强有力的个人表达方式。

expressionism.t: n. 表现主义（艺术流派）

e.en: German {expressionism} influenced many modern horror films.
e.zh: 德国表现主义影响了许多现代恐怖电影。

e.en: The museum's new wing focuses on abstract {expressionism}.
e.zh: 博物馆的新展厅专门展出抽象表现主义作品。

expressionist.t:
n. 表现主义者
adj. 表现主义的

e.en: He paints in a bold {expressionist} style.
e.zh: 他以大胆的表现主义风格作画。

e.en: The gallery features {expressionist} works from the 1920s.
e.zh: 画廊展出了二十年代的表现主义作品。

e.en: The film uses {expressionistic} lighting to create unease.
e.zh: 这部电影用表现主义式的灯光营造不安感。

e.en: Her dance moves were dramatic and {expressionistic}.
e.zh: 她的舞步戏剧化且富有表现主义色彩。

expressionless.t: adj. 面无表情的，木然的

e.en: His face remained {expressionless} during the entire interview.
e.zh: 整个面试过程中他的脸都毫无表情。

e.en: The robot stared back with an {expressionless} gaze.
e.zh: 机器人用毫无表情的目光回望。

e.en: She stared {expressionlessly} at the screen for hours.
e.zh: 她面无表情地盯着屏幕看了好几个小时。

e.en: The judge listened {expressionlessly} to both arguments.
e.zh: 法官面无表情地听完了双方的陈述。

e.en: Idiomatic {expressions} are tricky for language learners.
e.zh: 习惯用语对语言学习者来说很棘手。

e.en: Her facial {expressions} gave away her real feelings.
e.zh: 她的面部表情泄露了真实感受。

expressive.t: adj. 富有表现力的，传神的

e.en: The toddler has a wonderfully {expressive} face.
e.zh: 这个小孩有一张表情丰富得让人喜爱的脸。

e.en: Python is a concise yet {expressive} programming language.
e.zh: Python 是一门简洁而表达力强的编程语言。

e.en: She gestured {expressively} while telling the story.
e.zh: 她讲故事时手势丰富生动。

e.en: The pianist played {expressively}, drawing tears from the audience.
e.zh: 钢琴家演奏得动情至深,让观众落泪。

e.en: The {expressiveness} of his writing won her over.
e.zh: 他文字的表现力打动了她。

e.en: Sign language has remarkable {expressiveness} and nuance.
e.zh: 手语有着惊人的表现力和细腻度。

e.en: The new query language offers greater {expressivity} than SQL.
e.zh: 这种新查询语言比 SQL 表达力更强。

e.en: Genetic {expressivity} varies even among identical twins.
e.zh: 即使在同卵双胞胎之间,基因表现度也存在差异。

e.en: The contract {expressly} forbids subletting the apartment.
e.zh: 合同明确禁止转租公寓。

e.en: This tool was designed {expressly} for video editors.
e.zh: 这款工具是专门为视频剪辑师设计的。

e.en: Traffic on the {expressway} crawled for over an hour.
e.zh: 高速公路上的车流缓慢移动了一个多小时。

e.en: Take the {expressway} to reach downtown faster.
e.zh: 走高速公路可以更快到达市中心。

e.en: The government may {expropriate} land to build the railway.
e.zh: 政府可能征用土地来修建铁路。

e.en: Critics warned the regime would {expropriate} foreign assets.
e.zh: 批评者警告该政权会没收外国资产。

e.en: The state {expropriated} hundreds of private factories overnight.
e.zh: 国家一夜之间征收了数百家私营工厂。

e.en: His family's farmland was {expropriated} during the revolution.
e.zh: 他家的农田在革命期间被征收了。

e.en: Investors fear {expropriation} in politically unstable countries.
e.zh: 投资者担心在政治不稳定的国家遭遇财产征用。

e.en: The court ordered fair compensation for the land {expropriation}.
e.zh: 法院判令为此次土地征用给予合理补偿。

e.en: Cheating on the exam led to his {expulsion} from school.
e.zh: 考试作弊导致他被学校开除。

e.en: The {expulsion} of the diplomat strained relations between the countries.
e.zh: 驱逐这名外交官使两国关系紧张。

e.en: He hired a lawyer to {expunge} the arrest from his record.
e.zh: 他请律师把那次逮捕记录从档案中清除。

e.en: The editor decided to {expunge} every offensive passage.
e.zh: 编辑决定删除每一段冒犯性的内容。

e.en: Schools sometimes {expurgate} classic novels for younger readers.
e.zh: 学校有时会删改经典小说给年轻读者阅读。

e.en: The censors tried to {expurgate} all political references.
e.zh: 审查员试图删去所有涉及政治的内容。

e.en: She wore an {exquisite} silk dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一件精美的丝绸礼服参加晚宴。

e.en: The chef prepared an {exquisite} seven-course tasting menu.
e.zh: 主厨准备了一份精致的七道菜品鉴菜单。

e.en: The watch is {exquisitely} crafted by hand.
e.zh: 这块手表是纯手工精心制作的。

e.en: Her debut novel is {exquisitely} written and deeply moving.
e.zh: 她的处女作文笔精美,感人至深。

ext.t: n. 分机号；扩展（extension 的缩写）

e.en: Please call me at {ext} 412 after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后请打分机 412 找我。

e.en: Save the file with a .txt {ext} for compatibility.
e.zh: 为了兼容性,请用 .txt 扩展名保存文件。

e.en: Only three copies of the manuscript are still {extant}.
e.zh: 这份手稿现存仅剩三份。

e.en: The museum displays the oldest {extant} map of the city.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着这座城市现存最古老的地图。

e.en: Her {extemporaneous} speech moved the entire audience.
e.zh: 她即兴的演讲打动了全场观众。

e.en: The debate format requires {extemporaneous} responses to the prompts.
e.zh: 这种辩论形式要求选手即兴回应议题。

e.en: He spoke {extemporaneously} for twenty minutes without notes.
e.zh: 他不用讲稿即兴演讲了二十分钟。

e.en: The musician composed {extemporaneously} based on audience suggestions.
e.zh: 这位音乐家根据观众的建议即兴创作。

extempore.t:
adj. 即兴的
adv. 即兴地

e.en: The mayor delivered her remarks {extempore} after the announcement.
e.zh: 市长在宣布消息后即兴发表了讲话。

e.en: Jazz musicians often play {extempore} during live shows.
e.zh: 爵士乐手在现场演出中常常即兴演奏。

e.en: Good teachers can {extemporize} when students ask unexpected questions.
e.zh: 好老师在学生提出意外问题时能够即兴应对。

e.en: The pianist began to {extemporize} on a simple folk tune.
e.zh: 钢琴家开始基于一首简单的民谣即兴演奏。

extend.t:
v. 延伸，扩展
v. 延长，延期

e.en: Can we {extend} the deadline by another week?
e.zh: 我们能把截止日期再延长一周吗?

e.en: The new library will {extend} into the empty lot next door.
e.zh: 新图书馆将向旁边的空地延伸扩建。

extendable.t: adj. 可延伸的，可扩展的

e.en: The dining table is {extendable} to seat ten people.
e.zh: 这张餐桌可以拉伸,容纳十个人就座。

e.en: They offer a six-month contract {extendable} for another year.
e.zh: 他们提供一份可再延长一年的六个月合同。

e.en: We {extended} our vacation by three more days.
e.zh: 我们把假期又延长了三天。

e.en: My {extended} family gathers every Lunar New Year.
e.zh: 我的大家庭每年春节都会聚一聚。

e.en: A WiFi {extender} fixed the dead spot in our basement.
e.zh: 一个 WiFi 信号扩展器解决了我们地下室的信号盲区。

e.en: The hairdresser used a hose {extender} to reach the sink.
e.zh: 理发师用了一个软管延长器才够到水池。

extending.t: v. 延伸，扩展（现在分词）

e.en: The company is {extending} parental leave to twenty weeks.
e.zh: 公司正在把育儿假延长到二十周。

e.en: A long pier was {extending} far into the calm sea.
e.zh: 一条长长的码头向平静的海面延伸而去。

extends.t: v. 延伸（第三人称单数）；继承（编程）

e.en: The warranty {extends} for two years from the purchase date.
e.zh: 保修期自购买之日起延续两年。

e.en: In Java, the Dog class {extends} the Animal class.
e.zh: 在 Java 中,Dog 类继承自 Animal 类。

extensible.t: adj. 可扩展的，可延伸的

e.en: The framework is fully {extensible} through plugins and hooks.
e.zh: 这个框架完全可以通过插件和钩子来扩展。

e.en: XML stands for {extensible} markup language.
e.zh: XML 表示可扩展标记语言。

extension.t:
n. 扩展，延伸
n. 分机；插件

e.en: I requested a one-week {extension} on my essay.
e.zh: 我申请把论文的截止时间延后一周。

e.en: Install the browser {extension} to block annoying ads.
e.zh: 安装这个浏览器扩展程序就能拦截烦人的广告。

e.en: In set theory, {extensional} equality compares actual members.
e.zh: 在集合论中,外延相等比较的是实际的元素。

e.en: The two definitions are {extensional}ly equivalent but worded differently.
e.zh: 这两种定义在外延上等价,只是表述不同。

e.en: She wore long hair {extensions} to the wedding.
e.zh: 她戴着长长的接发去参加婚礼。

e.en: VS Code has thousands of useful {extensions} available.
e.zh: VS Code 提供成千上万个实用的扩展程序。

e.en: She has {extensive} experience in product design.
e.zh: 她在产品设计方面有丰富的经验。

e.en: The fire caused {extensive} damage to the warehouse.
e.zh: 这场火灾对仓库造成了大面积损失。

e.en: This drug has been {extensively} tested in clinical trials.
e.zh: 这种药已经在临床试验中经过了广泛测试。

e.en: He has traveled {extensively} throughout Southeast Asia.
e.zh: 他在东南亚各地广泛游历过。

extrajudicial.t: adj. 法外的；司法程序外的

e.en: Human rights groups condemned the {extrajudicial} killings.
e.zh: 人权组织谴责了这些法外处决行为。

e.en: The report documented widespread {extrajudicial} detentions.
e.zh: 该报告记录了大量法外拘留事件。

extralinguistic.t: adj. 语言之外的；非语言的

e.en: Body language and tone are important {extralinguistic} cues.
e.zh: 肢体语言和语调是重要的语言外线索。

e.en: Translators must consider {extralinguistic} context, not just words.
e.zh: 译者不仅要看字面,还要考虑语言外的语境。

e.en: The scandal involved an {extramarital} affair with a coworker.
e.zh: 那起丑闻涉及与同事的婚外情。

e.en: Many cultures still strongly disapprove of {extramarital} relationships.
e.zh: 许多文化至今仍强烈反对婚外关系。

e.en: The university funds several {extramural} research projects each year.
e.zh: 这所大学每年资助若干校外研究项目。

e.en: He plays in an {extramural} basketball league on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末在一个校外篮球联赛里打球。

e.en: The composer drew inspiration from {extramusical} sources like poetry.
e.zh: 这位作曲家从诗歌等音乐之外的领域汲取灵感。

e.en: Critics dismissed the {extramusical} associations as distracting.
e.zh: 评论家认为那些音乐之外的联想反而分散了注意力。

e.en: Please remove any {extraneous} details from the report.
e.zh: 请把报告中无关的细节都删掉。

e.en: The essay includes a lot of {extraneous} information.
e.zh: 这篇文章夹杂了不少多余的信息。

extranet.t: n. 外联网（企业对外网络）

e.en: Suppliers log into the company {extranet} to track their orders.
e.zh: 供应商通过公司外联网登录,跟踪自己的订单。

e.en: The {extranet} lets partners share files securely.
e.zh: 这套外联网让合作伙伴可以安全地共享文件。

extraordinaire.t: adj. 非凡的；出类拔萃的

e.en: She's a baker {extraordinaire}, famous for her sourdough bread.
e.zh: 她是出类拔萃的烘焙师,以酸面包闻名。

e.en: Meet our chef {extraordinaire}, who trained in Paris.
e.zh: 来认识一下我们这位非凡的主厨,他曾在巴黎深造。

e.en: The new model is {extraordinarily} good at summarizing long documents.
e.zh: 这个新模型在总结长文档方面表现得异常出色。

e.en: She was {extraordinarily} kind to me during my first week.
e.zh: 我刚来的第一周,她对我格外关照。

e.en: What an {extraordinary} performance by the young pianist tonight!
e.zh: 今晚这位年轻钢琴家的演出真是非同凡响!

e.en: The team achieved {extraordinary} results despite the small budget.
e.zh: 尽管预算有限,团队还是取得了非凡的成绩。

e.en: It's risky to {extrapolate} long-term trends from just two data points.
e.zh: 仅凭两个数据点推断长期趋势是很冒险的。

e.en: Analysts {extrapolate} future sales based on this quarter's growth.
e.zh: 分析师根据本季度的增长来推算未来的销售。

e.en: The forecast is just an {extrapolation} of last year's numbers.
e.zh: 这份预测只是对去年数据的简单外推。

e.en: Such an {extrapolation} ignores changes in consumer behavior.
e.zh: 这种推断忽视了消费者行为的变化。

extras.t: n. 额外之物；（影视）群众演员

e.en: The movie hired hundreds of {extras} for the battle scene.
e.zh: 这部电影为战争场面雇了数百名群众演员。

e.en: The hotel room comes with free {extras} like breakfast and Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 这间酒店房间附赠早餐和无线网络等额外服务。

e.en: She claims to have {extrasensory} perception and can read minds.
e.zh: 她声称拥有超感官知觉，能读懂别人的心思。

e.en: Scientists remain skeptical about {extrasensory} abilities.
e.zh: 科学家对超感官能力仍持怀疑态度。

e.en: Astronomers discovered a new {extrasolar} planet last week.
e.zh: 天文学家上周发现了一颗新的太阳系外行星。

e.en: The telescope is designed to detect {extrasolar} worlds.
e.zh: 这台望远镜专为探测系外行星而设计。

extraterrestrial.t:
adj. 外星的
n. 外星人

e.en: NASA continues searching for {extraterrestrial} life on Mars.
e.zh: 美国航空航天局继续在火星上寻找外星生命。

e.en: The film features a friendly {extraterrestrial} who befriends a boy.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个友好的外星人与男孩结为朋友的故事。

extraterritorial.t: adj. 治外法权的；域外的

e.en: Embassies enjoy {extraterritorial} status under international law.
e.zh: 根据国际法，使馆享有治外法权地位。

e.en: The law has {extraterritorial} reach over crimes committed abroad.
e.zh: 该法律对境外犯罪也具有域外管辖权。

e.en: Diplomats invoked {extraterritoriality} to avoid local prosecution.
e.zh: 外交官援引治外法权以避免当地起诉。

e.en: The treaty granted foreign citizens {extraterritoriality} in port cities.
e.zh: 该条约赋予外国公民在港口城市的治外法权。

e.en: Critics drew on {extratextual} sources to interpret the novel.
e.zh: 评论家借助文本之外的资料来解读这部小说。

e.en: The judge refused to consider {extratextual} evidence about intent.
e.zh: 法官拒绝考虑文本之外有关意图的证据。

e.en: Her wedding was a stunning display of {extravagance}.
e.zh: 她的婚礼极尽奢华，令人惊叹。

e.en: He was criticized for the {extravagance} of his spending habits.
e.zh: 他因挥霍无度的消费习惯而受到批评。

e.en: She gave up small {extravagances} to save for a house.
e.zh: 她放弃了一些小奢侈，攒钱买房。

e.en: The CEO's {extravagances} included private jets and luxury yachts.
e.zh: 这位首席执行官的奢侈消费包括私人飞机和豪华游艇。

e.en: He made {extravagant} promises that he could never keep.
e.zh: 他许下了根本无法兑现的夸张承诺。

e.en: They threw an {extravagant} party for her fortieth birthday.
e.zh: 他们为她的四十岁生日办了一场奢华的派对。

e.en: She dresses {extravagantly} for every red carpet event.
e.zh: 她每次出席红毯活动都穿得极其奢华。

e.en: The critics praised the film {extravagantly} after the premiere.
e.zh: 首映过后，影评人对这部电影赞不绝口。

extravaganza.t: n. 盛大演出；华丽盛会

e.en: The show was a musical {extravaganza} with dazzling costumes.
e.zh: 这场演出是一场华丽的音乐盛会，服装炫目。

e.en: Fans gathered for the annual fireworks {extravaganza} downtown.
e.zh: 粉丝们聚集在市中心参加一年一度的烟火盛会。

e.en: Personality tests often measure {extraversion} and openness.
e.zh: 性格测试通常会测量外向性和开放性。

e.en: Her high {extraversion} makes her thrive at networking events.
e.zh: 她外向性很高，因此在社交活动中如鱼得水。

e.en: As an {extravert}, he gains energy from being around people.
e.zh: 作为一个外向的人，他从与人相处中获得能量。

e.en: The job suits an {extravert} who enjoys public speaking.
e.zh: 这份工作适合喜欢公开演讲的外向者。

e.en: She is naturally {extraverted} and loves meeting new clients.
e.zh: 她天生外向，喜欢结识新客户。

e.en: More {extraverted} students often dominate class discussions.
e.zh: 比较外向的学生常常在课堂讨论中占主导。

extreme.t:
adj. 极端的；极度的
n. 极端

e.en: The desert experiences {extreme} temperatures during summer.
e.zh: 沙漠在夏天会经历极端的高温。

e.en: He took an {extreme} position in the political debate.
e.zh: 他在政治辩论中持极端立场。

e.en: The new phone is {extremely} fast and lightweight.
e.zh: 这款新手机极其快速且轻便。

e.en: I'm {extremely} grateful for all your help today.
e.zh: 我非常感谢你今天提供的所有帮助。

e.en: The climate here swings between {extremes} of hot and cold.
e.zh: 这里的气候在酷热和严寒两个极端之间来回摆动。

e.en: He goes to {extremes} just to win an argument.
e.zh: 为了赢一场争论，他可以走极端。

e.en: The government launched a campaign against online {extremism}.
e.zh: 政府发起了一场打击网络极端主义的行动。

e.en: Religious {extremism} threatens peace in many regions.
e.zh: 宗教极端主义威胁着许多地区的和平。

extremist.t:
n. 极端分子
adj. 极端的

e.en: Police arrested an {extremist} planning an attack downtown.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名计划在市中心发动袭击的极端分子。

e.en: His {extremist} views alienated even close friends.
e.zh: 他的极端观点让连亲密朋友都疏远了他。

e.en: Social media platforms struggle to remove {extremists} from their networks.
e.zh: 社交媒体平台难以将极端分子从其网络中清除。

e.en: A small group of {extremists} disrupted the peaceful protest.
e.zh: 一小撮极端分子扰乱了和平抗议活动。

e.en: Cold weather can be dangerous for the {extremity} of fingers and toes.
e.zh: 寒冷天气可能对手指和脚趾这些末梢部位造成危险。

e.en: In her {extremity}, she finally called for help.
e.zh: 在万分危急之时，她终于求救了。

e.en: Scientists found an {extremophile} thriving in boiling hot springs.
e.zh: 科学家发现一种嗜极生物在沸腾的温泉中繁衍生息。

e.en: This {extremophile} survives in the most acidic environments on Earth.
e.zh: 这种嗜极生物能在地球上最酸的环境中存活。

extricable.t: adj. 可摆脱的；可解开的

e.en: The tangled cables were barely {extricable} from the box.
e.zh: 那些缠在一起的电缆几乎无法从箱子里解开。

e.en: He found his savings not easily {extricable} from the locked account.
e.zh: 他发现自己的存款很难从被冻结的账户中取出。

e.en: It took hours to {extricate} the driver from the wreckage.
e.zh: 花了几个小时才把司机从车祸残骸中救出来。

e.en: She struggled to {extricate} herself from the awkward conversation.
e.zh: 她努力想从这场尴尬的对话中脱身。

e.en: The firefighters' quick {extrication} of the victim saved his life.
e.zh: 消防员迅速将伤者救出，挽救了他的生命。

e.en: Her {extrication} from the failing company took months of negotiation.
e.zh: 她从那家濒临破产的公司脱身花了数月的谈判。

e.en: Money is an {extrinsic} motivator, while passion is intrinsic.
e.zh: 金钱是外在的激励，而热情是内在的。

e.en: The value of the painting is largely {extrinsic} to its appearance.
e.zh: 这幅画的价值很大程度上与它的外观无关。

e.en: Employees who are {extrinsically} motivated often need constant rewards.
e.zh: 靠外部因素激励的员工往往需要持续的奖励。

e.en: The data is {extrinsically} valuable because of market demand.
e.zh: 由于市场需求，这些数据具有外在的价值。

e.en: His {extroversion} makes him a natural fit for sales roles.
e.zh: 他的外向性格让他天生适合销售工作。

e.en: Studies link {extroversion} to greater social satisfaction.
e.zh: 研究表明外向性与更高的社交满意度相关。

e.en: She's a true {extrovert} who loves big parties and crowds.
e.zh: 她是个真正的外向者，喜欢大型派对和人群。

e.en: Being an {extrovert} helps when networking at conferences.
e.zh: 参加会议时社交起来，外向性格很有帮助。

e.en: His {extroverted} personality made him popular at school.
e.zh: 他外向的性格让他在学校很受欢迎。

e.en: The team needed someone more {extroverted} to lead client meetings.
e.zh: 团队需要一个更外向的人来主持客户会议。

e.en: The machine can {extrude} plastic into long, thin tubes.
e.zh: 这台机器可以将塑料挤压成又长又细的管子。

e.en: Bakers {extrude} dough through molds to shape pasta.
e.zh: 面包师把面团挤压通过模具来塑形意面。

extruded.t:
adj. 挤压成型的
v. extrude 过去式

e.en: The factory {extruded} thousands of aluminum rods this morning.
e.zh: 工厂今天上午挤出了数千根铝棒。

e.en: This 3D printer {extruded} the model layer by layer.
e.zh: 这台3D打印机一层层挤出了这个模型。

e.en: The {extruder} clogged and halted the entire production line.
e.zh: 挤出机堵塞了，导致整条生产线停工。

e.en: A high-quality {extruder} is essential for reliable 3D printing.
e.zh: 一台高品质的挤出机对可靠的3D打印至关重要。

e.en: Aluminum {extrusion} is widely used to make window frames.
e.zh: 铝挤压成型被广泛用于制造窗框。

e.en: The factory specializes in plastic {extrusion} for car parts.
e.zh: 该工厂专门从事汽车零部件的塑料挤出加工。

exuberance.t: n. 生气勃勃；热情洋溢

e.en: Her youthful {exuberance} lit up the entire room.
e.zh: 她青春洋溢的活力点亮了整个房间。

e.en: The crowd cheered with {exuberance} after the winning goal.
e.zh: 在制胜进球后，人群欢呼雀跃。

e.en: The poem captured the small {exuberances} of childhood summers.
e.zh: 这首诗捕捉了童年夏天里那些小小的欢欣。

e.en: Markets ride the {exuberances} and panics of investors.
e.zh: 市场随着投资者的狂热与恐慌而起伏。

exuberant.t: adj. 兴高采烈的；茂盛的

e.en: The children gave an {exuberant} welcome to their grandfather.
e.zh: 孩子们热情洋溢地欢迎他们的爷爷。

e.en: She wrote an {exuberant} review praising every dish on the menu.
e.zh: 她写了一篇热情洋溢的评论，称赞菜单上的每一道菜。

exuberantly.t: adv. 兴高采烈地；热情洋溢地

e.en: The puppy greeted her {exuberantly} at the door.
e.zh: 小狗在门口兴奋地迎接她。

e.en: He spoke {exuberantly} about his upcoming trip to Japan.
e.zh: 他兴高采烈地谈论着即将到来的日本之行。

e.en: The doctor examined the wound's {exudate} for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查伤口渗出液以查找感染迹象。

e.en: Tree {exudate} hardens into amber over millions of years.
e.zh: 树木的渗出液经过数百万年硬化成琥珀。

exude.t: v. 散发（气味、气质）；渗出

e.en: Confident leaders {exude} calm even in difficult situations.
e.zh: 自信的领导者即使在困境中也散发着沉着的气质。

e.en: Roses {exude} a sweet fragrance throughout the garden.
e.zh: 玫瑰在整个花园里散发出甜美的芳香。

exuded.t: v. 散发出；渗出（exude 的过去式）

e.en: She {exuded} confidence as she walked into the interview.
e.zh: 她走进面试间时浑身散发着自信。

e.en: The freshly baked bread {exuded} a warm, comforting aroma.
e.zh: 刚出炉的面包散发出温暖宜人的香气。

exudes.t: v. 散发；渗出（exude 的三单）

e.en: The new café {exudes} a cozy, welcoming atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家新咖啡馆散发着温馨宜人的氛围。

e.en: He {exudes} authority whenever he addresses the team.
e.zh: 每当他向团队讲话时都散发着权威感。

exuding.t: v. 散发着；渗出（exude 的现在分词）

e.en: She walked in {exuding} charm and easy confidence.
e.zh: 她走进来时散发着魅力和从容的自信。

e.en: The pine forest was {exuding} a fresh, resinous scent.
e.zh: 松林散发着清新的松脂香气。

e.en: Fans began to {exult} as their team scored the winner.
e.zh: 球迷们在自家球队攻入制胜球时欢呼雀跃。

e.en: It's unkind to {exult} over a rival's failure.
e.zh: 为对手的失败而幸灾乐祸是不厚道的。

exultant.t: adj. 欢欣鼓舞的；得意的

e.en: The {exultant} crowd carried the captain on their shoulders.
e.zh: 狂喜的人群把队长扛在肩上。

e.en: She gave an {exultant} smile after passing the bar exam.
e.zh: 通过律师资格考试后，她露出了狂喜的笑容。

exultantly.t: adv. 欢欣地；得意洋洋地

e.en: He raised his arms {exultantly} as he crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 他冲过终点线时狂喜地高举双臂。

e.en: The team cheered {exultantly} after winning the championship.
e.zh: 球队赢得冠军后狂喜地欢呼。

e.en: Her face glowed with {exultation} when she got the job offer.
e.zh: 她收到工作录用通知时脸上洋溢着狂喜。

e.en: There was widespread {exultation} when the war finally ended.
e.zh: 战争终于结束时，举国上下一片欢腾。

e.en: They moved to a quiet {exurb} for more space and cleaner air.
e.zh: 他们搬到一个安静的远郊区以求更大的空间和更清新的空气。

e.en: Housing prices in the {exurb} have risen since remote work began.
e.zh: 自从远程办公兴起以来，远郊区的房价一直在上涨。

exxon.t: n. 埃克森（美国石油公司）

e.en: {Exxon} reported record profits despite falling oil demand.
e.zh: 尽管石油需求下降，埃克森仍公布了创纪录的利润。

e.en: Shareholders voted on a new climate policy at the {Exxon} meeting.
e.zh: 埃克森公司股东大会上对一项新的气候政策进行了投票。

eye.t:
n. 眼睛
v. 注视；打量

e.en: She has a sharp {eye} for design details.
e.zh: 她对设计细节有敏锐的眼光。

e.en: He rubbed his tired {eye} after staring at the screen.
e.zh: 盯着屏幕太久后,他揉了揉疲惫的眼睛。

eye-catching.t: adj. 吸睛的；引人注目的

e.en: The poster has a really {eye-catching} color scheme.
e.zh: 这张海报的配色非常吸睛。

e.en: She wore an {eye-catching} red dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条引人注目的红裙子去派对。

eyeball.t:
n. 眼球
v. 打量；盯看

e.en: Apps compete fiercely for {eyeball} time on your phone.
e.zh: 各家应用都在拼命抢占你手机上的眼球时间。

e.en: The doctor examined his {eyeball} under bright light.
e.zh: 医生在强光下检查了他的眼球。

e.en: She raised an {eyebrow} when she heard the price.
e.zh: 听到价格时,她挑了挑眉。

e.en: He plucked a stray hair from his {eyebrow}.
e.zh: 他从眉毛里拔掉了一根杂毛。

e.en: Her bold political views raised a few {eyebrows}.
e.zh: 她大胆的政治观点让一些人侧目。

e.en: She filled in her {eyebrows} before heading out.
e.zh: 她出门前画了一下眉毛。

eyed.t: v. 注视；打量（eye 的过去式）

e.en: The cat {eyed} the goldfish hungrily through the glass.
e.zh: 那只猫隔着玻璃饥饿地盯着金鱼。

e.en: Investors have long {eyed} the startup as a takeover target.
e.zh: 投资者长期把这家初创公司视为收购目标。

e.en: A single {eyedrop} can soothe irritation in seconds.
e.zh: 一滴眼药水就能在几秒内缓解眼睛不适。

e.en: He carries a small {eyedrop} bottle in his bag.
e.zh: 他包里放着一小瓶眼药水。

e.en: Use the {eyedropper} tool to pick a color from the image.
e.zh: 用吸管工具从图片中拾取颜色。

e.en: She measured the medicine with a tiny {eyedropper}.
e.zh: 她用小滴管量取药水。

eyeful.t: n. 满眼所见；养眼的人或物

e.en: The mountain view at sunrise was quite an {eyeful}.
e.zh: 日出时的山景着实让人大饱眼福。

e.en: She got an {eyeful} of dust when the wind picked up.
e.zh: 风一刮,她眼里灌满了灰尘。

e.en: He polished the {eyeglass} lens with a soft cloth.
e.zh: 他用软布擦拭眼镜片。

e.en: The shop sells designer {eyeglass} frames at a discount.
e.zh: 这家店打折出售名牌眼镜框。

e.en: She peeked through the {eyehole} before opening the door.
e.zh: 她先从猫眼往外看,然后才开门。

e.en: The mask had a small {eyehole} on each side.
e.zh: 那个面具两边各有一个小眼孔。

e.en: A loose {eyelash} kept making her blink uncontrollably.
e.zh: 一根掉落的睫毛让她不停地眨眼。

e.en: She applied glue along the {eyelash} extension carefully.
e.zh: 她小心地沿着假睫毛涂胶水。

e.en: Her long {eyelashes} fluttered as she laughed.
e.zh: 她笑起来时长长的睫毛微微颤动。

e.en: He curled his {eyelashes} for the photo shoot.
e.zh: 他为拍摄夹了睫毛。

e.en: Deep cave fish are often pale and {eyeless}.
e.zh: 深穴鱼往往体色苍白且没有眼睛。

e.en: The statue's {eyeless} face looked eerily peaceful.
e.zh: 那尊雕像没有眼睛的脸看上去诡异地平静。

eyelet.t: n. 小孔；(衣物上的) 扣眼

e.en: Thread the lace through each {eyelet} on the boot.
e.zh: 把鞋带从靴子的每个金属孔里穿过去。

e.en: Her blouse had delicate {eyelet} embroidery on the collar.
e.zh: 她的衬衫领口有精致的镂空绣花。

e.en: A mosquito landed on his {eyelid} while he slept.
e.zh: 他睡觉时一只蚊子落在了他的眼皮上。

e.en: She dabbed primer on each {eyelid} before applying shadow.
e.zh: 她在涂眼影前先在每只眼皮上打了一层底。

e.en: His heavy {eyelids} kept drooping during the late meeting.
e.zh: 深夜开会时,他沉重的眼皮一直耷拉下来。

e.en: She closed her {eyelids} and took a deep breath.
e.zh: 她闭上眼皮,深吸了一口气。

e.en: She drew a thin wing of {eyeliner} along her lash line.
e.zh: 她沿着睫毛根画了细细的眼线翘尾。

e.en: Waterproof {eyeliner} survives even an emotional movie.
e.zh: 防水眼线液连看催泪电影都不会花。

e.en: The pirate costume came with a black {eyepatch}.
e.zh: 那套海盗服配了一只黑色眼罩。

e.en: After surgery, he wore an {eyepatch} for two weeks.
e.zh: 手术后,他戴了两周的眼罩。

e.en: Adjust the {eyepiece} until the image looks sharp.
e.zh: 调整目镜,直到图像变清晰。

e.en: The microscope's {eyepiece} magnifies the sample tenfold.
e.zh: 显微镜的目镜把样本放大十倍。

eyes.t:
n. 眼睛（复数）
v. 注视（三单）

e.en: Her {eyes} lit up when she opened the gift.
e.zh: 她打开礼物时眼睛一下子亮了起来。

e.en: Keep your {eyes} on the road while driving.
e.zh: 开车时眼睛要盯着路面。

eyeshade.t: n. 遮光帽檐；遮阳眼罩

e.en: He wore a green {eyeshade} while editing late at night.
e.zh: 他深夜编稿时戴着一顶绿色遮光帽檐。

e.en: The sleep {eyeshade} blocked out the morning sun completely.
e.zh: 那个睡眠眼罩把清晨的阳光完全挡住了。

e.en: She blended a smoky {eyeshadow} for the evening event.
e.zh: 她为晚上的活动晕染了一款烟熏眼影。

e.en: The palette has twelve shades of shimmery {eyeshadow}.
e.zh: 这盘里有十二种珠光眼影色。

e.en: Stay within {eyeshot} of the lifeguard at the beach.
e.zh: 在沙滩上要待在救生员视线范围内。

e.en: The deer disappeared beyond {eyeshot} into the trees.
e.zh: 那只鹿消失在树林里,看不见了。

e.en: Reading in dim light can strain your {eyesight}.
e.zh: 在昏暗的光线下看书会损伤视力。

e.en: His {eyesight} has improved since the laser surgery.
e.zh: 激光手术后他的视力有所改善。

e.en: The clinic tracks patients' {eyesights} across yearly checkups.
e.zh: 诊所每年体检时都会记录病人的视力情况。

e.en: Different {eyesights} require different prescription lenses.
e.zh: 不同的视力需要不同度数的镜片。

eyesore.t: n. 碍眼的东西；难看的景物

e.en: That abandoned warehouse is a real {eyesore} downtown.
e.zh: 市中心那座废弃仓库真是煞风景。

e.en: Tangled cables behind the desk are an {eyesore}.
e.zh: 桌后那堆缠在一起的电线看着很碍眼。

e.en: The crab swiveled each {eyestalk} to scan the seafloor.
e.zh: 螃蟹转动着每只眼柄扫视海底。

e.en: A snail's {eyestalk} retracts when gently touched.
e.zh: 轻轻一碰,蜗牛的眼柄就会缩回去。

e.en: Long hours on the laptop give me serious {eyestrain}.
e.zh: 长时间用笔记本电脑会让我眼睛非常疲劳。

e.en: Blue-light glasses claim to reduce {eyestrain}.
e.zh: 防蓝光眼镜号称可以缓解视疲劳。

eyewall.t: n. 风眼壁（台风中心结构）

e.en: The hurricane's {eyewall} packed winds over 150 miles per hour.
e.zh: 飓风的眼壁带着超过每小时150英里的狂风。

e.en: Forecasters watched the {eyewall} tighten before landfall.
e.zh: 预报员看着登陆前飓风眼壁不断收紧。

eyewash.t: n. 洗眼液；糊弄人的话

e.en: Keep an {eyewash} bottle near every chemistry workstation.
e.zh: 每个化学操作台旁都要放一瓶洗眼液。

e.en: His apology was pure {eyewash}, not a real change.
e.zh: 他的道歉纯粹是装样子,根本没真改。

e.en: The brand sells affordable prescription {eyewear} online.
e.zh: 这个品牌在网上卖平价的处方眼镜。

e.en: Always wear protective {eyewear} when using a power saw.
e.zh: 使用电锯时一定要佩戴护目镜。

e.en: An {eyewitness} described the suspect to the police.
e.zh: 一名目击者向警方描述了嫌疑人。

e.en: The journalist gave an {eyewitness} account of the protest.
e.zh: 那位记者对抗议活动做了亲历式报道。

eyre.t: n. 巡回法庭；巡回审判

e.en: Medieval judges traveled on {eyre} to hear regional cases.
e.zh: 中世纪的法官会到各地巡回审理案件。

e.en: The court of {eyre} once handled royal pleas across England.
e.zh: 巡回法庭曾在英格兰各地审理王室诉讼。

e.en: Records of medieval {eyres} survive in many county archives.
e.zh: 许多郡级档案馆里仍保存着中世纪巡回法庭的记录。

e.en: The {eyres} brought royal justice to remote villages.
e.zh: 巡回法庭把王室的司法带到了偏远村庄。

e.en: The eagle returned to its {eyrie} high on the cliff.
e.zh: 那只鹰回到了悬崖高处的巢穴。

e.en: From his hilltop {eyrie}, he could see the whole valley.
e.zh: 从山顶的高处住所,他可以看到整个山谷。

easiest.t: a. 容易的, 缓缓的, 舒适的, 从容的, 宽容的, 流畅的, 随便的, 自在的, 疲软的\nadv. 容易地, 慢慢地

eddied.t: n. 逆流, 漩涡\nv. (使)起漩涡

edgier.t: a. 刀口锐利的, 尖利的, 急躁的
