elves.t: n. 小精灵, 矮人, 淘气鬼\n[电] 超低频的简写

emporia.t: n. 商场, 大百货商店

emptier.t:
a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
[计] 空

emptiest.t:
a. 空的, 空虚的, 空腹的, 空洞的
n. 空的东西, 空车
vt. 倒空, 使变空, 使排出
vi. 流空
[计] 空

englishwomen.t: n. 英国女人, 英格兰妇女

epoxied.t: a. 环氧的\n[化] 环氧; 表氧; 桥氧

espied.t: vt. 看出, 望见, 发现

exemplified.t: vt. 例证, 例示\n[法] 制作经公章证明的誊本, 例证

e.en: She would not speak, {e'en} to defend herself.
e.zh: 她甚至不肯开口为自己辩护。

e.en: The old song says love lasts {e'en} in sorrow.
e.zh: 那首老歌说，即便悲伤中爱也会延续。

e.en: Was there {e'er} a kinder friend?
e.zh: 世上可曾有过更善良的朋友吗？

e.en: I shall remember you {e'er} with gratitude.
e.zh: 我将永远怀着感激记住你。

e.en: The technician replaced the damaged {e-bend} in the waveguide.
e.zh: 技术员更换了波导中损坏的E形弯管。

e.en: An {e-bend} can redirect the beam inside the device.
e.zh: 电子束弯转装置可以改变设备内光束的方向。

e.en: I downloaded an {e-book} for the flight.
e.zh: 我为这趟航班下载了一本电子书。

e.en: Her new novel is available as an {e-book}.
e.zh: 她的新小说已有电子书版本。

e.en: Many libraries now lend {e-books} online.
e.zh: 许多图书馆现在在线出借电子书。

e.en: He reads {e-books} on his tablet every night.
e.zh: 他每天晚上都在平板电脑上读电子书。

e-business.t: 电子商务企业；电子业务

e.en: The company moved into {e-business} after years in retail.
e.zh: 那家公司做了多年零售后转向电子商务。

e.en: Good security is essential for any {e-business}.
e.zh: 良好的安全措施对任何电子商务企业都很重要。

e.en: Small {e-businesses} often rely on social media.
e.zh: 小型电子商务企业常常依靠社交媒体。

e.en: The new law affects many online {e-businesses}.
e.zh: 这项新法律影响许多线上电子商务企业。

e.en: She sent an {e-card} for his birthday.
e.zh: 她给他发了一张生日电子贺卡。

e.en: The transit app stores your {e-card} on the phone.
e.zh: 交通应用把你的电子卡存放在手机里。

e.en: We exchanged {e-cards} during the holidays.
e.zh: 假期里我们互相发送了电子贺卡。

e.en: Students use {e-cards} to enter the library.
e.zh: 学生用电子卡进入图书馆。

e.en: The wallet app lets users store {e-cash}.
e.zh: 这个钱包应用允许用户储存电子现金。

e.en: Some shops accept {e-cash} instead of coins.
e.zh: 有些商店接受电子现金而不是硬币。

e.en: The pandemic accelerated the growth of {e-commerce}.
e.zh: 疫情加速了电子商务的发展。

e.en: She studies {e-commerce} strategy at university.
e.zh: 她在大学学习电子商务策略。

e.en: The transformer uses an {e-core} to guide magnetic flux.
e.zh: 这个变压器使用E形铁芯来引导磁通。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the processor's {e-core} for efficiency.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了处理器的电子核心以提高效率。

e.en: The train schedule appeared on the {e-display}.
e.zh: 列车时刻表显示在电子显示屏上。

e.en: A bright {e-display} can drain the battery quickly.
e.zh: 明亮的电子显示屏会很快耗尽电池。

e.en: Please complete the {e-form} before your appointment.
e.zh: 请在预约前填好电子表单。

e.en: The tax office replaced paper applications with an {e-form}.
e.zh: 税务局用电子表格取代了纸质申请。

e.en: The city expanded {e-government} services this year.
e.zh: 该市今年扩大了电子政务服务。

e.en: Reliable identity checks are vital for {e-government}.
e.zh: 可靠的身份核验对电子政务至关重要。

e.en: The diagram labels the outer {e-layer} clearly.
e.zh: 图表清楚标出了外部电子层。

e.en: Radio signals reflected from the ionospheric {e-layer}.
e.zh: 无线电信号从电离层的E层反射回来。

e.en: Many schools now offer {e-learning} courses for adults.
e.zh: 许多学校现在为成年人提供在线学习课程。

e.en: The company uses {e-learning} to train new staff remotely.
e.zh: 公司用电子学习方式远程培训新员工。

e.en: She sends a weekly {e-newsletter} to her customers.
e.zh: 她每周给客户发送一份电子通讯。

e.en: The charity's {e-newsletter} announced three new projects.
e.zh: 该慈善机构的邮件简报公布了三个新项目。

e.en: The {e-number} appears often in calculus and probability.
e.zh: 数学常数e的数值常出现在微积分和概率中。

e.en: Students used the {e-number} to model continuous growth.
e.zh: 学生们用e这个数值来模拟连续增长。

e.en: My daughter has an {e-pal} in Canada.
e.zh: 我女儿在加拿大有一个网上笔友。

e.en: The class found {e-pals} to practice English with.
e.zh: 全班找了电子笔友来练习英语。

e.en: Some writers use {e-prime} to make claims sound less absolute.
e.zh: 有些作者使用不用be动词的英语写法，让说法显得不那么绝对。

e.en: The essay was rewritten in {e-prime} for a style exercise.
e.zh: 这篇文章为一次文体练习被改写成不用be动词的英语。

e-region.t: 电子业务区域；网络区域

e.en: The report defines each {e-region} by online sales activity.
e.zh: 报告按线上销售活动来界定每个电子业务区域。

e.en: Users in this {e-region} receive local payment options.
e.zh: 这个网络区域的用户会看到本地付款选项。

e-scope.t: 电子内窥镜；电子显微镜

e.en: The doctor examined the airway with an {e-scope}.
e.zh: 医生用电子内窥镜检查了气道。

e.en: The lab bought an {e-scope} for detailed surface images.
e.zh: 实验室购买了一台电子显微镜来获取精细的表面图像。

e-tailer.t: 网络零售商；电商零售商

e.en: The small {e-tailer} sells handmade bags online.
e.zh: 这家小型网络零售商在网上销售手工包。

e.en: A large {e-tailer} can ship products within one day.
e.zh: 大型电商零售商可以在一天内发货。

e.en: The pandemic accelerated {e-tailing} in many countries.
e.zh: 疫情加速了许多国家的网络零售发展。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on fashion {e-tailing}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于时装网上销售的论文。

e.en: The physicist calculated the {e-vector} of the wave.
e.zh: 物理学家计算了该波的电场矢量。

e.en: This diagram shows the {e-vector} changing direction over time.
e.zh: 这张图显示电子矢量随时间改变方向。

e.en: The city tested {e-voting} in a local election.
e.zh: 该市在一次地方选举中测试了电子投票。

e.en: Security is the main concern with {e-voting}.
e.zh: 网络投票最主要的顾虑是安全性。

e.en: The sensor detected an unusual {e-wave} pattern.
e.zh: 传感器检测到一种异常的电波模式。

e.en: Researchers modeled the {e-wave} inside the material.
e.zh: 研究人员模拟了材料内部的电子波。

e.en: He published poems in a small {e-zine}.
e.zh: 他在一本小型电子杂志上发表诗歌。

e.en: The music {e-zine} reviews new indie albums.
e.zh: 这本音乐网络杂志评论新的独立音乐专辑。

e.en: Independent {e-zines} helped new writers find readers.
e.zh: 独立电子杂志帮助新作者找到读者。

e.en: She subscribed to several fashion {e-zines}.
e.zh: 她订阅了几本时尚网络杂志。

e.en: They helped {eachother} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后他们彼此帮助。

e.en: The two teams respect {eachother} despite the rivalry.
e.zh: 尽管互为竞争对手，两支队伍仍互相尊重。

e.en: Flowers seemed to bloom {eachwhere} in the valley.
e.zh: 山谷里似乎各处都有花开放。

e.en: The old poem says joy lives {eachwhere}.
e.zh: 那首古诗说欢乐存在于每个地方。

e.en: The company's {eadquarters} are in London.
e.zh: 公司的总部在伦敦。

e.en: Reporters waited outside police {eadquarters} all morning.
e.zh: 记者们整个上午都在警察总部外等候。

eager-beaver.t: 特别积极的人；热心过头者

e.en: The new intern is an {eager-beaver} who arrives early every day.
e.zh: 那名新实习生特别积极，每天都早早到岗。

e.en: Don't be such an {eager-beaver}; wait for the instructions first.
e.zh: 别这么热心过头，先等指示再说。

e.en: The children waited {eagerl} for the show to begin.
e.zh: 孩子们急切地等着演出开始。

e.en: She listened {eagerl} as the results were announced.
e.zh: 公布结果时，她热切地听着。

eagle-eyed.t: 目光敏锐的；观察细致的

e.en: An {eagle-eyed} editor spotted the spelling mistake.
e.zh: 一位目光敏锐的编辑发现了那个拼写错误。

e.en: The {eagle-eyed} guard noticed the hidden camera.
e.zh: 那名观察细致的警卫注意到了隐藏的摄像头。

e.en: The museum displayed an {eaglestone} in its mineral case.
e.zh: 博物馆在矿物展柜中陈列了一块鹰石。

e.en: Medieval women sometimes carried an {eaglestone} as a charm.
e.zh: 中世纪女性有时会携带鹰石作为护身物。

e.en: The incense was made from rare {eaglewood}.
e.zh: 这种香是用稀有沉香木制成的。

e.en: Traders once carried {eaglewood} across the sea.
e.zh: 商人过去曾把鹰木香材运过海。

e.en: Tourists gathered to watch the river {eagre}.
e.zh: 游客聚集起来观看河上的涌潮。

e.en: The sudden {eagre} rushed upstream with surprising force.
e.zh: 突来的潮水逆涌以惊人的力量向上游冲去。

e.en: The {ealderman} spoke at the town meeting.
e.zh: 那位市议员在镇民大会上发言。

e.en: In old records, an {ealderman} managed local affairs.
e.zh: 在旧档案中，地方长老负责管理当地事务。

e.en: The {ealdorman} governed the shire for the king.
e.zh: 这位郡长代表国王治理该郡。

e.en: A powerful {ealdorman} could influence royal decisions.
e.zh: 有权势的郡长能影响王室决策。

e.en: The old poem calls the child {eamless} and alone.
e.zh: 这首古诗称那孩子无亲无靠、孤身一人。

e.en: She felt {eamless} after leaving her family home.
e.zh: 离开家后，她觉得自己像没有亲眷可依。

e.en: The shepherd carried a weak {eanling} across the field.
e.zh: 牧羊人抱着一只虚弱的小羊穿过田地。

e.en: In spring, each {eanling} stayed close to its mother.
e.zh: 春天里，每只幼崽都紧跟着母亲。

e.en: The child had a bad {ear-ache} all night.
e.zh: 那个孩子整晚耳朵疼得厉害。

e.en: Cold wind can sometimes cause {ear-ache}.
e.zh: 冷风有时会引起耳痛。

e.en: My manager will {ear-bash} me about the missed deadline.
e.zh: 经理会因为错过期限而对我唠叨训斥。

e.en: He likes to {ear-bash} strangers about politics.
e.zh: 他喜欢对陌生人没完没了地谈政治。

e.en: Pull down the {ear-flap} when the wind gets cold.
e.zh: 风变冷时，把帽子的护耳片拉下来。

e.en: The helmet has a soft {ear-flap} on each side.
e.zh: 这顶头盔两侧各有一片柔软的护耳。

e.en: An {ear-minded} musician learns melodies quickly.
e.zh: 重听觉的音乐人学旋律很快。

e.en: The teacher used songs for her {ear-minded} students.
e.zh: 老师为偏重听觉学习的学生使用歌曲。

e.en: The agent adjusted his {ear-piece} before speaking.
e.zh: 特工说话前调整了一下耳机听筒。

e.en: One {ear-piece} of my glasses broke yesterday.
e.zh: 我的眼镜有一只镜腿昨天断了。

e.en: An {ear-piercing} alarm woke the whole building.
e.zh: 刺耳的警报声把整栋楼都吵醒了。

e.en: She booked an {ear-piercing} appointment for Saturday.
e.zh: 她预约了周六去穿耳洞。

e.en: She lost one silver {ear-ring} at the party.
e.zh: 她在聚会上丢了一只银耳环。

e.en: The dancer wore a bright gold {ear-ring}.
e.zh: 舞者戴着一只亮闪闪的金耳环。

e.en: The beachcomber found an {ear-shell} near the rocks.
e.zh: 海滩拾贝的人在岩石旁发现了一枚耳形贝壳。

e.en: An {ear-shell} has a flat, curved shape.
e.zh: 耳贝有扁平弯曲的形状。

e.en: The crowd gave an {ear-splitting} cheer.
e.zh: 人群爆发出震耳欲聋的欢呼声。

e.en: An {ear-splitting} crash came from the kitchen.
e.zh: 厨房里传来一声震耳欲聋的撞击声。

e.en: She was smiling {ear-to-ear} after the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息后，她笑得合不拢嘴。

e.en: The winner crossed the line grinning {ear-to-ear}.
e.zh: 获胜者冲过终点线时咧嘴大笑。

e.en: I got an {earbashing} for arriving late.
e.zh: 我因为迟到挨了一顿长篇训斥。

e.en: His speech became an {earbashing} about office manners.
e.zh: 他的讲话变成了关于办公室礼仪的唠叨。

e.en: At parties, Colin can be a real {earbender}.
e.zh: 在聚会上，科林真是个爱唠叨的人。

e.en: She gave me an {earbender} about the new policy.
e.zh: 她就新政策跟我讲了一大通。

e.en: Her pearl {earbob} caught the candlelight.
e.zh: 她的珍珠耳坠映着烛光。

e.en: The antique box held a single silver {earbob}.
e.zh: 古董盒里装着一只银色小耳环。

e.en: One {earbud} fell out during my run.
e.zh: 我跑步时掉了一只入耳式耳机。

e.en: This {earbud} blocks a lot of street noise.
e.zh: 这只耳机能隔绝不少街上的噪音。

e.en: The pilot wore an {earcap} under his helmet.
e.zh: 飞行员在头盔下面戴着护耳帽。

e.en: A warm {earcap} covered the baby's ears.
e.zh: 一顶暖和的护耳帽盖住了婴儿的耳朵。

e.en: Use one {eardrop} in the infected ear.
e.zh: 在感染的那只耳朵里滴一滴滴耳液。

e.en: Her sapphire {eardrop} matched the blue dress.
e.zh: 她的蓝宝石耳坠和蓝裙子很相配。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {eardrops} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生为这次感染开了滴耳液。

e.en: She wore long crystal {eardrops} at dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐时戴着长长的水晶耳坠。

e.en: The headset has a flexible {earhook}.
e.zh: 这副耳机有一个可弯曲的耳挂。

e.en: Fasten the hearing aid with the {earhook}.
e.zh: 用耳钩固定助听器。

e.en: The cold made his {earlap} turn red.
e.zh: 寒冷让他的耳垂变红了。

e.en: She tied the hat's {earlap} under her chin.
e.zh: 她把帽子的护耳片系在下巴下面。

e.en: The toy rabbit had a torn {earlet}.
e.zh: 玩具兔子有一只小耳朵破了。

e.en: Each seed has a tiny {earlet} on one side.
e.zh: 每粒种子一侧都有一个小耳状突起。

e.en: The editor asked us to {earlierise} the deadline.
e.zh: 编辑要求我们把截止日期提前。

e.en: Schools may {earlierise} breakfast during exam week.
e.zh: 考试周期间，学校可能会提前供应早餐。

e.en: The editor tried to {earlierize} the publication date.
e.zh: 编辑试图把出版日期提前。

e.en: They {earlierized} the meeting to avoid the storm.
e.zh: 他们把会议时间调早，以避开暴风雨。

e.en: The {earliness} of his arrival surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他到得这么早让大家都很意外。

e.en: Farmers judged the crop by its {earliness}.
e.zh: 农民按作物成熟得早不早来判断收成。

e.en: He inherited the {earlship} after his uncle died.
e.zh: 叔叔去世后，他继承了伯爵爵位。

e.en: The old {earlship} carried little political power.
e.zh: 这个古老的伯爵身份几乎没有政治权力。

e.en: The island installed an {early-warning} system for tsunamis.
e.zh: 这座岛安装了海啸预警系统。

e.en: Fever can be an {early-warning} sign of infection.
e.zh: 发烧可能是感染的早期警示信号。

e.en: Let's meet {earlyish}, maybe around eight.
e.zh: 我们早点见吧，大概八点左右。

e.en: The train arrived {earlyish} despite the bad weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气不好，火车还是来得偏早。

e.en: The pale bands are {earlywood} formed in spring.
e.zh: 这些浅色条带是春季形成的早材。

e.en: Scientists measured the {earlywood} in each tree ring.
e.zh: 科学家测量了每个年轮中的早材。

e.en: She wore one red {earmuff} after losing the other.
e.zh: 她弄丢了另一只，只戴着一只红色耳罩。

e.en: The worker replaced a cracked {earmuff} on his headset.
e.zh: 工人更换了耳机上一只裂开的护耳罩。

e.en: Put on your {earmuffs} before going outside.
e.zh: 出门前把耳罩戴上。

e.en: The airport crew used {earmuffs} near the engines.
e.zh: 机场工作人员在发动机旁使用防噪护耳。

earn-out.t: 业绩对赌付款；赚取式收购款

e.en: The founders accepted an {earn-out} tied to future sales.
e.zh: 创始人接受了一笔与未来销售挂钩的业绩对赌付款。

e.en: Lawyers argued over the {earn-out} formula after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后，律师们就赚取式收购款的计算公式争论不休。

earnings-related.t: 与收入有关的；与盈利有关的

e.en: The company delayed its {earnings-related} announcement.
e.zh: 公司推迟了与盈利有关的公告。

e.en: Workers received {earnings-related} benefits after the policy changed.
e.zh: 政策改变后，员工获得了与收入挂钩的福利。

e.en: He cleaned the tiny {earpick} after using it.
e.zh: 他用完那把小掏耳勺后把它清洗干净。

e.en: The antique set included a silver {earpick}.
e.zh: 这套古董用具里有一把银制挖耳工具。

e.en: Keep your voice low within the child's {earreach}.
e.zh: 孩子听得到时，说话声音要放低。

e.en: The guards stayed just beyond {earreach} of the prisoners.
e.zh: 守卫站在囚犯刚好听不见的地方。

e.en: The new {earset} fit comfortably during long calls.
e.zh: 这副新耳机在长时间通话时戴着很舒服。

e.en: Judges noted the dog's high {earset}.
e.zh: 评委注意到这只狗的耳位较高。

e.en: Sheep grazed quietly on the {earsh} after harvest.
e.zh: 收割后，羊群在茬地上安静地吃草。

e.en: The farmer burned the dry {earsh} before ploughing.
e.zh: 农夫在耕地前烧掉了干燥的田茬。

e.en: The fish's {earstone} revealed its age.
e.zh: 鱼的耳石显示了它的年龄。

e.en: A loose {earstone} can disturb a person's balance.
e.zh: 松动的耳石可能影响人的平衡。

e.en: Pull the {eartab} to remove the seal.
e.zh: 拉一下这个耳形小片就能撕开封口。

e.en: Each calf wore an {eartab} with a number.
e.zh: 每头小牛耳朵上都戴着带编号的耳部标签。

e.en: Villagers left offerings for the {earth-god}.
e.zh: 村民给土地神留下供品。

e.en: The myth describes an {earth-god} who shaped the mountains.
e.zh: 这个神话讲述了一位塑造群山的地神。

e.en: The temple honored an ancient {earth-goddess}.
e.zh: 这座神庙供奉一位古老的大地女神。

e.en: Poets pictured the {earth-goddess} as a mother.
e.zh: 诗人把大地女神描绘成母亲。

e.en: Gardeners {earth-in} young plants before frost arrives.
e.zh: 霜冻来临前，园丁会给幼苗培土。

e.en: You should {earth-in} the roots after transplanting.
e.zh: 移栽后你应该用土把根部盖好。

earth-moving.t: 土方工程的；震撼人心的

e.en: The site needed heavy {earth-moving} equipment.
e.zh: 这个工地需要重型土方工程设备。

e.en: Her speech had an {earth-moving} emotional force.
e.zh: 她的演讲有一种震撼人心的情感力量。

e.en: The discovery was an {earth-shaking} moment in medicine.
e.zh: 这一发现是医学上惊天动地的时刻。

e.en: Don't expect an {earth-shaking} change overnight.
e.zh: 别指望一夜之间出现极重大的变化。

e.en: The report contained no {earth-shattering} news.
e.zh: 这份报告没有什么震撼性的消息。

e.en: For her, leaving home was an {earth-shattering} decision.
e.zh: 对她来说，离开家是一个极其重大的决定。

eatage.t: 供牲畜食用的草料或饲料地

e.en: The farmer saved the lower field for winter {eatage}.
e.zh: 农夫把低洼地留作冬季牲畜吃的草料地。

e.en: Good {eatage} was scarce after the long drought.
e.zh: 久旱之后，好的牲畜草料很稀缺。

e.en: It is no {eath} task to cross those hills.
e.zh: 翻越那些山丘绝不是一件容易的事。

e.en: The old verse says the door opened {eath}.
e.zh: 那首古诗说门轻易地打开了。

e.en: The clinic treats teenagers with {eating-disorders}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗有进食障碍的青少年。

e.en: Public awareness of {eating-disorders} has grown.
e.zh: 公众对饮食失调的认识已经提高。

e.en: They found a cheap {eating-house} near the docks.
e.zh: 他们在码头附近找到一家便宜的小饭馆。

e.en: The old {eating-house} served stew and ale.
e.zh: 那家老餐馆供应炖菜和麦酒。

e.en: The guide lists every {eating-place} in town.
e.zh: 这本指南列出了镇上每个吃饭的地方。

e.en: We need a quiet {eating-place} for the meeting.
e.zh: 我们需要一个安静的餐饮场所来开会。

e.en: The boats rested on mud at {ebb-tide}.
e.zh: 退潮时，小船停在泥滩上。

e.en: At {ebb-tide}, the rocks appear above the water.
e.zh: 落潮时，岩石露出水面。

e.en: She carried an {ebbet} from the well.
e.zh: 她从井边提着一个水桶回来。

e.en: The cracked {ebbet} leaked across the floor.
e.zh: 那个破裂的提桶把水漏了一地。

e.en: Fishermen walked the shore at {ebbtide}.
e.zh: 渔民在退潮时沿着海岸行走。

e.en: The channel is shallow during {ebbtide}.
e.zh: 落潮时这条水道很浅。

e.en: The paper described an {ebdoenzyme} active inside the cell.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种在细胞内起作用的内酶。

e.en: An {ebdoenzyme} may remain bound within the tissue.
e.zh: 内酶可能仍然结合在组织内部。

e.en: The physician noted {eberthemia} after the infection worsened.
e.zh: 感染加重后，医生记录到高热状态。

e.en: Persistent {eberthemia} can signal a serious illness.
e.zh: 持续发热可能预示严重疾病。

ebicon.t: 外形像乌木的化石贝类

e.en: The collector labeled the dark shell an {ebicon}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那枚深色贝壳标为外形像乌木的化石贝类。

e.en: An {ebicon} was found in the limestone layer.
e.zh: 石灰岩层中发现了一枚乌木状化石贝类。

e.en: The study measured {ebiconductivity} in living tissue.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了活体组织中的电生物传导性。

e.en: Changes in {ebiconductivity} affected the sensor readings.
e.zh: 电生物传导性的变化影响了传感器读数。

e.en: Doctors worked quickly to contain {ebola}.
e.zh: 医生们迅速行动以控制埃博拉病毒病。

e.en: The village received vaccines after the {ebola} outbreak.
e.zh: 埃博拉疫情暴发后，村里收到了疫苗。

e.en: The carpenter planned to {ebonise} the chair legs.
e.zh: 木匠打算把椅子腿染成乌木色。

e.en: They {ebonise} pale wood for a formal look.
e.zh: 他们把浅色木料染黑，以显得更庄重。

e.en: The old fountain pen had an {ebonite} feed.
e.zh: 那支老钢笔有一个硬橡胶笔舌。

e.en: Early electrical parts were often made of {ebonite}.
e.zh: 早期电气零件常用硫化硬胶制成。

e.en: She used stain to {ebonize} the frame.
e.zh: 她用染色剂把画框染成乌木色。

e.en: Cabinetmakers sometimes {ebonize} maple for contrast.
e.zh: 家具木工有时会把枫木染黑以形成对比。

e.en: The finish {ebonizes} the wood without hiding the grain.
e.zh: 这种涂饰能把木头染成乌木色，又不遮住纹理。

e.en: He {ebonizes} small boxes for antique restorers.
e.zh: 他为古董修复师把小盒子染黑。

e.en: {Ebonizing} the table gave it a sharper profile.
e.zh: 把桌子染成乌木色后，它的轮廓更利落。

e.en: The workshop teaches traditional {ebonizing} techniques.
e.zh: 这个工坊教授传统的染黑处理技法。

e.en: I downloaded an {ebook} for the flight.
e.zh: 我为这趟航班下载了一本电子书。

e.en: Her new {ebook} includes audio examples.
e.zh: 她的新电子书包含音频示例。

e.en: The botanist described the flower as {ebracteate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花描述为无苞片的。

e.en: An {ebracteate} inflorescence lacks small leaflike bracts.
e.zh: 无苞片花序缺少小叶状的苞片。

e.en: The specimen was marked {ebracteolate} in the flora.
e.zh: 这份标本在植物志中被标为无小苞片。

e.en: An {ebracteolate} flower has no secondary bractlets.
e.zh: 无小苞片的花没有次级小苞片。

e.en: The memoir describes his youthful {ebrieties} with regret.
e.zh: 回忆录带着悔意描述了他年轻时的种种醉态。

e.en: Such public {ebrieties} embarrassed his family.
e.zh: 这种当众酩酊的行为让他的家人难堪。

e.en: The old doctor noted his {ebriety} with concern.
e.zh: 老医生担心地注意到他的醉酒状态。

e.en: Public {ebriety} was treated harshly in that town.
e.zh: 在那个镇上，公共场合醉酒会受到严厉处罚。

e.en: The chemist calibrated the {ebuillometer} before the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家在实验前校准了沸点测定仪。

e.en: An old {ebuillometer} stood beside the glass condenser.
e.zh: 一台旧沸点测定仪放在玻璃冷凝器旁。

e.en: The laboratory {ebullator} kept the solution boiling evenly.
e.zh: 实验室煮沸器让溶液保持均匀沸腾。

e.en: A small {ebullator} released bubbles through the liquid.
e.zh: 一个小型起泡装置把气泡释放到液体中。

e.en: Her youthful {ebulliency} filled the room.
e.zh: 她年轻的热情活力感染了整个房间。

e.en: The speech had an unusual {ebulliency} for a budget debate.
e.zh: 这场预算辩论中的演讲罕见地洋溢着兴奋劲。

e.en: The students used an {ebulliometer} to measure the solvent.
e.zh: 学生们用沸点计测量这种溶剂。

e.en: A damaged {ebulliometer} can give misleading boiling points.
e.zh: 损坏的沸点测定仪可能给出误导性的沸点。

e.en: The paper explained {ebulliometry} in simple terms.
e.zh: 这篇论文用简单语言解释了沸点测定法。

e.en: They used {ebulliometry} to estimate the compound's purity.
e.zh: 他们用沸点测定法估算该化合物的纯度。

e.en: The {ebullioscope} revealed a slight rise in boiling point.
e.zh: 沸点升高测定仪显示沸点略有上升。

e.en: She cleaned the {ebullioscope} after every trial.
e.zh: 她每次试验后都会清洁沸点升高测定仪。

e.en: The lab reported an {ebullioscopic} constant for the solvent.
e.zh: 实验室报告了该溶剂的沸点升高常数。

e.en: His {ebullioscopic} measurements were surprisingly consistent.
e.zh: 他的沸点升高法测量结果出奇地一致。

e.en: They taught {ebullioscopy} in the physical chemistry course.
e.zh: 他们在物理化学课上讲授沸点升高测定法。

e.en: {Ebullioscopy} can help determine molecular mass.
e.zh: 沸点升高测定法可帮助测定分子量。

e.en: Astronauts train to avoid {ebullism} in low pressure.
e.zh: 宇航员接受训练，以避免低压下发生体液沸腾症。

e.en: Severe {ebullism} can occur without a pressure suit.
e.zh: 没有加压服时可能发生严重的体液沸腾症。

e.en: The sudden {ebullition} of the liquid startled him.
e.zh: 液体突然沸腾把他吓了一跳。

e.en: Her {ebullition} of anger surprised the committee.
e.zh: 她怒气的突然爆发让委员会很意外。

e.en: The surgeon found {eburnated} bone in the damaged joint.
e.zh: 外科医生在受损关节中发现了象牙样硬化的骨质。

e.en: An {eburnated} surface appeared where cartilage had worn away.
e.zh: 软骨磨损处出现了象牙样硬化表面。

e.en: X-rays showed {eburnation} in the arthritic knee.
e.zh: X光片显示关节炎膝部有象牙样硬化。

e.en: Advanced {eburnation} often follows long cartilage loss.
e.zh: 长期软骨缺失后常会出现晚期象牙样硬化。

e.en: The statue had an {eburnean} sheen under the lamp.
e.zh: 灯下那座雕像泛着象牙般的光泽。

e.en: She admired the {eburnean} keys of the antique piano.
e.zh: 她欣赏那架古董钢琴乳白如象牙的琴键。

e.en: This plant {ecad} survives best in salty soil.
e.zh: 这种植物生态型最适合在盐碱土中生存。

e.en: The botanist described each {ecad} separately.
e.zh: 植物学家分别描述了每一种生态型。

e.en: The flower is {ecalcarate}, lacking the usual spur.
e.zh: 这种花是无距的，缺少常见的花距。

e.en: An {ecalcarate} petal helped identify the species.
e.zh: 一片无距花瓣帮助识别了这个物种。

e.en: The technician replaced the faulty {ecaporator} in the unit.
e.zh: 技术员更换了设备中有故障的蒸发器。

e.en: A clean {ecaporator} improves the system's cooling efficiency.
e.zh: 干净的蒸发器能提高系统的制冷效率。

e.en: The specimen had an {ecarinate} sternum.
e.zh: 这个标本有无龙骨突的胸骨。

e.en: Biologists noted the {ecarinate} shape of the shell.
e.zh: 生物学家注意到贝壳呈无龙骨突形态。

e.en: They played {ecarte} after dinner in the salon.
e.zh: 晚饭后他们在客厅玩埃卡特纸牌戏。

e.en: The rules of {ecarte} differ from modern bridge.
e.zh: 埃卡特纸牌戏的规则不同于现代桥牌。

e.en: The larva appeared {ecaudate} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这只幼虫看起来是无尾的。

e.en: An {ecaudate} form is common in this group.
e.zh: 无尾形态在这一类群中很常见。

e.en: The clause has an {ecbatic} sense, not a final one.
e.zh: 这个从句表示结果，而不是表示目的。

e.en: She marked the {ecbatic} use in the Greek sentence.
e.zh: 她标出了这个希腊句子中表示结果的用法。

e.en: The physician avoided any {ecbolic} drug during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在孕期避免使用任何促分娩药物。

e.en: Ancient texts mention an {ecbolic} herb with caution.
e.zh: 古代文献谨慎提到一种堕胎草药。

e.en: The inventor demonstrated an {eccaleobion} for hatching eggs.
e.zh: 发明者展示了一台用于孵蛋的人工孵化器。

e.en: An old {eccaleobion} appears in the museum catalogue.
e.zh: 博物馆目录中收录了一台旧式人工孵化器。

e.en: His {eccentrical} habits amused the whole village.
e.zh: 他那些古怪的习惯让全村人都觉得好笑。

e.en: The old diagram showed an {eccentrical} orbit around the star.
e.zh: 那张旧图显示出围绕恒星的偏心轨道。

e.en: The geneticist diagnosed {eccentrochondroplasia} after reviewing the scans.
e.zh: 遗传学医生查看扫描结果后诊断为偏中心软骨发育不良。

e.en: Research on {eccentrochondroplasia} remains limited because cases are rare.
e.zh: 由于病例罕见，关于偏中心软骨发育不良的研究仍然有限。

e.en: The surgeon removed an {ecchondrosis} from the joint surface.
e.zh: 外科医生从关节表面切除了一个软骨赘生物。

e.en: An {ecchondrosis} may cause pain when it presses on nearby tissue.
e.zh: 软骨赘生物压迫邻近组织时可能引起疼痛。

e.en: Her arm was badly {ecchymosed} after the fall.
e.zh: 她摔倒后手臂出现了严重瘀斑。

e.en: The doctor noted an {ecchymosed} patch below the eye.
e.zh: 医生注意到眼睛下方有一块瘀斑。

e.en: Small {ecchymoses} appeared on his legs overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间，他腿上出现了几处小瘀斑。

e.en: The nurse documented the {ecchymoses} before giving treatment.
e.zh: 护士在治疗前记录了这些皮下出血斑。

e.en: A large {ecchymosis} formed around the injured knee.
e.zh: 受伤的膝盖周围形成了一大片瘀斑。

e.en: The report described {ecchymosis} as evidence of blunt trauma.
e.zh: 报告把皮下出血描述为钝器伤的证据。

e.en: The old medical text used {ecclasis} to describe deliberate bone breaking.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书用ecclasis描述有意折断骨头的做法。

e.en: Severe {ecclasis} can damage surrounding nerves and vessels.
e.zh: 严重骨折可能损伤周围的神经和血管。

e.en: The early Christian {ecclesia} met in private homes.
e.zh: 早期基督教会常在私人住宅中聚会。

e.en: In Athens, the {ecclesia} allowed citizens to vote on policy.
e.zh: 在雅典，公民大会让公民就政策投票。

ecclesiae.t: 教会的复数；公民大会的复数

e.en: Several ancient {ecclesiae} kept records of their assemblies.
e.zh: 几个古代教会保存了其集会记录。

e.en: The historian compared the {ecclesiae} of different Greek cities.
e.zh: 历史学家比较了不同希腊城邦的公民大会。

ecclesiarch.t: 教会主管；司礼神职人员

e.en: The {ecclesiarch} arranged the order of the service.
e.zh: 这位司礼神职人员安排了礼拜的次序。

e.en: Visitors asked the {ecclesiarch} about the monastery's customs.
e.zh: 访客向教会主管询问修道院的习俗。

e.en: His essays criticized the rigid {ecclesiasticism} of the period.
e.zh: 他的文章批评了那个时期僵化的教会主义。

e.en: The novel treats {ecclesiasticism} as both discipline and social power.
e.zh: 这部小说把教士作风既写成纪律，也写成社会权力。

e.en: The pamphlet mocked him as an {ecclesiolater}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲笑他是个盲目崇拜教会的人。

e.en: An {ecclesiolater} may value the institution above its teachings.
e.zh: 盲目崇拜教会的人可能把制度看得比教义更重要。

e.en: The reformer warned against {ecclesiolatry} in public sermons.
e.zh: 这位改革者在公开布道中警告人们不要盲目崇拜教会。

e.en: Her thesis studies {ecclesiolatry} in nineteenth-century religious debates.
e.zh: 她的论文研究十九世纪宗教论辩中的教会盲目崇拜。

ecclesiologist.t: 教会建筑或制度研究者

e.en: The {ecclesiologist} examined the church's medieval tower.
e.zh: 这位教会建筑研究者考察了教堂的中世纪塔楼。

e.en: As an {ecclesiologist}, she studied how parishes were organized.
e.zh: 作为教会制度研究者，她研究堂区是如何组织的。

e.en: The engineer measured the {ecclisis} of the damaged wall.
e.zh: 工程师测量了受损墙体的倾斜程度。

e.en: A slight {ecclisis} in the lens distorted the image.
e.zh: 镜片轻微偏斜使图像发生了变形。

e.en: The manuscript describes {eccope} as a surgical removal.
e.zh: 手稿把eccope描述为一种外科切除。

e.en: Ancient physicians sometimes used {eccope} to treat diseased tissue.
e.zh: 古代医生有时用截除术处理病变组织。

e.en: {Eccrine} glands help cool the body through sweat.
e.zh: 外分泌汗腺通过排汗帮助身体降温。

e.en: The biopsy showed changes in the {eccrine} duct.
e.zh: 活检显示外分泌汗腺导管发生了变化。

e.en: Few students choose {eccrinology} as their main specialty.
e.zh: 很少有学生把分泌学选为自己的主要专业。

e.en: The lecture on {eccrinology} focused on sweat glands.
e.zh: 这场关于外分泌研究的讲座重点讲了汗腺。

e.en: The course introduced {eccrisiology} alongside digestion and metabolism.
e.zh: 这门课在讲消化和代谢的同时介绍了排泄生理学。

e.en: Older medical writers used {eccrisiology} for the study of bodily excretions.
e.zh: 早期医学作者用eccrisiology指对人体排泄物的研究。

e.en: The pathologist identified the rare {eccyclomastoma} in the specimen.
e.zh: 病理学家在标本中识别出这种罕见的乳腺外翻样肿瘤。

e.en: A suspected {eccyclomastoma} requires careful microscopic examination.
e.zh: 疑似乳腺外翻样肿瘤需要仔细的显微镜检查。

e.en: The report described the fever as {ecdemic} rather than local.
e.zh: 报告称这种发热并非本地性，而是外来的。

e.en: An {ecdemic} disease may appear when travelers bring it home.
e.zh: 旅行者把疾病带回家时，可能出现外来性疾病。

e.en: The physician classified the illness as {ecdemonosus}.
e.zh: 医生把这种疾病归为非地方性疾病。

e.en: A case of {ecdemonosus} puzzled the rural clinic.
e.zh: 一例非地方性疾病让这家乡村诊所感到困惑。

e.en: The insect undergoes several {ecdyses} before adulthood.
e.zh: 这种昆虫在成年前会经历数次蜕皮。

e.en: Researchers recorded the crab's {ecdyses} throughout the season.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了这只蟹整个季节的换壳过程。

e.en: The club hired an {ecdysiast} for the late show.
e.zh: 俱乐部为深夜演出雇了一名脱衣舞演员。

e.en: She jokingly called the molting snake an {ecdysiast}.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说那条正在蜕皮的蛇像个脱衣舞演员。

e.en: The lab detected {ecdyson} in the insect sample.
e.zh: 实验室在昆虫样本中检测到了蜕皮激素。

e.en: Researchers compared {ecdyson} levels before molting.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了蜕皮前的蜕皮激素水平。

e.en: {Ecdysone} triggers molting in many insects.
e.zh: 蜕皮激素会触发许多昆虫蜕皮。

e.en: The study measured {ecdysone} in larval tissues.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了幼虫组织中的蜕皮激素。

e.en: Some supplements contain plant-derived {ecdysterone}.
e.zh: 有些补充剂含有植物来源的蜕皮甾酮。

e.en: The beetle produced more {ecdysterone} before pupation.
e.zh: 甲虫在化蛹前产生了更多蜕皮甾酮。

e.en: Successful {ecesis} depends on suitable soil and moisture.
e.zh: 植物能否成功定居生长取决于合适的土壤和水分。

e.en: The ecologist studied {ecesis} after the forest fire.
e.zh: 生态学家研究了森林火灾后的植物定居过程。

e.en: {Ecgonine} is a chemical related to cocaine.
e.zh: 芽子碱是一种与可卡因相关的化学物质。

e.en: Forensic tests can identify {ecgonine} derivatives.
e.zh: 法医检测可以识别芽子碱衍生物。

e.en: The agronomist measured the soil's {echard} content.
e.zh: 农学家测量了土壤中的难利用水分含量。

e.en: High {echard} means plants cannot absorb all moisture.
e.zh: 难利用水分高意味着植物不能吸收全部水分。

e.en: A narrow {echauguette} projected from the castle wall.
e.zh: 一座狭窄的角楼从城堡墙上伸出。

e.en: The guard watched the valley from the {echauguette}.
e.zh: 守卫从瞭望小塔上观察山谷。

e.en: The engraver used an {echelette} for fine measurements.
e.zh: 雕刻师用刻线尺进行精细测量。

e.en: A tiny {echelette} lay beside the model tower.
e.zh: 模型塔旁放着一把小梯。

e.en: The spectrograph used an {echelle} grating.
e.zh: 这台光谱仪使用了阶梯光栅。

e.en: An {echelle} can separate light into many orders.
e.zh: 阶梯光栅可以把光分成多个级次。

e.en: The manual described {echelon-telegraphy} for long lines.
e.zh: 手册介绍了长线路使用的梯级电报术。

e.en: Engineers replaced {echelon-telegraphy} with newer systems.
e.zh: 工程师用更新的系统取代了梯级电报术。

e.en: The commander ordered the {echelonment} of reserve units.
e.zh: 指挥官下令将预备部队作梯次配置。

e.en: The stones showed careful {echelonment} along the slope.
e.zh: 石块沿坡面呈现出仔细的分层排列。

e.en: Persistent {echeosis} made it hard for her to sleep.
e.zh: 持续的耳鸣让她难以入睡。

e.en: The physician noted {echeosis} after the loud explosion.
e.zh: 医生记录了爆炸巨响后出现的听觉异常。

e.en: She planted an {echeveria} in a clay pot.
e.zh: 她把一株拟石莲花属多肉种在陶盆里。

e.en: The {echeveria} formed a neat rosette of leaves.
e.zh: 这株拟石莲花长出整齐的莲座状叶片。

e.en: An {echidna} searched for ants under the log.
e.zh: 一只针鼹在木头下面寻找蚂蚁。

e.en: The {echidna} is one of the few egg-laying mammals.
e.zh: 针鼹是少数会产卵的哺乳动物之一。

e.en: Several {echidnae} were seen near the trail.
e.zh: 小路附近有人看见了几只针鼹。

e.en: Female {echidnae} lay eggs instead of giving birth.
e.zh: 雌性针鼹产卵，而不是直接产仔。

e.en: The seed has an {echinate} surface.
e.zh: 这种种子的表面带有刺状突起。

e.en: Under the microscope, the pollen looked {echinate}.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，花粉看起来呈多刺状。

e.en: The fruit was covered with an {echinated} shell.
e.zh: 这种果实外面包着带刺的壳。

e.en: Scientists described the specimen as {echinated}.
e.zh: 科学家把这个标本描述为具刺状突起。

e.en: {Echinenone} gives some marine animals their color.
e.zh: 海胆酮使一些海洋动物呈现颜色。

e.en: The pigment analysis found traces of {echinenone}.
e.zh: 色素分析发现了微量海胆酮。

e.en: The reef survey counted many {echini} among the rocks.
e.zh: 礁石调查在岩石间数到了许多海胆。

e.en: Collectors displayed dried {echini} in glass cases.
e.zh: 收藏者把干燥的海胆壳陈列在玻璃柜中。

e.en: The limestone contained a well-preserved {echinite}.
e.zh: 这块石灰岩中含有一枚保存完好的海胆化石。

e.en: She labeled the fossil as an {echinite}.
e.zh: 她把这件化石标注为海胆化石。

e.en: The sample contained several {echinococci}.
e.zh: 样本中含有数条棘球绦虫。

e.en: Dogs can carry {echinococci} without obvious symptoms.
e.zh: 狗可能携带棘球绦虫而没有明显症状。

e.en: {Echinococcosis} can damage the liver and lungs.
e.zh: 棘球蚴病可能损害肝脏和肺部。

e.en: Public health workers screened villagers for {echinococcosis}.
e.zh: 公共卫生人员为村民筛查包虫病。

e.en: {Echinococcus} infection often comes from contaminated food.
e.zh: 棘球绦虫感染常来自受污染的食物。

e.en: The veterinarian warned about {echinococcus} in sheepdogs.
e.zh: 兽医提醒注意牧羊犬身上的棘球绦虫。

e.en: The blood smear showed a single {echinocyte}.
e.zh: 血涂片显示出一个棘形红细胞。

e.en: An {echinocyte} has small projections on its surface.
e.zh: 棘形红细胞表面有细小突起。

e.en: The alien called humans {earthborn} creatures.
e.zh: 那个外星人把人类称作地球出生的生物。

e.en: She preferred {earthborn} magic to celestial power.
e.zh: 她更喜欢源自大地的魔法，而不是天界之力。

e.en: The drill reached deep into the {earthcrust}.
e.zh: 钻头深入到了地壳之中。

e.en: Heat slowly rises through the {earthcrust}.
e.zh: 热量会慢慢穿过地壳上升。

e.en: Our school planted trees on {Earth Day}.
e.zh: 我们学校在地球日种了树。

e.en: The museum held an {Earth Day} event.
e.zh: 博物馆举办了一场地球日活动。

e.en: Heavy rain triggered an {earthflow} on the hillside.
e.zh: 大雨引发了山坡上的土流。

e.en: Engineers monitored the slow {earthflow} near the road.
e.zh: 工程师监测着道路附近缓慢移动的土流。

e.en: This mushroom has the {earthiest} flavor.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇的泥土味最浓。

e.en: He told the {earthiest} jokes at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐时讲了最粗俗朴实的笑话。

e.en: The cellar smelled {earthily} of roots and damp stone.
e.zh: 地窖里散发着根茎和潮湿石头的泥土气。

e.en: She laughed {earthily} at his rude remark.
e.zh: 听到他的粗鲁话，她很接地气地大笑起来。

e.en: The second design felt {earthlier} and warmer.
e.zh: 第二个设计感觉更朴实，也更温暖。

e.en: His poems became {earthlier} after the war.
e.zh: 战后他的诗变得更贴近尘世。

e.en: The novel shows her {earthliest} concerns.
e.zh: 这部小说展现了她最世俗的关切。

e.en: Clay is the {earthliest} material in the collection.
e.zh: 黏土是这个系列中最朴实的材料。

e.en: The moon's dark side glowed with {earthlight}.
e.zh: 月球暗面泛着来自地球的微光。

e.en: At dawn, soft {earthlight} filled the valley.
e.zh: 黎明时，柔和的大地微光洒满山谷。

e.en: Her paintings have a quiet {earthliness}.
e.zh: 她的画有一种安静的朴实感。

e.en: The monk warned against excessive {earthliness}.
e.zh: 那位僧人告诫人们不要过分留恋尘世。

e.en: The sailors teased him as an {earthlubber}.
e.zh: 水手们取笑他是个不惯航海的陆上人。

e.en: An {earthlubber} may feel sick on rough seas.
e.zh: 不惯航海的人在风浪大的海上可能会晕船。

e.en: The robot mistook the astronaut for an {earthman}.
e.zh: 机器人把那名宇航员误认作地球人。

e.en: He was an {earthman}, practical and fond of soil.
e.zh: 他是个贴近土地的人，务实又喜欢泥土。

e.en: The story describes {earthmen} meeting Martians.
e.zh: 这个故事描写地球人与火星人相遇。

e.en: The villagers were hardy {earthmen} who trusted the seasons.
e.zh: 村民们是坚韧的土地之民，相信季节的节律。

e.en: The technician checked the wire with an {earthmeter}.
e.zh: 技术员用接地电阻表检查了电线。

e.en: An {earthmeter} can measure grounding resistance.
e.zh: 接地电阻表可以测量接地电阻。

e.en: The site needed heavy {earthmoving} equipment.
e.zh: 工地需要重型土方工程设备。

e.en: {Earthmoving} began before the foundations were poured.
e.zh: 浇筑地基之前，土方工程已经开始。

e.en: The child dug up an {earthnut} from the garden.
e.zh: 孩子从花园里挖出了一颗地下块茎。

e.en: In some regions, {earthnut} means peanut.
e.zh: 在一些地区，earthnut 指花生。

e.en: The old {earthometer} recorded tiny ground movements.
e.zh: 那台旧测地仪记录了细微的地面移动。

e.en: He repaired an {earthometer} for the survey team.
e.zh: 他为测量队修好了一台测地仪。

e.en: The farmer called the small tuber an {earthpea}.
e.zh: 农民把这种小块茎叫作地下豆。

e.en: Recipes sometimes use {earthpea} as an old word for peanut.
e.zh: 食谱中有时用 earthpea 这个旧词表示花生。

e.en: The astronauts watched {earthrise} from the Moon.
e.zh: 宇航员们在月球上观看地球升起。

e.en: That photograph of {earthrise} changed many minds.
e.zh: 那张地出的照片改变了许多人的想法。

e.en: The painter filled the canvas with a red {earthscape}.
e.zh: 画家在画布上铺满红色的大地景观。

e.en: Drones mapped the changing {earthscape} after the quake.
e.zh: 无人机绘制了地震后变化中的地貌景色。

e.en: You can see {earthshine} on the crescent moon.
e.zh: 你能在新月的暗面看到地球反照光。

e.en: The photograph captured faint {earthshine} before dawn.
e.zh: 照片捕捉到了黎明前微弱的地球反照光。

e.en: The mine collapse sent an {earthshock} through the valley.
e.zh: 矿井塌方让整个山谷感到地震般的冲击。

e.en: Sensors detected a small {earthshock} at midnight.
e.zh: 传感器在午夜检测到一次小的地动震荡。

e.en: We found an {earthstar} fungus under the pines.
e.zh: 我们在松树下发现了一朵地星菌。

e.en: The {earthstar} opened its arms after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后，那朵地星菌展开了星状外层。

e.en: The signal was received by an {earth station}.
e.zh: 信号由一座地面站接收。

e.en: Engineers upgraded the remote {earth station}.
e.zh: 工程师升级了那座偏远的卫星通信地面站。

e.en: The satellite sent back a clear {earthview}.
e.zh: 卫星传回了一幅清晰的地球景观。

e.en: Her painting imagined an {earthview} from orbit.
e.zh: 她的画想象了从轨道上俯瞰地球的景象。

e.en: The museum displayed {echinodermal} fossils from an ancient seabed.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自古海床的棘皮动物化石。

e.en: Researchers studied {echinodermal} larvae under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察棘皮动物幼体。

echinodermatous.t: 棘皮动物样的；具棘皮特征的

e.en: The specimen had an {echinodermatous} surface with tiny spines.
e.zh: 这个标本表面像棘皮动物一样布满细小棘刺。

e.en: She noted several {echinodermatous} features in the fossil.
e.zh: 她在化石中记录了几处棘皮动物特征。

e.en: An {echinoid} rolled slowly across the reef floor.
e.zh: 一只海胆类动物缓慢地滚过礁底。

e.en: The fossil's {echinoid} shape helped identify the layer.
e.zh: 这块化石的海胆状外形有助于识别地层。

e.en: The leaf looked smooth, but its edge was {echinulate}.
e.zh: 这片叶子看着光滑，但边缘有细小棘刺。

e.en: Under magnification, the shell appeared {echinulate}.
e.zh: 放大观察时，贝壳表面显得布满小刺。

e.en: The diver found an {echinus} hiding between rocks.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一只海胆藏在岩石之间。

e.en: The column's {echinus} supports the square slab above it.
e.zh: 柱头的圆凸饰支撑着上方的方形石板。

e.en: The paper measured {echitamine} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 论文测定了植物提取物中的鸡骨常山碱含量。

e.en: Chemists isolated {echitamine} for further testing.
e.zh: 化学家分离出鸡骨常山碱以便进一步测试。

echitenine.t: 鸡骨常山宁；一种生物碱

e.en: The lab report listed {echitenine} among the alkaloids detected.
e.zh: 实验报告把鸡骨常山宁列为检出的生物碱之一。

e.en: Researchers compared {echitenine} with related plant compounds.
e.zh: 研究人员将鸡骨常山宁与相关植物化合物进行比较。

e.en: The cave gave his voice a strange {echitone}.
e.zh: 洞穴让他的声音带上了一种奇怪的回声调。

e.en: The composer used an {echitone} effect in the final scene.
e.zh: 作曲家在最后一幕使用了反响音调效果。

e.en: An {echiuroid} burrowed into the soft mud.
e.zh: 一只螠虫类动物钻进了软泥里。

e.en: The sample showed {echiuroid} anatomy despite its damage.
e.zh: 尽管样本受损，仍显示出螠虫类的解剖特征。

e.en: The old stable still had an {echma} near the door.
e.zh: 旧马厩门边仍有一根拴马柱。

e.en: He tied the mule to the stone {echma}.
e.zh: 他把骡子拴在石制系留桩上。

e.en: Bats use {echo-location} to hunt in darkness.
e.zh: 蝙蝠利用回声定位在黑暗中捕食。

e.en: The robot tested {echo-location} in a narrow hallway.
e.zh: 机器人在狭窄走廊里测试回声定位。

e.en: The crew used {echo-sounding} to map the harbor floor.
e.zh: 船员用回声测深绘制港底地形。

e.en: Modern {echo-sounding} can reveal hidden underwater ridges.
e.zh: 现代回声测深能显示隐藏的水下山脊。

e.en: The clinician noted {echo-speech} during the assessment.
e.zh: 临床医生在评估中注意到模仿言语现象。

e.en: His {echo-speech} repeated the last words of each question.
e.zh: 他的回声语言会重复每个问题的最后几个词。

e.en: The hospital bought a new {echocardiograph} for the cardiac unit.
e.zh: 医院为心脏科购置了一台新的超声心动图仪。

e.en: The {echocardiograph} showed a leaking valve.
e.zh: 超声心动图显示有一个心脏瓣膜漏血。

e.en: The {echocardiographer} adjusted the probe carefully.
e.zh: 超声心动图技师仔细调整探头。

e.en: A skilled {echocardiographer} can spot subtle valve problems.
e.zh: 熟练的超声心动图技师能发现细微的瓣膜问题。

e.en: The doctor ordered {echocardiography} after hearing a murmur.
e.zh: 医生听到心脏杂音后安排了超声心动图检查。

e.en: Prenatal {echocardiography} can assess a baby's heart.
e.zh: 产前超声心动图检查可以评估胎儿心脏。

e.en: Before CT scans, {echoencephalography} helped detect brain shifts.
e.zh: 在CT扫描普及前，脑回声描记术可帮助发现脑移位。

e.en: The textbook described {echoencephalography} as an ultrasound method.
e.zh: 教材把脑回声描记术描述为一种超声方法。

e.en: The technician printed an {echogram} for the doctor.
e.zh: 技师为医生打印了一张超声图。

e.en: The {echogram} revealed a dense school of fish.
e.zh: 回声图显示出一大群密集的鱼。

echograph.t: 超声诊断仪；回声记录仪

e.en: The clinic replaced its aging {echograph}.
e.zh: 诊所更换了老旧的超声诊断仪。

e.en: An {echograph} recorded the signal returning from the seabed.
e.zh: 回声记录仪记录了从海床返回的信号。

e.en: Abdominal {echography} found no serious abnormality.
e.zh: 腹部超声检查没有发现严重异常。

e.en: Marine {echography} helped chart the depth of the lake.
e.zh: 水域回声描记法帮助测绘了湖水深度。

e.en: The tunnel gave every footstep an {echoic} quality.
e.zh: 隧道让每一步脚步声都带着回声感。

e.en: Words like buzz and hiss are often called {echoic}.
e.zh: buzz和hiss这样的词常被称为拟声词。

e.en: The poet used {echoism} to imitate rain on leaves.
e.zh: 诗人用拟声现象来模仿雨打树叶的声音。

e.en: In therapy notes, {echoism} described his repeated imitation.
e.zh: 在治疗记录中，回声式重复指的是他反复模仿他人。

echolalic.t: 患模仿言语的；回声言语的

e.en: The child gave an {echolalic} response to the question.
e.zh: 那个孩子对问题作出了回声言语式回答。

e.en: Some {echolalic} speech can still communicate emotion.
e.zh: 有些模仿言语仍然能传达情绪。

e.en: The case report discussed {echopathia} after brain injury.
e.zh: 病例报告讨论了脑损伤后的病理性模仿。

e.en: Doctors distinguished {echopathia} from ordinary mimicry.
e.zh: 医生把模仿症与普通模仿区分开来。

e.en: The neurologist noted {echopraxia} during the examination.
e.zh: 神经科医生在检查中注意到他有模仿他人动作的症状。

e.en: Her {echopraxia} made her repeat the nurse's gestures.
e.zh: 她的模仿动作症状让她重复护士的手势。

e.en: The lab identified an {echovirus} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室在样本中鉴定出一种埃可病毒。

e.en: An {echovirus} infection can sometimes cause fever.
e.zh: 埃可病毒感染有时会引起发烧。

e.en: That cafe has an {echt} Viennese atmosphere.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆有真正地道的维也纳氛围。

e.en: He wanted an {echt} example of rural cooking.
e.zh: 他想要一个真正地道的乡村烹饪例子。

e.en: Severe {eclampsia} can endanger both mother and baby.
e.zh: 严重子痫可能危及母亲和婴儿。

e.en: Doctors treated the {eclampsia} as an emergency.
e.zh: 医生把这次子痫作为急症处理。

e.en: The old report described the seizure as {eclampsism}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这次抽搐描述为子痫样发作。

e.en: Modern doctors rarely use the term {eclampsism}.
e.zh: 现代医生很少使用子痫样发作状态这个术语。

e.en: The manuscript used {eclips} where we write eclipse.
e.zh: 手稿中用旧拼法eclips表示今天的eclipse。

e.en: He found {eclips} in an old astronomy text.
e.zh: 他在一本旧天文学书里见到eclips这个旧拼法。

e.en: Irish grammar often discusses {eclipsis} in detail.
e.zh: 爱尔兰语语法常常详细讨论省音现象。

e.en: The poet used {eclipsis} to shorten the line.
e.zh: 诗人用省略手法缩短了这一行。

e.en: The planet's path was drawn on an {ecliptical} chart.
e.zh: 那颗行星的轨迹被画在黄道图上。

e.en: Ancient writers linked {ecliptical} events with omens.
e.zh: 古代作者把日月食现象同征兆联系起来。

e.en: The mountain belt contains bands of {eclogite}.
e.zh: 这条山带含有多条榴辉岩带。

e.en: Geologists study {eclogite} to understand deep crustal pressure.
e.zh: 地质学家研究榴辉岩，以了解地壳深部压力。

e.en: The team recorded the moth's {eclosion} at dawn.
e.zh: 团队记录下蛾子在黎明时羽化的过程。

e.en: Warm weather can speed up {eclosion} in insects.
e.zh: 温暖天气会加快昆虫的孵化或羽化。

e.en: The patient experienced {ecmnesia} after the accident.
e.zh: 病人在事故后出现旧事重现性记忆错乱。

e.en: In {ecmnesia}, past events may feel present again.
e.zh: 在旧事重现性记忆错乱中，过去的事件可能像正在发生一样。

e.en: They chose {eco-friendly} packaging for the new product.
e.zh: 他们为新产品选择了环保包装。

e.en: The hotel promotes {eco-friendly} travel habits.
e.zh: 这家酒店推广环保的旅行习惯。

e.en: The store attracts {eco-minded} shoppers.
e.zh: 这家店吸引有环保意识的顾客。

e.en: An {eco-minded} designer avoids wasteful materials.
e.zh: 有环保意识的设计师会避免使用浪费资源的材料。

e.en: The authorities called the arsonist an {eco-terrorist}.
e.zh: 当局称那名纵火者为生态恐怖分子。

e.en: Activists rejected the label {eco-terrorist}.
e.zh: 活动人士拒绝接受生态恐怖分子这个标签。

e.en: The island depends heavily on {eco-tourism}.
e.zh: 这座岛很大程度上依赖生态旅游。

e.en: Good {eco-tourism} protects wildlife and supports local people.
e.zh: 良好的生态旅游会保护野生动物并支持当地居民。

e.en: The report was full of corporate {ecobabble}.
e.zh: 这份报告充满了企业式的空泛环保套话。

e.en: Voters wanted clear policies, not {ecobabble}.
e.zh: 选民想要明确政策，而不是空洞的环保套话。

e.en: Unchecked pollution could cause an {ecocatastrophe}.
e.zh: 不受控制的污染可能造成生态灾难。

e.en: The oil spill became a regional {ecocatastrophe}.
e.zh: 那次漏油事件演变成区域性的生态灾难。

ecocentrism.t: 生态中心主义；生态本位观

e.en: {Ecocentrism} values ecosystems beyond their usefulness to humans.
e.zh: 生态中心主义重视生态系统本身，而不只看它对人类的用途。

e.en: Her essay contrasts {ecocentrism} with human-centered environmental policy.
e.zh: 她的文章把生态本位观与以人为中心的环境政策作对比。

ecocidal.t: 生态灭绝性的；毁坏生态的

e.en: The court described the drilling plan as {ecocidal}.
e.zh: 法院称这项钻探计划具有毁坏生态的性质。

e.en: Activists condemned the {ecocidal} effects of the chemical spill.
e.zh: 活动人士谴责化学品泄漏造成的生态灭绝性影响。

ecocide.t: 生态灭绝；大规模生态破坏

e.en: Some lawyers want {ecocide} recognized as an international crime.
e.zh: 一些律师希望把生态灭绝认定为国际罪行。

e.en: The poisoned river became a symbol of industrial {ecocide}.
e.zh: 这条被污染的河成了工业性大规模生态破坏的象征。

ecoclimate.t: 生态气候；生态环境气候

e.en: The valley has a fragile {ecoclimate} shaped by fog and shade.
e.zh: 这个山谷有由雾气和阴影塑造的脆弱生态气候。

e.en: Researchers tracked how farming changed the local {ecoclimate}.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了农业如何改变当地的生态环境气候。

e.en: Plant height changed gradually along the coastal {ecocline}.
e.zh: 植物高度沿着海岸生态渐变带逐渐变化。

e.en: The study mapped an {ecocline} from wet forest to dry grassland.
e.zh: 这项研究绘制了从湿润森林到干草地的生态梯度。

ecodevelopment.t: 生态发展；兼顾生态的发展

e.en: The village adopted {ecodevelopment} instead of rapid industrial expansion.
e.zh: 这个村庄选择生态发展，而不是快速工业扩张。

e.en: Her report defines {ecodevelopment} as growth within environmental limits.
e.zh: 她的报告把兼顾生态的发展定义为在环境限度内增长。

ecodoom.t: 生态末日论；生态灾难感

e.en: The documentary avoids simple {ecodoom} and focuses on solutions.
e.zh: 这部纪录片避免单纯的生态末日论，而是关注解决办法。

e.en: Online debates often swing between denial and {ecodoom}.
e.zh: 网上争论常在否认问题和生态灾难感之间摇摆。

ecodoomster.t: 生态末日论者；环保悲观派

e.en: He rejects the label {ecodoomster} because he still believes change is possible.
e.zh: 他拒绝生态末日论者这个标签，因为他仍相信改变是可能的。

e.en: Critics dismissed the scientist as an {ecodoomster}.
e.zh: 批评者把这位科学家贬称为环保悲观派。

ecofallow.t: 生态休耕的；生态休耕地

e.en: The farmer left one field {ecofallow} to restore insects and wildflowers.
e.zh: 农民让一块田生态休耕，以恢复昆虫和野花。

e.en: An {ecofallow} strip separated the crops from the stream.
e.zh: 一条生态休耕带把农作物与小溪隔开。

e.en: {Ecofeminism} links the exploitation of nature with the oppression of women.
e.zh: 生态女性主义把对自然的剥削与对女性的压迫联系起来。

e.en: The course includes a week on {ecofeminism} and environmental justice.
e.zh: 这门课有一周内容讨论生态女性主义和环境正义。

ecofeminist.t: 生态女性主义者；生态女性主义的

e.en: An {ecofeminist} scholar spoke at the climate conference.
e.zh: 一位生态女性主义学者在气候会议上发言。

e.en: The novel offers an {ecofeminist} reading of rural labor.
e.zh: 这部小说从生态女性主义角度解读乡村劳动。

e.en: His neighbors jokingly called him an {ecofreak} for sorting every scrap.
e.zh: 邻居开玩笑说他把每点废料都分类，像个环保怪人。

e.en: The article used {ecofreak} as an insult against climate activists.
e.zh: 这篇文章把狂热环保者当作辱骂气候活动人士的词。

ecogenesis.t: 生态发生；生态系统形成

e.en: The lecture explained {ecogenesis} after a volcanic island emerges.
e.zh: 讲座解释了火山岛出现后的生态系统形成过程。

e.en: Scientists studied {ecogenesis} in the restored wetland.
e.zh: 科学家研究了修复湿地中的生态发生。

e.en: The database records {ecogeographic} traits of wild crop relatives.
e.zh: 这个数据库记录野生作物近缘种的生态地理特征。

e.en: Their model includes {ecogeographic} variation across mountain slopes.
e.zh: 他们的模型纳入了山坡之间的生态地理差异。

e.en: The columnist mocked the city's sudden {ecomania}.
e.zh: 专栏作家嘲笑这座城市突然兴起的环保狂热。

e.en: Brands tried to profit from the public's {ecomania}.
e.zh: 各品牌试图从公众的生态热潮中获利。

e.en: The paper proposes an {ecometabolic} view of urban waste.
e.zh: 这篇论文提出了看待城市废弃物的生态代谢视角。

e.en: Researchers measured {ecometabolic} flows between farms and nearby towns.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了农场与附近城镇之间的生态代谢流动。

e.en: The chemical may act as an {ecomone} between soil organisms.
e.zh: 这种化学物质可能在土壤生物之间充当生态激素。

e.en: Few students had heard the term {ecomone} before the seminar.
e.zh: 研讨会之前，很少有学生听过环境信息素这个术语。

e.en: The bird occupies a narrow {econiche} in the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 这种鸟在雨林树冠层占据一个狭窄的生态位。

e.en: The company found an {econiche} for reusable camping gear.
e.zh: 这家公司找到了可重复使用露营装备的生态小众市场。

econobox.t: 经济型小车；环保经济盒子

e.en: He drove an old {econobox} that barely reached highway speed.
e.zh: 他开着一辆老旧经济型小车，几乎开不到高速公路速度。

e.en: The startup sells an {econobox} kit for balcony composting.
e.zh: 这家初创公司销售用于阳台堆肥的环保经济盒子套件。

e.en: The policy was evaluated {econometrically} using regional employment data.
e.zh: 这项政策用地区就业数据按计量经济学方法进行了评估。

e.en: She tested the claim {econometrically} rather than relying on anecdotes.
e.zh: 她用计量经济学方法检验这个说法，而不是依赖传闻。

e.en: An {econometrician} built the model for the central bank.
e.zh: 一位计量经济学家为中央银行建立了模型。

e.en: The company hired an {econometrician} to measure advertising effects.
e.zh: 公司聘请了一名计量经济学家来衡量广告效果。

e.en: The {econometrist} questioned the assumptions behind the forecast.
e.zh: 这位计量经济学家质疑预测背后的假设。

e.en: As an {econometrist}, she studies how policy changes affect wages.
e.zh: 作为计量经济学家，她研究政策变化如何影响工资。

e.en: The factory pursued {economization} of every production step.
e.zh: 工厂对每个生产环节都追求节约化。

e.en: Budget pressure led to rapid {economization} across the department.
e.zh: 预算压力促使整个部门迅速采取节省措施。

e.en: Modern boilers use {economizers} to recover wasted heat.
e.zh: 现代锅炉用节能器回收浪费的热量。

e.en: Careful {economizers} avoided unnecessary spending during the crisis.
e.zh: 谨慎节俭的人在危机期间避免了不必要开支。

e.en: She bought an {economy-size} bottle of detergent.
e.zh: 她买了一瓶经济装洗衣液。

e.en: The {economy-size} pack costs less per serving.
e.zh: 这种经济装每份的价格更低。

e.en: The columnist mocked him as an {econut} after the protest.
e.zh: 抗议之后，专栏作者嘲笑他是环保狂热分子。

e.en: She calls herself an {econut} who loves low-waste living.
e.zh: 她自称是热爱低废生活的环保迷。

ecoparasite.t: 生态寄生物；环境寄生者

e.en: The vine acts as an {ecoparasite} on nearby trees.
e.zh: 这种藤蔓像生态寄生物一样依附在附近树木上。

e.en: Critics called the company an {ecoparasite} exploiting public land.
e.zh: 批评者称这家公司是利用公共土地的环境寄生者。

e.en: Each {ecophene} showed a different response to drought.
e.zh: 每种生态表型对干旱表现出不同反应。

e.en: Researchers compared the mountain {ecophene} with the coastal form.
e.zh: 研究人员把山地生态型与海岸型进行了比较。

e.en: Her research in {ecophysiology} examines how plants survive heat.
e.zh: 她的生态生理学研究考察植物如何耐受高温。

e.en: The course introduces marine {ecophysiology} through field experiments.
e.zh: 这门课通过野外实验介绍海洋生态生理学。

ecopornography.t: 煽情环保影像；生态色情化

e.en: The critic dismissed the glossy disaster film as {ecopornography}.
e.zh: 评论家把那部华丽的灾难片斥为煽情环保影像。

e.en: Some campaigns use {ecopornography} instead of serious ecological analysis.
e.zh: 有些宣传用生态色情化画面取代严肃的生态分析。

e.en: The patient received an {ecorthatic} brace after surgery.
e.zh: 病人术后使用了矫正姿势的支具。

e.en: The therapist recommended {ecorthatic} exercises for spinal alignment.
e.zh: 治疗师建议做矫直训练来改善脊柱排列。

e.en: The island population may represent a distinct {ecospecies}.
e.zh: 该岛种群可能代表一个独立的生态种。

e.en: Botanists debated whether the grass was an {ecospecies}.
e.zh: 植物学家争论这种草是否属于生态物种。

ecospecific.t: 生态种特有的；同生态种的

e.en: The study identified an {ecospecific} response to soil acidity.
e.zh: 研究发现了对土壤酸度的生态种特异反应。

e.en: These insects show {ecospecific} mating preferences in the wild.
e.zh: 这些昆虫在野外表现出同生态种内的交配偏好。

ecossaise.t: 埃科赛兹舞；苏格兰舞曲

e.en: The pianist ended the recital with a lively {ecossaise}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以一首活泼的埃科赛兹舞曲结束独奏会。

e.en: They learned an {ecossaise} during the historical dance workshop.
e.zh: 他们在历史舞蹈工作坊里学了一支苏格兰舞。

ecotage.t: 环保破坏行动；生态破坏抗议

e.en: The group denied planning {ecotage} against the pipeline.
e.zh: 该组织否认计划对管道实施环保破坏行动。

e.en: Debates over {ecotage} divided the environmental movement.
e.zh: 围绕生态破坏式抗议的争论使环保运动内部出现分歧。

e.en: The village uses {ecotechnology} to clean wastewater naturally.
e.zh: 这个村庄利用生态技术自然净化废水。

e.en: Investors are funding new {ecotechnology} for low-carbon housing.
e.zh: 投资者正在资助用于低碳住房的新型环保技术。

ecotecture.t: 生态建筑；环保建筑设计

e.en: The studio specializes in {ecotecture} for hot climates.
e.zh: 这家工作室专门做炎热气候下的生态建筑设计。

e.en: Good {ecotecture} reduces energy use without sacrificing comfort.
e.zh: 优秀的环保建筑能在不牺牲舒适度的情况下降低能耗。

ecoterrorism.t: 生态恐怖主义；环保暴力行动

e.en: Officials labeled the sabotage as {ecoterrorism}.
e.zh: 官员把这次破坏行为定性为生态恐怖主义。

e.en: Activists rejected accusations of {ecoterrorism} after the protest.
e.zh: 抗议之后，活动人士否认生态恐怖主义指控。

ecoterrorist.t: 生态恐怖分子；环保暴力者

e.en: Police arrested an alleged {ecoterrorist} near the construction site.
e.zh: 警方在施工现场附近逮捕了一名涉嫌生态恐怖分子。

e.en: The article unfairly called every radical protester an {ecoterrorist}.
e.zh: 那篇文章不公正地把每个激进抗议者都称作环保暴力者。

e.en: The survey focused on {ecotonal} vegetation between forest and grassland.
e.zh: 调查重点研究森林与草原之间生态交错带的植被。

e.en: Bird diversity is often high in {ecotonal} habitats.
e.zh: 生态交错带生境中的鸟类多样性往往较高。

ecotone.t: 生态交错带；群落过渡区

e.en: The wetland forms an {ecotone} between lake and forest.
e.zh: 这片湿地形成了湖泊与森林之间的生态交错带。

e.en: Species from both habitats meet in the {ecotone}.
e.zh: 两个生境的物种在这个群落过渡区相遇。

e.en: Each {ecotope} was mapped according to soil and moisture.
e.zh: 每个生态小区都按土壤和湿度进行了绘图。

e.en: The rare moss survives only in a shaded {ecotope}.
e.zh: 这种稀有苔藓只在阴湿的生态小区中存活。

ecotopian.t: 生态乌托邦的；生态理想主义者

e.en: His novel imagines an {ecotopian} society without fossil fuels.
e.zh: 他的小说想象了一个没有化石燃料的生态乌托邦社会。

e.en: Critics dismissed her plan as {ecotopian} but impractical.
e.zh: 批评者认为她的计划过于生态理想化而不切实际。

e.en: We booked an {ecotour} through the rainforest.
e.zh: 我们预订了一趟穿越雨林的生态旅游。

e.en: The guide designed the {ecotour} to support local conservation.
e.zh: 导游设计这条生态旅游线路来支持当地保护工作。

e.en: Scientists measured the {ecotoxicity} of the new pesticide.
e.zh: 科学家测定了这种新农药的生态毒性。

e.en: Regulators require {ecotoxicity} data before approving the chemical.
e.zh: 监管机构在批准该化学品前要求提供生态毒性数据。

e.en: The report included an {ecotoxicological} assessment of river pollution.
e.zh: 报告包含了对河流污染的生态毒理学评估。

e.en: They reviewed {ecotoxicological} evidence before banning the compound.
e.zh: 他们在禁用该化合物前审查了生态毒理学证据。

e.en: This grass {ecotype} tolerates salty soil better than others.
e.zh: 这种草的生态型比其他类型更耐盐碱土。

e.en: Researchers identified a local {ecotype} adapted to mountain winters.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种适应山区冬季的本地生态型。

e.en: Several plant {ecotypes} grow along the dry coastline.
e.zh: 几种植物生态型生长在干旱的海岸线上。

e.en: The study compared {ecotypes} from valleys and high slopes.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了山谷和高坡上的不同生态型。

e.en: The seeds showed clear {ecotypic} differences after transplantation.
e.zh: 移栽后，这些种子表现出明显的生态型差异。

e.en: Scientists mapped {ecotypic} variation across the species range.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了该物种分布范围内的生态型变异。

ecotypically.t: 按生态型地；生态变型地

e.en: The populations differed {ecotypically} in their drought response.
e.zh: 这些种群在抗旱反应上呈现生态型差异。

e.en: Samples were grouped {ecotypically} before genetic testing began.
e.zh: 在基因检测开始前，样本先按生态型分组。

e.en: The patient had mild {ecphlysis} after the skin treatment.
e.zh: 这名患者在皮肤治疗后出现了轻微脱皮。

e.en: Old medical texts used {ecphlysis} for the shedding of skin.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用ecphlysis指皮肤的脱落。

e.en: The poet used {ecphonesis} to heighten the scene's emotion.
e.zh: 诗人用感叹修辞增强了场景的情感。

e.en: In rhetoric, {ecphonesis} can turn grief into a cry.
e.zh: 在修辞中，感叹表达能把悲伤化作呼喊。

e.en: A familiar smell triggered {ecphoria} of her childhood home.
e.zh: 熟悉的气味唤起了她对童年家园的记忆。

e.en: Psychologists studied {ecphoria} during recognition tests.
e.zh: 心理学家在再认测试中研究记忆唤起。

e.en: The old remedy was described as {ecphractic} in medical notes.
e.zh: 旧医案把这种药方描述为能疏通阻塞。

e.en: An {ecphractic} treatment was meant to open blocked passages.
e.zh: 所谓疏通疗法旨在打开受阻的通道。

e.en: The physician recorded a small {ecphyma} near the scar.
e.zh: 医生记录疤痕旁有一个小的皮肤赘生物。

e.en: Older dermatology books used {ecphyma} for certain skin outgrowths.
e.zh: 较旧的皮肤病学书籍用ecphyma指某些皮肤赘生物。

e.en: The surgeon noted possible {ecptoma} after the examination.
e.zh: 外科医生检查后指出可能存在器官脱垂。

e.en: In older pathology, {ecptoma} meant a falling or displacement of tissue.
e.zh: 在旧病理学中，ecptoma指组织的下垂或移位。

e.en: The wound showed signs of {ecpyesis} by the third day.
e.zh: 到第三天，伤口出现了化脓迹象。

e.en: Antiseptic care reduced {ecpyesis} after minor surgery.
e.zh: 消毒护理减少了小手术后的化脓。

ecracite.t: 炸药的一种；旧式烈性炸药

e.en: The archive mentioned {ecracite} in a report on explosives.
e.zh: 档案在一份炸药报告中提到了ecracite这种烈性炸药。

e.en: Miners avoided storing {ecracite} near open flames.
e.zh: 矿工避免把ecracite炸药存放在明火附近。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with {ecrodactylia} in one hand.
e.zh: 这个新生儿被诊断出一只手有先天缺指畸形。

e.en: Genetic counseling may follow a family history of {ecrodactylia}.
e.zh: 如果家族中有先天缺指趾畸形史，可能需要遗传咨询。

e.en: The crowd watched in {ecstacy} as the singer returned.
e.zh: 歌手返场时，观众陷入狂喜。

e.en: Old spellings sometimes wrote ecstasy as {ecstacy}.
e.zh: 旧拼写有时把ecstasy写作ecstacy。

e.en: The music seemed to {ecstasize} the entire audience.
e.zh: 这音乐似乎让全场观众都陷入狂喜。

e.en: Mystic writers used to {ecstasize} over visions of light.
e.zh: 神秘主义作家过去常因光明异象而狂喜赞叹。

e.en: Bladder {ecstrophy} requires careful surgical planning.
e.zh: 膀胱外翻畸形需要周密的手术规划。

e.en: The lecture explained {ecstrophy} as an outward turning of tissue.
e.zh: 讲座把外翻畸形解释为组织向外翻出。

e.en: The scan suggested {ectacolia} rather than simple constipation.
e.zh: 扫描结果提示是结肠扩张，而不只是便秘。

e.en: Older case reports described {ectacolia} after chronic obstruction.
e.zh: 较旧的病例报告描述了慢性梗阻后的结肠扩张。

e.en: The incision was extended {ectad} from the marked point.
e.zh: 切口从标记点向外延伸。

e.en: Anatomists used {ectad} to mean toward the exterior.
e.zh: 解剖学家用ectad表示朝向外部。

e.en: The {ectal} surface of the structure was slightly rough.
e.zh: 该结构的外侧表面略显粗糙。

e.en: In anatomy, {ectal} contrasts with deeper internal positions.
e.zh: 在解剖学中，ectal与更深的内部位置相对。

e.en: The report noted mild bronchial {ectasia}.
e.zh: 报告指出有轻度支气管扩张。

e.en: Vascular {ectasia} can appear on imaging studies.
e.zh: 血管扩张可在影像检查中显现。

e.en: The physician prescribed an {ectillotic} preparation for unwanted hair.
e.zh: 医生开了一种用于去除多余毛发的脱毛制剂。

e.en: Old pharmacology texts classified some caustics as {ectillotic}.
e.zh: 旧药理学文献把一些腐蚀剂归为脱毛药。

e.en: The team examined {ectoangial} tissue around the vessel.
e.zh: 团队检查了血管周围的管外组织。

e.en: An {ectoangial} reaction may occur outside the vascular wall.
e.zh: 血管壁外可能发生管外反应。

ectobiology.t: 体外生物学；外生生物学

e.en: The lab's {ectobiology} project studied embryos outside the body.
e.zh: 实验室的体外生物学项目研究体外胚胎。

e.en: In speculative fiction, {ectobiology} often replaces natural pregnancy.
e.zh: 在科幻作品中，外生生物学常取代自然怀孕。

e.en: The {ectoblast} later forms skin and nervous tissue.
e.zh: 外胚层后来形成皮肤和神经组织。

e.en: Students labeled the {ectoblast} on the early embryo diagram.
e.zh: 学生在早期胚胎图上标出了外胚叶。

e.en: The surgeon noted {ectochondral} growth near the joint.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到关节附近有软骨外生长。

e.en: An {ectochondral} layer was visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以看到一层外软骨性结构。

e.en: The insect egg's {ectochorion} protected it from drying out.
e.zh: 昆虫卵的外卵壳膜保护它免于干燥。

e.en: Researchers measured pores in the {ectochorion} of each egg.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了每个卵外卵壳膜上的孔隙。

ectochroic.t: 外部着色的；表面有色的

e.en: The shell showed an {ectochroic} stain after treatment.
e.zh: 处理后贝壳出现了表面有色的污斑。

e.en: Its {ectochroic} markings faded in strong sunlight.
e.zh: 它外部着色的斑纹在强光下褪色了。

ectocommensal.t: 体表共栖的；外共栖生物

e.en: The crab carries an {ectocommensal} worm on its shell.
e.zh: 这只蟹的壳上带着一种体表共栖蠕虫。

e.en: An {ectocommensal} may benefit without harming its host.
e.zh: 外共栖生物可能受益而不伤害宿主。

e.en: Some algae release {ectocrine} chemicals into the water.
e.zh: 一些藻类会向水中释放外分泌化学物质。

e.en: The study focused on {ectocrine} signals between nearby cells.
e.zh: 这项研究关注邻近细胞之间的外分泌信号。

e.en: A tough {ectocyst} surrounds the dormant organism.
e.zh: 坚韧的外囊包围着休眠的生物体。

e.en: The parasite's {ectocyst} ruptured during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中寄生虫的外包囊破裂了。

e.en: The child was born with {ectodactylism} affecting both hands.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时双手都有裂手畸形。

e.en: Genetic counseling explained how {ectodactylism} can run in families.
e.zh: 遗传咨询解释了裂手裂足畸形如何在家族中遗传。

e.en: The {ectoderm} develops into skin and parts of the nervous system.
e.zh: 外胚层会发育成皮肤和部分神经系统。

e.en: She reviewed how the {ectoderm} differs from the mesoderm.
e.zh: 她复习了外胚层与中胚层的区别。

e.en: The rare {ectodermosis} affected the patient's skin and nails.
e.zh: 这种罕见的外胚层病变影响了患者的皮肤和指甲。

e.en: Doctors discussed {ectodermosis} in the genetics seminar.
e.zh: 医生们在遗传学研讨会上讨论了外胚层病变。

e.en: The bacterium uses an {ectoenzyme} to break down nutrients outside the cell.
e.zh: 这种细菌利用胞外酶在细胞外分解营养物。

e.en: Researchers tracked {ectoenzyme} activity on the cell surface.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了细胞表面的外酶活性。

e.en: Scientists debated the ethics of human {ectogenesis}.
e.zh: 科学家讨论了人类体外孕育的伦理问题。

e.en: In the novel, {ectogenesis} made artificial wombs common.
e.zh: 在这部小说里，体外孕育让人工子宫变得普遍。

e.en: The report described an {ectogenetic} method for embryo development.
e.zh: 报告描述了一种胚胎体外发生的方法。

e.en: Their {ectogenetic} experiment required strict temperature control.
e.zh: 他们的体外发生实验需要严格控温。

e.en: The doctor suspected an {ectogenic} cause for the irritation.
e.zh: 医生怀疑这种刺激有外源性原因。

e.en: An {ectogenic} embryo develops outside the mother's body.
e.zh: 体外产生的胚胎在母体外发育。

e.en: The infection was linked to an {ectogenous} source.
e.zh: 这次感染与外源来源有关。

e.en: Botanists described the fungus as {ectogenous} on the root surface.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种真菌描述为根表外生的。

e.en: The paper mentioned {ectoglia} in a discussion of nerve support cells.
e.zh: 论文在讨论神经支持细胞时提到了外神经胶质。

e.en: Under the stain, {ectoglia} appeared as a thin outer layer.
e.zh: 染色后，外神经胶质呈现为一层薄薄的外层。

e.en: The organism released an {ectohormone} that influenced nearby cells.
e.zh: 该生物释放出一种影响邻近细胞的外激素。

e.en: An {ectohormone} can act outside the body that produces it.
e.zh: 外激素可以在产生它的机体外发挥作用。

e.en: Pine needles formed dark {ectohumus} above the mineral soil.
e.zh: 松针在矿质土上方形成了深色表层腐殖质。

e.en: The ecologist sampled {ectohumus} from the forest floor.
e.zh: 生态学家从森林地表采集了表层腐殖质样本。

e.en: The cell wall showed signs of {ectolysis} after exposure.
e.zh: 暴露后细胞壁显示出外溶解迹象。

e.en: Researchers induced {ectolysis} to study the organism's outer layer.
e.zh: 研究人员诱导外溶解以研究该生物的外层。

e.en: Each {ectomere} contributes to the embryo's outer tissues.
e.zh: 每个外裂球都参与形成胚胎的外部组织。

e.en: The diagram marked the {ectomere} at the animal pole.
e.zh: 图中在动物极标出了外裂球。

e.en: Neural crest cells give rise to much of the {ectomesenchyme}.
e.zh: 神经嵴细胞产生了大部分外间充质。

e.en: The dentist studied {ectomesenchyme} during tooth development.
e.zh: 牙医研究了牙齿发育过程中的外间充质。

e.en: The textbook used {ectomesoblast} for tissue between ectoderm and mesoderm.
e.zh: 教材用外中胚层指外胚层和中胚层之间的组织。

e.en: An {ectomesoblast} region was identified in the embryo section.
e.zh: 胚胎切片中识别出一个外间胚层区域。

e.en: He had an {ectomorphic} build with narrow shoulders.
e.zh: 他是瘦长体型，肩膀较窄。

e.en: Older psychology texts linked {ectomorphic} bodies with temperament.
e.zh: 早期心理学文本曾把外胚型体格与气质联系起来。

e.en: Oak roots often form {ectomycorrhizal} partnerships with fungi.
e.zh: 橡树根常与真菌形成外生菌根共生关系。

e.en: The forest soil was rich in {ectomycorrhizal} networks.
e.zh: 这片森林土壤中有丰富的外生菌根网络。

e.en: The infant was born with {ectromelia} affecting one arm.
e.zh: 这个婴儿出生时一只手臂有肢体缺如畸形。

e.en: Laboratory staff monitored the colony for signs of {ectromelia}.
e.zh: 实验室人员监测鼠群是否出现鼠痘迹象。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the patient's lower-lid {ectropion}.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了患者下眼睑外翻的问题。

e.en: Cervical {ectropion} is often found during a routine exam.
e.zh: 宫颈柱状上皮外移常在常规检查中发现。

e.en: The museum displayed an {ectypal} cast of the ancient seal.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件古印章的复制铸件。

e.en: His theory treated human beauty as an {ectypal} image of a higher form.
e.zh: 他的理论把人的美视为更高形式的摹本形象。

e.en: The gallery owned only an {ectype} of the original medal.
e.zh: 画廊收藏的只是原始奖章的复制品。

e.en: Scholars compared the manuscript with a later {ectype}.
e.zh: 学者们把手稿同后来的摹本进行比较。

e.en: The printer studied {ectypography} before learning lithography.
e.zh: 这名印刷工先学习凸版印刷术，然后才学习石版印刷。

e.en: Early manuals on {ectypography} describe raised letters and pressure.
e.zh: 早期的凸版印刷手册会说明凸起字模和压力的作用。

e.en: Ancient geographers mapped the {ecumene} as they understood it.
e.zh: 古代地理学家按照自己的理解绘制人类居住世界。

e.en: Climate change is reshaping the limits of the {ecumene}.
e.zh: 气候变化正在重塑人类可居住世界的边界。

e.en: The council sought an {ecumenic} agreement among churches.
e.zh: 该会议寻求各教会之间的普世性共识。

e.en: Her essay used {ecumenic} in its older sense of worldwide.
e.zh: 她的文章把ecumenic用于较古老的“世界性”含义。

e.en: His sermons promoted {ecumenicalism} among local congregations.
e.zh: 他的布道在当地各会众之间倡导普世教会主义。

e.en: Critics feared that {ecumenicalism} would blur doctrinal boundaries.
e.zh: 批评者担心普世教会主义会模糊教义边界。

e.en: The bishop was known as a committed {ecumenicist}.
e.zh: 这位主教以坚定的普世教会主义者身份闻名。

e.en: An {ecumenicist} may work across several Christian traditions.
e.zh: 普世教会主义者可能会在多个基督教传统之间开展工作。

e.en: The statement emphasized the {ecumenicity} of the early councils.
e.zh: 该声明强调早期大公会议的普世性。

e.en: They questioned the movement's real {ecumenicity}.
e.zh: 他们质疑这场运动真正的教会合一性。

e.en: She teaches {ecumenics} at a theological college.
e.zh: 她在一所神学院教授普世教会研究。

e.en: Modern {ecumenics} often includes interfaith dialogue.
e.zh: 现代普世教会研究常常包括宗教间对话。

e.en: The pastor was an active {ecumenist} in the city.
e.zh: 这位牧师是城里活跃的普世教会主义者。

e.en: As an {ecumenist}, she attended services in many denominations.
e.zh: 作为普世教会主义者，她参加过许多教派的礼拜。

e.en: The planner imagined an {ecumenopolis} covering the whole planet.
e.zh: 这位规划师设想了一座覆盖整个地球的全球城市。

e.en: Science fiction often portrays an {ecumenopolis} as crowded and layered.
e.zh: 科幻作品常把全球城市描绘得拥挤而层层叠叠。

e.en: The doctor asked when the child's {ecuresis} began.
e.zh: 医生询问这个孩子的遗尿是从什么时候开始的。

e.en: Severe stress can sometimes worsen {ecuresis} in adults.
e.zh: 严重压力有时会加重成年人的尿失禁。

e.en: The {edacious} child finished every cake on the plate.
e.zh: 这个贪吃的孩子把盘子里的每块蛋糕都吃完了。

e.en: An {edacious} market can consume small firms quickly.
e.zh: 一个贪婪的市场会很快吞噬小公司。

e.en: His {edacity} at dinner amused the whole table.
e.zh: 他晚餐时的贪吃样子逗乐了整桌人。

e.en: The empire's {edacity} for land alarmed its neighbors.
e.zh: 这个帝国对土地的贪婪让邻国感到警惕。

e.en: We ordered salted {edamame} before the sushi arrived.
e.zh: 寿司上桌前，我们点了一份盐味毛豆。

e.en: Frozen {edamame} makes a quick protein-rich snack.
e.zh: 冷冻毛豆可以很快做成富含蛋白质的小吃。

e.en: The plant's growth depends on local {edaphic} conditions.
e.zh: 这种植物的生长取决于当地的土壤条件。

e.en: Researchers separated climatic factors from {edaphic} effects.
e.zh: 研究人员把气候因素同土壤影响区分开来。

e.en: The two forests are {edaphically} very different.
e.zh: 从土壤条件看，这两片森林差异很大。

e.en: The species is {edaphically} restricted to limestone soils.
e.zh: 从土壤条件看，该物种只限于石灰岩土壤。

e.en: She studied {edaphology} to understand crop yields.
e.zh: 她学习土壤学，以了解作物产量。

e.en: Modern {edaphology} links soil chemistry with plant ecology.
e.zh: 现代土壤学把土壤化学与植物生态联系起来。

e.en: The {edaphon} includes bacteria, fungi, and tiny animals.
e.zh: 土壤生物群包括细菌、真菌和微小动物。

e.en: Pesticides can disturb the {edaphon} beneath a field.
e.zh: 农药可能扰乱田地下方的土壤生物群。

e.en: The poem uses an {Eddaic} style.
e.zh: 这首诗采用了《埃达》式的风格。

e.en: She studied {Eddaic} myths at university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究《埃达》中的北欧神话。

e.en: The {Eddas} preserve many Norse myths.
e.zh: 《埃达》文集保存了许多北欧神话。

e.en: He quoted the {Eddas} in his lecture.
e.zh: 他在讲座中引用了《埃达》文集。

e.en: The saga contains several {Eddic} verses.
e.zh: 这部传奇中包含几段《埃达》式诗句。

e.en: Her article compares {Eddic} and skaldic poetry.
e.zh: 她的文章比较了《埃达》诗歌和宫廷吟唱诗。

eddish.t: 再生草；收割后的草茬地

e.en: Cattle grazed on the {eddish} after harvest.
e.zh: 收割后，牛在再生草地上吃草。

e.en: The farmer left the {eddish} for sheep.
e.zh: 农夫把草茬地留给羊群。

e.en: She boiled an {eddo} for dinner.
e.zh: 她晚餐煮了一个芋头。

e.en: The market sells {eddo} beside yams.
e.zh: 市场在山药旁边也卖芋头。

e.en: The stew included sliced {eddoes}.
e.zh: 这道炖菜里放了切片芋头。

e.en: He planted {eddoes} behind the house.
e.zh: 他在屋后种了芋头。

e.en: The doctor checked the {edemata} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了这些水肿部位。

e.en: Severe {edemata} can signal heart problems.
e.zh: 严重水肿可能提示心脏问题。

e.en: The tissue looked {edematose} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后那块组织看起来有水肿。

e.en: An {edematose} limb may feel heavy.
e.zh: 浮肿的肢体可能会觉得沉重。

e.en: The fossil jaw was almost {edental}.
e.zh: 这块化石颌骨几乎没有牙齿。

e.en: An {edental} patient needs special dentures.
e.zh: 无齿患者需要专门的假牙。

e.en: The {edentulous} man smiled gently.
e.zh: 那位无牙的老人温和地笑了。

e.en: Dentists treat many {edentulous} patients.
e.zh: 牙医会治疗许多缺齿患者。

e.en: The lab isolated {edestan} from hemp seeds.
e.zh: 实验室从大麻籽中分离出植物种子蛋白。

e.en: Researchers measured {edestan} in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样品中的谷蛋白含量。

edestin.t: 麻仁球蛋白；植物种子蛋白

e.en: Hemp seed contains the protein {edestin}.
e.zh: 大麻籽含有麻仁球蛋白。

e.en: The study compared {edestin} with other globulins.
e.zh: 这项研究把麻仁球蛋白与其他球蛋白作了比较。

edetate.t: 依地酸盐；乙二胺四乙酸盐

e.en: The injection contained calcium {edetate}.
e.zh: 这针剂含有钙依地酸盐。

e.en: Doctors may use {edetate} for metal poisoning.
e.zh: 医生可能用依地酸盐治疗金属中毒。

e.en: The coin landed {edge-on} in the crack.
e.zh: 硬币侧着落进了裂缝里。

e.en: We saw the galaxy {edge-on}.
e.zh: 我们看到的是这个星系的侧面。

e.en: Keep every {edge-tool} sharp and clean.
e.zh: 每件刃具都要保持锋利和干净。

e.en: A chisel is a common {edge-tool}.
e.zh: 凿子是一种常见的有刃工具。

e.en: The butcher trimmed the {edgebone} away.
e.zh: 屠夫把边骨修掉了。

e.en: An {edgebone} remained in the old specimen.
e.zh: 旧标本中还留着一块边缘骨片。

e.en: The mirror seemed {edgeless} in the dark.
e.zh: 那面镜子在黑暗中看起来没有边界。

e.en: Use an {edgeless} tool on delicate surfaces.
e.zh: 在脆弱表面上要使用没有锋刃的工具。

e.en: The mason set an {edgestone} along the garden path.
e.zh: 石匠沿着花园小路安放了一块边石。

e.en: Old {edgestones} marked the line of the former road.
e.zh: 旧路缘石标出了从前道路的位置。

e.en: Turn the table {edgeways} to get it through the door.
e.zh: 把桌子侧着转过去，才能穿过门口。

e.en: She could not get a word in {edgeways}.
e.zh: 她连插一句话的机会都没有。

e.en: She was the {edgiest} person in the waiting room.
e.zh: 她是候诊室里最坐立不安的人。

e.en: That jacket is the {edgiest} piece in the collection.
e.zh: 那件夹克是整个系列中最前卫的一件。

e.en: The letter {edh} appears in Old English texts.
e.zh: 字母ð会出现在古英语文本中。

e.en: Students often confuse {edh} with thorn.
e.zh: 学生常把edh和thorn这两个古字母混淆。

e.en: The court issued an {edictal} notice to absent heirs.
e.zh: 法院向缺席继承人发布了公告通知。

e.en: The king's {edictal} power shaped public life.
e.zh: 国王发布法令的权力影响了公共生活。

e.en: The sermon had an {edificatory} purpose.
e.zh: 这篇布道带有教化人的目的。

e.en: She preferred stories with an {edificatory} moral.
e.zh: 她更喜欢带有启发性寓意的故事。

e.en: The report described the town's {edificial} heritage.
e.zh: 报告描述了这座城镇的建筑遗产。

e.en: His drawings focused on {edificial} forms rather than people.
e.zh: 他的画重点表现建筑形态，而不是人物。

e.en: The teacher saw herself as an {edifier} of young minds.
e.zh: 这位教师把自己看作启迪年轻心灵的人。

e.en: In the essay, the poet appears as a public {edifier}.
e.zh: 在这篇文章中，诗人被写成公共教化者。

e.en: The Roman {edile} supervised markets and public games.
e.zh: 古罗马市政官负责监管市场和公共竞赛。

e.en: A local {edile} promised repairs to the bridge.
e.zh: 一名地方市政官承诺修缮这座桥。

e.en: Please send me an {editable} version of the document.
e.zh: 请把这份文件的可编辑版本发给我。

e.en: The template is fully {editable} in the app.
e.zh: 这个模板可以在应用里完全编辑。

e.en: Scholars compared the manuscript with the {editioprinceps}.
e.zh: 学者们把手稿同首印本进行了比较。

e.en: The library owns a rare {editioprinceps} of the poem.
e.zh: 这家图书馆藏有那首诗的珍贵初版。

editorialise.t: 发表社论意见；加主观评论

e.en: Reporters should not {editorialise} in a news story.
e.zh: 记者不应在新闻报道中加入主观评论。

e.en: He tends to {editorialise} whenever he explains the data.
e.zh: 他解释数据时总喜欢夹带评论。

e.en: The editor removed the obvious {editorialization} from the article.
e.zh: 编辑删去了文章中明显的主观评论。

e.en: Readers complained about the {editorialization} of basic facts.
e.zh: 读者抱怨基本事实被写得带有社论色彩。

e.en: The magazine's {editress} defended the controversial cover.
e.zh: 这本杂志的女主编为有争议的封面辩护。

e.en: In older novels, an {editress} often appears in literary circles.
e.zh: 在较早的小说里，女编辑常出现在文人圈中。

e.en: The {editrix} prepared a careful edition of the letters.
e.zh: 这位女编者精心整理出版了那些书信。

e.en: Critics mocked the term {editrix} as old-fashioned.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑editrix这个词已经过时。

e.en: The inscription may refer to an {Edomite} ruler.
e.zh: 这段铭文可能提到了一位以东统治者。

e.en: The scholar studied {Edomite} pottery from the region.
e.zh: 这位学者研究了该地区出土的以东陶器。

e.en: The study measured children's {educability} rather than their current grades.
e.zh: 这项研究衡量的是儿童的可教育性，而不是他们目前的成绩。

e.en: Teachers should not confuse disability with low {educability}.
e.zh: 教师不应把残障误认为可培养性低。

e.en: Each {educant} was asked to keep a learning journal.
e.zh: 每位受教育者都被要求写学习日志。

e.en: The old report described the pupil as an active {educant}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这名学生描述为积极的学习者。

e.en: The program treats every {educatee} as a partner in learning.
e.zh: 这个项目把每个受教育者都视为学习中的伙伴。

e.en: An {educatee} may also teach others through discussion.
e.zh: 受教育者也可以通过讨论来教导他人。

e.en: The policy memo was full of {educationese} and vague promises.
e.zh: 这份政策备忘录满是教育界行话和含糊承诺。

e.en: Parents wanted plain advice, not more {educationese}.
e.zh: 家长想要的是明白的建议，而不是更多教育套话。

e.en: His speech drifted into {educationism}, as if schools could solve every problem.
e.zh: 他的演讲滑向了教育至上观，仿佛学校能解决所有问题。

e.en: Critics said the reform was driven by narrow {educationism}.
e.zh: 批评者说，这项改革受狭隘的教育主义驱动。

educatory.t: 教育性的；有教育作用的

e.en: The museum designed an {educatory} tour for young visitors.
e.zh: 博物馆为年轻参观者设计了一条有教育作用的参观路线。

e.en: Punishment alone is rarely {educatory}.
e.zh: 单靠惩罚很少具有教育意义。

e.en: The psychologist argued that the child was fully {educible}.
e.zh: 心理学家认为这个孩子完全可以接受教育。

e.en: Certain habits are {educible} through patient practice.
e.zh: 某些习惯可以通过耐心练习培养出来。

e.en: The app promises {educreation} through puzzles and stories.
e.zh: 这款应用承诺通过谜题和故事实现寓教于乐。

e.en: Good {educreation} still needs clear learning goals.
e.zh: 好的教育娱乐化仍然需要明确的学习目标。

e.en: The chemist collected the {educt} from the reaction vessel.
e.zh: 化学家从反应容器中收集了引出物。

e.en: For Peirce, an {educt} could be drawn from signs and relations.
e.zh: 在皮尔斯那里，某种推断物可以从符号和关系中得出。

e.en: The lesson encouraged the {eduction} of ideas from experience.
e.zh: 这堂课鼓励从经验中引出想法。

e.en: The philosopher discussed the {eduction} of conclusions from signs.
e.zh: 这位哲学家讨论了如何从符号中推断结论。

e.en: The teacher used an {eductive} method instead of direct instruction.
e.zh: 老师采用引导式方法，而不是直接讲授。

e.en: His argument relied on an {eductive} reading of the evidence.
e.zh: 他的论证依赖对证据的推论性解读。

e.en: Honey served as a natural {edulcorant} in the medicine.
e.zh: 蜂蜜在这种药里充当天然甜味剂。

e.en: The editor used humor as an {edulcorant} for harsh criticism.
e.zh: 编辑用幽默来缓和尖锐的批评。

e.en: They used syrup to {edulcorate} the bitter tonic.
e.zh: 他们用糖浆给苦味补药增甜。

e.en: The spokesperson tried to {edulcorate} the bad news.
e.zh: 发言人试图把坏消息说得缓和一些。

e.en: The {edulcorated} mixture was easier for children to swallow.
e.zh: 调甜后的混合物更容易让儿童吞服。

e.en: The report offered an {edulcorated} version of the scandal.
e.zh: 这份报告给出了对丑闻经过粉饰的版本。

e.en: A little sugar {edulcorates} the herbal drink.
e.zh: 一点糖能让这杯草本饮料变甜。

e.en: Polite language {edulcorates} the force of his refusal.
e.zh: 礼貌用语缓和了他拒绝时的强硬感。

e.en: She was {edulcorating} the medicine with fruit syrup.
e.zh: 她正用水果糖浆给药增甜。

e.en: The minister kept {edulcorating} the facts during the interview.
e.zh: 部长在采访中不断淡化事实。

e.en: The pharmacist added an {edulcorative} ingredient to the mixture.
e.zh: 药剂师在混合物中加入了一种增甜成分。

e.en: Her {edulcorative} phrasing made the criticism sound gentle.
e.zh: 她缓和性的措辞让批评听起来温和许多。

edwardine.t: 爱德华式的；爱德华时代的

e.en: The room had an {Edwardine} fireplace and tall windows.
e.zh: 这个房间有爱德华式壁炉和高大的窗户。

e.en: Her novel captures an {Edwardine} sense of social restraint.
e.zh: 她的小说捕捉到了爱德华时代那种社会拘谨感。

e.en: {Eek}, there is a spider in the sink!
e.zh: 呀，水槽里有只蜘蛛！

e.en: She typed {eek} when she saw the huge bill.
e.zh: 她看到那张高额账单时打出了“呀”。

e.en: The fisherman pulled an {eel-pout} from the cold water.
e.zh: 渔夫从冷水里钓上来一条鳕鳚。

e.en: An {eel-pout} can look more like a small cod than an eel.
e.zh: 鳕鳚看起来更像小鳕鱼，而不像鳗鱼。

e.en: The old charter mentioned {eelfare} owed to the lord.
e.zh: 那份旧特许状提到要向领主缴纳鳗鱼税。

e.en: Historians found records of {eelfare} along the river.
e.zh: 历史学家发现了河边捕鳗通行权的记录。

e.en: The creature had an {eellike} body and tiny fins.
e.zh: 这种生物身体像鳗鱼，还有细小的鳍。

e.en: His {eellike} movements helped him slip through the crowd.
e.zh: 他像鳗鱼般灵活地穿过人群。

e.en: They lowered an {eelpot} beside the muddy bank.
e.zh: 他们在泥泞河岸旁放下一个捕鳗笼。

e.en: The old {eelpot} was woven from willow branches.
e.zh: 那个旧鳗鱼篓是用柳枝编成的。

e.en: An {eelpout} hides among rocks on the seabed.
e.zh: 鳕鳚会躲在海底的岩石间。

e.en: The guide identified the fish as an {eelpout}.
e.zh: 向导认出那条鱼是鳕鳚。

e.en: He carried an {eelspear} on winter fishing trips.
e.zh: 他冬天去捕鱼时带着一把叉鳗矛。

e.en: The museum displayed a rusty {eelspear} from the marshes.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一把来自沼泽地的生锈捕鳗叉。

e.en: The farmer blamed {eelworm} for the damaged potato crop.
e.zh: 农民认为马铃薯受损是线虫造成的。

e.en: Gardeners can reduce {eelworm} by rotating their crops.
e.zh: 园丁可以通过轮作来减少线虫。

e.en: The fish felt {eely} in my wet hands.
e.zh: 那条鱼在我湿手里摸起来滑得像鳗鱼。

e.en: He gave an {eely} answer and avoided the real issue.
e.zh: 他的回答滑头，避开了真正的问题。

e.en: Her grief was barely {effable} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，她的悲痛几乎难以言表。

e.en: The poet searched for an {effable} form of wonder.
e.zh: 诗人寻找一种可以说出口的惊奇之感。

e.en: The marks were {effaceable} with a damp cloth.
e.zh: 这些痕迹用湿布就能擦掉。

e.en: Some memories are not easily {effaceable}.
e.zh: 有些记忆并不容易抹去。

e.en: The typo {effciency} should be corrected before printing.
e.zh: 印刷前应把拼错的“effciency”改正。

e.en: He wrote {effciency} in his notes by mistake.
e.zh: 他在笔记里误写成了“effciency”。

e.en: The sign said {effcient}, but the spelling was wrong.
e.zh: 牌子上写着“effcient”，但拼写错了。

e.en: She meant to write {effcient} as efficient.
e.zh: 她本来想把“effcient”写成 efficient。

e.en: The reform was {effectible} only with broad public support.
e.zh: 这项改革只有在公众广泛支持下才可实现。

e.en: Lawyers debated whether the promise was legally {effectible}.
e.zh: 律师们争论这个承诺在法律上是否可执行。

e.en: The {effection} of the plan took several months.
e.zh: 这个计划的实现花了好几个月。

e.en: They studied the {effection} of change through small acts.
e.zh: 他们研究变化如何通过小行动得以造成。

e.en: The court questioned the {effectivity} of the new rule.
e.zh: 法院质疑这项新规则的效力。

e.en: Managers measured the {effectivity} of the training program.
e.zh: 管理者评估了培训项目的有效性。

e.en: The {effectuation} of the agreement required both signatures.
e.zh: 该协议的生效需要双方签字。

e.en: She focused on the practical {effectuation} of the policy.
e.zh: 她关注这项政策的实际落实。

e.en: The critic used {effemination} as an outdated insult.
e.zh: 那位评论家把“女性化”当作过时的侮辱用语。

e.en: The essay discusses the supposed {effemination} of court life.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论宫廷生活所谓的柔弱化。

e.en: They feared luxury would {effeminize} the soldiers.
e.zh: 他们担心奢侈生活会使士兵变得柔弱。

e.en: Modern writers rarely use {effeminize} without irony.
e.zh: 现代作家很少不带讽刺地使用“使女性化”这个词。

e.en: Neuroscientists measured motor {efference} during the task.
e.zh: 神经科学家测量了任务中的运动传出冲动。

e.en: The theory links {efference} to the sense of agency.
e.zh: 该理论把传出作用与主体感联系起来。

efferentation.t: 传出神经支配；离心传导

e.en: The study measured {efferentation} in damaged nerves.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了受损神经中的传出神经支配。

e.en: Motor control depends on accurate {efferentation}.
e.zh: 运动控制依赖准确的离心神经传导。

e.en: The soda lost its {effervescency} overnight.
e.zh: 这瓶汽水一夜之间失去了起泡性。

e.en: Her {effervescency} lifted the whole room.
e.zh: 她的活泼劲儿让整个房间都明亮起来。

e.en: The powder is {effervescible} in warm water.
e.zh: 这种粉末在温水中会起泡。

e.en: His {effervescible} mood spread quickly.
e.zh: 他那种容易兴奋的情绪很快感染了大家。

e.en: An {effervescive} tablet dissolved in the glass.
e.zh: 一片起泡片在杯中溶解了。

e.en: The band gave an {effervescive} performance.
e.zh: 乐队献上了一场欢腾活跃的演出。

e.en: Doctors questioned the drug's {efficacity}.
e.zh: 医生们质疑这种药的功效。

e.en: The policy's {efficacity} remains uncertain.
e.zh: 这项政策的效力仍不确定。

e.en: The old remedy proved surprisingly {efficatious}.
e.zh: 这个老偏方出人意料地有效。

e.en: They sought a more {efficatious} treatment.
e.zh: 他们寻求一种更有功效的治疗方法。

e.en: The museum displayed an {effigial} mask.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件肖像面具。

e.en: His {effigial} stillness unsettled the guards.
e.zh: 他雕像般的静止让守卫感到不安。

e.en: The sculptor tried to {effigurate} the saint.
e.zh: 雕塑家试图塑造出那位圣人的形象。

e.en: The poem {effigurates} grief as winter.
e.zh: 这首诗把悲伤描绘成冬天。

effloresce.t: 开花；繁荣发展；风化成粉

e.en: The cactus will {effloresce} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后仙人掌会开花。

e.en: Medieval towns began to {effloresce} through trade.
e.zh: 中世纪城镇开始因贸易而繁荣发展。

e.en: The wall salt had {effloresced} in white patches.
e.zh: 墙里的盐分已经风化成一块块白斑。

e.en: Her talent {effloresced} during college.
e.zh: 她的才华在大学期间充分绽放。

e.en: We walked past {efflorescent} shrubs in spring.
e.zh: 春天我们走过正在开花的灌木丛。

e.en: The brick showed {efflorescent} mineral deposits.
e.zh: 砖面显出风化析出的矿物沉积。

e.en: The plant {effloresces} only in strong sun.
e.zh: 这种植物只有在强烈阳光下才开花。

e.en: Salt {effloresces} on the damp plaster.
e.zh: 盐分会在潮湿的灰泥上风化析出。

e.en: The meadow was {efflorescing} after heavy rain.
e.zh: 大雨过后，草地正在开花。

e.en: A new culture was {efflorescing} in the city.
e.zh: 一种新文化正在这座城市中繁盛起来。

e.en: The pipe allowed the {effluence} of waste water.
e.zh: 这根管道让废水流出。

e.en: A warm {effluence} rose from the vents.
e.zh: 一股暖流从通风口散发出来。

e.en: An {effluvial} smell filled the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里充满了一股臭气。

e.en: The report described {effluvial} pollution near factories.
e.zh: 报告描述了工厂附近由排出物造成的污染。

e.en: Spring brought a sudden {efforescence} of color.
e.zh: 春天带来了突然绽放的色彩。

e.en: The wall showed {efforescence} after the leak.
e.zh: 漏水后墙面出现了风化析出的痕迹。

e.en: The moon seemed to {effulge} above the sea.
e.zh: 月亮仿佛在海面上灿烂发光。

e.en: Her confidence began to {effulge} on stage.
e.zh: 她的自信开始在舞台上闪耀出来。

e.en: The sunset {effulged} across the clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳在云层间灿烂辉耀。

e.en: Joy {effulged} from his face.
e.zh: 喜悦从他的脸上闪耀出来。

e.en: The temple stood {effulging} in morning light.
e.zh: 寺庙伫立在晨光中熠熠发亮。

e.en: Her smile was {effulging} with relief.
e.zh: 她的笑容因释然而明亮起来。

e.en: The vessel began to {effund} dark liquid.
e.zh: 容器开始流出深色液体。

e.en: The speech seemed to {effund} pure anger.
e.zh: 那番演讲似乎倾泻出纯粹的愤怒。

e.en: The cut flowers {effuse} a faint scent.
e.zh: 剪下的花散发出淡淡香气。

e.en: He began to {effuse} gratitude after the rescue.
e.zh: 获救后他开始倾吐感激之情。

e.en: Blood had {effused} into the tissue.
e.zh: 血液已经渗流到组织中。

e.en: She {effused} thanks to every volunteer.
e.zh: 她向每一位志愿者热情致谢。

e.en: The valve acted as an {effuser} of steam.
e.zh: 这个阀门起到释放蒸汽的装置作用。

e.en: He was an endless {effuser} of compliments.
e.zh: 他是个总把赞美说个不停的人。

e.en: The cut stem {effuses} a sticky white sap.
e.zh: 被切开的茎会流出黏稠的白色汁液。

e.en: Her letter {effuses} warmth and gratitude.
e.zh: 她的信中流露出温暖和感激之情。

e.en: The wound was {effusing} blood slowly.
e.zh: 伤口正慢慢渗出血来。

e.en: He stood there, {effusing} confidence before the crowd.
e.zh: 他站在那里，在众人面前流露出自信。

e.en: An {eft} slipped beneath the wet leaves.
e.zh: 一只幼年蝾螈滑进湿叶下面。

e.en: The child mistook the tiny {eft} for a lizard.
e.zh: 孩子把那只小水螈误认成了蜥蜴。

e.en: The storm ended, and {eftsoon} the stars appeared.
e.zh: 暴风雨停了，此后不久星星便出现了。

e.en: He promised help, and {eftsoon} sent money.
e.zh: 他答应帮忙，随后就寄来了钱。

e.en: The bell rang, and {eftsoons} the hall emptied.
e.zh: 铃声响起，不久大厅就空了。

e.en: She spoke softly, and {eftsoons} fell silent.
e.zh: 她轻声说了几句，随后便沉默下来。

e.en: The manifesto called for liberty and {egality}.
e.zh: 这份宣言呼吁自由和平等。

e.en: Their ideal of {egality} challenged inherited privilege.
e.zh: 他们的平等理念挑战了世袭特权。

e.en: The sudden scream did {egast} the guests.
e.zh: 突如其来的尖叫确实吓坏了客人。

e.en: No warning could {egast} her steady mind.
e.zh: 任何警告都无法惊动她沉稳的心。
