e.en: Researchers examined the {elutriated} cell fraction under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下检查了经淘洗分离的细胞部分。

e.en: The team is {elutriating} soil to remove fine dust.
e.zh: 团队正在淘洗土壤，以去除细小尘粒。

e.en: An {elutriating} device can separate cells by size.
e.zh: 淘洗分选装置可以按大小分离细胞。

e.en: {Elutriation} separated the clay from the coarser sand.
e.zh: 淘洗分选把黏土和较粗的沙粒分开了。

e.en: Cell {elutriation} is useful when gentle separation is required.
e.zh: 需要温和分离时，细胞淘洗分选很有用。

e.en: The protein band was recovered with an {elutron}.
e.zh: 这条蛋白质带是用电洗脱装置回收的。

e.en: An {elutron} can extract molecules from a gel slice.
e.zh: 电洗脱装置可以从凝胶切片中提取分子。

e.en: The geologist described the pale {eluvial} horizon in the soil profile.
e.zh: 地质学家描述了土壤剖面中颜色较浅的淋溶层。

e.en: Gold may collect in {eluvial} deposits near weathered rock.
e.zh: 金可能聚集在风化岩附近的残积矿床中。

e.en: Rainwater can {eluviate} minerals from the upper soil layer.
e.zh: 雨水会把上层土壤中的矿物淋洗出去。

e.en: The horizon began to {eluviate} as acids moved downward.
e.zh: 随着酸性物质向下移动，该土层开始发生淋溶。

e.en: The {eluviated} layer looked lighter than the soil below it.
e.zh: 被淋溶的土层看起来比下面的土壤更浅。

e.en: Clay had been removed from the {eluviated} horizon.
e.zh: 黏土已经从这个淋溶层中被带走。

e.en: The {eluviating} soil lost iron during years of heavy rain.
e.zh: 这片正在淋溶的土壤在多年暴雨中流失了铁。

e.en: Acidic water was {eluviating} clay from the upper horizon.
e.zh: 酸性水正在把上层土壤中的黏土淋洗出来。

e.en: {Eluviation} removed clay and iron from the surface layer.
e.zh: 淋溶作用把表层中的黏土和铁带走了。

e.en: Strong {eluviation} often creates a pale soil horizon.
e.zh: 强烈的淋溶作用常会形成浅色土层。

e.en: The miners sampled the {eluvium} above the bedrock.
e.zh: 矿工采样了基岩上方的残积层。

e.en: Coarse {eluvium} covered the slope after long weathering.
e.zh: 长期风化后，粗粒残积物覆盖了山坡。

e.en: The quarry exposed a narrow {elvan} dike.
e.zh: 采石场露出了一条狭窄的英安质岩脉。

e.en: Cornish miners used {elvan} for a hard pale rock.
e.zh: 康沃尔矿工用elvan指一种坚硬的浅色岩石。

e.en: The specimen was identified as {elvanite} from an old Cornish mine.
e.zh: 这件标本被鉴定为来自康沃尔老矿的英安岩。

e.en: Veins of {elvanite} cut through the darker country rock.
e.zh: 英安岩脉穿过了较暗的围岩。

e.en: The river was closed to {elver} fishing in spring.
e.zh: 春季这条河禁止捕捞鳗苗。

e.en: Each tiny {elver} had traveled far from the sea.
e.zh: 每条小小的幼鳗都从海里跋涉了很远。

e.en: The botanist identified the leaf as {emarginate} at the tip.
e.zh: 植物学家认出这片叶子的尖端有缺刻。

e.en: An {emarginate} petal has a small notch along its edge.
e.zh: 凹缘花瓣的边上有一个小缺口。

e.en: The specimen had {emarginated} leaves and pale flowers.
e.zh: 这个标本有缺刻叶和浅色花。

e.en: She drew the {emarginated} margin of the shell carefully.
e.zh: 她仔细画出贝壳那道带凹缺的边缘。

e.en: The leaf ends {emarginately} rather than in a sharp point.
e.zh: 这片叶子的末端呈凹缺状，而不是尖尖的。

e.en: The petals are cut {emarginately} along the upper edge.
e.zh: 这些花瓣的上缘被切成凹缺状。

e.en: The {emargination} of the leaf helped confirm the species.
e.zh: 叶片边缘的缺刻帮助确认了这个物种。

e.en: A slight {emargination} appeared at the end of each petal.
e.zh: 每片花瓣末端都出现了轻微的凹缺。

emasculative.t: 削弱男子气概的；去势的

e.en: He rejected the {emasculative} tone of the old advertisement.
e.zh: 他反感那则旧广告中削弱男子气概的语气。

e.en: The procedure was described as {emasculative} in the medical notes.
e.zh: 病历中把这项手术描述为去势性的。

e.en: The farmer cleaned the {emasculator} before using it.
e.zh: 农夫在使用阉割钳前把它清洗干净。

e.en: Critics called the policy an {emasculator} of local authority.
e.zh: 批评者称这项政策削弱了地方权力。

e.en: The vet prepared an {emasculatory} instrument for the operation.
e.zh: 兽医为手术准备了一件去势器械。

e.en: They saw the reform as {emasculatory} to the old council.
e.zh: 他们认为这项改革削弱了旧议会的权力。

e.en: The spring thaw caused an {embacle} near the bridge.
e.zh: 春季解冻在桥附近造成了河冰阻塞。

e.en: Villagers feared the {embacle} would flood the lower fields.
e.zh: 村民担心冰坝会淹没低处的田地。

e.en: Workers {embale} the cotton before it leaves the warehouse.
e.zh: 工人们在棉花离开仓库前把它打成包。

e.en: They had to {embale} the cloth tightly for shipping.
e.zh: 他们必须把布料紧紧打包以便运输。

e.en: Engineers planned to {embank} the river before the rains.
e.zh: 工程师计划在雨季前给这条河筑堤。

e.en: They will {embank} the road to protect it from floods.
e.zh: 他们将给道路修筑堤岸，以防洪水冲毁。

e.en: The {embanked} canal runs behind the village.
e.zh: 那条筑有堤岸的运河从村后流过。

e.en: They {embanked} the low road after repeated flooding.
e.zh: 道路屡次被淹后，他们给低洼路段筑了堤。

e.en: The crew spent two weeks {embanking} the river.
e.zh: 施工队花了两周时间给这条河筑堤。

e.en: Careful {embanking} protected the farms from winter floods.
e.zh: 细致的堤岸工程保护了农田免受冬季洪水侵袭。

e.en: The city {embanks} the stream every few years.
e.zh: 这座城市每隔几年就给这条溪流加固筑堤。

e.en: A raised wall {embanks} the railway through the marsh.
e.zh: 一道高墙把穿过沼泽的铁路围护起来。

e.en: The fallen gate seemed to {embar} our passage.
e.zh: 倒下的大门似乎挡住了我们的通路。

e.en: Old laws could {embar} trade between the towns.
e.zh: 旧法律可能会妨碍这些城镇之间的贸易。

e.en: His spelling mistake caused real {embarassment} in the meeting.
e.zh: 他的拼写错误在会议上造成了真正的尴尬。

e.en: She laughed to hide her {embarassment} after the slip.
e.zh: 失言之后，她用笑声掩饰自己的窘迫。

e.en: We waited at the {embarcadero} for the ferry.
e.zh: 我们在码头等渡船。

e.en: Fishermen unloaded baskets of shrimp beside the {embarcadero}.
e.zh: 渔民们在登船处旁卸下一筐筐虾。

e.en: The {embarcation} of troops began before dawn.
e.zh: 部队的登船在黎明前开始。

e.en: Several small {embarcations} moved slowly across the bay.
e.zh: 几艘小船缓慢地驶过海湾。

e.en: The passengers delayed their {embarkment} until the storm passed.
e.zh: 乘客们推迟登船，直到暴风雨过去。

e.en: Her {embarkment} for the long voyage was carefully recorded.
e.zh: 她启程远航的登船过程被仔细记录下来。

e.en: His sudden question seemed to {embarras} the witness.
e.zh: 他突如其来的问题似乎让证人很窘迫。

e.en: Heavy debts can {embarras} a small business for years.
e.zh: 沉重债务可能多年阻碍一家小企业发展。

embarrassable.t: 容易尴尬的；可使困窘的

e.en: He is surprisingly {embarrassable} for such a confident speaker.
e.zh: 作为这么自信的演讲者，他却出奇地容易尴尬。

e.en: The topic was too {embarrassable} to discuss at dinner.
e.zh: 这个话题太容易让人难堪，不适合在晚餐时讨论。

e.en: The road was {embarred} by a fallen tree.
e.zh: 道路被一棵倒下的树挡住了。

e.en: His claim was {embarred} by an earlier agreement.
e.zh: 他的主张受到先前协议的限制。

e.en: The critic saw the change as an {embasement} of public taste.
e.zh: 批评家认为这种变化是在降低公众品味。

e.en: Currency {embasement} weakened trust in the ruler.
e.zh: 货币贬值削弱了人们对统治者的信任。

e.en: The king sent an {embassador} to negotiate peace.
e.zh: 国王派出一名使节去谈判和平。

e.en: In older texts, {embassador} often means ambassador.
e.zh: 在较古老的文本中，embassador常指大使。

e.en: The queen received the {embassage} in the great hall.
e.zh: 女王在大厅接见了使节团。

e.en: His {embassage} to the northern court lasted three months.
e.zh: 他出使北方宫廷的使命持续了三个月。

e.en: Soft light seemed to {embathe} the quiet room.
e.zh: 柔和的光仿佛笼罩着安静的房间。

e.en: She would {embathe} the cloth in warm water.
e.zh: 她会把布料浸在温水里。

emblemize.t: 使成为象征；用徽章表示

e.en: The mural tries to {emblemize} the city's resilience.
e.zh: 这幅壁画试图象征这座城市的韧性。

e.en: Writers often {emblemize} justice with balanced scales.
e.zh: 作家常用天平来象征正义。

emblemized.t: 被象征化；用徽章表现的

e.en: The dove {emblemized} peace in the old poster.
e.zh: 那张旧海报里的鸽子象征着和平。

e.en: Her family crest was {emblemized} on the gate.
e.zh: 她家的纹章被刻在大门上作为标志。

e.en: The designer is {emblemizing} loyalty with a simple knot.
e.zh: 设计师正用一个简单的结来象征忠诚。

e.en: His speech kept {emblemizing} the farm as national virtue.
e.zh: 他的演讲不断把农场塑造成民族美德的象征。

e.en: She was seen as an {embodier} of quiet courage.
e.zh: 她被视为沉静勇气的体现者。

e.en: The actor became an {embodier} of the modern antihero.
e.zh: 这位演员成了现代反英雄形象的具体代表。

e.en: Heavy rain can {embog} trucks on this road.
e.zh: 大雨会让卡车陷在这条路的泥沼里。

e.en: The committee managed to {embog} the proposal in procedure.
e.zh: 委员会设法让这项提案陷入程序泥潭。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {embolectomy} to restore blood flow.
e.zh: 外科医生实施栓子切除术以恢复血流。

e.en: After the {embolectomy}, his leg pain eased quickly.
e.zh: 栓子切除术后，他的腿痛很快缓解了。

e.en: Tiny {emboli} can block vessels in the lung.
e.zh: 微小栓子可能堵塞肺部血管。

e.en: The scan showed several {emboli} near the artery.
e.zh: 扫描显示动脉附近有几个栓子。

embolic.t: 栓塞性的；由栓子引起的

e.en: Doctors suspected an {embolic} stroke after the sudden weakness.
e.zh: 突发无力后，医生怀疑是栓塞性中风。

e.en: The report described an {embolic} blockage in the artery.
e.zh: 报告描述了动脉内的栓塞性堵塞。

e.en: The patient had {embolisation} to shrink the tumor's blood supply.
e.zh: 病人接受栓塞治疗以减少肿瘤供血。

e.en: Accidental {embolisation} may damage nearby healthy tissue.
e.zh: 意外栓塞可能损伤附近的健康组织。

e.en: An {embolismic} month kept the lunar calendar aligned.
e.zh: 一个闰月使阴历与季节保持一致。

e.en: The scholar studied {embolismic} cycles in ancient calendars.
e.zh: 这位学者研究古代历法中的置闰周期。

e.en: The manuscript mentions an {embolismical} adjustment to the year.
e.zh: 手稿提到对年份作置闰调整。

e.en: Priests calculated {embolismical} months for ritual dates.
e.zh: 祭司为仪式日期计算闰月。

e.en: The radiologist planned to {embolize} the bleeding vessel.
e.zh: 放射科医生计划对出血血管施行栓塞。

e.en: A clot can {embolize} and travel to the brain.
e.zh: 血块可能脱落成栓子并移行到脑部。

e.en: The architect described the porch as an {embolon} in the facade.
e.zh: 建筑师把门廊称为立面中的嵌入结构。

e.en: In old terminology, an {embolon} could mean an inserted piece.
e.zh: 在旧术语中，embolon可指插入的一块东西。

e.en: An {embolus} lodged in a narrow artery.
e.zh: 一个栓子卡在狭窄的动脉里。

e.en: The clot became an {embolus} after it broke loose.
e.zh: 血块脱落后变成了栓子。

e.en: The lecture explained {emboly} during early development.
e.zh: 讲座解释了早期发育中的胚胎内陷。

e.en: Older writers used {emboly} for a kind of insertion.
e.zh: 早期作者用emboly表示一种插入。

e.en: His {embonpoint} gave him a genial, prosperous look.
e.zh: 他微胖的体态让他显得和善又富足。

e.en: The portrait gently flatters her {embonpoint}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像温和地美化了她丰满的身形。

e.en: Dark trees {emborder} the narrow path.
e.zh: 深色树木围出了这条狭窄小路的边界。

e.en: She used gold thread to {emborder} the cloth.
e.zh: 她用金线给布料镶边。

e.en: The cottage seemed to {embosk} itself among the pines.
e.zh: 那间小屋仿佛隐入松林之中。

e.en: Poets liked to {embosk} lovers in shaded groves.
e.zh: 诗人喜欢把恋人安置在幽暗树丛里。

embossable.t: 可压花的；可浮雕加工的

e.en: This thick paper is {embossable} with a simple hand press.
e.zh: 这种厚纸可用简单手压机压出浮雕花纹。

e.en: The factory tests whether the leather is {embossable}.
e.zh: 工厂会测试这种皮革是否适合压花。

e.en: The panel has an {embossed-groove} pattern around the edge.
e.zh: 面板边缘有一圈压凸沟槽图案。

e.en: Dust collected inside each {embossed-groove} line.
e.zh: 灰尘积在每一道浮雕凹槽线里。

e.en: The lid carried a delicate floral {embossment}.
e.zh: 盖子上有精致的花卉浮雕装饰。

e.en: A raised {embossment} made the seal easy to feel.
e.zh: 凸起的压印让这枚印章摸起来很明显。

e.en: The old book had gold {embossments} on its cover.
e.zh: 那本旧书封面上有金色压花图案。

e.en: Several {embossments} decorated the metal shield.
e.zh: 几处浮雕装饰点缀着那面金属盾牌。

e.en: Critics saw {embourgeoisement} in the party's new manners.
e.zh: 批评者从该党的新作风中看到了资产阶级化。

e.en: The neighborhood's {embourgeoisement} changed its shops and rents.
e.zh: 这个街区的中产化改变了店铺和租金。

e.en: The novel mocks the family's slow {embourgeoisification}.
e.zh: 小说嘲讽了这个家庭缓慢的中产化过程。

e.en: Urban renewal brought {embourgeoisification} to the old district.
e.zh: 城市更新使老城区逐渐中产化。

e.en: The mason tried to {embow} the doorway gracefully.
e.zh: 石匠试图把门口砌成优雅的拱形。

e.en: Wind seemed to {embow} the sail outward.
e.zh: 风似乎把帆向外吹成弓形。

e.en: The cliffs {embay} a quiet strip of water.
e.zh: 峭壁围出一片安静的水域。

e.en: A curve in the coast can {embay} the harbor.
e.zh: 海岸的弯曲处会形成港湾。

e.en: The village stood beside an {embayed} beach.
e.zh: 村庄坐落在一片湾状海滩旁。

e.en: The boat rested in an {embayed} stretch of sea.
e.zh: 小船停在一段被海岸围住的海面上。

e.en: The headlands were {embaying} the calm water.
e.zh: 岬角正把平静的水面围成海湾。

e.en: Maps show the coast {embaying} near the town.
e.zh: 地图显示城镇附近的海岸呈湾状弯入。

e.en: A rocky arm {embays} the fishing port.
e.zh: 一条岩石岬臂围住了渔港。

e.en: The shoreline {embays} several small beaches.
e.zh: 这条海岸线围成了几处小海滩。

e.en: The engineer checked the bolt {embedment} depth.
e.zh: 工程师检查了螺栓的埋入深度。

e.en: Proper {embedment} keeps the anchor secure.
e.zh: 适当的嵌入能让锚固件保持牢靠。

embelin.t: 恩贝林，一种植物化合物

e.en: Researchers tested {embelin} against cultured cells.
e.zh: 研究人员用恩贝林测试培养细胞。

e.en: The extract contains small amounts of {embelin}.
e.zh: 这种提取物含有少量恩贝林。

e.en: An {embergoose} landed near the marsh.
e.zh: 一只黑雁落在沼泽附近。

e.en: Old bird books call the brent goose an {embergoose}.
e.zh: 旧鸟类书把布伦特雁称作黑雁。

e.en: Years of unfair treatment caused deep {embitterment}.
e.zh: 多年的不公待遇造成了深深的怨恨。

e.en: The dispute led to the {embitterment} of both families.
e.zh: 这场纠纷让两家人的关系变得充满怨气。

e.en: The sunset seemed to {emblaze} the windows.
e.zh: 夕阳仿佛把窗户照得通红发亮。

e.en: They planned to {emblaze} the hall with banners.
e.zh: 他们打算用旗帜把大厅装点得鲜明夺目。

e.en: The tower was {emblazed} by the morning sun.
e.zh: 塔楼被晨光照得明亮耀眼。

e.en: His shield was {emblazed} with a golden lion.
e.zh: 他的盾牌上饰有一头金狮。

e.en: Torches were {emblazing} the narrow passage.
e.zh: 火把正照亮那条狭窄通道。

e.en: The artist was {emblazing} the border with red paint.
e.zh: 画家正用红漆把边框装饰得醒目。

e.en: The manuscript showed careful {emblazonment} on every page.
e.zh: 这份手稿每页都有精细的纹章装饰。

e.en: The flag's {emblazonment} made the cause unmistakable.
e.zh: 旗帜上醒目的标志让这项事业一目了然。

e.en: The hall displayed many old {emblazonries}.
e.zh: 大厅里陈列着许多古老的纹章装饰。

e.en: Heralds studied the {emblazonries} of noble houses.
e.zh: 纹章官研究各贵族家族的纹章图饰。

e.en: The book explains medieval {emblazonry} in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细讲解了中世纪纹章艺术。

e.en: Gold {emblazonry} covered the ceremonial cloak.
e.zh: 典礼披风上布满金色华丽图饰。

e.en: The dove was an {emblematical} sign of peace.
e.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征性标志。

e.en: The painting has an {emblematical} quality rather than realism.
e.zh: 这幅画重在象征意味，而不是写实。

e.en: The crown appears {emblematically} above the motto.
e.zh: 王冠作为象征出现在格言上方。

e.en: The scene works {emblematically}, not literally.
e.zh: 这个场景是象征性地起作用，并非按字面理解。

e.en: The old spelling {emblematise} appears in British texts.
e.zh: 旧拼法 emblematise 会出现在英国文本中。

e.en: Poets may {emblematise} hope as a rising sun.
e.zh: 诗人可能用升起的太阳来象征希望。

e.en: The {emblematist} paired each image with a motto.
e.zh: 这位象征画作者为每幅图配上一句格言。

e.en: A skilled {emblematist} could read meaning in every crest.
e.zh: 熟练的徽章学者能读出每个纹章中的含义。

e.en: The broken chain can {emblematize} freedom.
e.zh: 断裂的锁链可以象征自由。

e.en: Writers often {emblematize} innocence with white flowers.
e.zh: 作家常用白花来象征纯真。

emblematized.t: 被象征；被作为标志表现

e.en: Justice was {emblematized} by a balanced scale.
e.zh: 正义由一架平衡的天平来象征。

e.en: The city {emblematized} resilience after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾之后，这座城市成了坚韧的象征。

e.en: The torch {emblematizes} knowledge in the seal.
e.zh: 印章中的火炬象征知识。

e.en: For many readers, the journey {emblematizes} moral growth.
e.zh: 对许多读者来说，这段旅程象征道德成长。

e.en: The poet was {emblematizing} grief through winter images.
e.zh: 诗人正通过冬日意象来象征悲伤。

e.en: The logo succeeds by {emblematizing} speed and precision.
e.zh: 这个标志成功地象征了速度与精准。

e.en: Her thesis focuses on Renaissance {emblematology}.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦文艺复兴时期的象征学。

e.en: Students of {emblematology} compare images and mottoes.
e.zh: 研究象征学的学生会比较图像与格言。

emblement.t: 可收获作物；租地收益作物

e.en: The tenant claimed the wheat as an {emblement}.
e.zh: 承租人声称小麦属于可收获作物。

e.en: In old law, an {emblement} protected the farmer's labor.
e.zh: 在旧法律中，可收获作物保护农民的劳动成果。

emblements.t: 可收获作物；租地收益作物

e.en: The court treated the corn as {emblements}.
e.zh: 法院把这些玉米视为可收获作物。

e.en: Old leases often mentioned {emblements} after a tenant died.
e.zh: 旧租约常提到承租人死后的可收获作物。

e.en: The old beam was {embowed} by years of pressure.
e.zh: 那根旧梁多年受压后弯成了弓形。

e.en: She stood beneath the {embowed} branches of the willow.
e.zh: 她站在柳树拱起的枝条下面。

e.en: The hunter learned how to {embowel} a deer cleanly.
e.zh: 猎人学会了怎样干净地取出鹿的内脏。

e.en: The brutal tale says the victim was {emboweled} after the battle.
e.zh: 那个残酷的故事说受害者在战后被剖腹。

emboweled.t: 被取出内脏的；被剖腹的

e.en: The fish was {emboweled} before it was salted.
e.zh: 那条鱼在腌制前已经被去掉内脏。

e.en: The chronicle describes an {emboweled} soldier on the field.
e.zh: 编年史描写了战场上一名被剖腹的士兵。

e.en: The {emboweler} worked quickly in the slaughterhouse.
e.zh: 那名取内脏的工人在屠宰场里动作很快。

e.en: In the grim legend, the {emboweler} appears as a feared executioner.
e.zh: 在那个阴森的传说中，剖腹者是令人畏惧的刽子手。

e.en: The manual explains {emboweling} large fish after cleaning the scales.
e.zh: 手册说明了刮鳞后怎样给大鱼取出内脏。

e.en: The poem refers darkly to the {emboweling} of enemies.
e.zh: 那首诗阴郁地提到对敌人的剖腹。

embowelled.t: 被取出内脏的；被剖腹的

e.en: The goose was {embowelled} and prepared for roasting.
e.zh: 那只鹅被取出内脏后准备烤制。

e.en: The old text describes a traitor {embowelled} in public.
e.zh: 那部古文献描述了一个叛徒被当众剖腹。

e.en: The butcher finished {embowelling} the carcass before dawn.
e.zh: 屠夫在黎明前完成了尸体的去内脏处理。

e.en: Medieval accounts sometimes mention {embowelling} as a punishment.
e.zh: 中世纪记载有时提到剖腹作为一种惩罚。

embower.t: 用枝叶遮蔽；把…安置在树荫中

e.en: Tall trees {embower} the quiet cottage.
e.zh: 高大的树木把那间安静的小屋遮在绿荫里。

e.en: They hoped to {embower} the garden path with roses.
e.zh: 他们希望用玫瑰把花园小径围成荫廊。

embowered.t: 被树荫环绕的；隐在绿荫中的

e.en: The chapel was {embowered} in ivy and old trees.
e.zh: 那座小教堂隐在常春藤和老树的绿荫中。

e.en: We found an {embowered} bench beside the stream.
e.zh: 我们在溪边找到一张被树荫环绕的长椅。

e.en: The vines were {embowering} the doorway by midsummer.
e.zh: 到仲夏时，藤蔓已经把门口遮成一片绿荫。

e.en: She loved the {embowering} trees around the lane.
e.zh: 她喜欢小路周围那些形成荫蔽的树木。

embowers.t: 用枝叶遮蔽；把…围在绿荫中

e.en: A ring of poplars {embowers} the farmhouse.
e.zh: 一圈白杨树把农舍围在绿荫中。

e.en: The poet says memory {embowers} childhood in soft light.
e.zh: 诗人说记忆把童年笼罩在柔和的光里。

e.en: Their {embracement} after the rescue moved everyone.
e.zh: 获救后他们相拥的情景感动了所有人。

e.en: The policy showed a cautious {embracement} of reform.
e.zh: 这项政策表现出对改革的谨慎接受。

e.en: The court punished the {embraceor} for approaching jurors secretly.
e.zh: 法院惩罚了那个秘密接触陪审员的贿买者。

e.en: An {embraceor} could corrupt a trial before it began.
e.zh: 企图贿买陪审员的人可能在审判开始前就破坏公正。

e.en: The lawyer was accused of {embracery} during the trial.
e.zh: 那名律师被指在审判期间犯有贿买陪审员罪。

e.en: Old legal books treat {embracery} as a serious offense.
e.zh: 旧法律书把贿买陪审员罪视为严重罪行。

e.en: Her {embracive} manner made visitors feel welcome.
e.zh: 她爱拥抱又热情的举止让访客感到受欢迎。

e.en: The essay argues for an {embracive} view of culture.
e.zh: 那篇文章主张一种包容性的文化观。

e.en: The judge warned that any {embracor} would face prison.
e.zh: 法官警告说，任何企图贿买陪审员者都将面临监禁。

e.en: Records name the {embracor} who tried to influence the jury.
e.zh: 记录点名了那个试图影响陪审团的贿买者。

e.en: The map showed every {embranchment} of the river.
e.zh: 地图标出了这条河的每一条支流。

e.en: The argument follows an {embranchment} of earlier theory.
e.zh: 这个论点沿用了早期理论的一个分支。

e.en: Do not {embrangle} the issue with old gossip.
e.zh: 不要用旧流言把这个问题搅得更乱。

e.en: The contract could {embrangle} the company in costly disputes.
e.zh: 这份合同可能使公司陷入代价高昂的纠纷。

e.en: The case became {embrangled} in technical objections.
e.zh: 这个案件因技术性异议而变得纠缠不清。

e.en: He gave an {embrangled} account of the accident.
e.zh: 他对事故作了一番混乱不清的叙述。

e.en: The lawsuit created an {embranglement} of claims and denials.
e.zh: 这场诉讼造成了主张和否认交织的混乱局面。

e.en: She avoided the emotional {embranglement} of the quarrel.
e.zh: 她避开了那场争吵带来的情感纠缠。

e.en: His explanation {embrangles} a simple question.
e.zh: 他的解释把一个简单问题弄得纠缠不清。

e.en: The new rule {embrangles} small firms in paperwork.
e.zh: 新规定使小公司陷入文书手续的混乱中。

e.en: They spent hours {embrangling} the plan with exceptions.
e.zh: 他们花了几个小时用各种例外把计划搅得混乱。

e.en: The debate is {embrangling} legal and moral questions.
e.zh: 这场辩论正把法律和道德问题纠缠在一起。

e.en: The captain tried to {embrave} the frightened crew.
e.zh: 船长试图让受惊的船员鼓起勇气。

e.en: Flowers were used to {embrave} the festival hall.
e.zh: 人们用鲜花装饰节日大厅，使它更漂亮。

e.en: Cold weather can {embrittle} some plastics.
e.zh: 寒冷天气会使某些塑料变脆。

e.en: Hydrogen may {embrittle} steel over time.
e.zh: 氢可能会随着时间使钢材脆化。

e.en: The {embrittled} pipe cracked under light pressure.
e.zh: 那根变脆的管子在轻微压力下裂开了。

e.en: Engineers replaced the {embrittled} bolts before testing.
e.zh: 工程师在测试前更换了被脆化的螺栓。

e.en: The botanist studied {emersed} leaves above the pond.
e.zh: 植物学家研究池塘上方露出水面的叶子。

e.en: Some aquarium plants grow better when {emersed}.
e.zh: 有些水族植物在挺水状态下长得更好。

e.en: The moon's {emersion} from the shadow was gradual.
e.zh: 月亮从阴影中逐渐露出。

e.en: Divers watched the submarine's {emersion} at dawn.
e.zh: 潜水员在黎明时看着潜艇浮出水面。

e.en: Persistent {emesis} can quickly cause dehydration.
e.zh: 持续呕吐很快会导致脱水。

e.en: The poison center advised against inducing {emesis}.
e.zh: 中毒咨询中心建议不要催吐。

emetically.t: 以催吐方式；令人作呕地

e.en: The drug acted {emetically} within minutes.
e.zh: 这种药在几分钟内就产生了催吐作用。

e.en: The scene was {emetically} graphic for many viewers.
e.zh: 对许多观众来说，这个场面逼真得令人作呕。

e.en: His paper reviewed early theories of {emeticology}.
e.zh: 他的论文回顾了早期的催吐学理论。

e.en: Modern {emeticology} overlaps with toxicology and pharmacology.
e.zh: 现代呕吐研究与毒理学和药理学有交叉。

e.en: Doctors once used {emetin} to treat amoebic infections.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用吐根碱治疗阿米巴感染。

e.en: High doses of {emetin} can damage the heart.
e.zh: 高剂量依米丁可能损伤心脏。

e.en: The label warned that {emetine} was highly toxic.
e.zh: 标签警告说吐根碱毒性很强。

e.en: Researchers measured {emetine} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了样本中的依米丁含量。

e.en: An {emeu} crossed the dusty road slowly.
e.zh: 一只鸸鹋慢慢穿过尘土飞扬的道路。

e.en: The old book spelled emu as {emeu}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把emu拼作emeu。

e.en: The nurse recorded the patient's first {emiction}.
e.zh: 护士记录了病人的第一次排尿。

e.en: Pain during {emiction} may signal infection.
e.zh: 小便时疼痛可能提示感染。

e.en: The study examined {emigrational} patterns after the war.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了战后的移民模式。

e.en: Economic pressure shaped the village's {emigrational} history.
e.zh: 经济压力塑造了这个村庄的移居史。

e.en: Every {emigrator} carried a small bundle of belongings.
e.zh: 每个移民者都带着一小包行李。

e.en: The novel follows an {emigrator} seeking work abroad.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一名移居者到国外找工作的经历。

e.en: The famine caused a large {emigratory} movement.
e.zh: 饥荒引发了大规模的迁出潮。

e.en: Their {emigratory} route led through three countries.
e.zh: 他们的移居路线经过了三个国家。

e.en: The scholar's {eminency} was recognized across Europe.
e.zh: 这位学者的显赫地位在欧洲各地得到承认。

e.en: He spoke with the calm of ecclesiastical {eminency}.
e.zh: 他说话时带着教会高位者的从容。

emiocytosis.t: 半细胞胞吐；细胞释放现象

e.en: The microscope captured {emiocytosis} in the gland cells.
e.zh: 显微镜记录了腺细胞中的半细胞胞吐现象。

e.en: Few textbooks discuss {emiocytosis} in detail.
e.zh: 很少有教科书详细讨论半细胞胞吐。

e.en: The scientist examined the tiny {embryon} under a microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下观察这个微小胚胎。

e.en: The plan existed only as an {embryon} of a larger reform.
e.zh: 这个计划还只是更大改革的早期雏形。

e.en: The lab stored {embryonated} eggs for vaccine research.
e.zh: 实验室保存含胚鸡蛋用于疫苗研究。

e.en: Only fully {embryonated} seeds were selected for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验只挑选已经形成胚胎的种子。

e.en: The tissue developed {embryonically} before becoming specialized.
e.zh: 这种组织先以胚胎方式发育，然后才分化。

e.en: The idea existed {embryonically} in his earliest notes.
e.zh: 这个想法在他最早的笔记中已有初步雏形。

e.en: A moss is an {embryophyte} with a simple body structure.
e.zh: 苔藓是一种有胚植物，结构较简单。

e.en: The lecture traced how each {embryophyte} adapted to life on land.
e.zh: 讲座讲述了各种陆生植物如何适应陆地生活。

e.en: The doctor described the {embryotic} stage of development.
e.zh: 医生描述了发育中的胚胎阶段。

e.en: Their alliance was still {embryotic} and easily broken.
e.zh: 他们的联盟仍处于萌芽状态，很容易破裂。

e.en: The old textbook described {embryotomy} as a desperate obstetric procedure.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把毁胎术描述为一种无奈的产科手术。

e.en: Modern medicine has made {embryotomy} extremely rare in practice.
e.zh: 现代医学使胚胎切开术在实际中极为罕见。

e.en: The placenta supplies {embryotroph} during early growth.
e.zh: 胎盘在早期发育中提供胚胎营养物质。

e.en: Researchers measured the {embryotroph} available inside the egg.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了卵内可用的胚胎营养物质。

e.en: The paper compared patterns of {embryotrophy} in different animals.
e.zh: 论文比较了不同动物的胚胎营养模式。

e.en: Successful pregnancy depends partly on stable {embryotrophy}.
e.zh: 成功妊娠部分依赖稳定的胚胎供养。

e.en: The historical manual mentioned {embryulcia} among difficult birth procedures.
e.zh: 这本历史手册在难产手术中提到牵引胎儿术。

e.en: Few modern doctors would encounter {embryulcia} outside old medical texts.
e.zh: 现代医生几乎只会在旧医学文献中见到牵引胎儿术。

e.en: The museum displayed an {embryulcus} used in early obstetrics.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件早期产科使用的牵胎器。

e.en: An {embryulcus} appears only in specialized historical medical discussions.
e.zh: 胎儿牵引钩只出现在专门的医学史讨论中。

e.en: The soldiers began to {embus} before sunrise.
e.zh: 士兵们在日出前开始上车。

e.en: Passengers must {embus} at the marked stop.
e.zh: 乘客必须在标明的站点上车。

e.en: The {emeer} received visitors in the palace courtyard.
e.zh: 那位埃米尔在宫殿庭院接见来访者。

e.en: Travelers described the {emeer} as both a ruler and a judge.
e.zh: 旅行者把这位穆斯林统治者描述为统治者兼法官。

e.en: The small {emeerate} controlled the desert trade route.
e.zh: 这个小酋长国控制着沙漠贸易路线。

e.en: His family ruled the {emeerate} for three generations.
e.zh: 他的家族统治这个埃米尔辖区三代。

e.en: The manuscript was damaged but still {emendable}.
e.zh: 手稿虽有损坏，但仍可校订。

e.en: Most errors in the report are {emendable} before publication.
e.zh: 报告中的多数错误在发表前都可以修正。

e.en: The editor chose to {emendate} several corrupted lines.
e.zh: 编辑决定校订几处受损的文字。

e.en: Scholars often {emendate} ancient texts with great caution.
e.zh: 学者们通常非常谨慎地修正古代文本。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {emendating} a medieval poem.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在校订一首中世纪诗歌。

e.en: The committee is {emendating} the draft before approval.
e.zh: 委员会正在批准前修正草案。

e.en: The {emendator} restored a missing phrase in the poem.
e.zh: 校订者恢复了诗中缺失的一个短语。

e.en: A careful {emendator} marks every uncertain reading.
e.zh: 细心的文本修订者会标出每处不确定读法。

e.en: The edition includes {emendatory} notes below the text.
e.zh: 这个版本在正文下方附有校订性注释。

e.en: Her {emendatory} suggestions improved the legal draft.
e.zh: 她的修正性建议改善了法律草案。

e.en: The fabric had an {emeraldine} sheen in daylight.
e.zh: 这块布在日光下带有翠绿色光泽。

e.en: Chemists discussed {emeraldine} as a form of polyaniline.
e.zh: 化学家把苯胺绿作为聚苯胺的一种形态来讨论。

e.en: Several professors {emeriti} attended the ceremony.
e.zh: 几位荣休教授出席了典礼。

e.en: The college invited its {emeriti} to advise younger faculty.
e.zh: 学院邀请荣誉退休者指导年轻教师。

e.en: The old Bible translation used {emerods} for a painful disease.
e.zh: 旧版圣经译文用emerods指一种疼痛的疾病。

e.en: Doctors today would call {emerods} hemorrhoids.
e.zh: 今天的医生会把emerods称为痔疮。

e.en: Cold weather accelerated the steel's {embrittlement}.
e.zh: 寒冷天气加速了钢材的脆化。

e.en: Hydrogen {embrittlement} can weaken metal parts.
e.zh: 氢脆会削弱金属零件的强度。

e.en: Repeated heating {embrittles} the old plastic.
e.zh: 反复加热会使旧塑料变脆。

e.en: Hydrogen sometimes {embrittles} high-strength steel.
e.zh: 氢有时会使高强度钢脆化。

e.en: The acid was {embrittling} the pipe lining.
e.zh: 这种酸正在使管道内衬变脆。

e.en: Engineers tested the {embrittling} effect of radiation.
e.zh: 工程师测试了辐射造成脆化的影响。

e.en: The trainer will {embrocate} the athlete's sore leg.
e.zh: 教练会给运动员酸痛的腿涂擦药液。

e.en: She learned to {embrocate} the bruise gently.
e.zh: 她学会了轻轻擦洗那处瘀伤。

e.en: He {embrocated} the sprain before the match.
e.zh: 他在比赛前给扭伤处涂了药液。

e.en: The horse's legs were {embrocated} after training.
e.zh: 训练后，马腿被擦上了药液。

e.en: The nurse {embrocates} the swollen joint carefully.
e.zh: 护士小心地给肿胀的关节涂擦药液。

e.en: He {embrocates} his shoulders after every race.
e.zh: 每次比赛后，他都会给肩膀擦药。

e.en: She was {embrocating} his stiff neck with oil.
e.zh: 她正用油给他僵硬的脖子涂擦。

e.en: The groom spent ten minutes {embrocating} the horse.
e.zh: 马夫花了十分钟给那匹马擦药。

e.en: The boxer smelled strongly of {embrocation}.
e.zh: 那名拳击手身上有很重的擦剂味。

e.en: She used an {embrocation} to warm the muscle.
e.zh: 她用擦剂让肌肉发热放松。

e.en: Old sports bags often smelled of {embrocations}.
e.zh: 旧运动包里常有各种擦剂的味道。

e.en: The clinic stocked several herbal {embrocations}.
e.zh: 诊所备有几种草本擦剂。

e.en: The contract dispute became a legal {embroglio}.
e.zh: 这场合同争议变成了法律上的复杂纠纷。

e.en: She avoided the political {embroglio} entirely.
e.zh: 她完全避开了那场政治混乱。

e.en: His {embroilment} in the scandal ruined his career.
e.zh: 他卷入丑闻，毁掉了自己的事业。

e.en: The novel traces her emotional {embroilment} with the family.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了她与这个家庭的情感纠葛。

e.en: Autumn rains {embrown} the fallen leaves.
e.zh: 秋雨使落叶变成褐色。

e.en: Smoke can {embrown} old kitchen walls.
e.zh: 烟会把旧厨房的墙熏成棕褐色。

e.en: The sun had {embrowned} his weathered face.
e.zh: 太阳把他饱经风霜的脸晒成了棕褐色。

e.en: An {embrowned} map lay on the table.
e.zh: 一张泛褐的地图摊在桌上。

e.en: The heat was {embrowning} the crust nicely.
e.zh: 高温正把外皮烤成漂亮的棕色。

e.en: Years of smoke caused the ceiling's slow {embrowning}.
e.zh: 多年的烟熏使天花板慢慢发褐。

e.en: The setting sun {embrowns} the dry hills.
e.zh: 落日把干燥的山丘染成褐色。

e.en: Tea sometimes {embrowns} the inside of cups.
e.zh: 茶有时会把杯子内壁染成棕色。

e.en: The old poem says warriors {embrue} their swords.
e.zh: 那首古诗说武士们让剑染上鲜血。

e.en: Rain seemed to {embrue} the dark soil.
e.zh: 雨水似乎把深色土壤浸湿了。

e.en: Cruel training can {embrute} a young soldier.
e.zh: 残酷训练会使年轻士兵变得野蛮。

e.en: The essay claims poverty may {embrute} society.
e.zh: 这篇文章认为贫困可能使社会兽性化。

e.en: The poet described an {embry} hope in spring.
e.zh: 诗人描写了春天里尚未成形的希望。

e.en: An {embry} plan slowly took shape.
e.zh: 一个初步的计划慢慢成形。

e.en: The textbook briefly defines {embryectomy}.
e.zh: 教科书简要定义了胚胎切除术。

e.en: Modern obstetrics rarely mentions {embryectomy} outside history.
e.zh: 现代产科学很少在历史语境之外提到胚胎切除术。

e.en: The doctor noted {embryocardia} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查中记录到胚胎样心音。

e.en: Older manuals describe {embryocardia} as a grave sign.
e.zh: 旧医学手册把胚胎样心音描述为严重征象。

e.en: The lecture mentioned {embryoctony} in ancient medicine.
e.zh: 讲座提到了古代医学中的毁胎术。

e.en: Few students had heard the term {embryoctony} before.
e.zh: 很少有学生以前听过毁胎术这个术语。

e.en: The lab cultured {embryogenic} plant cells.
e.zh: 实验室培养了成胚植物细胞。

e.en: Researchers studied {embryogenic} signals in early development.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了早期发育中的胚胎发生信号。

e.en: The course covers human {embryogeny} in detail.
e.zh: 这门课程详细讲授人类胚胎发生。

e.en: Plant {embryogeny} differs among species.
e.zh: 不同物种的植物胚胎发育并不相同。

e.en: Scientists grew an {embryoid} body in culture.
e.zh: 科学家在培养中长出了一个类胚体。

e.en: The cells formed {embryoid} structures after treatment.
e.zh: 处理后，这些细胞形成了胚胎样结构。

e.en: The biopsy suggested an {embryoma}.
e.zh: 活检结果提示可能是胚胎瘤。

e.en: A rare {embryoma} was discussed at the conference.
e.zh: 会议上讨论了一例罕见的胚性肿瘤。

e.en: The surgeon noted {emphraxis} in the small duct.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到小导管出现阻塞。

e.en: Untreated inflammation may cause {emphraxis} of nearby passages.
e.zh: 炎症若不治疗，可能导致附近通道堵塞。

e.en: The scan showed {emphysemic} changes in both lungs.
e.zh: 扫描显示双肺有气肿样改变。

e.en: He developed an {emphysemic} cough after years of smoking.
e.zh: 多年吸烟后，他出现了肺气肿样咳嗽。

e.en: The farm was held under {emphyteusis}.
e.zh: 这座农场是按永佃权持有的。

e.en: Roman law recognized {emphyteusis} as a lasting land right.
e.zh: 罗马法承认永佃权是一种长期土地权利。

e.en: The {emphyteuta} paid rent but improved the land.
e.zh: 这名永佃权持有人支付地租，同时改良土地。

e.en: A medieval {emphyteuta} could transfer certain rights to heirs.
e.zh: 中世纪的永佃权持有人可把某些权利传给继承人。

e.en: The old text misspelled {emphyysema} in the diagnosis.
e.zh: 旧文本在诊断中把气肿一词拼错了。

e.en: Doctors now spell {emphyysema} as emphysema.
e.zh: 医生现在把这个气肿词写作 emphysema。

e.en: Her manager was accused of {empire-building}.
e.zh: 她的经理被指责在扩张个人势力。

e.en: The documentary traces Rome's {empire-building} across Europe.
e.zh: 这部纪录片追溯罗马在欧洲的帝国扩张。

e.en: He wrote a thesis on {empirio-criticism}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于经验批判主义的论文。

e.en: Lenin attacked {empirio-criticism} in his philosophical work.
e.zh: 列宁在其哲学著作中批判了经验批判主义。

e.en: The seminar introduced {empirio-monism} as a Russian movement.
e.zh: 研讨课把经验一元论介绍为一种俄国思想运动。

e.en: Bogdanov developed {empirio-monism} from earlier positivist ideas.
e.zh: 波格丹诺夫从早期实证主义思想发展出经验一元论。

e.en: Few students had heard of {empirio-symbolism}.
e.zh: 很少有学生听说过经验象征主义。

e.en: The article links {empirio-symbolism} with debates on perception.
e.zh: 文章把经验象征主义同关于感知的争论联系起来。

e.en: His book explains {empiriocriticism} in simple terms.
e.zh: 他的书用浅显语言解释经验批判主义。

e.en: Marxist writers often rejected {empiriocriticism}.
e.zh: 马克思主义作者常常反对经验批判主义。

e.en: She compared {empiriomonism} with classical empiricism.
e.zh: 她把经验一元论同古典经验主义作了比较。

e.en: The lecture treated {empiriomonism} as a historical philosophy.
e.zh: 讲座把经验一元论视为一种历史哲学。

e.en: The essay uses {empirism} where modern writers say empiricism.
e.zh: 这篇文章使用 empirism，现代作者通常说 empiricism。

e.en: His strict {empirism} left little room for speculation.
e.zh: 他严格的经验主义几乎不给推测留下空间。

e.en: Her method was strongly {empiristic}.
e.zh: 她的方法带有强烈的经验主义色彩。

e.en: The philosopher rejected purely {empiristic} explanations of mind.
e.zh: 这位哲学家拒绝对心灵作纯经验主义解释。

e.en: Passengers will {emplane} through gate twelve.
e.zh: 乘客将从十二号登机口登机。

e.en: The crew helped the injured travelers {emplane} safely.
e.zh: 机组人员帮助受伤旅客安全登机。

e.en: The team {emplaned} before dawn.
e.zh: 队伍在黎明前登上了飞机。

e.en: All equipment was {emplaned} by midnight.
e.zh: 所有设备在午夜前都已装上飞机。

e.en: The airline {emplanes} soldiers before civilian passengers.
e.zh: 航空公司先让士兵登机，再让普通乘客登机。

e.en: She {emplanes} at noon and arrives by evening.
e.zh: 她中午登机，傍晚前抵达。

e.en: {Emplaning} began soon after the security check.
e.zh: 安检后不久便开始登机。

e.en: They delayed {emplaning} the cargo until the storm passed.
e.zh: 他们推迟把货物装上飞机，等风暴过去。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared an {emplastrum} for the wound.
e.zh: 药剂师为伤口配制了一种硬膏剂。

e.en: Old medical manuals list {emplastrum} among common plasters.
e.zh: 旧医学手册把硬膏剂列为常用膏药之一。

e.en: The satirist mocked the minister's {empleomania}.
e.zh: 讽刺作家嘲笑那位部长的嗜官癖。

e.en: His {empleomania} made every committee seat seem precious.
e.zh: 他的任职狂让每个委员会席位都显得珍贵。

e.en: The old contract called him an {employe}.
e.zh: 那份旧合同称他为雇员。

e.en: Each {employe} received a printed notice.
e.zh: 每名职员都收到了一份打印通知。

e.en: Many workers were {employless} after the mill closed.
e.zh: 工厂关闭后，许多工人失去了工作。

e.en: The charity helped {employless} youths find training.
e.zh: 慈善机构帮助失业青年寻找培训机会。

e.en: The knight wore an {emplumed} helmet.
e.zh: 骑士戴着一顶饰有羽毛的头盔。

e.en: An {emplumed} hat completed her theatrical costume.
e.zh: 一顶羽饰帽让她的戏服完整起来。

e.en: The villain planned to {empoison} the king's wine.
e.zh: 反派计划在国王的酒中下毒。

e.en: Bitterness can {empoison} even a close friendship.
e.zh: 怨恨甚至会毒害亲密的友谊。

e.en: The {empoisoned} cup was hidden in the chamber.
e.zh: 那只被下毒的杯子藏在房间里。

e.en: Their debate was {empoisoned} by old resentment.
e.zh: 他们的争论被旧怨毒化了。

e.en: The court identified the {empoisoner} after weeks of inquiry.
e.zh: 经过数周调查，法院确认了投毒者。

e.en: Jealousy was the quiet {empoisoner} of their partnership.
e.zh: 嫉妒是悄悄毒害他们合作关系的因素。

e.en: The lotion's {emollience} soothed her cracked hands.
e.zh: 这款乳液的柔润感舒缓了她干裂的双手。

e.en: His voice had an unexpected {emollience} during the apology.
e.zh: 他道歉时的声音带着出人意料的温和安抚。

e.en: She added a smiling {emoticon} to soften the message.
e.zh: 她加了一个微笑表情符号，让信息显得柔和些。

e.en: That old {emoticon} looks different from modern emoji.
e.zh: 那个老式颜文字和现代表情图标看起来不一样。

e.en: Teenagers filled the chat with {emoticons}.
e.zh: 青少年把聊天室里刷满了表情符号。

e.en: Some email clients still convert {emoticons} into images.
e.zh: 有些电子邮件客户端仍会把颜文字转换成图片。

emotionalise.t: 使情绪化；赋予感情色彩

e.en: The headline tried to {emotionalise} a technical debate.
e.zh: 这个标题试图把一场技术讨论情绪化。

e.en: She refused to {emotionalise} the policy dispute.
e.zh: 她拒绝给这场政策争议添上感情色彩。

emotionalist.t: 感情主义者；情绪化的人

e.en: Critics dismissed him as an {emotionalist} rather than a thinker.
e.zh: 批评者把他斥为感情主义者，而不是思想家。

e.en: An {emotionalist} may trust feeling over evidence.
e.zh: 情绪化的人可能更相信感受而不是证据。

e.en: The speech had an {emotionalistic} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这篇演讲从头到尾都带着感情主义的语气。

e.en: They avoided {emotionalistic} appeals in the report.
e.zh: 他们在报告中避免了情绪化的诉求。

emotionalize.t: 使情绪化；赋予感情色彩

e.en: News coverage can {emotionalize} a simple disagreement.
e.zh: 新闻报道可能会把一次简单分歧情绪化。

e.en: The director chose to {emotionalize} the final scene.
e.zh: 导演选择给最后一幕注入更强的感情色彩。

emotionalized.t: 被情绪化的；带感情色彩的

e.en: The debate became highly {emotionalized} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后，这场辩论变得高度情绪化。

e.en: Her {emotionalized} account moved the entire room.
e.zh: 她带着强烈感情色彩的叙述打动了全场。

e.zh: 这项研究测量了儿童在压力下的情绪反应性。

e.en: His poetry is known for its intense {emotivity}.
e.zh: 他的诗以强烈的感情性而闻名。

e.en: The vase had an {empaistic} band around its neck.
e.zh: 花瓶颈部有一圈浮雕式装饰。

e.zh: 艺术史家注意到盾牌上的凸起装饰纹样。

e.en: Ancient punishments could {empale} prisoners on stakes.
e.zh: 古代刑罚可能会把囚犯刺穿在木桩上。

e.zh: 他们打算用矮栅栏把花园围起来。

e.en: The banner was {empaled} on a broken spear.
e.zh: 那面旗帜被刺穿在一根断矛上。

e.en: The field was {empaled} with rough wooden posts.
e.zh: 那片田地被粗木桩围了起来。

e.en: The chronicle describes {empalement} as a brutal punishment.
e.zh: 编年史把刺穿刑描述为一种残酷惩罚。

e.en: The {empalement} of the boundary took two days.
e.zh: 用木桩围起边界花了两天时间。

e.en: The soldiers began {empaling} the captured standards.
e.zh: 士兵们开始把缴获的旗帜刺挂起来。

e.zh: 工人们正用新木桩把牧场围起来。

e.en: The music seemed to {emparadise} the quiet hall.
e.zh: 那音乐仿佛让安静的大厅变成天堂。

e.en: Love can {emparadise} even a poor room.
e.zh: 爱情能让一间贫寒的屋子也充满极乐。

e.en: The nurse listened {empathically} to his fears.
e.zh: 护士很有共情地倾听他的恐惧。

e.en: She responded {empathically} instead of offering quick advice.
e.zh: 她体恤地回应，而不是马上给建议。

e.en: Engineers inspected the aircraft's {empennage} after landing.
e.zh: 飞机降落后，工程师检查了它的尾翼结构。

e.en: Damage to the {empennage} made the jet unstable.
e.zh: 尾部结构受损使这架喷气机变得不稳定。

e.en: The paper used {emperical} where it meant empirical.
e.zh: 那篇论文把应写作 empirical 的地方误写成了 emperical。

e.en: Her editor marked {emperical} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 她的编辑把 emperical 标为拼写错误。

e.en: His {emperorship} lasted only three turbulent years.
e.zh: 他的帝位只维持了动荡的三年。

e.en: The ceremony confirmed her symbolic {emperorship}.
e.zh: 这场仪式确认了她象征性的皇帝身份。

e.en: The poet imagined a vast {empery} of light.
e.zh: 诗人想象出一个辽阔的光明帝国。

e.en: Kings fought for {empery} over the islands.
e.zh: 诸王为争夺这些岛屿的最高统治权而战。

e.en: The actor used {emphase} on the final word.
e.zh: 演员在最后一个词上加重了语气。

e.en: Old grammar books sometimes spell emphasis as {emphase}.
e.zh: 旧语法书有时把 emphasis 写作 emphase。

e.en: His answer was short but {emphatical}.
e.zh: 他的回答很短，却语气强烈。

e.en: The judge gave an {emphatical} warning to the witness.
e.zh: 法官向证人发出了措辞强烈的警告。

e.en: The sentence gains {emphaticalness} from its repetition.
e.zh: 这个句子因重复而增强了强调性。

e.zh: 她语气强烈，让拒绝的意思毫不含糊。

e.en: The screen uses an {emissive} layer to produce light.
e.zh: 这块屏幕使用发光层来产生光。

e.zh: 天文学家测量了这种气体的发射特性。

e.zh: 博物馆展出了一支早期电视史上的摄像管。

e.en: Engineers once used the {emitron} to capture live images.
e.zh: 工程师曾用这种早期摄像管采集实时图像。

e.en: The material's {emittance} changes as its surface oxidizes.
e.zh: 材料表面氧化后，它的发射率会发生变化。

e.en: Physicists calculated the beam {emittance} before the experiment.
e.zh: 物理学家在实验前计算了束流发射度。

e.en: The old prescription listed the dose in {emmagee}.
e.zh: 这张旧处方用毫克的旧称标明剂量。

e.en: A pharmacist explained that {emmagee} meant milligram.
e.zh: 药剂师解释说这个旧词表示毫克。

e.en: The artist tried to {emmarble} the plaster surface.
e.zh: 艺术家试图让石膏表面呈现大理石般的效果。

e.zh: 岁月仿佛使雕像苍白的表皮变得像大理石。

e.zh: 魔术师希望用最后一个戏法让观众惊叹。

e.en: Her courage could {emmarvel} even her harshest critics.
e.zh: 她的勇气甚至能让最苛刻的批评者惊奇。

e.en: The herb was once sold as an {emmenagogue}.
e.zh: 这种草药过去曾作为通经药出售。

e.en: Doctors warned that an {emmenagogue} could be unsafe during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生警告说，催经剂在怀孕期间可能不安全。

e.zh: 医生在病历中记录了患者月经不规律。

e.en: Older medical texts often used {emmenia} for menstrual discharge.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献常用这个词指月经流出物。

e.en: The article discussed {emmeniopathy} in nineteenth-century medical language.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了十九世纪医学语言中的月经病。

e.en: A specialist treated the recurring {emmeniopathy} with careful monitoring.
e.zh: 专科医生通过细致监测治疗这种反复出现的经期障碍。

e.en: Her dissertation examined the history of {emmenology}.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了月经学的发展史。

e.en: Modern gynecology replaced much of old {emmenology}.
e.zh: 现代妇科学取代了许多旧式经期研究内容。

e.en: The bakery uses {emmer} flour for its rustic loaves.
e.zh: 这家面包店用二粒小麦粉制作乡村面包。

e.en: Archaeologists found charred {emmer} grains at the ancient site.
e.zh: 考古学家在古遗址发现了烧焦的二粒小麦颗粒。

e.en: The loose wire could {emmesh} a bird's feet.
e.zh: 松散的铁丝可能缠住鸟的脚。

e.en: The scandal began to {emmesh} several senior officials.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻开始牵连几名高级官员。

e.en: The eye exam showed complete {emmetropia}.
e.zh: 眼科检查显示视力完全正视，没有屈光不正。

e.en: Children with {emmetropia} do not need corrective lenses.
e.zh: 正视儿童通常不需要矫正镜片。

e.en: The keeper would {emmew} the hawk after training.
e.zh: 管理员会在训练后把鹰关入笼中。

e.en: Fear can {emmew} a person more tightly than walls.
e.zh: 恐惧能比墙壁更牢地囚禁一个人。

e.en: Researchers isolated {emodin} from rhubarb root.
e.zh: 研究人员从大黄根中分离出大黄素。

e.en: The study tested whether {emodin} affected cell growth.
e.zh: 这项研究测试大黄素是否影响细胞生长。

e.en: She added a smile {emoji} to the message.
e.zh: 她在消息里加了一个微笑表情符号。

e.en: That {emoji} can mean different things in different cultures.
e.zh: 那个表情符号在不同文化中可能有不同含义。

e.en: The cream can {emolliate} dry and cracked skin.
e.zh: 这种乳霜可以软化干裂的皮肤。

e.en: Kind words helped {emolliate} the anger in the room.
e.zh: 温和的话语帮助缓和了屋里的怒气。

e.en: The {emolliated} leather felt smooth under her hand.
e.zh: 软化后的皮革摸起来很顺滑。

e.en: His {emolliated} tone made the apology easier to accept.
e.zh: 他缓和后的语气让道歉更容易被接受。

e.en: She applied an {emolliating} balm to the rash.
e.zh: 她在皮疹上涂了一种软化舒缓的香膏。

e.en: The minister adopted an {emolliating} style during the talks.
e.zh: 部长在会谈中采用了缓和的表达方式。

e.en: The detective suspected deliberate {empoisonment} of the well.
e.zh: 侦探怀疑有人故意向水井下毒。

e.en: The poem describes the slow {empoisonment} of trust.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了信任被慢慢毒害的过程。

empolder.t: 围海造田；筑堤排水成田

e.en: Engineers planned to {empolder} the marshland near the coast.
e.zh: 工程师计划在海岸附近的沼泽地筑堤排水成田。

e.en: The villagers helped {empolder} land for new fields.
e.zh: 村民们帮忙围垦土地，以开辟新的农田。

e.en: War can {empoverish} families for generations.
e.zh: 战争可能使许多家庭几代人都陷入贫困。

e.en: Bad policy may {empoverish} public life.
e.zh: 糟糕的政策会使公共生活变得贫乏。

e.en: The report needs more {emprical} evidence before publication.
e.zh: 这份报告在发表前需要更多实证证据。

e.en: Her {emprical} method relied on careful observation.
e.zh: 她的经验方法依赖细致的观察。

e.en: The knight began a dangerous {emprise} at dawn.
e.zh: 那名骑士在黎明时开始了一项危险的冒险行动。

e.en: Their reform was an ambitious public {emprise}.
e.zh: 他们的改革是一项雄心勃勃的公共事业。

e.en: The {emprising} captain sailed beyond the known maps.
e.zh: 那位勇于冒险的船长驶出了已知地图的范围。

e.en: An {emprising} spirit shaped the young colony.
e.zh: 一种开拓事业的精神塑造了这个年轻殖民地。

e.en: The old master would {emprize} loyalty above talent.
e.zh: 那位老大师会把忠诚看得比才能更珍贵。

e.en: They {emprize} plain speech in their meetings.
e.zh: 他们在会议中很赏识坦率的表达。

e.en: The doctor noted an {emprotid} swelling near the jaw.
e.zh: 医生注意到下颌附近有腮腺部位的肿胀。

e.en: An {emprotid} gland infection can cause facial pain.
e.zh: 耳下腺感染可能引起面部疼痛。

e.en: The physician recommended {empsyxis} to reduce the fever.
e.zh: 医生建议进行降温以减轻发热。

e.en: Ancient writers discussed {empsyxis} after intense heat.
e.zh: 古代作者讨论过高热之后的冷却过程。

e.en: He came home {empty-handed} after the sale.
e.zh: 那场特卖结束后，他空手回了家。

e.en: The police left the building {empty-handed}.
e.zh: 警方离开那栋楼时一无所获。

e.en: His {empty-headed} answer annoyed the teacher.
e.zh: 他那个没头脑的回答惹恼了老师。

e.en: The novel mocks an {empty-headed} young aristocrat.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了一位愚蠢的年轻贵族。

e.en: As an {empty-nester}, Maria started traveling more.
e.zh: 孩子离家后，玛丽亚作为空巢父母开始更多地旅行。

e.en: The club offers classes for every new {empty-nester}.
e.zh: 这个俱乐部为每位新空巢父母提供课程。

e.en: The patient reported {emptysis} after several days of coughing.
e.zh: 病人说自己咳嗽数日后出现了咯血。

e.en: Severe {emptysis} requires urgent medical attention.
e.zh: 严重咳血需要立即就医。

e.en: Sunset began to {empurple} the western clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳开始把西边的云染成紫色。

e.en: Cold air can {empurple} a child's lips.
e.zh: 寒冷的空气会使孩子的嘴唇发紫。

e.en: The hills were {empurpled} by the evening light.
e.zh: 群山被傍晚的光线染成了紫色。

e.en: His {empurpled} fingers showed how cold he was.
e.zh: 他发紫的手指说明他冻得很厉害。

e.en: Dusk {empurples} the river before night falls.
e.zh: 夜幕降临前，暮色把河水染成紫色。

e.en: The bruise {empurples} as it spreads under the skin.
e.zh: 淤伤在皮下扩散时会变得发紫。

empurpling.t: 正在发紫；正在染成紫色

e.en: The {empurpling} sky made everyone pause.
e.zh: 天空渐渐染成紫色，让所有人都停了下来。

e.en: Her {empurpling} knuckles worried the nurse.
e.zh: 她逐渐发紫的指关节让护士很担心。

e.en: The scan showed {empyema} around the lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示肺部周围有脓胸。

e.en: Untreated {empyema} can become life-threatening.
e.zh: 未经治疗的积脓可能危及生命。

e.en: The oil left an {empyreuma} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 这油在厨房里留下了一股焦臭味。

e.en: Chemists once used {empyreuma} to describe burnt odors.
e.zh: 化学家曾用这个词来描述烧焦的气味。

e.en: The medicine had an {empyreumatic} smell.
e.zh: 这种药有一股焦臭味。

e.en: An {empyreumatic} note lingered in the roasted beans.
e.zh: 烘烤过的豆子里残留着一丝烧焦味。

e.en: He complained of {empyrosis} after a heavy meal.
e.zh: 他吃完一顿大餐后抱怨胃灼热。

e.en: Persistent {empyrosis} may need medical treatment.
e.zh: 持续烧心可能需要医学治疗。

e.en: Her concise style is {emulable} by younger writers.
e.zh: 她简洁的文风是年轻作者可以仿效的。

e.en: The system offers an {emulable} model for small clinics.
e.zh: 这个系统为小诊所提供了一个可借鉴的模式。

e.en: Each {emulant} tried to surpass the master's design.
e.zh: 每个竞争者都试图超越大师的设计。

e.en: He became an {emulant} of the old poet's manner.
e.zh: 他成了那位老诗人风格的仿效者。

e.en: The class developed an {emulative} spirit during the contest.
e.zh: 比赛期间，全班形成了一种好胜的气氛。

e.en: His {emulative} admiration pushed him to copy her technique.
e.zh: 他带着仿效的钦佩之情，努力模仿她的技巧。

e.en: The apprentices worked {emulatively} to impress the master.
e.zh: 学徒们争先恐后地干活，想给师傅留下印象。

e.en: She studied the pianist {emulatively}, noting every movement.
e.zh: 她带着仿效之心研究那位钢琴家，记下每个动作。

e.en: The prize created an {emulatory} mood among the students.
e.zh: 这个奖项在学生之间激起了好胜的情绪。

e.en: His {emulatory} essays echoed the historian's grand style.
e.zh: 他的仿效性文章呼应了那位历史学家的宏大风格。

e.en: The doctor described the kidney as an {emulgent} organ.
e.zh: 医生把肾脏描述为负责排泄的器官。

e.en: Old anatomy texts mention an {emulgent} vessel near the kidney.
e.zh: 旧解剖书会提到肾脏附近的一条输出血管。

e.en: The {emulous} student practiced until midnight every day.
e.zh: 那个好胜的学生每天练习到午夜。

e.en: They watched their rivals with {emulous} admiration.
e.zh: 他们带着既佩服又想赶超的心情看着对手。

e.en: The young chefs {emulously} refined their signature dishes.
e.zh: 年轻厨师们好胜地改进自己的招牌菜。

e.en: He listened {emulously} to the senior lawyer's argument.
e.zh: 他带着想要赶超的心情听那位资深律师辩论。

e.en: Her {emulousness} made every rehearsal more intense.
e.zh: 她的好胜心让每次排练都更加紧张。

e.en: A little {emulousness} can help a team improve.
e.zh: 适度的竞争欲能帮助团队进步。

e.en: The chemist tested whether the oil was {emulsible} in water.
e.zh: 化学师测试这种油是否能在水中乳化。

e.en: An {emulsible} concentrate is easier to mix before spraying.
e.zh: 可乳化浓缩液在喷洒前更容易混合。

e.en: Temperature affects the {emulsifiability} of the fat mixture.
e.zh: 温度会影响这种脂肪混合物的乳化能力。

e.en: The report compared the {emulsifiability} of several oils.
e.zh: 报告比较了几种油的可乳化性。

e.en: The pesticide is sold as an {emulsifiable} concentrate.
e.zh: 这种农药以可乳化浓缩液的形式出售。

e.en: Only {emulsifiable} ingredients will blend smoothly into the lotion.
e.zh: 只有可乳化的成分才能顺利混入乳液。

e.en: Almond seeds contain {emulsin}, which acts on certain glycosides.
e.zh: 杏仁种子含有苦杏仁酶，能作用于某些糖苷。

e.en: The old chemistry text described {emulsin} as a plant enzyme.
e.zh: 那本旧化学书把苦杏仁酶描述为一种植物酶。

e.en: The soap has an {emulsive} effect on grease.
e.zh: 这种肥皂对油脂有乳化作用。

e.en: An {emulsive} liquid formed after vigorous shaking.
e.zh: 用力摇晃后形成了一种乳液状液体。

e.en: Gelatin can behave as an {emulsoid} in solution.
e.zh: 明胶在溶液中可以表现为乳状胶体。

e.en: The lecture contrasted an {emulsoid} with a suspension.
e.zh: 讲座把乳胶体和悬浮液作了对比。

e.en: Ancient physicians discussed the body's {emunctories} in detail.
e.zh: 古代医师详细讨论过人体的排泄器官。

e.en: The skin and kidneys were once called natural {emunctories}.
e.zh: 皮肤和肾脏曾被称为天然排泄器官。

e.en: The skin was treated as an {emunctory} in older medicine.
e.zh: 在旧医学中，皮肤被视为一种排泄器官。

e.en: The text lists several {emunctory} functions of the body.
e.zh: 这篇文章列出了人体的几种排泄功能。

e.en: The cable needs {en-casement} before it can be buried.
e.zh: 电缆在埋入地下前需要包封保护。

e.en: Glass {en-casement} preserved the fragile specimen.
e.zh: 玻璃外壳封装保存了这个易碎标本。

e.en: The {enaction} of the law changed local hiring rules.
e.zh: 这项法律的制定改变了当地的招聘规定。

e.en: Drama therapy uses {enaction} to explore difficult memories.
e.zh: 戏剧治疗通过行动演绎来探索痛苦记忆。

enactive.t: 行动生成的；演 enact 的

e.en: The theory emphasizes {enactive} learning through movement.
e.zh: 该理论强调通过动作实现的行动式学习。

e.en: Children build meaning through {enactive} engagement with objects.
e.zh: 儿童通过亲身操作物体来建构意义。

e.en: Parliament is the formal {enactor} of the statute.
e.zh: 议会是这项法规的正式制定者。

e.en: In the exercise, each {enactor} played a workplace role.
e.zh: 在练习中，每个扮演者都饰演一个职场角色。

e.en: The committee reviewed the bill's {enactory} language.
e.zh: 委员会审查了法案中用于制定条款的措辞。

e.en: Her {enactory} approach turned plans into concrete routines.
e.zh: 她注重落实的做法把计划变成了具体流程。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {enalite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为海成岩。

e.en: Layers of {enalite} marked the ancient shoreline.
e.zh: 几层海生岩标出了古老海岸线的位置。

enallage.t: 换格用法；语法替代修辞

e.en: The poet used {enallage} to make the line sound strange.
e.zh: 诗人使用换格用法，让这一行听起来有些奇特。

e.en: In rhetoric, {enallage} can shift one grammatical form for another.
e.zh: 在修辞中，换格用法可以用一种语法形式替代另一种。

e.en: The {enamelist} repaired the damaged surface by hand.
e.zh: 那位珐琅工匠用手工修复了受损表面。

e.en: An experienced {enamelist} can mix colors with great precision.
e.zh: 经验丰富的珐琅工匠能非常精确地调配颜色。

enamine.t: 烯胺；含双键胺类化合物

e.en: The chemist prepared an {enamine} for the next reaction.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种烯胺，用于下一步反应。

e.en: This {enamine} reacts quickly under mild laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 这种烯胺在温和的实验条件下反应很快。

e.en: The old melody seemed to {enamour} everyone in the room.
e.zh: 那首老旋律似乎让屋里每个人都着迷。

e.en: Her quiet confidence could {enamour} even skeptical listeners.
e.zh: 她从容的自信甚至能让怀疑的听众倾心。

e.en: The speaker was {enamouring} the audience with gentle humor.
e.zh: 演讲者正用温和的幽默吸引听众。

e.en: It was an {enamouring} performance, full of warmth and control.
e.zh: 那是一场令人倾心的表演，温暖而克制。

e.en: The city {enamours} visitors with its quiet gardens.
e.zh: 这座城市以宁静的花园让游客着迷。

e.en: A clear style often {enamours} readers more than ornament does.
e.zh: 清晰的风格往往比华丽修饰更能打动读者。

enanthate.t: 庚酸酯；药物庚酸酯形式

e.en: The medicine was supplied as testosterone {enanthate}.
e.zh: 这种药物以睾酮庚酸酯的形式供应。

e.en: An {enanthate} ester can release the drug more slowly.
e.zh: 庚酸酯可以让药物释放得更慢。

e.en: The doctor noticed an {enanthema} inside the child's mouth.
e.zh: 医生注意到孩子口腔内有黏膜疹。

e.en: Measles may cause an {enanthema} before the skin rash appears.
e.zh: 麻疹在皮疹出现前可能先引起黏膜疹。

e.en: The plant contains {enanthotoxin}, which can cause severe poisoning.
e.zh: 这种植物含有毒芹毒素，可能导致严重中毒。

e.en: Researchers studied how {enanthotoxin} affects the nervous system.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了毒芹毒素如何影响神经系统。

e.en: The reaction introduced an {enanthoyl} group into the molecule.
e.zh: 该反应把庚酰基引入了分子中。

e.en: An {enanthoyl} derivative may have different solubility.
e.zh: 庚酰基衍生物可能具有不同的溶解性。

enantiomeric.t: 对映异构的；手性对应的

e.en: The two compounds showed different {enantiomeric} purity.
e.zh: 这两种化合物显示出不同的对映异构纯度。

e.en: An {enantiomeric} pair can behave differently in the body.
e.zh: 一对对映异构体在人体内可能表现不同。

e.en: Each crystal was the {enantiomorph} of the other.
e.zh: 每个晶体都是另一个晶体的对映形体。

e.en: A left hand is often used to explain an {enantiomorph}.
e.zh: 人们常用左手来解释对映形体。

enantiomorphism.t: 对映形态；镜像异构现象

e.en: The mineral displayed clear {enantiomorphism} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这种矿物在显微镜下显示出明显的对映形态。

e.en: Chemists use {enantiomorphism} to describe mirror-image structures.
e.zh: 化学家用对映形态来描述镜像结构。

e.en: The two shells had {enantiomorphous} spiral forms.
e.zh: 这两个贝壳具有对映形的螺旋结构。

e.en: Some crystals grow in {enantiomorphous} pairs.
e.zh: 有些晶体会成对长成镜像异构的形态。

e.en: Classical writers contrasted {enantiopathy} with homeopathy.
e.zh: 古典作者把对症疗法与顺势疗法作对比。

e.en: In {enantiopathy}, a treatment opposes the patient's symptoms.
e.zh: 在对症疗法中，治疗手段与患者症状相反。

e.en: The critic called the phrase an example of {enantiosis}.
e.zh: 评论家称这个短语是反语法的例子。

e.en: Ancient rhetoricians used {enantiosis} to express meaning by opposition.
e.zh: 古代修辞学家用矛盾表达来通过对立传达意义。

enantiotropic.t: 互变晶型的；对映转变的

e.en: Sulfur has {enantiotropic} forms at different temperatures.
e.zh: 硫在不同温度下具有互变晶型。

e.en: The {enantiotropic} transition was measured during heating.
e.zh: 加热过程中测量到了互变晶型转变。

enantiotropy.t: 互变晶型性；可逆多晶转变

e.en: The textbook explains {enantiotropy} with sulfur as an example.
e.zh: 教材用硫作为例子解释互变晶型性。

e.en: Pressure can influence {enantiotropy} in some solid materials.
e.zh: 压力会影响某些固体材料的可逆多晶转变。

e.en: The stem showed an {enarch} arrangement of xylem.
e.zh: 这根茎显示出内始式的木质部排列。

e.en: Botanists described the vascular tissue as {enarch}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种维管组织描述为内始式。

e.en: The doorway was {enarched} with carved stone.
e.zh: 门口用雕刻石材做成了拱形。

e.en: Her eyebrows {enarched} slightly in surprise.
e.zh: 她惊讶地微微扬起了眉毛。

enarchist.t: 统治主义者；主张权威者

e.en: The pamphlet mocked him as an {enarchist}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲讽他是个统治主义者。

e.en: An {enarchist} may defend strong centralized rule.
e.zh: 统治主义者可能会维护强有力的中央统治。

enargite.t: 硫砷铜矿；黝铜矿类矿物

e.en: The sample contained {enargite} and several other copper minerals.
e.zh: 样品中含有硫砷铜矿和其他几种铜矿物。

e.en: Miners identified {enargite} by its dark metallic luster.
e.zh: 矿工通过深色金属光泽辨认出硫砷铜矿。

e.en: The hip is a classic example of {enarthrosis}.
e.zh: 髋关节是球窝关节的典型例子。

e.en: An {enarthrosis} allows movement in many directions.
e.zh: 球窝关节允许向多个方向运动。

e.en: The inheritance passed through an {enate} relative.
e.zh: 这份遗产通过一位母系亲属传承。

e.en: In botany, an {enate} growth may arise from the surface tissue.
e.zh: 在植物学中，同源外生的生长物可能来自表层组织。

encephalitogen.t: 致脑炎物质；脑炎诱发物

e.en: The protein acted as an {encephalitogen} in the animal study.
e.zh: 这种蛋白在动物研究中起到了致脑炎物质的作用。

e.en: Researchers isolated an {encephalitogen} from the experimental tissue sample.
e.zh: 研究人员从实验组织样本中分离出一种脑炎诱发物。

e.en: The vaccine candidate showed {encephalitogenic} effects in early tests.
e.zh: 这种候选疫苗在早期测试中显示出能诱发脑炎的影响。

e.en: Doctors avoided using the {encephalitogenic} compound in further trials.
e.zh: 医生在后续试验中避免使用这种可能诱发脑炎的化合物。

e.en: Higher {encephalization} is often linked with complex social behavior.
e.zh: 较高的脑发达程度常与复杂的社会行为有关。

e.en: The study compared {encephalization} across several mammal species.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了几种哺乳动物的脑化程度。

e.en: The newborn was diagnosed with an {encephalocele} after imaging tests.
e.zh: 影像检查后，这名新生儿被诊断出脑膨出。

e.en: Surgeons repaired the {encephalocele} shortly after birth.
e.zh: 外科医生在婴儿出生后不久修复了脑膨出。

e.en: The doctor reviewed the {encephalogram} for signs of seizure activity.
e.zh: 医生查看脑电图，寻找癫痫活动的迹象。

e.en: Her {encephalogram} showed normal patterns during sleep.
e.zh: 她的脑电图显示睡眠期间的模式正常。

e.en: The old {encephalograph} was replaced with a digital system.
e.zh: 那台旧脑电图仪被一套数字系统取代了。

e.en: Technicians calibrated the {encephalograph} before the patient arrived.
e.zh: 技术人员在病人到达前校准了脑记录仪。

encephalography.t: 脑电图检查；脑成像记录

e.en: The clinic uses {encephalography} to monitor abnormal brain activity.
e.zh: 这家诊所使用脑电图检查来监测异常脑活动。

e.en: Modern {encephalography} can help doctors study sleep disorders.
e.zh: 现代脑部记录技术可以帮助医生研究睡眠障碍。

e.en: The pathologist described the tumor as {encephaloid} in texture.
e.zh: 病理学家描述这个肿瘤质地像脑组织。

e.en: An {encephaloid} mass was found during the examination.
e.zh: 检查中发现了一个脑样肿块。

e.en: The scan revealed a rare {encephalolith} near the old injury.
e.zh: 扫描显示旧伤附近有一个罕见的脑内结石。

e.en: Doctors discussed whether the {encephalolith} required surgery.
e.zh: 医生讨论这个脑石是否需要手术。

e.en: The report used {encephaloma} to describe the unusual brain tumor.
e.zh: 报告用脑瘤一词来描述这个异常的脑部肿瘤。

e.en: A suspected {encephaloma} was later found to be benign.
e.zh: 一个疑似脑瘤后来被发现是良性的。

e.en: The MRI showed {encephalomalacia} after the stroke.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示中风后出现了脑组织软化。

e.en: Severe head trauma can sometimes lead to {encephalomalacia}.
e.zh: 严重头部外伤有时会导致脑软化。

e.en: The patient developed {encephalomyelitis} after a viral infection.
e.zh: 这名患者在病毒感染后出现了脑脊髓炎。

e.en: Doctors treated the {encephalomyelitis} with high-dose steroids.
e.zh: 医生用大剂量类固醇治疗这种脑脊髓炎。

e.en: The lab confirmed {encephalomyocarditis} in the infected mice.
e.zh: 实验室确认受感染的小鼠患有脑心肌炎。

e.en: Outbreaks of {encephalomyocarditis} can affect livestock and wildlife.
e.zh: 脑心肌炎暴发可能影响家畜和野生动物。

e.en: The {encephalon} includes the major structures of the brain.
e.zh: 脑包括大脑的主要结构。

e.en: Students labeled the {encephalon} during the anatomy lesson.
e.zh: 学生们在解剖课上标注了颅内脑部结构。

e.en: The specimen was classified as {encephalous} rather than headless.
e.zh: 这个标本被归为有脑类型，而不是无头类型。

e.en: In older anatomy texts, {encephalous} organisms were contrasted with simpler forms.
e.zh: 在较早的解剖学文本中，有脑生物常与更简单的形态相对比。

e.en: His rude remark began to {enchafe} the guests.
e.zh: 他的粗鲁言论开始激怒客人们。

e.en: The delay did not merely annoy her; it seemed to {enchafe} her pride.
e.zh: 这次延误不只是让她烦恼，似乎还刺痛了她的自尊。

e.en: The constant criticism was {enchafing} everyone in the room.
e.zh: 不断的批评正在惹恼房间里的每个人。

e.en: He spoke in an {enchafing} tone that made compromise harder.
e.zh: 他说话的语气很容易激怒人，使妥协更加困难。

e.en: Fear can {enchain} people more tightly than iron.
e.zh: 恐惧能比铁链更牢地束缚人。

e.en: The prisoner was {enchain}ed to the wall in the old tale.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，囚犯被用链子锁在墙上。

e.en: The hero found the monster {enchained} beneath the castle.
e.zh: 英雄发现怪物被锁链束缚在城堡下面。

e.en: She felt {enchained} by duties she had never chosen.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被从未选择过的责任束缚住了。

e.en: The tyrant was accused of {enchaining} his own people.
e.zh: 这个暴君被指责束缚自己的人民。

e.en: The poet described memories {enchaining} one sorrow to another.
e.zh: 诗人描写记忆把一种悲伤接连牵住另一种悲伤。

e.en: The novel explores the {enchainment} of debt and dependence.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨债务与依赖造成的束缚。

e.en: They spoke of {enchainment} as both physical and moral captivity.
e.zh: 他们谈到束缚时，既指身体上的囚禁，也指道德上的禁锢。

e.en: Poverty {enchains} families across generations.
e.zh: 贫困会跨越几代人束缚家庭。

e.en: In the legend, a spell {enchains} the dragon under the mountain.
e.zh: 在传说中，一个咒语把龙锁在山下。

e.en: The captain will {encharge} the officer with guarding the gate.
e.zh: 队长将委托那名军官负责守卫大门。

e.en: They {encharge}d him to carry the sealed letter.
e.zh: 他们托付他送那封密封的信。

e.en: The jeweler will {enchase} the silver cup with tiny vines.
e.zh: 珠宝匠会在银杯上雕镂细小的藤蔓纹。

e.en: Gold threads seemed to {enchase} the dark leather cover.
e.zh: 金线仿佛镶嵌装饰着那深色皮革封面。

e.en: She wore an {enchased} bracelet from the Victorian period.
e.zh: 她戴着一只维多利亚时期的雕镂手镯。

e.en: The altar was {enchased} with gold and colored stones.
e.zh: 祭坛上镶嵌装饰着黄金和彩色宝石。

e.en: The inheritance followed the {enatic} line of the family.
e.zh: 遗产按家族的母系亲属线继承。

e.en: Anthropologists recorded several {enatic} obligations in the clan.
e.zh: 人类学家记录了该氏族中的几项母系亲属义务。

e.en: The surgeon described the growth as an {enblastoma}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这个增生描述为内芽瘤。

e.en: Older medical texts rarely mention {enblastoma} today.
e.zh: 如今较少有旧医学文献提到内芽瘤。

e.en: The college held {encaenia} in the old hall.
e.zh: 学院在旧礼堂举行了校庆典礼。

e.en: Guests wore formal robes for the {encaenia}.
e.zh: 来宾为落成典礼穿上了正式礼袍。

e.en: The keeper had to {encage} the injured hawk overnight.
e.zh: 饲养员不得不把受伤的鹰关进笼中过夜。

e.en: Fear can {encage} a person more tightly than walls.
e.zh: 恐惧能比墙更牢地禁锢一个人。

e.en: The {encaged} bird beat its wings against the wire.
e.zh: 被关在笼中的鸟拍打翅膀撞着铁丝。

e.en: She felt {encaged} by the rigid rules.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被僵硬的规则禁锢住了。

e.en: The trap {encages} small animals without harming them.
e.zh: 这个陷阱会把小动物关住但不伤害它们。

e.en: Debt sometimes {encages} whole families for years.
e.zh: 债务有时会把整个家庭禁锢多年。

e.en: They avoided {encaging} the fox unless treatment was necessary.
e.zh: 除非需要治疗，他们避免把狐狸关进笼子。

e.en: The policy had an {encaging} effect on local artists.
e.zh: 这项政策对当地艺术家产生了禁锢作用。

e.en: Hard labor can {encallow} the palms.
e.zh: 繁重劳动会使手掌结茧变硬。

e.en: Repeated loss seemed to {encallow} his heart.
e.zh: 一次次失去似乎让他的心变得麻木坚硬。

e.en: The viral proteins {encapsidate} the new genetic material.
e.zh: 病毒蛋白会把新的遗传物质包入衣壳。

e.en: Researchers tested how quickly particles could {encapsidate} RNA.
e.zh: 研究人员测试颗粒能多快把RNA包入衣壳。

e.en: The formula can {encapsule} the drug for slow release.
e.zh: 这种配方能把药物封装起来以便缓慢释放。

e.en: A single image seemed to {encapsule} the whole crisis.
e.zh: 一张图片似乎概括了整场危机。

e.en: The lab is {encapsuling} the compound in a protective shell.
e.zh: 实验室正在把这种化合物封装进保护壳。

e.en: His speech was {encapsuling} decades of frustration.
e.zh: 他的演讲正在浓缩几十年来的挫败感。

e.en: The poem tries to {encarnalize} abstract grief.
e.zh: 这首诗试图把抽象的悲痛肉体化。

e.en: Medieval writers often {encarnalize} spiritual temptation.
e.zh: 中世纪作家常把精神诱惑赋予肉身形象。

e.en: The botanist examined the {encarpa} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家在镜下检查了果内层。

e.en: Damage to the {encarpa} changed the seed's development.
e.zh: 果内层受损改变了种子的发育。

e.en: An {encarpus} ran along the temple frieze.
e.zh: 一条果花雕饰带沿着神庙檐壁延伸。

e.en: The restorer cleaned the stone {encarpus} carefully.
e.zh: 修复师小心清理了石刻果花饰带。

e.en: The voucher is {encashable} at any branch.
e.zh: 这张凭证可在任何分行兑现。

e.en: Unused leave is not {encashable} under this contract.
e.zh: 根据这份合同，未休假期不能折现。

e.en: The museum required careful {encastage} before shipping the statue.
e.zh: 博物馆要求在运输雕像前仔细装箱。

e.en: Poor {encastage} left the instruments exposed to moisture.
e.zh: 包装入箱不当使这些仪器暴露在潮气中。

e.en: The manual described {encatarrhaphy} as an internal suture technique.
e.zh: 手册把内缝术描述为一种内部缝合技术。

e.en: Few modern surgeons use the term {encatarrhaphy}.
e.zh: 现代外科医生很少使用内缝术这个术语。

e.en: The monks would {encave} their supplies during raids.
e.zh: 遭遇袭击时，僧侣会把补给藏入洞中。

e.en: Erosion can {encave} the soft limestone cliff.
e.zh: 侵蚀会使柔软的石灰岩峭壁凹陷成洞。

e.en: The philosopher used {ence} to mean simple being.
e.zh: 这位哲学家用ence表示单纯的存在。

e.en: In that old glossary, {ence} was defined as existence.
e.zh: 在那本旧词汇表中，ence被定义为存在。

e.en: The queen was said to be {enceinte}.
e.zh: 据说王后已经怀孕。

e.en: The old {enceinte} still surrounds part of the town.
e.zh: 旧城墙仍环绕着城镇的一部分。

e.en: The specimens included several preserved {encephala}.
e.zh: 这些标本包括几件保存下来的脑部样本。

e.en: Comparative anatomy studies {encephala} across species.
e.zh: 比较解剖学研究不同物种的脑。

e.en: The physician recorded severe {encephalalgia} after the fever.
e.zh: 医生记录发热后出现严重头痛。

e.en: Old case notes used {encephalalgia} for persistent head pain.
e.zh: 旧病例记录用脑痛一词指持续性头痛。

e.en: The diagnosis listed {encephalasthenia} after months of exhaustion.
e.zh: 在数月疲惫后，诊断写为脑衰弱。

e.en: Victorian doctors sometimes blamed study for {encephalasthenia}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生有时把脑衰弱归咎于读书过度。

e.en: The scan showed abnormal {encephalic} activity.
e.zh: 扫描显示脑部活动异常。

e.en: The embryo developed clear {encephalic} structures early.
e.zh: 胚胎很早就形成了清晰的头部结构。

e.en: The old {enchaser} repaired the silver bowl.
e.zh: 那位老雕刻师修好了银碗。

e.en: An {enchaser} added delicate patterns to the ring.
e.zh: 一名金属雕饰工匠给戒指加上精细花纹。

e.en: The cup shows fine {enchasing} around its rim.
e.zh: 杯口周围有精美的錾刻装饰。

e.en: She learned {enchasing} from a traditional silversmith.
e.zh: 她向一位传统银匠学习金属雕饰。

e.en: The monk kept a small {enchiridion} of prayers.
e.zh: 那位修士随身带着一本简短祈祷手册。

e.en: This {enchiridion} explains the rules in plain language.
e.zh: 这本简明指南用通俗语言解释规则。

enchondral.t: 软骨内的；经软骨形成的

e.en: The doctor discussed {enchondral} bone growth.
e.zh: 医生讲解了经软骨形成的骨骼生长。

e.en: They studied an {enchondral} process in the lab.
e.zh: 他们在实验室研究一种软骨内过程。

e.en: The scan revealed an {enchondroma} in her finger.
e.zh: 扫描显示她的手指里有一个内生软骨瘤。

e.en: Most cases of {enchondroma} are monitored rather than removed.
e.zh: 多数内生软骨瘤病例会先观察，而不是直接切除。

e.en: The report described an {enchondromatous} lesion.
e.zh: 报告描述了一处内生软骨瘤性病灶。

e.en: Several {enchondromatous} changes appeared on the X-ray.
e.zh: X光片上出现了几处内生软骨瘤性变化。

e.en: The scholar compared Greek and {enchorial} inscriptions.
e.zh: 学者比较了希腊文字和本地文字铭文。

e.en: An {enchorial} custom survived in the remote villages.
e.zh: 一种本地习俗在偏远村庄保留了下来。

e.en: The textbook defined {enchylema} as living cell substance.
e.zh: 教材把细胞质定义为活细胞中的物质。

e.en: Early biologists used {enchylema} in a broader sense.
e.zh: 早期生物学家对原生质内液这个词用得更宽泛。

e.en: The specimen showed {enchymatous} tissue under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下标本显示出实质组织。

e.en: He used {enchymatous} to describe the soft cellular mass.
e.zh: 他用细胞质的这个词来描述那团柔软细胞物质。

e.en: A stone wall formed an {encincture} around the garden.
e.zh: 一堵石墙形成了环绕花园的围墙。

e.en: The poet imagined clouds in {encincture} of the moon.
e.zh: 诗人想象云朵环绕着月亮。

e.en: The surgeon selected an {encipter} for the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生为这次操作选用了一件穿刺器。

e.en: An old {encipter} lay in the medical museum case.
e.zh: 一件旧外科针具陈列在医学博物馆的柜中。

e.en: She tried to {enclasp} the child in her arms.
e.zh: 她想把孩子紧紧抱在怀里。

e.en: The vines {enclasp} the wooden fence each summer.
e.zh: 每到夏天，藤蔓都会缠抱住木篱笆。

e.en: His {enclasping} hands would not let go.
e.zh: 他紧握着的双手不肯松开。

e.en: The {enclasping} branches made a green arch.
e.zh: 相互环抱的枝条形成了一道绿色拱门。

e.en: The lecture introduced {enclisis} in ancient Greek.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了古希腊语中的附加词现象。

e.en: In some dialects, {enclisis} changes the rhythm of a sentence.
e.zh: 在一些方言中，附着重音会改变句子的节奏。

e.en: The suffix functions as an {enclitic} in this language.
e.zh: 这个后缀在该语言中起附着词作用。

e.en: An {enclitic} pronoun follows the verb in that construction.
e.zh: 在那种结构中，后附代词跟在动词后面。

e.en: The pronoun is attached {enclitically} to the verb.
e.zh: 这个代词以后附方式连在动词上。

e.en: Particles may behave {enclitically} in rapid speech.
e.zh: 在快速说话时，小品词可能表现为附着成分。

e.en: The chapter lists several Latin {enclitics}.
e.zh: 这一章列出了几个拉丁语附着词。

e.en: Students often confuse {enclitics} with ordinary suffixes.
e.zh: 学生常把后附词和普通后缀混淆。

e.en: The charity helped {enclothe} children before winter.
e.zh: 慈善机构在冬天前帮助孩子们穿上衣物。

e.en: Mist seemed to {enclothe} the valley at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，薄雾似乎覆盖了山谷。

e.en: Smoke began to {encloud} the narrow room.
e.zh: 烟雾开始使狭窄的房间变得模糊。

e.en: Anger can {encloud} a person's judgment.
e.zh: 愤怒会使一个人的判断变得不清。

e.en: They would {encoffin} the body before sunset.
e.zh: 他们会在日落前把遗体装入棺中。

e.en: The ruins seemed to {encoffin} a forgotten age.
e.zh: 这些废墟仿佛埋葬了一个被遗忘的时代。

e.en: A small {encoignure} stood between the windows.
e.zh: 窗户之间放着一个小墙角柜。

e.en: The chair occupied an awkward {encoignure} of the room.
e.zh: 那把椅子占据了房间里一个别扭的角落。

e.en: The book received lavish {encomia} from critics.
e.zh: 这本书得到了评论家的大量赞辞。

e.en: Ancient {encomia} praised heroes and rulers.
e.zh: 古代颂词常赞美英雄和统治者。

e.en: The review was almost embarrassingly {encomiastic}.
e.zh: 那篇评论赞颂得几乎令人尴尬。

e.en: He wrote an {encomiastic} speech for the retiring judge.
e.zh: 他为即将退休的法官写了一篇赞颂演说。

e.en: The poem has an {encomiastical} tone throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇带有颂扬的语气。

e.en: Her {encomiastical} remarks pleased the committee.
e.zh: 她那些赞颂性的话让委员会很满意。

e.en: The farmer had to {encoop} the chickens before nightfall.
e.zh: 农夫必须在天黑前把鸡关进笼子里。

e.en: They felt {encooped} in the tiny room all weekend.
e.zh: 整个周末他们都觉得被困在那间小屋里。

e.en: The pediatrician explained that {encopresis} can follow long-term constipation.
e.zh: 儿科医生解释说，儿童遗粪症可能由长期便秘引起。

e.en: His parents sought help when {encopresis} began affecting school life.
e.zh: 当遗粪症开始影响学校生活时，他的父母寻求了帮助。

e.en: We may {encounter} delays during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间我们可能会遇到延误。

e.en: Her first {encounter} with the professor was awkward.
e.zh: 她第一次见到那位教授时场面有些尴尬。

e.en: They {encountered} several problems during the test.
e.zh: 他们在测试过程中遇到了几个问题。

e.en: I {encountered} an old friend at the station.
e.zh: 我在车站遇见了一位老朋友。

e.en: She seemed to {encradle} the child with both arms.
e.zh: 她似乎用双臂把孩子温柔地抱在怀里。

e.en: The valley was {encradled} by dark green hills.
e.zh: 那片山谷被深绿色的群山环抱着。

e.en: The sunset began to {encrimson} the western clouds.
e.zh: 夕阳开始把西边的云染成深红色。

e.en: Anger seemed to {encrimson} his face within seconds.
e.zh: 几秒之内，怒气似乎让他的脸涨得通红。

e.en: The banners were {encrimsoned} by the evening light.
e.zh: 那些旗帜被傍晚的光线染成了深红色。

e.en: He turned away with an {encrimsoned} face.
e.zh: 他满脸通红地转过身去。

e.en: The {encrimsoning} sky warned of a cold night.
e.zh: 渐渐变红的天空预示着夜里会很冷。

e.en: Shame was {encrimsoning} her cheeks as she spoke.
e.zh: 她说话时，羞愧让双颊渐渐泛红。

e.en: Autumn often {encrimsons} the maples along the road.
e.zh: 秋天常把路边的枫树染成深红色。

e.en: The accusation {encrimsons} his face immediately.
e.zh: 那句指责立刻让他的脸涨红。

e.en: The museum displayed an {encrinite} from the limestone cliff.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自石灰岩峭壁的海百合化石。

e.en: She sketched the star-shaped sections of the {encrinite}.
e.zh: 她画下了那块海百合化石星形的截面。

e.en: An {encrustment} of salt covered the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧管道上覆盖着一层盐结壳。

e.en: The conservator removed the dark {encrustment} from the statue.
e.zh: 文物修复师清除了雕像上的黑色硬壳层。

e.en: Schools help {enculturate} children into shared civic habits.
e.zh: 学校帮助儿童适应共同的公民习惯和文化。

e.en: New employees are slowly {enculturated} into the firm's values.
e.zh: 新员工会逐渐被带入公司的价值文化中。

e.en: The program is {enculturating} students into academic life.
e.zh: 这个项目正在帮助学生适应学术生活的文化。

e.en: Elders played an {enculturating} role in the community.
e.zh: 长者在社区中发挥着传承文化的作用。

e.en: Rituals can have an {enculturative} function for young members.
e.zh: 仪式对年轻成员可能具有文化教化作用。

e.en: The museum designed {enculturative} activities for immigrant families.
e.zh: 博物馆为移民家庭设计了帮助文化适应的活动。

e.en: The old debt became an {encumberment} on the estate.
e.zh: 那笔旧债成了这份地产上的负担。

e.en: He viewed the heavy armor as an {encumberment}.
e.zh: 他觉得那套沉重的盔甲是个累赘。

e.en: Travelers may {encounter} rough weather in the mountains.
e.zh: 旅行者在山里可能会遇到恶劣天气。

e.en: That brief {encounter} changed her opinion of him.
e.zh: 那次短暂的相遇改变了她对他的看法。

e.en: They tried to {encurtain} the stage before the reveal.
e.zh: 他们试图在揭幕前用帘子遮住舞台。

e.en: Mist {encurtained} the harbor until noon.
e.zh: 雾气一直到中午都笼罩着港口。

e.en: The professor described an {encyclic} pattern in the poem.
e.zh: 教授描述了诗中一种循环式的结构。

e.en: Ancient writers sometimes used {encyclic} forms of argument.
e.zh: 古代作者有时使用循环式的论证形式。

e.en: Her {encyclopaedical} notes filled three large volumes.
e.zh: 她百科全书式的笔记写满了三大卷。

e.en: He had an {encyclopaedical} knowledge of medieval music.
e.zh: 他对中世纪音乐有百科全书般渊博的知识。

e.en: His essays show a remarkable {encyclopaedism}.
e.zh: 他的文章展现出惊人的百科全书式学识。

e.en: The age valued {encyclopaedism} and broad curiosity.
e.zh: 那个时代重视博学和广泛的好奇心。

encyclopaedist.t: 百科全书编纂者；博学者

e.en: The {encyclopaedist} revised entries on ancient medicine.
e.zh: 那位百科全书编纂者修订了古代医学的条目。

e.en: As an {encyclopaedist}, she collected facts from many fields.
e.zh: 作为一名博学者，她从许多领域收集事实。

e.en: She checked the {encyclopedia} for the date of the battle.
e.zh: 她查百科全书确认那场战役的日期。

e.en: The online {encyclopedia} is updated every month.
e.zh: 这部在线百科全书每个月都会更新。

e.en: The report offered an {encyclopedical} survey of local plants.
e.zh: 这份报告对当地植物作了百科全书式的概述。

e.en: His {encyclopedical} memory impressed the entire class.
e.zh: 他广博得像百科全书一样的记忆力让全班印象深刻。

encyclopedically.t: 以百科全书方式；广博地

e.en: The topic is treated {encyclopedically} in the new reference book.
e.zh: 这本新参考书以百科全书方式处理这个主题。

e.en: She answered {encyclopedically}, adding dates, names, and sources.
e.zh: 她回答得十分广博，还补充了日期、姓名和出处。

encyclopedism.t: 百科全书式知识观或写法

e.en: His lecture had the dry breadth of {encyclopedism}.
e.zh: 他的讲座带着百科全书式知识观的枯燥广度。

e.en: The essay attacks {encyclopedism} without real understanding.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评只有罗列知识而缺乏真正理解的百科全书式写法。

e.en: The {encyclopedist} checked every historical date twice.
e.zh: 那位百科全书编纂者把每个历史日期都核对了两遍。

e.en: She wrote like an {encyclopedist}, precise and wide-ranging.
e.zh: 她写作时像百科全书编纂者一样，精准而涉猎广泛。

encyclopedize.t: 编入百科全书；使百科化

e.en: The project aims to {encyclopedize} local folklore.
e.zh: 这个项目旨在把地方民俗编入百科资料。

e.en: Teachers should not {encyclopedize} every simple lesson.
e.zh: 教师不该把每堂简单课都讲成百科全书式内容。

e.en: Some parasites {encyst} inside muscle tissue.
e.zh: 有些寄生虫会在肌肉组织内形成囊。

e.en: The organism can {encyst} when conditions become harsh.
e.zh: 环境变得恶劣时，这种生物能够包囊化。

e.en: Low temperature can trigger {encystation} in the organism.
e.zh: 低温会触发这种生物的成囊过程。

e.en: The study measured {encystation} under different salt levels.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了不同盐度下的包囊形成情况。

e.en: The doctor found an {encysted} mass near the joint.
e.zh: 医生在关节附近发现了一个被囊包住的肿块。

e.en: The {encysted} larvae survived for months in soil.
e.zh: 这些成囊的幼虫在土壤中存活了数月。

e.en: The cells were {encysting} as nutrients disappeared.
e.zh: 营养物质消失时，这些细胞正在成囊。

e.en: Researchers observed {encysting} parasites through the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员通过显微镜观察正在包囊化的寄生虫。

e.en: The amoeba {encysts} during dry periods.
e.zh: 这种变形虫在干旱时期会形成囊。

e.en: A parasite often {encysts} in the host's tissue.
e.zh: 寄生虫常常会在宿主组织中包囊化。

e.en: The paper describes {encytosis} in early cell development.
e.zh: 这篇论文描述了早期细胞发育中的细胞内吞作用。

e.en: Abnormal {encytosis} may affect how cells absorb particles.
e.zh: 异常的细胞内吞作用可能影响细胞吸收颗粒的方式。

end-all.t: 终极目标；最重要的事物

e.en: Profit is not the {end-all} of education.
e.zh: 利润并不是教育的终极目标。

e.en: He treated promotion as the {end-all} of his career.
e.zh: 他把升职看成自己职业生涯最重要的事。

e.en: The flute is an {end-blown} instrument.
e.zh: 这种长笛是一种从端部吹奏的乐器。

e.en: They studied an ancient {end-blown} pipe.
e.zh: 他们研究了一件古代的端吹管乐器。

e.en: Replace the cracked {end-cap} before using the tube.
e.zh: 使用管子前先更换裂开的端盖。

e.en: The cereal was displayed on an {end-cap} near checkout.
e.zh: 这种麦片陈列在收银台附近的货架端头。

end-for-end.t: 首尾颠倒地；两端对调地

e.en: Turn the board {end-for-end} before cutting again.
e.zh: 再次切割前，把木板首尾调换一下。

e.en: The mechanic rotated the part {end-for-end}.
e.zh: 机械师把这个零件两端对调了。

end-of-dayglass.t: 日终玻璃；一天熔余玻璃制品

e.en: The museum displayed a colorful {end-of-dayglass} vase.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只色彩斑斓的日终玻璃花瓶。

e.en: Collectors prize {end-of-dayglass} for its accidental patterns.
e.zh: 收藏者看重日终玻璃，因为它有偶然形成的纹样。

e.en: The parser stopped at {end-of-file}.
e.zh: 解析器在文件结尾处停止了。

e.en: An unexpected {end-of-file} caused the build to fail.
e.zh: 意外的文件结尾导致构建失败。

e.en: Place a semicolon at the {end-of-line}.
e.zh: 在这一行的行尾加上分号。

e.en: The device reached {end-of-line} last year.
e.zh: 这款设备去年已经到达产品寿命终止阶段。

e.en: We met near the {end-of-the-year}.
e.zh: 我们是在年末前后见面的。

e.en: The {end-of-the-year} report is due tomorrow.
e.zh: 年底报告明天就要提交。

e.en: The cars collided {end-on} at the crossing.
e.zh: 两辆车在路口正面相撞。

e.en: Viewed {end-on}, the beam looked very narrow.
e.zh: 从端面看，这根梁显得很窄。

e.en: The {end-result} was better than expected.
e.zh: 最终结果比预期更好。

e.en: Small errors can change the {end-result}.
e.zh: 小错误也可能改变最终结果。

end-run.t: 绕过规则的做法；端线突破

e.en: The company made an {end-run} around the regulators.
e.zh: 这家公司采取手段绕过了监管机构。

e.en: The runner scored on a quick {end-run}.
e.zh: 那名跑者通过一次快速端线突破得分。

e.en: The team defined the desired {end-state} first.
e.zh: 团队先明确了想要达到的最终状态。

e.en: Without an {end-state}, the strategy felt vague.
e.zh: 没有目标状态，这项战略显得很模糊。

e.en: The poem uses an {end-stop} after each line.
e.zh: 这首诗每一行末尾都用了停顿。

e.en: Install an {end-stop} to limit the carriage travel.
e.zh: 安装一个终端止挡来限制滑架行程。

e.en: Most lines in the sonnet are {end-stopped}.
e.zh: 这首十四行诗的大多数诗行都在行末停顿。

e.en: Her {end-stopped} verse sounds formal and controlled.
e.zh: 她这种行末停顿的诗句听起来正式而克制。

e.en: Please enter the meeting {end-time}.
e.zh: 请输入会议的结束时间。

e.en: The preacher spoke about {end-time} visions.
e.zh: 那位传道人谈到了末世异象。

e.en: We need {end-to-end} encryption for messages.
e.zh: 我们需要对消息进行端到端加密。

e.en: The team tested the {end-to-end} checkout flow.
e.zh: 团队测试了完整的结账流程。

e.en: The flood may {endamage} the old foundations.
e.zh: 洪水可能会损害旧地基。

e.en: Careless words can {endamage} a fragile friendship.
e.zh: 轻率的话会伤害脆弱的友谊。

e.en: The {endamaged} bridge was closed overnight.
e.zh: 受损的桥整夜被封闭。

e.en: Her reputation was {endamaged} by the false report.
e.zh: 那篇虚假报道损害了她的名声。

e.en: The report described the {endamagement} of the roof.
e.zh: 报告描述了屋顶受损的情况。

e.en: They sued for {endamagement} caused by the leak.
e.zh: 他们因泄漏造成的损害提起诉讼。

e.en: Salt water {endamages} the metal fittings quickly.
e.zh: 盐水会很快损坏金属配件。

e.en: Repeated criticism {endamages} a child's confidence.
e.zh: 反复批评会伤害孩子的信心。

e.en: The storm was {endamaging} crops across the valley.
e.zh: 暴风雨正在损害山谷里的庄稼。

e.en: His silence proved {endamaging} during the inquiry.
e.zh: 在调查中，他的沉默后来显得很不利。

e.en: The doctor identified an {endameba} in the sample.
e.zh: 医生在样本中发现了一种内阿米巴。

e.en: An {endameba} can live inside the host's intestine.
e.zh: 内阿米巴可以生活在宿主的肠道内。

e.en: The specialist suspected {endangeitis} after the scan.
e.zh: 扫描后，专科医生怀疑是血管内膜炎。

e.en: Untreated {endangeitis} can narrow small blood vessels.
e.zh: 未经治疗的血管内膜炎会使小血管变窄。

e.en: The autopsy revealed severe {endaortitis}.
e.zh: 尸检发现了严重的主动脉内膜炎。

e.en: Chronic {endaortitis} may weaken the arterial wall.
e.zh: 慢性主动脉内膜炎可能削弱动脉壁。

e.en: The stem shows an {endarch} pattern of xylem growth.
e.zh: 这根茎显示出内始式木质部生长模式。

e.en: Botanists call this vascular arrangement {endarch}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种维管排列称为内始式。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed {endarteritis} in the small artery.
e.zh: 活检证实小动脉有动脉内膜炎。

e.en: Advanced {endarteritis} can restrict blood flow.
e.zh: 严重的动脉内膜炎会限制血液流动。

e.en: Plaque formed along the {endarterium}.
e.zh: 斑块沿动脉内膜形成。

e.en: The surgeon examined the torn {endarterium} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查撕裂的动脉内膜。

e.en: The {endbrain} develops early in the embryo.
e.zh: 端脑在胚胎早期就开始发育。

e.en: Damage to the {endbrain} affected memory and judgment.
e.zh: 端脑受损影响了记忆和判断。

e.en: The collector labeled the crystal as {endellionite}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块晶体标为恩德利昂石。

e.en: Rare {endellionite} was found in the old mine.
e.zh: 老矿井里发现了稀有的恩德利昂石。

e.en: The island has several {endemical} bird species.
e.zh: 这座岛有几种地方特有的鸟类。

e.en: Malaria was once {endemical} in the region.
e.zh: 疟疾曾经在该地区呈地方性流行。

e.en: The fever occurs {endemically} in coastal villages.
e.zh: 这种热病在沿海村庄地方性流行。

e.en: The plant grows {endemically} on those cliffs.
e.zh: 这种植物只在那些悬崖上特有生长。

e.en: Researchers measured malaria {endemicity} across the district.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了全区疟疾的地方流行程度。

e.en: High {endemicity} makes vaccination planning more urgent.
e.zh: 高地方流行性使疫苗规划更加紧迫。

e.en: Photosynthesis includes {endergonic} chemical reactions.
e.zh: 光合作用包含吸能的化学反应。

e.en: The cell drives an {endergonic} process with ATP.
e.zh: 细胞用ATP推动一个吸能过程。

e.en: The physician chose an {endermic} method for treatment.
e.zh: 医生选择了经皮方式进行治疗。

e.en: An {endermic} application delivers medicine through the skin.
e.zh: 经皮用药能让药物通过皮肤进入体内。

e.en: The microscope revealed a thin {endexine}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出一层薄薄的花粉内外壁层。

e.en: Pollen structure depends partly on the {endexine}.
e.zh: 花粉结构部分取决于内外壁层。

e.en: The farrier inspected the horse's {endfrog}.
e.zh: 蹄铁匠检查了马蹄叉的内侧部。

e.en: A bruised {endfrog} can make a horse limp.
e.zh: 马蹄叉内侧部挫伤会让马跛行。

e.en: The truck's {endgate} would not latch properly.
e.zh: 卡车的尾部闸门扣不上。

e.en: Workers opened the {endgate} to unload the grain.
e.zh: 工人打开端部闸门卸下谷物。

e.en: The mill hired an {endhand} for the late shift.
e.zh: 工厂为晚班雇了一名收尾工。

e.en: An experienced {endhand} checked the finished pieces.
e.zh: 一名经验丰富的收尾工检查了成品。

e.en: The chemist used an {endiometer} to test the gas.
e.zh: 化学家用气体分析仪检测这种气体。

e.en: An old {endiometer} stood on the laboratory shelf.
e.zh: 一台旧量气计放在实验室架子上。

endistance.t: 使相隔；拉开距离；疏远的距离感

e.en: The new policy seemed to {endistance} managers from the staff.
e.zh: 这项新政策似乎让管理层与员工更加疏远。

e.en: Long silence can {endistance} old friends without either noticing.
e.zh: 长久的沉默会在不知不觉中拉开老朋友之间的距离。

e.en: The clerk was asked to {endite} a formal reply.
e.zh: 书记员被要求起草一份正式回复。

e.en: She would {endite} verses for every village wedding.
e.zh: 她会为村里的每场婚礼吟作诗句。

e.en: He wrote the date on the {endleaf} of the old Bible.
e.zh: 他把日期写在那本旧圣经的衬页上。

e.en: A torn {endleaf} made the rare book less valuable.
e.zh: 一张破损的衬页让这本珍本书价值降低。

e.en: The boards were laid {endlong} across the narrow bridge.
e.zh: 木板沿纵向铺在那座窄桥上。

e.en: They stored the pipes {endlong} to save floor space.
e.zh: 他们把管子首尾顺着放，以节省地面空间。

e.en: The {endmost} seat gave her a clear view of the aisle.
e.zh: 最末端的座位让她能清楚看到过道。

e.en: Check the {endmost} shelf for the spare keys.
e.zh: 去最尽头的架子上找备用钥匙。

e.en: The surgeon chose {endoaneurysmorrhaphy} for the damaged vessel.
e.zh: 外科医生为受损血管选择了动脉瘤内缝合术。

e.en: Early texts describe {endoaneurysmorrhaphy} as a demanding operation.
e.zh: 早期文献把动脉瘤内缝合术描述为一项高难度手术。

e.en: The biopsy suggested {endoangiitis} in several small vessels.
e.zh: 活检显示几条小血管可能有血管内膜炎。

e.en: Untreated {endoangiitis} can narrow the affected arteries.
e.zh: 未经治疗的血管内膜炎可能使受累动脉变窄。

e.en: The patient developed {endoarteritis} after the infection spread.
e.zh: 感染扩散后，患者出现了动脉内膜炎。

e.en: Chronic {endoarteritis} may gradually restrict blood flow.
e.zh: 慢性动脉内膜炎可能逐渐限制血流。

e.en: The map marked an {endobatholithic} zone beneath the ridge.
e.zh: 地图标出了山脊下方的岩基内部区域。

e.en: They studied {endobatholithic} minerals from the granite body.
e.zh: 他们研究了来自花岗岩体内部的矿物。

e.en: The parasite depends on {endobiosis} for most of its life cycle.
e.zh: 这种寄生物生命周期的大部分依赖体内生活。

e.en: Researchers compared {endobiosis} with free-living bacterial forms.
e.zh: 研究人员把体内共生与自由生活的细菌形态作了比较。

e.en: The worm has an {endobiotic} stage inside the host.
e.zh: 这种虫在宿主体内有一个内生生活阶段。

e.en: Some fungi are {endobiotic} within plant tissues.
e.zh: 有些真菌在植物组织内部生活。

e.en: The embryo's {endoblast} later forms parts of the gut.
e.zh: 胚胎的内胚层后来会形成肠道的一些部分。

e.en: The diagram labels the {endoblast} beneath the outer layer.
e.zh: 图中把外层下方的内胚层标了出来。

e.en: The lab traced {endoblastic} cells during early development.
e.zh: 实验室追踪了早期发育中的内胚层细胞。

e.en: An {endoblastic} origin was proposed for the tissue.
e.zh: 有人提出该组织起源于内胚层。

e.en: The scan revealed an {endocardiac} mass near the valve.
e.zh: 扫描发现瓣膜附近有一个心内肿块。

e.en: Doctors monitored {endocardiac} pressure during the procedure.
e.zh: 医生在手术过程中监测心内压力。

e.en: Inflammation of the {endocardium} can damage heart valves.
e.zh: 心内膜发炎可能损伤心脏瓣膜。
