e.en: The {endocardium} lines the inner chambers of the heart.
e.zh: 心内膜覆盖心脏各腔的内表面。

e.en: In a peach, the hard stone is the {endocarp}.
e.zh: 在桃子里，坚硬的果核层就是果内皮。

e.en: The {endocarp} protects the seed inside the fruit.
e.zh: 果内皮保护果实内部的种子。

e.en: The paper describes {endocaryogamy} in a rare fungal species.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种罕见真菌中的核内融合。

e.en: Under the microscope, {endocaryogamy} occurred within one cell.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，核内配合发生在一个细胞内。

e.en: The fossil {endocast} preserved the shape of the brain cavity.
e.zh: 这件化石颅腔内模保留了脑腔的形状。

e.en: Scientists used an {endocast} to study the animal's senses.
e.zh: 科学家利用内部铸型研究这种动物的感官。

e.en: The drug affects {endocellular} signaling pathways.
e.zh: 这种药物会影响细胞内信号通路。

e.en: They measured {endocellular} fluid changes after stimulation.
e.zh: 他们测量了刺激后细胞内液体的变化。

endocentric.t: 向心结构的；有中心词的

e.en: Blackbird is often analyzed as an {endocentric} compound.
e.zh: blackbird 常被分析为有中心词的复合词。

e.en: An {endocentric} phrase has a head that defines its category.
e.zh: 向心短语有一个决定其类别的中心词。

e.en: The museum displayed an {endoceratite} from Ordovician rocks.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自奥陶纪岩层的内角石类化石。

e.en: An {endoceratite} shell can reveal ancient marine conditions.
e.zh: 内角石类化石的壳体能透露古代海洋环境。

e.en: The specialist recommended {endocervicectomy} after abnormal results.
e.zh: 检查结果异常后，专科医生建议进行宫颈内膜切除术。

e.en: Recovery from {endocervicectomy} depends on the extent of surgery.
e.zh: 宫颈内膜切除术后的恢复取决于手术范围。

endochondral.t: 软骨内的；经软骨形成的

e.en: Long bones develop through {endochondral} ossification.
e.zh: 长骨通过软骨内骨化发育而成。

e.en: The study focused on {endochondral} growth in young animals.
e.zh: 这项研究关注幼年动物的软骨内生长。

e.en: The fish carries an {endocommensal} organism in its gut.
e.zh: 这种鱼的肠道里带有一种体内共栖生物。

e.en: An {endocommensal} microbe benefits without harming the host.
e.zh: 体内共栖微生物受益而不伤害宿主。

endocomplement.t: 内补体；细胞内补体成分

e.en: The assay detected {endocomplement} inside the immune cells.
e.zh: 检测在免疫细胞内发现了内补体成分。

e.en: Older immunology texts mention {endocomplement} only briefly.
e.zh: 较早的免疫学文献只简略提到内补体。

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {endoconidiotoxicosis} after the mold exposure.
e.zh: 霉菌暴露后，兽医怀疑是内生分生孢子中毒症。

e.en: Cases of {endoconidiotoxicosis} are rarely described outside specialist reports.
e.zh: 内生分生孢子中毒症的病例很少出现在专业报告之外。

e.en: Each {endoconidium} developed inside the fungal cell.
e.zh: 每个内生分生孢子都在真菌细胞内部发育。

e.en: The slide showed an {endoconidium} under high magnification.
e.zh: 载玻片在高倍放大下显示出一个内生分生孢子。

e.en: The scan revealed {endocranial} pressure changes.
e.zh: 扫描显示颅内压力发生了变化。

e.en: Researchers measured the {endocranial} volume of the fossil skull.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这块化石头骨的颅腔容量。

e.en: The {endocranium} protects the brain from direct injury.
e.zh: 颅腔保护大脑免受直接损伤。

e.en: Marks on the {endocranium} helped identify ancient blood vessels.
e.zh: 颅骨内面的痕迹帮助识别了古代血管。

e.en: The paper described a possible {endocrator} in hormone control.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种可能参与激素控制的内分泌调节物。

e.en: This experimental {endocrator} affected several metabolic pathways.
e.zh: 这种实验性内分泌调节物影响了多条代谢通路。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests for {endocrinal} imbalance.
e.zh: 医生要求检查是否存在内分泌失衡。

e.en: Stress can disturb normal {endocrinal} function.
e.zh: 压力可能扰乱正常的内分泌功能。

e.en: The patient needed an {endocrinologic} evaluation before surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术前需要接受内分泌学评估。

e.en: Her symptoms raised several {endocrinologic} questions.
e.zh: 她的症状提出了几个内分泌学方面的问题。

e.en: The rash was linked to an {endocrinopathic} disorder.
e.zh: 这种皮疹与一种内分泌病性疾病有关。

e.en: Some {endocrinopathic} changes appear slowly over years.
e.zh: 有些内分泌病性变化会在多年间缓慢出现。

e.en: Diabetes is a common form of {endocrinopathy}.
e.zh: 糖尿病是一种常见的内分泌病。

e.en: The clinic treats children with rare {endocrinopathies}.
e.zh: 这家诊所治疗患有罕见内分泌病的儿童。

e.en: The tumor responded well to {endocrinotherapy}.
e.zh: 这种肿瘤对内分泌治疗反应良好。

e.en: Doctors discussed {endocrinotherapy} as a long-term option.
e.zh: 医生们讨论了把内分泌治疗作为长期方案。

e.en: The sect guarded its {endoctrine} from outsiders.
e.zh: 这个教派不让外人接触其内部教义。

e.en: His essay invents an {endoctrine} of private moral law.
e.zh: 他的文章提出了一套私人道德法的内在学说。

e.en: The virus entered through an {endocytic} pathway.
e.zh: 这种病毒通过胞吞途径进入细胞。

e.en: Researchers tracked {endocytic} vesicles in living cells.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了活细胞中的胞吞囊泡。

e.en: Cells can {endocytose} particles from their surroundings.
e.zh: 细胞能够内吞周围环境中的颗粒。

e.en: The drug helps macrophages {endocytose} damaged material.
e.zh: 这种药物帮助巨噬细胞内吞受损物质。

e.en: The molecule enters the cell by {endocytosis}.
e.zh: 这种分子通过胞吞作用进入细胞。

e.en: Blocking {endocytosis} reduced the infection rate.
e.zh: 阻断胞吞作用降低了感染率。

e.en: The {endoderm} later forms parts of the gut.
e.zh: 内胚层随后会形成肠道的部分结构。

e.en: Embryology students learn how the {endoderm} develops.
e.zh: 胚胎学学生会学习内胚层如何发育。

e.en: The root {endodermis} controls water movement into the plant.
e.zh: 根的内皮层控制水分进入植物体内。

e.en: A clear {endodermis} was visible in the stem section.
e.zh: 茎的切片中可以看到清晰的内皮层。

e.en: She chose {endodontia} as her dental specialty.
e.zh: 她选择牙髓病学作为自己的牙科专科。

e.en: Modern {endodontia} often saves teeth that once were removed.
e.zh: 现代牙髓病学常能保住过去会被拔掉的牙齿。

e.en: He needed {endodontic} treatment after the infection spread.
e.zh: 感染扩散后，他需要接受根管治疗。

e.en: The dentist used special {endodontic} instruments.
e.zh: 牙医使用了专门的牙髓治疗器械。

e.en: The tooth was treated {endodontically} before the crown was placed.
e.zh: 装牙冠前，这颗牙已经过根管治疗。

e.en: A tooth managed {endodontically} can remain functional for years.
e.zh: 经过根管治疗处理的牙齿可以多年保持功能。

e.en: She referred him to a clinic specializing in {endodontics}.
e.zh: 她把他转到一家专门做牙髓病学治疗的诊所。

e.en: Advances in {endodontics} have made root canals less painful.
e.zh: 牙髓病学的进步让根管治疗不那么痛苦。

e.en: My dentist sent me to an {endodontist}.
e.zh: 我的牙医把我转给了一位牙髓专科医生。

e.en: The {endodontist} repaired the infected root canal.
e.zh: 牙髓专科医生修复了受感染的根管。

e.en: The bacterium produces an {endoenzyme} that breaks down starch.
e.zh: 这种细菌产生一种能分解淀粉的胞内酶。

e.en: An {endoenzyme} acts inside the cell rather than outside it.
e.zh: 胞内酶在细胞内部而不是外部发挥作用。

e.en: Photosynthesis includes {endoergic} steps that store energy.
e.zh: 光合作用包含储存能量的吸能步骤。

e.en: The reaction is {endoergic} under normal laboratory conditions.
e.zh: 在正常实验室条件下，这个反应是吸能的。

e.en: Malaria parasites have an {endoerythrocytic} stage.
e.zh: 疟原虫有一个红细胞内阶段。

e.en: The drug targets the {endoerythrocytic} form of the parasite.
e.zh: 这种药物针对寄生虫的红细胞内形态。

e.en: The surgeon monitored {endogastric} pressure during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中监测胃内压力。

e.en: An {endogastric} device was used to deliver the medication.
e.zh: 医生使用胃内装置来输送药物。

e.en: The bacterium acted as an {endogen} within the host tissue.
e.zh: 这种细菌在宿主组织内起着内生物的作用。

e.en: Researchers traced the {endogen} to processes inside the cell.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种内源物质追溯到细胞内部的过程。

e.en: The study examined {endogenesis} in early tissue development.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了早期组织发育中的内源发生。

e.en: Geologists debated whether the mineral showed signs of {endogenesis}.
e.zh: 地质学家争论这种矿物是否显示出内生形成的迹象。

e.en: The team proposed an {endogenetic} explanation for the abnormal growth.
e.zh: 团队提出了对这种异常生长的内源发生解释。

e.en: Some rocks preserve {endogenetic} features formed deep below the surface.
e.zh: 有些岩石保留了在地表深处形成的内生特征。

e.en: The symptoms may reflect an {endogenic} disorder rather than infection.
e.zh: 这些症状可能反映的是内源性疾病，而不是感染。

e.en: Volcanic heat is an {endogenic} force within the Earth.
e.zh: 火山热是地球内部的一种内生力量。

e.en: The model assumes {endogeny} in several economic variables.
e.zh: 这个模型假定几个经济变量具有内生性。

e.en: Biologists used {endogeny} to describe development from internal causes.
e.zh: 生物学家用内源状态来描述由内部原因引起的发育。

e.en: The parasite showed {endoglobular} growth inside red blood cells.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在红细胞内表现出血球内生长。

e.en: Doctors noted {endoglobular} changes during the microscopic examination.
e.zh: 医生在显微检查中注意到血球内的变化。

e.en: The surgeon avoided damaging the {endoglossic} muscle fibers.
e.zh: 外科医生避免损伤舌内的肌纤维。

e.en: The paper analyzed {endoglossic} norms within the speech community.
e.zh: 论文分析了该语言社群内部的语言规范。

e.en: The fungus secretes {endoglucanase} to break down plant cellulose.
e.zh: 这种真菌分泌内切葡聚糖酶来分解植物纤维素。

e.en: Engineers increased {endoglucanase} activity in the industrial enzyme mix.
e.zh: 工程师提高了工业酶混合物中的内切葡聚糖酶活性。

e.en: Scientists found {endolithic} microbes living inside desert rocks.
e.zh: 科学家发现了生活在沙漠岩石内部的微生物。

e.en: The lichen has an {endolithic} form that protects it from sunlight.
e.zh: 这种地衣有一种岩石内部生长的形态，可避开强光。

e.en: The inner ear contains {endolymph} that helps maintain balance.
e.zh: 内耳含有帮助维持平衡的内淋巴液。

e.en: Excess {endolymph} can contribute to dizziness and hearing problems.
e.zh: 内淋巴液过多可能导致头晕和听力问题。

e.en: The phage produces {endolysin} to break the bacterial cell wall.
e.zh: 这种噬菌体产生内溶素来破坏细菌细胞壁。

e.en: Researchers tested {endolysin} as a possible antibacterial treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员测试内溶素作为潜在的抗菌疗法。

e.en: The intrusion caused {endometamorphism} within the cooling magma body.
e.zh: 这次侵入在冷却的岩浆体内部引起了内变质作用。

e.en: Students compared contact metamorphism with {endometamorphism} in the sample.
e.zh: 学生们把样本中的接触变质作用与内变质作用作了比较。

e.en: The slides showed healthy {endometria} from several patients.
e.zh: 这些切片显示了几名患者健康的子宫内膜。

e.en: Different {endometria} respond differently to hormonal changes.
e.zh: 不同的子宫内膜对激素变化的反应并不相同。

e.en: Postpartum fever can sometimes indicate {endometritis}.
e.zh: 产后发热有时可能提示子宫内膜炎。

e.en: The veterinarian treated the cow for chronic {endometritis}.
e.zh: 兽医为这头奶牛治疗慢性子宫内膜炎。

e.en: Megakaryocytes often undergo {endomitosis} during platelet production.
e.zh: 巨核细胞在产生血小板时常发生核内有丝分裂。

e.en: The textbook describes {endomitosis} as chromosome replication without cell division.
e.zh: 教科书把核内有丝分裂描述为没有细胞分裂的染色体复制。

e.en: Some protozoa reproduce through {endomixis} under certain conditions.
e.zh: 某些原生动物在特定条件下通过内配合繁殖。

e.en: The lecture contrasted {endomixis} with ordinary sexual reproduction.
e.zh: 讲座把内配合与普通有性生殖作了对比。

e.en: The scan suggested an {endomomental} mass near the stomach.
e.zh: 扫描显示胃附近可能有一个大网膜内肿块。

e.en: Surgeons inspected the {endomomental} space for hidden bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生检查大网膜内空间是否有隐匿出血。

e.en: He had an {endomorphic} build with a broad waist.
e.zh: 他的体型偏内胚型，腰身较宽。

e.en: The mineral displayed {endomorphic} changes after heating.
e.zh: 这种矿物在加热后显示出内形态变化。

e.en: In algebra, an {endomorphism} maps a structure to itself.
e.zh: 在代数学中，自同态把一个结构映射到它自身。

e.en: The geologist described the crystal change as {endomorphism}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种晶体变化描述为内形态变化。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed viral {endomyocarditis} in the patient.
e.zh: 活检确认这名患者患有病毒性心内膜心肌炎。

e.en: Untreated {endomyocarditis} can weaken the heart severely.
e.zh: 未经治疗的心内膜心肌炎可能严重削弱心脏功能。

e.en: The {endomysium} surrounds each individual muscle fiber.
e.zh: 肌内膜包绕着每一根单独的肌纤维。

e.en: Celiac disease can produce antibodies against the {endomysium}.
e.zh: 乳糜泻可能产生针对肌内膜的抗体。

e.en: The old anatomical text used {endon} to mean the inner part.
e.zh: 这本旧解剖学著作用endon表示内部部分。

e.en: Philosophers sometimes contrasted the {endon} with the outward appearance.
e.zh: 哲学家有时把内在部分同外在表象相对照。

e.en: The {endoneurium} protects individual nerve fibers within a nerve.
e.zh: 神经内膜保护神经内部的单根神经纤维。

e.en: Inflammation in the {endoneurium} may affect signal conduction.
e.zh: 神经内膜中的炎症可能影响信号传导。

e.en: The palynologist identified the {endonexine} in the pollen wall.
e.zh: 孢粉学家在花粉壁中识别出花粉内外壁层。

e.en: Damage to the {endonexine} changed the grain's microscopic appearance.
e.zh: 花粉内外壁层受损改变了花粉粒的显微外观。

e.en: The variety developed an {endonormative} standard among local speakers.
e.zh: 这种变体在本地说话者中形成了以内在规范为准的标准。

e.en: Editors favored {endonormative} usage instead of imported rules.
e.zh: 编辑们偏好本土内部规范的用法，而不是外来的规则。

e.en: The membrane's {endosity} affected the dye movement.
e.zh: 这层膜的内渗性影响了染料的移动。

e.en: Researchers measured {endosity} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控条件下测量了内吸性质。

e.en: Water entered the cell by {endosmose}.
e.zh: 水通过内渗进入了细胞。

e.en: The old text described {endosmose} in plant tissues.
e.zh: 那本旧书描述了植物组织中的向内渗透。

e.en: The solution swelled through {endosmosis}.
e.zh: 溶液因内渗作用而膨胀。

e.en: Students observed {endosmosis} across the thin membrane.
e.zh: 学生们观察到液体穿过薄膜的向内渗透作用。

e.en: The {endosmotic} flow increased after heating.
e.zh: 加热后，内渗流动增强了。

e.en: They recorded an {endosmotic} pressure change.
e.zh: 他们记录到一次向内渗透的压力变化。

e.en: The virus escaped from the {endosome}.
e.zh: 病毒从内体中逃逸出来。

e.en: Proteins were sorted inside the {endosome}.
e.zh: 蛋白质在内吞小体内被分选。

e.en: Microbes colonized the root {endosphere}.
e.zh: 微生物定植在根部内球层。

e.en: The model divides Earth into crust and {endosphere}.
e.zh: 该模型把地球分为地壳和内部圈层。

e.en: The bacterium formed an {endospore} during stress.
e.zh: 这种细菌在压力下形成了芽孢。

e.en: An {endospore} can survive extreme heat.
e.zh: 内生孢子能在极端高温下存活。

e.en: The stain highlighted the {endosporium} clearly.
e.zh: 染色清楚地显示出孢子内层。

e.en: Damage to the {endosporium} reduced spore survival.
e.zh: 内孢壁受损降低了孢子的存活率。

endosporous.t: 具内生孢子的；芽孢性的

e.en: The culture contained {endosporous} bacterial cells.
e.zh: 培养物中含有具内生孢子的细菌细胞。

e.en: An {endosporous} form helps the organism persist.
e.zh: 芽孢性形态帮助该生物长期存活。

endosporulation.t: 内生孢子形成；芽孢形成

e.en: Nutrient stress triggered {endosporulation} in the colony.
e.zh: 营养压力触发了菌落中的芽孢形成。

e.en: They studied {endosporulation} under a microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下研究内生孢子形成。

e.en: The damaged {endostea} showed signs of repair.
e.zh: 受损的骨内膜显示出修复迹象。

e.en: Surgeons avoided scraping the {endostea} unnecessarily.
e.zh: 外科医生避免不必要地刮伤内骨膜。

e.en: The scan showed {endosteal} bone growth.
e.zh: 扫描显示出骨内膜性骨生长。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {endosteal} surface after surgery.
e.zh: 医生在术后监测内骨膜表面。

e.en: The implant was fixed {endosteally} in the jaw.
e.zh: 植入物被固定在颌骨的内骨膜上。

e.en: New tissue spread {endosteally} along the canal.
e.zh: 新组织沿骨内膜在管道内扩展。

e.en: The insect's {endosternite} supports internal muscles.
e.zh: 昆虫的内胸骨片支撑内部肌肉。

e.en: A broken {endosternite} changed the specimen's posture.
e.zh: 破裂的内腹板改变了标本的姿态。

e.en: The {endosteum} lines the inner bone cavity.
e.zh: 骨内膜覆盖着骨腔内壁。

e.en: Inflammation reached the {endosteum} after infection.
e.zh: 感染后炎症蔓延到内骨膜。

e.en: The X-ray revealed a small {endostosis}.
e.zh: X光片显示出一处小的骨内增生。

e.en: Pain was linked to {endostosis} near the joint.
e.zh: 疼痛与关节附近的内生骨赘有关。

e.en: The pearl forms near the {endostracum}.
e.zh: 珍珠在壳内层附近形成。

e.en: Microscopy showed layers within the {endostracum}.
e.zh: 显微观察显示内壳质层中有多层结构。

e.en: The larva uses its {endostyle} to trap food.
e.zh: 幼体用咽下沟捕获食物。

e.en: The {endostyle} is linked to thyroid evolution.
e.zh: 内柱与甲状腺的演化有关。

e.en: The farm stopped using {endosulfan} years ago.
e.zh: 这家农场多年前已停止使用硫丹。

e.en: Tests found {endosulfan} residues in the soil.
e.zh: 检测发现土壤中有硫丹残留。

e.en: Mitochondria likely arose through {endosymbiosis}.
e.zh: 线粒体很可能起源于内共生。

e.en: The lecture explained {endosymbiosis} in early cells.
e.zh: 讲座解释了早期细胞中的细胞内共生。

e.en: The seed's {endotesta} hardened during drying.
e.zh: 种子的内种皮在干燥过程中变硬。

e.en: Pigments accumulated in the {endotesta}.
e.zh: 色素积累在种皮内层。

e.en: The coral's {endotheca} strengthened its skeleton.
e.zh: 珊瑚的内鞘增强了骨骼结构。

e.en: Researchers examined the {endotheca} of the anther.
e.zh: 研究人员检查了花药的内壁层。

e.en: The {endothecium} helps the anther open.
e.zh: 药室内壁有助于花药开裂。

e.en: Cells in the {endothecium} thickened as pollen matured.
e.zh: 花粉成熟时，内壁层细胞逐渐增厚。

e.en: Different {endothelia} respond to inflammation differently.
e.zh: 不同内皮组织对炎症的反应各不相同。

e.en: The samples contained damaged {endothelia}.
e.zh: 样本中含有受损的内皮组织。

endothelioid.t: 内皮样的；似内皮细胞的

e.en: The biopsy showed {endothelioid} tumor cells.
e.zh: 活检显示有内皮样肿瘤细胞。

e.en: They described an {endothelioid} pattern under microscopy.
e.zh: 他们描述了显微镜下似内皮细胞的形态。

endonucleolytic.t: 核酸内切裂解的；内切核酸的

e.en: The enzyme showed {endonucleolytic} activity on damaged DNA.
e.zh: 这种酶对受损DNA表现出核酸内切裂解活性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {endonucleolytic} cleavage rate in vitro.
e.zh: 研究人员在体外测量了内切核酸裂解速率。

endoparasite.t: 体内寄生虫；内寄生生物

e.en: The tapeworm is an {endoparasite} that lives inside its host.
e.zh: 绦虫是一种生活在宿主体内的内寄生虫。

e.en: Veterinarians tested the animal for common {endoparasites}.
e.zh: 兽医检测了这只动物是否有常见的体内寄生虫。

endoparasitic.t: 体内寄生的；内寄生性的

e.en: Some worms have an {endoparasitic} life cycle.
e.zh: 有些蠕虫具有体内寄生的生活周期。

e.en: The study compared free-living and {endoparasitic} species.
e.zh: 这项研究比较了自由生活物种和内寄生物种。

e.en: This {endopeptidase} cuts proteins at internal peptide bonds.
e.zh: 这种内肽酶会切开蛋白质内部的肽键。

e.en: The drug inhibits a bacterial {endopeptidase}.
e.zh: 这种药物会抑制一种细菌内肽酶。

endoperoxide.t: 内过氧化物；环内过氧化物

e.en: Artemisinin contains an unusual {endoperoxide} bridge.
e.zh: 青蒿素含有一种不寻常的内过氧桥。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a stable {endoperoxide} compound.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一种稳定的内过氧化物。

endophagous.t: 在内部取食的；内食性的

e.en: The larvae are {endophagous} and feed inside the stem.
e.zh: 这些幼虫在植物茎内部取食，属于内食性。

e.en: An {endophagous} insect may be hard to detect early.
e.zh: 内食性昆虫在早期可能很难被发现。

e.en: Psychologists use {endophasia} to describe silent inner speech.
e.zh: 心理学家用内言语来描述无声的内心语言。

e.en: During reading, {endophasia} may shape how words are processed.
e.zh: 阅读时，心中默语可能影响词语的处理方式。

endophilic.t: 喜在室内栖息的；内生境偏好的

e.en: The mosquito is {endophilic} and rests inside houses.
e.zh: 这种蚊子喜在室内栖息，常停留在屋内。

e.en: Control programs target {endophilic} insects with indoor spraying.
e.zh: 防控项目用室内喷洒来针对喜室内栖息的昆虫。

e.en: The fungus is an {endophyte} living inside healthy leaves.
e.zh: 这种真菌是生活在健康叶片内部的内生菌。

e.en: An {endophyte} can help a plant resist drought.
e.zh: 内生菌可以帮助植物抵抗干旱。

e.en: The amoeba's {endoplasm} streamed toward the food particle.
e.zh: 变形虫的内质朝食物颗粒流动。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {endoplasm} looked granular.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，细胞内质看起来呈颗粒状。

e.en: Older texts sometimes call the cell nucleus an {endoplast}.
e.zh: 较早的文献有时把细胞核称为内质体。

e.en: The biologist noted an {endoplast} in the protozoan cell.
e.zh: 生物学家记录了原生动物细胞中的内质体。

e.en: The seed's {endopleura} protects the developing embryo.
e.zh: 种子的内种皮保护正在发育的胚。

e.en: Botanists examined the {endopleura} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察了种皮内层。

endopodite.t: 内肢；节肢动物附肢内支

e.en: The crustacean limb includes an {endopodite} and an exopodite.
e.zh: 甲壳动物的肢体包括内肢和外肢。

e.en: Damage to the {endopodite} affected the animal's movement.
e.zh: 内肢受损影响了这种动物的运动。

endopolyploid.t: 内多倍体的；细胞内多倍化的

e.en: Some plant tissues become {endopolyploid} during development.
e.zh: 一些植物组织在发育过程中会变成内多倍体。

e.en: The lab counted nuclei in {endopolyploid} cells.
e.zh: 实验室统计了内多倍体细胞中的细胞核。

e.en: An {endoproct} has its anus inside the ring of tentacles.
e.zh: 内肛动物的肛门位于触手环内部。

e.en: The specimen was identified as a marine {endoproct}.
e.zh: 这个标本被鉴定为一种海生内肛动物。

endoprosthesis.t: 体内假体；植入式内假体

e.en: The surgeon replaced the joint with an {endoprosthesis}.
e.zh: 外科医生用体内假体替换了这个关节。

e.en: A metal {endoprosthesis} supported the damaged bone.
e.zh: 金属内假体支撑了受损的骨骼。

e.en: The analyst explored the patient's {endopsychic} conflicts.
e.zh: 分析师探讨了患者内心的冲突。

e.en: Dreams may reveal {endopsychic} tensions.
e.zh: 梦境可能揭示心理内部的紧张。

endoradiosonde.t: 体内无线电探测器；内放射探测器

e.en: The patient swallowed an {endoradiosonde} for diagnostic monitoring.
e.zh: 患者吞下体内无线电探测器以便进行诊断监测。

e.en: An {endoradiosonde} can transmit data from inside the body.
e.zh: 体内无线电探测器可以从身体内部传输数据。

endoradiosonds.t: 体内无线电探测器复数形式

e.en: Early {endoradiosonds} were larger than modern capsule devices.
e.zh: 早期的体内无线电探测器比现代胶囊设备更大。

e.en: The hospital ordered several {endoradiosonds} for research trials.
e.zh: 医院为研究试验订购了几个体内无线电探测器。

e.en: The proposal is {endorsable} if the budget is revised.
e.zh: 如果预算经过修改，这项提案是可以赞同的。

e.en: Only properly {endorsable} checks can be transferred.
e.zh: 只有可依法背书的支票才能转让。

e.en: The {endorsee} may claim payment from the bank.
e.zh: 被背书人可以向银行要求付款。

e.en: Her name appeared as the {endorsee} on the check.
e.zh: 她的名字作为被背书人出现在支票上。

e.en: The {endorsor} signed the back of the bill.
e.zh: 背书人在票据背面签了名。

e.en: A respected {endorsor} helped the campaign gain trust.
e.zh: 一位受尊敬的赞同者帮助这场活动赢得信任。

endosarc.t: 内质；原生动物内层原生质

e.en: The amoeba's {endosarc} moved slowly under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，变形虫的内质缓慢移动。

e.en: Food vacuoles formed within the {endosarc}.
e.zh: 食物泡在内质中形成。

endoscopist.t: 内镜医师；内窥镜检查医生

e.en: The {endoscopist} found a small ulcer.
e.zh: 内镜医师发现了一处小溃疡。

e.en: An experienced {endoscopist} performed the procedure safely.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的内镜医生安全地完成了检查。

endosexine.t: 花粉外壁内层；内外壁层

e.en: The pollen's {endosexine} was visible after staining.
e.zh: 染色后可以看到花粉外壁内层。

e.en: Palynologists measured the thickness of the {endosexine}.
e.zh: 孢粉学家测量了花粉外壁内层的厚度。

endothelioma.t: 内皮组织肿瘤样病变或肿瘤

e.en: The biopsy suggested an {endothelioma} near the vessel wall.
e.zh: 活检提示血管壁附近有内皮组织肿瘤。

e.en: Older papers sometimes used {endothelioma} for tumors now classified differently.
e.zh: 早期论文有时用内皮瘤称呼如今另行分类的肿瘤。

e.en: The pathologist noted {endotheloid} cells in the sample.
e.zh: 病理医生注意到样本中有内皮样细胞。

e.en: Its {endotheloid} appearance made the diagnosis more difficult.
e.zh: 它呈内皮样外观，使诊断更加困难。

e.en: The report described an {endothermal} process during the reaction.
e.zh: 报告描述了反应过程中的吸热过程。

e.en: Some engineers prefer {endothermal} materials for controlled heat absorption.
e.zh: 一些工程师偏好用吸热材料来控制热量吸收。

e.en: Melting ice is an {endothermic} process.
e.zh: 冰融化是一个吸热过程。

e.en: Birds are {endothermic} animals that regulate body temperature internally.
e.zh: 鸟类是能在体内调节体温的温血动物。

e.en: Mammals rely on {endothermy} to stay active in cold weather.
e.zh: 哺乳动物依靠内温调节在寒冷天气中保持活跃。

e.en: The evolution of {endothermy} changed how animals used energy.
e.zh: 温血性的演化改变了动物利用能量的方式。

e.en: The farm stopped using {endothion} after stricter safety rules.
e.zh: 安全规定收紧后，农场停止使用这种有机磷杀虫剂。

e.en: Laboratory tests measured traces of {endothion} in the soil.
e.zh: 实验室检测了土壤中微量的内硫磷残留。

e.en: The vaccine study tested an {endotoxoid} preparation.
e.zh: 这项疫苗研究测试了一种内毒素类毒素制剂。

e.en: Researchers compared the {endotoxoid} with untreated bacterial toxin.
e.zh: 研究人员将这种内毒素类毒素与未经处理的细菌毒素作比较。

endotracheitis.t: 气管内炎症；气管内膜炎

e.en: The patient developed {endotracheitis} after prolonged intubation.
e.zh: 患者长期插管后出现气管内炎症。

e.en: Doctors treated the {endotracheitis} with antibiotics and airway care.
e.zh: 医生用抗生素和气道护理治疗气管内膜炎。

e.en: The parasite has an {endotrophic} stage inside its host.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫在宿主体内有一个内营养阶段。

e.en: Botanists described the fungus as {endotrophic} in young roots.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种真菌描述为在幼根内取食。

e.en: The worm has an {endozoic} phase in marine fish.
e.zh: 这种蠕虫在海鱼体内有一个体内生活阶段。

e.en: Some seeds survive {endozoic} transport through birds.
e.zh: 有些种子能经由鸟类体内运输后仍然存活。

endplay.t: 桥牌残局打法；轴向间隙

e.en: Her clever {endplay} forced the defender to lead into her tenace.
e.zh: 她巧妙的桥牌残局打法迫使防守方出牌送入她的夹张。

e.en: The mechanic measured excessive {endplay} in the crankshaft.
e.zh: 技师测出曲轴的轴向间隙过大。

e.en: The old pesticide {endrin} is banned in many countries.
e.zh: 这种旧式杀虫剂狄氏剂在许多国家被禁用。

e.en: Scientists found {endrin} residues in sediment near the factory.
e.zh: 科学家在工厂附近的沉积物中发现狄氏剂残留。

e.en: The motor's {endshield} was cracked after years of vibration.
e.zh: 多年振动后，电机端盖裂开了。

e.en: Technicians removed the {endshield} to inspect the bearing.
e.zh: 技术人员拆下端盖检查轴承。

e.en: The bridge was {endurably} built for harsh winters.
e.zh: 这座桥建得很耐久，能经受严冬。

e.en: Her influence remained {endurably} present in the school.
e.zh: 她的影响在这所学校中长期存在。

e.en: The hikers were {endurant} despite the freezing rain.
e.zh: 尽管下着冰冷的雨，徒步者们仍很能忍耐。

e.en: In philosophy, a chair is often treated as an {endurant}.
e.zh: 在哲学中，椅子常被看作一种持久存在物。

e.en: The tunnel's {endwall} showed signs of water damage.
e.zh: 隧道端壁出现了水损痕迹。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the turbine {endwall} to reduce losses.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计涡轮端壁以减少损失。

e.en: She stacked the books {endways} on the narrow shelf.
e.zh: 她把书竖着码在狭窄的书架上。

e.en: The plank slid {endways} through the doorway.
e.zh: 木板端朝前地滑过门口。

e.en: Place the tiles {endwise} along the border.
e.zh: 沿边缘把瓷砖端对端地铺好。

e.en: The rod was loaded {endwise} during the test.
e.zh: 测试时这根杆受到轴向加载。

e.en: The manuscript uses {endyma} for a garment worn in ritual.
e.zh: 这份手稿用endyma指仪式中穿的衣物。

e.en: Scholars glossed {endyma} as a covering rather than an ornament.
e.zh: 学者把endyma解释为覆盖物，而不是装饰品。

e.en: The chemist synthesized an {enelone} for the reaction study.
e.zh: 化学家为反应研究合成了一种烯酮类化合物。

e.en: This {enelone} reacts quickly with the chosen nucleophile.
e.zh: 这种烯酮类化合物会与所选亲核试剂迅速反应。

enepidermic.t: 表皮内的；位于表皮上的

e.en: The lesion showed {enepidermic} changes under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见病灶有表皮内变化。

e.en: Researchers studied {enepidermic} pigment cells in the tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了组织中的表皮内色素细胞。

e.en: Her {energic} speech stirred the whole room.
e.zh: 她充满活力的演讲打动了全场。

e.en: The old critic praised his {energic} prose.
e.zh: 那位老评论家称赞他的散文有力。

e.en: The dancer gave an {energid} performance.
e.zh: 那名舞者献上了一场充满活力的表演。

e.en: His {energid} reply surprised the committee.
e.zh: 他有劲的回答让委员会感到意外。

e.en: The essay links {energism} with early theories of will.
e.zh: 这篇文章把活力论同早期的意志理论联系起来。

e.en: His philosophy treated {energism} as a social principle.
e.zh: 他的哲学把能动学说视为一种社会原则。

e.en: The grid requires careful {energization} after repairs.
e.zh: 电网维修后需要谨慎供能。

e.en: The coach focused on the team's {energization}.
e.zh: 教练把重点放在激发球队活力上。

e.en: The monk described the man as an {energumen}.
e.zh: 那名修士把这个人描述成被邪灵附身者。

e.en: Critics called the speaker a political {energumen}.
e.zh: 批评者称这位演讲者是政治狂热者。

e.en: We bought an {energy-efficient} washing machine.
e.zh: 我们买了一台节能洗衣机。

e.en: The building uses {energy-efficient} lighting throughout.
e.zh: 这栋楼到处都使用能效高的照明。

e.en: Data centers are often {energy-hungry} facilities.
e.zh: 数据中心往往是耗能很大的设施。

e.en: The expanding city became increasingly {energy-hungry}.
e.zh: 这座不断扩张的城市变得越来越急需能源。

energy-intensive.t: 能源密集型的；高耗能的

e.en: Steelmaking is an {energy-intensive} industry.
e.zh: 炼钢是一个能源密集型行业。

e.en: The company reduced its {energy-intensive} processes.
e.zh: 公司减少了高耗能的生产流程。

e.en: The report covers several {energy-related} risks.
e.zh: 这份报告涵盖了几项与能源有关的风险。

e.en: They discussed {energy-related} taxes at the meeting.
e.zh: 他们在会上讨论了与能源有关的税收。

energyintensive.t: 能源密集型的；高耗能的

e.en: The article used {energyintensive} as a compound adjective.
e.zh: 这篇文章把energyintensive用作复合形容词。

e.en: Some databases list {energyintensive} without a hyphen.
e.zh: 有些数据库把energyintensive列为不带连字符的写法。

e.en: The map shows the proposed {energyline} route.
e.zh: 地图显示了拟建能源线路的走向。

e.en: The healer spoke of an invisible {energyline}.
e.zh: 那位治疗师谈到一条看不见的能量线。

e.en: The long illness left him in {enervation}.
e.zh: 长期患病使他陷入衰弱状态。

e.en: She blamed the summer heat for her {enervation}.
e.zh: 她把自己的精力耗尽归咎于夏天的炎热。

e.en: The climate had an {enervative} effect on travelers.
e.zh: 这种气候对旅客有使人衰弱的影响。

e.en: He disliked the {enervative} routine of court life.
e.zh: 他不喜欢宫廷生活那种耗神的日常。

e.en: Luxury can {enerve} a once vigorous nation.
e.zh: 奢靡会削弱一个曾经充满活力的国家。

e.en: The humid air seemed to {enerve} the workers.
e.zh: 潮湿的空气似乎使工人们变得衰弱。

e.en: The old textbook classified anxiety as {eneurosis}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把焦虑归为神经官能症。

e.en: Doctors no longer use {eneurosis} in ordinary diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生在普通诊断中已不再使用eneurosis这个词。

e.en: The portrait was drawn {enface} rather than in profile.
e.zh: 这幅肖像画的是正面，而不是侧面。

e.en: The two seals were printed {enface} on the page.
e.zh: 两个印章在页面上正面对置地印出。

e.en: Age brought a gradual {enfeeblement} of his body.
e.zh: 年岁带来了他身体的逐渐衰弱。

e.en: The scandal caused the party's political {enfeeblement}.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻导致该党的政治力量被削弱。

e.en: The lord agreed to {enfeoff} the knight with land.
e.zh: 领主同意把土地授予那名骑士作封地。

e.en: The deed could {enfeoff} trustees with the estate.
e.zh: 这份契据可以把地产转让给受托人。

enfeoffed.t: 已授予封地的；已转让地产的

e.en: The knight was {enfeoffed} with a small manor.
e.zh: 那名骑士获授了一小块庄园作为封地。

e.en: The property was {enfeoffed} to the trustees.
e.zh: 这处地产已转让给受托人。

e.en: The charter records the {enfeoffing} of several tenants.
e.zh: 这份宪章记录了向几名佃户授予封地的事。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {enfeoffing} of the estate.
e.zh: 律师们讨论了这处地产的转让。

e.en: The document confirmed the {enfeoffment} of the heir.
e.zh: 文件确认了对继承人的封地授予。

e.en: Medieval law treated {enfeoffment} as a formal conveyance.
e.zh: 中世纪法律把地产转让视为正式的让与行为。

e.en: The lord {enfeoffs} his vassal with farmland.
e.zh: 领主把农田授予他的附庸作封地。

e.en: The settlement {enfeoffs} the trustees with legal title.
e.zh: 这项和解把法定所有权转让给受托人。

e.en: Smoke filled the {engine-room} after the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起后，轮机舱里充满了烟。

e.en: Only trained staff may enter the ship's {engine-room}.
e.zh: 只有受过训练的人员才能进入船上的轮机舱。

e.en: His {engineership} required both mathematics and practical judgment.
e.zh: 他的工程师职务既需要数学知识，也需要实际判断力。

e.en: The bridge displayed remarkable {engineership} for its time.
e.zh: 这座桥展现了当时非凡的工程技艺。

e.en: The {engineless} glider circled silently above the field.
e.zh: 那架无发动机滑翔机在田野上空静静盘旋。

e.en: They found an {engineless} boat drifting near the harbor.
e.zh: 他们发现一艘没有发动机的船在港口附近漂流。

e.en: The {engineman} checked the pressure before departure.
e.zh: 出发前，机工检查了压力。

e.en: An experienced {engineman} kept the old locomotive running.
e.zh: 一名经验丰富的机车司机让那台老火车头继续运转。

e.en: The {enginemen} worked through the night below deck.
e.zh: 那些轮机员在甲板下通宵工作。

e.en: Several {enginemen} gathered beside the stalled locomotive.
e.zh: 几名机车工聚在停住的火车头旁。

e.en: The factory's old {enginery} shook the floor.
e.zh: 工厂里的旧机器设备震得地板发颤。

e.en: The poem imagines the hidden {enginery} of fate.
e.zh: 这首诗想象着命运背后隐秘的运转机制。

e.en: The artisan proposed an {enginous} solution to the problem.
e.zh: 那位工匠提出了一个巧妙的解决办法。

e.en: Her {enginous} mind delighted in difficult puzzles.
e.zh: 她富有巧思的头脑喜欢钻研难题。

e.en: Ancient walls {engird} the hilltop town.
e.zh: 古老的城墙环绕着山顶小镇。

e.en: Dark clouds seemed to {engird} the valley.
e.zh: 乌云似乎把整个山谷围了起来。

e.en: The castle was {engirded} by a deep moat.
e.zh: 城堡被一条深护城河环绕着。

e.en: She felt {engirded} by duties on every side.
e.zh: 她觉得自己被四面八方的责任包围。

e.en: The river was {engirding} the island like silver thread.
e.zh: 那条河像银线一样环绕着小岛。

e.en: He described fear as {engirding} the city.
e.zh: 他把恐惧描写成笼罩并围住了这座城市。

e.en: Vines {engirdle} the abandoned tower.
e.zh: 藤蔓环绕着那座废弃的塔。

e.en: A jeweled belt seemed to {engirdle} her gown.
e.zh: 一条珠宝腰带似乎束住了她的长裙。

e.en: A stone wall {engirdles} the monastery garden.
e.zh: 一道石墙环绕着修道院的花园。

e.en: Mist {engirdles} the mountain at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，薄雾环绕着那座山。

e.en: An {engirdling} road connected the scattered villages.
e.zh: 一条环绕道路连接起分散的村庄。

e.en: The queen wore an {engirdling} chain of gold.
e.zh: 女王戴着一条环绕腰身的金链。

e.en: The lake lay {engirt} with dark pines.
e.zh: 那片湖被深色松林环绕着。

e.en: He stood {engirt} by enemies in the old tale.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，他站在敌人的包围中。

e.en: The scientist studied {englacial} channels beneath the ice.
e.zh: 科学家研究了冰层下的冰川内部通道。

e.en: Pressure shaped the {englacial} flow over centuries.
e.zh: 数百年来，压力塑造了冰川内部的流动。

e.en: Courtiers tried to {engle} the young prince.
e.zh: 朝臣们试图讨好那位年轻王子。

e.en: The old text says he would {engle} every guest.
e.zh: 那篇古文说他会殷勤讨好每一位客人。

e.en: The diary called him an {english-man} of gentle manners.
e.zh: 日记称他是一位举止温和的英格兰男子。

e.en: An {english-man} arrived at the port before noon.
e.zh: 一名英国男子在中午前抵达港口。

e.en: The statute referred to the rights of {englishry}.
e.zh: 那部法令提到了英格兰人群体的权利。

e.en: He mocked their stiff idea of {englishry}.
e.zh: 他嘲笑他们那种拘谨的英国性观念。

e.en: The glass shell seemed to {englobe} the tiny garden.
e.zh: 玻璃外壳似乎把那座小花园包裹成一个球体。

e.en: Night appeared to {englobe} the silent sea.
e.zh: 夜色仿佛环抱住了寂静的大海。

e.en: The monster would {englut} anything thrown into the pit.
e.zh: 那怪物会吞下任何扔进坑里的东西。

e.en: Greed seemed to {englut} his better judgment.
e.zh: 贪欲似乎吞没了他更清醒的判断。

e.en: The furnace {engluts} coal at a frightening rate.
e.zh: 这座炉子以惊人的速度吞耗煤炭。

e.en: Ambition {engluts} every quieter impulse in him.
e.zh: 野心吞没了他心中每一种较平和的冲动。

e.en: The beast {englutted} the feast in minutes.
e.zh: 那头野兽几分钟内就吞下了整桌宴席。

e.en: His mind was {englutted} with rumors and fear.
e.zh: 他的脑子里塞满了谣言和恐惧。

e.en: The rumor seemed to {enfever} the crowd.
e.zh: 这个谣言似乎让人群狂热起来。

e.en: Grief can {enfever} an already restless mind.
e.zh: 悲伤会使本已不安的心更加激动。

e.en: The soldiers were caught in an {enfilade}.
e.zh: 士兵们陷入了纵向火力扫射之中。

e.en: Sunlight crossed the palace {enfilade} of rooms.
e.zh: 阳光穿过宫殿里一连串相通的房间。

e.en: The road was {enfiladed} by guns on the ridge.
e.zh: 这条路受到山脊上火炮的纵向扫射。

e.en: The {enfiladed} rooms opened neatly into one another.
e.zh: 这些纵向相连的房间整齐地彼此贯通。

e.en: The machine guns created deadly {enfilades}.
e.zh: 机枪形成了致命的纵向火力。

e.en: The museum preserves long {enfilades} of formal rooms.
e.zh: 博物馆保留着一长排庄重相通的房间。

e.en: The army used {enfilading} fire against the trench.
e.zh: 军队用纵向火力攻击那条战壕。

e.en: An {enfilading} doorway framed the distant garden.
e.zh: 一道纵向贯通的门洞框住了远处的花园。

e.en: Traditional perfumers used {enfleurage} for delicate jasmine.
e.zh: 传统调香师用脂吸法提取娇嫩茉莉的香气。

e.en: The workshop demonstrated {enfleurage} with glass plates.
e.zh: 工坊用玻璃板演示了脂吸法。

e.en: Spring rains {enflower} the quiet meadow.
e.zh: 春雨让宁静的草地开满鲜花。

e.en: They planned to {enflower} the arch for the wedding.
e.zh: 他们打算用鲜花装饰婚礼拱门。

e.en: The valley was {enflowered} after weeks of rain.
e.zh: 连雨数周后，山谷开满了花。

e.en: She wore an {enflowered} dress to the picnic.
e.zh: 她穿着一件饰有花朵的裙子去野餐。

e.en: The warm spell was {enflowering} the orchard early.
e.zh: 这阵暖和天气让果园早早开花。

e.en: Volunteers were {enflowering} the stage before the ceremony.
e.zh: 志愿者们在典礼前用花装饰舞台。

e.en: The anesthetist chose {enflurane} for the procedure.
e.zh: 麻醉师为这次手术选择了恩氟烷。

e.en: Modern hospitals rarely use {enflurane} now.
e.zh: 现代医院如今很少使用恩氟烷。

e.en: The court found the contract {enforcible}.
e.zh: 法院认定这份合同可以强制执行。

e.en: Only clear promises are legally {enforcible}.
e.zh: 只有明确的承诺才具有法律强制执行力。

e.en: The law gave officials {enforcive} powers.
e.zh: 这部法律赋予官员强制执行权。

e.en: His tone became stern and {enforcive}.
e.zh: 他的语气变得严厉而带有强制性。

e.en: The project will {enforest} the abandoned hillside.
e.zh: 这个项目将在废弃山坡上造林。

e.en: Legends {enforest} the valley with imagined spirits.
e.zh: 传说让这座山谷仿佛布满了想象中的精灵。

e.en: Dark curtains {enframe} the bright window.
e.zh: 深色窗帘框住了明亮的窗户。

e.en: The poem helps {enframe} her grief.
e.zh: 这首诗帮助她表达并框定自己的悲伤。

e.en: They looked at {engagement-rings} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后他们去看了订婚戒指。

e.en: Vintage {engagement-rings} can be surprisingly affordable.
e.zh: 复古订婚戒指有时会出人意料地实惠。

e.en: The actors {engarb} themselves as medieval knights.
e.zh: 演员们把自己装扮成中世纪骑士。

e.en: Ceremony can {engarb} simple power in dignity.
e.zh: 仪式能把单纯的权力装点得更庄严。

e.en: Children helped {engarland} the statue with roses.
e.zh: 孩子们帮忙用玫瑰花环装饰雕像。

e.en: Praise can {engarland} even a modest achievement.
e.zh: 赞美也能给一项小小成就增添光彩。

e.en: Sunset seemed to {engild} the river.
e.zh: 夕阳仿佛给河面镀上了金色。

e.en: Flattery can {engild} a poor decision.
e.zh: 奉承会把糟糕的决定粉饰得好看些。

e.en: The {engine-driver} checked the signal carefully.
e.zh: 火车司机仔细查看了信号。

e.en: As a child, he wanted to be an {engine-driver}.
e.zh: 他小时候想当一名火车司机。

e.en: The old {engine-house} now serves as a museum.
e.zh: 那座旧机车库如今用作博物馆。

e.en: Steam pipes ran behind the factory {engine-house}.
e.zh: 蒸汽管道从工厂动力机房后面穿过。

englutting.t: 使贪吃；使过饱和；吞没塞满

e.en: The feast seemed to be {englutting} every guest at the table.
e.zh: 这场盛宴似乎让桌边每位客人都吃得过饱。

e.en: Smoke was {englutting} the narrow room within minutes.
e.zh: 几分钟内，烟雾就把狭小的房间完全塞满了。

e.en: The potter brushed white {engobe} over the red clay.
e.zh: 陶工在红陶土上刷了一层白色化妆土。

e.en: A thin {engobe} helped hide flaws in the surface.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的泥釉遮住了表面的瑕疵。

e.en: Gardeners {engraft} the new shoot onto a strong rootstock.
e.zh: 园丁把新芽嫁接到强壮的砧木上。

e.en: The teacher tried to {engraft} discipline into daily habits.
e.zh: 老师试图把纪律深植进日常习惯中。

e.en: The {engraftation} of the branch took several weeks to heal.
e.zh: 这根枝条的嫁接用了几个星期才愈合。

e.en: The reform depended on the {engraftation} of new values.
e.zh: 这项改革取决于新价值观的深植。

e.en: The {engrafted} branch produced fruit the next spring.
e.zh: 那根嫁接的枝条第二年春天结了果。

e.en: Old loyalties remained {engrafted} in the community.
e.zh: 旧日的忠诚仍深植在这个群体之中。

engrafting.t: 嫁接；移植结合；灌输深植

e.en: They spent the afternoon {engrafting} apple shoots in the orchard.
e.zh: 他们一下午都在果园里嫁接苹果枝。

e.en: The program focused on {engrafting} confidence in young learners.
e.zh: 这个项目重在把自信深植于年轻学习者心中。

e.en: She {engrafts} rare roses onto hardy stems.
e.zh: 她把稀有玫瑰嫁接到耐寒的茎上。

e.en: The ritual {engrafts} memory onto public identity.
e.zh: 这种仪式把记忆深植进公共身份之中。

engrail.t: 刻成锯齿边；饰以波纹边

e.en: The silversmith used a fine tool to {engrail} the rim.
e.zh: 银匠用细工具在边缘刻出锯齿纹。

e.en: Heraldic artists sometimes {engrail} a shield's border.
e.zh: 纹章画师有时会把盾牌边框画成波纹齿状。

engrailed.t: 有锯齿边的；饰波纹边的

e.en: The old coin had an {engrailed} edge.
e.zh: 那枚旧硬币有一圈锯齿状边缘。

e.en: An {engrailed} border framed the family crest.
e.zh: 一道波纹齿状边框围住了家族徽章。

e.en: The craftsman was {engrailing} the silver plate by hand.
e.zh: 工匠正在手工给银盘刻锯齿边。

e.en: The {engrailing} on the shield followed a medieval pattern.
e.zh: 盾牌上的波纹齿饰沿用了中世纪图案。

e.en: The manuscript's border showed delicate {engrailment}.
e.zh: 手稿边框呈现出精细的波纹齿饰。

e.en: He studied the {engrailment} around the antique seal.
e.zh: 他细看古印周围的锯齿边饰。

engrainedly.t: 根深蒂固地；深深嵌入地

e.en: She reacted {engrainedly}, without stopping to think.
e.zh: 她根深蒂固地作出反应，甚至没有停下来思考。

e.en: The dye lay {engrainedly} in the old fabric.
e.zh: 染料深深嵌在那块旧布料里。

e.en: The psychologist described each habit as an {engramme}.
e.zh: 心理学家把每个习惯描述为一种记忆痕迹。

e.en: A painful {engramme} seemed to shape his response.
e.zh: 一段痛苦的记忆印迹似乎影响了他的反应。

engrammic.t: 记忆痕迹的；记忆印迹相关的

e.en: The paper discussed {engrammic} changes after learning.
e.zh: 论文讨论了学习之后与记忆痕迹有关的变化。

e.en: They searched for an {engrammic} basis for fear.
e.zh: 他们寻找恐惧的记忆印迹基础。

engraphy.t: 记录法；铭刻术；书写记录

e.en: The scholar used {engraphy} to describe ancient recording practices.
e.zh: 这位学者用记录法来描述古代的记录实践。

e.en: In his lecture, {engraphy} meant the act of inscribing signs.
e.zh: 在他的讲座中，engraphy指的是刻写符号的行为。

e.en: Mist seemed to {enhalo} the mountain at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，雾气似乎给山峰罩上光晕。

e.en: The lamp's glow would {enhalo} her hair in portraits.
e.zh: 画像里，灯光常把她的头发映成一圈光环。

e.en: The coach suggested an {enhancive} exercise routine.
e.zh: 教练建议了一套有提升作用的训练安排。

e.en: Good lighting has an {enhancive} effect on the room.
e.zh: 良好的照明对这个房间有增强美感的作用。

e.en: F sharp and G flat can be {enharmonic} notes.
e.zh: 升F和降G可以是等音音符。

e.en: The passage uses an {enharmonic} change to shift keys.
e.zh: 这段乐曲用异名同音转换来转调。

enharmonically.t: 以等音方式；异名同音地

e.en: The chord was respelled {enharmonically} in the new key.
e.zh: 这个和弦在新调中被按等音方式重新记写。

e.en: She resolved the passage {enharmonically} during improvisation.
e.zh: 她在即兴演奏时用异名同音方式解决了这段乐句。

e.en: Her calm words helped {enhearten} the tired team.
e.zh: 她平静的话语鼓舞了疲惫的团队。

e.en: A small victory can {enhearten} people after months of failure.
e.zh: 几个月失败之后，一次小胜利也能使人振作。

enhemospore.t: 血内孢子；血液寄生孢子

e.en: The parasite produced an {enhemospore} inside the host's blood.
e.zh: 这种寄生物在宿主血液中产生了血内孢子。

e.en: Researchers identified the {enhemospore} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下识别出这种血液寄生孢子。

e.en: The collector prized an {enhydrite} with a moving bubble.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视一块带有活动气泡的含水晶体。

e.en: An {enhydrite} can trap ancient liquid inside a mineral cavity.
e.zh: 水胆石能把古老液体封存在矿物空腔中。

e.en: The geologist found an {enhydrous} quartz specimen.
e.zh: 地质学家发现了一块内部含液体的石英标本。

e.en: Its {enhydrous} cavity held a tiny drop of water.
e.zh: 它的含水空腔里有一小滴水。

e.en: He gave an {enigmatical} answer and left the room.
e.zh: 他给了一个神秘难解的回答，然后离开了房间。

e.en: The poem's {enigmatical} images invite many interpretations.
e.zh: 这首诗谜一般的意象引出许多解读。

e.en: The old bridge seemed to {enlink} the two villages.
e.zh: 那座旧桥似乎把两个村庄连接起来。

e.en: Shared memories {enlink} the members of the family.
e.zh: 共同的记忆把这个家庭的成员连在一起。

e.en: The keeper would {enlock} the gate at dusk.
e.zh: 看守会在黄昏时把大门锁上。

e.en: Fear can {enlock} a person in silence.
e.zh: 恐惧会把人困在沉默里。

enmarble.t: 使呈大理石纹；使坚如大理石

e.en: The artist used pale veins to {enmarble} the painted wall.
e.zh: 艺术家用浅色纹路让彩绘墙面呈现大理石纹。

e.en: Time seemed to {enmarble} her grief into a calm expression.
e.zh: 时间仿佛把她的悲伤凝成了平静的神情。

e.en: The falcon was {enmewed} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间，那只猎鹰被关了起来。

e.en: He felt {enmewed} in the narrow boarding school dormitory.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被困在狭窄的寄宿学校宿舍里。

e.en: The village held an {ennaton} after the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼后，村里举行了九日祈祷。

e.en: She described the ancient {ennaton} in her church notes.
e.zh: 她在教会笔记中描述了古老的九日宗教仪式。

e.en: The museum displayed an {ennead} of small bronze figures.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一组九件小型青铜像。

e.en: Egyptian myth often speaks of a divine {ennead}.
e.zh: 埃及神话常提到一个由九位神组成的神群。

e.en: The floor pattern formed a regular {enneagon}.
e.zh: 地面的图案形成了一个正九边形。

e.en: Students measured each side of the {enneagon}.
e.zh: 学生们测量了这个九边形的每一条边。

e.en: The architect chose an {enneagonal} plan for the chapel.
e.zh: 建筑师为小礼拜堂选择了九边形平面。

e.en: An {enneagonal} frame surrounded the central window.
e.zh: 中央窗户外有一个九边形框架。

e.en: She used the {enneagram} to discuss personality patterns.
e.zh: 她用九型人格图来讨论人格模式。

e.en: The manuscript showed an {enneagram} drawn in red ink.
e.zh: 手稿上有一个用红墨水画的九角星形。

e.en: The crystal had an unusual {enneahedral} shape.
e.zh: 这块晶体呈现出少见的九面体形状。

e.en: They modeled an {enneahedral} solid on the computer.
e.zh: 他们在电脑上建立了一个九面体立体模型。

e.en: The puzzle piece was shaped like an {enneahedron}.
e.zh: 这块拼图片的形状像一个九面体。

e.en: A true {enneahedron} has exactly nine faces.
e.zh: 真正的九面体正好有九个面。

e.en: The temple front was described as {enneastyle}.
e.zh: 这座神庙的正面被描述为九柱式。

e.en: An {enneastyle} portico stood before the old hall.
e.zh: 旧大厅前有一座九柱式门廊。

e.en: The scholar called the facade {enneastylos}.
e.zh: 学者称这座立面为九柱式。

e.en: An {enneastylos} design was rare in that region.
e.zh: 九柱式设计在那个地区很少见。

e.en: The poem follows an {enneasyllabic} line pattern.
e.zh: 这首诗遵循九音节诗行的格式。

e.en: He tested whether each verse was {enneasyllabic}.
e.zh: 他检查每一行诗是否都是九音节。

e.en: The radio manual mentioned an {enneode} in the circuit.
e.zh: 收音机手册提到电路中有一个九极管。

e.en: Few engineers today have handled an {enneode}.
e.zh: 如今很少有工程师接触过九电极管。

e.en: The lab detected {enniatine} in the contaminated grain.
e.zh: 实验室在受污染的谷物中检测到恩镍菌素类毒素。

e.en: Researchers studied how {enniatine} affects cell membranes.
e.zh: 研究人员研究恩镍菌素如何影响细胞膜。

e.en: Chemists once used {ennilnilium} for element 109.
e.zh: 化学家曾用ennilnilium来称呼第109号元素。

e.en: The name {ennilnilium} disappeared after meitnerium was approved.
e.zh: “ennilnilium”这个名称在䥑被批准后就不再使用。

e.en: The endless lecture began to {ennuye} the audience.
e.zh: 没完没了的讲座开始让听众感到厌倦。

e.en: Formal dinners often {ennuye} him more than meetings.
e.zh: 正式晚宴常常比会议更让他烦闷。

e.en: The {ennuyee} stared blankly at the stage.
e.zh: 那个感到厌倦的人茫然地望着舞台。

e.en: Every fashionable {ennuyee} claimed to be tired of society.
e.zh: 每个时髦的厌世者都声称自己厌倦了社交界。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {enol}.
e.zh: 这个反应产生了少量烯醇。

e.en: An {enol} can change into a keto form.
e.zh: 烯醇可以转变成酮式结构。

e.en: The enzyme {enolase} appears in glycolysis.
e.zh: 烯醇化酶出现在糖酵解过程中。

e.en: Doctors measured {enolase} as a possible tumor marker.
e.zh: 医生测量烯醇化酶，将其作为可能的肿瘤标志物。

e.en: The author tried to {enigmatize} a simple childhood memory.
e.zh: 作者试图把一段简单的童年记忆写得神秘莫测。

e.en: His vague answers only {enigmatized} the problem further.
e.zh: 他含糊的回答只是让这个问题更加扑朔迷离。

e.en: The portrait was {enigmatized} by years of conflicting rumors.
e.zh: 多年来互相矛盾的传闻让这幅肖像变得神秘难解。

e.en: She felt {enigmatized} by the way strangers described her work.
e.zh: 陌生人那样描述她的作品，让她觉得自己被神秘化了。

e.en: The critic's essay was {enigmatizing} an otherwise plain scene.
e.zh: 评论家的文章把一个本来平淡的场景说得神秘起来。

e.en: His {enigmatizing} silence made everyone uneasy.
e.zh: 他那令人费解的沉默让所有人都不安。

eniotypy.t: 印刷凹凸不匀；压印效果

e.en: The old book showed {eniotypy} on several thick pages.
e.zh: 这本旧书有几页厚纸上能看出凹凸的压印痕迹。

e.en: Collectors value the subtle {eniotypy} left by early presses.
e.zh: 收藏者看重早期印刷机留下的细微凹凸效果。

e.en: Floodwater can {enisle} a village for days.
e.zh: 洪水可能让一个村庄好几天像岛一样被隔绝。

e.en: The poet uses fog to {enisle} the lonely house.
e.zh: 诗人用雾气把那座孤屋写得仿佛与世隔绝。

e.en: The {enisled} farm could be reached only by boat.
e.zh: 那座被水围困的农场只能乘船到达。

e.en: He lived an {enisled} life among his books.
e.zh: 他与书为伴，过着孤立隔绝的生活。

e.en: The tyrant threatened to {enjail} anyone who spoke freely.
e.zh: 暴君威胁要把任何敢自由发声的人关进监牢。

e.en: Fear can {enjail} the mind more tightly than walls.
e.zh: 恐惧对心灵的囚禁可能比高墙还要严密。

e.en: The {enjailed} rebels wrote letters from their cells.
e.zh: 被囚禁的反抗者在牢房里写信。

e.en: Her imagination felt {enjailed} by the rigid rules.
e.zh: 那些僵硬的规则让她觉得想象力受到了禁锢。

e.en: The regime was {enjailing} journalists without fair trials.
e.zh: 该政权未经公正审判就把记者关进监狱。

e.en: He resisted the {enjailing} habits of routine work.
e.zh: 他抗拒日常工作中那些令人受束缚的习惯。

e.en: The poem uses {enjambement} to keep the thought moving.
e.zh: 这首诗运用跨行连续，让思绪不断向前推进。

e.en: Her {enjambement} makes each line feel unfinished and tense.
e.zh: 她的跨行写法让每一行都显得未完而紧张。

e.en: The captain's {enjoinder} was brief and impossible to ignore.
e.zh: 船长的命令很简短，却不容忽视。

e.en: She left us with an {enjoinder} to speak honestly.
e.zh: 她临走前嘱咐我们要诚实说话。

e.en: The court's {enjoinment} stopped the sale immediately.
e.zh: 法院的禁令立即叫停了这笔出售。

e.en: His final {enjoinment} was to protect the archive.
e.zh: 他最后的嘱托是保护好档案。

e.en: A single spark can {enkindle} dry grass.
e.zh: 一点火星就能点燃干草。

e.en: Her speech helped {enkindle} hope in the crowd.
e.zh: 她的演讲在人群中激起了希望。

e.en: The {enkindled} fire warmed the small room.
e.zh: 点燃的火温暖了那间小屋。

e.en: His {enkindled} curiosity led him back to the library.
e.zh: 被激起的好奇心使他又回到了图书馆。

e.en: Dry wind {enkindles} the smallest campfire.
e.zh: 干燥的风会把最小的营火也吹旺。

e.en: Music {enkindles} memories she thought were lost.
e.zh: 音乐唤起了她以为已经消失的记忆。

e.en: He was {enkindling} the stove before dawn.
e.zh: 天亮前他正在点燃炉子。

e.en: The teacher's question was {enkindling} a lively debate.
e.zh: 老师的问题正激发一场热烈的讨论。

e.en: Vines {enlace} the old stone wall.
e.zh: 藤蔓缠绕着那堵古老的石墙。

e.en: The novel tries to {enlace} history with private grief.
e.zh: 这部小说试图把历史与个人悲痛交织在一起。

e.en: The gate was {enlaced} with winter ivy.
e.zh: 大门上缠满了冬日的常春藤。

e.en: Their stories were {enlaced} with old family secrets.
e.zh: 他们的故事与家族旧秘密交织在一起。

e.en: The {enlacement} of branches blocked the narrow path.
e.zh: 交错缠绕的树枝挡住了狭窄的小路。

e.en: The essay studies the {enlacement} of myth and politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章研究神话与政治之间的交织关系。

e.en: A silver thread {enlaces} the dark fabric.
e.zh: 一根银线缠绕在深色布料上。

e.en: The film {enlaces} comedy with sudden moments of fear.
e.zh: 这部电影把喜剧和突如其来的恐惧交织在一起。

e.en: The roots were {enlacing} beneath the cracked pavement.
e.zh: 树根在开裂的人行道下面互相缠绕。

e.en: Her speech kept {enlacing} humor with sharp criticism.
e.zh: 她的演讲不断把幽默和尖锐批评交织起来。

e.en: The map is {enlargeable} on most phone screens.
e.zh: 这张地图在大多数手机屏幕上都可以放大。

e.en: They chose an {enlargeable} design for the growing school.
e.zh: 他们为不断扩大的学校选择了可扩建的设计。

e.en: The report noted an {enlargment} of the affected area.
e.zh: 报告指出受影响区域有所扩大。

e.en: This rare spelling of {enlargment} appears in the old manuscript.
e.zh: 这个“扩大”一词的罕见拼法出现在那份旧手稿中。

e.en: The moon seemed to {enlight} the ruined tower.
e.zh: 月光仿佛照亮了那座废弃的塔楼。

e.en: Wise counsel can {enlight} a troubled mind.
e.zh: 明智的忠告能启迪困惑的心灵。

e.en: The critic tried to {enrank} the poets by influence.
e.zh: 评论家试图按影响力给这些诗人划分等级。

e.en: Old heraldic rules could {enrank} a family among nobles.
e.zh: 古老的纹章规则能把一个家族列入贵族阶层。

e.en: The music seemed to {enrapt} the entire hall.
e.zh: 那音乐仿佛让整个大厅的人都陶醉了。

e.en: Her story could {enrapt} even the most restless children.
e.zh: 她的故事连最坐不住的孩子也会听得入迷。

e.en: The sunrise would {enravish} any traveler who saw it.
e.zh: 任何旅人见到那日出都会为之着迷。

e.en: Poets claimed her voice could {enravish} the heart.
e.zh: 诗人说她的嗓音能让人心醉神迷。

e.en: The commander planned to {enregiment} the new recruits quickly.
e.zh: 指挥官打算迅速把新兵编入部队。

e.en: The school tried to {enregiment} every hour of the students' day.
e.zh: 学校试图把学生每天的每个小时都严格安排起来。

e.en: The clerk must {enregister} each parcel before noon.
e.zh: 办事员必须在中午前把每个包裹登记在册。

e.en: The ritual helped {enregister} the child's place in the community.
e.zh: 这个仪式帮助确认并记录孩子在社群中的位置。

e.en: Frost can {enridge} the wet soil overnight.
e.zh: 霜冻会在一夜之间使湿土隆起成脊。

e.en: The old scar seemed to {enridge} the skin along his arm.
e.zh: 那道旧疤使他手臂上的皮肤显得隆起成线。

e.en: Dark trees {enring} the quiet lake.
e.zh: 深色的树木环绕着宁静的湖。

e.en: The dancers would {enring} the fire at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时舞者会围着火堆成圈起舞。

e.en: The bishop will {enrobe} the novice during the ceremony.
e.zh: 主教将在仪式上为见习修士披上长袍。

e.en: The chef likes to {enrobe} the cake in dark chocolate.
e.zh: 厨师喜欢用黑巧克力把蛋糕包覆起来。

e.en: The monks stood {enrobed} in plain brown cloth.
e.zh: 僧侣们穿着朴素的棕色长袍站着。

e.en: The strawberries were {enrobed} in glossy chocolate.
e.zh: 草莓被光亮的巧克力包裹着。

e.en: The attendant {enrobes} the actor before the scene begins.
e.zh: 场景开始前，侍者给演员披上长袍。

e.en: A thin layer of caramel {enrobes} each apple slice.
e.zh: 每片苹果都裹着一层薄薄的焦糖。

e.en: The priest was {enrobing} in the small side room.
e.zh: 神父正在旁边的小房间里穿上祭袍。

e.en: The factory uses a machine for {enrobing} biscuits with chocolate.
e.zh: 工厂用机器给饼干裹上巧克力。

e.en: The gardener hoped to {enroot} the cutting before winter.
e.zh: 园丁希望在冬天前让插枝生根。

e.en: Shared hardship can {enroot} loyalty in a group.
e.zh: 共同经历的苦难能在群体中深植忠诚。

e.en: The ambulance is {enroute} to the hospital now.
e.zh: 救护车现在正在去医院的路上。

e.en: We stopped for coffee {enroute} to Berlin.
e.zh: 我们在去柏林途中停下来喝了咖啡。

e.en: The old tale may {ensample} courage under pressure.
e.zh: 这个古老故事可以作为压力下勇气的例证。

e.en: His conduct seemed to {ensample} the virtues his teacher praised.
e.zh: 他的行为似乎体现了老师称赞的那些美德。

e.en: The battle would {ensanguine} the fields by nightfall.
e.zh: 到夜幕降临时，战斗会把田野染成血色。

e.en: Sunset seemed to {ensanguine} the western clouds.
e.zh: 落日仿佛把西边的云染成了血红色。

e.en: The soldier carried an {ensanguined} banner from the field.
e.zh: 士兵从战场上带回一面染血的旗帜。

e.en: An {ensanguined} sunset burned above the roofs.
e.zh: 屋顶上方燃着一片血红的晚霞。

e.en: Philosophers once asked whether plants are {ensate} beings.
e.zh: 哲学家曾追问植物是否是有感觉的生命。

e.en: The poem imagines the whole earth as {ensate}.
e.zh: 这首诗把整个大地想象成有感知的存在。

e.en: The scribe would {enscroll} the decree in careful letters.
e.zh: 书记员会用工整的字把法令写入卷轴。

e.en: The artist tried to {enscroll} the paper without creasing it.
e.zh: 艺术家试着把纸卷起来而不弄出折痕。

e.en: The notary must {enseal} the document before delivery.
e.zh: 公证人必须在送出前给文件盖章封缄。

e.en: They used wax to {enseal} the letter against tampering.
e.zh: 他们用蜡封住信件，以防被人拆动。

e.en: The villagers gathered to {ensepulcher} their fallen leader.
e.zh: 村民们聚集起来安葬他们逝去的领袖。

e.en: The legend says the king was {ensepulcher} beneath the chapel.
e.zh: 传说那位国王被安葬在小礼拜堂下面。

e.en: They came at dawn to {ensepulchre} the saint.
e.zh: 他们在黎明前来安葬那位圣人。

e.en: The poem asks who will {ensepulchre} forgotten heroes.
e.zh: 这首诗追问谁会安葬被遗忘的英雄。

e.en: The chemist studied the {enolic} form of the compound.
e.zh: 化学家研究了这种化合物的烯醇形式。

e.en: Some sugars can briefly adopt an {enolic} structure.
e.zh: 有些糖可以短暂呈现烯醇结构。

e.en: The reaction begins with {enolization} under basic conditions.
e.zh: 该反应在碱性条件下以烯醇化开始。

e.en: Rapid {enolization} changed the expected product mixture.
e.zh: 快速烯醇化改变了预期的产物混合物。

enological.t: 酿酒学的；葡萄酒酿造的

e.en: The winery hired a consultant for {enological} advice.
e.zh: 酒庄聘请顾问提供酿酒学方面的建议。

e.en: Better hygiene solved several {enological} problems in the cellar.
e.zh: 更好的卫生措施解决了酒窖里的几项葡萄酒酿造问题。

e.en: An {enologist} tested the acidity before bottling.
e.zh: 一名酿酒学家在装瓶前检测了酸度。

e.en: The {enologist} recommended aging the wine in oak.
e.zh: 这位葡萄酒技师建议用橡木桶陈酿这款酒。

e.en: She studied {enology} in France before opening a winery.
e.zh: 她在法国学习酿酒学后开了一家酒庄。

e.en: Modern {enology} relies on both tradition and chemistry.
e.zh: 现代葡萄酒酿造学既依靠传统，也依靠化学。

e.en: {Enolphosphopyruvate} is an intermediate in carbohydrate metabolism.
e.zh: 烯醇式磷酸丙酮酸是糖代谢中的一种中间产物。

e.en: The enzyme transfers phosphate from {enolphosphopyruvate}.
e.zh: 这种酶从烯醇式磷酸丙酮酸转移磷酸基。

e.en: The injury left him with mild {enophthalmus}.
e.zh: 这次受伤使他出现了轻度眼球内陷。

e.en: Doctors noted {enophthalmus} during the eye examination.
e.zh: 医生在眼部检查时注意到眼球内陷。

e.en: The old poet described an {enorm} beast in the forest.
e.zh: 那位旧体诗人描写了森林里一头巨大的野兽。

e.en: They faced an {enorm} task with little help.
e.zh: 他们在几乎没有帮助的情况下承担了一项极大的任务。

e.en: The manuscript used {enormious} where modern English uses enormous.
e.zh: 这份手稿用enormious表示现代英语中的enormous。

e.en: He imagined an {enormious} tower above the clouds.
e.zh: 他想象出一座高耸入云的庞大高塔。

e.en: The vintner used an {enoscope} to inspect the wine.
e.zh: 酿酒师用葡萄酒检测仪检查这款酒。

e.en: An old {enoscope} stood on the laboratory shelf.
e.zh: 实验室架子上放着一台旧的葡萄酒检测仪。

e.en: The movement demanded {enosis} with the neighboring state.
e.zh: 这场运动要求与邻国实现政治合并。

e.en: Historians still debate the causes of {enosis}.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在讨论这次联合的成因。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {enostosis} in the femur.
e.zh: 扫描显示股骨内有一个小的骨岛。

e.en: Most cases of {enostosis} need no treatment.
e.zh: 大多数骨内生骨瘤病例不需要治疗。

e.en: The philosopher tried to {enounce} his principle plainly.
e.zh: 这位哲学家试图清楚表达他的原则。

e.en: She would {enounce} each word before the class repeated it.
e.zh: 她会先清楚念出每个词，再让全班跟读。

e.en: He {enounced} the rule before the debate began.
e.zh: 辩论开始前，他清楚宣布了规则。

e.en: The actor {enounced} every syllable with care.
e.zh: 那名演员仔细地发清了每一个音节。

e.en: The judge's {enouncement} ended the long dispute.
e.zh: 法官的宣告结束了这场漫长争端。

e.en: Her careful {enouncement} helped the audience understand.
e.zh: 她清楚的表述帮助听众理解了内容。

e.en: The document {enounces} a strict moral code.
e.zh: 这份文件宣示了一套严格的道德准则。

e.en: He {enounces} difficult names slowly for the visitors.
e.zh: 他慢慢念出难读的姓名，方便来访者听清。

e.en: She was {enouncing} the policy in formal language.
e.zh: 她正在用正式语言阐明这项政策。

e.en: The teacher spent the morning {enouncing} vowel sounds.
e.zh: 老师花了一个上午清楚示范元音发音。

e.en: We have troubles {enow} without inviting more.
e.zh: 我们已有足够多的麻烦，不必再自找更多。

e.en: There was food {enow} for every guest.
e.zh: 食物足够每一位客人享用。

e.en: The crop disease became {enphytotic} in the valley.
e.zh: 这种作物病害在山谷中成了地方性植物病。

e.en: Scientists mapped the {enphytotic} spread of the fungus.
e.zh: 科学家绘制了这种真菌地方性传播的范围。

e.en: Passengers will {enplane} through the rear door today.
e.zh: 今天乘客将从后门登机。

e.en: The crew helped the medical team {enplane} first.
e.zh: 机组人员协助医疗队先行登机。

e.en: The passengers {enplaned} before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 暴风雨到来前，乘客们已经登机。

e.en: Staff {enplaned} the children ahead of the tour group.
e.zh: 工作人员让孩子们在旅行团之前先登机。

e.en: The team {enplanes} at dawn for the final match.
e.zh: 球队将在黎明登机前往参加决赛。

e.en: This gate {enplanes} priority passengers first.
e.zh: 这个登机口先安排优先乘客登机。

e.en: {Enplaning} began ten minutes later than scheduled.
e.zh: 登机比原定时间晚了十分钟开始。

e.en: Agents were {enplaning} families before other travelers.
e.zh: 工作人员先安排家庭旅客登机，然后才是其他旅客。

e.en: His public insult caused her sudden {enragement}.
e.zh: 他公开的侮辱使她突然暴怒。

e.en: The novel traces the hero's {enragement} after betrayal.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了主人公遭背叛后的愤怒升级。

e.en: The conquest helped {enserf} many free peasants.
e.zh: 这次征服使许多自由农民沦为农奴。

e.en: Debt can effectively {enserf} a desperate worker.
e.zh: 债务实际上会让绝望的工人失去自由。

e.en: Historians debated the causes of their {enserfment}.
e.zh: 历史学家争论他们沦为农奴的原因。

e.en: The law accelerated the {enserfment} of rural families.
e.zh: 这项法律加速了农村家庭的农奴化。

e.en: He paused to {ensheathe} the ceremonial sword.
e.zh: 他停下来把礼仪剑收入鞘中。

e.en: The cable was {ensheathed} in thick rubber.
e.zh: 电缆被厚厚的橡胶包住。

e.en: The ridge seemed to {enshield} the village from storms.
e.zh: 那道山脊似乎保护村庄免受风暴侵袭。

e.en: Old trees {enshield} the house from the road.
e.zh: 老树把房子同道路遮隔开来。

e.en: The plant has long {ensiform} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物长着细长的剑形叶。

e.en: An {ensiform} shadow lay across the wall.
e.zh: 一道剑形阴影落在墙上。

e.en: Several {ensigncies} were abolished after the reform.
e.zh: 改革后几个少尉职位被取消了。

e.en: The records list vacant {ensigncies} in the regiment.
e.zh: 档案列出了该团空缺的旗手职务。

e.en: He purchased an {ensigncy} in the old regiment.
e.zh: 他买下了旧团里的一个少尉职位。

e.en: The young officer resigned his {ensigncy} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻后那名年轻军官辞去了少尉职务。

e.en: His {ensignship} began during a difficult campaign.
e.zh: 他的少尉生涯始于一场艰难战役。

e.en: The diary describes her brother's brief {ensignship}.
e.zh: 日记记述了她哥哥短暂的旗手任职经历。

e.en: The farm stored corn as {ensilage} for winter.
e.zh: 农场把玉米制成青贮饲料留到冬天。

e.en: Proper {ensilage} keeps the fodder nutritious.
e.zh: 妥善青贮能保持饲料的营养。

e.en: The cattle were fed {ensilaged} grass.
e.zh: 牛吃的是已经青贮过的草料。

e.en: They {ensilaged} the chopped maize in a sealed pit.
e.zh: 他们把切碎的玉米青贮在密封窖里。

e.en: Different {ensilages} suit different dairy herds.
e.zh: 不同的青贮饲料适合不同的奶牛群。

e.en: He {ensilages} fresh clover every summer.
e.zh: 他每年夏天都把新鲜三叶草青贮起来。

e.en: The workers are {ensilaging} maize before the rain.
e.zh: 工人们赶在下雨前把玉米青贮起来。

e.en: Careful {ensilaging} reduces waste on the farm.
e.zh: 仔细进行青贮处理能减少农场浪费。

e.en: Farmers {ensile} the crop while it is still moist.
e.zh: 农民在作物仍有水分时把它青贮起来。

e.en: They built a tower to {ensile} fresh fodder.
e.zh: 他们建了一座塔来青贮新鲜饲料。

e.en: The {ensiled} corn smelled pleasantly sour.
e.zh: 青贮过的玉米闻起来有怡人的酸味。

e.en: They {ensiled} the grass in plastic-wrapped bales.
e.zh: 他们把草料用塑料包成草捆青贮。

e.en: The cooperative sells several grass {ensiles}.
e.zh: 合作社出售几种草类青贮饲料。

e.en: She {ensiles} surplus fodder for the dry season.
e.zh: 她把多余饲料青贮起来供旱季使用。

e.en: They began {ensiling} the cut grass at dawn.
e.zh: 他们黎明时开始青贮割下的草。

e.en: Good {ensiling} depends on excluding air.
e.zh: 良好的青贮处理取决于隔绝空气。

e.en: They {ensilo} the forage as soon as it is cut.
e.zh: 他们一割下牧草就把它存入青贮窖。

e.en: The farm used concrete pits to {ensilo} maize.
e.zh: 农场用混凝土窖来青贮玉米。

e.en: The painting was {enskied} above the doorway.
e.zh: 那幅画被挂在门口上方的高处。

e.en: In the poem, the hero is {enskied} after death.
e.zh: 在诗中，英雄死后升上了天界。

e.en: The myth {enskies} brave warriors among the stars.
e.zh: 这个神话把勇士升入群星之间。

e.en: The gallery {enskies} minor portraits in a dim corner.
e.zh: 画廊把几幅次要肖像挂在昏暗角落的高处。

e.en: The curator chose to {ensky} the small portrait.
e.zh: 策展人决定把那幅小肖像挂到高处。

e.en: The ode seems to {ensky} the fallen king.
e.zh: 这首颂歌似乎把逝去的国王升入天界。

e.en: They were {enskying} paintings near the ceiling.
e.zh: 他们正把画挂到接近天花板的高处。

e.en: The poet's {enskying} of love feels deliberately grand.
e.zh: 诗人把爱情升华到天上的写法显得刻意宏大。

e.en: The story traces his gradual {ensnarement} by debt.
e.zh: 故事描写他逐渐被债务套牢的过程。

e.en: Her {ensnarement} in the plot was accidental.
e.zh: 她卷入这个阴谋纯属偶然。

e.en: The wire can {ensnarl} birds and small animals.
e.zh: 这种铁丝会缠住鸟和小动物。

e.en: New rules may {ensnarl} the approval process.
e.zh: 新规定可能会让审批流程陷入混乱。

e.en: She painted an {enso} with one quick brushstroke.
e.zh: 她用一笔迅速画出了一个禅圆。

e.en: The black {enso} became the logo's central image.
e.zh: 黑色禅圆成了标志的核心图像。

e.en: The software can {ensonify} climate data for listeners.
e.zh: 这款软件能把气候数据转成声音供人聆听。

e.en: Artists {ensonify} city traffic into layered music.
e.zh: 艺术家把城市交通声转化成层次丰富的音乐。

ensorcel.t: 迷住；施魔法控制；使着迷

e.en: The old tale says the witch could {ensorcel} travelers with a song.
e.zh: 古老传说说，女巫能用歌声迷住旅人。

e.en: Her quiet confidence seemed to {ensorcel} the whole room.
e.zh: 她从容的自信仿佛让整个房间都着了迷。

e.en: The knight stood {ensorceled} before the silver mirror.
e.zh: 骑士站在银镜前，像被施了魔法。

e.en: The audience sat {ensorceled} by her strange, low voice.
e.zh: 观众被她奇异低沉的嗓音迷住了。

ensorcell.t: 迷住；施魔法控制；使着迷

e.en: Legends claim the ring can {ensorcell} anyone who wears it.
e.zh: 传说称这枚戒指能迷住任何佩戴它的人。

e.en: A gifted speaker may {ensorcell} a crowd without raising his voice.
e.zh: 有才华的演说者不用提高嗓门也能使人群着迷。

e.en: The villagers believed the lake was {ensorcelled} by a jealous spirit.
e.zh: 村民相信这片湖被一个嫉妒的精灵施了魔法。

e.en: She watched the dancers, completely {ensorcelled} by their grace.
e.zh: 她看着舞者，完全被他们的优雅迷住了。

e.en: The hero broke the queen's {ensorcellment} with a single word.
e.zh: 英雄只用一句话就解除了女王身上的魔法。

e.en: His {ensorcellment} with fame made ordinary life feel dull.
e.zh: 他对名声的迷恋让平凡生活显得乏味。

e.en: In the poem, the moon {ensorcels} the sleeping city.
e.zh: 在诗中，月亮使沉睡的城市像着了魔。

e.en: Her music {ensorcels} listeners who expect only simple songs.
e.zh: 她的音乐迷住了那些原本只期待简单歌曲的听众。

ensoul.t: 赋予灵魂；使有精神生命

e.en: The sculptor hoped to {ensoul} the stone with human sorrow.
e.zh: 雕刻家希望把人的悲伤注入石头，使它有灵魂。

e.en: Rituals can {ensoul} a place with shared memory.
e.zh: 仪式能用共同记忆赋予一个地方精神生命。

ensouled.t: 有灵魂的；被赋予精神的

e.en: The philosopher argued that every animal was {ensouled}.
e.zh: 这位哲学家认为每一种动物都有灵魂。

e.en: Her paintings feel {ensouled} by grief and tenderness.
e.zh: 她的画仿佛被悲伤和温柔赋予了灵魂。

e.en: He described art as the {ensouling} of raw material.
e.zh: 他把艺术描述为给原始材料注入灵魂。

e.en: The ceremony was meant to be an {ensouling} act for the community.
e.zh: 这场仪式意在成为给社群注入精神的行动。

e.en: The debate over fetal {ensoulment} shaped medieval theology.
e.zh: 关于胎儿何时获得灵魂的争论影响了中世纪神学。

e.en: For her, music offered a kind of {ensoulment} to daily labor.
e.zh: 在她看来，音乐给日常劳作带来某种精神注入。

ensphere.t: 包围成球；围住；置于球体中

e.en: Clouds seemed to {ensphere} the mountain at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时云层仿佛把那座山包围成一个球。

e.en: The poet tried to {ensphere} an entire life in one image.
e.zh: 诗人试图用一个意象包住整个人生。

ensphered.t: 被包围的；置于球体中的

e.en: The lamp glowed, {ensphered} in a shell of frosted glass.
e.zh: 灯在磨砂玻璃罩中发光，像被球体包住。

e.en: Their private grief was {ensphered} within public ceremony.
e.zh: 他们私人的悲伤被包裹在公共仪式之中。

e.en: A ring of mist {enspheres} the valley each morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨，一圈雾气都会围住山谷。

e.en: The final chapter {enspheres} the novel's scattered memories.
e.zh: 最后一章把小说中零散的记忆包拢起来。

enspirit.t: 鼓舞；赋予精神；使充满活力

e.en: The leader's words helped {enspirit} the tired volunteers.
e.zh: 领导者的话鼓舞了疲惫的志愿者。

e.en: Color can {enspirit} a plain room without costly changes.
e.zh: 色彩不用昂贵改造就能让朴素房间充满活力。

enstatite.t: 顽火辉石；一种硅酸盐矿物

e.en: The meteorite contained tiny crystals of {enstatite}.
e.zh: 这块陨石含有微小的顽火辉石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {enstatite} in the dark volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在深色火山岩中鉴定出顽火辉石。

enstatitic.t: 含顽火辉石的；顽火辉石质的

e.en: The sample showed an {enstatitic} composition under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下样本显示出顽火辉石质的成分。

e.en: Researchers compared several {enstatitic} meteorites from the collection.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了收藏中的几块含顽火辉石陨石。

e.en: Nurses used linen strips to {enswathe} the injured arm.
e.zh: 护士用亚麻布条包裹受伤的手臂。

e.en: Morning fog began to {enswathe} the quiet harbor.
e.zh: 晨雾开始笼罩安静的港口。

e.en: The mummy's {enswathement} was remarkably well preserved.
e.zh: 这具木乃伊的缠裹保存得异常完好。

e.en: The valley's {enswathement} in fog delayed the search.
e.zh: 山谷被雾笼罩，耽误了搜寻工作。

entablement.t: 柱上楣构；古典建筑檐部

e.en: The temple's {entablement} rested on six marble columns.
e.zh: 神庙的柱上楣构由六根大理石柱支撑。

e.en: Restorers repaired cracks in the carved {entablement}.
e.zh: 修复人员修补了雕刻檐部上的裂缝。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {entacoustic} device for the hard of hearing.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件早期给听力受损者使用的助听装置。

e.en: Doctors tested an {entacoustic} instrument designed to amplify speech.
e.zh: 医生测试了一种用于放大语音的耳内传声器具。

e.en: The surgeon moved the probe {entad} with great care.
e.zh: 外科医生非常小心地把探针向内推进。

e.en: Anatomists describe the fold as turning {entad} near the joint.
e.zh: 解剖学家描述该皱褶在关节附近向内转。

e.en: The old spelling {entaglement} appears in several early dictionaries.
e.zh: entaglement 这种旧拼法出现在几部早期词典中。

e.en: Their financial {entaglement} made a clean separation difficult.
e.zh: 他们的财务纠缠使彻底分开变得困难。

e.en: The diagram marks the {ental} surface of the shell.
e.zh: 图示标出了贝壳的内侧表面。

e.en: In anatomical notes, {ental} usually means directed inward.
e.zh: 在解剖学笔记中，ental 通常表示朝向内部。

e.en: The trainer hoped to {entame} the nervous horse gradually.
e.zh: 驯马师希望逐步驯服那匹紧张的马。

e.en: Law alone cannot {entame} a culture of corruption.
e.zh: 单靠法律无法让腐败文化受到控制。

entameba.t: 内阿米巴；变形虫属原虫

e.en: The lab report mentioned {entameba} in the stool sample.
e.zh: 化验报告提到粪便样本中有内阿米巴。

e.en: Doctors treated the intestinal infection caused by {entameba}.
e.zh: 医生治疗了由内阿米巴引起的肠道感染。

entamoebiasis.t: 内阿米巴病；阿米巴感染

e.en: Untreated {entamoebiasis} can cause severe diarrhea.
e.zh: 未经治疗的内阿米巴病可能导致严重腹泻。

e.en: The traveler was tested for {entamoebiasis} after returning home.
e.zh: 这名旅行者回国后接受了内阿米巴病检测。

e.en: The physician noted abnormal {entasia} in the patient's limbs.
e.zh: 医生注意到患者四肢有异常的肌肉强直。

e.en: Old medical texts used {entasia} for a state of bodily tension.
e.zh: 旧医学文献用entasia表示身体紧张状态。

e.en: Greek columns often show subtle {entasis} near the middle.
e.zh: 希腊柱子中部常有细微的柱身微凸。

e.en: The architect added {entasis} to make the column look straight.
e.zh: 建筑师加入柱身微凸，使柱子看起来更挺直。

e.en: Aristotle used {entelechy} to describe fulfilled potential.
e.zh: 亚里士多德用entelechy描述潜能的实现。

e.en: The seed's {entelechy} is the mature tree it may become.
e.zh: 种子的内在目的就是它可能长成的成熟树木。

e.en: The {entellus} is often seen near temples in India.
e.zh: 长尾叶猴常在印度寺庙附近出现。

e.en: A troop of {entellus} monkeys crossed the road at dawn.
e.zh: 一群长尾叶猴在黎明时穿过道路。

e.en: The poem seems to {entemple} memory itself.
e.zh: 这首诗似乎把记忆本身奉为神圣。

e.en: Ancient builders would {entemple} the statue after the ceremony.
e.zh: 古代工匠会在仪式后把雕像安置于庙中。

e.en: The damaged building was not {enterable} after the fire.
e.zh: 火灾后，这栋受损建筑已无法进入。

e.en: Only numbers are {enterable} in this field.
e.zh: 这个字段只能录入数字。

e.en: Severe {enteralgia} kept the patient awake all night.
e.zh: 严重肠痛让病人整夜无法入睡。

e.en: The doctor distinguished {enteralgia} from ordinary indigestion.
e.zh: 医生把肠绞痛与普通消化不良区分开来。

e.en: Early researchers called serotonin {enteramine} in intestinal tissue.
e.zh: 早期研究者把肠组织中的血清素称为肠胺。

e.en: The paper discussed {enteramine} as a gut-derived chemical signal.
e.zh: 论文讨论了肠胺作为肠道来源的化学信号。

e.en: The pharmacist described the tablet as {enterate} rather than gastric.
e.zh: 药剂师说明这种药片是肠溶的，而不是胃溶的。

e.en: An {enterate} preparation releases medicine in the intestine.
e.zh: 肠溶制剂会在肠道内释放药物。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {enterectomy} to remove damaged bowel.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了肠切除术，切除受损肠段。

e.en: Recovery after {enterectomy} requires careful nutritional support.
e.zh: 肠切除术后的恢复需要谨慎的营养支持。

e.en: The old diagnosis described the condition as {enteremphraxis}.
e.zh: 旧诊断把这种情况称为肠梗阻。

e.en: Pain and vomiting suggested {enteremphraxis} rather than mild cramps.
e.zh: 疼痛和呕吐提示是肠道阻塞，而不是轻微痉挛。

enteroanthelone.t: 肠黏膜茸状突起；肠息肉

e.en: The pathologist identified an {enteroanthelone} during examination.
e.zh: 病理医生在检查中发现了肠黏膜茸状突起。

e.en: An {enteroanthelone} may resemble a small intestinal polyp.
e.zh: 肠黏膜茸状突起可能像一个小的肠息肉。

e.en: Some {enterobacteria} can cause hospital-acquired infections.
e.zh: 一些肠杆菌类细菌会导致院内感染。

e.en: The study measured {enterobacteria} in river water samples.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了河水样本中的肠杆菌类细菌。

e.en: The culture revealed an {enterobacterium} resistant to several drugs.
e.zh: 培养结果显示有一种对多种药物耐受的肠杆菌。

e.en: Each {enterobacterium} was tested for antibiotic sensitivity.
e.zh: 每一种肠杆菌都接受了抗生素敏感性测试。

e.en: Bacteria produce {enterobactin} to capture scarce iron.
e.zh: 细菌产生肠杆菌素来捕获稀缺的铁。

e.en: The experiment measured {enterobactin} levels under iron starvation.
e.zh: 实验测量了缺铁条件下的肠杆菌素水平。

e.en: Children with {enterobiasis} often itch at night.
e.zh: 患蛲虫病的儿童夜间常会发痒。

e.en: Good hygiene helps prevent {enterobiasis} from spreading at school.
e.zh: 良好卫生习惯有助于防止蛲虫病在学校传播。

e.en: The scan confirmed an {enterocele} behind the vaginal wall.
e.zh: 扫描确认阴道壁后方有小肠膨出。

e.en: Surgery may be needed when an {enterocele} causes pressure.
e.zh: 当肠疝造成压迫时，可能需要手术。

e.en: {Enterochromaffin} cells release much of the body's serotonin.
e.zh: 肠嗜铬细胞会释放人体大部分血清素。

e.en: The tumor arose from {enterochromaffin} tissue in the gut.
e.zh: 这个肿瘤源自肠道中的肠嗜铬组织。

e.en: The drug had a mild {enterocinetic} effect after meals.
e.zh: 这种药在饭后有轻微促进肠运动的作用。

e.en: Researchers studied the {enterocinetic} response in isolated bowel tissue.
e.zh: 研究人员在离体肠组织中研究促进肠运动的反应。

e.en: The patient developed an {enterococcal} bloodstream infection.
e.zh: 患者出现了肠球菌性血流感染。

e.en: Hospitals monitor {enterococcal} resistance to common antibiotics.
e.zh: 医院会监测肠球菌对常用抗生素的耐药性。

e.en: The water sample contained high levels of {enterococci}.
e.zh: 水样中含有高水平的肠球菌。

e.en: Some {enterococci} are harmless, but others cause infection.
e.zh: 有些肠球菌无害，但另一些会引起感染。

e.en: The embryology lecture explained how the {enterocoel} forms in some animals.
e.zh: 胚胎学课解释了某些动物的肠体腔如何形成。

e.en: Researchers compared the {enterocoel} with other types of body cavities.
e.zh: 研究人员把肠源体腔与其他类型的体腔作了比较。

e.en: The starfish embryo shows {enterocoelic} development of the coelom.
e.zh: 海星胚胎表现出体腔的肠体腔式发育。

e.en: She described the {enterocoelic} pouch in her zoology notes.
e.zh: 她在动物学笔记中描述了肠源体腔囊。

e.en: Some deuterostomes are described as {enterocoelous} in older texts.
e.zh: 一些后口动物在旧教材中被描述为有肠体腔。

e.en: The professor contrasted {enterocoelous} animals with schizocoelous ones.
e.zh: 教授把有肠体腔的动物同裂体腔动物作了对比。

e.en: The infant was treated for severe {enterocolitis} after surgery.
e.zh: 这个婴儿术后因严重小肠结肠炎接受治疗。

e.en: Antibiotics can sometimes trigger {enterocolitis} in vulnerable patients.
e.zh: 抗生素有时会在脆弱患者中诱发小肠结肠炎。

e.en: Textbooks once used {enterogastrone} to describe hormones that slow stomach activity.
e.zh: 教科书曾用肠抑胃素来指减慢胃活动的激素。

e.en: The experiment measured whether {enterogastrone} reduced acid secretion.
e.zh: 实验测量肠抑胃素是否会减少胃酸分泌。

e.en: The chart wrote {enterogastrtis}, but the doctor meant enterogastritis.
e.zh: 病历上写成enterogastrtis，但医生指的是肠胃炎。

e.en: Search results for {enterogastrtis} usually point to the correct medical spelling.
e.zh: 搜索enterogastrtis的结果通常会指向正确的医学拼写。

enterograph.t: 肠道造影图；肠动描记器

e.en: The radiologist reviewed the {enterograph} for signs of obstruction.
e.zh: 放射科医生查看肠道造影图，寻找梗阻迹象。

e.en: An old physiology lab used an {enterograph} to record intestinal movement.
e.zh: 旧式生理实验室用肠动描记器记录肠道运动。

e.en: The flock showed symptoms consistent with {enterohepatitis}.
e.zh: 这群家禽出现了符合肠肝炎的症状。

e.en: Veterinarians monitored the outbreak of {enterohepatitis} closely.
e.zh: 兽医密切监测这次肠肝炎暴发。

e.en: The lab grew an {enteroid} from intestinal stem cells.
e.zh: 实验室用肠道干细胞培养出一个肠类器官。

e.en: The tissue had an {enteroid} structure under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这块组织呈现肠样结构。

e.en: The enzyme {enterokinase} activates trypsinogen in the small intestine.
e.zh: 肠激酶在小肠中激活胰蛋白酶原。

e.en: Biochemists used {enterokinase} to cut a fusion protein.
e.zh: 生物化学家用肠激酶切割融合蛋白。

e.en: The drug increased {enterokinesia} during the trial.
e.zh: 这种药在试验中增强了肠运动。

e.en: Poor {enterokinesia} can contribute to abdominal discomfort.
e.zh: 肠蠕动不良可能导致腹部不适。

e.en: Dietary lignans are converted into {enterolactone} by gut bacteria.
e.zh: 膳食木脂素会被肠道细菌转化为肠内酯。

e.en: The study measured {enterolactone} levels in blood samples.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了血样中的肠内酯水平。

e.en: The horse needed surgery to remove a large {enterolith}.
e.zh: 这匹马需要手术取出一块很大的肠石。

e.en: A calcified {enterolith} can block the intestine.
e.zh: 钙化的肠石可能堵塞肠道。

e.en: Imaging revealed an {enterolithic} mass near the obstruction.
e.zh: 影像显示梗阻附近有肠石性肿块。

e.en: The surgeon noted {enterolithic} material in the bowel.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到肠腔内有肠石样物质。

e.en: The patient was referred to an {enterologist} for chronic bowel pain.
e.zh: 患者因慢性肠道疼痛被转诊给肠病学医生。

e.en: An {enterologist} may work closely with a gastroenterologist.
e.zh: 肠病学医生可能会与胃肠科医生密切合作。

e.en: Her research in {enterology} focused on intestinal infections.
e.zh: 她在肠病学方面的研究集中于肠道感染。

e.en: Older medical books sometimes treated {enterology} as a separate field.
e.zh: 旧医学书有时把肠病学视为一个独立领域。

e.en: The scan suggested {enteromegalia} rather than a localized tumor.
e.zh: 扫描提示是肠肿大，而不是局部肿瘤。

e.en: Severe inflammation may lead to {enteromegalia} in rare cases.
e.zh: 严重炎症在少数情况下可能导致肠肿大。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed {enteromycosis} in the immunocompromised patient.
e.zh: 活检证实这名免疫低下患者患有肠真菌病。

e.en: Doctors considered {enteromycosis} after standard antibiotics failed.
e.zh: 常规抗生素无效后，医生考虑到肠真菌病。

e.en: The simple animal has one {enteron} for digestion.
e.zh: 这种简单动物有一个用于消化的消化腔。

e.en: The textbook used {enteron} as a general term for the gut.
e.zh: 教材把enteron用作肠管的通称。

e.en: The sample contained {enteroom} collected during the procedure.
e.zh: 样本中含有手术过程中采集的肠内容物。

e.en: The nurse labeled the {enteroom} specimen for laboratory analysis.
e.zh: 护士给肠腔内容物标本贴上标签，以便实验室分析。

e.en: The outbreak was linked to {enteropathogenic} bacteria in the water supply.
e.zh: 这次暴发与供水中的致肠病细菌有关。

e.en: Clinicians tested for {enteropathogenic} strains of E. coli.
e.zh: 临床医生检测了致肠病性大肠杆菌菌株。

e.en: The old diagnosis of {enteroptosis} appeared in her medical notes.
e.zh: 她的病历中出现了肠下垂这个旧诊断。

e.en: Weak abdominal support was once blamed for {enteroptosis}.
e.zh: 过去人们曾把肠下垂归因于腹部支撑薄弱。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the {enterorrhexis} immediately.
e.zh: 外科医生立即修补了肠破裂处。

e.en: Blunt trauma can rarely cause {enterorrhexis}.
e.zh: 钝性外伤少数情况下会造成肠破裂。

e.en: Philosophers debated whether such {entia} truly exist.
e.zh: 哲学家争论这样的实体是否真的存在。

e.en: The theory treats numbers as abstract {entia}.
e.zh: 这个理论把数字视为抽象存在物。

e.en: The child was {enticeable} with promises of sweets.
e.zh: 只要许诺给糖果，那个孩子就容易被吸引。

e.en: Even careful investors are sometimes {enticeable} by quick profits.
e.zh: 即使谨慎的投资者有时也会被快速获利所诱惑。

e.en: The pollen grain's {entine} remained visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下仍能看到花粉粒的内壁。

e.en: Botanists described the {entine} as the softer inner layer.
e.zh: 植物学家把内层膜描述为较柔软的内层。

e.en: The argument gives the mind an {entitative} status.
e.zh: 这个论证赋予心灵一种实体性的地位。

e.en: Medieval writers used {entitative} language about abstract qualities.
e.zh: 中世纪作者会用实体化的语言谈论抽象性质。

e.en: The database stores unique {entity-identifiers} for every customer.
e.zh: 数据库为每位客户保存唯一的实体标识符。

e.en: Missing {entity-identifiers} made the records hard to merge.
e.zh: 缺少实体标识符让这些记录很难合并。

e.en: The embryologist identified the {entoblast} in the early sample.
e.zh: 胚胎学家在早期样本中识别出了内胚层。

e.en: Older textbooks often called the endoderm the {entoblast}.
e.zh: 旧教材常把内胚层称作entoblast。

e.en: The fracture extended toward the {entocondyle} of the bone.
e.zh: 骨折延伸到了骨头的内侧髁。

e.en: Anatomists measured the {entocondyle} during the skeletal study.
e.zh: 解剖学家在骨骼研究中测量了内髁。

e.en: The scan showed abnormal {entocranial} pressure.
e.zh: 扫描显示颅内压力异常。

e.en: Researchers compared the skull's {entocranial} surface with casts.
e.zh: 研究人员把颅骨内表面与模型进行了比较。

e.en: The {entoderm} later forms parts of the gut.
e.zh: 内胚层后来会形成肠道的一些部分。

e.en: In older biology texts, {entoderm} is used for endoderm.
e.zh: 在较旧的生物学文本中，entoderm用来指内胚层。

e.en: The surgeon described the tube as {entogastric}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这根管描述为入胃的。

e.en: The report noted mild {entogastric} irritation after treatment.
e.zh: 报告指出治疗后有轻微胃内刺激。

e.en: The physician suspected an {entogenous} source of infection.
e.zh: 医生怀疑感染源来自体内。

e.en: Some minerals form through {entogenous} processes underground.
e.zh: 有些矿物通过地下的内生过程形成。

e.en: The scheme could {entoil} honest people in legal trouble.
e.zh: 这个骗局可能使诚实的人陷入法律麻烦。

e.en: Vines began to {entoil} the abandoned gate.
e.zh: 藤蔓开始缠住那扇废弃的大门。

e.en: He felt {entoiled} in promises he could not keep.
e.zh: 他觉得自己被无法兑现的承诺缠住了。

e.en: The bird was {entoiled} in a loose fishing net.
e.zh: 那只鸟被松散的渔网缠住了。

e.en: The contract was {entoiling} them in endless obligations.
e.zh: 这份合同让他们陷入无尽的义务之中。

e.en: The creeper was {entoiling} the old stone wall.
e.zh: 爬藤正缠绕着那面旧石墙。

e.en: Debt {entoils} many families before they notice the danger.
e.zh: 许多家庭还没意识到危险就被债务缠住了。

e.en: The net {entoils} whatever drifts too close.
e.zh: 这张网会缠住任何漂得太近的东西。

e.en: The old anatomy chart labeled the organ an {entoleter}.
e.zh: 那张旧解剖图把该器官标作内消化器官。

e.en: Students rarely meet the word {entoleter} outside historical texts.
e.zh: 学生很少在历史文献之外见到entoleter这个词。

e.en: The larva develops {entomesenchyme} during early growth.
e.zh: 幼体在早期发育中形成内胚间充质。

e.en: The paper traced cells from the {entomesenchyme}.
e.zh: 论文追踪了来自内胚间充质的细胞。

e.en: The clinic treated a rare case of {entomiasis}.
e.zh: 诊所治疗了一例罕见的昆虫寄生病。

e.en: Poor sanitation can increase the risk of {entomiasis}.
e.zh: 卫生条件差会增加昆虫寄生病的风险。

e.en: The museum expanded its {entomic} collection this year.
e.zh: 博物馆今年扩大了昆虫标本收藏。

e.en: Her {entomic} notes described the beetle's wing structure.
e.zh: 她的昆虫学笔记描述了甲虫的翅膀结构。

e.en: The professor gave an {entomical} lecture on moth behavior.
e.zh: 教授做了一场关于蛾类行为的昆虫学讲座。

e.en: Its {entomical} features helped identify the species.
e.zh: 它的昆虫特征有助于识别这个物种。

e.en: The anthropologist marked the {entomion} on the skull.
e.zh: 人类学家在颅骨上标出了蝶鳞缝点。

e.en: Measurements from the {entomion} helped compare the specimens.
e.zh: 来自该颅骨测点的测量值有助于比较标本。

e.en: The oak leaf bore a small {entomocecidum}.
e.zh: 橡树叶上长着一个小虫瘿。

e.en: Botanists collected the {entomocecidum} for closer study.
e.zh: 植物学家采集了这个昆虫虫瘿以便进一步研究。

e.en: The survey documented the island's {entomofauna}.
e.zh: 这项调查记录了岛上的昆虫区系。

e.en: Climate change is altering local {entomofauna}.
e.zh: 气候变化正在改变当地的昆虫群。

entomogenous.t: 昆虫寄生的；生于昆虫的

e.en: The fungus is {entomogenous} and grows on beetle larvae.
e.zh: 这种真菌寄生于昆虫，生长在甲虫幼虫上。

e.en: Researchers isolated an {entomogenous} parasite from the colony.
e.zh: 研究人员从群体中分离出一种昆虫寄生物。

e.en: The surgeon explained the {enterostomy} before the operation.
e.zh: 手术前，外科医生解释了肠造口术。

e.en: After the {enterostomy}, she needed special wound care.
e.zh: 肠造口术后，她需要特殊的伤口护理。

e.en: The vet performed an {enterotomy} to remove the blockage.
e.zh: 兽医进行了肠切开术以清除堵塞物。

e.en: An {enterotomy} may be necessary during complex abdominal surgery.
e.zh: 复杂腹部手术中可能需要进行肠切开术。

e.en: The lamb died suddenly from {enterotoxemia}.
e.zh: 这只羔羊因肠毒血症突然死亡。

e.en: Vaccination helps prevent {enterotoxemia} in young goats.
e.zh: 接种疫苗有助于预防幼山羊的肠毒血症。

e.en: Older medical texts often called typhoid fever {enterotyphus}.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献常把伤寒称为肠伤寒。

e.en: The doctor found the word {enterotyphus} in a nineteenth-century case note.
e.zh: 医生在一份十九世纪病例记录中看到了肠伤寒这个词。

e.en: The child caught an {enterovirus} at school.
e.zh: 这个孩子在学校感染了肠道病毒。

e.en: Some types of {enterovirus} can affect the nervous system.
e.zh: 某些类型的肠道病毒会影响神经系统。

e.en: The parasite was classified as an {enterozoon}.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫被归为肠内寄生动物。

e.en: An {enterozoon} lives inside the digestive tract of its host.
e.zh: 肠内寄生动物生活在宿主的消化道内。

e.en: He wrote {enterpreneur} when he meant entrepreneur.
e.zh: 他本想写企业家，却误写成了enterpreneur。

e.en: The teacher marked {enterpreneur} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 老师把enterpreneur标为拼写错误。

e.en: The city welcomed young {enterprisers} with tax incentives.
e.zh: 这座城市用税收优惠欢迎年轻创业者。

e.en: Ambitious {enterprisers} often see risk as opportunity.
e.zh: 有抱负的企业家常把风险看作机会。

e.en: The chemist used {enthalpimetry} to study the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家用焓变测定法研究这个反应。

e.en: Modern {enthalpimetry} can detect very small heat changes.
e.zh: 现代焓变测定法能检测很小的热量变化。

e.en: The {enthalpogram} showed a sharp thermal peak.
e.zh: 焓变图显示出一个尖锐的热峰。

e.en: She compared each {enthalpogram} after changing the solvent.
e.zh: 更换溶剂后，她比较了每一张焓图。

e.en: The surgeon avoided using an {enthetic} material.
e.zh: 外科医生避免使用植入性材料。

e.en: In old medical writing, {enthetic} disease meant an introduced infection.
e.zh: 在旧医学文献中，enthetic疾病指外来感染。

e.en: The old laboratory kept an {enthrakometer} in a wooden case.
e.zh: 那间老实验室把二氧化碳测量仪放在木盒里。

e.en: An {enthrakometer} was once used to measure carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 二氧化碳测量仪过去曾用于测量二氧化碳。

e.en: Her {enthrallment} with the novel lasted for days.
e.zh: 她对这本小说的着迷持续了好几天。

e.en: The crowd watched in silent {enthrallment}.
e.zh: 人群屏息凝神地看着，完全被吸引住了。

e.en: His {enthralment} with ancient maps became obvious.
e.zh: 他对古地图的着迷变得很明显。

e.en: The singer held the audience in {enthralment}.
e.zh: 这位歌手让观众听得入迷。

e.en: The ceremony will {enthrone} the new monarch tomorrow.
e.zh: 典礼将于明天让新君主登基。

e.en: Critics say the policy would {enthrone} profit over justice.
e.zh: 批评者说，这项政策会把利润置于正义之上。

e.en: The ritual {enthrones} each ruler before the nobles.
e.zh: 这项仪式让每位统治者在贵族面前登基。

e.en: The essay {enthrones} reason above tradition.
e.zh: 这篇文章把理性置于传统之上。

e.en: The priests were {enthroning} the young king at dawn.
e.zh: 祭司们在黎明时为年轻国王举行登基仪式。

e.en: The book is accused of {enthroning} wealth as the highest value.
e.zh: 这本书被指责把财富奉为最高价值。

e.en: The cathedral prepared for the bishop's {enthronisation}.
e.zh: 大教堂为主教的就任典礼做准备。

e.en: Newspapers described the {enthronisation} in formal language.
e.zh: 报纸用正式措辞报道了登基典礼。

e.en: The king's {enthronization} drew visitors from across the country.
e.zh: 国王的登基典礼吸引了全国各地的访客。

e.en: Her {enthronization} as abbess followed a long election.
e.zh: 她经过漫长选举后举行了女修道院院长就任礼。

e.en: They planned to {enthronize} the prince in spring.
e.zh: 他们计划在春天让王子登基。

e.en: The church will {enthronize} the new bishop next week.
e.zh: 教会将在下周为新主教举行就任礼。

e.en: The newly {enthronized} queen greeted the crowd.
e.zh: 新近登基的女王向人群致意。

e.en: For decades, the theory remained {enthronized} in textbooks.
e.zh: 几十年来，这一理论一直在教科书中被奉为权威。

e.en: The archbishop is {enthronizing} the new bishop today.
e.zh: 大主教今天正在为新主教举行就任礼。

e.en: The article criticizes the culture for {enthronizing} fame.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评这种文化把名声奉为至高无上。

e.en: His argument was {enthymematic}, leaving one premise unstated.
e.zh: 他的论证是省略三段论式的，留下一个前提没有明说。

e.en: The professor analyzed the speech's {enthymematic} structure.
e.zh: 教授分析了这篇演讲的省略三段论结构。

e.en: An {enthymeme} relies on an assumption the audience accepts.
e.zh: 省略三段论依赖听众认可的一个假设。
