e.en: The advertisement used an {enthymeme} instead of a full argument.
e.zh: 这则广告用了省略三段论，而不是完整论证。

entomolite.t: 昆虫化石或虫形石化物

e.en: The museum labeled the tiny fossil as an {entomolite}.
e.zh: 博物馆把这块小化石标注为昆虫化石。

e.en: She found an {entomolite} in the limestone layer.
e.zh: 她在石灰岩层中发现了一块虫形石化物。

e.en: The report included detailed {entomologic} observations.
e.zh: 报告包含了详细的昆虫学观察。

e.en: His {entomologic} notes helped identify the beetle.
e.zh: 他的昆虫学笔记帮助确认了这只甲虫。

entomologize.t: 研究昆虫；从事昆虫采集

e.en: They spent the summer trying to {entomologize} in the marshes.
e.zh: 他们整个夏天都在沼泽地研究昆虫。

e.en: Victorian collectors liked to {entomologize} during country walks.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的收藏者喜欢在乡间散步时采集昆虫。

e.en: The infected fly was covered by an {entomomycete}.
e.zh: 那只受感染的苍蝇身上长满了寄生昆虫的真菌。

e.en: Researchers isolated an {entomomycete} from dead aphids.
e.zh: 研究人员从死蚜虫中分离出一种虫生真菌。

entomophagous.t: 食昆虫的；以昆虫为食的

e.en: Many bats are {entomophagous} and hunt at night.
e.zh: 许多蝙蝠以昆虫为食，并在夜间捕猎。

e.en: The farmer encouraged {entomophagous} birds near the fields.
e.zh: 农民鼓励食虫鸟类在田地附近活动。

entomophilous.t: 靠昆虫传粉的；喜昆虫的

e.en: The orchid is {entomophilous} and depends on bees.
e.zh: 这种兰花靠昆虫传粉，依赖蜜蜂。

e.en: Bright petals often mark an {entomophilous} plant.
e.zh: 鲜艳的花瓣常常表明植物需要昆虫传粉。

e.en: The botanist studied {entomophily} in alpine flowers.
e.zh: 这位植物学家研究高山花卉的昆虫传粉。

e.en: Loss of bees can reduce {entomophily} in orchards.
e.zh: 蜜蜂减少会降低果园里的昆虫传粉。

entomophyte.t: 虫生植物；寄生昆虫的真菌

e.en: Older texts described the fungus as an {entomophyte}.
e.zh: 旧文献把这种真菌称作寄生昆虫的真菌。

e.en: The specimen was catalogued as an {entomophyte}.
e.zh: 这个标本被登记为虫生植物。

entomophytous.t: 虫生植物的；寄生昆虫的

e.en: The lecture covered several {entomophytous} fungi.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了几种寄生昆虫的真菌。

e.en: An {entomophytous} growth appeared on the dead larva.
e.zh: 死去的幼虫上出现了虫生真菌的生长物。

entomostracan.t: 小型甲壳类动物的；介形类动物

e.en: The pond sample contained an {entomostracan}.
e.zh: 池塘样本中含有一种小型甲壳类动物。

e.en: She compared several {entomostracan} shells under the microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下比较了几个介形类动物的壳。

e.en: His old handbook used {entomotaxy} for insect classification.
e.zh: 他的旧手册用昆虫分类学来整理昆虫。

e.en: The course introduced {entomotaxy} before fieldwork began.
e.zh: 课程在野外实习前介绍了昆虫分类学。

e.en: The {entomotomist} examined the beetle's mouthparts.
e.zh: 昆虫解剖学家检查了甲虫的口器。

e.en: An experienced {entomotomist} prepared the tiny specimen.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的昆虫解剖学家处理了这个微小标本。

e.en: The student learned {entomotomy} through careful dissection.
e.zh: 学生通过细致解剖学习昆虫解剖学。

e.en: Early manuals of {entomotomy} used detailed plates.
e.zh: 早期的昆虫解剖学手册使用了精细图版。

entoparasite.t: 体内寄生虫；内寄生生物

e.en: The worm lives as an {entoparasite} in fish.
e.zh: 这种蠕虫作为体内寄生虫生活在鱼体内。

e.en: Doctors identified the {entoparasite} after a blood test.
e.zh: 医生通过血液检测确认了这种内寄生虫。

entophyte.t: 内生植物；体内寄生植物

e.en: The fungus was described as an {entophyte} of the grass.
e.zh: 这种真菌被描述为禾草的内生植物。

e.en: An {entophyte} may live quietly inside plant tissue.
e.zh: 内生植物可能安静地生活在植物组织内。

entophytic.t: 内生植物的；体内寄生的

e.en: The leaf showed signs of {entophytic} infection.
e.zh: 这片叶子显示出内生性侵染的迹象。

e.en: Researchers tracked {entophytic} fungi inside the stem.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了茎内的内生真菌。

e.en: The surgeon found the organ in an {entopic} position.
e.zh: 外科医生发现该器官处在正常位置。

e.en: An {entopic} pregnancy develops inside the uterus.
e.zh: 原位妊娠是在子宫内发育的妊娠。

e.en: The diagram distinguished ectoplasm from {entoplasm}.
e.zh: 图示区分了外质和细胞内层原生质。

e.en: Granules moved slowly through the {entoplasm}.
e.zh: 颗粒在内质中缓慢移动。

entoplastra.t: 内腹甲板复数；龟腹甲内板

e.en: The fossil preserved both {entoplastra} clearly.
e.zh: 这块化石清楚地保存了两块内腹甲板。

e.en: She compared the {entoplastra} of several turtles.
e.zh: 她比较了几只龟的内腹甲板。

e.en: The turtle's {entoplastron} was unusually broad.
e.zh: 这只龟的内腹甲板异常宽。

e.en: Paleontologists measured the {entoplastron} of the specimen.
e.zh: 古生物学家测量了该标本的龟腹甲内板。

e.en: The sample included a tiny {entoproct}.
e.zh: 样本中有一只微小的内肛动物。

e.en: An {entoproct} colony grew on the submerged rope.
e.zh: 一群内肛动物生长在浸水的绳索上。

entoptic.t: 眼内产生的；内视现象的

e.en: Floaters are a common {entoptic} phenomenon.
e.zh: 飞蚊影是一种常见的眼内视觉现象。

e.en: The patient reported {entoptic} flashes in bright light.
e.zh: 患者报告在强光下看到眼内产生的闪光。

entoptoscope.t: 内视镜；眼内现象观察器

e.en: The physician demonstrated an {entoptoscope} to the class.
e.zh: 医生向全班演示了一台眼内现象观察器。

e.en: An {entoptoscope} can reveal shadows within the eye.
e.zh: 内视镜可以显示眼内的阴影。

e.en: The shell showed a small {entoptygma} near its edge.
e.zh: 贝壳边缘附近有一处小的向内皱襞。

e.en: He sketched the {entoptygma} in the anatomical plate.
e.zh: 他在解剖图版中画出了内褶。

e.en: The paper described damage to the {entoretina}.
e.zh: 论文描述了视网膜内层的损伤。

e.en: Signals pass through the {entoretina} before reaching deeper cells.
e.zh: 信号先经过内视网膜，再到达更深层细胞。

e.en: The parasite was described as an {entorganism} living inside its host.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫被描述为生活在宿主体内的内生生物。

e.en: Old medical texts sometimes used {entorganism} for an internal parasite.
e.zh: 旧医学文献有时用entorganism指体内寄生物。

e.en: The pathologist noted changes in the {entostroma} of the tissue.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到该组织内部基质的变化。

e.en: In older anatomical writing, {entostroma} referred to an inner supporting layer.
e.zh: 在较早的解剖学写作中，entostroma指内部支撑层。

e.en: The surgeon avoided damaging the {entotic} structures during the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中避免损伤耳内结构。

e.en: An {entotic} infection can cause deep pain and dizziness.
e.zh: 耳内感染可能引起深部疼痛和头晕。

e.en: The lecture compared {entozoa} with parasites that live on the skin.
e.zh: 讲座把体内寄生虫类与生活在皮肤上的寄生虫作了比较。

e.en: Nineteenth-century zoologists classified many worms as {entozoa}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的动物学家把许多蠕虫归为体内寄生虫类。

e.en: The doctor identified the worm as an {entozoan}.
e.zh: 医生确认这条蠕虫是一种体内寄生虫。

e.en: An {entozoan} may live unnoticed in an animal for months.
e.zh: 体内寄生虫可能在动物体内潜伏数月而不被发现。

e.en: The specimen showed an {entozoic} stage in its life cycle.
e.zh: 标本显示其生命周期中有一个体内寄生阶段。

e.en: Some {entozoic} worms depend entirely on their hosts for food.
e.zh: 一些体内寄生的蠕虫完全依赖宿主获取食物。

e.en: The museum hired an {entozoologist} to examine the preserved parasites.
e.zh: 博物馆聘请了一位体内寄生虫学家检查保存的寄生虫。

e.en: As an {entozoologist}, she specialized in worms found inside mammals.
e.zh: 作为体内寄生虫学家，她专门研究哺乳动物体内的蠕虫。

e.en: His early papers helped establish {entozoology} as a separate field.
e.zh: 他的早期论文推动体内寄生虫学成为一个独立领域。

e.en: Students of {entozoology} studied parasites found inside birds and fish.
e.zh: 学习体内寄生虫学的学生研究鸟类和鱼类体内的寄生虫。

e.en: Each {entozoon} was removed and preserved for study.
e.zh: 每只体内寄生虫都被取出并保存以供研究。

e.en: The old report called the intestinal worm an {entozoon}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这种肠道蠕虫称为体内寄生虫。

e.en: The audience returned after the {entr'acte} for the final act.
e.zh: 观众在幕间休息后回来观看最后一幕。

e.en: The orchestra played a lively {entr'acte} before the curtain rose again.
e.zh: 帷幕再次升起前，乐团演奏了一段活泼的幕间曲。

e.en: The study measured the {entrainment} of sleep cycles by daylight.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了日光对睡眠周期的带动同步作用。

e.en: Engineers reduced the {entrainment} of air bubbles in the liquid.
e.zh: 工程师减少了液体中空气泡的夹带。

e.en: Bureaucratic rules can {entrammel} even simple decisions.
e.zh: 官僚规则甚至会束缚简单决策。

e.en: The net seemed to {entrammel} every branch it touched.
e.zh: 那张网似乎缠住了碰到的每一根树枝。

e.en: The reform was {entrammelled} by endless legal objections.
e.zh: 这项改革被无休止的法律异议束缚住了。

e.en: The bird lay {entrammelled} in the torn fishing net.
e.zh: 那只鸟被破渔网缠住，倒在那里。

e.en: Her {entrancement} with the music lasted long after the concert ended.
e.zh: 音乐会结束很久后，她仍沉浸在那种迷醉中。

e.en: The child watched the magician in complete {entrancement}.
e.zh: 孩子完全出神地看着魔术师。

e.en: She chose to {entreasure} the letter in a locked drawer.
e.zh: 她决定把那封信珍藏在上锁的抽屉里。

e.en: Poets often {entreasure} small moments of ordinary life.
e.zh: 诗人常把平凡生活中的小瞬间视为珍宝。

e.en: He looked at her {entreatingly} before she closed the door.
e.zh: 她关门前，他恳求地看着她。

e.en: The child spoke {entreatingly}, hoping for one more chance.
e.zh: 孩子哀求地说着，希望再得到一次机会。

e.en: His {entreatment} softened the judge's tone.
e.zh: 他的恳求让法官的语气缓和下来。

e.en: Despite repeated {entreatment}, the committee refused to change its decision.
e.zh: 尽管一再哀求，委员会仍拒绝改变决定。

e.en: The dancer finished the variation with a sharp {entrechat}.
e.zh: 舞者以一个利落的芭蕾交叉击腿跳结束了变奏。

e.en: A clean {entrechat} requires quick beats of the legs in the air.
e.zh: 干净的交叉击腿跳需要双腿在空中迅速击打。

e.en: The solo included several fast {entrechats} near the end.
e.zh: 独舞临近结尾时包含几个快速的交叉击腿跳。

e.en: Her {entrechats} looked effortless from the audience.
e.zh: 从观众席看，她的交叉击腿跳显得毫不费力。

e.en: He ordered an {entrecote} with pepper sauce.
e.zh: 他点了一份配胡椒酱的肋眼牛排。

e.en: The butcher recommended {entrecote} for quick grilling.
e.zh: 肉铺师傅推荐用肋间肉快速烧烤。

e.en: The manuscript border was decorated with delicate {entrelacement}.
e.zh: 手稿边框装饰着精细的交错纹样。

e.en: The novel's {entrelacement} of memories and dreams can be hard to follow.
e.zh: 小说中记忆与梦境的交织有时让人难以跟上。

e.en: The chef served a citrus {entremets} between the rich courses.
e.zh: 厨师在几道浓郁菜品之间上了一份柑橘餐间小点。

e.en: Her chocolate {entremets} had layers of mousse and sponge cake.
e.zh: 她的巧克力精致甜点有慕斯和海绵蛋糕夹层。

e.en: The city celebrates {entrepreneurialism} through grants and public events.
e.zh: 这座城市通过补助和公共活动来推崇创业精神。

e.en: Critics say excessive {entrepreneurialism} can weaken public services.
e.zh: 批评者说，过度强调企业家主义可能削弱公共服务。

e.en: The young {entrepreneuse} opened a design studio downtown.
e.zh: 这位年轻女创业者在市中心开了一家设计工作室。

e.en: Newspapers once called her an {entrepreneuse} rather than a business leader.
e.zh: 报纸过去称她为女企业家，而不是商业领袖。

e.en: The office archives were kept on the {entresol}.
e.zh: 办公室档案存放在夹层楼上。

e.en: A narrow staircase led from the shop to the {entresol}.
e.zh: 一段窄楼梯从店铺通向半层楼。

entropically.t: 以熵的方式；热力学熵上

e.en: The particles spread {entropically} through the chamber.
e.zh: 粒子以熵增的方式在腔室中扩散。

e.en: The system became {entropically} favored at higher temperatures.
e.zh: 在更高温度下，该系统在熵方面更有利。

e.en: The surgeon corrected the patient's {entropion} in a short procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生通过一个短小手术矫正了患者的睑内翻。

e.en: Untreated {entropion} can make the eyelashes scratch the cornea.
e.zh: 未经治疗的睑内翻会使睫毛刮擦角膜。

e.en: Workers will {entruck} the crates before sunrise.
e.zh: 工人们会在日出前把板条箱装上卡车。

e.en: The relief team had to {entruck} supplies across the flooded road.
e.zh: 救援队不得不用卡车把物资运过被淹的道路。

e.en: She applied for an {entry-level} job at the bank.
e.zh: 她申请了银行的一份初级职位。

e.en: This camera is {entry-level}, but the lens is surprisingly good.
e.zh: 这台相机属于入门级，但镜头出乎意料地好。

entryist.t: 打入主义者；渗透派成员

e.en: The party expelled him as an alleged {entryist}.
e.zh: 该党称他是打入主义者，并将他开除。

e.en: An {entryist} may join a larger group to influence it from within.
e.zh: 渗透派成员可能加入较大组织，从内部施加影响。

e.en: The {entryman} checked the shipment papers at the dock.
e.zh: 报关员在码头核对了货运文件。

e.en: Each {entryman} had to confirm the horse's registration.
e.zh: 每位参赛报名者都必须确认马匹的登记信息。

e.en: The poem describes the {entwinement} of memory and grief.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了记忆与悲伤的交织。

e.en: The {entwinement} of vines made the fence hard to repair.
e.zh: 藤蔓的缠绕让篱笆很难修补。

e.en: The ropes began to {entwist} in the strong current.
e.zh: 绳索在急流中开始缠绕在一起。

e.en: Old loyalties {entwist} with new political interests.
e.zh: 旧日忠诚与新的政治利益交织在一起。

e.en: The {entwisted} branches blocked the narrow path.
e.zh: 缠绕的树枝挡住了狭窄的小路。

e.en: Their histories were {entwisted} by years of alliance and rivalry.
e.zh: 多年的联盟与竞争使他们的历史交织在一起。

e.en: The cable was {entwisting} around the metal post.
e.zh: 电缆正缠绕在金属柱上。

e.en: The novel keeps {entwisting} private desire with public duty.
e.zh: 这部小说不断把私人欲望与公共责任交织起来。

e.en: The plant {entwists} itself around the balcony rail.
e.zh: 这株植物缠绕在阳台栏杆上。

e.en: The essay {entwists} philosophy with personal confession.
e.zh: 这篇文章把哲学与个人坦白交织起来。

e.en: The museum label described the seal as an example of {entypy}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签称这枚印章是凹印术的例子。

e.en: Fine {entypy} can preserve tiny details in the metal surface.
e.zh: 精细的压印图案能保留金属表面的细小细节。

e.en: The surgeon chose to {enucleate} the cyst completely.
e.zh: 外科医生选择把囊肿完整剜出。

e.en: The lecturer tried to {enucleate} the argument's central premise.
e.zh: 讲师试图阐明这个论证的核心前提。

e.en: The {enucleated} tumor was sent to the laboratory.
e.zh: 被剜出的肿瘤被送往实验室。

e.en: Researchers injected DNA into an {enucleated} egg cell.
e.zh: 研究人员把DNA注入一个去核卵细胞中。

e.en: The procedure {enucleates} the mass without damaging nearby tissue.
e.zh: 该手术会剜出肿块，同时不损伤附近组织。

e.en: Her final chapter {enucleates} the theory with unusual clarity.
e.zh: 她的最后一章异常清楚地阐明了这一理论。

e.en: The doctor is {enucleating} the lesion under local anesthesia.
e.zh: 医生正在局部麻醉下剜出病灶。

e.en: The article is {enucleating} a complex legal principle.
e.zh: 这篇文章正在阐明一项复杂的法律原则。

e.en: The parser stores each token type as an {enum}.
e.zh: 解析器把每种标记类型存为一个枚举类型。

e.en: Use an {enum} when a variable has only a few valid states.
e.zh: 当变量只有少数几个有效状态时，可以使用枚举类型。

e.en: The object has three {enumerable} properties.
e.zh: 这个对象有三个可枚举属性。

e.en: The set is infinite but still {enumerable}.
e.zh: 这个集合是无限的，但仍然可数清。

e.en: The report uses an {enumerative} style in its opening section.
e.zh: 报告开头部分采用列举式风格。

e.en: An {enumerative} proof checks every possible case.
e.zh: 枚举式证明会检查每一种可能情况。

e.en: The phrase is barely {enunciable} after the tongue twister.
e.zh: 绕口令之后，这个短语几乎难以清楚发音。

e.en: A good rule should be {enunciable} in plain language.
e.zh: 一条好规则应当能用普通语言表述出来。

e.en: The sentence has a calm, {enunciative} tone.
e.zh: 这个句子带有平静的陈述性语气。

e.en: Actors practice {enunciative} control before performing classical verse.
e.zh: 演员在表演古典诗体前会练习发音表达控制。

e.en: The radio {enunciator} read the emergency message clearly.
e.zh: 广播播音员清楚地读出了紧急信息。

e.en: In the old ceremony, an {enunciator} proclaimed the new law.
e.zh: 在古老的仪式上，宣告者宣布了新法律。

e.en: Her {enunciatory} style made every syllable easy to hear.
e.zh: 她的发音表达方式让每个音节都很容易听清。

e.en: The judge used an {enunciatory} tone when stating the ruling.
e.zh: 法官在宣读裁决时用了宣告式的语气。

e.en: Years of hardship can {enure} a person to discomfort.
e.zh: 多年的艰苦会使人习惯不适。

e.en: The benefit will {enure} to the employees under the contract.
e.zh: 根据合同，这项利益将归员工享有。

e.en: The sailors were {enured} to cold nights at sea.
e.zh: 水手们已经习惯了海上的寒冷夜晚。

e.en: The legal advantage {enured} to the company after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后，这项法律利益归公司享有。

e.en: Repeated exposure {enures} workers to the factory noise.
e.zh: 反复接触会让工人习惯工厂的噪声。

e.en: Any profit {enures} to the trust rather than the manager.
e.zh: 任何利润都归信托所有，而不是归经理。

e.en: He tried to {enveigle} his friend into signing the paper.
e.zh: 他试图哄骗朋友在文件上签字。

e.en: The advertisement {enveigled} buyers with promises of easy wealth.
e.zh: 这则广告用轻松致富的承诺诱骗买家。

e.en: Mist began to {enveil} the valley before sunset.
e.zh: 日落前，薄雾开始遮住山谷。

e.en: The poet used soft images to {enveil} her grief.
e.zh: 诗人用柔和的意象掩盖自己的悲伤。

e.en: The snake can {envenom} its prey with one quick bite.
e.zh: 这条蛇能用迅速一咬使猎物中毒。

e.en: His accusations only {envenom} the argument further.
e.zh: 他的指责只会进一步激化这场争论。

e.en: Some spiders {envenomate} insects before eating them.
e.zh: 有些蜘蛛会先给昆虫注入毒液再进食。

e.en: The scorpion did not {envenomate} every defensive sting.
e.zh: 蝎子并不是每次防御性蜇刺都会注入毒液。

e.en: The doctor treated the {envenomation} with antivenom.
e.zh: 医生用抗蛇毒血清治疗这次毒液中毒。

e.en: Rapid swelling may signal serious {envenomation} after a bite.
e.zh: 被咬后迅速肿胀可能表示发生了严重中毒。

e.en: The hunter found an {envenomed} wound on the dog.
e.zh: 猎人在狗身上发现了一处中毒的伤口。

e.en: She answered with an {envenomed} remark about his failure.
e.zh: 她用一句充满怨毒的话回应他的失败。

e.en: Snake {envenoming} requires quick medical attention.
e.zh: 蛇咬造成的毒液中毒需要迅速就医。

e.en: The report studied {envenoming} from several tropical species.
e.zh: 这份报告研究了几种热带物种造成的毒液中毒。

e.en: The paper describes {envenomization} as a complex biological event.
e.zh: 论文把毒液注入描述为一种复杂的生物过程。

e.en: Severe {envenomization} can damage tissue around the bite.
e.zh: 严重的毒液作用会损伤咬伤周围的组织。

e.en: The wasp {envenoms} small insects with its sting.
e.zh: 黄蜂用刺使小昆虫中毒。

e.en: Resentment {envenoms} every conversation between them.
e.zh: 怨恨让他们之间的每次谈话都充满毒意。

e.en: An {envier} often notices what others have before his own gifts.
e.zh: 嫉妒者常先注意别人拥有的东西，而忽略自己的天赋。

e.en: She was no bitter {envier} of her sister's success.
e.zh: 她并不是一个怨恨姐姐成功的嫉妒者。

e.en: The local {enviro} group opposed the new road.
e.zh: 当地环保团体反对修建这条新路。

e.en: The company hired an {enviro} consultant for the project.
e.zh: 公司为这个项目聘请了一名环境顾问。

e.en: The study considered {environal} factors around the old mine.
e.zh: 这项研究考虑了旧矿区周围的环境因素。

e.en: Writers once used {environal} to mean surrounding or encircling.
e.zh: 作家过去曾用environal表示周围的或环绕的。

e.en: The course introduced {environics} as a broad study of human surroundings.
e.zh: 这门课把环境学介绍为对人类周围环境的广泛研究。

e.en: Early {environics} combined architecture, ecology, and social planning.
e.zh: 早期环境系统研究结合了建筑、生态和社会规划。

environment-friendlier.t: 更环保的；更利于环境的

e.en: The new packaging is {environment-friendlier} than plastic wrap.
e.zh: 这种新包装比塑料膜更环保。

e.en: They chose an {environment-friendlier} route for the delivery trucks.
e.zh: 他们为送货卡车选择了一条更有利于环境的路线。

e.en: We bought {environment-friendly} soap for the campsite.
e.zh: 我们为露营地买了环保肥皂。

e.en: The town promotes {environment-friendly} transport like cycling.
e.zh: 该镇推广骑车等对环境友好的交通方式。

e.en: His speech took an {environmentalistic} view of city planning.
e.zh: 他的演讲从环保主义角度看待城市规划。

e.en: The novel has an {environmentalistic} message about industrial waste.
e.zh: 这部小说传达了关于工业废料的环保主义信息。

e.en: The hotel uses {environmentally-friendly} cleaning products.
e.zh: 这家酒店使用环保清洁产品。

e.en: Buying second-hand furniture can be {environmentally-friendly}.
e.zh: 购买二手家具可能更不伤害环境。

e.en: She studied {environmentology} before working in conservation.
e.zh: 她在从事保护工作前学习过环境学。

e.en: The professor used {environmentology} to describe interdisciplinary environmental research.
e.zh: 教授用环境学来描述跨学科的环境研究。

e.en: The poem ends with a brief {envoi} to the reader.
e.zh: 这首诗以一段写给读者的简短结语收尾。

e.en: In older texts, an {envoi} could mean a messenger sent abroad.
e.zh: 在较古老的文本中，envoi也可指派往国外的使者。

e.en: His brief {envoyship} ended after the treaty was signed.
e.zh: 条约签署后，他短暂的使节任期便结束了。

e.en: The novel treats {envoyship} as a lonely burden.
e.zh: 这部小说把使节身份写成一种孤独的负担。

e.en: The old builders {enwall} the garden against winter winds.
e.zh: 老工匠们筑墙把花园围住，以挡住冬风。

e.en: Fear can {enwall} a person from the wider world.
e.zh: 恐惧会把一个人与更广阔的世界隔绝开来。

e.en: She tried to {enweave} silver threads into the cloth.
e.zh: 她试着把银线织进那块布里。

e.en: The poet would {enweave} memory and myth in every stanza.
e.zh: 诗人会在每一节里把记忆与神话交织起来。

e.en: The dancers {enwheel} the fire at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，舞者们围着火堆转成一圈。

e.en: Clouds seemed to {enwheel} the mountain peak.
e.zh: 云层仿佛环绕着那座山峰。

e.en: Ivy began to {enwind} the broken gate.
e.zh: 常春藤开始缠绕那扇破旧的门。

e.en: The melody seemed to {enwind} itself around her thoughts.
e.zh: 那段旋律似乎缠绕在她的思绪周围。

e.en: The {enwinding} vines hid the cottage windows.
e.zh: 盘绕的藤蔓遮住了小屋的窗户。

e.en: He followed an {enwinding} path through the ruins.
e.zh: 他沿着一条蜿蜒盘绕的小路穿过废墟。

e.en: The cave seemed to {enwomb} the sleeping traveler.
e.zh: 那洞穴似乎像子宫一样包裹着熟睡的旅人。

e.en: Silence can {enwomb} a new idea before words arrive.
e.zh: 在语言出现之前，沉默也能孕育一个新想法。

e.en: The child felt {enwombed} in the warm darkness.
e.zh: 孩子觉得自己被温暖的黑暗包裹着。

e.en: A secret hope lay {enwombed} in his careful silence.
e.zh: 一种隐秘的希望孕育在他谨慎的沉默里。

e.en: The {enwombing} darkness made the room feel safe.
e.zh: 包裹着一切的黑暗让房间显得安全。

e.en: Her patience was {enwombing} a difficult plan.
e.zh: 她的耐心正在孕育一个艰难的计划。

e.en: They {enwreathe} the statue with flowers each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天，他们都用鲜花环绕那座雕像。

e.en: Smoke began to {enwreathe} the ruined tower.
e.zh: 烟雾开始缭绕在那座废塔周围。

e.en: The clerk would {enwrite} each name in a heavy ledger.
e.zh: 书记员会把每个名字写进厚厚的账簿里。

e.en: Grief can {enwrite} itself on a person's face.
e.zh: 悲伤会铭刻在一个人的脸上。

e.en: The gate was {enwrought} with leaves and tiny birds.
e.zh: 那扇门上精心雕饰着叶子和小鸟。

e.en: Old beliefs were {enwrought} into the village customs.
e.zh: 古老的信念被织入了村庄的习俗之中。

e.en: His open contempt caused her sudden {enxashment}.
e.zh: 他赤裸裸的轻蔑让她突然恼怒起来。

e.en: The letter's tone added to the committee's {enxashment}.
e.zh: 那封信的语气进一步激怒了委员会。

e.en: She moved to {Enzed} after finishing university.
e.zh: 她大学毕业后搬去了新西兰。

e.en: The comedian joked about {Enzed} accents on stage.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员在台上拿新西兰口音开玩笑。

e.en: An {Enzedder} helped us find the right bus.
e.zh: 一位新西兰人帮我们找到了正确的公交车。

e.en: He writes like an {Enzedder} with dry humor.
e.zh: 他的写作带着新西兰人式的冷幽默。

e.en: The island suffered an {enzooty} among its sheep.
e.zh: 岛上的羊群暴发了一场地方性动物病。

e.en: Veterinarians tracked the {enzooty} through several farms.
e.zh: 兽医在几个农场追踪这场地方性动物病。

enzygotic.t: 合子内的；与合子有关的

e.en: The study examined {enzygotic} changes after fertilization.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了受精后合子内的变化。

e.en: Researchers described an {enzygotic} stage in early development.
e.zh: 研究人员描述了早期发育中的一个合子阶段。

e.en: The starch was {enzymatically} broken down into sugars.
e.zh: 淀粉通过酶作用被分解成糖。

e.en: Researchers {enzymatically} modified the protein in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室中通过酶作用改造了这种蛋白质。

e.en: Heat can destroy the {enzymic} activity in fresh juice.
e.zh: 高温会破坏鲜榨果汁中的酶活性。

e.en: The reaction followed an {enzymic} pathway.
e.zh: 这个反应沿着一条酶促途径进行。

e.en: The sample was {enzymically} treated before analysis.
e.zh: 样品在分析前经过了酶处理。

e.en: Some fibers break down {enzymically} during fermentation.
e.zh: 一些纤维会在发酵过程中经酶作用分解。

e.en: An {enzymologist} explained why the reaction slowed.
e.zh: 一位酶学家解释了反应变慢的原因。

e.en: The hospital hired an {enzymologist} for the research team.
e.zh: 医院为研究团队聘请了一名酶学家。

e.en: She specialized in {enzymology} during graduate school.
e.zh: 她在研究生阶段专攻酶学。

e.en: Modern {enzymology} helps explain many metabolic disorders.
e.zh: 现代酶学有助于解释许多代谢疾病。

e.en: The protein underwent {enzymolysis} during digestion.
e.zh: 这种蛋白质在消化过程中发生了酶解作用。

e.en: Researchers used {enzymolysis} to break down the plant fibers.
e.zh: 研究人员利用酶促分解来分解植物纤维。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with a rare {enzymopathy}.
e.zh: 这个孩子被诊断出患有一种罕见的酶病。

e.en: An inherited {enzymopathy} can disrupt normal metabolism.
e.zh: 遗传性酶功能异常症会扰乱正常代谢。

e.en: The lecture discussed {eobiogenesis} on the ancient Earth.
e.zh: 这场讲座讨论了远古地球上的生命早期起源。

e.en: Scientists proposed a new model of {eobiogenesis}.
e.zh: 科学家提出了一种新的生命早期起源模型。

e.en: An {eobiont} may have lacked modern cellular structures.
e.zh: 原始生命体可能没有现代细胞结构。

e.en: The model treats each {eobiont} as a simple chemical system.
e.zh: 该模型把每个原始生命体视为简单的化学系统。

e.en: The patient described brief {eocylosis} after waking.
e.zh: 患者描述醒来后有短暂的清晨视力模糊。

e.en: Persistent {eocylosis} should be checked by an eye doctor.
e.zh: 持续的清晨视力模糊应由眼科医生检查。

e.en: The fossils preserve an {eogenetic} stage of the species.
e.zh: 这些化石保存了该物种早期生成的阶段。

e.en: Geologists studied the rock's {eogenetic} mineral changes.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了这块岩石初生阶段的矿物变化。

e.en: The {eohippus} was much smaller than a modern horse.
e.zh: 始祖马比现代马小得多。

e.en: Museum visitors saw a reconstructed {eohippus} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者看到了复原的始祖马骨架。

e.en: Desert stones were polished by {eolation}.
e.zh: 沙漠中的石头被风蚀打磨得很光滑。

e.en: The dunes show patterns caused by {eolation}.
e.zh: 这些沙丘呈现出风力作用造成的纹理。

e.en: The cliff is made of pale {eolianite}.
e.zh: 这处悬崖由浅色风成岩构成。

e.en: Old dunes hardened into {eolianite} over time.
e.zh: 古老沙丘随着时间推移固结成了风成岩。

e.en: A small {eolienne} powered the remote cabin.
e.zh: 一台小型风力机为偏远木屋供电。

e.en: The village installed an {eolienne} near the coast.
e.zh: 村庄在海岸附近安装了一台风力发电机。

e.en: The chipped stone was once called an {eolith}.
e.zh: 这块有缺口的石头曾被称为疑似早期石器。

e.en: Archaeologists debated whether the {eolith} was natural.
e.zh: 考古学家争论这件疑似早期石器是否为天然形成。

e.en: The museum removed its old {eolithic} display.
e.zh: 博物馆撤下了旧的疑似早期石器展品。

e.en: Scholars questioned the {eolithic} interpretation of the flakes.
e.zh: 学者质疑这些石片属于疑似早期石器的解释。

e.en: The toy demonstrated {eolomotion} with a tiny fan.
e.zh: 这个玩具用一个小风扇演示了空气推动运动。

e.en: Engineers measured {eolomotion} in the light experimental craft.
e.zh: 工程师测量了这架轻型实验飞行器的空气推动运动。

e.en: Crystal strength often depends on {eolotropy}.
e.zh: 晶体强度常常取决于各向异性。

e.en: The paper measured optical {eolotropy} in thin films.
e.zh: 论文测量了薄膜中的光学各向异性。

e.en: The mountains seemed {eonian} under the stars.
e.zh: 星空下的群山仿佛永世长存。

e.en: She spoke of an {eonian} silence before creation.
e.zh: 她谈到创世之前那种极其漫长的寂静。

e.en: Early psychiatrists used {eonism} as a clinical term.
e.zh: 早期精神科医生把异装癖作为临床术语使用。

e.en: Modern writers discuss {eonism} in historical context.
e.zh: 现代作者会在历史语境中讨论易装倾向。

e.en: The fossil may represent an ancient {eophyte}.
e.zh: 这块化石可能代表一种远古原始植物。

e.en: Botanists compared the {eophyte} with later algae.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种早期植物与后来的藻类作比较。

e.en: The diary mentions unusual {eopsia} at dawn.
e.zh: 日记提到黎明时出现了异常的晨间视觉。

e.en: Doctors recorded changes in her {eopsia}.
e.zh: 医生记录了她晨间视觉的变化。

e.en: The tissue was stained with {eosine}.
e.zh: 这份组织样本用曙红进行了染色。

e.en: The artist mixed {eosine} into the red ink.
e.zh: 艺术家把伊红染料混入红色墨水中。

e.en: Blood tests showed mild {eosinopenia}.
e.zh: 血液检查显示有轻度嗜酸细胞减少症。

e.en: Stress can sometimes cause temporary {eosinopenia}.
e.zh: 压力有时会导致暂时性的嗜酸细胞减少症。

e.en: The pathologist noted {eosinophilous} granules in the cells.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到细胞中有嗜酸性颗粒。

e.en: Some tissues appear strongly {eosinophilous} after staining.
e.zh: 有些组织染色后显得明显亲曙红。

e.en: The collector bought a crystal of {eosphorite}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一块曙磷铝锰矿晶体。

e.en: Pink {eosphorite} was found in the pegmatite vein.
e.zh: 在这条伟晶岩脉中发现了粉色曙磷铝锰矿。

e.en: Nineteenth-century scientists argued about {eozoon}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的科学家曾围绕始生动物化石展开争论。

e.en: The supposed {eozoon} later proved to be mineral structure.
e.zh: 那件所谓的始生动物化石后来被证明是矿物结构。

e.en: Several {eozoons} were listed in the old catalog.
e.zh: 旧目录中列出了几件始生动物化石。

e.en: Most claimed {eozoons} are now treated with caution.
e.zh: 如今人们对大多数所谓的始生动物化石都持谨慎态度。

e.en: The surgeon noted an {epacmastic} discharge from the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到伤口有发脓性分泌物。

e.en: Older physicians sometimes used an {epacmastic} plaster to draw out infection.
e.zh: 旧时医生有时用促脓膏药来引出感染。

e.en: The fever entered its {epacme} after the crisis passed.
e.zh: 危象过后，发热进入了衰退期。

e.en: Critics saw the empire's wealth as an {epacme}, not a beginning.
e.zh: 评论者认为帝国的财富已是盛期之后，而非开端。

epact.t: 闰余；太阳年与太阴年差

e.en: The calendar table lists the {epact} for each year.
e.zh: 历法表列出了每一年的闰余。

e.en: Medieval computists used the {epact} to calculate Easter.
e.zh: 中世纪历算者用闰余来推算复活节。

e.en: The monk copied the {epactal} numbers into the margin.
e.zh: 修士把闰余数抄在页边。

e.en: An {epactal} table helped readers follow the lunar cycle.
e.zh: 一张闰余表帮助读者追踪月相周期。

e.en: Aristotle discussed {epagoge} as a route from examples to principles.
e.zh: 亚里士多德把归纳法视为由例子通向原则的路径。

e.en: Her argument relies on {epagoge} rather than strict deduction.
e.zh: 她的论证依靠归纳推理，而不是严格演绎。

e.en: The teacher used an {epagogic} method, starting with simple cases.
e.zh: 老师采用归纳式方法，从简单案例讲起。

e.en: His {epagogic} reasoning moved from observations to a general rule.
e.zh: 他的归纳推理从观察走向一般规则。

e.en: The poem uses {epanadiplosis} to make the line feel circular.
e.zh: 这首诗用首尾重复法让诗行产生循环感。

e.en: In rhetoric class, we identified {epanadiplosis} in the slogan.
e.zh: 在修辞课上，我们指出了口号里的首尾重复法。

e.en: The speech gains force through {epanaphora} at the start of each clause.
e.zh: 这篇演讲通过每个分句开头的重复增强力量。

e.en: Biblical prose often uses {epanaphora} for solemn rhythm.
e.zh: 圣经体散文常用句首重复法来形成庄重节奏。

e.en: The entomologist examined the fly's {epandrium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 昆虫学家在显微镜下检查这只苍蝇的雄性外生殖器背板。

e.en: Species can be distinguished by the shape of the {epandrium}.
e.zh: 不同物种可凭雄性外生殖器背板的形状来区分。

e.en: The fossil skull appeared {epanisognathous} in the reconstruction.
e.zh: 复原图中的化石头骨显得上下颌不等。

e.en: A specialist described the animal as {epanisognathous} after measuring its jaws.
e.zh: 专家测量其颌部后称这种动物上下颌不等。

e.en: The sentence uses {epanodos} by returning to its earlier words in reverse order.
e.zh: 这个句子用词序倒回法，以相反顺序回到前面的词。

e.en: Her sermon employed {epanodos} to give the passage balance.
e.zh: 她的布道运用回环修辞，使段落更有平衡感。

epanorthosis.t: 改正强调法；自我修正修辞

e.en: His phrase, 'a mistake, no, a disaster,' is {epanorthosis}.
e.zh: 他说的“一个错误，不，是一场灾难”就是自我修正修辞。

e.en: The novelist used {epanorthosis} to show the narrator revising a thought.
e.zh: 小说家用改正强调法表现叙述者在修正想法。

e.en: The botanist described the tiny growth as {epanthous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这处微小生长物描述为生在花上的。

e.en: An {epanthous} parasite may damage the blossom before fruit forms.
e.zh: 附花寄生物可能在结果前损害花朵。

eparch.t: 东仪教区主教；地方长官

e.en: The {eparch} visited the parish during the feast.
e.zh: 东仪教区主教在节日期间访问了该堂区。

e.en: In Byzantine administration, an {eparch} governed an important province.
e.zh: 在拜占庭行政体系中，地方长官治理重要行省。

eparchial.t: 教区主教的；行省长官的

e.en: The council reviewed the {eparchial} records from several churches.
e.zh: 委员会查阅了几座教会的教区主教档案。

e.en: An {eparchial} decree regulated trade in the city.
e.zh: 一项行省长官令规范了城中的贸易。

e.en: The new {eparchy} serves Greek Catholics in the region.
e.zh: 这个新的东仪教区服务该地区的希腊天主教徒。

e.en: Ancient documents mention an {eparchy} along the frontier.
e.zh: 古代文献提到边境一带有一个行省辖区。

e.en: The patient complained of {eparsalgia} around the injured joint.
e.zh: 患者诉说受伤关节周围有肿胀痛。

e.en: Old medical notes recorded {eparsalgia} after the infection worsened.
e.zh: 旧病历记载感染加重后出现了肿胀痛。

e.en: The surgeon identified an {eparterial} bronchus on the scan.
e.zh: 外科医生在扫描中识别出位于动脉上方的支气管。

e.en: In anatomy, {eparterial} structures lie above a nearby artery.
e.zh: 在解剖学中，eparterial结构位于邻近动脉上方。

e.en: The dancer softened her {epaulement} during the adagio.
e.zh: 舞者在慢板段落中柔化了肩部姿态。

e.en: Good {epaulement} gives classical ballet a refined line.
e.zh: 良好的斜肩位让古典芭蕾呈现优雅线条。

e.en: The fish uses {epaxial} muscles to stabilize its spine.
e.zh: 这条鱼用背侧肌肉来稳定脊柱。

e.en: Biologists compared {epaxial} and hypaxial muscle development.
e.zh: 生物学家比较了轴上方肌肉与轴下方肌肉的发育。

e.en: She added fresh {epazote} to the pot of beans.
e.zh: 她往豆子锅里加入了新鲜土荆芥。

e.en: Dried {epazote} gives the soup a sharp herbal aroma.
e.zh: 干墨西哥香草让汤带有浓烈的草本香气。

e.en: The young {epeeist} won her first national medal.
e.zh: 这位年轻重剑运动员赢得了首枚全国奖牌。

e.en: An experienced {epeeist} waits patiently for a clean opening.
e.zh: 经验丰富的重剑选手会耐心等待清晰的进攻机会。

e.en: Geologists mapped an {epeiric} sea that once covered the craton.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了曾覆盖克拉通的陆表海。

e.en: The limestone formed in a broad {epeiric} environment.
e.zh: 这片石灰岩形成于广阔的浅内海环境。

epeirogenesis.t: 陆块升降运动；造陆作用

e.en: The plateau rose slowly through {epeirogenesis}.
e.zh: 这片高原通过陆块升降运动缓慢抬升。

e.en: Geologists distinguish {epeirogenesis} from mountain-building compression.
e.zh: 地质学家把造陆作用同造山挤压区分开来。

e.en: The basin records an {epeirogenic} uplift event.
e.zh: 该盆地记录了一次陆块升降的抬升事件。

e.en: Broad {epeirogenic} movements reshaped the old continent.
e.zh: 大范围的造陆运动重塑了这片古老大陆。

epeirogenically.t: 以造陆方式；因陆块升降

e.en: The region was {epeirogenically} uplifted over millions of years.
e.zh: 该地区在数百万年间因陆块升降而抬升。

e.en: The shoreline shifted {epeirogenically}, not through local faulting.
e.zh: 海岸线是以造陆方式移动的，而不是因局部断层活动。

e.en: Slow {epeirogeny} changed the drainage pattern.
e.zh: 缓慢的造陆作用改变了水系格局。

e.en: The model explains subsidence as {epeirogeny}.
e.zh: 这个模型把沉降解释为陆块升降作用。

e.en: The scan showed an {epencephalic} developmental defect.
e.zh: 扫描显示有后脑发育缺陷。

e.en: Researchers measured {epencephalic} growth in the embryo.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了胚胎菱脑的生长情况。

e.en: The {epencephalon} later forms important brain structures.
e.zh: 后脑之后会形成重要的脑部结构。

e.en: Damage near the {epencephalon} affected coordination.
e.zh: 后脑附近的损伤影响了协调能力。

e.en: The {ependyma} lines the brain ventricles.
e.zh: 室管膜覆盖在脑室内壁。

e.en: Inflammation of the {ependyma} can block fluid flow.
e.zh: 室管膜发炎可能阻碍脑脊液流动。

e.en: The dialect shows several vowel {epentheses}.
e.zh: 这种方言有几处元音插音现象。

e.en: Linguists counted the {epentheses} in casual speech.
e.zh: 语言学家统计了随意口语中的插入音。

e.en: The word developed an extra vowel by {epenthesis}.
e.zh: 这个词通过插音多出了一个元音。

e.en: English speakers often use {epenthesis} in difficult clusters.
e.zh: 英语使用者常在难发的辅音连缀中加入插音。

e.en: The patient complained of persistent {eperalgia}.
e.zh: 患者诉说持续的肝区疼痛。

e.en: Old medical texts listed {eperalgia} among abdominal pains.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把肝痛列为腹痛的一类。

e.en: A silver {epergne} stood in the center of the table.
e.zh: 一只银制餐桌花果架摆在桌子中央。

e.en: She filled the {epergne} with grapes and roses.
e.zh: 她把葡萄和玫瑰放进餐桌中央花果架里。

e.en: The second clause offers {epexegesis} of the first.
e.zh: 第二个从句对第一个从句作了补充说明。

e.en: His sermon relied heavily on {epexegesis}.
e.zh: 他的布道大量依靠详加解释。

e.en: The sentence ends with an {epexegetic} phrase.
e.zh: 这个句子以一个补充解释短语结尾。

e.en: Her note was {epexegetic}, clarifying the legal term.
e.zh: 她的注释具有阐明作用，解释了那个法律术语。

e.en: The phrase functions {epexegetically} in the passage.
e.zh: 这个短语在文中起补充解释作用。

e.en: He added the clause {epexegetically} after the main statement.
e.zh: 他在主句后以补充解释方式加上了从句。

ephah.t: 伊法；古希伯来容量单位

e.en: The law required an {ephah} of fine flour.
e.zh: 律法要求献上一伊法细面。

e.en: An {ephah} was an ancient Hebrew dry measure.
e.zh: 伊法是一种古希伯来的干量单位。

e.en: The paper described an {ephapse} between adjacent neurons.
e.zh: 论文描述了相邻神经元之间的神经接触。

e.en: Signals may pass through an {ephapse} without a classic synapse.
e.zh: 信号可能不经传统突触而通过突触样连接传递。

e.en: The shell shows {epharmony} with its rocky habitat.
e.zh: 这种贝壳表现出与岩石栖息地的适应性调和。

e.en: Biologists used {epharmony} to describe the plant's form.
e.zh: 生物学家用形态适应来描述这种植物的形态。

e.en: The statue depicts an {ephebe} holding a spear.
e.zh: 这座雕像描绘了一名持矛的古希腊青年。

e.en: In Athens, an {ephebe} received civic and military training.
e.zh: 在雅典，青年男子会接受公民和军事训练。

e.en: The athletes gathered in the {ephebeion} before practice.
e.zh: 运动员们训练前聚集在古希腊青年训练馆里。

e.en: Archaeologists identified the room as an {ephebeion}.
e.zh: 考古学家认定这个房间是青年训练馆。

ephebeum.t: 青年训练馆；体育场附室

e.en: The old gymnasium included an {ephebeum} for young men.
e.zh: 这座古体育馆设有供青年男子使用的训练馆。

e.en: An inscription marked the chamber as the {ephebeum}.
e.zh: 一段铭文标明该房间为青年训练馆。

e.en: The clinic added a unit for {ephebiatrics}.
e.zh: 诊所增设了一个青少年医学科室。

e.en: Her research in {ephebiatrics} focuses on puberty disorders.
e.zh: 她在青少年医学方面的研究聚焦青春期障碍。

e.en: The poem celebrates {ephebic} beauty and strength.
e.zh: 这首诗赞美青年男子的美与力量。

e.en: Doctors tracked {ephebic} changes during adolescence.
e.zh: 医生追踪了青春期的变化。

e.en: The article discusses {ephebogenesis} in classical education.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论古典教育中的青年形成过程。

e.en: Hormones drive much of human {ephebogenesis}.
e.zh: 激素推动了人类青春期发育的大部分过程。

e.en: An {ephebos} trained for service to the city.
e.zh: 古希腊青年公民会为服务城邦而受训。

e.en: The vase shows an {ephebos} beside his teacher.
e.zh: 这只陶瓶画着一名古希腊青年站在老师旁边。

e.en: The museum label calls the figure an {ephebus}.
e.zh: 博物馆标签称这个人物为古希腊青年。

e.en: Each {ephebus} swore an oath before training began.
e.zh: 每名青年男子在训练开始前都要宣誓。

e.en: The old label listed {ephedrin} as an active ingredient.
e.zh: 旧标签把麻黄碱列为有效成分。

e.en: Doctors monitored patients closely after giving {ephedrin}.
e.zh: 医生给药麻黄碱后密切监测病人。

e.en: A small {ephelis} appeared on her cheek after summer.
e.zh: 夏天过后，她脸颊上出现了一小块雀斑。

e.en: The dermatologist described the mark as an {ephelis}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生把这处斑点称为雀斑。

e.en: The pond was full of delicate {ephemerae} at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，池塘里满是纤弱的蜉蝣。

e.en: Those fashion trends were cultural {ephemerae}.
e.zh: 那些时尚潮流只是短暂的文化现象。

e.en: Digital tools accelerated {ephemeralization} in publishing.
e.zh: 数字工具加速了出版业用更少资源完成更多事情的趋势。

e.en: Buckminster Fuller popularized the idea of {ephemeralization}.
e.zh: 巴克敏斯特·富勒推广了“少物多成”这一理念。

e.en: The survey recorded an {ephemeretum} near the riverbank.
e.zh: 调查记录到河岸附近有一片短生植物群落。

e.en: A brief spring {ephemeretum} covered the dry ground.
e.zh: 短暂的春季短生植物群覆盖了干燥地面。

e.en: An {ephemerid} rose from the water and vanished.
e.zh: 一只蜉蝣从水面升起后很快消失。

e.en: The critic called the pamphlet a political {ephemerid}.
e.zh: 评论家称那本小册子只是短命的政治读物。

e.en: Navigators once relied on printed {ephemerides}.
e.zh: 航海者过去依靠印刷的星历表。

e.en: The archive preserves astronomical {ephemerides} from the seventeenth century.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着十七世纪的天文星历表。

e.en: The court employed an {ephemerist} to prepare planetary tables.
e.zh: 宫廷雇用一名星历编算者来制作行星表。

e.en: As an {ephemerist}, she recorded each day's weather.
e.zh: 作为日记作者，她记录每天的天气。

e.en: The viral slogan proved to be an {ephemeron}.
e.zh: 那句爆红口号最终只是短暂存在的东西。

e.en: Each software build was treated as an {ephemeron}.
e.zh: 每个软件构建版本都被视为短期存在的对象。

e.en: Botanists classified the weed as an {ephemerophyte}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种杂草归为短生外来植物。

e.en: An {ephemerophyte} may appear for one season only.
e.zh: 短生外来植物可能只出现一个季节。

e.en: The artist captured an {ephemerous} moment of light.
e.zh: 艺术家捕捉到一瞬即逝的光影。

e.en: Their victory felt bright but {ephemerous}.
e.zh: 他们的胜利灿烂却短暂。

e.en: The scholar used {ephemerus} to mean lasting one day.
e.zh: 那位学者用ephemerus表示只持续一天。

e.en: A fever once called {ephemerus} passed overnight.
e.zh: 一种曾被称为ephemerus的热病一夜之间就消退了。

e.en: The microscope showed an {ephippial} case around the eggs.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见卵外有鞍状卵囊。

e.en: Researchers noted the specimen's {ephippial} structure.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了标本的鞍形结构。

e.en: The priest wore an embroidered {ephod}.
e.zh: 祭司穿着一件刺绣的以弗得圣衣。

e.en: The biblical passage describes the {ephod} in detail.
e.zh: 这段圣经文字详细描述了以弗得。

e.en: An {ephor} could challenge a Spartan king.
e.zh: 斯巴达监察官可以质疑国王。

e.en: The historian explained the duties of an {ephor}.
e.zh: 历史学家解释了监察官的职责。

e.en: The reform changed the {ephoral} powers in Sparta.
e.zh: 这项改革改变了斯巴达监察官的权力。

e.en: Scholars debate the origin of the {ephoral} office.
e.zh: 学者们争论监察官职位的起源。

ephoralty.t: 监察官职位；监察官任期

e.en: His {ephoralty} lasted only one year.
e.zh: 他的监察官任期只有一年。

e.en: The inscription dates from the first {ephoralty} recorded there.
e.zh: 这块铭文出自当地有记录的首个监察官任期。

e.en: The {ephorate} checked the power of kings.
e.zh: 监察官团制衡国王的权力。

e.en: He studied how the Spartan {ephorate} developed.
e.zh: 他研究斯巴达监察官制度如何发展。

e.en: The {ephori} met before the assembly.
e.zh: 监察官们在大会前会面。

e.en: Ancient writers often criticized the {ephori}.
e.zh: 古代作家常常批评这些监察官。

e.en: Five {ephors} were elected each year.
e.zh: 每年选出五名监察官。

e.en: The {ephors} supervised public conduct in Sparta.
e.zh: 监察官们监督斯巴达的公共行为。

e.en: The larva developed into an {ephyra}.
e.zh: 幼体发育成了水母幼体。

e.en: An {ephyra} swims differently from an adult jellyfish.
e.zh: 水母幼体的游动方式不同于成年水母。

e.en: Several {ephyrae} drifted in the tank.
e.zh: 几只水母幼体在水箱中漂动。

e.en: The biologist counted the {ephyrae} after feeding.
e.zh: 生物学家在投喂后清点水母幼体。

e.en: The tiny {ephyrula} pulsed under the lens.
e.zh: 那只小水母幼体在镜头下收缩游动。

e.en: A healthy {ephyrula} soon becomes more transparent.
e.zh: 健康的小水母幼体很快会变得更加透明。

e.en: The nurse called it an {epi} during the busy shift.
e.zh: 忙碌值班时，护士把它简称为一场流行病。

e.en: In biology, {epi} often means upon or above.
e.zh: 在生物学中，epi常表示在……之上或表面。

epiandrosterone.t: 表雄酮，一种甾体激素代谢物

e.en: The lab measured {epiandrosterone} in the urine sample.
e.zh: 实验室检测了尿样中的表雄酮。

e.en: Researchers studied how {epiandrosterone} changes during treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员观察表雄酮在治疗期间如何变化。

e.en: The fungus formed an {epibasidium} during spore production.
e.zh: 这种真菌在产生孢子时形成了上担子。

e.en: She identified the {epibasidium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下辨认出了上担子结构。

epibenthos.t: 底表生物，海底表面生物群

e.en: The survey counted the {epibenthos} living on the seabed.
e.zh: 调查统计了生活在海底表面的底表生物。

e.en: Pollution can damage local {epibenthos} communities.
e.zh: 污染会损害当地的底表生物群落。

epibiont.t: 附生生物，附着在他物上的生物

e.en: A small {epibiont} grew on the turtle's shell.
e.zh: 一小种附生生物长在海龟壳上。

e.en: Scientists removed each {epibiont} before weighing the crab.
e.zh: 科学家在称螃蟹重量前去除了每个附生生物。

epibiosis.t: 附生关系，生物附着共生现象

e.en: The study examined {epibiosis} on marine shells.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了海洋贝壳上的附生关系。

e.en: {Epibiosis} may help some organisms avoid predators.
e.zh: 附生现象可能帮助某些生物躲避捕食者。

epiblast.t: 上胚层，早期胚胎外层细胞

e.en: The {epiblast} later gives rise to many body tissues.
e.zh: 上胚层后来会形成许多身体组织。

e.en: They observed {epiblast} cells during early development.
e.zh: 他们观察了早期发育中的上胚层细胞。

epibolic.t: 外包运动的，胚胎外包的

e.en: The embryo showed {epibolic} movement during gastrulation.
e.zh: 胚胎在原肠胚形成时表现出外包运动。

e.en: The paper described an {epibolic} pattern of cell spreading.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种细胞扩展的外包模式。

epiboly.t: 外包运动，胚胎细胞包覆过程

e.en: {Epiboly} spreads cells over the yolk surface.
e.zh: 外包运动使细胞扩展并覆盖卵黄表面。

e.en: The defect slowed {epiboly} in the developing embryo.
e.zh: 这个缺陷减缓了发育中胚胎的外包运动。

e.en: The coating formed a strong {epibond} with the metal.
e.zh: 涂层与金属形成了牢固的表面键合。

e.en: Engineers tested the {epibond} after heating the sample.
e.zh: 工程师在加热样品后测试了外延键合。

e.en: The fish has a small {epibranchial} bone near the gill.
e.zh: 这条鱼在鳃附近有一块小的鳃上骨。

e.en: An {epibranchial} chamber helps some animals breathe air.
e.zh: 鳃上腔能帮助某些动物呼吸空气。

epibromohydrin.t: 环氧溴丙烷，化工中间体

e.en: The plant handled {epibromohydrin} under strict safety rules.
e.zh: 工厂按严格安全规定处理环氧溴丙烷。

e.en: Chemists used {epibromohydrin} to prepare the compound.
e.zh: 化学家用环氧溴丙烷制备这种化合物。

e.en: The old fastener had an {epicadmium} finish.
e.zh: 这个旧紧固件表面有镀镉层。

e.en: Inspectors rejected the {epicadmium} coating for cracks.
e.zh: 检查员因裂纹而拒收这层镀镉涂层。

e.en: The director wanted an {epical} tone for the final scene.
e.zh: 导演希望最后一幕有史诗般的气势。

e.en: His speech turned {epical} as the crowd grew louder.
e.zh: 随着人群声音变大，他的演讲变得宏大激昂。

e.en: The team failed {epically} in the final minutes.
e.zh: 球队在最后几分钟惨烈地失败了。

e.en: The mountains rose {epically} above the valley.
e.zh: 群山史诗般地耸立在山谷之上。

epicalyx.t: 副萼，花萼外的一圈苞片

e.en: The hibiscus has a clear {epicalyx} below the calyx.
e.zh: 木槿在花萼下方有明显的副萼。

e.en: She drew the {epicalyx} separately in the botanical diagram.
e.zh: 她在植物图中把副萼单独画了出来。

epicanthic.t: 内眦赘皮的，眼角皮褶的

e.en: The doctor noted an {epicanthic} fold near the eye.
e.zh: 医生记录了眼角附近的内眦赘皮。

e.en: {Epicanthic} features vary widely among healthy people.
e.zh: 内眦赘皮特征在健康人群中差异很大。

e.en: The infant had a mild {epicanthus}.
e.zh: 这个婴儿有轻度内眦赘皮。

e.en: Surgeons discussed whether the {epicanthus} affected vision.
e.zh: 外科医生讨论内眦赘皮是否影响视力。

e.en: The scan showed fluid near the {epicardiac} surface.
e.zh: 扫描显示心脏外层表面附近有液体。

e.en: Researchers mapped {epicardiac} nerves in the heart.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了心外膜神经分布图。

e.en: The surgeon avoided damaging the {epicardial} vessels.
e.zh: 外科医生避免损伤心外膜血管。

e.en: Excess {epicardial} fat can affect heart health.
e.zh: 过多的心外膜脂肪会影响心脏健康。

e.en: The {epicardium} covers the outer surface of the heart.
e.zh: 心外膜覆盖心脏的外表面。

e.en: Inflammation reached the {epicardium} in severe cases.
e.zh: 在严重病例中，炎症波及心外膜。

e.en: The apple's {epicarp} protects the flesh underneath.
e.zh: 苹果的外果皮保护下面的果肉。

e.en: A thick {epicarp} helps the fruit resist drying.
e.zh: 厚外果皮有助于果实抵抗干燥。

e.en: The poem has an {epicedial} mood throughout.
e.zh: 这首诗通篇带有挽歌般的哀悼情绪。

e.en: Her {epicedial} lines honored the fallen soldiers.
e.zh: 她那些挽歌式诗句悼念了阵亡士兵。

e.en: The {epicedian} praised the dead king in solemn verse.
e.zh: 这位挽歌作者用庄重诗句赞颂逝去的国王。

e.en: His {epicedian} style suited the memorial service.
e.zh: 他的挽歌式风格很适合这场追悼会。

e.en: She wrote an {epicedium} for her old teacher.
e.zh: 她为自己的老教师写了一首挽歌。

e.en: The ancient {epicedium} was read at the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼上朗读了那首古老的悼亡诗。

epicene.t: 通性别的；雌雄同体的；无性别差异的

e.en: The old grammar book listed {epicene} nouns separately.
e.zh: 那本旧语法书把通性名词单独列出。

e.en: Some species have {epicene} flowers with both sexual organs.
e.zh: 有些物种开雌雄同体的花，兼有两种生殖器官。

e.en: The scholar discussed {epicenism} in medieval pronoun use.
e.zh: 那位学者讨论了中世纪代词用法中的通性现象。

e.en: In botany, {epicenism} may describe a lack of sexual distinction.
e.zh: 在植物学中，epicenism 可指缺少性别区分的状态。

e.en: The map marked several earthquake {epicentra} across the region.
e.zh: 地图标出了该地区多个地震震中。

e.en: These cities became cultural {epicentra} after the festival expanded.
e.zh: 节日扩大后，这些城市成了文化中心。

e.en: The strongest damage occurred near the {epicentral} zone.
e.zh: 最严重的破坏发生在震中区域附近。

e.en: The museum sits in an {epicentral} part of the old city.
e.zh: 这座博物馆位于老城的中心地带。

e.en: Scientists located the earthquake's {epicentrum} beneath the bay.
e.zh: 科学家确定地震震中位于海湾下方。

e.en: The square became the {epicentrum} of public debate.
e.zh: 广场成了公共辩论的中心。

e.en: The geologist identified {epichlorite} in the altered volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在蚀变火山岩中鉴定出绿泥石类表生矿物。

e.en: Thin veins of {epichlorite} crossed the mineral sample.
e.zh: 矿物样本中有细细的绿泥石脉穿过。

e.en: The plant uses {epichlorohydrin} to make epoxy resins.
e.zh: 这家工厂使用环氧氯丙烷来生产环氧树脂。

e.en: Workers must avoid inhaling {epichlorohydrin} during production.
e.zh: 工人在生产过程中必须避免吸入环氧氯丙烷。

e.en: The lab measured {epicholestanol} in the steroid sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了甾体样品中的表胆甾烷醇。

e.en: Researchers compared {epicholestanol} with related cholesterol derivatives.
e.zh: 研究人员把表胆甾烷醇与相关胆固醇衍生物作比较。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {epicholesterol}.
e.zh: 该反应产生了少量表胆固醇。

e.en: Chemists used {epicholesterol} as a reference compound.
e.zh: 化学家把表胆固醇用作参比化合物。

e.en: The inscription preserves an {epichorial} form of the alphabet.
e.zh: 这段铭文保留了一种地方性的字母形式。

e.en: Archaeologists studied the {epichorial} customs of the island community.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了这个岛屿社群的本地习俗。

e.en: The critic called Homer the greatest ancient {epicist}.
e.zh: 评论家称荷马为最伟大的古代史诗诗人。

e.en: A modern {epicist} may write long narratives in verse.
e.zh: 现代叙事诗作者也可能用诗体写长篇故事。

e.en: The cliff exposed layers of {epiclastic} volcanic sediment.
e.zh: 峭壁露出了多层火山碎屑再沉积物。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {epiclastic} deposits around the volcano.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了火山周围再沉积火山碎屑层的分布图。

e.en: The priest recited the {epiclesis} during the Eucharistic prayer.
e.zh: 神父在圣餐祷文中诵念了圣灵祈求文。

e.en: In Greek religion, an {epiclesis} identified a deity's local aspect.
e.zh: 在希腊宗教中，神明称号会标明某位神的地方性面向。

epicon.t: 史诗体作品；史诗式叙事

e.en: The novel was described as an {epicon} of migration and loss.
e.zh: 这部小说被描述为一部关于迁徙与失落的史诗式叙事。

e.en: Few readers recognized the poem as a deliberate {epicon}.
e.zh: 很少有读者看出这首诗是有意写成的史诗体作品。

e.en: The scan showed an {epicondylar} fracture near the elbow.
e.zh: 扫描显示肘部附近有上髁骨折。

e.en: Surgeons checked the {epicondylar} region before placing the pin.
e.zh: 外科医生在置入钢针前检查了上髁区域。

e.en: The tendon attaches near the medial {epicondyle}.
e.zh: 这条肌腱附着在内侧上髁附近。

e.en: Pain over the {epicondyle} can limit elbow movement.
e.zh: 上髁处疼痛会限制肘部活动。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed lateral {epicondylitis} after examining his elbow.
e.zh: 医生检查他的肘部后诊断为外侧上髁炎。

e.en: Repetitive gripping can make {epicondylitis} worse.
e.zh: 反复用力抓握会加重上髁炎。

epicontinental.t: 陆表海的；大陆边缘浅海的

e.en: An {epicontinental} sea once covered this low plain.
e.zh: 这片低平原曾被陆表海覆盖。

e.en: The fossils formed in shallow {epicontinental} waters.
e.zh: 这些化石形成于大陆边缘的浅海水域。

e.en: The frog skeleton has a distinct {epicoracoid}.
e.zh: 这具蛙类骨骼有明显的上喙骨。

e.en: Comparative anatomists examined the {epicoracoid} in early amphibians.
e.zh: 比较解剖学家研究了早期两栖动物的上喙骨。

e.en: The seedling's {epicotyl} grew upward toward the light.
e.zh: 幼苗的上胚轴朝着光线向上生长。

e.en: Botany students measured the {epicotyl} after germination.
e.zh: 植物学学生在发芽后测量了上胚轴。

e.en: The {epicotyledonary} shoot emerged after the cotyledons opened.
e.zh: 子叶张开后，子叶以上的芽开始长出。

e.en: Researchers recorded {epicotyledonary} growth in each seedling.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了每株幼苗上胚轴部位的生长情况。

e.en: The discharge papers included an {epicrisis} of her treatment.
e.zh: 出院文件中包含了她治疗过程的病例总结。

e.en: The historian added an {epicrisis} after presenting the evidence.
e.zh: 历史学家在列出证据后加了一段评述性结论。

e.en: The test checked {epicritic} sensation in the patient's fingertips.
e.zh: 这项测试检查患者指尖的精细触觉。

e.en: Her {epicritic} judgment separated similar arguments with care.
e.zh: 她辨别性的判断细致地区分了相似的论点。

e.en: His {epicurism} showed in every carefully planned dinner.
e.zh: 他对享乐和美食的讲究体现在每一顿精心安排的晚餐中。

e.en: The essay attacks shallow {epicurism} as a poor guide to life.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评肤浅的享乐主义不足以指导人生。

e.en: The insect's {epicuticle} helps reduce water loss.
e.zh: 昆虫的表皮外层有助于减少水分流失。

e.en: Scientists examined wax crystals on the leaf {epicuticle}.
e.zh: 科学家检查了叶片上角质层表面的蜡质晶体。

epicuticular.t: 表皮外层的；角质层外的

e.en: The leaf has an {epicuticular} wax coating.
e.zh: 这片叶子有一层表皮外蜡质覆盖物。

e.en: Researchers measured the {epicuticular} lipids on the insect.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了昆虫体表外层的脂质。

e.en: The lab synthesized {epicyanohydrin} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 实验室在受控条件下合成了环氧氰醇。

e.en: The report lists {epicyanohydrin} among reactive intermediates.
e.zh: 报告把环氧氰醇列为反应性中间体之一。

e.en: The mechanism involves an {epicyclic} reaction.
e.zh: 该机理涉及一种周环反应。

e.en: Ancient models used {epicyclic} paths for planets.
e.zh: 古代模型用本轮轨道解释行星运动。

e.en: The drawing resembled an {epicycliod} rather than a circle.
e.zh: 这幅图像更像外摆线状曲线，而不是圆。

e.en: He misspelled {epicycliod} in the geometry notes.
e.zh: 他在几何笔记里把外摆线状曲线这个词拼错了。

e.en: An {epicycloid} is traced by a point on a rolling circle.
e.zh: 外摆线由滚动圆上一点的轨迹形成。

e.en: The gear tooth profile followed an {epicycloid}.
e.zh: 这个齿轮的齿形采用了外摆线轮廓。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {epicystostomy} to drain urine.
e.zh: 外科医生实施膀胱上造口术来引流尿液。

e.en: After the {epicystostomy}, the patient needed careful monitoring.
e.zh: 膀胱上造口术后，患者需要细致监测。

e.en: The pathologist identified the mass as an {epicytoma}.
e.zh: 病理医生将这个肿块判定为室管膜瘤。

e.en: Older records used {epicytoma} for a rare tumor type.
e.zh: 早期记录用上皮细胞瘤指一种罕见肿瘤。

e.en: The speech had an {epideictic} style.
e.zh: 这篇演讲带有颂扬性的修辞风格。

e.en: Critics called the ceremony {epideictic} and theatrical.
e.zh: 评论者称这场仪式炫示性强且很戏剧化。

epidemical.t: 流行性的；传染病流行的

e.en: The town faced an {epidemical} outbreak that winter.
e.zh: 那年冬天，小镇遭遇了一场流行性疫情。

e.en: Fear spread with almost {epidemical} speed.
e.zh: 恐惧以近乎流行病般的速度扩散。

e.en: The botanist described the orchid as an {epidendron}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种兰花描述为附生植物。

e.en: Moss can behave like an {epidendron} on old trees.
e.zh: 苔藓在老树上可以像附生植物一样生长。

e.en: The cream treats minor {epidermic} irritation.
e.zh: 这种乳膏用于处理轻微的表皮刺激。

e.en: The sample showed clear {epidermic} damage.
e.zh: 样本显示出明显的皮肤外层损伤。

e.en: The bacterium produces {epidermin} as an antibiotic peptide.
e.zh: 这种细菌会产生表皮素这种抗菌肽。

e.en: Scientists tested {epidermin} against resistant strains.
e.zh: 科学家测试了表皮素对耐药菌株的作用。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {epidermitis} after the rash appeared.
e.zh: 皮疹出现后，医生诊断为轻度表皮炎。

e.en: Chemical exposure can trigger {epidermitis} in sensitive skin.
e.zh: 化学品接触可能在敏感皮肤上诱发表皮炎。

e.en: Wound healing requires gradual {epidermization}.
e.zh: 伤口愈合需要逐步发生表皮化。

e.en: The graft showed good {epidermization} after two weeks.
e.zh: 两周后，移植物显示出良好的表皮形成。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {epidermolysis} bullosa.
e.zh: 这个孩子被诊断为大疱性表皮松解症。

e.en: Severe friction may cause localized {epidermolysis}.
e.zh: 严重摩擦可能导致局部表皮松解。

e.en: Athlete's foot is a common form of {epidermophytosis}.
e.zh: 脚气是表皮癣菌病的一种常见形式。

e.en: The clinic treated {epidermophytosis} with antifungal medicine.
e.zh: 诊所用抗真菌药治疗表皮癣菌病。

e.en: The teacher used an {epidiascope} to project the diagram.
e.zh: 老师用实物幻灯两用投影仪投射图表。

e.en: An old {epidiascope} stood in the lecture room.
e.zh: 讲堂里放着一台老式实物幻灯两用投影仪。

e.en: His poem used {epidictic} language to praise the hero.
e.zh: 他的诗用颂扬性的语言赞美这位英雄。

e.en: The debate shifted into an {epidictic} display of values.
e.zh: 辩论转成了一场价值观的炫示性展示。

e.en: Sperm mature in the {epididymis} before ejaculation.
e.zh: 精子在射精前会在附睾中成熟。

e.en: The ultrasound showed swelling near the {epididymis}.
e.zh: 超声显示附睾附近有肿胀。

e.en: The patient had pain caused by {epididymitis}.
e.zh: 患者的疼痛由附睾炎引起。

e.en: Doctors often treat {epididymitis} with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生通常用抗生素治疗附睾炎。

e.en: The specimen retained a thin {epidochium}.
e.zh: 这个标本保留了一层薄薄的覆盖膜。

e.en: Microscopy revealed damage to the {epidochium}.
e.zh: 显微观察显示外覆层受到了损伤。

e.en: The rock contained veins of green {epidote}.
e.zh: 这块岩石中含有绿色绿帘石脉。

e.en: Collectors prize clear crystals of {epidote}.
e.zh: 收藏者珍视透明的绿帘石晶体。

e.en: The sample showed an {epidotic} alteration zone.
e.zh: 样本显示出一个含绿帘石的蚀变带。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {epidotic} rocks near the fault.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了断层附近绿帘石质岩石的分布。

e.en: The basalt underwent strong {epidotization} during alteration.
e.zh: 玄武岩在蚀变过程中发生了强烈绿帘石化。

e.en: Field notes mention {epidotization} along the fracture zone.
e.zh: 野外记录提到裂隙带沿线有绿帘石化现象。

e.en: The {epidotized} basalt showed a greenish tint under the lens.
e.zh: 这块绿帘石化玄武岩在镜下呈现绿色调。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {epidotized} zone near the old fault.
e.zh: 地质学家标出了旧断层附近的绿帘石化带。

e.en: The report classified the basin as an {epieugeosyncline}.
e.zh: 报告把这个盆地归为后优地槽。

e.en: Few students had heard the term {epieugeosyncline} before the lecture.
e.zh: 听讲座前，很少有学生听过后优地槽这个术语。

e.en: The coral rubble supported diverse {epifauna}.
e.zh: 珊瑚碎块上生活着多样的表栖动物群。

e.en: Researchers counted the {epifauna} on each submerged panel.
e.zh: 研究人员统计了每块水下板上的表栖动物群。

e.en: The team compared {epifaunal} communities across three reefs.
e.zh: 团队比较了三处礁区的表栖动物群落。

e.en: Small crabs were common in the {epifaunal} samples.
e.zh: 这些表栖动物样本中常见小螃蟹。

e.en: Severe damage occurred in the {epifocal} area after the quake.
e.zh: 地震后，震中区遭受了严重破坏。

e.en: The {epifocal} distance was estimated from early seismic readings.
e.zh: 研究人员根据早期地震读数估算了震中距离。

e.en: The village lay close to the earthquake's {epifocus}.
e.zh: 这个村庄靠近此次地震的震中。

e.en: Seismologists recalculated the {epifocus} using new station data.
e.zh: 地震学家用新的台站数据重新计算了震中位置。

e.en: The fungus produced {epigaeous} fruiting bodies after rain.
e.zh: 雨后，这种真菌长出了地上子实体。

e.en: Botanists noted the plant's {epigaeous} germination pattern.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了这种植物的地上萌发模式。

e.en: Bright plumage can serve an {epigamic} function in birds.
e.zh: 鲜艳羽毛在鸟类中可能具有求偶炫耀功能。

e.en: The study examined {epigamic} displays during the breeding season.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了繁殖季节的求偶炫耀行为。

e.en: Darwin discussed {epigamy} in relation to sexual selection.
e.zh: 达尔文在性选择语境下讨论了求偶炫耀。

e.en: The ritual dance seemed to be a form of {epigamy}.
e.zh: 这种仪式性舞蹈似乎是一种求偶炫耀。

e.en: The patient felt pressure in the {epigaster} after eating.
e.zh: 病人饭后感到上腹部有压迫感。

e.en: Anatomy texts once used {epigaster} for the upper abdomen.
e.zh: 解剖学文献曾用epigaster指上腹部。

e.en: She reported burning pain in the {epigastrium}.
e.zh: 她说上腹部有灼烧样疼痛。

e.en: The doctor palpated the {epigastrium} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查时触诊了她的上腹部。

e.en: The surgeon described the planned {epigastrorrhaphy} to the interns.
e.zh: 外科医生向实习医生说明了计划进行的上腹部缝合术。

e.en: Older case notes mentioned {epigastrorrhaphy} after abdominal trauma.
e.zh: 较早的病例记录提到腹部创伤后的上腹部缝合术。

epigeal.t: 地上生长的；地上萌发的

e.en: Beans usually show {epigeal} germination as the cotyledons rise.
e.zh: 豆类通常表现为地上萌发，子叶会升到土面以上。

e.en: The species has an {epigeal} stem rather than a buried one.
e.zh: 这个物种有地上茎，而不是埋在地下的茎。

e.en: The ore body formed through {epigene} mineralization.
e.zh: 这个矿体是通过后成矿化形成的。

e.en: Geologists distinguished {epigene} features from primary structures.
e.zh: 地质学家把后成特征与原生构造区分开来。

e.en: Modern biology rejected simple preformation in favor of {epigenesis}.
e.zh: 现代生物学否定了简单预成论，转向渐成发育观点。

e.en: The lecture traced {epigenesis} from embryology to genetics.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了渐成发育概念从胚胎学到遗传学的发展。

e.en: The cave followed an {epigenic} drainage pattern.
e.zh: 这个洞穴遵循后成的排水格局。

e.en: They found {epigenic} minerals cutting across older layers.
e.zh: 他们发现后成矿物穿切了更古老的岩层。

e.en: The researcher compared each plant's {epigenotype} under drought stress.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了每株植物在干旱胁迫下的表观基因型。

e.en: An {epigenotype} may change without altering the DNA sequence.
e.zh: 表观基因型可能在不改变DNA序列的情况下发生变化。

e.en: The lichen formed an {epigenous} crust on the leaf surface.
e.zh: 这种地衣在叶面形成了表生的壳层。

e.en: Some parasites are {epigenous} rather than embedded in host tissue.
e.zh: 有些寄生物生于表面，而不是嵌入宿主组织中。

e.en: The mushroom is {epigeous}, appearing above the soil in autumn.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇是地上生的，秋天会出现在土面上。

e.en: The seedlings showed {epigeous} development in the greenhouse.
e.zh: 温室里的幼苗表现出地上发育。

e.en: The infection caused {epiglottal} swelling and breathing difficulty.
e.zh: 感染导致会厌肿胀并引起呼吸困难。

e.en: Some languages include rare {epiglottal} consonants.
e.zh: 有些语言包含罕见的会厌辅音。

e.en: The atlas labeled several animal {epiglottides} for comparison.
e.zh: 图谱标出了几种动物的会厌以便比较。

e.en: Medical Latin sometimes uses {epiglottides} as a plural form.
e.zh: 医学拉丁语有时把epiglottides用作复数形式。

e.en: Critics dismissed the novel as {epigonic} and uninspired.
e.zh: 评论家认为这部小说只是模仿前人，缺乏灵感。

e.en: His early poems have an {epigonic} dependence on Romantic models.
e.zh: 他的早期诗作对浪漫主义范式有后继模仿式的依赖。

epigonium.t: 藓类孢蒴包被；生殖包被

e.en: The botanist examined the {epigonium} under a dissecting microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在解剖显微镜下观察了生殖包被。

e.en: In mosses, the {epigonium} may surround the developing sporophyte.
e.zh: 在苔藓中，生殖包被可能包围发育中的孢子体。

e.en: He was seen as an {epigonus} of a greater philosopher.
e.zh: 他被视为一位伟大哲学家的追随模仿者。

e.en: The composer disliked being called an {epigonus}.
e.zh: 这位作曲家不喜欢被称为前人的模仿者。

e.en: Her {epigrammatical} style made every paragraph memorable.
e.zh: 她警句式的文风让每一段都令人难忘。

e.en: The critic preferred {epigrammatical} remarks to long explanations.
e.zh: 那位评论家更喜欢隽永简练的评论，而不是冗长解释。

epigrammatically.t: 以警句方式；简练隽永地

e.en: He answered {epigrammatically}, leaving the room amused and silent.
e.zh: 他以警句般的方式作答，让全场又好笑又沉默。

e.en: The essay ends {epigrammatically} with a sharp moral observation.
e.zh: 这篇文章以一句尖锐的道德观察简练收尾。

e.en: The speech had more {epigrammatism} than practical policy.
e.zh: 这场演说警句风格多于实际政策内容。

e.en: Victorian reviewers admired his {epigrammatism} and verbal polish.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的评论家欣赏他的隽语表达和文字打磨。

e.en: The young {epigrammatist} became famous for cruelly funny lines.
e.zh: 这位年轻的警句作者因尖刻又好笑的句子而出名。

e.en: As an {epigrammatist}, she valued precision over emotional warmth.
e.zh: 作为善写隽语的人，她看重精确胜过情感温度。

e.en: He tried to {epigrammatize} every political failure into a joke.
e.zh: 他试图把每一次政治失败都写成一句笑话式警句。

e.en: Do not {epigrammatize} grief when plain sympathy is needed.
e.zh: 需要朴素同情时，不要把悲伤硬说成隽语。

epigrammatized.t: 被写成警句的；隽语化的

e.en: The scandal was {epigrammatized} in a single savage sentence.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻被浓缩成一句尖刻的警句。

e.en: His pain became {epigrammatized} until it sounded almost elegant.
e.zh: 他的痛苦被隽语化后，听起来几乎显得优雅。

e.en: The columnist was a tireless {epigrammatizer} of public stupidity.
e.zh: 这位专栏作家总是不停地把公众的愚蠢写成警句。

e.en: A clever {epigrammatizer} can make cruelty sound like wit.
e.zh: 聪明的隽语化者能把刻薄说得像机智。

epigrammatizing.t: 写警句的；隽语化表达的

e.en: His {epigrammatizing} habit annoyed colleagues during serious meetings.
e.zh: 他爱说警句的习惯在严肃会议上惹恼了同事。

e.en: She was {epigrammatizing} sorrow instead of describing it honestly.
e.zh: 她在把悲伤说成隽语，而不是诚实地描述它。

e.en: The study measured activity in the {epigranular} layers of cortex.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了大脑皮层颗粒层上方各层的活动。

e.en: Damage to {epigranular} tissue changed the animal's sensory response.
e.zh: 颗粒层上方组织受损改变了动物的感觉反应。

e.en: The date is confirmed {epigraphically} by a stone inscription.
e.zh: 这个日期由一段石刻铭文从铭文方面得到确认。

e.en: The poem opens {epigraphically} with a borrowed classical line.
e.zh: 这首诗以题词式的方式引用了一句古典诗行开头。

e.en: The {epigraphist} identified the ruler named on the broken tablet.
e.zh: 铭文学家辨认出了残碑上提到的统治者。

e.en: An experienced {epigraphist} can read weathered letters on stone.
e.zh: 有经验的碑铭研究者能读出石头上风化的字母。

epiguanine.t: 表鸟嘌呤；鸟嘌呤异构体

e.en: The chemist detected {epiguanine} in the unusual pigment sample.
e.zh: 化学家在这份异常色素样本中检测到了表鸟嘌呤。

e.en: Older papers sometimes describe {epiguanine} as a guanine-related compound.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把表鸟嘌呤描述为与鸟嘌呤相关的化合物。

e.en: The biologist examined the spider's {epigyne} under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下检查了这只蜘蛛的外雌器。

e.en: Shape of the {epigyne} helps distinguish closely related species.
e.zh: 外雌器的形状有助于区分亲缘很近的物种。

epigynous.t: 子房下位的；着生于子房上的

e.en: Apple blossoms are commonly described as {epigynous} flowers.
e.zh: 苹果花通常被描述为子房下位的花。

e.en: In an {epigynous} flower, the petals appear above the ovary.
e.zh: 在子房下位花中，花瓣看起来位于子房上方。

e.en: The botanist noted {epigyny} as a key trait of the family.
e.zh: 植物学家把子房下位性记为该科的关键特征。

e.en: Understanding {epigyny} helps students interpret floral diagrams.
e.zh: 理解子房下位性有助于学生读懂花部图式。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {epikeratophakia} as an older refractive procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生把表层角膜晶片术作为一种较早的屈光手术来讨论。

e.en: Modern laser surgery has largely replaced {epikeratophakia} in many clinics.
e.zh: 在许多诊所，现代激光手术已很大程度上取代了表层角膜晶片术。

e.en: Some people {epilate} their legs instead of shaving them.
e.zh: 有些人会给腿部脱毛，而不是用剃刀刮。

e.en: The clinic can {epilate} unwanted hair with a small device.
e.zh: 诊所可以用小型设备去除多余毛发。

e.en: Her {epilated} skin stayed smooth for several weeks.
e.zh: 她脱毛后的皮肤保持了数周光滑。

e.en: The doctor cleaned the {epilated} area before applying medicine.
e.zh: 医生在上药前清洁了已经脱毛的区域。

e.en: This device {epilates} hair from the root.
e.zh: 这台设备会从根部拔除毛发。

e.en: She {epilates} once a month before swimming season.
e.zh: 游泳季前，她每月脱毛一次。

e.en: She was {epilating} her legs before the trip.
e.zh: 出发前她正在给腿部脱毛。

e.en: An {epilating} machine may hurt more than a razor.
e.zh: 脱毛器可能比剃刀更疼。

e.en: Laser {epilation} can reduce hair growth over time.
e.zh: 激光脱毛可以逐渐减少毛发生长。

e.en: The nurse explained that {epilation} might irritate sensitive skin.
e.zh: 护士解释说，脱毛可能会刺激敏感皮肤。

e.en: She bought an {epilator} for home hair removal.
e.zh: 她买了一台脱毛器在家去除毛发。

e.en: A good {epilator} pulls hair out instead of cutting it.
e.zh: 好的拔毛器会把毛发拔出，而不是剪断。

e.en: His arm jerked {epileptically} during the seizure.
e.zh: 癫痫发作时，他的手臂痉挛般抽动。

e.en: The old film flickered {epileptically} on the damaged screen.
e.zh: 老电影在受损银幕上痉挛般闪烁。

e.en: The EEG showed {epileptiform} activity during sleep.
e.zh: 脑电图显示睡眠期间有癫痫样活动。

e.en: Doctors investigated the child's {epileptiform} movements carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了这个孩子似癫痫的动作。

e.en: Doctors identified an {epileptogenic} area in the temporal lobe.
e.zh: 医生在颞叶发现了一个可诱发癫痫的区域。

e.en: The scar tissue was considered {epileptogenic} after repeated seizures.
e.zh: 反复发作后，那块瘢痕组织被认为具有致癫痫性。

e.en: The child showed {epileptoid} movements during the fever.
e.zh: 孩子发烧时出现了类似癫痫的动作。

e.en: Older reports described his attacks as {epileptoid} rather than epileptic.
e.zh: 早期报告把他的发作描述为癫痫样，而不是真正的癫痫。

e.en: Algae were most abundant in the {epilimnile} zone.
e.zh: 藻类在湖泊上层带最为丰富。

e.en: The survey measured {epilimnile} temperatures throughout summer.
e.zh: 这项调查测量了整个夏季湖面上层的温度。

e.en: Warm water in the {epilimnion} held less dissolved oxygen.
e.zh: 湖泊上层温水层中的水含有较少溶解氧。

e.en: Fish stayed below the {epilimnion} during the hottest weeks.
e.zh: 最热的几周里，鱼群停留在湖泊上层温水层以下。

e.en: The biologist collected {epilithic} algae from the streambed.
e.zh: 生物学家从溪床岩石上采集了附生藻类。

e.en: These {epilithic} communities tolerate strong sunlight and fast currents.
e.zh: 这些岩石附生群落能耐受强光和急流。

e.en: The novel's {epilog} reveals what happened years later.
e.zh: 小说的尾声交代了多年后发生的事。

e.en: Her speech ended with a quiet {epilog} about gratitude.
e.zh: 她的演讲以一段平静的感谢结语收尾。

e.en: The {epilogist} stepped forward after the final scene.
e.zh: 最后一幕结束后，致结语者走上前来。

e.en: As an {epilogist}, he tied the play's moral threads together.
e.zh: 作为写尾声的人，他把戏剧的道德线索串联起来。

e.en: The old diagnosis of {epiloia} is now called tuberous sclerosis.
e.zh: 过去称为结节性硬化症的诊断，如今叫作结节性硬化复合征。

e.en: Patients with {epiloia} may have seizures and skin signs.
e.zh: 结节性硬化症患者可能出现癫痫发作和皮肤表现。

e.en: The surgeon avoided disturbing the {epilymph} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术中避免扰动耳内的外淋巴液。

e.en: Damage to the membrane can let {epilymph} leak out.
e.zh: 膜受损可能会使外淋巴液渗漏出来。

e.en: The geologist described the glossy crust as {epimagma}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那层有光泽的外壳描述为表面熔浆。

e.en: Cooling {epimagma} formed a thin skin over the hotter flow.
e.zh: 冷却中的表面熔浆在更热的熔流上形成了一层薄壳。

e.en: The seed was partly covered by a fleshy {epimatium}.
e.zh: 种子的一部分被肉质的外套覆盖。

e.en: Botanists noted the bright {epimatium} around the mature seed.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到成熟种子周围鲜亮的假种皮。

e.en: The stain highlighted an {epimembranal} layer on the cells.
e.zh: 染色显示出细胞表面的一层膜上结构。

e.en: Researchers studied {epimembranal} deposits after inflammation.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了炎症后形成的膜上沉积物。

e.en: Glucose and galactose differ as an {epimer} pair.
e.zh: 葡萄糖和半乳糖是一对差向异构体。

e.en: The chemist isolated one {epimer} from the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从反应混合物中分离出一种差向异构体。

e.en: The missing {epimerase} disrupted normal sugar metabolism.
e.zh: 缺失的差向异构酶扰乱了正常的糖代谢。

e.en: This bacterial {epimerase} changes the configuration of one carbon atom.
e.zh: 这种细菌差向异构酶会改变一个碳原子的构型。

e.en: The embryologist traced the {epimere} beside the neural tube.
e.zh: 胚胎学家追踪了神经管旁的上肌节。

e.en: In some arthropods, the {epimere} forms part of the segment wall.
e.zh: 在某些节肢动物中，体节背部构成体节壁的一部分。

e.en: Heat can cause {epimerization} during sugar processing.
e.zh: 加热可能在糖加工过程中引起差向异构化。

e.en: The catalyst promoted {epimerization} at a single chiral center.
e.zh: 催化剂促进了单个手性中心的差向异构化。

e.en: The fossil preserved an unusual {epimorph} of the original shell.
e.zh: 这块化石保留了原贝壳的一种异常外形型。

e.en: Minerals sometimes form an {epimorph} around another crystal.
e.zh: 矿物有时会围绕另一块晶体形成表生形态。

e.en: Limb repair in the salamander involves {epimorphosis}.
e.zh: 蝾螈的肢体修复涉及外形再生。

e.en: The lecture compared {epimorphosis} with simpler wound healing.
e.zh: 讲座把再生修复与较简单的伤口愈合作了比较。

e.en: The {epimysium} surrounds the entire skeletal muscle.
e.zh: 肌外膜包裹着整块骨骼肌。

e.en: A tough {epimysium} helps transmit force to the tendon.
e.zh: 坚韧的肌外膜有助于把力量传递到肌腱。

e.en: The statue was kept in the {epinaos} behind the main chamber.
e.zh: 雕像被安放在主殿后方的神庙后室里。

e.en: Archaeologists found inscriptions along the {epinaos} wall.
e.zh: 考古学家在殿后部墙上发现了铭文。

e.en: The plant showed {epinastic} leaf bending after exposure to ethylene.
e.zh: 植物接触乙烯后出现了叶片偏上性弯曲。

e.en: Flooded roots can trigger {epinastic} growth in tomato shoots.
e.zh: 根部受涝会诱发番茄枝条的偏上生长。

e.en: Ethylene often causes {epinasty} in sensitive plants.
e.zh: 乙烯常会使敏感植物发生偏上性生长。

e.en: The drooping leaves were a sign of {epinasty}, not drought.
e.zh: 下垂的叶片是偏上性的表现，而不是干旱造成的。

e.en: The nurse prepared {epinephrin} for the severe allergic reaction.
e.zh: 护士为严重过敏反应准备了肾上腺素。

e.en: Older labels may spell epinephrine as {epinephrin}.
e.zh: 旧标签可能把肾上腺素拼作epinephrin。

e.en: The {epineurium} protects bundles of nerve fibers.
e.zh: 神经外膜保护着成束的神经纤维。

e.en: Surgeons aligned the {epineurium} before repairing the cut nerve.
e.zh: 外科医生在修复断裂神经前对齐了神经外膜。

e.en: The chemist identified {epinine} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家在植物提取物中鉴定出马尾松碱。

e.en: Older pharmacology papers mention {epinine} only briefly.
e.zh: 较早的药理学论文只简略提到马尾松碱。

e.en: The report used {epinosic} terminology unfamiliar to most readers.
e.zh: 这份报告使用了多数读者不熟悉的肌肉纤维相关术语。

e.en: An {epinosic} description appeared in the old anatomy text.
e.zh: 那本旧解剖书里出现了一段与肌肉纤维有关的描述。

e.en: The beetle's {epinotum} was marked with tiny ridges.
e.zh: 这只甲虫的中胸背板上有细小的脊纹。

e.en: She measured the {epinotum} under a microscope.
e.zh: 她在显微镜下测量昆虫的中胸背板。

epiorganism.t: 附生在生物体上的生物

e.en: The shell carried an {epiorganism} that looked like algae.
e.zh: 贝壳上附着着一种看起来像藻类的附生生物。

e.en: Each {epiorganism} was recorded during the reef survey.
e.zh: 礁区调查中记录了每一种附生在生物体上的生物。

e.en: The museum displayed an {epiornithic} bone from Madagascar.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块来自马达加斯加的巨鸟类化石骨。

e.en: Her paper challenged the accepted {epiornithic} timeline.
e.zh: 她的论文质疑了公认的巨鸟类化石年代线。

e.en: The cave contained {epipalaeolithic} tools and animal bones.
e.zh: 洞穴中有旧石器时代末期的工具和动物骨骼。

e.en: Researchers dated the hearth to the {epipalaeolithic} period.
e.zh: 研究人员把这个炉址断定为旧石器时代末期。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared an {epipastic} powder for the rash.
e.zh: 药剂师为皮疹配制了一种撒敷用粉剂。

e.en: An {epipastic} treatment was common in older medical practice.
e.zh: 撒粉式治疗在旧时医学实践中很常见。

e.en: Tuna often hunt in the {epipelagic} zone.
e.zh: 金枪鱼常在海洋表层带捕食。

e.en: Sunlight supports much of the {epipelagic} food web.
e.zh: 阳光支撑着海洋表层带的大部分食物网。

e.en: The flower has {epipetalous} stamens near the corolla.
e.zh: 这朵花在花冠附近有着生于花瓣上的雄蕊。

e.en: Botanists noted the {epipetalous} structure in their sketch.
e.zh: 植物学家在草图中标出了这种花瓣上着生的结构。

e.en: The slug's {epiphallus} was examined for species identification.
e.zh: 研究人员检查蛞蝓的副阴茎以鉴定物种。

e.en: In some insects, the {epiphallus} helps guide mating.
e.zh: 在某些昆虫中，附属交配器有助于完成交配。

e.en: The novel ends with an {epiphanous} moment of forgiveness.
e.zh: 小说以一个顿悟般显现的宽恕时刻结尾。

e.en: Her {epiphanous} smile changed the mood in the room.
e.zh: 她那仿佛豁然显现的微笑改变了房间里的气氛。

e.en: The larva uses its {epipharynx} while feeding.
e.zh: 幼虫进食时会用到口器的上咽部。

e.en: Damage to the {epipharynx} made the specimen hard to classify.
e.zh: 上咽部受损使这个标本难以分类。

e.en: The symptoms may be {epiphenomena} rather than direct causes.
e.zh: 这些症状可能只是附带现象，而不是直接原因。

e.en: Philosophers debated whether thoughts were mere {epiphenomena}.
e.zh: 哲学家争论思想是否只是单纯的副现象。

e.en: He defended {epiphenomenalism} in his philosophy seminar.
e.zh: 他在哲学研讨课上为副现象论辩护。

e.en: {Epiphenomenalism} treats consciousness as causally powerless.
e.zh: 副现象论认为意识没有因果作用力。

e.en: The lichen was described as {epiphloedal} in the field notes.
e.zh: 野外记录把这种地衣描述为生于树皮表面的。

e.en: An {epiphloedal} fungus spread across the old trunk.
e.zh: 一种生于树皮表面的真菌蔓延在老树干上。

e.en: The botanist used {epiphloeodal} for growth on bark.
e.zh: 植物学家用生于树皮表面的这个词来描述树皮上的生长。

e.en: Several {epiphloeodal} lichens covered the shaded branch.
e.zh: 几种生于树皮表面的地衣覆盖了背阴的树枝。

e.en: The speech ended with a sharp {epiphonema}.
e.zh: 演讲以一句有力的感叹式结语收尾。

e.en: Rhetoric students analyzed the {epiphonema} in the sermon.
e.zh: 修辞课学生分析了布道中的感叹式结语。

e.en: A tiny {epiphyll} grew on the rainforest leaf.
e.zh: 一株细小的叶上附生植物长在雨林叶片上。

e.en: The survey counted each {epiphyll} separately.
e.zh: 调查把每一株叶上附生植物都单独计数。

e.en: The leaf showed an {epiphylline} colony of algae.
e.zh: 叶片上有一片生于叶上的藻类群落。

e.en: Some {epiphylline} mosses thrive in humid forests.
e.zh: 一些生于叶上的苔藓在潮湿森林中生长旺盛。

e.en: The fern supports several {epiphyllous} organisms.
e.zh: 这株蕨类植物支撑着几种生于叶上的生物。

e.en: Rain can wash {epiphyllous} growth from smooth leaves.
e.zh: 雨水会把光滑叶片上的叶生附着物冲掉。

e.en: The fracture ran through the child's {epiphysis}.
e.zh: 骨折线穿过了这个孩子的骨骺。

e.en: Older anatomy books sometimes call the pineal gland the {epiphysis}.
e.zh: 旧解剖书有时把松果体称为epiphysis。

e.en: The young athlete was diagnosed with {epiphysitis}.
e.zh: 这名年轻运动员被诊断出骨骺炎。

e.en: Rest is often recommended when {epiphysitis} causes pain.
e.zh: 骨骺炎引起疼痛时，通常建议休息。

e.en: The orchid's {epiphytal} roots clung to the branch.
e.zh: 兰花的附生根紧贴在树枝上。

e.en: Humidity shapes many {epiphytal} communities in cloud forests.
e.zh: 湿度塑造了云雾林中许多附生植物群落。

e.en: The orchid grows {epiphytically} on old trees.
e.zh: 这种兰花以附生方式长在老树上。

e.en: Some ferns survive {epiphytically} without rooting in soil.
e.zh: 有些蕨类不扎根土壤也能以附生方式存活。

e.en: {Epiphytism} lets plants reach brighter forest light.
e.zh: 附生生活让植物能接触到森林中更明亮的光。

e.en: The lecture compared parasitism with {epiphytism}.
e.zh: 讲座比较了寄生现象和附生现象。

e.en: Her thesis in {epiphytology} compared orchids growing on rainforest trees.
e.zh: 她的附生植物学论文比较了雨林树上生长的兰花。

e.en: Modern {epiphytology} often studies how canopy plants capture water.
e.zh: 现代附生植物学常研究树冠植物如何获取水分。

epiphytotic.t: 植物间流行病的；大规模发病的

e.en: The rust became {epiphytotic} after weeks of wet weather.
e.zh: 连续几周潮湿天气后，锈病在植物间大规模流行。

e.en: Farmers feared an {epiphytotic} outbreak in the wheat fields.
e.zh: 农民担心麦田里会暴发植物流行病。

e.en: The fossil preserved both {epiplastra} near the front of the shell.
e.zh: 这块化石保存了壳前部的两块上腹甲骨。

e.en: Researchers measured the turtle's {epiplastra} to compare related species.
e.zh: 研究人员测量这只龟的上腹甲骨，用来比较近缘物种。

epiplastron.t: 上腹甲骨；龟胸甲前部骨

e.en: The left {epiplastron} was cracked but still identifiable.
e.zh: 左侧上腹甲骨已经裂开，但仍能辨认。

e.en: In turtles, the {epiplastron} forms part of the front plastron.
e.zh: 在龟类中，上腹甲骨构成腹甲前部的一部分。

e.en: The surgeon inspected the {epiploa} for signs of inflammation.
e.zh: 外科医生检查大网膜是否有炎症迹象。

e.en: Older anatomy texts sometimes call the omenta {epiploa}.
e.zh: 较旧的解剖学书有时把网膜称为epiploa。

e.en: The {epiploon} can help contain infection within the abdomen.
e.zh: 大网膜能帮助把感染限制在腹腔内。

e.en: A fold of {epiploon} covered the injured intestine.
e.zh: 一层大网膜覆盖在受伤的肠管上。

e.en: The snail extended its {epipodia} while moving across the glass.
e.zh: 蜗牛爬过玻璃时伸出了足侧突。

e.en: These {epipodia} bear sensory tentacles in many mollusks.
e.zh: 许多软体动物的这些足侧突带有感觉触手。

epipodite.t: 肢上突；甲壳动物附肢外突

e.en: The crab's {epipodite} was drawn beside the gill in the diagram.
e.zh: 图中把螃蟹的肢上突画在鳃旁边。

e.en: In some crustaceans, an {epipodite} helps with respiration.
e.zh: 在某些甲壳动物中，肢上突有助于呼吸。

e.en: The limpet's {epipodium} carried small sensory projections.
e.zh: 帽贝的足侧部带有小的感觉突起。

e.en: A colorful {epipodium} bordered the sea slug's foot.
e.zh: 海蛞蝓的足缘有一圈鲜艳的足侧部。

epipteric.t: 翼点上方的；颅骨翼区的

e.en: The scan showed an {epipteric} bone near the temple.
e.zh: 扫描显示太阳穴附近有一块翼点上方小骨。

e.en: Anthropologists recorded the {epipteric} suture pattern of the skull.
e.zh: 人类学家记录了这块颅骨翼点区的缝合形态。

e.en: The fossil mammal had long {epipubes} projecting from the pelvis.
e.zh: 这具哺乳动物化石有从骨盆伸出的长上耻骨。

e.en: Marsupials use {epipubes} to support muscles around the abdomen.
e.zh: 有袋动物用上耻骨支撑腹部周围的肌肉。

e.en: The specimen showed a clear {epipubic} bone on each side.
e.zh: 标本两侧都显示出清楚的上耻骨。

e.en: An {epipubic} structure occurs in many early mammals.
e.zh: 许多早期哺乳动物都有上耻骨结构。

epirogeny.t: 造陆运动；地壳升降运动

e.en: Slow {epirogeny} lifted the ancient shoreline above sea level.
e.zh: 缓慢的造陆运动把古海岸线抬升到海平面以上。

e.en: Geologists linked the plateau's rise to broad {epirogeny}.
e.zh: 地质学家把高原隆起与大范围地壳升降运动联系起来。

e.en: The debate over {episcopalism} divided the reformers.
e.zh: 关于主教制的争论使改革者产生分歧。

e.en: He defended {episcopalism} as the church's historic structure.
e.zh: 他为主教制辩护，认为这是教会的历史组织形式。

e.en: During his {episcopature}, the diocese opened several schools.
e.zh: 在他的主教任期内，教区开办了几所学校。

e.en: The book traces the {episcopature} of a controversial bishop.
e.zh: 这本书追溯了一位有争议主教的任职时期。

episcope.t: 不透明物投影仪；反射投影器

e.en: The teacher used an {episcope} to project the page onto the wall.
e.zh: 老师用反射投影器把书页投到墙上。

e.en: An old {episcope} stood in the corner of the laboratory.
e.zh: 一台旧的不透明物投影仪放在实验室角落。

episcopize.t: 按主教制组织；使主教化

e.en: The reform tried to {episcopize} the scattered congregations.
e.zh: 这项改革试图按主教制组织分散的会众。

e.en: Critics said the plan would {episcopize} a traditionally independent church.
e.zh: 批评者说，该计划会使一个传统上独立的教会主教化。

episcotister.t: 频闪遮光盘；转盘遮光器

e.en: The physicist adjusted the {episcotister} to interrupt the beam.
e.zh: 物理学家调节频闪遮光盘来切断光束。

e.en: An {episcotister} creates regular flashes in optical experiments.
e.zh: 频闪遮光盘在光学实验中产生规律闪光。

e.en: The anthology included several {episedia} written for fallen soldiers.
e.zh: 这本文集中收有几首写给阵亡士兵的挽诗。

e.en: Ancient poets composed {episedia} for public funerals.
e.zh: 古代诗人为公共葬礼创作葬歌。

episematic.t: 具识别标记的；有信号色的

e.en: The bird's {episematic} stripe helps members of its species recognize it.
e.zh: 这只鸟的识别条纹帮助同类认出它。

e.en: Some insects use {episematic} colors during courtship displays.
e.zh: 一些昆虫在求偶展示中使用信号色。

episepalous.t: 着生于萼片上的；萼上生的

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's {episepalous} stamens.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花有着生于萼片上的雄蕊。

e.en: An {episepalous} part is attached directly to a sepal.
e.zh: 萼上生的部分直接附着在萼片上。

e.en: The surgeon documented the {episioelytorrhaphy} in the operative report.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术报告中记录了会阴阴道缝合术。

e.en: Modern texts rarely mention {episioelytorrhaphy} outside gynecologic history.
e.zh: 现代教材很少在妇科史之外提到会阴阴道缝合术。

e.en: Her headaches were {episodical} rather than constant.
e.zh: 她的头痛是偶发的，并不是持续不断。

e.en: The novel has an {episodical} structure with loosely connected chapters.
e.zh: 这部小说采用分集式结构，各章联系较松散。

episomal.t: 附加体的；游离遗传因子的

e.en: The virus persisted as {episomal} DNA in the cell nucleus.
e.zh: 这种病毒以附加体DNA的形式存在于细胞核中。

e.en: Researchers selected cells carrying an {episomal} vector.
e.zh: 研究人员筛选出携带游离载体的细胞。

episomally.t: 游离质粒样地；附加体方式地

e.en: The plasmid was maintained {episomally} in the host cells.
e.zh: 该质粒以附加体方式保留在宿主细胞中。

e.en: Some viral DNA can replicate {episomally} without entering chromosomes.
e.zh: 有些病毒DNA可以不整合进染色体而以游离形式复制。

e.en: The antibiotic resistance gene was carried on an {episome}.
e.zh: 这个抗生素耐药基因由一个附加体携带。

e.en: A viral {episome} may persist in the nucleus for years.
e.zh: 病毒附加体可能在细胞核内持续存在多年。

e.en: Several {episomes} were detected in the bacterial culture.
e.zh: 研究人员在细菌培养物中检测到几个附加体。

e.en: Latent viruses can survive as {episomes} inside infected cells.
e.zh: 潜伏病毒能以附加体形式在受感染细胞内存活。

e.en: The old physician applied an {epispastic} plaster to the skin.
e.zh: 那位老医生把发疱膏贴在皮肤上。

e.en: An {epispastic} was once used to draw irritation to the surface.
e.zh: 起疱药过去曾用来把刺激反应引到皮肤表面。

e.en: The hard {episperm} protected the seed during storage.
e.zh: 坚硬的种皮在储存期间保护了种子。

e.en: Botanists examined the {episperm} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察种子的外被。

e.en: The {episporangium} forms the outer covering of the sporangium.
e.zh: 孢子囊外层构成孢子囊的外部覆盖。

e.en: Damage to the {episporangium} exposed the developing spores.
e.zh: 孢子囊外层受损后，正在发育的孢子暴露出来。

e.en: The {episporium} showed fine ridges under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可以看到孢子外壁上有细小脊纹。

e.en: A thick {episporium} helps spores survive dry conditions.
e.zh: 较厚的外孢壁有助于孢子在干燥环境中存活。

e.en: The study found strong {epistasis} between two growth genes.
e.zh: 这项研究发现两个生长基因之间存在强烈上位性。

e.en: In {epistasis}, one gene can mask the effect of another.
e.zh: 在上位性中，一个基因可能掩盖另一个基因的作用。

e.en: The breeder noticed {epistasy} in the color pattern of the flowers.
e.zh: 育种者注意到花色图案中存在上位性。

e.en: Genetic {epistasy} can make inheritance harder to predict.
e.zh: 遗传上位性会使遗传结果更难预测。

e.en: The insect's {episterna} were carefully drawn in the anatomy plate.
e.zh: 昆虫的侧胸片被仔细绘入解剖图版中。

e.en: Tiny setae covered the {episterna} near the legs.
e.zh: 腿部附近的胸侧板上覆盖着细小刚毛。

e.en: The beetle had a distinctive {episternal} suture.
e.zh: 这只甲虫有一条很有特征的侧胸片缝。

e.en: Researchers compared the {episternal} plates of related insects.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了近缘昆虫的胸侧板。

e.en: The {episternites} differ slightly between the two species.
e.zh: 这两个物种的侧胸片略有不同。

e.en: She labeled the {episternites} before describing the thorax.
e.zh: 她先标出胸侧板小片，然后描述胸部结构。

e.en: The {episternum} lies on the side of the insect thorax.
e.zh: 侧胸片位于昆虫胸部的侧面。

e.en: A crack ran across the left {episternum} of the specimen.
e.zh: 标本左侧胸板上有一道裂纹。

e.en: The lab isolated an unusual {episteroid} from the sample.
e.zh: 实验室从样本中分离出一种不寻常的类固醇样物质。

e.en: An {episteroid} compound affected the cells differently from cholesterol.
e.zh: 这种类固醇样化合物对细胞的影响不同于胆固醇。

e.en: The famous {epistoler} wrote with wit and restraint.
e.zh: 那位著名书信作者写作机智而克制。

e.en: As an {epistoler}, she revealed more in letters than in essays.
e.zh: 作为写信人，她在书信中透露的内容比散文更多。

e.en: The novel uses an {epistolic} structure throughout.
e.zh: 这部小说全篇采用书信体结构。

e.en: His {epistolic} style feels formal but intimate.
e.zh: 他的书信风格显得正式却又亲近。

e.en: The critic praised the book's {epistolical} elegance.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这本书的书信体优雅。

e.en: Her {epistolical} exchanges with friends were later published.
e.zh: 她与朋友的书信往来后来被出版。

e.en: He liked to {epistolize} about politics late at night.
e.zh: 他喜欢在深夜写信谈论政治。

e.en: The author chose to {epistolize} the entire romance.
e.zh: 作者选择用书信体写完整个爱情故事。

e.en: A tireless {epistolizer}, he answered every note by hand.
e.zh: 他是个不知疲倦的写信者，每封便条都亲笔回复。

e.en: The {epistolizer} turns private letters into public art.
e.zh: 这位书信体作者把私人信件化为公共艺术。

e.en: Her research focuses on Renaissance {epistolography}.
e.zh: 她的研究重点是文艺复兴时期的书信文学。

e.en: Manuals of {epistolography} taught readers how to compose letters.
e.zh: 书信写作手册教读者如何撰写信件。

e.en: The {epistoma} was visible above the mouthparts of the insect.
e.zh: 在昆虫口器上方可以看到口上板。

e.en: A damaged {epistoma} made the specimen hard to identify.
e.zh: 口前片受损使这个标本难以鉴定。

e.en: The beetle's {epistome} bears two small projections.
e.zh: 这只甲虫的口上板带有两个小突起。

e.en: Taxonomists use the shape of the {epistome} for comparison.
e.zh: 分类学家用口前片的形状进行比较。

e.en: The speech ends each clause with the same phrase, a classic {epistrophe}.
e.zh: 这篇演讲每个分句都以同一短语收尾，是典型的句尾反复。

e.en: Poets use {epistrophe} to give lines a ringing close.
e.zh: 诗人用尾语重复让诗行收束得更有回响。

e.en: The {epistropheus} allows the head to rotate from side to side.
e.zh: 枢椎使头部能够左右转动。

e.en: A fracture of the {epistropheus} can be medically serious.
e.zh: 第二颈椎骨折在医学上可能很严重。

e.en: The preacher's {epistrophy} made the sermon memorable.
e.zh: 牧师的句尾反复让布道更令人难忘。

e.en: In rhetoric, {epistrophy} repeats words at the ends of clauses.
e.zh: 在修辞学中，尾语重复是在分句结尾重复词语。

e.en: The carved {epistyle} rested above the temple columns.
e.zh: 雕刻的柱上横梁架在神庙柱子上方。

e.en: Architects restored the cracked {epistyle} with matching stone.
e.zh: 建筑师用相配的石材修复了开裂的柱顶楣梁。

e.en: The poet chose an {epitaphial} tone for the final stanza.
e.zh: 诗人在最后一节采用了碑文式的语调。

e.en: An {epitaphial} inscription marked the old family tomb.
e.zh: 一段墓志铭式的碑文标记着那座古老家族墓。

e.en: Her {epitaphic} lines were brief but moving.
e.zh: 她写的墓志铭文字简短却动人。

e.en: The novel ends with an {epitaphic} meditation on loss.
e.zh: 小说以一段悼念式的失落沉思收尾。

e.en: The village {epitaphist} wrote verses for many graves.
e.zh: 村里的墓志铭作者为许多坟墓写过诗句。

e.en: A skilled {epitaphist} can honor a life in few words.
e.zh: 熟练的墓志铭作者能用寥寥数语纪念一生。

epitasis.t: 戏剧情节展开；病势加重

e.en: In classical drama, the {epitasis} complicates the hero's choice.
e.zh: 在古典戏剧中，情节展开部分会使英雄的选择更复杂。

e.en: The physician noted a sudden {epitasis} of the fever.
e.zh: 医生记录到发热病情突然加重。

e.en: The chip uses an {epitaxial} layer grown on silicon.
e.zh: 这枚芯片使用了在硅上生长的外延层。
