e.en: The argument could {escalade} into a serious dispute.
e.zh: 这场争论可能会升级成严重纠纷。

e.en: Police feared the protest would {escalade} overnight.
e.zh: 警方担心抗议会在夜间加剧。

e.en: The local dispute {escaladed} into national headlines.
e.zh: 这起地方纠纷升级成了全国新闻。

e.en: Costs {escaladed} after the project was delayed.
e.zh: 项目延期后，成本迅速上升。

e.en: He became known as an {escalader} of minor conflicts.
e.zh: 他因总把小冲突升级而出名。

e.en: A skilled mediator can calm an {escalader} before talks collapse.
e.zh: 熟练的调解人能在谈判破裂前安抚挑事升级的人。

e.en: The crisis {escalades} when supplies run out.
e.zh: 物资耗尽时，危机会进一步升级。

e.en: Her tone {escalades} from polite to openly angry.
e.zh: 她的语气从客气变成明显愤怒。

e.en: The {escalading} dispute worried both governments.
e.zh: 不断升级的争端让两国政府都很担忧。

e.en: Managers met daily to control {escalading} costs.
e.zh: 经理们每天开会，以控制不断攀升的成本。

e.en: The minister rejected any {escalatory} military response.
e.zh: 部长拒绝采取任何会导致升级的军事回应。

e.en: His {escalatory} language made compromise harder.
e.zh: 他那种火上浇油的措辞让妥协更难。

e.en: The gardener planted {escallonia} along the windy path.
e.zh: 园丁在多风的小路旁种下了南美常绿灌木。

e.en: Pink {escallonia} flowers attracted bees in summer.
e.zh: 粉色的南美常绿灌木花在夏天吸引了蜜蜂。

e.en: The chef served one large {escallop} with butter.
e.zh: 厨师端上一只配黄油的大扇贝。

e.en: The old plate had an {escallop} pattern around the rim.
e.zh: 那只旧盘子的边缘有扇形花纹。

escalloped.t: 扇形边的；切成薄片烤的

e.en: The dress had an {escalloped} collar.
e.zh: 那条裙子有扇形花边的衣领。

e.en: She brought {escalloped} potatoes to the picnic.
e.zh: 她带了奶油焗薄片土豆去野餐。

e.en: They spent the morning {escalloping} near the bay.
e.zh: 他们整个上午都在海湾附近捕扇贝。

e.en: The tailor was {escalloping} the edge of the lace.
e.zh: 裁缝正在把蕾丝边做成扇形。

e.en: Fresh {escallops} arrived at the market before dawn.
e.zh: 新鲜扇贝在黎明前运到了市场。

e.en: Tiny {escallops} decorated the silver tray.
e.zh: 银托盘上装饰着细小的扇形花边。

e.en: She ordered a veal {escalope} with lemon.
e.zh: 她点了一份配柠檬的小牛肉薄片。

e.en: The chicken {escalope} was crisp outside and tender inside.
e.zh: 那块鸡肉排外酥里嫩。

escaloped.t: 切薄片烹调的；扇形边的

e.en: The cook served {escaloped} potatoes with ham.
e.zh: 厨师端上了配火腿的焗薄片土豆。

e.en: The curtain had an {escaloped} lower edge.
e.zh: 窗帘下缘是扇形边。

e.en: The menu offered pork {escalopes} in mushroom sauce.
e.zh: 菜单上有蘑菇酱猪肉薄片。

e.en: She flattened the {escalopes} before frying them.
e.zh: 她先把薄肉片拍平再下锅煎。

e.en: The trap looked dangerous but was {escapable}.
e.zh: 这个陷阱看起来危险，但仍能逃脱。

e.en: Some delays are annoying yet {escapable} with better planning.
e.zh: 有些延误很烦人，但通过更好规划可以避免。

e.en: The shelter uses an {escape-proof} gate for nervous dogs.
e.zh: 收容所给紧张的狗使用防逃脱的门。

e.en: No prison is truly {escape-proof}.
e.zh: 没有哪座监狱是真正无法逃出的。

e.en: The new cage was advertised as {escapeproof}.
e.zh: 这个新笼子被宣传为防逃脱设计。

e.en: They built an {escapeproof} room for the magic show.
e.zh: 他们为魔术表演建了一个无法逃出的房间。

e.en: Miners followed the {escapeway} after the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起后，矿工们沿着逃生通道撤离。

e.en: The inspector found the {escapeway} blocked by debris.
e.zh: 检查员发现逃生通道被碎片堵住了。

e.en: Houdini made {escapology} famous around the world.
e.zh: 胡迪尼让脱逃术闻名世界。

e.en: Modern {escapology} mixes theater with careful engineering.
e.zh: 现代逃脱表演把戏剧效果和精密设计结合起来。

e.en: The soldiers climbed the muddy {escarp} at dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明时爬上泥泞的陡坡。

e.en: A stone {escarp} protected the old fortress.
e.zh: 一道石砌陡壁保护着那座旧堡垒。

e.en: The village stood above an {escarped} hillside.
e.zh: 村庄坐落在一片陡峭山坡上方。

e.en: The {escarped} bank made the fort harder to attack.
e.zh: 筑成陡壁的堤岸让堡垒更难被攻破。

e.en: Engineers were {escarping} the slope to protect the road.
e.zh: 工程师正在把斜坡修成陡壁以保护道路。

e.en: Erosion was slowly {escarping} the riverbank.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在慢慢把河岸冲成陡坡。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed {esoenteritis} after several tests.
e.zh: 经过几项检查后，医生诊断为肠道内层炎症。

e.en: Severe {esoenteritis} can cause dehydration quickly.
e.zh: 严重的肠道内层炎症会很快导致脱水。

e.en: The scan showed an {esophagal} narrowing.
e.zh: 扫描显示有食管狭窄。

e.en: He reported {esophagal} pain after swallowing.
e.zh: 他报告说吞咽后出现食管疼痛。

e.en: The biopsy revealed {esophagean} tissue changes.
e.zh: 活检显示食管组织发生了变化。

e.en: Researchers studied {esophagean} cancer cells in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室研究食管癌细胞。

e.en: She needed an {esophagectomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 她需要做食管切除术来切除肿瘤。

e.en: Recovery after {esophagectomy} can take several months.
e.zh: 食管切除术后的恢复可能需要几个月。

e.en: The specimens included two human {esophagi}.
e.zh: 这些标本包括两个人类食管。

e.en: Bird {esophagi} vary greatly between species.
e.zh: 不同鸟类的食管差异很大。

e.en: The surgeon inserted an {esophagofiberscope} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地插入食管纤维内镜。

e.en: An {esophagofiberscope} helps inspect the upper digestive tract.
e.zh: 食管纤维内镜有助于检查上消化道。

e.en: The physician used an {esophagoscope} during the procedure.
e.zh: 医生在操作过程中使用了食管镜。

e.en: A rigid {esophagoscope} requires careful handling.
e.zh: 硬式食管镜需要谨慎操作。

e.en: The patient underwent {esophagoscopy} on Monday.
e.zh: 患者周一接受了食管镜检查。

e.en: Diagnostic {esophagoscopy} found no obvious blockage.
e.zh: 诊断性食管镜检查没有发现明显阻塞。

e.en: He explained the theory rather {esoterically}.
e.zh: 他把这个理论讲得相当深奥。

e.en: The symbol is used {esoterically} in that tradition.
e.zh: 在那个传统中，这个符号以秘传方式使用。

e.en: Her book explores Western {esotericism}.
e.zh: 她的书探讨西方秘传学。

e.en: Some readers confuse philosophy with {esotericism}.
e.zh: 有些读者会把哲学和深奥玄学混为一谈。

e.en: The child was treated for {esotropia}.
e.zh: 这个孩子接受了内斜视治疗。

e.en: Untreated {esotropia} may affect depth perception.
e.zh: 未经治疗的内斜视可能影响深度感知。

e.en: The officer carried an {espantoon} at his side.
e.zh: 那名警官腰侧带着一根警棍。

e.en: An old {espantoon} hung in the museum case.
e.zh: 一根旧短杖挂在博物馆展柜里。

e.en: The mill made paper from {esparto}.
e.zh: 这家工厂用西班牙草造纸。

e.en: Baskets woven from {esparto} are very durable.
e.zh: 用西班牙草编成的篮子很耐用。

e.en: They waited in quiet {esperance}.
e.zh: 他们怀着安静的希望等待着。

e.en: The poem speaks of {esperance} after grief.
e.zh: 这首诗写的是悲伤过后的希望。

e.en: The sick dog {espews} its food onto the floor.
e.zh: 那只病狗把食物吐到了地板上。

e.en: The vent {espews} steam after the pressure rises.
e.zh: 压力升高后，通风口喷出蒸汽。

e.en: Her {espial} of the hidden door changed everything.
e.zh: 她发现那扇暗门后，一切都变了。

e.en: The scout reported his {espial} of enemy movement.
e.zh: 侦察员报告说他发现了敌军动向。

e.en: The {espier} noticed footprints by the window.
e.zh: 那个发现者注意到窗边有脚印。

e.en: A careful {espier} can read small signs of danger.
e.zh: 细心的观察者能看出危险的细小迹象。

e.en: The violinist played the melody {espressivo}.
e.zh: 小提琴手富有表情地演奏了这段旋律。

e.en: The score marks this passage {espressivo} and slow.
e.zh: 乐谱标明这一段要富有表情且缓慢地演奏。

e.en: The museum displayed an {espringal} beside other siege engines.
e.zh: 博物馆把一架古代投石机和其他攻城器械一起展出。

e.en: An {espringal} could hurl heavy bolts at castle walls.
e.zh: 古代投石机能把沉重的弩箭射向城墙。

e.en: The doctor suspected {espundia} after the ulcer spread.
e.zh: 溃疡扩散后，医生怀疑是鼻咽黏膜利什曼病。

e.en: Untreated {espundia} can damage tissue in the nose and throat.
e.zh: 未经治疗的鼻咽黏膜利什曼病会损伤鼻咽组织。

e.en: The botanist described the stem as {esquamate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这根茎描述为无鳞状结构。

e.en: An {esquamate} surface lacks the tiny scales seen nearby.
e.zh: 无鳞表面没有旁边可见的细小鳞片。

e.en: The surgeon performed an {esquillectomy} to remove the hardened mass.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了粪石切除术，以取出那块硬化物。

e.en: An {esquillectomy} may be needed when medication fails.
e.zh: 药物无效时，可能需要进行粪石切除术。

e.en: Older books sometimes use {Esquimaux} for Arctic peoples.
e.zh: 旧书有时用Esquimaux来指称北极地区民族。

e.en: The term {Esquimaux} is now considered outdated.
e.zh: Esquimaux这个称呼现在被认为已经过时。

e.en: The architect showed us a quick {esquisse}.
e.zh: 建筑师给我们看了一张快速草图。

e.en: Her {esquisse} captured the dancer's movement beautifully.
e.zh: 她的初步素描很好地捕捉了舞者的动作。

e.en: He published an {essayette} about village life.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于乡村生活的短小随笔。

e.en: The editor wanted a light {essayette}, not a full article.
e.zh: 编辑想要一篇轻松短文，而不是完整文章。

e.en: The philosopher asked about the {esse} of the soul.
e.zh: 哲学家追问灵魂的存在本质。

e.en: In law, possession can affect the {esse} of a right.
e.zh: 在法律中，占有可能影响一项权利的存在。

e.en: The lecture traced {Essenism} in ancient Jewish history.
e.zh: 讲座追溯了古代犹太史中的艾赛尼派教义。

e.en: Some scholars compare {Essenism} with early Christian practices.
e.zh: 一些学者把艾赛尼派教义与早期基督教实践作比较。

e.en: Do not {essentialize} a culture from one custom.
e.zh: 不要凭一种习俗就把一个文化本质化。

e.en: The theory tends to {essentialize} gender differences.
e.zh: 这种理论往往把性别差异归为固定本质。

e.en: The article {essentializes} poverty as a personal failure.
e.zh: 这篇文章把贫困本质化为个人失败。

e.en: Such language {essentializes} groups and ignores individual lives.
e.zh: 这种语言把群体本质化，忽视了个人生活。

e.en: She criticized the essay for {essentializing} identity.
e.zh: 她批评那篇文章把身份本质化。

e.en: Avoid {essentializing} people based on nationality alone.
e.zh: 不要仅凭国籍就把人本质化。

e.en: The therapist studied {essentic} forms of communication.
e.zh: 治疗师研究了与情感表达有关的沟通形式。

e.en: His {essentic} exercises linked posture with feeling.
e.zh: 他的情感表达练习把姿势和感受联系起来。

e.en: The quarry exposed dark {essexite} near the road.
e.zh: 采石场在路边露出了深色的霞石正长岩。

e.en: Geologists identified the sample as {essexite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个样本鉴定为霞石正长岩。

e.en: The defendant offered an {essoin} for missing court.
e.zh: 被告提出了缺席出庭的合法理由。

e.en: Medieval records often mention an {essoin}.
e.zh: 中世纪记录中常会提到缺席应诉的理由。

e.en: The ring held a polished {essonite} stone.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着一颗打磨过的肉桂石。

e.en: Collectors value clear {essonite} for its warm color.
e.zh: 收藏者因清澈肉桂石的暖色而看重它。

e.en: The columnist sounded like an {estabilishmentarian} in that debate.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家在辩论中听起来像个支持既有体制的人。

e.en: Radicals mocked every {estabilishmentarian} in the council.
e.zh: 激进派嘲笑委员会里每个维护现行体制的人。

e.en: The link is {establishable} through public records.
e.zh: 这种关联可以通过公开记录加以证实。

e.en: A small clinic was {establishable} with local funding.
e.zh: 有了地方资金，一个小诊所是可以建立起来的。

e.en: He took an {establishmentarian} view of politics.
e.zh: 他对政治持维护建制的看法。

e.en: The bishop remained an {establishmentarian} on church policy.
e.zh: 那位主教在教会政策上仍支持国教体制。

establishmentarianism.t: 支持建制或国教的主张

e.en: Her essay criticized {establishmentarianism} in modern politics.
e.zh: 她的文章批评了现代政治中的建制主义。

e.en: Victorian debates often turned on {establishmentarianism}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的争论常围绕支持国教体制展开。

establishmentarians.t: 支持建制或国教的人们

e.en: The {establishmentarians} resisted the proposed reforms.
e.zh: 那些维护建制的人反对拟议的改革。

e.en: Several {establishmentarians} defended the state church.
e.zh: 几名支持国教体制的人为国立教会辩护。

e.en: Soldiers built an {estacade} across the narrow road.
e.zh: 士兵们在狭窄道路上筑起一道栅栏防御工事。

e.en: The old {estacade} slowed the river current.
e.zh: 那道旧木桩坝减缓了河水流速。

e.en: An {estafette} carried the message to headquarters.
e.zh: 一名骑马信使把消息送到了总部。

e.en: The army used an {estafette} system for urgent orders.
e.zh: 军队用接力传令制度传送紧急命令。

e.en: They found shelter in a smoky {estaminet}.
e.zh: 他们在一家烟雾缭绕的小酒馆里避雨。

e.en: The village {estaminet} served beer and soup.
e.zh: 村里的小酒馆供应啤酒和汤。

e.en: The {estanciero} owned thousands of cattle.
e.zh: 那位南美大牧场主拥有数千头牛。

e.en: Local workers negotiated wages with the {estanciero}.
e.zh: 当地工人与大牧场主商谈工资。

e.en: The {estate-agent} showed us three flats.
e.zh: 房地产经纪人带我们看了三套公寓。

e.en: She called an {estate-agent} before selling the house.
e.zh: 卖房前，她给一位房地产经纪人打了电话。

e.en: We ordered an {estate-bottled} red wine.
e.zh: 我们点了一瓶酒庄自产装瓶的红葡萄酒。

e.en: The label says it is {estate-bottled} in Burgundy.
e.zh: 标签上写着它是在勃艮第酒庄装瓶的。

estavel.t: 岩溶区可进可出的泉洞

e.en: After heavy rain, the {estavel} discharged muddy water.
e.zh: 大雨过后，那个岩溶泉洞排出了浑水。

e.en: In drought, the same {estavel} swallowed the stream.
e.zh: 干旱时，同一个岩溶洞又把溪水吞了进去。

e.en: The plant adopted an {ester-process} for the resin.
e.zh: 工厂对这种树脂采用了酯化处理工艺。

e.en: Engineers improved the {ester-process} to reduce waste.
e.zh: 工程师改进了酯化工艺以减少废料。

e.en: This {esterase} breaks down the compound quickly.
e.zh: 这种酯酶能迅速分解该化合物。

e.en: Researchers measured {esterase} activity in the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞中的酯酶活性。

e.en: The varnish contains {estergum} for better gloss.
e.zh: 这种清漆含有酯胶，以提高光泽。

e.en: Manufacturers add {estergum} to some adhesives.
e.zh: 制造商会在某些胶黏剂中加入松香酯树脂。

e.en: The lab used heat to speed up {esterification}.
e.zh: 实验室用加热来加快酯化反应。

e.en: {Esterification} gives the mixture a fruity smell.
e.zh: 酯化反应会让混合物带有果香。

e.en: The acid {esterifies} slowly at room temperature.
e.zh: 这种酸在室温下会缓慢发生酯化。

e.en: This reagent {esterifies} the alcohol efficiently.
e.zh: 这种试剂能高效地使醇酯化。

e.en: Chemists can {esterify} the compound overnight.
e.zh: 化学家可以在一夜之间使该化合物酯化。

e.en: They tried to {esterify} the fatty acid sample.
e.zh: 他们试图把脂肪酸样品转化为酯。

e.en: The {esterifying} agent was added drop by drop.
e.zh: 酯化剂被一滴一滴地加入。

e.en: She monitored the {esterifying} reaction for two hours.
e.zh: 她监测这场酯化反应持续了两个小时。

e.en: Water can promote {esterolysis} under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 在酸性条件下，水能促进酯解。

e.en: The enzyme caused rapid {esterolysis} in the sample.
e.zh: 这种酶使样品中的酯键迅速裂解。

e.en: His thesis examined touch through {esthematology}.
e.zh: 他的论文从感觉学角度研究触觉。

e.en: {Esthematology} overlaps with psychology and physiology.
e.zh: 感觉学与心理学和生理学都有交叉。

e.en: The patient gradually regained {esthesia} in her hand.
e.zh: 病人手部逐渐恢复了感觉。

e.en: The drug may reduce {esthesia} around the wound.
e.zh: 这种药可能会降低伤口周围的知觉。

e.en: The doctor tested an {esthesiogen} on the skin.
e.zh: 医生在皮肤上测试了一种感觉诱发物。

e.en: A mild {esthesiogen} produced tingling in volunteers.
e.zh: 一种温和的致感觉物让志愿者产生刺痛感。

e.en: The therapist used an {esthesiometer} after surgery.
e.zh: 治疗师在术后使用感觉计进行检查。

e.en: An {esthesiometer} measures sensitivity to light touch.
e.zh: 感觉计用于测量对轻触的敏感度。

e.en: The study included {esthesiometry} of the fingertips.
e.zh: 这项研究包括对指尖的感觉测量。

e.en: {Esthesiometry} helped track nerve recovery.
e.zh: 感觉测定有助于追踪神经恢复情况。

e.en: She specialized in {esthesiophysiology} during medical school.
e.zh: 她在医学院期间专攻感觉生理学。

e.en: {Esthesiophysiology} explains how nerves carry sensations.
e.zh: 感觉生理学解释神经如何传递感觉。

e.en: The poem depends on {esthesis} more than argument.
e.zh: 这首诗更依赖感知而不是论证。

e.en: Damage to the nerve altered his {esthesis}.
e.zh: 神经受损改变了他的感觉。

e.en: As an {esthete}, he noticed every detail of the room.
e.zh: 作为审美家，他注意到房间里的每个细节。

e.en: The novel gently mocks the young {esthete}.
e.zh: 这部小说温和地嘲讽了那位年轻的唯美主义者。

e.en: The architect defended the {esthetical} value of plain walls.
e.zh: 建筑师为素墙的审美价值辩护。

e.en: Her choice was practical, not merely {esthetical}.
e.zh: 她的选择很实用，并不只是美学上的考虑。

e.en: The {esthetician} recommended a gentler cleanser.
e.zh: 美容师建议使用更温和的洁面产品。

e.en: As an {esthetician}, she wrote about beauty and taste.
e.zh: 作为美学家，她写作讨论美与品味。

e.en: The movement embraced {estheticism} in art and life.
e.zh: 这场运动在艺术和生活中拥抱唯美主义。

e.en: Critics accused the novel of empty {estheticism}.
e.zh: 评论家指责这部小说只是空洞的审美至上。

e.en: The old report described {esthiomene} of the vulva.
e.zh: 那份旧报告描述了外阴侵蚀性溃疡。

e.en: Doctors rarely use the term {esthiomene} today.
e.zh: 如今医生很少使用“侵蚀性溃疡”这个术语。

e.en: The surgeon noted an {esthiomenous} lesion.
e.zh: 外科医生记录到一处侵蚀性溃疡病灶。

e.en: Older texts mention {esthiomenous} changes after infection.
e.zh: 旧文献提到感染后的侵蚀性溃疡变化。

e.en: She behaved {estimably} under great pressure.
e.zh: 她在巨大压力下表现得很值得称赞。

e.en: The team performed {estimably} despite limited funding.
e.zh: 尽管资金有限，团队仍表现得可敬。

e.en: The report offered an {estimative} cost for repairs.
e.zh: 报告给出了维修费用的估计值。

e.en: His {estimative} judgment proved surprisingly accurate.
e.zh: 他的评价性判断出人意料地准确。

e.en: The contract will {estipulate} payment dates clearly.
e.zh: 合同会明确规定付款日期。

e.en: Old legal forms may {estipulate} duties in formal language.
e.zh: 旧式法律文书可能用正式措辞订明义务。

e.en: The village held an {estival} festival by the river.
e.zh: 村庄在河边举行了夏季节庆。

e.en: Some plants survive the {estival} heat by lying dormant.
e.zh: 有些植物靠休眠熬过夏天的酷热。

e.en: Desert snails {estivate} during the hottest months.
e.zh: 沙漠蜗牛会在最热的几个月夏眠。

e.en: The biologist explained why the frogs {estivate} in mud.
e.zh: 生物学家解释了这些青蛙为何在泥中度夏休眠。

estivated.t: 已夏眠的；已度夏休眠的

e.en: The snail had {estivated} beneath a dry stone.
e.zh: 那只蜗牛曾在干石头下夏眠。

e.en: After it {estivated}, the animal became active again with rain.
e.zh: 夏眠过后，那只动物随着降雨又活跃起来。

e.en: This species {estivates} when ponds dry out.
e.zh: 池塘干涸时，这个物种会进入夏眠。

e.en: A lungfish {estivates} in a cocoon of mud.
e.zh: 肺鱼会在泥茧中度夏休眠。

e.en: The {estivating} frog barely moved in the heat.
e.zh: 那只正在夏眠的青蛙在炎热中几乎不动。

e.en: Researchers found several {estivating} snails under the bark.
e.zh: 研究人员在树皮下发现了几只度夏休眠的蜗牛。

e.en: {Estivation} helps some animals survive drought.
e.zh: 夏眠能帮助一些动物熬过干旱。

e.en: The lecture compared hibernation with {estivation}.
e.zh: 讲座把冬眠和夏季休眠作了比较。

e.en: The matador delivered the {estocada} with precision.
e.zh: 斗牛士精准地刺出了最后一剑。

e.en: A poor {estocada} can prolong the bullfight painfully.
e.zh: 糟糕的最后刺剑会痛苦地拖长斗牛过程。

e.en: The court found an {estoppage} based on prior promises.
e.zh: 法院认定先前承诺构成禁止反言。

e.en: Law students discussed {estoppage} in old property cases.
e.zh: 法学院学生讨论了旧产权案件中的法律阻却。

e.en: The tenant claimed {estovers} for repairing his cottage.
e.zh: 佃户主张有权取木材来修缮小屋。

e.en: Medieval leases often mentioned {estovers} from the lord's woods.
e.zh: 中世纪租约常提到可从领主林地取用木材的权利。

e.en: The judge sat on a raised {estrade}.
e.zh: 法官坐在抬高的审判台上。

e.en: Musicians gathered on the {estrade} before the ceremony.
e.zh: 典礼开始前，乐手们聚集在高台上。

e.en: The lab measured {estradienone} in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室测定了样品中的雌二烯酮类化合物。

e.en: Researchers studied how {estradienone} affects hormone signaling.
e.zh: 研究人员研究雌二烯酮如何影响激素信号传导。

e.en: The sauce was flavored with {estragon}.
e.zh: 这款酱汁用了龙蒿调味。

e.en: French cooks often pair {estragon} with chicken.
e.zh: 法国厨师常把塔拉贡香草和鸡肉搭配。

e.en: The paper identified {estraheptaenol} as a steroid derivative.
e.zh: 论文把雌甾七烯醇鉴定为一种甾体衍生物。

e.en: Only trace amounts of {estraheptaenol} appeared in the analysis.
e.zh: 分析中只出现了微量雌甾七烯醇类化合物。

e.en: The veterinarian noted clear {estral} behavior in the cow.
e.zh: 兽医注意到这头母牛明显处于发情期行为。

e.en: Hormone levels change through the {estral} cycle.
e.zh: 激素水平会随动情周期变化。

e.en: {Estrane} forms the core structure of many estrogens.
e.zh: 雌甾烷构成许多雌激素的核心结构。

e.en: The chemist compared several {estrane} derivatives.
e.zh: 化学家比较了几种雌甾烷衍生物。

e.en: The spectrum matched an {estratriene} compound.
e.zh: 光谱与一种雌甾三烯类化合物相符。

e.en: They synthesized {estratriene} derivatives for testing.
e.zh: 他们合成了雌甾三烯衍生物用于测试。

e.en: The farmer reported an {estray} found near his barn.
e.zh: 农夫报告在谷仓附近发现了一头走失牲畜。

e.en: Local law described how an {estray} should be claimed.
e.zh: 地方法律规定了无主走失牲畜应如何认领。

estreat.t: 摘录法庭记录；追缴罚金

e.en: The clerk will {estreat} the unpaid fine.
e.zh: 书记员将追缴那笔未付罚金。

e.en: Officials used to {estreat} entries from court rolls.
e.zh: 官员过去会从法庭卷宗中摘录条目。

e.en: The recognizance was {estreated} after he failed to appear.
e.zh: 他未出庭后，保证金被依法追缴。

e.en: The clerk {estreated} the relevant items from the roll.
e.zh: 书记员从卷宗中摘录了相关条目。

e.en: The court began {estreating} the forfeited bonds.
e.zh: 法院开始追缴被没收的保证金。

e.en: She spent the morning {estreating} entries from old records.
e.zh: 她上午一直在从旧记录中摘录条目。

e.en: The article discussed {estrenochrysene} as a synthetic compound.
e.zh: 文章把雌甾并䓛作为一种合成化合物来讨论。

e.en: Toxicologists tested {estrenochrysene} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 毒理学家在受控条件下测试了雌甾并䓛类化合物。

estrepe.t: 毁坏树木；剥夺权益；侵占土地

e.en: The tenant was accused of trying to {estrepe} the woodland before leaving.
e.zh: 那名佃户被指在离开前企图毁坏林地。

e.en: Old law books use {estrepe} for wasting land held by another.
e.zh: 古老的法律书用estrepe指损害他人持有的土地。

estrepement.t: 土地毁损；非法毁坏林木

e.en: The court treated the felling as {estrepement} of the estate.
e.zh: 法院将砍伐行为视为对地产的毁损。

e.en: Medieval tenants could be punished for {estrepement} before a judgment.
e.zh: 中世纪的佃户在判决前毁坏土地可能受罚。

e.en: The dermatologist noted {estriasis} across the patient's abdomen.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生注意到病人腹部有条纹状病变。

e.en: Severe stretching can leave scars described as {estriasis}.
e.zh: 严重拉伸可能留下被称为estriasis的条纹瘢痕。

e.en: The old inventory listed an {estrich} plume on the helmet.
e.zh: 旧清单列出头盔上有一根鸵鸟羽毛。

e.en: In heraldry, an {estrich} sometimes appears beside the shield.
e.zh: 在纹章学中，鸵鸟有时出现在盾徽旁。

e.en: Early researchers used {estrin} to describe estrogenic substances.
e.zh: 早期研究者用estrin来指雌激素类物质。

e.en: The paper compared ovarian extracts rich in {estrin}.
e.zh: 论文比较了富含雌激素类物质的卵巢提取物。

e.en: The compound acts {estrogenically} in certain cell tests.
e.zh: 这种化合物在某些细胞测试中以雌激素方式起作用。

e.en: Chemicals that behave {estrogenically} may disrupt development.
e.zh: 具有雌激素样作用的化学物质可能干扰发育。

e.en: The assay measured the {estrogenicity} of river samples.
e.zh: 该检测测量了河水样本的雌激素活性。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the plastic additive had significant {estrogenicity}.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这种塑料添加剂是否有显著雌激素活性。

e.en: The Victorian doctor diagnosed her restlessness as {estromania}.
e.zh: 那位维多利亚时代医生把她的躁动诊断为发情狂。

e.en: Modern clinicians rarely use the term {estromania}.
e.zh: 现代临床医生很少使用estromania这个术语。

e.en: The lab reported elevated {estron} in the blood sample.
e.zh: 实验室报告血样中的雌酮水平升高。

e.en: Some older texts spell estrone as {estron}.
e.zh: 一些较旧文献把estrone拼作estron。

estrosteron.t: 雌甾酮；旧称类固醇激素

e.en: The archive mentions {estrosteron} in an early hormone study.
e.zh: 档案在一项早期激素研究中提到雌甾酮。

e.en: Few modern papers still use the term {estrosteron}.
e.zh: 现代论文已经很少再使用estrosteron这个术语。

estrostilben.t: 雌激素性二苯乙烯化合物

e.en: Chemists synthesized {estrostilben} as a synthetic estrogen.
e.zh: 化学家合成了作为合成雌激素的二苯乙烯化合物。

e.en: The toxicology report grouped {estrostilben} with related hormonal agents.
e.zh: 毒理报告将estrostilben归入相关激素类物质。

e.en: The farmer recorded the cow's {estrual} behavior carefully.
e.zh: 农场主仔细记录了母牛的发情行为。

e.en: Hormone levels rise during the {estrual} phase.
e.zh: 在发情期，激素水平会上升。

e.en: The mare came into {estrum} earlier than expected.
e.zh: 那匹母马比预期更早进入发情期。

e.en: The poet used {estrum} to mean a sudden creative frenzy.
e.zh: 诗人用estrum表示突如其来的创作狂热。

e.en: The team mapped {estuarial} marshes along the coast.
e.zh: 团队绘制了沿海河口沼泽的地图。

e.en: Fish nurseries often depend on {estuarial} water conditions.
e.zh: 鱼类育幼区常依赖河口水域条件。

e.en: His {esurience} after the long fast was obvious.
e.zh: 长时间禁食后，他的饥饿感十分明显。

e.en: The essay attacks the {esurience} of powerful speculators.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击了有权势投机者的贪欲。

e.en: The travelers' {esuriency} grew as the food ran out.
e.zh: 食物耗尽时，旅人们越来越饥饿。

e.en: He wrote about the {esuriency} behind imperial expansion.
e.zh: 他写到帝国扩张背后的贪婪。

e.en: The {esurient} hikers hurried toward the village inn.
e.zh: 饥肠辘辘的徒步者匆匆赶往村里的旅店。

e.en: An {esurient} market quickly absorbed the new shares.
e.zh: 贪婪的市场很快吸收了新发行的股票。

e.en: The children stared {esuriently} at the cooling pies.
e.zh: 孩子们饥饿地盯着正在放凉的馅饼。

e.en: Investors moved {esuriently} into the newly opened sector.
e.zh: 投资者贪婪地涌入这个新开放的行业。

e.en: A raspberry is an {etaerio} of small drupelets.
e.zh: 覆盆子是由许多小核果组成的聚合果。

e.en: The botany exam asked students to identify an {etaerio}.
e.zh: 植物学考试要求学生辨认聚合果。

e.en: She placed the porcelain cups on an {etagere}.
e.zh: 她把瓷杯放在多层置物架上。

e.en: The antique {etagere} stood beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 那件古董多层架立在壁炉旁。

e.en: The engineer selected an {etalate} surface for the circuit pattern.
e.zh: 工程师选择了可蚀刻表面来制作电路图案。

e.en: After treatment, the metal became more {etalate}.
e.zh: 处理之后，这种金属变得更易蚀刻。

e.en: The dressmaker chose fine {etamin} for the summer blouse.
e.zh: 裁缝为夏季衬衫选用了细薄纱织物。

e.en: Flour was sifted through a piece of {etamin}.
e.zh: 面粉通过一块筛布被筛过。

e.en: The regiment reached the next {etape} before dusk.
e.zh: 该团在黄昏前抵达下一个行军站。

e.en: Cyclists use {etape} for a stage of a long race.
e.zh: 自行车手用etape指长距离比赛中的一个赛段。

etatism.t: 国家主义；国家干预主义

e.en: The party's platform leaned toward {etatism} and central planning.
e.zh: 该党的纲领倾向于国家干预主义和中央计划。

e.en: Critics saw the policy as a revival of {etatism}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项政策是国家主义的复兴。

etatist.t: 国家主义者；国家干预主义的

e.en: He defended an {etatist} approach to heavy industry.
e.zh: 他为重工业中的国家干预主义做法辩护。

e.en: The minister was described as an {etatist} by his opponents.
e.zh: 反对者把这位部长称为国家主义者。

e.en: The technician applied an {etchant} to the copper plate.
e.zh: 技术员把蚀刻剂涂在铜板上。

e.en: This acidic {etchant} removes the exposed metal quickly.
e.zh: 这种酸性腐蚀液能迅速去除外露金属。

e.en: The poem tries to {eternalise} a moment of grief.
e.zh: 这首诗试图让悲伤的一刻成为永恒。

e.en: Artists often {eternalise} ordinary faces in bronze.
e.zh: 艺术家常用青铜让普通面孔流传不朽。

e.en: The monument will {eternalize} their sacrifice.
e.zh: 这座纪念碑将使他们的牺牲永垂不朽。

e.en: She hoped the photograph would {eternalize} that summer.
e.zh: 她希望这张照片能让那个夏天成为永恒。

e.en: His courage was {eternalized} in local legend.
e.zh: 他的勇气在当地传说中被不朽化。

e.en: The painter {eternalized} the village before it disappeared.
e.zh: 画家在村庄消失前把它永久留在画中。

e.en: The song {eternalizes} a lost friendship.
e.zh: 这首歌让一段逝去的友谊永恒。

e.en: Public memory sometimes {eternalizes} flawed leaders.
e.zh: 公众记忆有时会让有缺陷的领袖不朽化。

e.en: The novelist was {eternalizing} her childhood town.
e.zh: 那位小说家正在把童年的小镇写成永恒。

e.en: They saw the statue as {eternalizing} imperial power.
e.zh: 他们认为这座雕像是在使帝国权力不朽化。

e.en: The poet praised an {eterne} beauty beyond time.
e.zh: 诗人赞美一种超越时间的永恒之美。

e.en: Her {eterne} vows sounded strangely old-fashioned.
e.zh: 她那些永恒誓言听起来有些古雅。

e.en: The old chronicle sought to {eternise} the king's deeds.
e.zh: 那部古老编年史试图让国王的事迹不朽。

e.en: A single image can {eternise} a private sorrow.
e.zh: 一幅图像能让个人的悲伤化为永恒。

e.en: The critic questioned the {eternization} of celebrity culture.
e.zh: 评论家质疑名人文化被不朽化的现象。

e.en: Religious art often aims at the {eternization} of sacred moments.
e.zh: 宗教艺术常旨在让神圣时刻永恒化。

e.en: The inscription will {eternize} her name.
e.zh: 这段铭文将使她的名字不朽。

e.en: He wanted to {eternize} the city in his novel.
e.zh: 他想在小说中让这座城市永恒存在。

e.en: The battle was {eternized} by later historians.
e.zh: 后来的历史学家让这场战役名垂不朽。

e.en: Her smile is {eternized} in the family portrait.
e.zh: 她的微笑在那幅全家福中被永久保存。

e.en: The museum {eternizes} moments that might otherwise vanish.
e.zh: 博物馆让那些本会消逝的时刻得以永恒。

e.en: This ritual {eternizes} the bond between the families.
e.zh: 这种仪式使两个家族的纽带长久不朽。

e.en: The film is {eternizing} a vanished way of life.
e.zh: 这部电影正在让一种消失的生活方式不朽化。

e.en: She disliked the habit of {eternizing} youthful pain.
e.zh: 她不喜欢把青春痛苦永恒化的习惯。

e.en: The formula uses {ethal} as a fatty alcohol base.
e.zh: 这个配方使用鲸蜡醇作为脂肪醇基料。

e.en: Pure {ethal} melts into a waxy liquid when heated.
e.zh: 纯鲸蜡醇受热后会融成蜡状液体。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {ethambutol} for tuberculosis treatment.
e.zh: 医生开了乙胺丁醇来治疗结核病。

e.en: Patients taking {ethambutol} need regular eye checks.
e.zh: 服用乙胺丁醇的患者需要定期检查眼睛。

e.en: The study mentioned {ethamivan} as a respiratory stimulant.
e.zh: 这项研究提到乙米香草胺是一种呼吸兴奋剂。

e.en: Use of {ethamivan} is now uncommon in routine practice.
e.zh: 乙米香草胺如今在常规医疗中并不常用。

e.en: In chemistry class, we identified {ethanamide} by its structure.
e.zh: 在化学课上，我们通过结构识别乙酰胺。

e.en: {Ethanamide} is also commonly called acetamide.
e.zh: 乙酰胺也常被称为acetamide。

e.en: The reagent contained a small amount of {ethanedithioamide}.
e.zh: 该试剂含有少量乙二硫代酰胺。

e.en: Researchers tested {ethanedithioamide} in the coordination experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员在配位实验中测试了乙二硫代酰胺。

e.en: A leak was detected because {ethanethiol} has a strong odor.
e.zh: 由于乙硫醇有强烈气味，泄漏被发现了。

e.en: Chemists handle {ethanethiol} carefully in a ventilated hood.
e.zh: 化学人员会在通风橱中小心处理乙硫醇。

e.en: The detergent contains {ethanolamine} to adjust acidity.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂含有乙醇胺，用来调节酸度。

e.en: Engineers used {ethanolamine} to remove carbon dioxide from the gas stream.
e.zh: 工程师使用乙醇胺从气流中去除二氧化碳。

e.en: The chemist ordered {ethanolurea} for the synthesis experiment.
e.zh: 化学家为合成实验订购了乙醇脲。

e.en: A small amount of {ethanolurea} was dissolved in water.
e.zh: 少量乙醇脲被溶解在水中。

e.en: Plants produce {ethene} as a natural ripening hormone.
e.zh: 植物会产生乙烯作为天然的催熟激素。

e.en: The factory converts {ethene} into polyethylene.
e.zh: 这家工厂把乙烯转化为聚乙烯。

etheogenesis.t: 伦理观念形成；道德生成

e.en: The philosopher studied {etheogenesis} in early childhood.
e.zh: 这位哲学家研究幼年时期道德观念的形成。

e.en: Her lecture linked {etheogenesis} with social habit.
e.zh: 她的讲座把道德生成与社会习惯联系起来。

ethephon.t: 乙烯利；植物生长调节剂

e.en: Farmers sprayed {ethephon} to encourage uniform fruit ripening.
e.zh: 农民喷洒乙烯利来促进果实均匀成熟。

e.en: The label warned that {ethephon} must be diluted carefully.
e.zh: 标签警告说乙烯利必须谨慎稀释。

e.en: The painting's {ethereality} made the room feel weightless.
e.zh: 这幅画的空灵感让房间显得轻盈无重。

e.en: Critics admired the {ethereality} of her voice.
e.zh: 评论家赞赏她嗓音中的飘渺气质。

e.en: The director used fog for the scene's {etherealization}.
e.zh: 导演用雾气让这个场景变得更加空灵。

e.en: The poem's {etherealization} of grief softened its pain.
e.zh: 这首诗把悲伤写得飘渺，从而减轻了痛感。

e.en: Soft light can {etherealize} an ordinary landscape.
e.zh: 柔和的光线能让普通风景显得空灵。

e.en: The writer tried to {etherealize} everyday sadness.
e.zh: 作家试图把日常的忧伤写得飘渺。

e.en: Her face was {etherealized} by the candlelight.
e.zh: 烛光使她的脸显得空灵。

e.en: The memory felt {etherealized} after many years.
e.zh: 多年以后，那段记忆变得飘渺起来。

e.en: The music {etherealizes} the final moments of the film.
e.zh: 这段音乐让影片最后的时刻显得空灵。

e.en: Moonlight {etherealizes} the garden at night.
e.zh: 月光使夜晚的花园变得飘渺。

e.en: The mist was {etherealizing} the distant hills.
e.zh: 薄雾正使远处的山丘显得空灵。

e.en: She avoided {etherealizing} poverty in her novel.
e.zh: 她在小说中避免把贫困写得过于飘渺。

e.en: An {etherial} glow surrounded the old chapel.
e.zh: 一层空灵的光辉笼罩着那座旧礼拜堂。

e.en: The choir produced an {etherial} sound.
e.zh: 唱诗班发出了空灵的声音。

e.en: The artist hoped to {etherialise} the figure with pale colors.
e.zh: 艺术家希望用淡色让人物显得空灵。

e.en: Romantic prose can {etherialise} ordinary desire.
e.zh: 浪漫主义散文会把普通欲望写得飘渺。

e.en: The veil seemed to {etherialize} her outline.
e.zh: 面纱似乎让她的轮廓变得空灵。

e.en: The composer tried to {etherialize} the melody.
e.zh: 作曲家试图让旋律显得更加飘渺。

etherification.t: 醚化作用；形成醚的过程

e.en: The reaction required heat for efficient {etherification}.
e.zh: 这个反应需要加热才能高效醚化。

e.en: Catalysts can speed up {etherification} in the mixture.
e.zh: 催化剂能加快混合物中的醚化作用。

e.en: The sample was {etherified} before further analysis.
e.zh: 样品在进一步分析前经过了醚化处理。

e.en: An {etherified} compound often has different solubility.
e.zh: 醚化后的化合物通常具有不同的溶解性。

e.en: The reagent {etherifies} the alcohol under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 这种试剂在酸性条件下使醇醚化。

e.en: This process {etherifies} part of the cellulose.
e.zh: 这个过程会使部分纤维素发生醚化。

e.en: Chemists can {etherify} alcohols with suitable reagents.
e.zh: 化学家可以用合适试剂使醇醚化。

e.en: The team tried to {etherify} the compound selectively.
e.zh: 团队试图选择性地将该化合物醚化。

e.en: The lab monitored the {etherifying} reaction overnight.
e.zh: 实验室整夜监测这个醚化反应。

e.en: They adjusted the temperature while {etherifying} the resin.
e.zh: 他们在使树脂醚化时调节了温度。

e.en: Doctors once used ether to {etherise} surgical patients.
e.zh: 医生过去曾用乙醚麻醉外科病人。

e.en: The chemist planned to {etherise} the alcohol derivative.
e.zh: 化学家计划使这种醇衍生物醚化。

e.en: Early surgery sometimes depended on {etherization}.
e.zh: 早期外科手术有时依赖乙醚麻醉。

e.en: The paper described the {etherization} of several alcohols.
e.zh: 论文描述了几种醇的醚化过程。

e.en: Surgeons would {etherize} patients before painful operations.
e.zh: 外科医生会在痛苦手术前用乙醚麻醉病人。

e.en: The protocol explains how to {etherize} the sample.
e.zh: 规程说明了如何使样品醚化。

etherized.t: 被乙醚麻醉的；已醚化的

e.en: The patient was {etherized} before the incision.
e.zh: 病人在切口前已被乙醚麻醉。

e.en: The {etherized} product was purified by distillation.
e.zh: 醚化后的产物通过蒸馏进行了纯化。

e.en: The old {etherizer} belonged to a medical museum.
e.zh: 那台旧乙醚麻醉器属于一家医学博物馆。

e.en: A stronger {etherizer} improved the chemical yield.
e.zh: 更强的醚化剂提高了化学产率。

e.en: The surgeon {etherizes} the animal before the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前用乙醚麻醉这只动物。

e.en: The reagent {etherizes} the alcohol under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 这种试剂在受控条件下使醇发生醚化。

e.en: They are {etherizing} the sample in a sealed vessel.
e.zh: 他们正在密闭容器中使样品醚化。

e.en: The old manual describes {etherizing} patients before surgery.
e.zh: 这本旧手册描述了术前用乙醚麻醉病人的做法。

e.en: The essay tries to {ethicize} every economic choice.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图把每个经济选择都作伦理化解释。

e.en: Teachers can {ethicize} the debate without silencing disagreement.
e.zh: 教师可以让辩论带有伦理视角，而不压制分歧。

ethide.t: 乙基化物；乙基金属化合物

e.en: The chemist isolated an unstable {ethide} from the reaction.
e.zh: 化学家从反应中分离出一种不稳定的乙基化物。

e.en: This old paper calls the organometallic salt an {ethide}.
e.zh: 这篇旧论文把这种有机金属盐称为乙基化物。

e.en: The molecule contains an {ethidene} group at one end.
e.zh: 这个分子的一端含有一个亚乙基基团。

e.en: Older nomenclature used {ethidene} for this bivalent radical.
e.zh: 较旧的命名法用亚乙基称呼这种二价基团。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {ethinamate} as a sleeping medicine.
e.zh: 医生过去曾把乙炔氨酯作为安眠药开给病人。

e.en: The report linked {ethinamate} misuse to dangerous sedation.
e.zh: 报告把乙炔氨酯滥用与危险的镇静作用联系起来。

e.en: In systematic naming, {ethine} is the compound acetylene.
e.zh: 在系统命名中，乙炔就是化合物acetylene。

e.en: The flame burned hotter when {ethine} was mixed with oxygen.
e.zh: 乙炔与氧气混合后，火焰燃烧得更热。

e.en: The drug molecule includes an {ethinyl} side group.
e.zh: 这种药物分子含有一个乙炔基侧基。

e.en: Chemists added an {ethinyl} substituent to improve stability.
e.zh: 化学家加入乙炔基取代基以提高稳定性。

e.en: Many contraceptive pills contain {ethinylestradiol}.
e.zh: 许多避孕药含有炔雌醇。

e.en: The study measured {ethinylestradiol} levels in wastewater.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了废水中的炔雌醇含量。

ethiofencarb.t: 乙硫苯威；氨基甲酸酯杀虫剂

e.en: Farmers used {ethiofencarb} to control aphids on crops.
e.zh: 农民曾用乙硫苯威防治作物上的蚜虫。

e.en: Regulators reviewed {ethiofencarb} residues in imported produce.
e.zh: 监管机构审查了进口农产品中的乙硫苯威残留。

e.en: The reaction produced a sodium {ethiolate} in solution.
e.zh: 该反应在溶液中生成了乙硫醇钠。

e.en: Researchers can {ethiolate} the surface before binding gold ions.
e.zh: 研究人员可先使表面乙硫基化，再结合金离子。

e.en: The orchard was treated with {ethion} decades ago.
e.zh: 这片果园几十年前曾使用乙硫磷处理。

e.en: Inspectors found traces of {ethion} on the leaves.
e.zh: 检查人员在叶片上发现了乙硫磷痕迹。

e.en: The patient received {ethionamide} for resistant tuberculosis.
e.zh: 这名患者因耐药结核接受乙硫异烟胺治疗。

e.en: Nausea is a common side effect of {ethionamide}.
e.zh: 恶心是乙硫异烟胺的常见副作用。

ethionine.t: 乙硫氨酸；蛋氨酸类似物

e.en: Scientists used {ethionine} to study liver injury in rats.
e.zh: 科学家用乙硫氨酸研究大鼠肝损伤。

e.en: The compound {ethionine} resembles the amino acid methionine.
e.zh: 乙硫氨酸这种化合物类似于氨基酸蛋氨酸。

ethiopification.t: 埃塞俄比亚化；本土化过程

e.en: The historian described the church's {ethiopification} over centuries.
e.zh: 历史学家描述了教会数百年来的埃塞俄比亚化过程。

e.en: Local artists shaped the {ethiopification} of imported styles.
e.zh: 本地艺术家推动了外来风格的埃塞俄比亚化。

ethisterone.t: 炔诺酮旧称；合成孕激素

e.en: Early hormone therapy sometimes used {ethisterone}.
e.zh: 早期激素治疗有时使用炔诺酮旧称的这种药物。

e.en: The textbook lists {ethisterone} among synthetic progestogens.
e.zh: 教材把ethisterone列为合成孕激素之一。

e.en: The scan revealed a rare {ethmolith} near the nasal cavity.
e.zh: 扫描显示鼻腔附近有一枚罕见的筛骨结石。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {ethmolith} after chronic sinus symptoms.
e.zh: 在长期鼻窦症状后，外科医生取出了这枚筛骨结石。

e.en: The diagram labels each {ethmoturbinal} bone in the skull.
e.zh: 图中标出了颅骨中的每块筛骨鼻甲。

e.en: An {ethmoturbinal} structure helps increase the nasal surface area.
e.zh: 筛鼻甲结构有助于增加鼻腔表面积。

e.en: The Roman authorities recognized him as an {ethnarch}.
e.zh: 罗马当局承认他是一个民族统治者。

e.en: In ancient usage, an {ethnarch} governed a people, not necessarily a kingdom.
e.zh: 在古代用法中，ethnarch统治一个族群，不一定统治王国。

e.en: The province became an {ethnarchy} under imperial supervision.
e.zh: 该省在帝国监督下成为一个民族管辖区。

e.en: Scholars debate whether the title implied full {ethnarchy}.
e.zh: 学者们争论这个头衔是否意味着完整的民族统治权。

e.en: The speech rejected {ethnicism} and called for equal citizenship.
e.zh: 这场演讲反对族群主义，并呼吁平等公民身份。

e.en: Critics saw {ethnicism} beneath the policy's neutral language.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项政策中性的措辞背后隐藏着民族偏见。

ethno.t: 民族风音乐；民族相关的

e.en: The festival mixes jazz with {ethno} and electronic music.
e.zh: 这个音乐节把爵士、民族风音乐和电子乐混合在一起。

e.en: The course introduces {ethno} approaches to cultural research.
e.zh: 这门课介绍文化研究中的民族相关方法。

e.en: She uses {ethnoarchaeology} to interpret ancient pottery use.
e.zh: 她运用民族考古学来解释古代陶器的使用方式。

e.en: Modern craft villages can inform {ethnoarchaeology}.
e.zh: 现代手工艺村落可以为民族考古学提供参考。

e.en: The archive preserves {ethnobiological} knowledge about medicinal plants.
e.zh: 该档案保存了有关药用植物的民族生物学知识。

e.en: Her {ethnobiological} survey recorded local names for fish.
e.zh: 她的民族生物学调查记录了鱼类的地方名称。

e.en: An {ethnobiologist} interviewed healers about forest plants.
e.zh: 一位民族生物学家采访了治疗者关于森林植物的知识。

e.en: The {ethnobiologist} compared local classifications with scientific taxonomy.
e.zh: 这位民族生物学家把当地分类与科学分类法进行了比较。

ethnobiology.t: 民族生物学；族群与生物关系研究

e.en: Her dissertation in {ethnobiology} examined local fishing knowledge.
e.zh: 她的民族生物学论文研究了当地的捕鱼知识。

e.en: {Ethnobiology} links ecology with cultural traditions.
e.zh: 民族生物学把生态学与文化传统联系起来。

e.en: The museum displayed an {ethnobotanic} collection from the rainforest.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自雨林的民族植物学藏品。

e.en: She used {ethnobotanic} records to identify medicinal plants.
e.zh: 她利用民族植物学记录来识别药用植物。

e.en: The {ethnobotanist} interviewed elders about healing herbs.
e.zh: 这位民族植物学家采访长者，了解治病草药。

e.en: As an {ethnobotanist}, he studies how communities use plants.
e.zh: 作为民族植物学家，他研究各社群如何使用植物。

e.en: The textbook was criticized for its {ethnocentricity}.
e.zh: 这本教材因带有民族中心主义倾向而受到批评。

e.en: Travel can reduce {ethnocentricity} by widening experience.
e.zh: 旅行能拓宽经历，从而减少民族中心主义倾向。

ethnocide.t: 文化灭绝；族群文化毁灭

e.en: Activists described the forced assimilation as {ethnocide}.
e.zh: 活动人士把这种强制同化称为文化灭绝。

e.en: The report warned that language bans could lead to {ethnocide}.
e.zh: 报告警告说，语言禁令可能导致族群文化毁灭。

e.en: Critics called the state an {ethnocracy} rather than a democracy.
e.zh: 批评者称这个国家是族群统治政体，而不是民主国家。

e.en: An {ethnocracy} privileges one ethnic group in political life.
e.zh: 族群统治政体会在政治生活中优待某一族群。

ethnogeny.t: 族群起源研究；民族发生

e.en: The lecture on {ethnogeny} traced the origins of the community.
e.zh: 这场关于民族发生的讲座追溯了该社群的起源。

e.en: Older theories of {ethnogeny} often relied on myths.
e.zh: 早期的族群起源理论常常依赖神话。

e.en: The {ethnohistorian} compared archives with oral traditions.
e.zh: 这位民族史学家把档案资料与口述传统进行比较。

e.en: An {ethnohistorian} can help explain colonial records.
e.zh: 民族史学家可以帮助解读殖民时期的记录。

ethnohistoric.t: 民族史的；民族历史相关的

e.en: The team analyzed {ethnohistoric} evidence from mission records.
e.zh: 团队分析了传教记录中的民族史证据。

e.en: Her article offered an {ethnohistoric} view of migration.
e.zh: 她的文章从民族史角度解读了迁徙。

e.en: He teaches {ethnohistory} at the university.
e.zh: 他在大学教授民族史。

e.en: {Ethnohistory} combines written records with oral memory.
e.zh: 民族史研究把书面记录与口述记忆结合起来。

e.en: The {ethnolinguist} documented songs in a threatened language.
e.zh: 这位民族语言学家记录了一种濒危语言的歌曲。

e.en: As an {ethnolinguist}, she studies language and culture together.
e.zh: 作为民族语言学家，她把语言和文化放在一起研究。

e.en: The archive contains rare {ethnologic} photographs.
e.zh: 档案馆收藏着珍贵的民族学照片。

e.en: His {ethnologic} approach focused on ritual and kinship.
e.zh: 他的民族学方法侧重于仪式和亲属关系。

e.en: The {ethnomethodologist} studied how nurses coordinate shifts.
e.zh: 这位常人方法学研究者研究护士如何协调班次。

e.en: An {ethnomethodologist} examines ordinary social interaction closely.
e.zh: 常人方法学研究者会细致考察日常社会互动。

e.en: Several {ethnomethodologists} observed courtroom conversations.
e.zh: 几位常人方法学研究者观察了法庭谈话。

e.en: {Ethnomethodologists} often analyze the rules people use unconsciously.
e.zh: 常人方法学研究者常分析人们无意识使用的规则。

e.en: Her {ethnomusicological} research focused on wedding songs.
e.zh: 她的民族音乐学研究聚焦于婚礼歌曲。

e.en: The recording has great {ethnomusicological} value.
e.zh: 这段录音具有很高的民族音乐学价值。

e.en: {Ethnomycology} studies how cultures use mushrooms.
e.zh: 民族真菌学研究不同文化如何使用蘑菇。

e.en: His fieldwork in {ethnomycology} recorded local names for fungi.
e.zh: 他的民族真菌学田野工作记录了当地对真菌的称呼。

ethnonationalist.t: 民族国家主义者；民族国家主义的

e.en: The party adopted an {ethnonationalist} platform.
e.zh: 该党采纳了民族国家主义纲领。

e.en: An {ethnonationalist} argued that citizenship should follow ancestry.
e.zh: 一名民族国家主义者主张公民身份应依据血统。

e.en: The seminar on {ethnonymics} examined changing group names.
e.zh: 这场族名学研讨会考察了族群名称的变化。

e.en: {Ethnonymics} can reveal political struggles over identity.
e.zh: 族名学能揭示围绕身份认同的政治争议。

e.en: The study reported {ethnopharmacologic} evidence for the remedy.
e.zh: 这项研究报告了该疗法的民族药理学证据。

e.en: Researchers reviewed {ethnopharmacologic} uses of desert plants.
e.zh: 研究人员回顾了沙漠植物的民族药理学用途。

ethnopsychology.t: 民族心理学；文化心理研究

e.en: {Ethnopsychology} explores how culture shapes emotion.
e.zh: 民族心理学探讨文化如何塑造情绪。

e.en: The course in {ethnopsychology} challenged universal models of mind.
e.zh: 这门民族心理学课程质疑了普遍心智模型。

e.en: The ancient text described each {ethnos} separately.
e.zh: 这部古代文献分别描述了每一个族群。

e.en: Modern writers use {ethnos} to mean an ethnic community.
e.zh: 现代作者用ethnos表示一个民族或族群共同体。

ethnoscience.t: 民族科学；本土知识体系研究

e.en: {Ethnoscience} studies local systems of classification.
e.zh: 民族科学研究地方性的分类体系。

e.en: The project treated farmers' weather knowledge as {ethnoscience}.
e.zh: 该项目把农民的天气知识视为民族科学。

ethogram.t: 动物行为记录图谱或清单

e.en: The biologist prepared an {ethogram} before observing the monkeys.
e.zh: 生物学家在观察猴子前准备了一份动物行为记录清单。

e.en: A detailed {ethogram} helped compare mating displays across species.
e.zh: 详细的行为图谱有助于比较不同物种的求偶展示。

e.en: The old formulary listed {ethoheptazine} among analgesic compounds.
e.zh: 旧版处方集把乙庚嗪列在镇痛化合物之中。

e.en: Few modern physicians would recognize {ethoheptazine} by name.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会一听名字就认出乙庚嗪。

e.en: The patient once took {ethopropazine} for tremor control.
e.zh: 这名患者曾服用乙丙嗪来控制震颤。

e.en: Older neurology texts discuss {ethopropazine} as an anticholinergic drug.
e.zh: 较旧的神经学教材把乙丙嗪作为抗胆碱药讨论。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {ethosuximide} for absence seizures.
e.zh: 医生开了乙琥胺来治疗失神发作。

e.en: Blood tests monitored the child's response to {ethosuximide}.
e.zh: 血液检查用于监测孩子对乙琥胺的反应。

e.en: The neurologist considered {ethotoin} after other medicines failed.
e.zh: 其他药物无效后，神经科医生考虑使用乙妥英。

e.en: Some patients reported dizziness while taking {ethotoin}.
e.zh: 有些患者在服用乙妥英时报告头晕。

e.en: The paper described {ethoxal} as a reactive laboratory reagent.
e.zh: 论文将乙氧醛描述为一种活泼的实验室试剂。

e.en: Impure {ethoxal} gave inconsistent results in the reaction.
e.zh: 不纯的乙氧醛使反应结果不一致。

e.en: Sodium {ethoxide} is often used as a strong base.
e.zh: 乙醇钠常被用作强碱。

e.en: The {ethoxide} ion attacked the carbonyl carbon.
e.zh: 乙氧负离子进攻了羰基碳。

e.en: The molecule contains an {ethoxy} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个乙氧基。

e.en: An {ethoxy} substituent changed the compound's smell.
e.zh: 一个乙氧基取代基改变了该化合物的气味。

e.en: The lab stored {ethoxybenzene} in a flammable cabinet.
e.zh: 实验室把乙氧基苯存放在易燃品柜中。

e.en: Pure {ethoxybenzene} has a sweet, ether-like odor.
e.zh: 纯乙氧基苯有一种甜甜的醚样气味。

e.en: The spectrum confirmed one {ethoxyl} group in the sample.
e.zh: 光谱确认样品中有一个乙氧基。

e.en: Replacing the methoxyl group with {ethoxyl} altered the solubility.
e.zh: 用乙氧基替代甲氧基后，溶解度发生了变化。

e.en: The dye intermediate was identified as {ethoxylaniline}.
e.zh: 这种染料中间体被鉴定为乙氧基苯胺。

e.en: Workers handled {ethoxylaniline} under a fume hood.
e.zh: 工人在通风橱内处理乙氧基苯胺。

e.en: The ophthalmologist prescribed {ethoxzolamide} to lower eye pressure.
e.zh: 眼科医生开了乙氧唑胺来降低眼压。

e.en: Some patients take {ethoxzolamide} when topical drops are insufficient.
e.zh: 当外用滴眼液不够有效时，一些患者会服用乙氧唑胺。

e.en: {Ethylamine} has a sharp ammonia-like smell.
e.zh: 乙胺有一种刺鼻的氨味。

e.en: The reaction used {ethylamine} to form an amide.
e.zh: 该反应用乙胺生成酰胺。

e.en: Chemists can {ethylate} the compound under basic conditions.
e.zh: 化学家可以在碱性条件下使该化合物乙基化。

e.en: Sodium {ethylate} reacts quickly with moisture.
e.zh: 乙醇钠会与水分迅速反应。

e.en: The reagent {ethylates} the alcohol during the synthesis.
e.zh: 该试剂在合成过程中使醇乙基化。

e.en: Several metal {ethylates} were tested as catalysts.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了几种金属乙醇盐作为催化剂。

ethylating.t: 正在乙基化的；乙基化用的

e.en: The team used an {ethylating} agent with great caution.
e.zh: 团队非常谨慎地使用了一种乙基化试剂。

e.en: They were {ethylating} the precursor to improve stability.
e.zh: 他们正在对前体进行乙基化以提高稳定性。

e.en: {Ethylation} changed the compound's biological activity.
e.zh: 乙基化改变了该化合物的生物活性。

e.en: The report measured DNA {ethylation} in exposed cells.
e.zh: 报告测量了暴露细胞中的DNA乙基化。

e.en: The anticoagulant {ethylbiscoumacetate} appears in older pharmacology texts.
e.zh: 抗凝药乙基双香豆素乙酸酯出现在较早的药理学教材中。

e.en: Researchers compared {ethylbiscoumacetate} with other coumarin derivatives.
e.zh: 研究人员将乙基双香豆素乙酸酯与其他香豆素衍生物进行了比较。

e.en: The synthesis required dry {ethylchlorosulfonate} and careful cooling.
e.zh: 该合成需要干燥的氯磺酸乙酯并小心冷却。

e.en: Because {ethylchlorosulfonate} is corrosive, gloves were mandatory.
e.zh: 由于氯磺酸乙酯有腐蚀性，必须戴手套。

e.en: {Ethylenediamine} can bind metal ions strongly.
e.zh: 乙二胺能与金属离子牢固结合。

e.en: The cleaner contained a small amount of {ethylenediamine}.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂含有少量乙二胺。

e.en: {Ethyleneimine} is handled only in controlled laboratory settings.
e.zh: 乙烯亚胺只能在受控的实验室环境中处理。

e.en: The polymer was prepared from {ethyleneimine} derivatives.
e.zh: 这种聚合物由乙烯亚胺衍生物制备而成。

e.en: The chemist noted an {ethylenic} bond in the structure.
e.zh: 化学家注意到该结构中有一个乙烯式双键。

e.en: {Ethylenic} compounds often undergo addition reactions.
e.zh: 含乙烯式双键的化合物常发生加成反应。

e.en: The formulation used {ethylethanolamine} as a stabilizer.
e.zh: 该配方使用乙基乙醇胺作为稳定剂。

e.en: Analysts detected {ethylethanolamine} in the industrial sample.
e.zh: 分析人员在工业样品中检测到乙基乙醇胺。

e.en: Older chemistry books sometimes call butene {ethylethylene}.
e.zh: 较旧的化学书有时把丁烯称为乙基乙烯。

e.en: The term {ethylethylene} is uncommon in modern nomenclature.
e.zh: 乙基乙烯这个术语在现代命名法中并不常见。

ethylhydrocupreine.t: 乙基氢化叩卜林，旧抗菌药

e.en: Early researchers tested {ethylhydrocupreine} against pneumococcal infections.
e.zh: 早期研究人员曾测试乙基氢化叩卜林对肺炎球菌感染的作用。

e.en: The obsolete drug {ethylhydrocupreine} is rarely mentioned today.
e.zh: 这种过时药物乙基氢化叩卜林如今很少被提及。

ethylhydroxyethylcellulose.t: 乙基羟乙基纤维素；化学增稠剂

e.en: The paint formula uses {ethylhydroxyethylcellulose} as a thickener.
e.zh: 这种涂料配方使用乙基羟乙基纤维素作增稠剂。

e.en: Researchers measured how {ethylhydroxyethylcellulose} changed the gel's viscosity.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了乙基羟乙基纤维素如何改变凝胶的黏度。

e.en: The chemist noted an {ethylic} odor from the sample.
e.zh: 化学师注意到样品有一种乙基类气味。

e.en: Older papers sometimes describe ethyl compounds as {ethylic} derivatives.
e.zh: 较早的论文有时把乙基化合物称为乙基衍生物。

e.en: The molecule contains an {ethylidene} group at one end.
e.zh: 这个分子的一端含有一个亚乙基基团。

e.en: They compared the stability of several {ethylidene} derivatives.
e.zh: 他们比较了几种乙叉基衍生物的稳定性。

ethylin.t: 乙基化物；旧称乙基化合物

e.en: The old laboratory note referred to the compound as {ethylin}.
e.zh: 那份旧实验记录把这种化合物称为乙基化物。

e.en: Modern chemists rarely use the term {ethylin}.
e.zh: 现代化学家很少使用ethylin这个术语。

e.en: The reaction achieved {ethylization} under mild conditions.
e.zh: 该反应在温和条件下实现了乙基化。

e.en: Incomplete {ethylization} reduced the yield of the target product.
e.zh: 乙基化不完全降低了目标产物的收率。

e.en: The team tried to {ethylize} the alcohol derivative.
e.zh: 团队尝试使这种醇衍生物乙基化。

e.en: A stronger reagent can {ethylize} the compound more quickly.
e.zh: 更强的试剂能更快地向该化合物引入乙基。

ethylmethylbutylamine.t: 乙基甲基丁胺；有机胺化合物

e.en: The spectrum helped identify {ethylmethylbutylamine} in the mixture.
e.zh: 光谱帮助确认了混合物中的乙基甲基丁胺。

e.en: Handling {ethylmethylbutylamine} requires standard laboratory precautions.
e.zh: 处理乙基甲基丁胺需要遵守常规实验室防护措施。

ethylmethylcellulose.t: 乙基甲基纤维素；纤维素醚

e.en: The tablet coating contains {ethylmethylcellulose} for controlled release.
e.zh: 这种片剂包衣含有乙基甲基纤维素，用于控释。

e.en: Manufacturers use {ethylmethylcellulose} to improve film strength.
e.zh: 生产商用乙基甲基纤维素来提高薄膜强度。

ethylnoradrenaline.t: 乙基去甲肾上腺素；药理化合物

e.en: The paper examined how {ethylnoradrenaline} affected blood pressure.
e.zh: 论文研究了乙基去甲肾上腺素对血压的影响。

e.en: Few modern studies mention {ethylnoradrenaline} by that name.
e.zh: 现代研究很少用这个名称提到乙基去甲肾上腺素。

ethylnorepinephrine.t: 乙基去甲肾上腺素；去甲肾上腺素衍生物

e.en: They tested {ethylnorepinephrine} on isolated heart tissue.
e.zh: 他们在离体心脏组织上测试了乙基去甲肾上腺素。

e.en: The database lists {ethylnorepinephrine} as a norepinephrine analog.
e.zh: 数据库将乙基去甲肾上腺素列为去甲肾上腺素类似物。

ethylpapaverine.t: 乙基罂粟碱；罂粟碱衍生物

e.en: The pharmacist discussed {ethylpapaverine} as an older vasodilator.
e.zh: 药剂师把乙基罂粟碱作为一种较早的血管扩张药来讨论。

e.en: Researchers synthesized {ethylpapaverine} from a papaverine precursor.
e.zh: 研究人员由罂粟碱前体合成了乙基罂粟碱。

e.en: The lotion uses {ethylparaben} to prevent microbial growth.
e.zh: 这款乳液使用羟苯乙酯来防止微生物滋生。

e.en: Some consumers check labels for {ethylparaben} and other preservatives.
e.zh: 有些消费者会查看标签上是否含有羟苯乙酯和其他防腐剂。

ethylphencyclidine.t: 乙基苯环己哌啶；致幻药类似物

e.en: Forensic tests detected {ethylphencyclidine} in the seized powder.
e.zh: 法医检测在查获的粉末中发现了乙基苯环己哌啶。

e.en: The report treats {ethylphencyclidine} as a PCP analog.
e.zh: 报告将乙基苯环己哌啶视为PCP类似物。

e.en: Historically, {ethylstibamine} was used against certain parasitic diseases.
e.zh: 历史上，乙基锑胺曾用于治疗某些寄生虫病。

e.en: The article described the toxicity of {ethylstibamine}.
e.zh: 文章描述了乙基锑胺的毒性。

e.en: The lab stored {ethylthioethane} in a sealed container.
e.zh: 实验室把乙硫醚存放在密封容器中。

e.en: A strong sulfur smell suggested {ethylthioethane} was present.
e.zh: 强烈的硫味表明可能存在乙硫醚。

e.en: The procedure's {ethymylation} step was difficult to reproduce.
e.zh: 该流程中的乙炔基化步骤很难重复。

e.en: Successful {ethymylation} produced the desired intermediate.
e.zh: 乙炔基化成功后生成了所需中间体。

e.en: Welders once commonly used {ethyne} with oxygen.
e.zh: 焊工过去常把乙炔与氧气一起使用。

e.en: In systematic nomenclature, acetylene is called {ethyne}.
e.zh: 在系统命名法中，乙炔被称为ethyne。

e.en: The drug molecule includes an {ethynyl} side group.
e.zh: 这种药物分子含有一个乙炔基侧基。

e.en: Chemists introduced an {ethynyl} substituent to alter reactivity.
e.zh: 化学家引入乙炔基取代基来改变反应活性。

e.en: The synthesis requires {ethynylation} before the final coupling step.
e.zh: 该合成在最终偶联步骤之前需要乙炔基化。

e.en: Catalysts can make {ethynylation} cleaner and more selective.
e.zh: 催化剂能让乙炔基化更干净且选择性更高。

e.en: The polymer backbone contains an {ethynylene} linkage.
e.zh: 这种聚合物主链含有亚乙炔基连接。

e.en: An {ethynylene} spacer can improve electronic communication.
e.zh: 乙炔撑间隔基可以增强电子传递。

e.en: The note used {ethyoxyl} for what is now called ethoxy.
e.zh: 这条注释用ethyoxyl表示现在所说的乙氧基。

e.en: An {ethyoxyl} group appears in the proposed structure.
e.zh: 拟议结构中出现了一个乙氧基基团。

etioallocholane.t: 异别胆烷；甾体母核化合物

e.en: The steroid skeleton was classified as {etioallocholane}.
e.zh: 这种甾体骨架被归类为异别胆烷。

e.en: Several metabolites share the {etioallocholane} framework.
e.zh: 几种代谢物具有相同的异别胆烷骨架。

etiocholanolone.t: 本胆烷醇酮；甾体代谢物

e.en: Urine analysis showed elevated {etiocholanolone} levels.
e.zh: 尿液分析显示本胆烷醇酮水平升高。

e.en: The study measured {etiocholanolone} as an androgen metabolite.
e.zh: 该研究把本胆烷醇酮作为雄激素代谢物进行测量。

e.en: Dark storage can {etiolate} young seedlings within days.
e.zh: 阴暗储存会在几天内使幼苗变得苍白细弱。

e.en: Years of isolation seemed to {etiolate} his confidence.
e.zh: 多年的孤立似乎削弱了他的自信。

e.en: The basement held rows of {etiolated} potato shoots.
e.zh: 地下室里有一排排苍白细弱的土豆芽。

e.en: Her argument felt {etiolated} after so many cautious revisions.
e.zh: 经过太多谨慎修改后，她的论点显得软弱无力。

e.en: Lack of sunlight {etiolates} the plants quickly.
e.zh: 缺少阳光会很快使植物苍白细弱。

e.en: Constant fear {etiolates} public debate.
e.zh: 持续的恐惧会削弱公共讨论。

etiolating.t: 使苍白细弱的；削弱中的

e.en: The {etiolating} seedlings leaned toward the window.
e.zh: 正在变得苍白细弱的幼苗朝窗户倾斜。

e.en: They worried about the {etiolating} effect of censorship.
e.zh: 他们担心审查制度会产生削弱活力的影响。

e.en: The botanist recorded severe {etiolation} in the dark-grown plants.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了暗处生长植物的严重黄化徒长。

e.en: Critics saw cultural {etiolation} in the timid reforms.
e.zh: 批评者认为这些畏缩的改革体现了文化活力的衰弱。

e.en: The {etiologist} traced the outbreak to contaminated water.
e.zh: 这位病因学家把疫情追溯到受污染的水源。

e.en: As an {etiologist}, she studies why disorders begin.
e.zh: 作为成因研究者，她研究疾病为何发生。

e.en: An {etioplast} can develop into a chloroplast after light exposure.
e.zh: 黄化质体受光后可以发育成叶绿体。

e.en: The microscope image showed an {etioplast} inside the seedling cell.
e.zh: 显微镜图像显示幼苗细胞内有一个黄化质体。

e.en: The chemist identified {etioporphyrin} in the petroleum sample.
e.zh: 化学家在石油样品中鉴定出了乙卟啉。

e.en: Researchers used {etioporphyrin} as a model porphyrin compound.
e.zh: 研究人员把乙卟啉用作卟啉类化合物模型。

e.en: Veterinarians used {etorphine} to sedate the rhinoceros.
e.zh: 兽医使用埃托啡麻醉那头犀牛。

e.en: Handling {etorphine} requires extreme caution and strict controls.
e.zh: 处理埃托啡需要极其谨慎并遵守严格管制。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {etrohysterectomy} as a rare option.
e.zh: 外科医生把腹膜外子宫切除术作为一种少见选择来讨论。

e.en: Older textbooks describe {etrohysterectomy} in technical detail.
e.zh: 较早的教材对腹膜外子宫切除术有技术性详述。

etrurian.t: 伊特鲁里亚的；伊特鲁里亚人

e.en: The museum displayed an {Etrurian} bronze mirror.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一面伊特鲁里亚青铜镜。

e.en: An {Etrurian} might have recognized the ancient inscription.
e.zh: 一名伊特鲁里亚人或许能认出那段古代铭文。

e.en: The lab tested {etruscomycin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 实验室用伊特鲁斯科霉素测试了几种细菌菌株。

e.en: Few clinicians encounter {etruscomycin} outside specialist literature.
e.zh: 很少有临床医生会在专业文献之外遇到伊特鲁斯科霉素。

e.en: She kept tiny scissors in a silver {etui}.
e.zh: 她把小剪刀放在一个银质小针线盒里。

e.en: The antique {etui} held needles, thread, and a thimble.
e.zh: 那个古董小盒里装着针、线和顶针。

e.en: The collector bought an ivory {etwee} at auction.
e.zh: 收藏家在拍卖会上买了一个象牙随身小盒。

e.en: Her grandmother's {etwee} still contained old sewing tools.
e.zh: 她祖母的小针线盒里还留着旧缝纫工具。

e.en: The dictionary lists several Greek {etyma} for the term.
e.zh: 词典列出了这个术语的几个希腊词源。

e.en: Students compared the {etyma} behind related English words.
e.zh: 学生们比较了相关英语词背后的词根原形。

e.en: The article offered an {etymologic} note on the word.
e.zh: 文章对这个词作了一条词源说明。

e.en: Her {etymologic} analysis linked the names to Old Norse.
e.zh: 她的词源学分析把这些名称同古诺斯语联系起来。

e.en: He consulted an old {etymologicon} for the obscure term.
e.zh: 他查阅了一本旧词源词典来了解这个生僻词。

e.en: The monastery library preserved a medieval {etymologicon}.
e.zh: 修道院图书馆保存着一部中世纪词源汇编。

e.en: British scholars often {etymologise} place names from old records.
e.zh: 英国学者常根据旧档案探究地名词源。

e.en: It is risky to {etymologise} from sound alone.
e.zh: 只凭读音来解释词源是有风险的。

e.en: The {etymologist} traced the word back to Latin.
e.zh: 词源学家把这个词追溯到拉丁语。

e.en: An {etymologist} can explain why spellings preserve older sounds.
e.zh: 词源学家能解释为什么拼写会保留较早的发音痕迹。

e.en: Linguists may {etymologize} a surname using historical documents.
e.zh: 语言学家可能会用历史文献解释一个姓氏的词源。

e.en: Writers sometimes {etymologize} playfully without real evidence.
e.zh: 作家有时会缺乏实证地玩笑式解释词源。

e.en: The term was {etymologized} as coming from a medieval verb.
e.zh: 这个术语被解释为源自一个中世纪动词。

e.en: Several folk sayings have been wrongly {etymologized}.
e.zh: 几条民间说法的词源曾被错误解释。

e.en: The professor {etymologizes} technical terms during lectures.
e.zh: 教授在讲课时会解释技术术语的词源。

e.en: He {etymologizes} jokes to show how meanings shift.
e.zh: 他通过解释笑话的词源来展示意义如何变化。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {etymologizing} old place names.
e.zh: 她花了一下午探究古老地名的词源。

e.en: The professor was {etymologizing} rather than defining the term.
e.zh: 教授是在作词源解释，而不是给这个词下定义。

e.en: The Greek {etymon} explains the modern spelling.
e.zh: 这个希腊语源词解释了现代拼写。

e.en: Linguists still debate the exact {etymon} of the word.
e.zh: 语言学家仍在争论这个词的确切词源。

e.en: The dictionary lists several possible {etymons} for the term.
e.zh: 词典列出了这个术语的几个可能语源词。

e.en: Related {etymons} can reveal how meanings changed.
e.zh: 相关词源能显示词义是怎样变化的。

e.en: The specimen showed an {etypic} pattern under the microscope.
e.zh: 这个标本在显微镜下呈现出非典型模式。

e.en: His response was {etypic} for someone so cautious.
e.zh: 对这么谨慎的人来说，他的反应并不典型。

e.en: The doctor noted an {etypical} reaction to the drug.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人对药物有异常反应。

e.en: Her {etypical} style made the essay stand out.
e.zh: 她非典型的风格让这篇文章显得突出。

e.en: The solution contained {etythrodextrin} after partial starch digestion.
e.zh: 淀粉部分分解后，溶液中含有赤糊精。

e.en: The chemist tested {etythrodextrin} with an iodine reagent.
e.zh: 化学家用碘试剂检测赤糊精。

e.en: The fern reproduces by {euapogamy} in certain conditions.
e.zh: 这种蕨类在特定条件下通过真无配子生殖繁殖。

e.en: Botanists distinguished {euapogamy} from other asexual processes.
e.zh: 植物学家把真无配子生殖同其他无性过程区分开来。

e.en: An {eubacterium} lacks the complex nucleus found in human cells.
e.zh: 真细菌没有人体细胞中那种复杂的细胞核。

e.en: The sample contained one dominant {eubacterium} species.
e.zh: 样本中有一种占优势的真细菌。

eubiotics.t: 益生调理；肠道菌群保健

e.en: The farm uses {eubiotics} to support animal gut health.
e.zh: 这家农场使用益生调理来支持动物肠道健康。

e.en: Researchers compared {eubiotics} with routine antibiotic treatment.
e.zh: 研究人员把益生调理与常规抗生素治疗作了比较。

e.en: The surgeon once used {eucaine} as a local anesthetic.
e.zh: 外科医生曾把优卡因用作局部麻醉剂。

e.en: Older manuals mention {eucaine} alongside cocaine substitutes.
e.zh: 旧手册把优卡因和可卡因替代品一起提到。

e.en: The mineral cabinet included a small piece of {eucairite}.
e.zh: 矿物柜里有一小块硒铜银矿。

e.en: Geologists identified {eucairite} in the silver-rich vein.
e.zh: 地质学家在富银矿脉中鉴定出硒铜银矿。

e.en: A tall {eucalypt} shaded the dry creek bed.
e.zh: 一棵高大的桉树遮住了干涸的小溪床。

e.en: The koala climbed slowly through the {eucalypt} branches.
e.zh: 考拉在桉树枝间慢慢攀爬。

e.en: The cough drops smelled strongly of {eucalyptol}.
e.zh: 这些止咳糖有很浓的桉叶油醇气味。

e.en: Scientists measured {eucalyptol} in the essential oil sample.
e.zh: 科学家测量了精油样本中的桉叶油醇含量。

e.en: The leaf has {eucamptodromous} veins that curve toward the margin.
e.zh: 这片叶子有向边缘弯曲的弧曲近缘叶脉。

e.en: Botanists described the species as {eucamptodromous} in the key.
e.zh: 植物学家在检索表中把该物种描述为叶脉弧曲近缘。

e.en: The oil sample contained traces of {eucarvone}.
e.zh: 这份油样中含有微量桉香芹酮。

e.en: Chemists studied {eucarvone} as a fragrant terpene ketone.
e.zh: 化学家把桉香芹酮作为一种芳香萜类酮来研究。

e.en: A yeast cell is a simple {eucaryote}.
e.zh: 酵母细胞是一种简单的真核生物。

e.en: Every {eucaryote} has cells with a membrane-bound nucleus.
e.zh: 每种真核生物的细胞都有膜包裹的细胞核。

e.en: The ophthalmologist used {eucatropine} to dilate the pupil.
e.zh: 眼科医生用优卡托品来散大瞳孔。

e.en: Older eye drops sometimes contained {eucatropine}.
e.zh: 较早的滴眼液有时含有优卡托品。

eucharis.t: 亚马逊百合；玉簪花属植物

e.en: The greenhouse kept a flowering {eucharis} near the door.
e.zh: 温室门边放着一株开花的亚马逊百合。

e.en: She chose {eucharis} bulbs for their white, graceful flowers.
e.zh: 她选择亚马逊百合球茎，是因为它们开白色而优雅的花。

e.en: The chapel used special {eucharistical} vessels during the service.
e.zh: 小教堂在礼拜中使用了专门的圣餐器皿。

e.en: His essay examined {eucharistical} language in medieval hymns.
e.zh: 他的论文研究了中世纪圣歌中的圣餐语言。

e.en: The test showed {euchlorhydria} rather than excess stomach acid.
e.zh: 检测显示是胃酸正常状态，而不是胃酸过多。

e.en: Doctors recorded {euchlorhydria} after the treatment ended.
e.zh: 治疗结束后，医生记录到患者胃酸正常。

euchloric.t: 含氯正常的；氯化良好的

e.en: The patient remained {euchloric} despite prolonged vomiting.
e.zh: 尽管长期呕吐，患者的氯含量仍保持正常。

e.en: The report described the fluid as {euchloric} and clear.
e.zh: 报告把这种液体描述为含氯正常且清澈。

e.en: The chemist prepared {euchlorine} under controlled conditions.
e.zh: 化学家在受控条件下制备了二氧化氯。

e.en: Old textbooks describe {euchlorine} as a yellow-green gas.
e.zh: 旧教材把二氧化氯描述为一种黄绿色气体。

e.en: Active genes are often found in {euchromatin}.
e.zh: 活跃基因常见于常染色质区域。

e.en: The stain made {euchromatin} appear lighter than heterochromatin.
e.zh: 染色后，常染色质显得比异染色质更浅。

euchromosome.t: 常染色质染色体区段；真染色体

e.en: The stained sample showed a pale {euchromosome} region.
e.zh: 染色后的样本显示出一片颜色较浅的常染色质区段。

e.en: Researchers compared the {euchromosome} with denser chromosomal material.
e.zh: 研究人员把真染色体区段与更致密的染色体物质作了比较。

euciliate.t: 具正常纤毛的；真纤毛类的

e.en: The microscope revealed a {euciliate} organism moving quickly.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见一个具正常纤毛的生物快速移动。

e.en: A {euciliate} cell can use tiny hairs for feeding.
e.zh: 真纤毛类细胞能用细小纤毛摄食。

euclase.t: 蓝柱石；易解理宝石矿物

e.en: The collector bought a small blue {euclase}.
e.zh: 收藏者买了一小块蓝色蓝柱石。

e.en: Because {euclase} cleaves easily, cutters handle it carefully.
e.zh: 由于蓝柱石容易解理，切割师会格外小心处理。

eucol.t: 眼药水基质；眼用胶体制剂

e.en: The pharmacist prepared {eucol} for the eye drops.
e.zh: 药剂师为这款眼药水配制了眼用胶体基质。

e.en: Older manuals mention {eucol} as an ophthalmic preparation.
e.zh: 旧手册把眼用胶体制剂列为一种眼科制剂。

e.en: The solution behaved like a stable {eucolloid}.
e.zh: 这种溶液表现得像稳定的真胶体。

e.en: A {eucolloid} remains dispersed instead of settling quickly.
e.zh: 真胶体会保持分散状态，而不是很快沉淀。

eucone.t: 具真晶锥的昆虫复眼结构

e.en: The beetle has a {eucone} type of compound eye.
e.zh: 这种甲虫具有真晶锥型复眼。

e.en: In a {eucone} eye, the crystalline cone is well developed.
e.zh: 在真晶锥复眼中，晶锥发育得很完整。

eucritic.t: 判断力健全的；善于辨析的

e.en: A {eucritic} reader notices the argument's weak point.
e.zh: 善于辨析的读者会注意到论证中的薄弱处。

e.en: The editor took a calm, {eucritic} view of the manuscript.
e.zh: 编辑以冷静而判断力健全的眼光审视了稿件。

euctratite.t: 优晶质岩；结晶良好的火成岩

e.en: The field note described the sample as {euctratite}.
e.zh: 野外记录把这个样本描述为结晶良好的火成岩。

e.en: Under the lens, {euctratite} showed clear mineral grains.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，优晶质岩显出清晰的矿物颗粒。

eucyclic.t: 轮列完整的；规则循环的

e.en: The botanist called the flower {eucyclic} in structure.
e.zh: 植物学家称这朵花的结构为轮列完整。

e.en: A {eucyclic} process returns neatly to its starting point.
e.zh: 规则循环的过程会整齐地回到起点。

eudaemon.t: 善灵；带来幸福的守护神

e.en: Ancient writers imagined a {eudaemon} guiding a good life.
e.zh: 古代作家想象有善灵引导人过上美好生活。

e.en: She used {eudaemon} as a metaphor for inner wisdom.
e.zh: 她用善灵来比喻内在的智慧。

eudaemonia.t: 幸福圆满；人性繁荣状态

e.en: Aristotle linked {eudaemonia} with virtuous activity.
e.zh: 亚里士多德把幸福圆满与有德性的行动联系起来。

e.en: For her, {eudaemonia} meant more than pleasure.
e.zh: 在她看来，幸福圆满不只是快乐。

e.en: The essay presents a {eudaemonic} theory of ethics.
e.zh: 这篇文章提出了一种幸福论伦理学。

e.en: He sought a {eudaemonic} balance between duty and joy.
e.zh: 他追求责任与喜悦之间能带来幸福的平衡。

e.en: The seminar introduced {eudaemonics} to philosophy students.
e.zh: 研讨课向哲学学生介绍了幸福学。

e.en: Classical {eudaemonics} asks what makes a life flourish.
e.zh: 古典幸福论伦理学追问什么使人生兴盛圆满。

eudaemonism.t: 幸福主义；以幸福为善的伦理观

e.en: His ethics leaned toward {eudaemonism} rather than strict duty.
e.zh: 他的伦理观偏向幸福主义，而不是严格的义务论。

e.en: Critics say {eudaemonism} can sound too self-regarding.
e.zh: 批评者说，幸福主义有时听起来过于关注自我。

eudaemonist.t: 幸福主义者；幸福论伦理学家

e.en: A {eudaemonist} sees happiness as central to ethics.
e.zh: 幸福主义者认为幸福是伦理学的核心。

e.en: The {eudaemonist} defended Aristotle against modern critics.
e.zh: 这位幸福论伦理学家为亚里士多德回应了现代批评者。

e.en: The book gives a {eudaemonistic} account of moral choice.
e.zh: 这本书从幸福主义角度解释道德选择。

e.en: Her {eudaemonistic} view treats flourishing as the highest good.
e.zh: 她的幸福论观点把人性繁荣视为最高的善。

e.en: The lecture used the older term {eudaemonistical} repeatedly.
e.zh: 讲座反复使用了“幸福主义的”这个较旧术语。

e.en: His {eudaemonistical} language sounded archaic but precise.
e.zh: 他的幸福论用语听起来古雅，却很精确。

eudaimonia.t: 幸福圆满；德性成就的人生

e.en: In Greek ethics, {eudaimonia} is not mere pleasure.
e.zh: 在希腊伦理学中，幸福圆满并不只是愉悦。

e.en: The course asks whether {eudaimonia} requires virtue.
e.zh: 这门课探讨幸福圆满是否需要德性。

eudaimonism.t: 幸福主义；亚里士多德式幸福论

e.en: The paper contrasts {eudaimonism} with utilitarianism.
e.zh: 论文将幸福主义与功利主义作了对比。

e.en: Modern virtue ethics often revives {eudaimonism}.
e.zh: 现代德性伦理学常常重新启用亚里士多德式幸福论。

eudalene.t: 桉萘；一种芳香烃化合物

e.en: The chemist identified {eudalene} in the reaction mixture.
e.zh: 化学家在反应混合物中鉴定出桉萘。

e.en: Old terpene studies sometimes mention {eudalene}.
e.zh: 早期萜烯研究有时会提到桉萘这种化合物。

e.en: The poet invoked a {eudemon} before beginning the hymn.
e.zh: 诗人在开始颂歌前呼唤了一位善灵。

e.en: He treated conscience as a private {eudemon}.
e.zh: 他把良知看作个人内心的守护幸福之灵。

eudemonia.t: 幸福圆满；美好生活状态

e.en: The philosopher defined {eudemonia} as rational flourishing.
e.zh: 哲学家把幸福圆满定义为理性的兴盛。

e.en: They discussed whether wealth can produce {eudemonia}.
e.zh: 他们讨论财富是否能带来美好生活状态。

e.en: The article takes a {eudemonic} approach to well-being.
e.zh: 这篇文章以幸福论方式讨论福祉。

e.en: A {eudemonic} goal is deeper than momentary pleasure.
e.zh: 使人幸福的目标比一时快乐更深层。

e.en: His class on {eudemonics} began with Aristotle.
e.zh: 他的幸福学课程从亚里士多德讲起。

e.en: Applied {eudemonics} studies what helps communities flourish.
e.zh: 应用幸福论伦理学研究什么能帮助社群繁荣。

eudemonism.t: 幸福主义；幸福论伦理观

e.en: She rejected crude hedonism but accepted {eudemonism}.
e.zh: 她拒绝粗浅的享乐主义，却接受幸福主义。

e.en: Classical {eudemonism} makes flourishing the aim of ethics.
e.zh: 古典幸福论伦理观把人生兴盛作为伦理目标。

e.en: The {eudemonist} argued that virtue should lead to happiness.
e.zh: 这位幸福论者认为，美德应当带来幸福。

e.en: As a {eudemonist}, she judged policies by human flourishing.
e.zh: 作为幸福论者，她用人的幸福繁荣来评判政策。

eudemonistic.t: 幸福论的；以幸福为目标的

e.en: His ethics took a strongly {eudemonistic} view of virtue.
e.zh: 他的伦理学对美德持强烈的幸福论观点。

e.en: The program had a {eudemonistic} aim: better lives for all.
e.zh: 这个项目有一种以幸福为目标的宗旨：让所有人生活得更好。

e.en: The chemist detected {eudesmene} in the essential oil sample.
e.zh: 化学家在精油样本中检测到了桉叶烯类化合物。

e.en: This plant extract contains traces of {eudesmene}.
e.zh: 这种植物提取物含有微量桉叶烯类化合物。

e.en: The students measured the gas with a {eudiometer}.
e.zh: 学生们用量气管测量了这种气体。

e.en: An old {eudiometer} stood on the laboratory shelf.
e.zh: 实验室架子上放着一支旧量气管。

e.en: The report included a {eudiometric} analysis of the mixture.
e.zh: 报告包含了对该混合气体的量气法分析。

e.en: They repeated the {eudiometric} test after cleaning the apparatus.
e.zh: 清洁仪器后，他们重复了这项气体分析测试。

e.en: The paper described a {eudiometrical} method for testing air quality.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种检测空气质量的量气法。

e.en: Her {eudiometrical} observations were unusually precise for that period.
e.zh: 她的气体测定观察在那个时期异常精确。

eudiometrically.t: 用量气法；按气体分析法

e.en: The sample was examined {eudiometrically} before the reaction.
e.zh: 反应前，样本已用量气法检查过。

e.en: They compared the gases {eudiometrically} in a sealed tube.
e.zh: 他们在密封管中按气体分析法比较这些气体。

e.en: Early chemists used {eudiometry} to study the composition of air.
e.zh: 早期化学家用量气法研究空气成分。

e.en: The course introduced {eudiometry} as a historical laboratory technique.
e.zh: 这门课把量气法作为一种历史实验技术来介绍。

e.en: The fossil showed a {eudipleural} arrangement of its paired parts.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出成对部位的两侧对称排列。

e.en: A {eudipleural} body plan is common in many animals.
e.zh: 两侧对称的身体结构在许多动物中很常见。

e.en: The old formulary listed {eudoxin} among digestive medicines.
e.zh: 旧药典把优多辛列在消化类药物中。

e.en: Few modern doctors would recognize the name {eudoxin}.
e.zh: 如今很少有医生会认得优多辛这个名称。

e.en: The dermatologist mentioned {eugallol} in a discussion of older treatments.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生在谈到旧疗法时提到了焦没食子酸单乙酸酯。

e.en: Historical texts describe {eugallol} as a medicinal compound.
e.zh: 历史文献把焦没食子酸单乙酸酯描述为一种药用化合物。

e.en: The essay used {eugenesis} to mean healthy development.
e.zh: 这篇文章用优生来表示健康的发展。

e.en: In older biology, {eugenesis} was contrasted with degeneration.
e.zh: 在较早的生物学中，优生与退化相对。

e.en: The lecture criticized the history of {eugenetics}.
e.zh: 讲座批判了优生学的历史。

e.en: Ideas from {eugenetics} influenced some harmful public policies.
e.zh: 优生学思想影响过一些有害的公共政策。

eugenically.t: 按优生学地；从优生角度

e.en: The policy was defended {eugenically} by its supporters.
e.zh: 支持者从优生学角度为这项政策辩护。

e.en: Such claims were often framed {eugenically} in the early twentieth century.
e.zh: 这类说法在二十世纪初常被包装成优生学论述。

e.en: Researchers isolated {eugenin} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物提取物中分离出丁香素。

e.en: The sample contained {eugenin} and several related compounds.
e.zh: 样本中含有丁香素和几种相关化合物。

e.en: The {eugenist} promoted ideas now considered unethical.
e.zh: 这位优生学者宣扬的观念如今被认为不道德。

e.en: A modern historian studied the writings of one prominent {eugenist}.
e.zh: 一位现代历史学家研究了一名著名优生论者的著作。

e.en: Clove oil contains {eugenol}, which gives it a sharp aroma.
e.zh: 丁香油含有丁香酚，因此带有浓烈香气。

e.en: The dentist used a preparation containing {eugenol}.
e.zh: 牙医使用了一种含丁香酚的制剂。

e.en: The map marked an ancient {eugeosynclinal} belt near the coast.
e.zh: 地图标出了海岸附近一条古老的优地槽带。

e.en: Geologists debated the {eugeosynclinal} origin of the rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家争论这些岩石是否源自优地槽环境。

e.en: The mountain range formed along a former {eugeosyncline}.
e.zh: 这条山脉形成于一个旧优地槽沿线。

e.en: Textbooks once used {eugeosyncline} to explain thick marine sediments.
e.zh: 教科书曾用优地槽来解释厚层海相沉积物。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {euglena} moved toward the light.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，眼虫朝着光移动。

e.en: A {euglena} has features associated with both plants and animals.
e.zh: 眼虫具有一些与植物和动物相关的特征。

e.en: The pond sample contained more than one {euglenid}.
e.zh: 池塘样本中含有不止一种眼虫类生物。

e.en: A {euglenid} can swim using a whip-like flagellum.
e.zh: 眼虫类生物能用鞭状鞭毛游动。

e.en: The biologist identified several {euglenoid} cells in the water.
e.zh: 生物学家在水中识别出几个眼虫类细胞。

e.en: Its {euglenoid} movement made the organism easy to recognize.
e.zh: 它眼虫状的运动方式使这种生物容易辨认。

e.en: The lab separated {euglobulin} from the serum sample.
e.zh: 实验室从血清样本中分离出真球蛋白。

e.en: Doctors once used the {euglobulin} test to study clot breakdown.
e.zh: 医生过去用真球蛋白试验研究血栓分解。

e.en: The patient showed {eugnosia} despite mild speech problems.
e.zh: 尽管有轻微语言问题，患者仍表现出正常认知能力。

e.en: Neurologists contrasted {eugnosia} with agnosia in the report.
e.zh: 神经科医生在报告中把正常认知能力与失认症作了对比。

e.en: The culture became {eugonic} after the temperature was adjusted.
e.zh: 温度调整后，培养物变得生长良好。

e.en: Researchers selected only {eugonic} colonies for the next test.
e.zh: 研究人员只选择生长良好的菌落进行下一项测试。

e.en: The diagram labels the {eugonidium} near the edge of the colony.
e.zh: 图中把群体边缘附近的真生殖细胞标了出来。

e.en: A mature {eugonidium} can develop into a new colony.
e.zh: 成熟的真生殖细胞可以发育成新的群体。

e.en: The plant line was confirmed as {euhaploid} after chromosome counting.
e.zh: 染色体计数后，这个植物品系被确认是真单倍体。

e.en: A {euhaploid} organism carries one complete set of chromosomes.
e.zh: 真单倍体生物携带一套完整的染色体。

e.en: The thin section contained several {euhedral} quartz crystals.
e.zh: 这张薄片中有几颗自形晶石英。

e.en: Geologists noted the {euhedral} shape as evidence of slow growth.
e.zh: 地质学家把自形晶形态视为缓慢生长的证据。

e.en: The lecture introduced {euhemerism} as a way to read myths.
e.zh: 讲座介绍了把神话作历史化解释的欧赫迈罗斯主义。

e.en: Through {euhemerism}, a god may be interpreted as a remembered king.
e.zh: 按照神话历史化解释，神明可能被理解为被后人记住的国王。

e.en: A strict {euhemerist} treats many legends as distorted history.
e.zh: 严格的神话历史化解释者把许多传说看作被扭曲的历史。

e.en: The {euhemerist} argued that the hero had once been a real ruler.
e.zh: 这位神话历史化解释者认为那位英雄曾是真实的统治者。

e.en: Her essay offered a {euhemeristic} reading of the old myth.
e.zh: 她的文章对这个古老神话作了历史化解释。

e.en: The scholar rejected the {euhemeristic} account as too literal.
e.zh: 这位学者认为这种神话历史化解释过于直白，因而予以反驳。

e.en: Some writers {euhemerize} ancient gods into early tribal chiefs.
e.zh: 一些作者把古代神明历史化解释为早期部落首领。

e.en: It is tempting to {euhemerize} every legend, but evidence is scarce.
e.zh: 人们很容易想把每个传说都历史化解释，但证据很少。

e.en: The species is a {euhermaphrodite} with functional male and female organs.
e.zh: 该物种是真雌雄同体生物，具有功能完整的雌雄器官。

e.en: A {euhermaphrodite} differs from an organism with only rudimentary organs.
e.zh: 真雌雄同体生物不同于只具退化器官的生物。

e.en: The fossil was described as an early {euhominid} specimen.
e.zh: 这块化石被描述为早期真猿人类标本。

e.en: Researchers debated whether the jaw belonged to a {euhominid}.
e.zh: 研究人员争论这块颌骨是否属于真猿人类成员。

e.en: The survey recorded {euhyponeuston} living just below the surface film.
e.zh: 调查记录了生活在水面膜正下方的真水面下生物群。

e.en: Oil pollution can damage the {euhyponeuston} in coastal waters.
e.zh: 石油污染会损害沿海水域的真水面下生物群。

e.en: The {eulachon} was once an important food fish on the coast.
e.zh: 太平洋细齿鲑曾是沿海地区重要的食用鱼。

e.en: People rendered {eulachon} into a rich oil for trade.
e.zh: 人们把太平洋细齿鲑熬成浓油用于交易。

e.en: The shell was classified as a {eulamellibranch} by the museum curator.
e.zh: 博物馆馆长把这枚贝壳归为真瓣鳃类软体动物。

e.en: A {eulamellibranch} has gills arranged in characteristic lamellae.
e.zh: 真瓣鳃类软体动物的鳃呈典型的瓣状排列。

e.en: The graph has an {Eulerian} path through every edge.
e.zh: 这个图有一条经过每条边的欧拉路径。

e.en: Engineers used an {Eulerian} model to describe the fluid flow.
e.zh: 工程师使用欧拉式模型来描述流体流动。

e.en: The priest offered a brief {eulogia} before the meal.
e.zh: 牧师在饭前作了简短的祝福。

e.en: In the old rite, the {eulogia} was shared among the faithful.
e.zh: 在旧礼仪中，圣饼会分给信众。

e.en: The family asked an old friend to be the {eulogist}.
e.zh: 家人请一位老朋友担任致悼词者。

e.en: As a political {eulogist}, he ignored the leader's failures.
e.zh: 作为政治颂扬者，他忽视了那位领导人的失败。

e.en: The review was so {eulogistical} that it sounded dishonest.
e.zh: 这篇评论过于颂扬，听起来不太真诚。

e.en: His {eulogistical} speech praised every minor achievement.
e.zh: 他的颂扬性演讲赞美了每一项小成就。

e.en: She spoke {eulogistically} about her mentor's generosity.
e.zh: 她以颂扬的方式谈到导师的慷慨。

e.en: The article treated the founder {eulogistically}, avoiding criticism.
e.zh: 文章以颂扬方式描写创始人，避开了批评。

e.en: The professor delivered a moving {eulogium} for his colleague.
e.zh: 教授为同事发表了一篇动人的悼词。

e.en: The book opens with a long {eulogium} to rural life.
e.zh: 这本书开篇是一段对乡村生活的长篇颂词。

e.en: The old volume collected {eulogiums} for the fallen general.
e.zh: 那本旧书收录了献给阵亡将军的颂词。

e.en: His speech was full of formal {eulogiums} and little substance.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是正式的赞美之辞，却没有多少实质内容。

e.en: The collector labeled the pale crystal as {eulytine}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这块浅色晶体标为铋氯矿。

e.en: Under the lens, the {eulytine} showed a glassy surface.
e.zh: 在放大镜下，这块铋氯矿呈现出玻璃般的表面。

e.en: The slide showed {eumitosis} in several healthy cells.
e.zh: 载玻片显示几个健康细胞正在进行正常有丝分裂。

e.en: The researcher compared abnormal division with {eumitosis}.
e.zh: 研究人员把异常分裂与正常有丝分裂作了比较。

eumorphic.t: 形态良好的；具正常形态的

e.en: The specimen was described as {eumorphic} despite its age.
e.zh: 尽管年代久远，这个标本仍被描述为形态良好。

e.en: Only {eumorphic} cells were counted in the final sample.
e.zh: 最终样本中只统计了形态正常的细胞。

e.en: A {eumycete} can reproduce by producing microscopic spores.
e.zh: 真菌可以通过产生微小孢子来繁殖。

e.en: The infection was traced to a soil-dwelling {eumycete}.
e.zh: 这次感染被追溯到一种生活在土壤中的真菌。

e.en: The lab tested {eumycetin} against several fungal cultures.
e.zh: 实验室用真菌素测试了几种真菌培养物。

e.en: Old pharmacology notes mention {eumycetin} as an antifungal agent.
e.zh: 旧药理笔记把真菌素列为一种抗真菌药物。

e.en: The doctor considered {eumycin} for a stubborn fungal infection.
e.zh: 医生考虑用真菌素治疗顽固的真菌感染。

e.en: The paper described {eumycin} as a compound active against molds.
e.zh: 论文把真菌素描述为一种对霉菌有效的化合物。

eunomic.t: 法治良好的；秩序井然的

e.en: The philosopher imagined a {eunomic} state governed by fair laws.
e.zh: 哲学家设想了一个由公正法律治理的良好法治国家。

e.en: Their reforms aimed to create a more {eunomic} society.
e.zh: 他们的改革旨在建立一个更有秩序、法治更完善的社会。

e.en: Ancient writers praised {eunomy} as the basis of civic peace.
e.zh: 古代作家称赞良好法治是城市和平的基础。

e.en: The treaty promised {eunomy} after years of corrupt rule.
e.zh: 条约承诺在多年腐败统治后恢复良好秩序。

e.en: The historian discussed {eunuchism} in several imperial courts.
e.zh: 历史学家讨论了几个帝国宫廷中的阉人制度。

e.en: Medical texts once used {eunuchism} to describe effects of castration.
e.zh: 医学文献曾用阉人状态来描述阉割后的影响。

e.en: The brutal regime tried to {eunuchize} some captured servants.
e.zh: 这个残暴政权曾试图阉割一些被俘的仆役。

e.en: Critics said the policy would {eunuchize} the independent courts.
e.zh: 批评者说这项政策会削弱独立法院，使其失去作用。

eunuchoid.t: 类阉人的；性腺功能低下样的

e.en: The patient showed a tall, {eunuchoid} body habitus.
e.zh: 这名患者表现出高瘦的类阉人体型。

e.en: Older doctors used {eunuchoid} to describe certain hormonal features.
e.zh: 旧时医生用类阉人的一词描述某些激素特征。

eunuchoidism.t: 类阉人症；性腺发育不全状态

e.en: The syndrome was once classified as {eunuchoidism}.
e.zh: 这种综合征曾被归类为类阉人症。

e.en: Delayed puberty may produce features resembling {eunuchoidism}.
e.zh: 青春期延迟可能产生类似类阉人症的特征。

euonymin.t: 卫矛苦苷；卫矛树脂成分

e.en: The pharmacist extracted {euonymin} from the shrub's bark.
e.zh: 药剂师从这种灌木的树皮中提取了卫矛苦苷。

e.en: Nineteenth-century remedies sometimes included {euonymin}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的药方有时会包含卫矛苦苷。

e.en: The chemist identified {eupachloroxin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家在植物提取物中鉴定出泽兰氯毒素。

e.en: High doses of {eupachloroxin} damaged the test animals' livers.
e.zh: 高剂量泽兰氯毒素损害了实验动物的肝脏。

eupatorium.t: 泽兰属植物；佩兰类草本

e.en: The herbalist dried {eupatorium} for a bitter tea.
e.zh: 草药师把泽兰属植物晒干，用来泡一杯苦茶。

e.en: Butterflies gathered around the blooming {eupatorium} near the path.
e.zh: 蝴蝶聚集在小路旁盛开的泽兰属植物周围。

e.en: Researchers measured {eupatoroxin} levels in the contaminated hay.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了受污染干草中的泽兰毒素含量。

e.en: The report linked cattle illness to {eupatoroxin} from local weeds.
e.zh: 报告把牛的疾病与当地杂草中的泽兰毒素联系起来。

e.en: An {eupatrid} could claim influence in early Athenian politics.
e.zh: 雅典贵族可以在早期雅典政治中主张影响力。

e.en: The novel uses {eupatrid} ironically for a snobbish aristocrat.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺地用雅典贵族一词称呼一个势利的贵族。

euphonize.t: 使声音悦耳和谐；改音求谐音；改得悦耳

e.en: The editor tried to {euphonize} the awkward line.
e.zh: 编辑试图把那句拗口的话改得更悦耳。

e.en: Poets sometimes {euphonize} words for smoother rhythm.
e.zh: 诗人有时会改动词语，使节奏更顺畅悦耳。

euphorbiaceous.t: 大戟科的；似大戟科植物的

e.en: The botanist identified a {euphorbiaceous} shrub near the trail.
e.zh: 植物学家在小径旁认出一株大戟科灌木。

e.en: Its milky sap suggested a {euphorbiaceous} plant.
e.zh: 它的乳白色汁液表明这可能是大戟科植物。

euphoriant.t: 引起欣快感的物质；致欣快的

e.en: The drug had a mild {euphoriant} effect.
e.zh: 这种药物有轻微的致欣快作用。

e.en: Doctors warned that the {euphoriant} could be addictive.
e.zh: 医生警告说，这种引起欣快感的物质可能会成瘾。

e.en: A strange {euphory} followed the dangerous climb.
e.zh: 那次危险攀登之后，他感到一种奇异的欣快。

e.en: The speech filled the crowd with brief {euphory}.
e.zh: 这场演讲让人群短暂地充满兴奋愉悦。

e.en: Coral reefs thrive in the {euphotic} zone.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁在海洋透光层中繁盛生长。

e.en: Only {euphotic} waters receive enough light for photosynthesis.
e.zh: 只有透光水域才有足够光照进行光合作用。

e.en: The herbalist dried {euphrasy} for a traditional eye wash.
e.zh: 草药师把小米草晒干，用来制作传统洗眼液。

e.en: Old remedies often praised {euphrasy} for sore eyes.
e.zh: 旧时疗法常称赞小米草能缓解眼睛酸痛。

euphroe.t: 帆船索具上的分索木块

e.en: The sailor replaced the cracked {euphroe} before departure.
e.zh: 水手在出航前更换了裂开的分索木块。

e.en: A {euphroe} helps spread several lines evenly.
e.zh: 分索木块有助于把几根绳索均匀分开。

euphuism.t: 绮丽矫饰文风；尤菲绣斯体

e.en: The novel mocks the courtier's elaborate {euphuism}.
e.zh: 这部小说嘲讽了那位朝臣华丽矫饰的文风。

e.en: Her speech slipped into {euphuism} and ornate comparisons.
e.zh: 她的演说变成了绮丽矫饰的语句和繁复比喻。

euphuist.t: 绮丽矫饰文风作家；尤菲绣斯体作者

e.en: The young {euphuist} loved balanced phrases and clever antithesis.
e.zh: 这位年轻的绮丽派作家喜欢工整短语和巧妙对偶。

e.en: Critics called him a {euphuist} rather than a plain speaker.
e.zh: 评论家称他是矫饰文风作家，而不是直白的演说者。

euphuistic.t: 绮丽矫饰的；尤菲绣斯体的

e.en: The letter was written in a highly {euphuistic} style.
e.zh: 这封信采用了非常绮丽矫饰的文体。

e.en: His {euphuistic} compliments sounded more clever than sincere.
e.zh: 他那些矫饰华丽的恭维听起来机巧多于真诚。

euphuistical.t: 绮丽矫饰的；辞藻华丽做作的

e.en: The professor criticized the essay's {euphuistical} language.
e.zh: 教授批评这篇文章语言华丽做作。

e.en: A {euphuistical} flourish ended the otherwise simple speech.
e.zh: 一段绮丽矫饰的收束破坏了原本朴素的演讲。

euphuistically.t: 以绮丽矫饰文风；辞藻华丽地

e.en: He wrote {euphuistically} when addressing the royal court.
e.zh: 他给宫廷写信时辞藻华丽而矫饰。

e.en: The narrator {euphuistically} compares every smile to a sunrise.
e.zh: 叙述者矫饰地把每个微笑都比作日出。

e.en: The physician recommended a light, {eupiptic} meal.
e.zh: 医生建议吃一顿清淡、易消化的饭。

e.en: Old medical texts described the tonic as {eupiptic}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把这种补剂描述为助消化的。

euplanktophytes.t: 真浮游植物；典型浮游植物类群

e.en: The lake sample contained many {euplanktophytes}.
e.zh: 湖水样本中含有许多真浮游植物。

e.en: Researchers counted {euplanktophytes} to assess water quality.
e.zh: 研究人员统计真浮游植物来评估水质。

euplastic.t: 易成形的；组织形成良好的

e.en: The surgeon noted healthy, {euplastic} tissue around the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到伤口周围有健康、成形良好的组织。

e.en: Clay with a {euplastic} texture was easier to mold.
e.zh: 质地易成形的黏土更容易塑造。

euploid.t: 整倍体的；染色体组完整的

e.en: The lab selected a {euploid} embryo for transfer.
e.zh: 实验室选择了一个整倍体胚胎进行移植。

e.en: A {euploid} cell has complete sets of chromosomes.
e.zh: 整倍体细胞具有完整的染色体组。

euploidy.t: 整倍性；染色体组完整状态

e.en: The test checked the embryo for {euploidy}.
e.zh: 这项检测检查胚胎是否具有整倍性。

e.en: Plant breeders sometimes rely on {euploidy} for stable traits.
e.zh: 植物育种者有时依靠整倍性来获得稳定性状。

e.en: After treatment, the patient returned to {eupnea}.
e.zh: 治疗后，病人的呼吸恢复正常。

e.en: The chart recorded steady {eupnea} during sleep.
e.zh: 记录表显示他睡眠期间呼吸平稳正常。

eupneic.t: 呼吸正常的；平静呼吸的

e.en: The nurse described the child as {eupneic} and alert.
e.zh: 护士描述这个孩子呼吸正常、神志清醒。

e.en: A {eupneic} patient breathes without visible distress.
e.zh: 呼吸正常的病人不会表现出明显呼吸困难。

e.en: The monitor showed {eupnoea} after the fever dropped.
e.zh: 退烧后，监护仪显示呼吸恢复正常。

e.en: Clinicians used {eupnoea} as a sign of improvement.
e.zh: 临床医生把正常呼吸视为病情好转的迹象。

eupnoeic.t: 呼吸正常的；平稳呼吸的

e.en: By morning, the patient was {eupnoeic} again.
e.zh: 到早晨时，病人又恢复了正常呼吸。

e.en: The report listed her as calm and {eupnoeic}.
e.zh: 报告记载她情绪平静、呼吸正常。

e.en: The chemist isolated {euporphin} from the sample.
e.zh: 化学家从样品中分离出优卟啉。

e.en: Older papers describe {euporphin} as a porphyrin compound.
e.zh: 较早的论文把优卟啉描述为一种卟啉化合物。

e.en: Several {eupotamic} species thrive in fast water.
e.zh: 几种适于河流生活的物种能在急流中繁盛。

e.en: The larvae show {eupotamic} adaptations.
e.zh: 这些幼虫表现出适应河流环境的特征。

e.en: The fish is largely {eupotamous} during its adult stage.
e.zh: 这种鱼在成年阶段大多生活在河流中。

e.en: Researchers compared {eupotamous} insects with pond species.
e.zh: 研究人员把河流性昆虫与池塘物种作了比较。

eupractic.t: 行动良好的；实践正常的

e.en: The therapist noted the patient's {eupractic} movements.
e.zh: 治疗师注意到病人的动作协调正常。

e.en: A {eupractic} response requires both intention and control.
e.zh: 良好的实践反应需要意图和控制力共同作用。

e.en: The examination found clear signs of {eupraxia}.
e.zh: 检查发现了动作协调正常的明显迹象。

e.en: Some philosophers used {eupraxia} to mean right action.
e.zh: 有些哲学家用eupraxia表示正当的行动。

eupurpurine.t: 优紫红素；一种染料物质

e.en: The fabric was tested for traces of {eupurpurine}.
e.zh: 这块织物被检测是否含有优紫红素痕迹。

e.en: Nineteenth-century dyers sometimes mentioned {eupurpurine}.
e.zh: 十九世纪的染工有时会提到优紫红素。

e.en: The old formula listed {euquinine} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 旧配方把优奎宁列为成分之一。

e.en: Doctors once discussed {euquinine} as a gentler alternative.
e.zh: 医生们曾讨论把优奎宁作为较温和的替代药物。
