e.en: They doubted the supposed {exhaustlessness} of the mine.
e.zh: 他们怀疑那座矿所谓的用之不竭。

e.en: Students gathered in the marble {exhedra}.
e.zh: 学生们聚集在大理石半圆形座席处。

e.en: The museum restored a Roman {exhedra}.
e.zh: 博物馆修复了一处罗马式谈话厅。

exheredate.t: 剥夺继承权；废除继承资格

e.en: The will tried to {exheredate} the eldest son.
e.zh: 遗嘱试图剥夺长子的继承权。

e.en: A parent could not {exheredate} a child lightly.
e.zh: 父母不能轻易废除子女的继承资格。

e.en: The court reviewed the disputed {exheredation}.
e.zh: 法院审查了这起有争议的剥夺继承权行为。

e.en: His {exheredation} shocked the whole family.
e.zh: 他的废嗣让全家都感到震惊。

e.en: The teacher used an {exhibitive} diagram in class.
e.zh: 老师在课堂上使用了一张展示性的图表。

e.en: Her style is more {exhibitive} than analytical.
e.zh: 她的风格更偏表现性，而不是分析性。

exhibitory.t: 展示的；说明性的；展览用的

e.en: The museum prepared {exhibitory} panels for the new fossils.
e.zh: 博物馆为新化石准备了展示说明板。

e.en: Her report had an {exhibitory} purpose rather than an argumentative one.
e.zh: 她的报告重在说明展示，而不是提出争辩。

exhilarant.t: 令人振奋的事物；兴奋剂

e.en: Fresh mountain air can feel like a natural {exhilarant}.
e.zh: 清新的山间空气会让人感觉像天然的兴奋剂。

e.en: The victory acted as an {exhilarant} for the exhausted team.
e.zh: 这场胜利让疲惫的队伍重新振奋起来。

exhilarative.t: 令人振奋的；使人兴奋的

e.en: The climb had an {exhilarative} effect on everyone.
e.zh: 这次攀登让每个人都精神振奋。

e.en: She loved the {exhilarative} rush of cold water.
e.zh: 她喜欢冷水带来的那种振奋感。

e.en: The coach gave an {exhortative} speech before the final.
e.zh: 决赛前，教练发表了一番鼓舞劝勉的话。

e.en: His letter was firm but {exhortative}, urging patience.
e.zh: 他的信语气坚定却带有劝勉意味，敦促大家保持耐心。

e.en: The sermon ended with an {exhortatory} call to help the poor.
e.zh: 布道最后劝勉大家去帮助穷人。

e.en: Her {exhortatory} tone made the volunteers stand straighter.
e.zh: 她激励性的语气让志愿者们更加振作。

e.en: The court ordered officials to {exhumate} the body for testing.
e.zh: 法院命令官员掘出遗体进行检测。

e.en: Historians tried to {exhumate} forgotten letters from the archive.
e.zh: 历史学家试图从档案中发掘被遗忘的信件。

e.en: The {exhumated} remains were sent to the laboratory.
e.zh: 被掘出的遗骸被送往实验室。

e.en: The article relied on {exhumated} documents from a private collection.
e.zh: 这篇文章依据的是从私人收藏中发掘出的文件。

e.en: Long storage caused {exiccation} of the plant samples.
e.zh: 长期存放导致植物样本干燥脱水。

e.en: The doctor noted severe {exiccation} in the neglected tissue.
e.zh: 医生注意到受损组织出现严重干燥。

exigible.t: 可要求的；可征收的；到期应付的

e.en: The tax became {exigible} at the end of the quarter.
e.zh: 这笔税款在季度末到期应缴。

e.en: Only proven losses are {exigible} under the contract.
e.zh: 合同下只有已证实的损失可以索赔。

e.en: The {exiguity} of evidence weakened the prosecution's case.
e.zh: 证据过于稀少，削弱了控方的案子。

e.en: They survived despite the {exiguity} of their supplies.
e.zh: 尽管补给十分贫乏，他们还是活了下来。

e.en: The poem speaks in the voice of an {exilian} returning home.
e.zh: 这首诗以一个流亡者返乡的口吻写成。

e.en: Her {exilian} memories shaped every page of the memoir.
e.zh: 她的流亡记忆塑造了回忆录的每一页。

e.en: The novel captures the {exilic} sadness of a lost homeland.
e.zh: 这部小说写出了失去故土后的流亡悲伤。

e.en: Scholars study the community's {exilic} writings with care.
e.zh: 学者们仔细研究这个群体在流亡时期的作品。

e.en: The {exility} of the thread made the repair difficult.
e.zh: 线太细弱，使修补工作变得困难。

e.en: Critics mocked the {exility} of his argument.
e.zh: 评论者嘲笑他的论证过于薄弱。

e.en: She was praised for her {eximious} scholarship.
e.zh: 她因卓越的学术成就受到赞扬。

e.en: The chef's {eximious} skill turned simple ingredients into art.
e.zh: 这位厨师的杰出技艺把普通食材变成了艺术品。

e.en: The prisoners showed signs of {exinanition} after weeks without food.
e.zh: 数周缺食后，囚犯们显出极度衰弱的迹象。

e.en: The speech left him with a sense of moral {exinanition}.
e.zh: 那场演讲让他感到一种道德上的空虚。

e.en: The botanist identified the fern as {exindusiate}.
e.zh: 植物学家认定这种蕨类没有囊群盖。

e.en: An {exindusiate} sorus lacks the usual protective covering.
e.zh: 无囊被的孢子囊群没有通常的保护覆盖物。

e.en: The pollen's {exine} remained intact under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，花粉外壁仍保持完整。

e.en: Scientists used patterns in the {exine} to identify the species.
e.zh: 科学家利用花粉外壁的纹样来识别物种。

existentialistic.t: 存在主义的；带存在主义色彩的

e.en: The film has an {existentialistic} mood throughout its final hour.
e.zh: 这部电影最后一小时始终带有存在主义色彩。

e.en: His {existentialistic} essays questioned freedom and responsibility.
e.zh: 他的存在主义式随笔质疑自由与责任。

existentialistically.t: 以存在主义方式；带存在主义地

e.en: She read the story {existentialistically}, focusing on choice and dread.
e.zh: 她以存在主义的方式解读这个故事，关注选择与恐惧。

e.en: The character behaves {existentialistically} when he rejects all excuses.
e.zh: 当这个角色拒绝一切借口时，他的行为带有存在主义意味。

e.en: Please keep the {exit-door} clear during the performance.
e.zh: 演出期间请保持出口门畅通。

e.en: A guard stood beside the {exit-door} after the alarm sounded.
e.zh: 警报响起后，一名警卫站在出口门旁。

e.en: The engineer measured the surface {exitance} of the lamp.
e.zh: 工程师测量了灯具表面的出射度。

e.en: Thermal {exitance} increases as the object grows hotter.
e.zh: 物体温度升高时，热出射度也会增加。

exlex.t: 法律之外的；不受法律保护的

e.en: The old code treated pirates as {exlex} offenders.
e.zh: 旧法典把海盗视为法律之外的罪犯。

e.en: He feared becoming {exlex}, with no court willing to hear him.
e.zh: 他害怕自己沦为不受法律保护的人，没有法院愿意受理。

e.en: A small {exlibris} was pasted inside the antique book.
e.zh: 那本古书内页贴着一张小小的藏书票。

e.en: Collectors value a rare {exlibris} almost like a print.
e.zh: 收藏家把稀有藏书票看得几乎像版画一样珍贵。

e.en: The embryo's {exoderm} later formed protective tissue.
e.zh: 胚胎的外胚层后来形成了保护组织。

e.en: Botanists examined the root {exoderm} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察根部外皮层。

e.en: The plant's {exodermis} reduced water loss.
e.zh: 植物的外皮层减少了水分流失。

e.en: A thick {exodermis} protected the young root.
e.zh: 厚实的根外皮保护了幼根。

e.en: She specialized in {exodontia} after dental school.
e.zh: 她从牙科学校毕业后专攻拔牙学。

e.en: Modern {exodontia} aims to reduce pain and infection.
e.zh: 现代牙齿拔除术旨在减少疼痛和感染。

e.en: The clinic offers {exodontics} for difficult wisdom teeth.
e.zh: 这家诊所为复杂智齿提供拔牙专科服务。

e.en: He wrote a textbook on {exodontics}.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于拔牙学的教材。

e.en: The dentist referred me to an {exodontist}.
e.zh: 牙医把我转诊给一位拔牙专科医生。

e.en: An experienced {exodontist} removed the impacted tooth.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的拔牙专科医生拔除了阻生牙。

e.en: The detector measured each emitted {exoelectron}.
e.zh: 探测器测量了每个释放出的外逸电子。

e.en: Heat can increase {exoelectron} emission from the surface.
e.zh: 加热会增加表面的外逸电子发射。

e.en: The reaction was strongly {exoenergetic}.
e.zh: 这个反应明显是放能的。

e.en: Researchers studied an {exoenergetic} collision between particles.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了一次粒子间释放能量的碰撞。

e.en: The bacterium secretes an {exoenzyme} to digest starch.
e.zh: 这种细菌分泌胞外酶来分解淀粉。

e.en: Each {exoenzyme} works outside the cell.
e.zh: 每种胞外酶都在细胞外发挥作用。

e.en: Fusion can be {exoergic} under the right conditions.
e.zh: 在合适条件下，聚变可以是放能的。

e.en: The physicist described the process as {exoergic}.
e.zh: 物理学家把这个过程描述为能量外释的。

e.en: Malaria parasites have an {exoerythrocytic} stage in the liver.
e.zh: 疟原虫在肝脏中有红细胞外期阶段。

e.en: The drug targets {exoerythrocytic} forms of the parasite.
e.zh: 这种药物针对寄生虫的红细胞外期形态。

e.en: The mayor served as an {exofficio} board member.
e.zh: 市长依职权当然担任董事会成员。

e.en: She held {exofficio} authority over the committee.
e.zh: 她对该委员会拥有依职权产生的权力。

e.en: The surgeon suspected {exogastritis} after the scan.
e.zh: 扫描后，外科医生怀疑存在胃外膜炎。

e.en: Severe {exogastritis} can mimic other abdominal diseases.
e.zh: 严重的胃外炎症可能类似其他腹部疾病。

e.en: The scientist traced the pollutant to an {exogen}.
e.zh: 科学家把污染物追溯到一种外源物。

e.en: In botany, an {exogen} grows by adding outer layers.
e.zh: 在植物学中，外生体通过增加外层来生长。

e.en: The theory proposed {exogenesis} for the mineral deposit.
e.zh: 该理论认为这种矿床是外源发生的。

e.en: Some researchers discuss {exogenesis} in relation to life on Earth.
e.zh: 一些研究人员在地球生命问题上讨论外生成。

e.en: Rain and wind are {exogenetic} forces shaping the land.
e.zh: 雨和风是塑造地貌的外源成因力量。

e.en: The geologist identified {exogenetic} changes in the rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家识别出岩石中的外生成因变化。

e.en: The disease was linked to an {exogenic} toxin.
e.zh: 这种疾病与一种外源毒素有关。

e.en: Weathering is an {exogenic} geological process.
e.zh: 风化是一种外生地质过程。

e.en: The map marked an ancient {exogeosyncline}.
e.zh: 地图标出了一个古老的外地槽。

e.en: Sediments accumulated slowly in the {exogeosyncline}.
e.zh: 沉积物在外部地槽中缓慢堆积。

e.en: The colony developed an {exoglossic} education system.
e.zh: 该殖民地发展出使用外来语言的教育体系。

e.en: An {exoglossic} policy favored the former colonial language.
e.zh: 一项外来语言政策偏向前殖民语言。

e.en: The engineer compared the {exograph} with the internal log.
e.zh: 工程师把外部记录图与内部日志进行了比较。

e.en: A clear {exograph} revealed the machine's vibration pattern.
e.zh: 清晰的外描图显示了机器的振动模式。

e.en: The paper discussed {exohemophylaxis} after repeated transfusions.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了反复输血后的异体输血免疫保护。

e.en: Doctors monitored {exohemophylaxis} in the experimental treatment.
e.zh: 医生在实验性治疗中监测异体输血免疫保护。

e.en: The fungus releases an {exohormone} into its environment.
e.zh: 这种真菌向环境中释放外激素。

e.en: Researchers measured {exohormone} levels in the culture medium.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了培养基中的外激素水平。

exolete.t: 过时的；废弃的词语或事物

e.en: The dictionary marked the term {exolete} after centuries of disuse.
e.zh: 这个词典把这个词标为过时词，因为它已经数百年不用了。

e.en: His essay revived several {exolete} expressions from early English sermons.
e.zh: 他的文章重新使用了早期英语布道中的几个废弃表达。

e.en: The technician adjusted the {exolever} before testing the old machine.
e.zh: 技术员在测试旧机器前调整了外部杠杆。

e.en: A broken {exolever} made the valve difficult to control.
e.zh: 外侧操作杆坏了，使这个阀门很难控制。

exolinguistics.t: 外星语言学；外部语言研究

e.en: Her thesis in {exolinguistics} imagined how humans might decode alien speech.
e.zh: 她关于外星语言学的论文设想了人类如何解读外星语言。

e.en: Some scholars use {exolinguistics} to describe language contact beyond one community.
e.zh: 一些学者用外部语言研究来描述超出单一社群的语言接触。

exoloma.t: 外生瘤；向外突出的肿块

e.en: The surgeon identified the swelling as an {exoloma} on the tissue surface.
e.zh: 外科医生确认这处肿胀是组织表面的外生瘤。

e.en: An {exoloma} may be noticed earlier because it grows outward.
e.zh: 外生瘤因为向外生长，可能更早被发现。

exometritis.t: 子宫外膜炎；子宫外层炎症

e.en: The report described rare postpartum {exometritis} in the patient.
e.zh: 报告描述了这名患者罕见的产后子宫外膜炎。

e.en: Doctors distinguished {exometritis} from inflammation inside the uterine lining.
e.zh: 医生把子宫外层炎症与子宫内膜的炎症区分开来。

exomixis.t: 异源混合；外来基因交配

e.en: The biologist used {exomixis} to explain breeding between distinct populations.
e.zh: 生物学家用异源混合来解释不同种群之间的繁殖。

e.en: In some plants, {exomixis} increases genetic variety.
e.zh: 在某些植物中，外来基因交配会增加遗传多样性。

exomorphism.t: 外形同构；外部形态相似

e.en: The crystals showed {exomorphism} despite having different internal structures.
e.zh: 这些晶体虽然内部结构不同，却表现出外形同构。

e.en: Designers sometimes exploit {exomorphism} to make new tools feel familiar.
e.zh: 设计师有时利用外部形态相似，让新工具显得熟悉。

e.en: The newborn was treated for {exomphalos} soon after birth.
e.zh: 这个新生儿出生后不久就接受了脐膨出治疗。

e.en: Prenatal scans can sometimes detect {exomphalos} before delivery.
e.zh: 产前扫描有时能在分娩前发现脐膨出。

e.en: The old medical text called the outward growth an {exoncoma}.
e.zh: 这本旧医学文献把这种向外生长的肿块称为外生肿瘤。

e.en: An {exoncoma} can press against nearby skin as it enlarges.
e.zh: 突出性肿块变大时可能压迫附近皮肤。

e.en: The lawyer presented {exonerative} evidence during the appeal.
e.zh: 律师在上诉中提交了能免罪的证据。

e.en: Her statement was not fully {exonerative}, but it weakened the accusation.
e.zh: 她的陈述不能完全开脱责任，但削弱了指控。

e.en: The school followed an {exonormative} model based on British pronunciation.
e.zh: 这所学校采用以英式发音为准的外部规范导向模式。

e.en: Critics argued that {exonormative} standards ignored local language habits.
e.zh: 批评者认为外部规范导向的标准忽视了本地语言习惯。

e.en: The enzyme {exonuclease} removes nucleotides from the end of DNA.
e.zh: 外切核酸酶会从DNA末端移除核苷酸。

e.en: Researchers measured {exonuclease} activity in the damaged cell samples.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了受损细胞样本中的外切核酸酶活性。

e.en: His collection of {exonumia} included transit tokens and old medals.
e.zh: 他的代币奖章收藏品包括交通代币和旧奖章。

e.en: Collectors value {exonumia} for its local history rather than face value.
e.zh: 收藏者看重代币奖章收藏品的地方历史，而不是面值。

e.en: The {exonumist} catalogued every trade token in the box.
e.zh: 这位代币奖章收藏者给盒子里的每枚商用代币编了目录。

e.en: As an {exonumist}, she studies medals that never served as legal money.
e.zh: 作为代币奖章收藏者，她研究那些从未作为法定货币使用的奖章。

e.en: London is the English {exonym} for a city called Londres in French.
e.zh: London是英语中的外来地名，而法语称这座城市为Londres。

e.en: Using an {exonym} can sometimes carry political meaning.
e.zh: 使用外族称名有时会带有政治含义。

exopathic.t: 外因致病的；外源病理的

e.en: The doctor suspected an {exopathic} cause rather than an inherited disorder.
e.zh: 医生怀疑是外因致病，而不是遗传性疾病。

e.en: Pollution may produce {exopathic} changes in exposed tissues.
e.zh: 污染可能在暴露组织中产生外源病理变化。

e.en: An {exopeptidase} breaks amino acids from the end of a peptide chain.
e.zh: 外肽酶会从肽链末端分解出氨基酸。

e.en: The lab compared {exopeptidase} levels before and after treatment.
e.zh: 实验室比较了治疗前后的外肽酶水平。

e.en: The parasite's {exophagy} allows it to feed outside the host's body.
e.zh: 这种寄生物的外食性使它能在宿主体外取食。

e.en: Mosquito {exophagy} can reduce the effect of indoor insecticide spraying.
e.zh: 蚊子的外部取食会降低室内杀虫喷洒的效果。

e.en: The therapist compared silent thought with {exophasia} during the test.
e.zh: 治疗师在测试中比较了默想和出声表达。

e.en: After the stroke, his {exophasia} improved faster than his writing.
e.zh: 中风后，他的外部言语恢复得比书写更快。

exophilic.t: 喜户外的；偏好外部环境的

e.en: The team studied {exophilic} mosquitoes that rest outdoors after feeding.
e.zh: 团队研究了吸血后停留在户外的喜户外蚊子。

e.en: An {exophilic} species may avoid traps placed inside houses.
e.zh: 偏好外部环境的物种可能会避开屋内设置的陷阱。

e.en: The botanist identified {exophloem} near the outer side of the vascular bundle.
e.zh: 植物学家在维管束外侧附近确认了外韧皮部。

e.en: In some stems, {exophloem} helps transport nutrients away from leaves.
e.zh: 在某些茎中，外韧皮部帮助把养分从叶片输送出去。

e.en: The optometrist detected mild {exophoria} during the eye exam.
e.zh: 验光师在眼科检查中发现了轻度外隐斜视。

e.en: Fatigue can make {exophoria} more noticeable when reading.
e.zh: 疲劳会让人在阅读时更明显地表现出外隐斜视。

e.en: The patient developed {exophthalmia} as the thyroid disease progressed.
e.zh: 随着甲状腺疾病进展，患者出现了眼球突出症。

e.en: Severe {exophthalmia} can make it difficult to close the eyelids.
e.zh: 严重的眼球突出症会让人难以闭合眼睑。

e.en: The doctor noted an {exophthalmic} appearance in both eyes.
e.zh: 医生注意到双眼呈现眼球突出的外观。

e.en: Older texts often describe Graves' disease as {exophthalmic} goiter.
e.zh: 旧文献常把格雷夫斯病称为突眼性甲状腺肿。

e.en: The scan helped explain the patient's sudden {exophthalmos}.
e.zh: 这次扫描帮助解释了患者突然出现的眼球突出。

e.en: Untreated thyroid disease may lead to {exophthalmos} in some cases.
e.zh: 未经治疗的甲状腺疾病在某些情况下可能导致眼球突出。

e.en: The doctor noted marked {exophthalmus} during the thyroid examination.
e.zh: 医生在甲状腺检查中注意到明显的眼球突出。

e.en: Severe {exophthalmus} can make closing the eyelids difficult.
e.zh: 严重的突眼会让闭合眼睑变得困难。

e.en: The amoeba's {exoplasm} appeared clearer than its inner cytoplasm.
e.zh: 变形虫的外质看起来比内部细胞质更透明。

e.en: Biology texts describe {exoplasm} as the firmer outer part of cytoplasm.
e.zh: 生物学教材把外质描述为细胞质较坚实的外层部分。

e.en: The shrimp's {exopodite} helps identify the structure of its limb.
e.zh: 虾的外肢有助于识别其附肢结构。

e.en: In many crustaceans, the {exopodite} forms the outer branch of an appendage.
e.zh: 在许多甲壳动物中，外肢构成附肢的外侧分支。

e.en: The specimen showed a small {exopoditic} lobe beside the main limb.
e.zh: 标本在主肢旁显示出一个小的外肢叶。

e.en: Researchers compared the {exopoditic} segments across related crustaceans.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了相关甲壳动物的外肢节段。

e.en: A grasshopper is an {exopterygote} because its wing buds develop externally.
e.zh: 蝗虫属于外翅类昆虫，因为它的翅芽在体外发育。

e.en: The course contrasts each {exopterygote} with insects that undergo complete metamorphosis.
e.zh: 课程把每种外翅类昆虫与完全变态昆虫作比较。

e.en: Her surprising {exorability} softened the dispute before it reached court.
e.zh: 她出人意料的可劝服性在案件上庭前缓和了争端。

e.en: The tyrant's lack of {exorability} made every petition useless.
e.zh: 暴君毫无可打动性，使每一份请愿都徒劳无功。

e.en: Despite his stern manner, the judge proved {exorable} after hearing the evidence.
e.zh: 尽管法官态度严厉，听完证据后还是可以被打动。

e.en: The old rule was not {exorable} by appeals to pity.
e.zh: 这条旧规不能靠同情诉求来劝动。

e.en: The {exorbitancy} of the rent forced them to move farther away.
e.zh: 租金高得离谱，迫使他们搬到更远的地方。

e.en: Parliament debated the {exorbitancy} of the minister's demands.
e.zh: 议会辩论了那位部长要求过分的问题。

e.en: The villagers requested an {exorcisement} after hearing strange voices at night.
e.zh: 村民夜里听到怪声后，请人进行驱魔。

e.en: The ritual of {exorcisement} was described in an old church manuscript.
e.zh: 一份古老教会手稿记载了驱魔仪式。

e.en: The priest carried an {exorcistic} text into the dark room.
e.zh: 神父带着一篇驱魔经文走进昏暗的房间。

e.en: Anthropologists studied the village's {exorcistic} songs and gestures.
e.zh: 人类学家研究了这个村庄的祓邪歌唱和手势。

e.en: The manuscript preserves several {exorcistical} formulas from the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 这份手稿保存了几条中世纪的驱魔套语。

e.en: Her research focuses on {exorcistical} practices in early modern Europe.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦近代早期欧洲的祓邪仪式。

e.en: The editor removed several lengthy {exordia} from the collected speeches.
e.zh: 编辑删去了演讲集中几段冗长的开场白。

e.en: Classical rhetoricians treated {exordia} as crucial entrances into an argument.
e.zh: 古典修辞学家把序言视为进入论证的关键开端。

e.en: The speaker's {exordial} remarks were brief but elegant.
e.zh: 演讲者的开场 remarks 简短而优雅。

e.en: An {exordial} paragraph should prepare readers for the main argument.
e.zh: 序言段落应当让读者为主要论点做好准备。

e.en: The sermon began with a solemn {exordium} about mercy.
e.zh: 布道以一段关于仁慈的庄重开场白开始。

e.en: In rhetoric, an {exordium} introduces the subject and wins attention.
e.zh: 在修辞学中，序言引入主题并吸引注意。

e.en: His early essays contain ornate {exordiums} before simple arguments.
e.zh: 他的早期文章在简单论点前有华丽的序言。

e.en: The teacher asked students to compare the {exordiums} of two speeches.
e.zh: 老师要求学生比较两篇演讲的开场白。

e.en: The chapel's {exornate} ceiling drew every visitor's eye upward.
e.zh: 小教堂装饰华美的天花板吸引每位访客抬头观看。

e.en: His {exornate} prose sometimes hid a rather simple idea.
e.zh: 他修饰繁复的散文有时掩盖了相当简单的想法。

e.en: The architect avoided unnecessary {exornation} on the small facade.
e.zh: 建筑师避免在小立面上做不必要的装饰。

e.en: The critic admired the poem's {exornation} but questioned its feeling.
e.zh: 评论家欣赏这首诗的文辞修饰，却质疑它的情感。

e.en: The fungus formed a dark {exosclerotium} around the infected tissue.
e.zh: 真菌在受感染组织周围形成了深色外菌核。

e.en: Microscopy revealed the {exosclerotium} as a hardened outer layer.
e.zh: 显微观察显示外菌核是一层硬化的外层。

e.en: The membrane showed an {exosmic} movement of fluid under pressure.
e.zh: 在压力下，膜表现出液体向外渗透的运动。

e.en: Older chemistry books used {exosmic} to describe outward osmotic flow.
e.zh: 较早的化学书用外渗的来描述向外的渗透流动。

e.en: The experiment measured {exosmosis} through a thin animal membrane.
e.zh: 实验测量了液体穿过薄动物膜的外渗现象。

e.en: Salt outside the cell can encourage {exosmosis} and shrinkage.
e.zh: 细胞外的盐分会促使外渗并导致细胞收缩。

e.en: The cells suffered {exosmotic} loss of water in the salty solution.
e.zh: 细胞在盐溶液中发生外渗性失水。

e.en: The report distinguishes {exosmotic} flow from inward osmotic movement.
e.zh: 报告区分了外渗流动和向内的渗透运动。

e.en: Satellites can travel through the thin {exosphere} above Earth.
e.zh: 卫星可以穿过地球上方稀薄的外逸层。

e.en: Mercury has a very tenuous {exosphere} instead of a dense atmosphere.
e.zh: 水星没有浓密大气，只有非常稀薄的外逸层。

e.en: The probe collected {exospheric} particles during its high-altitude pass.
e.zh: 探测器在高空飞越时收集了外逸层粒子。

e.en: Scientists modeled {exospheric} temperatures during increased solar activity.
e.zh: 科学家模拟了太阳活动增强期间外逸层的温度。

e.en: The microscope revealed a thick {exospore} around the fungal spore.
e.zh: 显微镜显示真菌孢子周围有厚厚的孢子外壁。

e.en: Some algae release an {exospore} that develops outside the parent cell.
e.zh: 有些藻类释放在母细胞外发育的外孢子。

exostosectomy.t: 骨赘切除术；外生骨疣切除

e.en: The surgeon performed an {exostosectomy} to relieve pressure on the tendon.
e.zh: 外科医生进行了骨赘切除术，以减轻肌腱所受的压力。

e.en: Recovery after {exostosectomy} usually includes rest and physical therapy.
e.zh: 骨赘切除术后的恢复通常包括休息和物理治疗。

e.en: The X-ray showed an {exostosis} near the patient's heel.
e.zh: X光片显示患者脚跟附近有一个外生骨疣。

e.en: Repeated irritation can sometimes lead to an {exostosis} in the ear canal.
e.zh: 反复刺激有时会导致耳道内形成骨赘。

e.en: The insect's {exostructure} protects its soft inner tissues.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的外部结构保护着柔软的内部组织。

e.en: Engineers designed an {exostructure} to support the damaged wall.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一个外部支撑结构来加固受损的墙体。

e.en: Some marine animals live in {exosymbiosis} with bacteria on their shells.
e.zh: 一些海洋动物与附着在壳上的细菌形成外共生关系。

e.en: The study examined {exosymbiosis} between algae and small invertebrates.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了藻类与小型无脊椎动物之间的体表共生。

e.en: The lecture focused on religious {exoterica} rather than hidden doctrines.
e.zh: 这场讲座关注的是宗教的外传知识，而不是隐秘教义。

e.en: Collectors filled the shelves with occult books and other {exoterica}.
e.zh: 收藏者把书架摆满了神秘学书籍和其他外传资料。

e.en: The monk gave an {exoterical} explanation suitable for ordinary listeners.
e.zh: 那位僧侣给出了适合普通听众理解的公开教义解释。

e.en: Her article treated the ritual in an {exoterical} rather than mystical way.
e.zh: 她的文章以外传而非神秘的方式阐释这个仪式。

e.en: The teacher explained the doctrine {exoterically} for new students.
e.zh: 老师以公开易懂的方式向新学生解释这项教义。

e.en: The symbol can be read {exoterically} as a simple moral lesson.
e.zh: 这个符号可以从外传层面理解为一个简单的道德教训。

exotericist.t: 外传论者；重公开教义者

e.en: As an {exotericist}, he rejected secret interpretations of the text.
e.zh: 作为外传论者，他拒绝对这部文本作秘密式解读。

e.en: The {exotericist} preferred teachings that ordinary believers could understand.
e.zh: 这位重视公开教义的人更偏爱普通信徒能理解的教导。

e.en: The botanist examined the {exothecium} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察了药室外壁。

e.en: Damage to the {exothecium} can affect how spores are released.
e.zh: 孢子囊外层受损会影响孢子的释放方式。

e.en: The rare {exothelioma} required careful pathological diagnosis.
e.zh: 这种罕见的外皮瘤需要进行细致的病理诊断。

e.en: Doctors discussed whether the growth was an {exothelioma} or another tumor.
e.zh: 医生们讨论这个增生物是外皮瘤还是另一种肿瘤。

e.en: The graph showed a sharp {exotherm} during the reaction.
e.zh: 图表显示反应过程中出现了一个明显的放热峰。

e.en: Chemists monitored the {exotherm} to keep the mixture safe.
e.zh: 化学家监测放热过程，以确保混合物保持安全。

e.en: The compound decomposed {exothermally} when heated.
e.zh: 这种化合物受热时以放热方式分解。

e.en: The resin cured {exothermally} inside the mold.
e.zh: 树脂在模具内固化时释放热量。

e.en: Burning wood is an {exothermic} reaction.
e.zh: 木材燃烧是一种放热反应。

e.en: The lab used cooling water to control the {exothermic} process.
e.zh: 实验室用冷却水来控制这个放热过程。

e.en: The chemicals reacted {exothermically} as soon as they were mixed.
e.zh: 这些化学品一混合就以放热方式发生反应。

e.en: Some adhesives cure {exothermically} and may become warm to the touch.
e.zh: 有些胶黏剂固化时会放热，摸起来可能会变热。

e.en: The novel uses {exotism} to make the setting feel distant and strange.
e.zh: 这部小说运用异国情调，让背景显得遥远而陌生。

e.en: Critics accused the painting of shallow {exotism}.
e.zh: 评论家批评这幅画只有肤浅的外来风格。

e.en: The bacterium releases an {exotoxin} that damages nerve tissue.
e.zh: 这种细菌会释放一种损伤神经组织的外毒素。

e.en: Vaccines can sometimes target the {exotoxin} rather than the bacterium itself.
e.zh: 疫苗有时可以针对外毒素，而不是细菌本身。

e.en: The child was diagnosed with {exotropia} after an eye exam.
e.zh: 眼科检查后，这个孩子被诊断为外斜视。

e.en: Mild {exotropia} may become more noticeable when a person is tired.
e.zh: 轻度外斜视在人疲劳时可能会变得更明显。

e.en: The physician tried to {expalpate} the edge of the swelling.
e.zh: 医生试图通过触诊摸清肿胀边缘。

e.en: It was difficult to {expalpate} the small lump beneath the skin.
e.zh: 要摸查皮下那个小肿块并不容易。

e.en: The old suitcase has an {expandible} side panel.
e.zh: 这个旧手提箱有一块可扩展的侧板。

e.en: They chose an {expandible} database design for future growth.
e.zh: 他们选择了可扩展的数据库设计，以便将来增长。

e.en: Rubber is valued for its {expansibility} under pressure.
e.zh: 橡胶因受压时具有可扩张性而受到重视。

e.en: The system's {expansibility} made later upgrades much easier.
e.zh: 这个系统的可扩展性让后续升级容易得多。

e.en: The device uses an {expansible} tube to hold the artery open.
e.zh: 该装置使用可膨胀管来撑开动脉。

e.en: An {expansible} plan allowed the school to add classrooms later.
e.zh: 一个可扩展的方案让学校以后能够增加教室。

e.en: The scan revealed an {expansile} lesion in the bone.
e.zh: 扫描显示骨内有一个扩张性病灶。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {expansile} mass for signs of rapid growth.
e.zh: 医生监测这个膨胀样肿块是否有快速增大的迹象。

expansin.t: 扩张蛋白；细胞壁松弛蛋白

e.en: The plant produces {expansin} to loosen its cell walls.
e.zh: 植物会产生扩张蛋白来松弛细胞壁。

e.en: Researchers measured {expansin} levels during root growth.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了根部生长过程中扩张蛋白的水平。

e.en: The material's thermal {expansivity} must be considered in bridge design.
e.zh: 桥梁设计必须考虑这种材料的热膨胀率。

e.en: Her intellectual {expansivity} impressed everyone in the seminar.
e.zh: 她思维的开阔性给研讨会上的每个人留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The judge issued an {exparte} order after reviewing the emergency request.
e.zh: 法官审查紧急申请后发布了一项单方命令。

e.en: Lawyers criticized the {exparte} communication with the court.
e.zh: 律师们批评了与法院进行的单方沟通。

e.en: Her {expatiation} on the poem lasted twenty minutes.
e.zh: 她对这首诗的详述持续了二十分钟。

e.en: The report avoided {expatiation} and gave only the facts.
e.zh: 这份报告避免铺陈，只列出事实。

e.en: His {expatiatory} style made the lecture feel endless.
e.zh: 他那种铺陈式的风格让讲座显得没完没了。

e.en: The editor cut several {expatiatory} paragraphs from the essay.
e.zh: 编辑删去了文章中几段详述性的段落。

e.en: The novel treats {expatriatism} as both freedom and loss.
e.zh: 这部小说把侨居生活写成自由与失落并存。

e.en: His long {expatriatism} changed his sense of home.
e.zh: 长期离乡生活改变了他对家的感觉。

e.en: The old spelling {expecially} appears in several letters.
e.zh: 这种旧拼法“尤其”出现在几封信里。

e.en: She used {expecially} where modern writers would use especially.
e.zh: 她用了expecially，而现代作者会用especially。

e.en: The engine failed {expectably} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 多年缺乏维护后，引擎故障是可预料的。

e.en: Prices rose {expectably} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 假日期间价格照预期上涨了。

e.en: The study measured {expectational} changes among new investors.
e.zh: 这项研究衡量了新投资者预期方面的变化。

e.en: Teachers noticed an {expectational} gap between parents and students.
e.zh: 老师注意到家长和学生之间存在期望差距。

e.en: The crowd waited in an {expectative} silence.
e.zh: 人群在期待的沉默中等待。

e.en: His {expectative} claim to the estate was never secure.
e.zh: 他对那份遗产的预期权利从未稳固。

e.en: Persistent {expectoration} can be a sign of infection.
e.zh: 持续咳痰可能是感染的迹象。

e.en: Public {expectoration} was forbidden in the old railway station.
e.zh: 旧火车站禁止随地吐痰。

e.en: The syrup has a mild {expectorative} effect.
e.zh: 这种糖浆有轻微的祛痰作用。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {expectorative} mixtures for chest colds.
e.zh: 医生过去会为胸部感冒开祛痰合剂。

e.en: The sign warned every {expectorator} to use a spittoon.
e.zh: 告示警告每个吐痰者要使用痰盂。

e.en: A chronic {expectorator} should seek medical advice.
e.zh: 长期咳痰的人应当就医咨询。

e.en: The manager tried to {expediate} the approval process.
e.zh: 经理试图加快审批流程。

e.en: Extra staff were hired to {expediate} deliveries.
e.zh: 公司增聘人手以促进配送完成。

e.en: They chose an {expediential} solution rather than a principled one.
e.zh: 他们选择了权宜的办法，而不是有原则的方案。

e.en: The policy was criticized as merely {expediential}.
e.zh: 这项政策被批评为只是图方便的权宜之计。

e.en: Each {expeditionist} carried supplies for two weeks.
e.zh: 每名远征成员都携带了两周的补给。

e.en: The young {expeditionist} wrote notes during the climb.
e.zh: 那位年轻探险者在攀登途中做了记录。

e.en: The committee adopted an {expeditive} procedure for urgent cases.
e.zh: 委员会为紧急案件采用了迅速程序。

e.en: Her {expeditive} approach helped finish the audit early.
e.zh: 她高效推进的做法帮助审计提前完成。

e.en: The {expeditor} checked every delayed order.
e.zh: 催办员核查了每一张延误订单。

e.en: A kitchen {expeditor} keeps dishes moving to the tables.
e.zh: 餐厅传菜协调员负责让菜品顺利送到餐桌。

e.en: The archaic word {expeditous} means quick or prompt.
e.zh: 这个古旧词expeditous意为迅速或及时。

e.en: An {expeditous} reply would greatly help the inquiry.
e.zh: 迅速回复会对这项询问大有帮助。

e.en: Violence is an {expellable} offense at the school.
e.zh: 在这所学校，暴力行为属于可开除的过错。

e.en: The foreign agent was legally {expellable} after the verdict.
e.zh: 判决后，这名外国代理人在法律上可被驱逐。

e.en: The medicine acted as an {expellant} for the parasite.
e.zh: 这种药起到了排出寄生虫的作用。

e.en: They used an {expellant} force to clear the blockage.
e.zh: 他们用排出力清除了堵塞。

e.en: Each {expellee} received a notice from the university.
e.zh: 每名被开除者都收到了大学的通知。

e.en: The border office recorded the name of every {expellee}.
e.zh: 边境办公室记录了每名被驱逐者的姓名。

e.en: The treatment had an {expellent} effect on the worms.
e.zh: 这种治疗对蠕虫有驱除作用。

e.en: An {expellent} order forced the diplomat to leave.
e.zh: 一项驱逐令迫使那名外交官离境。

e.en: The soldiers resented their apparent {expendability}.
e.zh: 士兵们怨恨自己显然被视为可以牺牲。

e.en: Cheap parts increase the product's {expendability}.
e.zh: 廉价零件提高了产品的可消耗性。

e.en: The old text uses {expendient} where we would write expedient.
e.zh: 这段旧文本用expendient，相当于现在的expedient。

e.en: It seemed {expendient} to delay the announcement.
e.zh: 推迟公告看起来是权宜而方便的做法。

e.en: She charged the dinner to her {expense-account}.
e.zh: 她把那顿晚餐记在自己的报销账户上。

e.en: The company tightened its {expense-account} rules.
e.zh: 公司收紧了公费开支规定。

e.en: The village offered an {expenseless} meal to travelers.
e.zh: 村子为旅人提供免费餐食。

e.en: He imagined an {expenseless} cure for every patient.
e.zh: 他设想一种让每位病人都不用花钱的疗法。

e.en: The {experienceless} intern needed close guidance during the first week.
e.zh: 这名缺乏经验的实习生第一周需要密切指导。

e.en: He sounded {experienceless}, but his questions were thoughtful.
e.zh: 他听起来经验不足，但提的问题很有思考。

e.en: An {experient} sailor can read the weather from small changes.
e.zh: 有经验的水手能从细微变化判断天气。

e.en: The philosopher described the self as an {experient} of sensations.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把自我描述为各种感觉的体验者。

e.en: Her teaching philosophy leans toward {experientialism} rather than lectures.
e.zh: 她的教学理念偏向体验式学习，而不是单纯讲课。

e.en: The essay defends {experientialism} as a basis for moral knowledge.
e.zh: 这篇文章为把经验主义作为道德知识基础进行辩护。

e.en: As an {experientialist}, he trusts practice more than abstract theory.
e.zh: 作为经验主义者，他更相信实践而不是抽象理论。

e.en: The school hired an {experientialist} to redesign its outdoor curriculum.
e.zh: 学校聘请了一位体验式教育倡导者来重设户外课程。

experimentalize.t: 使实验化；按实验方式处理

e.en: The team tried to {experimentalize} routine training with controlled trials.
e.zh: 团队试图用对照试验把日常训练实验化。

e.en: You can {experimentalize} the lesson by testing two methods in class.
e.zh: 你可以在课堂上测试两种方法，把这节课变成实验式教学。

e.en: Her {experimentative} style made the workshop lively and unpredictable.
e.zh: 她爱尝试的风格让工作坊生动又难以预料。

e.en: The proposal is still {experimentative} and needs careful review.
e.zh: 这个方案仍带有实验性质，需要仔细审查。

e.en: The {experimentator} recorded every unexpected reaction in the notebook.
e.zh: 实验者把每一次意外反应都记在笔记本里。

e.en: A careful {experimentator} avoids changing two variables at once.
e.zh: 谨慎的试验人员会避免一次改变两个变量。

e.en: The director wanted to {experimentize} the rehearsal process.
e.zh: 导演想把排练过程变成一种实验。

e.en: Researchers may {experimentize} a simple question before building a theory.
e.zh: 研究人员可能先把简单问题实验化，再建立理论。

e.en: The committee was criticized for {expertism} that ignored local voices.
e.zh: 委员会因专家主义作风、忽视当地声音而受到批评。

e.en: His {expertism} showed in the precise but inaccessible report.
e.zh: 那份准确却难懂的报告体现出他的专家腔。

expertize.t: 使专业化；提供专业鉴定

e.en: The consultant helped {expertize} the team's hiring process.
e.zh: 顾问帮助团队把招聘流程专业化。

e.en: They asked a jeweler to {expertize} the old ring.
e.zh: 他们请珠宝师为那枚旧戒指做专业鉴定。

e.en: Critics warned that {expertocracy} could weaken democratic debate.
e.zh: 批评者警告说，专家统治可能削弱民主讨论。

e.en: The crisis led some voters to favor {expertocracy} over party politics.
e.zh: 这场危机让一些选民更支持专家治国而非政党政治。

e.en: The priest said the offense was {expiable} through sincere repentance.
e.zh: 神父说，只要真诚悔改，这项过错是可以赎清的。

e.en: Not every public failure is easily {expiable} by an apology.
e.zh: 并非每一次公开失误都能轻易靠道歉弥补。

e.en: In the story, the king becomes an {expiator} for his people's suffering.
e.zh: 在故事中，国王成了为人民苦难赎罪的人。

e.en: The charity cast him as an {expiator} of past corporate harm.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构把他塑造成弥补企业旧日伤害的人。

e.en: They held an {expiatory} ceremony after the village tragedy.
e.zh: 村庄悲剧发生后，他们举行了赎罪仪式。

e.en: His donation felt more {expiatory} than generous.
e.zh: 他的捐款感觉更像是在补偿，而不是真正慷慨。

e.en: The {expiree} must renew the license before the deadline.
e.zh: 许可证到期的人必须在截止日期前续期。

e.en: Each {expiree} received a notice about the end of coverage.
e.zh: 每位保险期满者都收到了保障结束的通知。

e.en: The detective tried to {expiscate} the truth from scattered clues.
e.zh: 侦探试图从零散线索中查明真相。

e.en: Scholars still {expiscate} meanings hidden in the old manuscript.
e.zh: 学者们仍在探究那份古手稿中隐藏的含义。

e.en: Her {expiscatory} questions gradually exposed the contradiction.
e.zh: 她那些追根究底的问题逐渐暴露了矛盾。

e.en: The report took an {expiscatory} approach to the missing funds.
e.zh: 这份报告以查明真相的方式处理失踪资金问题。

e.en: The teacher marked {explaination} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 老师把 explaination 标为拼写错误。

e.en: He wrote {explaination}, but the correct word is explanation.
e.zh: 他写成了 explaination，但正确拼法是 explanation。

e.en: The theory must account for several {explananda} at once.
e.zh: 这个理论必须同时说明几个待解释事项。

e.en: Scientists listed the {explananda} before proposing a model.
e.zh: 科学家们先列出需要解释的现象，再提出模型。

e.en: In this argument, climate change is the main {explanandum}.
e.zh: 在这个论证中，气候变化是主要的待解释现象。

e.en: The philosopher separated the {explanandum} from the explanation itself.
e.zh: 哲学家把被解释项同解释本身区分开来。

e.en: The {explanans} includes both the law and the initial conditions.
e.zh: 解释项既包括规律，也包括初始条件。

e.en: A weak {explanans} cannot support such a broad conclusion.
e.zh: 薄弱的说明依据无法支撑如此宽泛的结论。

e.en: The lecturer paused to {explanate} the difficult passage.
e.zh: 讲师停下来阐明那段难懂的文字。

e.en: Please {explanate} your reasoning before giving the answer.
e.zh: 请先解释你的推理，再给出答案。

e.en: The chart has an {explanative} note under each column.
e.zh: 图表每一栏下面都有说明性注释。

e.en: Her tone became {explanative} when students looked confused.
e.zh: 看到学生困惑时，她的语气变得解释性更强。

e.en: She wrote {explanatively} about each design choice.
e.zh: 她以解释的方式说明了每个设计选择。

e.en: The teacher spoke {explanatively}, not defensively.
e.zh: 老师说话是在解释，而不是在辩解。

e.en: The note was added {explanatorily} after the chart.
e.zh: 图表后面附上了说明性的注释。

e.en: He answered {explanatorily} rather than emotionally.
e.zh: 他是以解释的口吻回答，而不是情绪化回应。

e.en: The essay's {explanatoriness} made it useful to beginners.
e.zh: 这篇文章的解释性让初学者觉得很有用。

e.en: Too much {explanatoriness} can slow the story down.
e.zh: 说明过多会拖慢故事节奏。

e.en: The surgeon scheduled {explantation} of the damaged device.
e.zh: 外科医生安排取出受损装置。

e.zh: 这块组织被准备好用于实验室外植培养。

e.zh: 附录在报告中起到补充作用。

e.en: They added {explementary} notes for missing context.
e.zh: 他们添加了补充说明来填补缺失背景。

e.zh: 编辑试图补全这个残缺的句子。

e.en: Formal logic may {explete} an argument's hidden premise.
e.zh: 形式逻辑可以补出论证中隐藏的前提。

e.en: The phrase has an {expletory} function in the sentence.
e.zh: 这个短语在句中起补足作用。

e.en: His {expletory} outburst shocked the room.
e.zh: 他那句咒骂式的爆发让全场震惊。

e.en: The machine failed {explicably} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 这台机器多年无人维护后故障，是说得通的。

e.zh: 她的愤怒显然和那个被打破的承诺有关。

e.en: In this theory, consciousness is the main {explicandum}.
e.zh: 在这个理论中，意识是主要待解释对象。

e.en: The scientist separated the {explicandum} from the explanation.
e.zh: 科学家把待解释的现象和解释本身区分开来。

e.en: The model served as the {explicans} for the strange data.
e.zh: 这个模型被用来解释那些奇怪的数据。

e.en: A good {explicans} should be clearer than the problem.
e.zh: 好的解释内容应当比问题本身更清楚。

e.en: The article included an {explicative} diagram.
e.zh: 文章中包含一张解释性的图表。

e.en: Her tone was calm and {explicative}.
e.zh: 她的语气平静而带有说明性。

e.en: He commented {explicatively} on the legal terms.
e.zh: 他对法律术语作了说明性评论。

e.en: The labels were arranged {explicatively} beside each image.
e.zh: 标签被说明性地放在每张图片旁边。

e.en: She became the clearest {explicator} of the poem.
e.zh: 她成了这首诗最清楚的阐释者。

e.en: A good {explicator} avoids unnecessary jargon.
e.zh: 好的解释者会避免不必要的行话。

e.en: The book opens with an {explicatory} chapter.
e.zh: 这本书开头有一章阐释性的内容。

e.en: His {explicatory} comments helped the audience follow.
e.zh: 他的解释性评论帮助观众跟上思路。

e.en: The contract's {explicity} reduced later disputes.
e.zh: 合同的明确性减少了后来的争议。

e.zh: 有些读者不喜欢这部小说情感表达太直白。

e.zh: 语言学家把这个音归为爆裂音。

e.zh: 那本旧手册把这种粉末称为爆炸物。

e.zh: 这个漏洞的可利用性使它成为严重安全风险。

e.zh: 工人抗议合同中存在的可剥削性。

e.zh: 报告谴责了对移民劳工的剥削。

e.zh: 这项发现很快就被商业利用。

e.en: They rejected the company's {exploitational} business model.
e.zh: 他们拒绝了这家公司剥削性的商业模式。

e.en: The film shows an {exploitational} attitude toward tragedy.
e.zh: 这部电影表现出一种利用悲剧牟利的态度。

e.zh: 这项法律旨在保护被剥削者，而不是雇主。

e.en: In the scam, each {exploitee} was promised easy money.
e.zh: 在骗局中，每个受利用者都被许诺能轻松赚钱。

e.en: The essay criticized the {exploiture} of public fear.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评了对公众恐惧的利用。

e.en: Early {exploiture} of the mine damaged the valley.
e.zh: 早期对矿山的开发破坏了山谷。

e.en: The team planned an {explorational} trip to the glacier.
e.zh: 团队计划了一次前往冰川的探索性旅行。

e.en: Their {explorational} research opened new questions.
e.zh: 他们的探索性研究提出了新的问题。

e.zh: 这位探索倡导者主张资助深海任务。

e.zh: 作为一名探索者，她重视不确定性。

e.zh: 工程师检测了这种气体的可爆性。

e.zh: 检查员从仓库里清除了所有易爆物质。

e.zh: 矿工进入前用爆炸性气体检测仪检查了隧道。

e.zh: 爆炸性气体检测仪可以提醒工人注意危险气体浓度。

e.zh: 摄影师用曝光计来设定合适的曝光。

e.zh: 一台旧手持测光表在明亮日光下仍然能用。

e.zh: 合同中的每个条款都可以按普通法律规则解释。

e.zh: 危机过后，该国推行出口拉动型增长。

e.zh: 出口拉动战略可能高度依赖国外需求。

e.zh: 设计师从一开始就考虑了该产品的可出口性。

e.zh: 严格的安全规定可能降低某些商品的出口潜力。

e.zh: 记者对这项阴谋的揭露震惊了公众。

e.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下损坏了那幅旧画。

e.zh: 讲师停下来阐释核心论点。

e.zh: 好的评论家能把一首难懂的诗讲清楚。

e.zh: 这部小说以一章很长的说明性内容开头。

e.zh: 她的阐述性风格让这个理论更容易理解。

e.zh: 这篇文章主要是说明性的，而不是论辩性的。

e.zh: 讲解这段文字时，他采用了解释性的语气。

e.zh: 她成了备受尊敬的古典哲学阐释者。

e.zh: 那位博物馆导览员耐心讲解当地历史。

e.zh: 他的阐释性注释帮助读者理解那篇布道。

e.en: The book has a calm, {expositorial} voice throughout.
e.zh: 这本书通篇都带着平和的讲解语气。

e.zh: 教授是以阐释方式发言，而不是诉诸情绪。

e.en: The passage is written {expositorily} to clarify a doctrine.
e.zh: 这一段以说明方式写成，用来阐明一条教义。

e.zh: 他说出鲁莽的话后，她用劝诫又不满的眼神看着他。

e.zh: 老教师用劝诫的口吻对吵闹的班级说话。

e.zh: 父亲以温和的劝诫回应了这个计划。

e.zh: 委员会的抗议式规劝没能阻止那项鲁莽政策。

e.en: The priest acted as an {expostulator} during the family dispute.
e.zh: 那位牧师在家庭争端中充当了劝诫者。

e.en: A persistent {expostulator} warned the council about the risks.
e.zh: 一位坚持劝阻的人提醒委员会注意这些风险。

e.en: He wrote an {expostulatory} letter to the minister.
e.zh: 他给部长写了一封带有劝诫和抗议意味的信。

e.en: Her {expostulatory} tone softened when he apologized.
e.zh: 他道歉后，她那种劝诫的语气缓和了下来。

e.zh: 文件突然被揭露，让官员们十分尴尬。

e.zh: 寒冷和雨水使那名徒步者陷入危险的暴露状态。

e.zh: 化学家在受控实验室条件下研究环氧化反应。

e.en: Efficient {expoxidation} can improve the yield of certain compounds.
e.zh: 高效的环氧化反应可以提高某些化合物的产率。

e.en: She sent the contract by {express-mail} on Monday.
e.zh: 她周一用特快专递寄出了合同。

e.zh: 护照在出行前刚好通过快递邮件送到。

e.zh: 发票中包含这批急件的快运费。

e.zh: 铁路快运服务曾在相距很远的城镇之间运送包裹。

e.zh: 舞者的表现力范围给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.zh: 儿童在表达能力的发展上差异很大。

e.zh: 这座城市以表现主义方式被描绘，街道扭曲，色彩强烈。

e.zh: 她以表现主义方式表演这一幕，而不是写实地表演。

e.zh: 这家诊所为创伤患者提供表达性治疗。

e.zh: 在表达性治疗中，音乐和绘画可以帮助情绪恢复。

e.zh: 探测器在火星上方探测到外大气层氢。

e.zh: 他们研究该行星外大气层物质的逃逸。

e.zh: 这次任务有几个外星生物学方面的目标。

e.zh: 外星生物学家寻找地球以外的生命迹象。

e.zh: 一些外星生物学家专注研究极端环境。

e.zh: 她在航天研究所学习外星生物学。

e.zh: 外部凝结影响了涂层最终的质地。

e.zh: 法院下令抹去那份旧逮捕记录。
