e.zh: 根据条约，使馆享有治外法权特权。

e.en: Older writers used {exterritorial} where extraterritorial is now common.
e.zh: 旧时作者使用exterritorial，如今更常见的是extraterritorial。

e.en: The treaty granted {exterritoriality} to foreign merchants.
e.zh: 该条约赋予外国商人治外法权。

e.en: Historians still debate the impact of {exterritoriality}.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在讨论治外法权的影响。

e.en: The new pesticide had an {extinctive} effect on local insects.
e.zh: 这种新农药对当地昆虫产生了导致灭绝的影响。

e.en: War can become an {extinctive} force against small cultures.
e.zh: 战争可能成为消灭小型文化的力量。

e.en: The report measured the species' {extinctivity} under climate stress.
e.zh: 报告衡量了该物种在气候压力下的灭绝倾向。

e.en: High {extinctivity} makes the ecosystem especially fragile.
e.zh: 高度的消亡倾向使这个生态系统格外脆弱。

e.en: The pollen's {extine} was thick enough to survive fossilization.
e.zh: 这种花粉的外壁厚到足以在化石化过程中保存下来。

e.en: Researchers examined the {extine} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下检查了花粉外壁。

e.en: The small fire was easily {extinguishable} with a blanket.
e.zh: 这场小火用毯子很容易扑灭。

e.en: Some legal rights are {extinguishable} after a fixed period.
e.zh: 有些法律权利在固定期限后可以终止。

e.en: The {extinguishment} of the fire took three hours.
e.zh: 扑灭这场火花了三个小时。

e.en: The contract confirmed the {extinguishment} of the old debt.
e.zh: 合同确认旧债已经消除。

e.en: The government adopted an {extirpative} policy toward the disease.
e.zh: 政府对这种疾病采取了根除性的政策。

e.en: His criticism had an {extirpative} tone, rejecting the whole tradition.
e.zh: 他的批评带有彻底清除的语气，否定了整个传统。

e.en: The doctor became known as an {extirpator} of rural epidemics.
e.zh: 这位医生以根除农村流行病而闻名。

e.en: The reformer saw himself as an {extirpator} of corruption.
e.zh: 这位改革者把自己看作腐败的铲除者。

e.en: The campaign used {extirpatory} measures against the invasive plant.
e.zh: 这场行动对入侵植物采取了根除性措施。

e.en: Her speech sounded almost {extirpatory} in its attack on old customs.
e.zh: 她的演讲在攻击旧习俗时听起来几乎像是要彻底铲除它们。

e.en: Critics {extoll} the novel for its precise language.
e.zh: 评论家高度赞扬这部小说语言精准。

e.en: The mayor used the speech to {extoll} local volunteers.
e.zh: 市长借这次演讲颂扬当地志愿者。

e.en: The ceremony became an {extolment} of civic courage.
e.zh: 这场仪式成了对公民勇气的颂扬。

e.en: His {extolment} of the leader sounded excessive.
e.zh: 他对那位领导人的高度赞美听起来过头了。

e.en: The old document accused him of {extorsion} and fraud.
e.zh: 那份旧文件指控他勒索和诈骗。

e.en: The court treated {extorsion} as a serious public offense.
e.zh: 法院把勒索视为严重的公共犯罪。

e.en: The landlord's {extorsive} demands frightened the tenants.
e.zh: 房东勒索性的要求吓坏了租户。

e.en: Officials condemned the gang's {extorsive} control of the market.
e.zh: 官员谴责该团伙对市场的强取式控制。

e.en: The company charged {extortionary} fees for basic repairs.
e.zh: 这家公司对基本维修收取高得离谱的费用。

e.en: Police investigated the group's {extortionary} threats against shopkeepers.
e.zh: 警方调查该团伙对店主的敲诈性威胁。

e.en: The rebels used {extortive} tactics to raise money.
e.zh: 叛乱者用勒索手段筹集资金。

e.en: Her lawyer described the settlement as {extortive} pressure.
e.zh: 她的律师称这项和解是强逼取得的压力结果。

e.en: She joined three {extra-curricular} clubs this term.
e.zh: 这学期她参加了三个课外社团。

e.en: Universities often value {extra-curricular} achievements as well as grades.
e.zh: 大学通常既看重成绩，也看重课外成就。

e.en: He ordered an {extra-large} pizza for the party.
e.zh: 他为聚会点了一个特大号披萨。

e.en: This jacket comes in an {extra-large} size.
e.zh: 这件夹克有特大号尺码。

e.en: The scandal involved an {extra-marital} relationship.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻涉及一段婚外关系。

e.en: They discussed the emotional damage caused by {extra-marital} affairs.
e.zh: 他们讨论了婚外情造成的情感伤害。

extra-special.t: 格外特别的；特别优待的

e.en: We made an {extra-special} dinner for her birthday.
e.zh: 我们为她的生日做了一顿格外特别的晚餐。

e.en: The hotel gave returning guests {extra-special} treatment.
e.zh: 酒店给回头客特别优待。

e.en: Scientists searched for {extra-terrestrial} life on distant planets.
e.zh: 科学家在遥远行星上寻找地球外生命。

e.en: The film begins with an {extra-terrestrial} signal from space.
e.zh: 这部电影以一个来自太空的外星信号开场。

e.en: The children imagined friendly {extra-terrestrials} visiting Earth.
e.zh: 孩子们想象友好的外星人造访地球。

e.en: Some theories claim that {extra-terrestrials} built the ancient monument.
e.zh: 有些理论声称外星人建造了那座古代纪念碑。

extraartistic.t: 艺术之外的；非艺术因素的

e.en: The critic ignored {extraartistic} details about the painter's private life.
e.zh: 评论家忽略了画家私生活中与艺术无关的细节。

e.en: Funding pressures created {extraartistic} limits on the exhibition.
e.zh: 资金压力给展览带来了艺术之外的限制。

extraatmospheric.t: 大气层外的；外层空间的

e.en: The satellite entered an {extraatmospheric} path after launch.
e.zh: 卫星发射后进入了大气层外轨道。

e.en: Engineers tested materials for {extraatmospheric} radiation exposure.
e.zh: 工程师测试材料承受外层空间辐射的能力。

e.en: Use an {extrabold} font for the poster title.
e.zh: 海报标题请使用特粗字体。

e.en: The logo looked clearer in an {extrabold} weight.
e.zh: 这个标志用超粗字重时看起来更清晰。

e.en: The specimen had an {extrabranchial} fold near the gills.
e.zh: 这个标本在鳃附近有一个鳃外褶皱。

e.en: Biologists noted {extrabranchial} tissue during the dissection.
e.zh: 生物学家在解剖时注意到鳃外组织。

e.en: The room needs an {extrabright} lamp for detailed work.
e.zh: 这个房间需要一盏超亮的灯来做精细工作。

e.en: She chose {extrabright} colors for the children's mural.
e.zh: 她为儿童壁画选择了格外明亮的颜色。

extracanonical.t: 非正典的；超出经典范围的

e.en: The appendix includes {extracanonical} writings from the same period.
e.zh: 附录收录了同一时期的非正典著作。

e.en: Her argument relies on {extracanonical} details ignored by most scholars.
e.zh: 她的论证依赖多数 学者忽略的正典外细节。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the {extracapsular} ligament after the injury.
e.zh: 外科医生在受伤后修复了关节囊外韧带。

e.en: The scan showed {extracapsular} spread of the tumor.
e.zh: 扫描显示肿瘤已向包囊外扩散。

e.en: Some bacteria carry antibiotic resistance on {extrachromosomal} DNA.
e.zh: 一些细菌把抗生素耐药性携带在染色体外DNA上。

e.en: The lab detected {extrachromosomal} circles in the cancer cells.
e.zh: 实验室在癌细胞中检测到染色体外环状结构。

e.en: The manuscript felt {extracondensed} after several rounds of cuts.
e.zh: 几轮删减后，这份手稿显得过度浓缩。

e.en: Researchers observed {extracondensed} chromatin in the damaged cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在受损细胞中观察到超凝缩染色质。

e.en: The committee rejected any {extraconstitutional} transfer of power.
e.zh: 委员会拒绝任何宪法之外的权力转移。

e.en: Critics called the emergency council an {extraconstitutional} body.
e.zh: 批评者称这个紧急委员会是超宪法机构。

e.en: The patient needed {extracorporeal} support while her lungs recovered.
e.zh: 患者在肺部恢复期间需要体外支持。

e.en: The hospital expanded its {extracorporeal} dialysis service.
e.zh: 医院扩大了体外透析服务。

e.en: The blood was oxygenated {extracorporeally} during the procedure.
e.zh: 手术过程中，血液通过体外方式充氧。

e.en: Some toxins can be removed {extracorporeally} with dialysis.
e.zh: 有些毒素可以通过透析在体外清除。

e.en: The scan revealed an {extracranial} injury near the temple.
e.zh: 扫描显示太阳穴附近有颅外损伤。

e.en: Doctors checked the {extracranial} arteries for narrowing.
e.zh: 医生检查了颅外动脉是否狭窄。

e.en: The team measured the {extractability} of oil from the seeds.
e.zh: 团队测量了从种子中提取油脂的可提取性。

e.en: Soil chemistry affects the {extractability} of heavy metals.
e.zh: 土壤化学性质会影响重金属的可萃取性。

e.en: The chemist chose a safer {extractant} for the experiment.
e.zh: 化学家为实验选择了一种更安全的萃取剂。

e.en: This {extractant} separates copper from the acidic solution.
e.zh: 这种萃取剂能把铜从酸性溶液中分离出来。

e.en: Only a small fraction of the mineral was {extractible}.
e.zh: 这种矿物只有一小部分可以提取。

e.en: The report lists the {extractible} compounds in the plant.
e.zh: 报告列出了该植物中可萃取的化合物。

e.en: The pharmacist noted an {extractiform} residue in the vial.
e.zh: 药剂师注意到小瓶里有浸膏样残留物。

e.en: Heating produced an {extractiform} mass with a bitter smell.
e.zh: 加热后形成了一团带苦味气味的提取物状物质。

e.en: The judge refused to consider {extracurial} comments about the case.
e.zh: 法官拒绝考虑关于此案的庭外评论。

e.en: Lawyers warned that {extracurial} pressure could affect the trial.
e.zh: 律师警告说，法院外压力可能影响审判。

e.en: The device failed when an {extracurrent} entered the circuit.
e.zh: 额外电流进入电路时，设备发生故障。

e.en: Engineers measured the {extracurrent} produced after the switch opened.
e.zh: 工程师测量了开关断开后产生的外电流。

e.en: The school added robotics to its {extracurriculum} this year.
e.zh: 学校今年把机器人课程加入了课外课程。

e.en: Her {extracurriculum} included debate, coding, and volunteer work.
e.zh: 她的课程外活动包括辩论、编程和志愿服务。

e.en: The cream showed no {extracutaneous} effects in the study.
e.zh: 研究中这种乳膏未显示皮肤外影响。

e.en: Doctors looked for {extracutaneous} signs of the infection.
e.zh: 医生寻找这种感染的皮外表现。

e.en: The offense is {extraditable} under the treaty.
e.zh: 根据该条约，这项罪行属于可引渡罪行。

e.en: Officials argued that the suspect was {extraditable}.
e.zh: 官员认为这名嫌疑人可以被引渡。

e.en: Masons repaired cracks along the bridge's {extrados}.
e.zh: 石匠修补了桥拱背上的裂缝。

e.en: The drawing marks the {extrados} of the old stone arch.
e.zh: 图纸标出了旧石拱的外弧面。

e.en: The scan suggested an {extradural} hematoma after the fall.
e.zh: 扫描提示跌倒后出现硬膜外血肿。

e.en: She received an {extradural} injection for pain relief.
e.zh: 她接受了硬膜外注射来缓解疼痛。

e.en: The placenta develops from {extraembryonic} tissues.
e.zh: 胎盘由胚外组织发育而来。

e.en: Scientists studied {extraembryonic} membranes in early development.
e.zh: 科学家研究了早期发育中的胚外膜。

extraessential.t: 非本质的；额外必要之外的

e.en: The editor removed {extraessential} details from the chapter.
e.zh: 编辑删去了这一章中非本质的细节。

e.en: Philosophers debated whether beauty was {extraessential} to the object.
e.zh: 哲学家争论美是否对该物而言是非本质的。

e.en: Ants fed on the plant's {extrafloral} nectar.
e.zh: 蚂蚁取食这种植物的花外蜜。

e.en: The botanist examined {extrafloral} glands on the leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家检查了叶片上的花外蜜腺。

e.en: The festival planned several {extraforaneous} performances downtown.
e.zh: 节日在市中心安排了几场户外演出。

e.en: Rain forced the {extraforaneous} meeting into a hall.
e.zh: 下雨迫使这场室外会议转到大厅里举行。

extragovernmental.t: 政府外的；非政府体系的

e.en: The report came from an {extragovernmental} watchdog group.
e.zh: 这份报告来自一个政府外监督组织。

e.en: They sought {extragovernmental} funding for the health project.
e.zh: 他们为这个健康项目寻求非政府体系的资金。

e.en: The lab requires special training for {extrahazardous} materials.
e.zh: 实验室要求处理特别危险材料前接受专门培训。

e.en: Insurers classified the expedition as {extrahazardous}.
e.zh: 保险公司把这次探险归为超高危活动。

e.en: The scan showed an {extrahepatic} blockage in the bile duct.
e.zh: 扫描显示胆管有肝外阻塞。

e.en: Doctors suspected {extrahepatic} spread of the infection.
e.zh: 医生怀疑感染已经扩散到肝外。

e.en: The group used {extralegal} pressure to silence critics.
e.zh: 该组织用法外压力压制批评者。

e.en: Some disputes were settled through {extralegal} local customs.
e.zh: 有些纠纷通过法律之外的地方习俗解决。

e.en: Birdwatchers recorded an {extralimital} sighting far north of the species range.
e.zh: 观鸟者记录到一次远在该物种分布区以北的超范围目击。

e.en: The museum noted the shell as an {extralimital} specimen.
e.zh: 博物馆把这枚贝壳标为超出正常范围的标本。

e.en: The essay examines {extraliterary} factors behind the novel's success.
e.zh: 这篇文章考察了小说成功背后的非文学因素。

e.en: Her reading often includes {extraliterary} evidence from politics and law.
e.zh: 她的解读常纳入来自政治和法律的文学外证据。

e.en: The philosopher described the object's {extrality} as independent of thought.
e.zh: 这位哲学家把物体的外在性描述为独立于思想。

e.en: The film gives the dream a strange sense of {extrality}.
e.zh: 这部电影让梦境带有一种奇异的超越现实感。

e.en: The mission studied {extralunar} dust collected beyond the Moon's orbit.
e.zh: 这次任务研究了在月球轨道之外采集的月外尘埃。

e.en: They debated possible {extralunar} bases for future exploration.
e.zh: 他们讨论了未来探索可能使用的月球以外基地。

e.en: The lesion had {extramarginal} growth beyond the visible border.
e.zh: 病灶在可见边界之外还有边缘外生长。

e.en: Her notes included {extramarginal} comments squeezed beside the page.
e.zh: 她的笔记还包括挤在页边之外的旁注。

extramental.t: 心智之外的；外在于心的

e.en: He argued that truth depends on an {extramental} reality.
e.zh: 他认为真理取决于心智之外的现实。

e.en: The theory denies any {extramental} source of moral value.
e.zh: 该理论否认道德价值有任何外在于心的来源。

e.en: The enzyme also has an {extramitochondrial} role in cell signaling.
e.zh: 这种酶在细胞信号传导中也有线粒体外作用。

e.en: Researchers measured {extramitochondrial} calcium during the experiment.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验中测量了线粒体外钙离子。

extramolecular.t: 分子外的；分子间外部的

e.en: The reaction depends on {extramolecular} forces in the solution.
e.zh: 该反应取决于溶液中的分子外作用力。

e.en: They modeled the drug's {extramolecular} interactions with nearby proteins.
e.zh: 他们模拟了药物与邻近蛋白的分子外相互作用。

e.en: The poem imagines an {extramundane} realm beyond ordinary life.
e.zh: 这首诗想象了一个超越日常生活的尘世之外境界。

e.en: His voice gave the ritual an {extramundane} feeling.
e.zh: 他的声音让仪式带上了超凡的感觉。

e.en: Some inheritance is controlled by {extranuclear} genetic material.
e.zh: 有些遗传受细胞核外遗传物质控制。

e.en: The stain revealed {extranuclear} particles in the cytoplasm.
e.zh: 染色显示细胞质中有核外颗粒。

e.en: The surgeon checked the {extraocular} muscles before the operation.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前检查了眼外肌。

e.en: The infection spread to {extraocular} tissue around the socket.
e.zh: 感染扩散到了眼眶周围的眼球外组织。

extraofficial.t: 官方之外的；非正式官方的

e.en: The minister made an {extraofficial} promise after the meeting.
e.zh: 部长在会后作出了一项官方之外的承诺。

e.en: News first came through {extraofficial} channels in the capital.
e.zh: 消息最先通过首都的非正式官方渠道传出。

e.en: The {extraordinariness} of her talent was obvious early on.
e.zh: 她才华的非凡之处很早就显露出来。

e.en: He tried to hide the {extraordinariness} of the discovery.
e.zh: 他试图掩盖这项发现的异常重要。

e.en: The botanist described the leaf as {extraovate} and slightly glossy.
e.zh: 植物学家把这片叶子描述为极卵形且略有光泽。

e.en: Its {extraovate} petals made the specimen easy to identify.
e.zh: 它特卵形的花瓣使这个标本易于辨认。

e.en: The study measured {extraparental} support from teachers and neighbors.
e.zh: 该研究衡量了来自教师和邻里的非父母支持。

e.en: Children may seek {extraparental} advice during adolescence.
e.zh: 孩子在青春期可能会寻求父母之外的建议。

e.en: The movement relied on {extraparliamentary} protest to gain attention.
e.zh: 这场运动依靠议会外抗议来获得关注。

e.en: Leaders discussed {extraparliamentary} ways to influence the bill.
e.zh: 领导人讨论了影响该法案的非议会途径。

extraparochial.t: 教区之外的；狭隘圈外的

e.en: The charity accepted {extraparochial} donations from neighboring towns.
e.zh: 该慈善机构接受了邻近城镇的教区外捐款。

e.en: She urged students to develop an {extraparochial} view of politics.
e.zh: 她敦促学生形成超越狭隘圈子的政治视野。

e.en: The lecture explored {extraphysical} explanations for consciousness.
e.zh: 讲座探讨了意识的超物理解释。

e.en: He rejected any {extraphysical} cause for the strange event.
e.zh: 他拒绝用任何物质之外的原因解释这件怪事。

e.en: The small sample limited the study's {extrapolability}.
e.zh: 样本太小限制了该研究的可外推性。

e.en: Reviewers questioned the {extrapolability} of the animal results to humans.
e.zh: 审稿人质疑动物结果能否外推到人类。

extraprofessional.t: 职业之外的；非专业领域的

e.en: Her {extraprofessional} interests include music and urban gardening.
e.zh: 她的职业外兴趣包括音乐和城市园艺。

e.en: The code warns judges against {extraprofessional} conduct that harms trust.
e.zh: 该准则警告法官避免损害信任的职业外行为。

e.en: The drug can cause {extrapyramidal} side effects in some patients.
e.zh: 这种药可能在部分患者中引起锥体外系副作用。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {extrapyramidal} symptoms after changing the dose.
e.zh: 医生在调整剂量后监测他的锥体外系症状。

e.en: The patient showed {extrarenal} signs of the autoimmune disease.
e.zh: 患者出现了这种自身免疫病的肾外表现。

e.en: Researchers studied {extrarenal} clearance of the compound.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了该化合物的肾外清除。

e.en: Funding decisions often involve {extrascientific} social pressures.
e.zh: 资助决定常涉及科学之外的社会压力。

e.en: The article separates scientific claims from {extrascientific} beliefs.
e.zh: 这篇文章把科学主张和非科学信念区分开来。

e.en: The baby blanket felt {extrasoft} against her skin.
e.zh: 这条婴儿毯贴着她的皮肤，摸起来格外柔软。

e.en: Choose an {extrasoft} brush for polishing the lens.
e.zh: 给镜片抛光时要选用极柔软的刷子。

e.en: The monitor recorded an {extrasystole} during the examination.
e.zh: 检查时监护仪记录到一次早搏。

e.en: An occasional {extrasystole} may feel like a skipped heartbeat.
e.zh: 偶发的期外收缩可能让人觉得心跳漏了一拍。

e.en: The doctor noticed an {extrasystolic} beat on the ECG.
e.zh: 医生在心电图上注意到一次早搏性搏动。

e.en: His {extrasystolic} rhythm became more frequent under stress.
e.zh: 他在压力下早搏性的心律变得更频繁。

e.en: The novel imagines an {extratellurian} civilization near Jupiter.
e.zh: 这部小说想象了木星附近的地外文明。

e.en: Scientists searched the meteorite for {extratellurian} minerals.
e.zh: 科学家在陨石中寻找地球以外的矿物。

e.en: The hurricane became {extratropical} before reaching Canada.
e.zh: 飓风到达加拿大前转变为温带气旋。

e.en: An {extratropical} storm brought heavy rain to the coast.
e.zh: 一场热带外风暴给海岸带来了大雨。

e.en: An {extrauterine} pregnancy can require urgent treatment.
e.zh: 子宫外妊娠可能需要紧急治疗。

e.en: The scan showed {extrauterine} growth of the tissue.
e.zh: 扫描显示组织在子宫外生长。

e.en: The palace was famous for its {extravagancy}.
e.zh: 这座宫殿以奢华铺张闻名。

e.en: She criticized the {extravagancy} of his promises.
e.zh: 她批评他的承诺过于夸张。

e.en: The speaker began to {extravagate} from the main argument.
e.zh: 演讲者开始偏离主要论点。

e.en: The old poem lets the mind {extravagate} through strange landscapes.
e.zh: 这首旧诗让思绪在奇异景色中漫游。

e.en: The essay's {extravagation} made its argument hard to follow.
e.zh: 这篇文章的离题发挥让论证难以跟上。

e.en: He enjoyed a mental {extravagation} during the long train ride.
e.zh: 漫长的火车旅途中，他享受了一次思绪漫游。

e.en: The nurse checked whether the drug might {extravasate}.
e.zh: 护士检查药物是否可能外渗。

e.en: Blood can {extravasate} into nearby tissue after trauma.
e.zh: 外伤后血液可能渗出到附近组织中。

e.en: The scan revealed {extravasated} contrast near the artery.
e.zh: 扫描显示动脉附近有外渗的造影剂。

e.en: The surgeon removed the {extravasated} blood from the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生清除了伤口中渗出的血液。

e.en: If the fluid {extravasates}, the skin may swell quickly.
e.zh: 如果液体外渗，皮肤可能很快肿胀。

e.en: The dye {extravasates} when the vessel wall is damaged.
e.zh: 血管壁受损时，染料会渗出血管。

e.en: The team stopped the {extravasating} infusion immediately.
e.zh: 团队立即停止了正在外渗的输液。

e.en: Imaging showed blood {extravasating} into the abdominal cavity.
e.zh: 影像显示血液正渗入腹腔。

e.en: The nurse treated the {extravasation} around the IV site.
e.zh: 护士处理了静脉针位置周围的外渗。

e.en: Contrast {extravasation} suggested an active internal bleed.
e.zh: 造影剂外渗提示体内仍在活动性出血。

e.en: The medicine moved into the {extravascular} space slowly.
e.zh: 药物缓慢进入血管外间隙。

e.en: Doctors measured {extravascular} fluid in the lung tissue.
e.zh: 医生测量了肺组织中的血管外液体。

e.en: The astronaut prepared for an {extravehicular} activity.
e.zh: 宇航员为一次舱外活动做准备。

e.en: The suit protects crew members during {extravehicular} repairs.
e.zh: 这套宇航服在舱外维修时保护机组人员。

e.en: The scan showed an {extraventricular} mass near the brainstem.
e.zh: 扫描显示脑干附近有一个脑室外肿块。

e.en: An {extraventricular} rhythm may originate outside the heart ventricles.
e.zh: 心室外节律可能起源于心室以外。

e.en: Her {extraversive} style made group work easier.
e.zh: 她外向的作风让小组合作更顺畅。

e.en: The therapist noted an {extraversive} movement of the eye.
e.zh: 治疗师注意到眼球有向外转动。

e.en: The paper described a hypothetical {extraviolet} band of radiation.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种假想的紫外线以外辐射带。

e.en: Old instruments could not detect the {extraviolet} signal.
e.zh: 旧仪器无法探测到这种紫外线以外的信号。

e.en: The graph has two local {extrema}.
e.zh: 这张图有两个局部极值。

e.en: Climate records often focus on seasonal {extrema}.
e.zh: 气候记录常常关注季节性的极端值。

e.en: The patient was in {extremis} when help arrived.
e.zh: 救援到达时，病人已处于生命垂危状态。

e.en: Leaders sometimes make harsh decisions in {extremis}.
e.zh: 领导者有时会在危急关头作出严厉决定。

e.en: The function reaches an {extremum} at zero.
e.zh: 这个函数在零点达到一个极值。

e.en: Engineers tested the design at every expected {extremum}.
e.zh: 工程师在每个预期的极端点测试了设计。

e.en: The firefighter became the trapped driver's {extricator}.
e.zh: 消防员成了被困司机的解救者。

e.en: They used a hydraulic {extricator} to open the crushed door.
e.zh: 他们用液压救援工具打开了被压坏的车门。

e.en: The judge ignored {extrinsical} details unrelated to the contract.
e.zh: 法官忽略了与合同无关的外在细节。

e.en: His motivation was {extrinsical}, driven mostly by rewards.
e.zh: 他的动机是外在的，主要由奖励驱动。

e.en: The geologist identified an {extrolite} in the volcanic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山岩中识别出一块外来岩块。

e.en: An {extrolite} can reveal the history of deeper crust.
e.zh: 外来岩块可以揭示更深地壳的历史。

e.en: The flower has {extrorse} anthers that open away from the center.
e.zh: 这种花的花药向外开裂，背离花心。

e.en: Botanists described the small spines as {extrorse}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些小刺描述为向外伸展。

e.en: Her {extroversive} style helped the team speak more openly.
e.zh: 她外向的作风让团队更愿意坦诚交流。

e.en: The theory contrasts introversive and {extroversive} tendencies.
e.zh: 这个理论对比了内倾和外倾的倾向。

e.en: He seemed {extrovertish} at parties but quiet at work.
e.zh: 他在聚会上显得有点外向，但工作时很安静。

e.en: The role needs an {extrovertish} confidence, not constant chatter.
e.zh: 这个角色需要一点外向的自信，而不是不停说话。

e.en: The counselor noticed his strongly {extrovertive} behavior in groups.
e.zh: 咨询师注意到他在群体中表现出很强的外向行为。

e.en: Some cultures reward an {extrovertive} manner in public life.
e.zh: 有些文化会奖励公共生活中的外向作风。

e.en: The mechanic used an {extructor} to remove the damaged bolt.
e.zh: 机械师用取出器拆下了损坏的螺栓。

e.en: A dental {extructor} must grip the tooth without crushing it.
e.zh: 牙科取出器必须夹住牙齿而不把它压碎。

e.en: Engineers tested the polymer's {extrudability} before production began.
e.zh: 工程师在投产前测试了这种聚合物的可挤出性。

e.en: Moisture can affect the dough's {extrudability} in pasta making.
e.zh: 水分会影响意面制作中面团的挤压成形性。

extrudable.t: 可挤出的；可挤压成形的

e.en: The recycled plastic is {extrudable} at lower temperatures.
e.zh: 这种再生塑料在较低温度下就可挤出成形。

e.en: They developed an {extrudable} paste for 3D printing ceramics.
e.zh: 他们开发了一种可挤出的浆料，用于三维打印陶瓷。

e.en: The hot {extrudant} cooled as it left the die.
e.zh: 热的挤出物离开模具后逐渐冷却。

e.en: Technicians checked the {extrudant} for bubbles and cracks.
e.zh: 技术人员检查挤出材料是否有气泡和裂纹。

e.en: The rubber {extrudate} was cut into equal lengths.
e.zh: 橡胶挤出物被切成等长的段。

e.en: A smooth {extrudate} indicates steady pressure inside the machine.
e.zh: 平滑的挤压成品说明机器内部压力稳定。

e.en: Basalt is a common {extrusive} volcanic rock.
e.zh: 玄武岩是一种常见的喷出火山岩。

e.en: The factory specializes in {extrusive} processes for plastic tubing.
e.zh: 这家工厂专门做塑料管材的挤出工艺。

e.en: Doctors decided to {extubate} the patient after her breathing improved.
e.zh: 病人呼吸好转后，医生决定为她拔除插管。

e.en: It is risky to {extubate} too soon after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后过早拔管有风险。

e.en: The garden's {exuberancy} surprised everyone after the rain.
e.zh: 雨后花园的繁茂让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: Her youthful {exuberancy} filled the room with laughter.
e.zh: 她年轻人的活力让房间里充满笑声。

e.en: The children seemed to {exuberate} with energy on the playground.
e.zh: 孩子们在操场上似乎洋溢着精力。

e.en: The mural appears to {exuberate} in color and movement.
e.zh: 这幅壁画在色彩和动感上显得生气勃勃。

e.en: The crowd {exuberated} with pride after the victory.
e.zh: 胜利之后，人群洋溢着自豪。

e.en: The restored park {exuberated} with flowers in spring.
e.zh: 修复后的公园在春天鲜花繁盛。

e.en: Her writing {exuberates} with humor and warmth.
e.zh: 她的文字洋溢着幽默和温情。

e.en: The forest {exuberates} after weeks of heavy rain.
e.zh: 连日大雨之后，森林显得格外繁盛。

e.en: The dancers were {exuberating} joy during the festival.
e.zh: 舞者们在节日里洋溢着喜悦。

e.en: The landscape was {exuberating} with new spring growth.
e.zh: 这片景色因春天的新生长而显得蓬勃。

e.en: The nurse noted {exudation} from the wound.
e.zh: 护士注意到伤口有渗出。

e.en: Resin {exudation} can protect a tree after injury.
e.zh: 树脂渗出可以在树木受伤后起到保护作用。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed an {exudative} eye condition.
e.zh: 医生诊断出一种渗出性眼病。

e.en: An {exudative} wound often needs careful cleaning.
e.zh: 有渗出的伤口通常需要仔细清洁。

e.en: Ancient baths sometimes included an {exudatoria} for sweating.
e.zh: 古代浴场有时设有用于发汗的房间。

e.en: The guide explained that the {exudatoria} functioned like a sauna.
e.zh: 导游解释说，这个发汗室的作用类似桑拿。

e.en: A mood of {exultance} spread through the stadium.
e.zh: 狂喜的气氛在体育场里蔓延开来。

e.en: Her quiet {exultance} showed in a small smile.
e.zh: 她含蓄的喜悦从一个微笑中流露出来。

e.en: The team's {exultancy} was obvious after the final whistle.
e.zh: 终场哨响后，球队的欢腾显而易见。

e.en: There was no cruelty in his {exultancy}, only relief.
e.zh: 他的得意喜悦中没有恶意，只有如释重负。

e.en: She raised the trophy {exultingly} above her head.
e.zh: 她欢欣地把奖杯举过头顶。

e.en: He laughed {exultingly} when the verdict was announced.
e.zh: 判决宣布时，他得意扬扬地笑了起来。

e.en: The jellyfish's {exumbrella} was marked with pale stripes.
e.zh: 这只水母伞状体的外表面带有淡色条纹。

e.en: Researchers measured the {exumbrella} to compare jellyfish growth.
e.zh: 研究人员测量伞状体外表面，以比较水母的生长情况。

e.en: They moved to an {exurban} community beyond the commuter rail line.
e.zh: 他们搬到了通勤铁路外的一处远郊社区。

e.en: The county faces pressure from {exurban} housing development.
e.zh: 该县正面临城市外围住宅开发的压力。

exurbanite.t: 远郊居民；城市外围居民

e.en: As an {exurbanite}, she drives an hour to work each morning.
e.zh: 作为远郊居民，她每天早上开车一小时去上班。

e.en: The article mocked the new {exurbanite} taste for large houses and quiet roads.
e.zh: 那篇文章嘲讽了新兴远郊居民偏爱大房子和安静道路的品味。

exurbia.t: 远郊地区；城市外围住宅带

e.en: Many families moved to {exurbia} for cheaper homes.
e.zh: 许多家庭为了更便宜的住房搬到了远郊地区。

e.en: The novel portrays {exurbia} as comfortable but isolating.
e.zh: 这部小说把城市外围住宅带描写得舒适却孤立。

e.en: The doctor described the gland as an {exutory} organ.
e.zh: 医生把这个腺体描述为排泄器官。

e.en: Old medical texts sometimes used {exutory} for processes that remove waste.
e.zh: 旧医学文献有时用exutory来指排出废物的过程。

e.en: A dry {exuvia} clung to the tree bark after the cicada emerged.
e.zh: 蝉羽化后，一层干燥的蜕壳贴在树皮上。

e.en: The biologist collected the {exuvia} to identify the insect species.
e.zh: 生物学家收集那层蜕皮来辨认昆虫种类。

e.en: The shed {exuviae} showed where the nymphs had matured.
e.zh: 那些脱落的遗蜕显示若虫曾在那里成熟。

e.en: Museum drawers held delicate {exuviae} from rare insects.
e.zh: 博物馆抽屉里保存着稀有昆虫脆弱的蜕壳。

e.en: The researcher studied the {exuvial} remains under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察蜕皮遗留物。

e.en: An {exuvial} case can reveal the insect's final juvenile stage.
e.zh: 蜕壳外壳能显示昆虫最后一个幼年阶段。

e.en: Snakes {exuviate} as they grow larger.
e.zh: 蛇在长大时会蜕皮。

e.en: The crab must {exuviate} before its new shell can harden.
e.zh: 螃蟹必须先脱壳，新壳才能变硬。

e.en: The {exuviated} shell lay beside the empty chrysalis.
e.zh: 蜕下的外壳躺在空蛹壳旁边。

e.en: After it had {exuviated}, the insect looked pale and soft.
e.zh: 昆虫蜕皮后，看起来颜色很淡而且身体柔软。

e.en: The young spider {exuviates} several times before adulthood.
e.zh: 幼蛛在成年前会蜕皮好几次。

e.en: When a lobster {exuviates}, it hides until the new shell hardens.
e.zh: 龙虾脱壳时会躲起来，直到新壳变硬。

e.en: The {exuviating} cicada slowly pulled free of its old skin.
e.zh: 正在蜕皮的蝉慢慢从旧皮里挣脱出来。

e.en: Researchers filmed the crab {exuviating} in the tank.
e.zh: 研究人员拍下了螃蟹在水箱中脱壳的过程。

e.en: The timing of {exuviation} depends on temperature and growth.
e.zh: 蜕皮的时间取决于温度和生长情况。

e.en: During {exuviation}, the animal is briefly soft and vulnerable.
e.zh: 在脱壳过程中，动物会短暂变得柔软而脆弱。

e.en: The chapel wall was covered with small {exvoto} paintings.
e.zh: 小教堂的墙上挂满了小幅还愿画。

e.en: She left an {exvoto} after recovering from the illness.
e.zh: 她病愈后留下了一件谢恩供品。

e.en: He still speaks kindly of his {exwife}.
e.zh: 他提起前妻时仍然很客气。

e.en: My {exwife} and I share custody of our son.
e.zh: 我和前妻共同拥有儿子的监护权。

e.en: The quotation was {exworks}, so shipping was not included.
e.zh: 报价是工厂交货价，因此不包括运费。

e.en: They bought the machinery {exworks} and arranged their own transport.
e.zh: 他们按出厂价购买机器，并自行安排运输。

e.en: The falconer fed the {eyas} by hand.
e.zh: 驯鹰人亲手喂养那只雏鹰。

e.en: An {eyas} must learn to fly before it can hunt.
e.zh: 幼猎鹰必须先学会飞行，才能捕猎。

eye-candy.t: 养眼之物；徒有外表的人物

e.en: The film offers plenty of {eye-candy} but little story.
e.zh: 这部电影有很多养眼画面，但故事很单薄。

e.en: He hated being treated as {eye-candy} at the event.
e.zh: 他讨厌在活动中被当成只有外表可看的花瓶。

e.en: The red poster was an immediate {eye-catcher} in the hallway.
e.zh: 那张红色海报在走廊里立刻吸引了眼球。

e.en: Her silver jacket was the {eye-catcher} of the whole outfit.
e.zh: 她那件银色夹克是整套装扮中最抢眼的部分。

e.en: The garden made an {eye-filling} display in spring.
e.zh: 春天的花园呈现出饱满悦目的景象。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {eye-filling} scenery and costumes.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部电影的景色和服装十分养眼。

e.en: The old scholar adjusted his {eye-glass} before reading.
e.zh: 老学者在阅读前调整了一下单片眼镜。

e.en: A scratched {eye-glass} can make the whole frame uncomfortable.
e.zh: 一片刮花的眼镜片会让整副眼镜戴起来不舒服。

e.en: He peered through the {eye-hole} in the mask.
e.zh: 他透过面具上的眼孔向外看。

e.en: The door had a tiny {eye-hole} for checking visitors.
e.zh: 门上有一个小小的窥孔，用来查看访客。

e.en: An {eye-lash} fell onto her cheek.
e.zh: 一根睫毛落在了她的脸颊上。

e.en: She brushed away an {eye-lash} before applying mascara.
e.zh: 她在涂睫毛膏前拂去了一根睫毛。

e.en: The {eye-lens} focuses light onto the retina.
e.zh: 眼睛的晶状体把光线聚焦到视网膜上。

e.en: Dust on the {eye-lens} made the microscope image cloudy.
e.zh: 目镜透镜上的灰尘让显微镜图像变得模糊。

eye-level.t: 与眼睛同高的；平视高度

e.en: Place the monitor at {eye-level} to reduce neck strain.
e.zh: 把显示器放在与眼睛同高的位置，以减轻颈部压力。

e.en: The painting was hung at {eye-level} for most visitors.
e.zh: 那幅画挂在大多数访客平视即可看到的高度。

eye-opener.t: 令人大开眼界的事物或经历；警醒之事

e.en: The documentary was a real {eye-opener} for many viewers.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让许多观众大开眼界。

e.en: Losing that client was an {eye-opener} for the whole team.
e.zh: 失去那位客户给整个团队敲响了警钟。

eye-openers.t: 令人大开眼界的事物；警醒之事

e.en: Travel often provides unexpected {eye-openers} about daily life.
e.zh: 旅行常会让人意外看见日常生活的新面貌。

e.en: The audit revealed several {eye-openers} about company spending.
e.zh: 审计揭示了公司开支中几件令人警醒的事。

eye-opening.t: 令人大开眼界的；发人深省的

e.en: Her report gave us an {eye-opening} look at rural schools.
e.zh: 她的报告让我们大开眼界地了解了乡村学校。

e.en: It was {eye-opening} to see how much food was wasted.
e.zh: 看到浪费了这么多食物，确实发人深省。

e.en: Adjust the {eye-piece} before looking through the telescope.
e.zh: 通过望远镜观察前，先调整目镜。

e.en: The mask has a soft {eye-piece} for better comfort.
e.zh: 这个面罩有柔软的眼部件，戴起来更舒服。

e.en: The garden has an {eye-pleasing} mix of colors.
e.zh: 这座花园色彩搭配赏心悦目。

e.en: She chose an {eye-pleasing} layout for the brochure.
e.zh: 她为宣传册选了一个好看的版式。

eye-popper.t: 极吸引眼球的东西；惊人之物

e.en: Her red evening dress was an {eye-popper} at the party.
e.zh: 她那条红色晚礼服在聚会上格外吸睛。

e.en: The final price was an {eye-popper} for every bidder.
e.zh: 最终价格让每个竞标者都吃了一惊。

e.en: The museum displayed {eye-popping} jewels from the royal collection.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了王室收藏中极其抢眼的珠宝。

e.en: They reported an {eye-popping} increase in online sales.
e.zh: 他们报告说线上销售额出现了惊人的增长。

e.en: The bird has a bright white {eye-ring}.
e.zh: 这只鸟有一圈明亮的白色眼圈。

e.en: Dark {eye-ring} marks made the mask look dramatic.
e.zh: 深色眼周环纹让面具显得很有戏剧感。

e.en: The old manager called him an {eye-servant} who stopped working when unobserved.
e.zh: 老经理说他是个没人盯着就停工的人。

e.en: An {eye-servant} may appear busy only when the boss is near.
e.zh: 只在监督下干活的人，往往老板在旁边才显得忙碌。

eye-service.t: 表面敷衍；只为讨好监督者的服务

e.en: The supervisor disliked work done only as {eye-service}.
e.zh: 主管不喜欢那种只做给人看的敷衍工作。

e.en: True loyalty is more than {eye-service} when leaders are watching.
e.zh: 真正的忠诚不只是领导在场时做表面功夫。

e.en: She applied blue {eye-shadow} before the performance.
e.zh: 演出前她涂了蓝色眼影。

e.en: This {eye-shadow} looks natural in daylight.
e.zh: 这款眼影在日光下看起来很自然。

e.en: The injury left swelling around his {eye-socket}.
e.zh: 那次受伤使他的眼眶周围肿了起来。

e.en: The skull's {eye-socket} was clearly visible in the model.
e.zh: 模型上头骨的眼窝清晰可见。

e.en: Researchers used {eye-tracking} to study reading patterns.
e.zh: 研究人员用眼动追踪来研究阅读模式。

e.en: The new headset supports {eye-tracking} for faster controls.
e.zh: 这款新头显支持眼动追踪，控制起来更快。

eye-watering.t: 贵得惊人的；刺眼流泪的

e.en: The restaurant charged an {eye-watering} price for a simple salad.
e.zh: 这家餐厅一份普通沙拉要价高得惊人。

e.en: The smoke was so thick and {eye-watering} that we left.
e.zh: 烟太浓，熏得人流泪，我们只好离开。

e.en: Only one trail was {eyeable} from the ridge.
e.zh: 从山脊上只能看见一条小径。

e.en: The editor wanted every photo to be {eyeable} at thumbnail size.
e.zh: 编辑希望每张照片缩成小图时也值得一看。

e.en: The negotiators sat {eyeball-to-eyeball} across the table.
e.zh: 谈判双方隔着桌子面对面坐着。

e.en: The two rivals stood {eyeball-to-eyeball} before the final vote.
e.zh: 最终投票前，两名对手直接对峙。

e.en: The hospital runs an {eyebank} for cornea donations.
e.zh: 这家医院设有眼库，用于角膜捐献。

e.en: An {eyebank} must screen donated tissue carefully.
e.zh: 眼库必须仔细筛查捐献组织。

e.en: The fish has a dark {eyebar} across its face.
e.zh: 这条鱼脸上有一道深色眼部横纹。

e.en: The hinge uses an {eyebar} to hold the pin.
e.zh: 这个铰链用一个眼形杆件固定插销。

e.en: Use the {eyebath} to rinse dust from your eye.
e.zh: 用洗眼杯把眼里的灰尘冲出来。

e.en: The nurse prepared an {eyebath} after the chemical splash.
e.zh: 化学品溅入眼睛后，护士准备了洗眼液。

eyebeam.t: 眼中射出的目光或光束

e.en: The comic hero fired an {eyebeam} at the robot.
e.zh: 漫画英雄从眼中射出光束击中了机器人。

e.en: His cold {eyebeam} seemed to silence the room.
e.zh: 他冰冷的目光仿佛让整个房间安静下来。

e.en: The quarterback wore {eyeblack} under both eyes.
e.zh: 四分卫在两只眼睛下方都涂了防眩黑膏。

e.en: Some players write messages on their {eyeblack}.
e.zh: 有些球员会在眼下黑膏上写字。

e.en: Attach the rope securely to the {eyebolt}.
e.zh: 把绳子牢牢系在吊环螺栓上。

e.en: The ceiling {eyebolt} was rated for heavy loads.
e.zh: 天花板上的吊环螺栓可承受重物。

e.en: The herbalist recommended {eyebright} for tired eyes.
e.zh: 草药师推荐用小米草缓解眼睛疲劳。

e.en: Wild {eyebright} grows in short grassland.
e.zh: 野生小米草生长在低矮草地上。

e.en: Fill the {eyecup} with sterile saline before rinsing.
e.zh: 冲洗前先把洗眼杯装满无菌盐水。

e.en: The camera's rubber {eyecup} blocks stray light.
e.zh: 相机的橡胶目镜罩能挡住杂光。

e.en: The doctor examined the {eyeground} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了眼底。

e.en: Changes in the {eyeground} may reveal disease.
e.zh: 眼底的变化可能显示疾病。

e.en: Wear an {eyeguard} during the procedure.
e.zh: 操作时要戴上护目罩。

e.en: The helmet included a clear {eyeguard}.
e.zh: 这顶头盔配有透明护目片。

e.en: She fastened the dress with an {eyehook}.
e.zh: 她用眼钩扣好裙子。

e.en: The surgeon used a tiny {eyehook}.
e.zh: 外科医生使用了一个小眼钩。

e.en: The {eyeleteer} worked beside the shoemaker.
e.zh: 打孔工在鞋匠旁边干活。

e.en: An experienced {eyeleteer} can finish quickly.
e.zh: 有经验的装孔工能很快完成。

e.en: A sudden {eyelight} showed her excitement.
e.zh: 她眼中突然的亮光显出兴奋。

e.en: The portrait lacks a natural {eyelight}.
e.zh: 这幅肖像缺少自然的眼神光。

e.en: The painter added bright {eyelights} last.
e.zh: 画家最后加上明亮的眼神光。

e.en: Her {eyelights} faded when she heard the news.
e.zh: 她听到消息后眼里的光暗了下来。

e.en: The shell had an {eyelike} spot.
e.zh: 贝壳上有一个像眼睛的斑点。

e.en: An {eyelike} opening stared from the wall.
e.zh: 墙上一个眼状开口像在凝视。

eyeminded.t: 重视觉的；以眼见为主的

e.en: He is strongly {eyeminded} when learning.
e.zh: 他学习时很依赖视觉。

e.en: An {eyeminded} reader notices layout first.
e.zh: 偏重视觉的读者会先注意版式。

e.en: The old poem says his {eyen} shone.
e.zh: 那首古诗写道他的双眼闪亮。

e.en: Editors kept {eyen} for its archaic flavor.
e.zh: 编辑保留eyen以保持古雅味道。

e.en: Tighten the {eyenut} before lifting.
e.zh: 起吊前先拧紧吊环螺母。

e.en: The cable was secured to an {eyenut}.
e.zh: 缆绳固定在一个有眼螺母上。

e.en: Dust collected in the statue's {eyepit}.
e.zh: 灰尘积在雕像的眼窝里。

e.en: A bruise darkened his left {eyepit}.
e.zh: 一块瘀伤使他的左眼窝发暗。

e.en: Adjust the lens to the correct {eyepoint}.
e.zh: 把镜头调到正确的视点。

e.en: The camera simulates a driver's {eyepoint}.
e.zh: 相机模拟驾驶者的观察点。

e.en: Every {eyer} saw the flaw at once.
e.zh: 每个观看者都立刻看出瑕疵。

e.en: The suspicious {eyer} studied the door.
e.zh: 那个多疑的注视者打量着门。

e.en: The tower stood within {eyereach}.
e.zh: 那座塔就在视力所及之处。

e.en: Keep the child within {eyereach}.
e.zh: 让孩子待在目光能看到的范围内。

e.en: The bird has a white {eyering}.
e.zh: 这只鸟有一圈白色眼环。

e.en: Fatigue left a dark {eyering}.
e.zh: 疲劳让他留下了一圈黑眼圈。

eyes-only.t: 仅限本人阅览；绝密传阅

e.en: The memo was marked {eyes-only}.
e.zh: 这份备忘录标为仅限本人阅览。

e.en: Send the report as an {eyes-only} file.
e.zh: 把报告作为绝密传阅文件发送。

e.en: The manager disliked an {eyeservant}.
e.zh: 经理不喜欢只在眼前卖力的人。

e.en: An {eyeservant} works only when watched.
e.zh: 眼前仆役式的人只在被看着时干活。

eyeservice.t: 做给人看的服务；表面勤快

e.en: His loyalty was mere {eyeservice}.
e.zh: 他的忠诚只是做给人看的。

e.en: The rule warns against {eyeservice} at work.
e.zh: 这条规矩告诫人们不要只表面勤快。

e.en: The nurse taped an {eyeshield} in place.
e.zh: 护士用胶带固定好护眼罩。

e.en: A plastic {eyeshield} blocked the sparks.
e.zh: 塑料护眼片挡住了火花。

e.en: The cottage looked {eyesome} in spring.
e.zh: 春天里那间小屋看起来很悦目。

e.en: She chose an {eyesome} arrangement of flowers.
e.zh: 她选了一种好看的插花摆法。

e.en: The butterfly wing has an {eyespot}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀上有一个眼状斑。

e.en: The organism uses an {eyespot} to sense light.
e.zh: 这种生物用感光点感知光线。

eyestone.t: 眼石；旧时清眼异物的小石

e.en: She kept an {eyestone} in a small box.
e.zh: 她把一颗眼石放在小盒子里。

e.en: Old remedies praised the {eyestone}.
e.zh: 旧时疗法很推崇这种清眼石。

e.en: The strain seemed to pull his {eyestrings}.
e.zh: 那种紧张像是在拉扯他的眼筋。

e.en: Old writers mentioned the {eyestrings} in pain.
e.zh: 旧时作者提到疼痛中的眼部肌腱。

e.en: Her upper {eyeteeth} were unusually sharp.
e.zh: 她的上犬齿格外尖。

e.en: He would give his {eyeteeth} for that chance.
e.zh: 为了那个机会，他会付出很大代价。

e.en: The dentist said my left {eyetooth} was chipped.
e.zh: 牙医说我的左犬齿崩了一小块。

e.en: He would give his {eyeteeth} for that rare book.
e.zh: 他为了那本珍本书愿意付出很大代价。

e.en: Cold wind made {eyewater} run down her cheeks.
e.zh: 冷风吹得她泪水顺着脸颊流下来。

e.en: The old letter brought {eyewater} to his eyes.
e.zh: 那封旧信让他眼里泛起泪水。

e.en: She answered with a quick {eyewink}.
e.zh: 她迅速眨了眨眼作为回答。

e.en: The chance vanished in an {eyewink}.
e.zh: 机会在一瞬间就消失了。

e.en: The playful {eyewinker} kept teasing the audience.
e.zh: 那个爱眨眼逗趣的人一直在逗观众。

e.en: A speck of dust caught on her {eyewinker}.
e.zh: 一粒灰尘粘在了她的睫毛上。

e.en: An {eyewitnes} described the crash to police.
e.zh: 一名目击者向警方描述了那起撞车事故。

e.en: The report quoted an {eyewitnes} from the scene.
e.zh: 报道引用了现场一名目击者的话。

e.en: The clinic used an {eykometer} to check his vision.
e.zh: 诊所用视力计检查他的视力。

e.en: An old {eykometer} stood beside the examination chair.
e.zh: 一台老式眼科测量仪放在检查椅旁边。

e.en: They picnicked on a grassy {eyot} in the Thames.
e.zh: 他们在泰晤士河上一座长满草的小岛上野餐。

e.en: Floodwater nearly covered the low {eyot}.
e.zh: 洪水几乎淹没了那座低矮的河心小岛。

e.en: The keeper identified the animal as an {eyra}.
e.zh: 饲养员认出那只动物是赤褐色美洲野猫。

e.en: An {eyra} moved silently through the forest shadows.
e.zh: 一只赤褐色美洲野猫悄无声息地穿过林间阴影。

e.en: The old price was listed in {eyrir}.
e.zh: 旧价格用冰岛旧辅币单位标出。

e.en: Collectors still discuss coins worth a few {eyrir}.
e.zh: 收藏者仍会谈起面值几个冰岛旧辅币的硬币。

e.en: The eagle guarded its {eyry} on the cliff.
e.zh: 那只鹰守着悬崖上的巢。

e.en: Their mountain cabin felt like an {eyry}.
e.zh: 他们的山间小屋像一处高高在上的居所。

e.en: She writes a monthly {ezine} about indie films.
e.zh: 她每月写一份关于独立电影的电子杂志。

e.en: The club sent its {ezine} to thousands of subscribers.
e.zh: 俱乐部把电子杂志发给了数千名订阅者。

east-north-east.t: 东东北方向；东偏北东北

e.en: The old compass marked {east-north-east} clearly.
e.zh: 那只旧罗盘清楚标出了东东北方向。

e.en: The wind shifted to {east-north-east} overnight.
e.zh: 夜里风向转成了东东北。

east-northeast.t: 东东北方向；东偏北东北

e.en: The boat sailed {east-northeast} toward the island.
e.zh: 小船向东东北方向驶向那座岛。

e.en: A cold wind blew from the {east-northeast}.
e.zh: 一阵冷风从东东北方向吹来。

east-south-east.t: 东东南方向；东偏南东南

e.en: The ridge runs {east-south-east} across the map.
e.zh: 那道山脊在地图上沿东东南方向延伸。

e.en: They steered {east-south-east} after sunrise.
e.zh: 日出后他们朝东东南方向航行。

east-southeast.t: 东东南方向；东偏南东南

e.en: The storm moved {east-southeast} during the afternoon.
e.zh: 下午风暴向东东南方向移动。

e.en: Our campsite lay {east-southeast} of the lake.
e.zh: 我们的营地位于湖的东东南方向。

e.en: The road forms an {east-west} route.
e.zh: 这条路形成了一条东西向路线。

e.en: Trade created stronger {east-west} connections.
e.zh: 贸易加强了东西之间的联系。

e.en: The ship went {eastabout} around the cape.
e.zh: 那艘船向东绕过海角航行。

e.en: They chose an {eastabout} route home.
e.zh: 他们选择了一条经东向回家的路线。

e.en: The merchant was called an {easterling} in old tales.
e.zh: 在古老故事里，那位商人被称作东方人。

e.en: An {easterling} wind chilled the harbor.
e.zh: 一阵来自东方的风使港口变冷。

e.en: The designer tried to {easternize} the room.
e.zh: 设计师试图让这个房间带上东方风格。

e.en: Some reforms aimed to {easternize} court rituals.
e.zh: 一些改革旨在使宫廷礼仪东方化。

e.en: The {eastmost} tower catches sunrise first.
e.zh: 最东边的塔最先照到日光。

e.en: They camped near the {eastmost} point.
e.zh: 他们在最靠东的地点附近扎营。

e.en: She grew up on the {eastside}.
e.zh: 她在城市东区长大。

e.en: The {eastside} entrance closes at six.
e.zh: 东侧入口六点关闭。

e.en: The plane turned {eastsoutheast} over the coast.
e.zh: 飞机在海岸上空转向东东南。

e.en: Rain clouds gathered to the {eastsoutheast}.
e.zh: 雨云在东东南方向聚集。

e.en: He thought the scheme was {easy-money}.
e.zh: 他以为这个计划能轻松赚钱。

e.en: The boom depended on {easy-money} policies.
e.zh: 这场繁荣依赖于宽松信贷政策。

e.en: This puzzle is {easy-peasy} for her.
e.zh: 这个谜题对她来说小菜一碟。

e.en: Just follow the steps; it is {easy-peasy}.
e.zh: 照着步骤做就行，真的很容易。

e.en: The surgeon studied a rare case of {ectopagia}.
e.zh: 外科医生研究了一例罕见的外寄生畸胎联体。

e.en: Medical texts describe {ectopagia} as a severe anomaly.
e.zh: 医学文献把外寄生畸胎联体描述为一种严重畸形。

e.en: A tick is a common {ectoparasite} of mammals.
e.zh: 蜱是哺乳动物常见的体外寄生虫。

e.en: The vet checked the dog for an {ectoparasite}.
e.zh: 兽医检查那只狗是否有体外寄生虫。

e.en: Fleas survive through {ectoparasitism} on warm-blooded hosts.
e.zh: 跳蚤通过在温血宿主身上的体外寄生生存。

e.en: The paper compared {ectoparasitism} in several bird species.
e.zh: 论文比较了几种鸟类中的体外寄生现象。

e.en: The diagram labels the insect's {ectophallus}.
e.zh: 图示标出了昆虫的外阴茎。

e.en: Researchers measured the {ectophallus} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下测量外阴茎。

e.en: The old manual mentions {ectophylaxination} of wounds.
e.zh: 那本旧手册提到了伤口的外部防护处理。

e.en: Doctors once debated {ectophylaxination} after exposure.
e.zh: 医生们曾讨论暴露后的外部防护处理。

e.en: The fungus behaves like an {ectophyte}.
e.zh: 这种真菌的表现像体表寄生植物。

e.en: An {ectophyte} grows on the host's surface.
e.zh: 体表寄生植物生长在宿主表面。

e.en: The scan revealed {ectopia} of the kidney.
e.zh: 扫描显示肾脏存在异位。

e.en: Untreated {ectopia} can cause serious complications.
e.zh: 未经处理的器官异位可能引起严重并发症。

e.en: The fossil shows an {ectoplacodial} structure.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出外板层结构。

e.en: Biologists used {ectoplacodial} features for classification.
e.zh: 生物学家用外板层特征进行分类。

e.en: An {ectoproct} colony covered the rock.
e.zh: 一群外肛动物覆盖了那块岩石。

e.en: The student identified the sample as an {ectoproct}.
e.zh: 学生把这个样本鉴定为外肛动物。

e.en: The lesion lay near the {ectorhinal} cortex.
e.zh: 病灶位于鼻外侧皮层附近。

e.en: Researchers mapped {ectorhinal} brain activity.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了鼻区外侧脑活动图。

e.en: The amoeba's {ectosarc} looked clear under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后，变形虫的外质看起来很清晰。

e.en: Movement begins when the {ectosarc} changes shape.
e.zh: 当外质改变形状时，运动就开始了。

e.en: The specimen had an {ectosarcous} outer layer.
e.zh: 这个标本有一层外部肉质层。

e.en: Older zoology texts describe the organism as {ectosarcous}.
e.zh: 较早的动物学文本把这种生物描述为外肉质的。

e.en: A crab's {ectoskeleton} protects its soft body.
e.zh: 螃蟹的外骨骼保护它柔软的身体。

e.en: The insect shed its old {ectoskeleton} overnight.
e.zh: 这只昆虫一夜之间蜕去了旧外骨骼。

e.en: The scan showed a small {ectostosis} near the joint.
e.zh: 扫描显示关节附近有一处小的骨外增生。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {ectostosis} for any rapid growth.
e.zh: 医生监测这处骨外生是否快速增大。

e.en: The mite lives as an {ectosymbiont} on the beetle.
e.zh: 这种螨作为体外共生生物生活在甲虫身上。

e.en: Researchers identified a new {ectosymbiont} on the coral surface.
e.zh: 研究人员在珊瑚表面发现了一种新的体外共生生物。

e.en: A lizard is an {ectotherm} that warms itself in sunlight.
e.zh: 蜥蜴是变温动物，会靠晒太阳取暖。

e.en: Each {ectotherm} in the study reacted strongly to air temperature.
e.zh: 研究中的每种外温动物都对气温反应明显。

e.en: The bacterium released an {ectotoxin} into the surrounding tissue.
e.zh: 这种细菌向周围组织释放了一种外毒素。

e.en: Scientists measured the {ectotoxin} in the culture fluid.
e.zh: 科学家测量了培养液中的体外毒素含量。

e.en: The fungus forms an {ectotrophic} relationship with tree roots.
e.zh: 这种真菌与树根形成外营养关系。

e.en: An {ectotrophic} mycorrhiza grows around the root surface.
e.zh: 外营养菌根会在根的表面周围生长。

e.en: The parasite showed {ectotropic} growth on the host surface.
e.zh: 这种寄生物在宿主体表表现出趋外生长。

e.en: They described the infection as mainly {ectotropic}.
e.zh: 他们把这种感染描述为主要发生在外部组织。

e.en: The flea is a common {ectozoan} on mammals.
e.zh: 跳蚤是哺乳动物身上常见的体外寄生动物。

e.en: A tiny {ectozoan} was found clinging to the fish's skin.
e.zh: 一只微小的体外寄生动物附着在鱼皮上。

ectozoic.t: 体外寄生的；外生动物的

e.en: Ticks have an {ectozoic} life on their hosts.
e.zh: 蜱在宿主身上过着体外寄生生活。

e.en: The report listed several {ectozoic} species from the survey.
e.zh: 报告列出了调查中发现的几种体外寄生物种。

e.en: The old textbook called the louse an {ectozoon}.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把虱子称为体外寄生动物。

e.en: Each {ectozoon} was removed carefully from the bird's feathers.
e.zh: 每只体外寄生动物都被小心地从鸟羽上取下。

e.en: The child was born with {ectrodactyly} of one hand.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时一只手有裂手畸形。

e.en: Genetic counseling helped the family understand {ectrodactyly}.
e.zh: 遗传咨询帮助这个家庭了解缺指畸形。

e.en: The geologist identified the dark mineral as {elaterite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这种深色矿物鉴定为弹沥青。

e.en: Old reports mention {elaterite} in the coal seam.
e.zh: 旧报告提到煤层中有弹性沥青矿。

e.en: Physicians once used {elaterium} as a powerful purgative.
e.zh: 医生过去曾把喷瓜泻药用作强力泻剂。

e.en: The herbal manual warned that {elaterium} could be dangerous.
e.zh: 草药手册警告说喷瓜汁干品可能有危险。

e.en: The technician tested the rubber with an {elaterometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用弹力计测试了这块橡胶。

e.en: An {elaterometer} can compare the resilience of different materials.
e.zh: 弹性测量器可以比较不同材料的回弹性。

e.en: The grammar book explains the {elative} form of the adjective.
e.zh: 这本语法书解释了形容词的极度级形式。

e.en: Her praise sounded almost {elative} in its intensity.
e.zh: 她的赞美强烈得几乎有些出格。

e.en: The manuscript uses {elavation} where modern editors write elevation.
e.zh: 这份手稿用了elavation，现代编辑会写作elevation。

e.en: The old spelling {elavation} appears in a medical note.
e.zh: 这个旧拼法elavation出现在一则医学记录中。

e.en: Commuters stood {elbow-to-elbow} on the crowded train.
e.zh: 通勤者在拥挤的列车上肩并肩站着。

e.en: The volunteers worked {elbow-to-elbow} throughout the long night.
e.zh: 志愿者们整夜并肩工作。

e.en: He rested his arm on the chair's {elbowboard}.
e.zh: 他把手臂放在椅子的扶手板上。

e.en: The carpenter replaced the cracked {elbowboard} beside the seat.
e.zh: 木匠更换了座位旁开裂的肘托板。

e.en: The old {elbowchair} stood beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 那把旧扶手椅放在壁炉旁。

e.en: She chose an {elbowchair} with carved wooden arms.
e.zh: 她选了一把带雕花木扶手的扶手椅。

e.en: The physician noted early {elcosis} in the patient's stomach.
e.zh: 医生注意到患者胃部有早期溃疡形成。

e.en: Untreated inflammation may lead to {elcosis} of the tissue.
e.zh: 未治疗的炎症可能导致组织溃疡病变。

e.en: In {eld}, he became gentler and more patient.
e.zh: 到了老年，他变得更温和也更有耐心。

e.en: The poet wrote of heroes from days of {eld}.
e.zh: 诗人写到古昔岁月中的英雄。

e.en: The text prints {eldder} as a variant of elder.
e.zh: 这段文字把eldder印作elder的变体。

e.en: An {eldder} spelling appears in the old parish record.
e.zh: 那份旧教区记录中出现了eldder这个旧拼法。

e.en: His slight {elderliness} showed in his careful steps.
e.zh: 他谨慎的步伐显出些许老态。

e.en: The portrait captures her {elderliness} without making her seem frail.
e.zh: 这幅肖像捕捉到她的年老之态，却不让她显得虚弱。

e.en: He accepted {eldership} in the local church.
e.zh: 他接受了当地教会的长老职位。

e.en: In that community, {eldership} carried real authority.
e.zh: 在那个社区里，长者身份带有真正的权威。

e.en: The old word {elding} meant fuel for a fire.
e.zh: 古词elding指生火用的燃料。

e.en: They gathered dry {elding} before nightfall.
e.zh: 他们在天黑前收集干柴作燃料。

e.en: The village {eldress} spoke first at the meeting.
e.zh: 村里的女长老在会上首先发言。

e.en: An {eldress} in the family kept the old stories alive.
e.zh: 家中一位年长女子保留着那些旧故事。

e.en: The poet praised the wisdom of the {elds}.
e.zh: 诗人赞颂前辈长者的智慧。

e.en: Our {elds} would have found this custom strange.
e.zh: 我们的先人会觉得这种习俗很奇怪。

e.en: The herbalist dried {elecampane} roots for winter remedies.
e.zh: 草药师晒干土木香根，用作冬季药方。

e.en: Tall {elecampane} grew beside the cottage wall.
e.zh: 高高的土木香长在小屋墙边。

e.en: The workshop used {elecroforming} to make thin metal shells.
e.zh: 车间用电成型制作薄金属壳。

e.en: A typo changed electroforming into {elecroforming} in the report.
e.zh: 报告里的拼写错误把electroforming写成了elecroforming。

e.en: The headline split {elect-ion} awkwardly across two lines.
e.zh: 标题把election生硬地断成elect-ion分到两行。

e.en: She corrected {elect-ion} to election in the proof.
e.zh: 她在校样中把elect-ion改成了election。

e.en: The party worried about the candidate's {electability}.
e.zh: 该党担心这名候选人的胜选可能。

e.en: Polls often shape public ideas of {electability}.
e.zh: 民调常会影响公众对可当选性的判断。

e.en: The note used {elephantiasicc} where elephantiasis was meant.
e.zh: 这条笔记本想写象皮病，却写成了elephantiasicc。

e.en: Doctors would not recognize {elephantiasicc} as a standard term.
e.zh: 医生不会把elephantiasicc视为规范术语。

e.en: The old chemistry text spelled enzyme as {enzym}.
e.zh: 那本旧化学书把enzyme拼作enzym。

e.en: An {enzym} can speed up a biological reaction.
e.zh: 酶能加快生物反应的速度。

e.en: The {euthermophilous} microbe thrived in hot springs.
e.zh: 这种嗜热微生物在温泉中生长旺盛。

e.en: Researchers tested several {euthermophilous} bacteria in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室测试了几种适高温细菌。

e.en: Customers complained about the {exorbitance} of the fees.
e.zh: 顾客抱怨收费高得离谱。

e.en: The judge criticized the {exorbitance} of the claim.
e.zh: 法官批评这项索赔要求过分。

e.en: The satellite provides {earthwatch} data for climate researchers.
e.zh: 这颗卫星为气候研究人员提供地球观测数据。

e.en: Volunteers joined an {earthwatch} project along the coast.
e.zh: 志愿者参加了沿海地区的环境监测项目。

e.en: The police interviewed an {earwitness} who heard the argument.
e.zh: 警方询问了一名听到争吵的听觉证人。

e.en: An {earwitness} may misremember voices under stress.
e.zh: 听觉证人在压力下可能会记错声音。

e.en: They spent an {easeful} afternoon by the quiet lake.
e.zh: 他们在安静的湖边度过了一个安适的下午。

e.en: The poem moves in an {easeful} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗以舒缓的节奏推进。

e.en: She settled {easefully} into the old armchair.
e.zh: 她从容安适地坐进那把旧扶手椅。

e.en: The melody drifted {easefully} through the room.
e.zh: 旋律舒缓地飘过房间。

e.en: He endured an {easeless} night of pain.
e.zh: 他忍受了一个疼痛不止、无法安睡的夜晚。

e.en: The city kept its {easeless} rhythm after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，这座城市仍保持着无休止的节奏。

e.en: The therapist taught simple {easers} for shoulder tension.
e.zh: 治疗师教了几个缓解肩部紧张的简单动作。

e.en: Low interest rates acted as {easers} for struggling borrowers.
e.zh: 低利率对困难借款人起到了缓解压力的作用。

e.en: Rain spread across the {east-central} part of the country.
e.zh: 降雨扩展到该国中东部地区。

e.en: The dialect is common in {east-central} Europe.
e.zh: 这种方言在欧洲中东部较为常见。
